papers.title: Toward Robust and 3D-Aware RGB-NIR Imaging in the Dark
papers.abstract_en: Robust low-light imaging remains challenging for the community. Recent studies have explored fusing Near-Infrared (NIR) with noisy RGB to achieve improved enhancement, yet most methods depend on carefully curated training data pairs, with limited robustness under different scenarios. This paper offers a new perspective for RGB-NIR low-light imaging by incorporating 3D-aware neural modeling. Without using clean RGB supervision, a powerful model can be optimized to implicitly fuse extremely noisy RGB observations with NIR cues in 3D space, effectively recovering clean RGB images. The proposed model obviates the requirement for clean RGB data collection, generalizes across different noise levels. Extensive evaluations on synthetic and real data demonstrate its superiority. Codes available: https://github.com/MyNiuuu/3DarkFusion
papers.comment: ACM Multimedia 2026, Codes and Models: https://github.com/MyNiuuu/3DarkFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向暗光环境的 RGB-NIR 成像新思路，引入 3D-aware 神经建模，在无需干净 RGB 真值监督的情况下，将极噪 RGB 观测与 NIR 线索在三维空间中隐式融合以恢复干净 RGB 图像。摘要称该方法免除了干净 RGB 数据采集需求，并能跨不同噪声水平泛化，在合成与真实数据上的评估均显示优势。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有 RGB-NIR 低光融合方法依赖精心制作的数据配对，在不同场景下鲁棒性有限；本文旨在摆脱对干净 RGB 监督数据的依赖，提升跨噪声水平的泛化能力。
Method: 提出 3D-aware 神经建模方法，在三维空间中将极度噪声的 RGB 观测与 NIR 信息进行隐式融合，不使用干净 RGB 作为监督信号即可优化模型并恢复清晰 RGB 图像。
Result: 在合成数据和真实数据上的大量评估表明，该方法相对现有方案具有优越性，并能在不同噪声水平下泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 3D-aware 神经建模为 RGB-NIR 低光成像提供了新视角，能避免干净 RGB 数据收集成本并提升鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: We study empirical scaling properties for text conditioning in visual generation. Such properties have rarely been measured because diffusion loss does not scale with the number of tokens in natural-language prompts. Surprisingly, we find that the converged diffusion loss scales with the amount of structured language in the prompt. To quantify structured language, we adapt two complementary measures: a white-box likelihood metric (GPG) and a black-box attribute metric (ED). Across controlled training runs, the converged diffusion loss decreases approximately linearly with GPG and follows a power law with ED. Guided by these scaling properties, we improve \emph{diffusability} by constructing structured prompts with semantic and geometric annotations derived from images, and improve \emph{promptability} by training a prompter through supervised fine-tuning, cold-start, and verifier-gated on-policy distillation. The resulting system outperforms all evaluated open-weight models on nearly every compositional, reasoning, and world-knowledge benchmark, while matching or surpassing the strongest closed-weight models on most evaluations.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉生成中文本条件化的经验缩放性质，发现收敛的扩散损失（diffusion loss）与提示中的结构化语言量相关。作者提出白盒似然度量（GPG）和黑盒属性度量（ED）来量化结构化语言，观察到收敛扩散损失随GPG近似线性下降、随ED呈幂律关系。据此改进可扩散性（diffusability）与可提示性（promptability），构建结构化提示并训练prompter，在组合性、推理和世界知识基准上优于所有评估的开源权重模型，并在多数评估上匹敌或超越最强闭源权重模型。
Motivation: 文本条件化在视觉生成中的缩放性质很少被测量，因为扩散损失不随自然语言提示中的token数量扩展。作者希望找到能反映生成质量的结构化语言度量，并利用这些性质指导文本到图像生成的改进。
Method: 提出两种互补度量：白盒似然度量（GPG）和黑盒属性度量（ED）。改进可扩散性时，从图像推导语义与几何注释来构建结构化提示；改进可提示性时，通过监督微调、冷启动和验证器门控的on-policy蒸馏训练一个prompter。
Result: 受控训练中，收敛扩散损失随GPG近似线性下降，随ED呈幂律下降。最终系统在几乎所有组合性、推理和世界知识基准上超过所有评估的开源权重模型，并在大多数评估上匹敌或超过最强闭源权重模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构化语言量是影响文本条件视觉生成中扩散损失的重要缩放因素，利用该性质可显著提升生成性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ExtractBench: A Benchmark for Schema-Guided Enterprise Document Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise workflows increasingly rely on agents for \emph{schema-guided extraction}: given a document and a user-defined schema, the agent faithfully follows the schema to produce the correct output with source evidence as grounding metadata. We present ExtractBench, a benchmark for schema-guided extraction and, to our knowledge, the first to score value accuracy, record completeness at scale, grounding, and measured cost together. The evaluation system contains 4,869 pages across 370 enterprise documents, 8 business domains, and 67 document types, with clear tags differentiating their challenge scenarios. The scalable schema and ground-truth curation pipeline combines independent-system agreement for real documents, known values for synthetic lists, and human verification for forms. We report order-insensitive value F1 for value accuracy, plus two grounding metrics for source traceability: word- and page-level F1. Commercial VLMs perform well on short documents but often truncate record lists on long ones, while coding agents retain higher accuracy at much higher cost. LlamaExtract Agentic Plus ranks first on all three metrics, with accuracy comparable to coding agents at a fraction of the cost. Dataset and evaluation code are available on \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/ExtractBench}{HuggingFace} and \href{https://github.com/run-llama/ExtractBench}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExtractBench，一个面向模式引导抽取 (schema-guided extraction) 的基准，据称是首个同时评测值准确率、大规模记录完整性、grounding 与实测成本的基准。评测集包含 370 份企业文档、4,869 页、8 个业务领域和 67 种文档类型，并带有区分挑战场景的标签。作者报告了序不敏感的值 F1 以及词级和页级 grounding F1；商业 VLM 在短文档上表现良好但常在长文档上截断记录列表，而 coding agents 准确率更高但成本显著更高，LlamaExtract Agentic Plus 在三个指标上均排名第一。
Motivation: 企业工作流日益依赖 agent 根据用户定义的 schema 从文档中抽取结构化信息，但缺少能在同一基准上同时衡量值准确率、大规模记录完整性、来源可追溯性 (grounding) 和成本的评估体系。
Method: 构建 ExtractBench 评测系统，包含 4,869 页、370 份企业文档、8 个业务领域和 67 种文档类型；采用可扩展的 schema 与真值构建管线：真实文档用独立系统一致性、合成列表用已知值、表单用人工验证。评估使用序不敏感值 F1，以及词级和页级 F1 两个 grounding 指标。
Result: 摘要报告商业 VLM 在短文档上表现良好但常在长文档上截断记录列表；coding agents 保持更高准确率但成本高得多；LlamaExtract Agentic Plus 在值准确率、grounding 两项指标上均排名第一，准确率与 coding agents 相当且成本低得多。
Conclusion: 该基准首次联合考虑准确率、完整性、grounding 和成本，并揭示长文档记录完整性是现有 VLM 的短板；数据集与评估代码已公开在 HuggingFace 和 GitHub 上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentially Private Nonparametric Modal Learning with Applications to Regression and Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Density modes provide a localized and interpretable summary of multimodal distributions, but their estimation under rigorous differential privacy constraints remains largely unexplored. We study differentially private recovery of density modes for multivariate distributions under local smoothness, curvature, and separation conditions. We propose DP-GRAMS, a mean-shift inspired method that performs noisy ascent on a differentially private score estimator. Assuming the density belongs locally to a Hölder class with smoothness parameter $β> 2$, our score estimator uses bias-reducing higher-order kernels, and then enforces privacy in the gradient ascent steps via gradient clipping and calibrated Gaussian noise. A private initialization scheme combines a density-aware utility with a suppression rule and, with $k\asymp M\log n$ draws over a public $h_{\mathrm{DAP}}$-grid and suppression radius $ρ_{\mathrm{init}}\asymp (\log n)^{-1/d}$, achieves high-probability coverage of the modal basins by successively suppressing selected local neighborhoods in competitive regions, while correlated noise across multiple starts enables joint release under a single $(\varepsilon,δ)$-differential privacy guarantee. We prove that all population modes are recovered with high probability and establish asymptotic error rates of the form $O\!\left((\tfrac{\log n}{n})^{\frac{2(β-1)}{d+2β}}\right) + O\!\left((\tfrac{\mathrm{polylog}(n,δ)}{n^2\varepsilon^2})^{\frac{β-1}{d+β}}\right)$. We also provide minimax lower bounds for private mode estimation, and show that our estimators are nearly optimal, up to a logarithmic factor in the MSE. We present two natural extensions: DP-PMS, a private modal-regression method, and DP-GRAMS-C, a clustering pipeline. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate favorable privacy-utility trade-offs relative to common baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多元分布在严格差分隐私约束下的密度众数 (density modes) 恢复问题，提出均值漂移启发的 DP-GRAMS 方法：在差分隐私的得分估计器上做带噪梯度上升，并配合私有初始化与抑制规则。作者证明该方法能以高概率恢复所有总体众数，给出渐近误差率与私有众数估计的 minimax 下界，并展示 DP-PMS（私有众数回归）和 DP-GRAMS-C（聚类）两个扩展。合成与真实数据实验表明其隐私-效用权衡优于常见基线。
Motivation: 密度众数提供了多峰分布的局部、可解释摘要，但在严格差分隐私约束下的估计问题此前基本未被探索，本文旨在填补这一空白并给出理论保证。
Method: 提出 DP-GRAMS：假设局部密度属于光滑参数 β>2 的 Hölder 类，使用降偏差的高阶核构造私有得分估计器，并在梯度上升步骤中通过梯度裁剪 (gradient clipping) 和校准高斯噪声实现隐私保护。私有初始化结合密度感知效用与抑制规则，在公共 h_DAP 网格上采 k≍M log n 个起点，通过连续抑制竞争区域中的局部邻域以覆盖众数盆地；来自多个起点的相关噪声允许在单一 (ε,δ)-差分隐私保证下联合发布。
Result: 证明所有总体众数都能以高概率被恢复，并建立形如 O((log n/n)^{2(β-1)/(d+2β)}) + O((polylog(n,δ)/(n^2 ε^2))^{(β-1)/(d+β)}) 的渐近误差率；同时给出私有众数估计的 minimax 下界，表明其估计量在 MSE 意义上除对数因子外接近最优。实验在合成与真实数据上显示相对常见基线具有更好的隐私-效用权衡。
Conclusion: 本文表明基于得分的带噪上升与私有初始化策略可实现近乎最优的私有密度众数估计，并自然扩展到私有众数回归 (DP-PMS) 与聚类 (DP-GRAMS-C) 任务。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Sign compression for Muon: SignMuon, MuonSign, and the Limits of Error Feedback
papers.abstract_en: SignMuon compresses the Muon update to one bit per parameter by taking its elementwise sign, providing the most direct way to run a matrix-aware optimizer under an extremely low communication budget. It outperforms SignSGD in practice, yet it can ascend even on a linear function. Signing the gradient before the Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO), rather than after, does not repair this: we construct a small explicit instance on which sign-before (MuonUSign) and sign-on-both-sides (MuonSign) ascend as well, so no placement of the sign around the oracle descends in general. Error feedback, the standard remedy for a biased compressor, does not rescue SignMuon: when applied to Muon's output, error feedback can fail for every smoothness constant, step size, and momentum. Applied to the gradient, error feedback does work, and EF21-MuonUSign and EF21-MuonSign attain the standard $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ rate for the squared gradient norm on smooth nonconvex problems, the latter at one bit in each direction. Experiments then reverse the ordering: across centralized CIFAR-10, federated CIFAR-10, and the nanoGPT speedrun, the strongest compressed method is consistently sign-after-the-LMO, precisely the placement we prove divergent, with the provably convergent variants trailing it. Compressing after the LMO, a heuristic, matters more at these scales than the guarantee does.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Muon 优化器的一比特符号压缩方案。作者提出 SignMuon，将 Muon 更新按元素取符号后压缩为每参数一比特，并系统分析符号放置位置（LMO 前、后或两侧）与误差反馈（error feedback）的作用。理论证明 SignMuon 及其变体即使在线性函数上也可能上升，误差反馈作用于梯度时才能得到标准收敛率；但实验却显示符号放在 LMO 之后（即被证明发散的启发式）在实际基准上表现最好。
Motivation: 在极低通信预算下运行矩阵感知优化器（matrix-aware optimizer）需要将更新压缩到每参数一比特，现有方案如 SignSGD 未被证明能与 Muon 这类优化器结合有效工作；同时有偏压缩器（biased compressor）的标准补救手段误差反馈是否适用尚不清楚。
Method: 提出 SignMuon（对 Muon 更新结果取符号），并构造三类变体：sign-before（MuonUSign）、sign-on-both-sides（MuonSign）以及符号作用于梯度的 EF21-MuonUSign/EF21-MuonSign，从理论上分析线性函数上的上升行为与光滑非凸问题下的收敛率，并在集中式/联邦 CIFAR-10 和 nanoGPT speedrun 上实验对比。
Result: 理论结果显示 SignMuon 优于 SignSGD 但可在线性函数上上升；符号放在 LMO 前或两侧也无法保证下降。误差反馈作用于 Muon 输出时对所有光滑常数、步长和动量都可能失败，而作用于梯度时 EF21-MuonUSign 和 EF21-MuonSign 达到平方梯度范数的 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛率（后者每方向一比特）。实验与理论排序相反：最强的压缩方法始终是符号放在 LMO 之后的启发式变体，而可证明收敛的变体反而落后。
Conclusion: 作者强调在实验所涉及的规模下，压缩放在 LMO 之后这一启发式比收敛保证更重要；符号放置位置对实际性能的影响超过理论保证的贡献。

papers.title: Freeze, Then Select: Structured Field Adapters and Stability-Validated Weak Selection for PDE Discovery from Sparse Observations
papers.abstract_en: PDE discovery from sparse observations requires reconstructing a continuous field and selecting the correct differential terms. Our analysis of optimization paths in coupled neural PDE discovery reveals three behaviors: the exact support can persist to the end of training, appear only transiently, or fail to emerge. To decouple equation selection from neural optimization, we develop a freeze-then-select method combining a structured field adapter with Stability-Validated Weak Selection (SVWS). Trained from observations without a PDE residual, the adapter factorizes the field into learned spatial features and temporal coefficients represented by cubic splines. After freezing the field, SVWS identifies recurrent terms across independent weak-form systems, refits candidate supports, and selects the final equation on held-out weak-form systems. Beyond fixed libraries, we apply the same principle to expressions generated by genetic programming and recover the power-law form of an unknown nonlinear diffusion function from sparse, noisy observations. Across all six sparse MDBench regimes, our method attains the highest exact support recovery rate, with its clearest gains over classical and neural baselines on challenging Kuramoto-Sivashinsky dynamics.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, and 17 tables; includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从稀疏观测中自动发现偏微分方程 (PDE discovery) 的任务，指出耦合神经 PDE 发现中存在三种优化路径行为：精确支撑集可持续到训练结束、仅短暂出现或完全无法涌现。作者提出 freeze-then-select 方法，结合结构化场适配器 (structured field adapter) 与稳定性验证弱选择 (Stability-Validated Weak Selection, SVWS)，在无 PDE 残差监督下从观测训练场表示，冻结场后通过弱形式系统选择候选支撑并重拟合，最终在留出弱形式系统上选出方程。方法在六个稀疏 MDBench 场景中取得最高精确支撑恢复率，并在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 动力学上相对经典与神经基线提升最明显，还可扩展到遗传编程生成的表达式以恢复未知非线性扩散函数的幂律形式。
Motivation: 从稀疏观测进行 PDE 发现需要同时重建连续场并选择正确的微分项，而耦合神经优化中正确支撑集的出现不稳定，可能只在训练过程中短暂存在或始终不出现，这促使作者将方程选择与神经优化解耦。
Method: 提出 freeze-then-select 两阶段流程：先训练一个结构化场适配器，将场分解为可学习空间特征与由三次样条 (cubic splines) 表示的时间系数，训练不使用 PDE 残差；冻结场后，SVWS 在独立弱形式系统上识别反复出现的候选项，对候选支撑进行重拟合，并在留出弱形式系统上选择最终方程。除固定库外，同一原则也应用于遗传编程生成的表达式。
Result: 在全部六个稀疏 MDBench 测试场景中，该方法取得最高的精确支撑恢复率；其中在挑战性的 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 动力学上相对经典和神经基线优势最为明显，并能从稀疏含噪观测中恢复未知非线性扩散函数的幂律形式。
Conclusion: 作者认为将方程选择从神经场优化中解耦的 freeze-then-select 策略能提升稀疏观测下 PDE 发现的支撑恢复稳定性与准确性，且不限于固定微分项库，可推广到基于遗传编程的表达式空间。

papers.title: GQ-FSL: Green Quantized Federated Split Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deploying state-of-the-art deep neural networks (DNNs) at the wireless edge is severely bottlenecked by the strict energy and resource constraints of mobile devices. While federated split learning (FSL) mitigates on-device computation by offloading workloads to an edge server, this may introduce systemic overheads, while the continuous exchange of cut-layer data, and submodels still incurs significant energy consumption (EC). To address this, we propose a green quantized FSL (GQ-FSL) framework that incorporates stochastic quantization for both local collaborative training and wireless transmissions. Notably, GQ-FSL supports asymmetric precision levels for the client- and server-side submodels, effectively decoupling device energy constraints from global convergence degradation. To quantify these tradeoffs, we develop parameterized energy models for the split architecture and derive a theoretical convergence bound under statistically heterogeneous data. Building on that, we formulate a joint optimization problem to configure the DNN split point and precision levels, minimizing the total system EC while satisfying a strict target accuracy constraint. Ultimately, we demonstrate that GQ-FSL enables large-scale DNN deployment on resource-constrained devices, achieving superior energy efficiency compared to quantized federated learning and full-precision FSL.
papers.comment: To appear in IEEE 27th International Workshop on Signal Processing Advances in Wireless Communications (SPAWC), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出绿色量化联邦分割学习框架 GQ-FSL，针对无线边缘部署 DNN 的能耗瓶颈，将随机量化同时应用于本地协作训练与无线传输，并支持客户端与服务端子模型采用不对称精度。作者开发了分割架构的参数化能耗模型，并在统计异构数据下推导理论收敛界，进而通过联合优化分割点与精度等级，在满足目标精度约束下最小化系统总能耗。摘要称该方法相比量化联邦学习与全精度 FSL 具有更优的能量效率。
Motivation: 在无线边缘部署先进 DNN 受限于移动设备严格的能量与资源约束；联邦分割学习（FSL）虽将计算卸载到边缘服务器，但连续交换割层数据与子模型仍带来显著能耗与系统性开销。
Method: 提出 GQ-FSL 框架，将随机量化（stochastic quantization）同时用于本地协作训练和无线传输；支持客户端与服务端子模型使用非对称精度，从而将设备能量约束与全局收敛退化解耦；并建立参数化能耗模型、推导异构数据下收敛界，再构造联合优化问题以配置 DNN 分割点和精度等级。
Result: 摘要报告 GQ-FSL 能在资源受限设备上实现大规模 DNN 部署，并相比量化联邦学习（quantized federated learning）与全精度 FSL 获得更优的能量效率，同时满足严格的目标精度约束。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过联合配置分割点与精度并引入随机量化，可以在不牺牲全局收敛的前提下显著降低系统能耗，为资源受限无线设备上的大规模 DNN 部署提供可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Development of FDD-ON: an Ontology for VAV HVAC System Fault Detection and Diagnostics
papers.abstract_en: Fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) technology is essential for improving HVAC system reliability, energy efficiency, and maintenance effectiveness. However, effective deployment of FDD solutions in buildings requires structured domain knowledge that can bridge heterogeneous data sources, diverse equipment types, and varied diagnostic outputs. Limited data interpretability and interoperability within the FDD domain have led to fragmented information silos, hindering the implementation of FDD and related applications, such as the digital twin-enabled FDD frameworks and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven maintenance decision-making systems. This paper presents an FDD Ontology (FDD-ON), a modular and extensible ontology to formally represent variable air volume (VAV) HVAC system components, fault types, symptom statuses, fault impacts and associated attributes. FDD-ON integrates HVAC system FDD semantics to provide comprehensive representations of fault and symptom attributes, supported by the well-defined controlled vocabulary. Additionally, FDD-ON offers comprehensive fault, symptom, and impact libraries to capture a broad spectrum of operational abnormalities and their consequences in VAV HVAC systems. Through explicit contributing cause-fault-symptom-impact relations, FDD-ON serves as a machine-interpretable basis for querying diagnostic knowledge, mapping heterogeneous FDD outputs, and developing interoperable FDD-related applications. FDD-ON is evaluated using publicly available VAV HVAC system datasets and demonstrated through FDD development applications. Results indicate that FDD-ON provides a foundational semantic framework for advancing scalable, transparent, and interoperable FDD solutions across various applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FDD-ON，一个模块化、可扩展的本体，用于正式表示变风量 (VAV) HVAC 系统的组件、故障类型、症状状态、故障影响及相关属性。该本体通过显式的贡献原因-故障-症状-影响关系提供机器可解释的诊断知识查询基础，并利用公开 VAV HVAC 数据集进行评估和 FDD 应用演示。
Motivation: HVAC 故障检测与诊断 (FDD) 的有效部署需要结构化领域知识来桥接异构数据源、多样设备类型和不同诊断输出，但当前 FDD 领域存在数据可解释性和互操作性不足的问题，形成信息孤岛，阻碍了数字孪生 FDD 框架和 AI 驱动维护决策等应用的发展。
Method: 提出 FDD-ON 本体，将 HVAC 系统 FDD 语义集成到受控词汇表中，构建全面的故障、症状和影响库，并通过显式建模贡献原因-故障-症状-影响关系来支持诊断知识查询和异构 FDD 输出映射。
Result: 使用公开可用的 VAV HVAC 系统数据集评估 FDD-ON，并通过 FDD 开发应用进行演示，结果表明 FDD-ON 为跨应用的可扩展、透明和可互操作 FDD 解决方案提供了基础语义框架。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FDD-ON 可作为推进可扩展、透明且可互操作 FDD 应用的语义基础，但未讨论其局限性或性能量化细节。

papers.title: Distribution and Transport of Fragmenting Microplastics in a 3D Global Eulerian Model
papers.abstract_en: Fragmentation, the breakage of matter into smaller pieces, is an important mechanism responsible for generating microplastics (MPs). We present the first global three-dimensional Eulerian model that resolves fragmentation alongside MP transport. The evolution of particle size is modeled as a transfer from larger- to smaller-size bins, governed by a fragmentation kinetics framework. Relative to a reference simulation without fragmentation, two distinct effects are identified: (1) the surface concentration field of MPs becomes horizontally dispersed, and (2) MPs sink to depths of 500 m where the reference simulation shows negligible concentration. The vertical shift can be explained by the loss of buoyancy when particle size decreases, which facilitates horizontal sub-mixed layer transport once the particles sink below 100 m depth. Neutrally buoyant particles (with diameter d < 1 um) are continuously produced in the ocean by the fragmentation of larger particles and accumulate in the major oceanic gyres. Ultimately, the concentration of these neutrally buoyant MPs peaks at the gyre centers, a behavior that is not captured by prior models. Furthermore, the globally integrated size spectrum exhibits a steepening power-law slope over time that continues to evolve throughout our 25-year simulation. Comparisons with the AOMI Level-3wm observational dataset demonstrate a meaningful improvement in predictive skill relative to previous models: including fragmentation elevates the spatial correlation between modeled and observed surface concentrations from 45% to 58%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个同时解析碎片化（fragmentation）与输运过程的全球三维欧拉微塑料模型，将粒子尺寸演化建模为大尺寸箱向小尺寸箱的转移，并用碎片化动力学框架控制。与不含碎片化的参考模拟相比，碎片化使表面浓度场水平分散，并导致微塑料下沉至500米深度；中性浮力粒子（d<1微米）在海洋环流中心聚集，这是先前模型未能捕捉的行为。与AOMI Level-3wm观测数据对比，包含碎片化将表面浓度的空间相关性从45%提升至58%。
Motivation: 碎片化是产生微塑料的重要机制，但此前缺少能够同时刻画碎片化过程与全球三维输运的模型，导致对小粒径中性浮力粒子的分布和深层输运预测不准确。
Method: 建立全球三维欧拉模型，将碎片化作为粒子从较大尺寸箱转移至较小尺寸箱的过程，基于碎片化动力学框架刻画尺寸演化，并运行25年模拟以研究长期演变。

papers.title: HierDoc: Hierarchical Page-to-Region Evidence Routing for Long-Document Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Multi-page document visual question answering requires locating sparse evidence at both the page and region levels. Existing approaches typically emphasize one level over the other: page-centric methods focus on page acquisition, with region operations serving mainly as navigation aids, whereas region-centric methods assume that the relevant pages have already been supplied. Consequently, page and region selection remain disconnected rather than forming successive evidence decisions. We propose HierDoc, a hierarchical evidence-routing framework that formulates long-document evidence acquisition as two-stage set prediction from pages to regions. A page policy selects evidence pages from the full document; these pages are then parsed for semantic elements, after which a region policy selects the elements passed to a downstream answer model. Both answer-agnostic policies are optimized with stage-wise GRPO using granularity-specific structured-set rewards. The answer model receives selected full pages together with selected region crops and OCR or table text, preserving global context while emphasizing fine-grained evidence. Across the evaluated benchmarks, HierDoc achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance among open-weight systems, improving LongDocURL by 16.87% relative to the strongest reported open-weight baseline. Controlled ablations further show that selected regional evidence improves the page-only system in accuracy and F1 by 5.51% and 4.82%, respectively. These results demonstrate the benefit of organizing coarse page routing and fine-grained region routing as successive, separately optimized stages of a unified evidence-acquisition process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HierDoc，一个面向多页文档视觉问答的分层证据路由框架，将长文档证据获取建模为从页面到区域的两阶段集合预测：页面策略从全文选出证据页，区域策略再从中选择语义元素传给下游答案模型，两个策略均为答案无关，并通过阶段式 GRPO 与粒度特定的结构化集合奖励联合优化。摘要报告在多个基准上达到开放权重系统的最优或接近最优性能，其中在 LongDocURL 上相对最强开放权重基线提升 16.87%；消融显示区域证据相对纯页面系统在准确率和 F1 上分别提升 5.51% 和 4.82%。
Motivation: 现有的多页文档 VQA 方法往往只侧重页面层级或区域层级之一：页面中心方法把区域操作当作导航辅助，区域中心方法则假设相关页面已给定，导致页面选择和区域选择相互割裂，而非形成连续的证据决策。
Method: 提出两阶段证据路由：页面策略从完整文档中选择证据页，对所选页面解析出语义元素后，区域策略选择传入下游答案模型的元素；答案模型同时接收选中的完整页面以及区域裁剪图和 OCR 或表格文本。两个策略采用阶段式 GRPO，并使用粒度特定的结构化集合奖励进行优化。
Result: 在评估基准上 HierDoc 达到开放权重系统中的最先进或接近最优性能，在 LongDocURL 上相对最强开放权重基线提升 16.87%；受控消融表明，加入选中的区域证据使纯页面系统在准确率上提升 5.51%、F1 提升 4.82%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将粗粒度页面路由与细粒度区域路由组织为统一证据获取过程中相继且分别优化的阶段，能够带来性能收益。

papers.title: CodeShrink: Adaptive Visual Compression for Efficient Multimodal Code Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Rendering source code as images offers a promising way to reduce the input costs of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Adjusting image resolution can trade visual token cost against content fidelity. However, resolution scaling alone overlooks two sources of inefficiency: blank regions created by line breaks and indentation, and code regions irrelevant to the current instruction. Moreover, the best compression setting varies across inputs, tasks, and models, limiting fixed-ratio strategies. We propose CodeShrink, an adaptive visual compression framework with three components. Blank-Free Rendering replaces whitespace-dependent layouts with compact layouts and explicit structural markers, removing layout-induced tokens. Adaptive Compression Configuration uses a lightweight agent trained with reinforcement learning to predict a per-input setting that balances token efficiency and readability. Dominant Token Selection jointly analyzes the instruction and code image to prune task-irrelevant visual tokens during inference. We evaluate CodeShrink on code question answering, clone detection, and code completion. CodeShrink reduces visual token use by up to 71.2\% while matching or exceeding uncompressed text-only inputs, and consistently outperforms text-based and visual compression baselines across all three tasks. These results show that combining layout compaction, adaptive configuration, and instruction-aware pruning can make multimodal code understanding more efficient. Our code is available at https://github.com/vinsontang1/CodeShrink.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeShrink，一个面向多模态代码理解的适应性视觉压缩框架，包含三个组件：无空白渲染 (Blank-Free Rendering)、基于强化学习的适应性压缩配置 (Adaptive Compression Configuration) 和主导 token 选择 (Dominant Token Selection)。摘要报告在代码问答、克隆检测和代码补全任务上最多减少 71.2% 的视觉 token 使用，同时匹配或超过未压缩的纯文本输入，并一致优于文本与视觉压缩基线。
Motivation: 将源代码渲染为图像可降低多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的输入成本，但单纯调整分辨率忽略了两类低效来源：换行和缩进造成的空白区域，以及与当前指令无关的代码区域；且最优压缩设置在输入、任务和模型之间变化，限制了固定比例策略。
Method: 提出三个组件：Blank-Free Rendering 用紧凑布局和显式结构标记替代依赖空白的布局，去除布局带来的 token；Adaptive Compression Configuration 用强化学习训练轻量智能体，为每个输入预测平衡 token 效率与可读性的设置；Dominant Token Selection 联合分析指令和代码图像，在推理时剪除任务无关的视觉 token。
Result: 在代码问答、克隆检测和代码补全三个任务上，CodeShrink 最多减少 71.2% 的视觉 token 使用，同时匹配或超过未压缩的纯文本输入，并始终优于基于文本和基于视觉压缩的基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为结合布局压缩、适应性配置和指令感知剪枝可以使多模态代码理解更高效，并已开源代码；未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: OASIS: Occlusion-aware Single-image Hand Avatar Reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Single-image 3D hand avatar reconstruction is fundamentally ill-posed and particularly challenging due to limited visual evidence under severe self-occlusion and the complex pose-dependent deformation of highly articulated hands. Existing methods predominantly rely on implicit NeRF-style representations, whose volumetric fitting is computationally expensive and often struggles to preserve fine-grained hand details. In this work, we present OASIS, a tailored 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for single-image hand avatar reconstruction. To faithfully encode sparse image-specific appearance cues in single-view reconstruction, we construct geometry-aligned visual evidence tokens by explicitly aligning input image observations with 3D hand geometry and context-adaptively tokenizing the resulting visual evidence. Since severe self-occlusion makes the reliability of image evidence inherently visibility-dependent, we introduce a visibility-conditioned point-image attention to reliably transfer visual evidence to geometric tokens, yielding occlusion-aware Gaussian features for faithful and robust reconstruction. To further capture non-rigid deformation of articulated hands, we introduce a Feature-on-Mesh representation to enable Gaussian deformation to be guided by local surface stretching. Under this framework, we adopt a one-shot adaptation scheme that learns a shared hand prior from multi-identity training data and then fits it to a target image for target-specific reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that OASIS outperforms existing baselines in both visual fidelity and efficiency across challenging poses and in-the-wild scenarios, and further demonstrates strong versatility in downstream applications such as text-to-avatar generation and texture editing.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026. Project page: https://mova-hand.github.io/MOVA/. Code repository: https://github.com/ivyyy77/OASIS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OASIS，一个基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的单图像手部化身重建框架，旨在解决单视角重建中严重自遮挡和手部关节非刚性形变带来的不适定问题。方法通过几何对齐的视觉证据 token、可见性条件下的 point-image attention 以及 Feature-on-Mesh 表示来生成遮挡感知的高斯特征，并采用 one-shot 适配方案从多身份训练数据学习共享手部先验。实验表明该方法在视觉保真度和效率上优于现有基线，并支持文本生成化身与纹理编辑等下游应用。
Motivation: 单图像 3D 手部化身重建本质上是不适定问题，自遮挡导致视觉证据有限，且高度关节化的手部具有复杂姿态相关形变。现有方法多依赖隐式 NeRF 风格表示，体积拟合计算开销大且难以保持细粒度手部细节。
Method: 构建几何对齐的视觉证据 token，将输入图像观测显式对齐到 3D 手部几何并进行上下文自适应 token 化；引入可见性条件下的 point-image attention 将视觉证据可靠传递到几何 token，得到遮挡感知的高斯特征；引入 Feature-on-Mesh 表示，使高斯形变由局部表面拉伸引导；采用 one-shot 适配方案，先在多身份数据上学习共享手部先验，再适配到目标图像。
Result: 大量实验表明 OASIS 在具有挑战性的姿态和野外场景中，在视觉保真度和效率上均优于现有基线，并在文本生成化身和纹理编辑等下游应用中展现出较强通用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调面向单图像手部重建的 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架结合可见性建模与表面引导形变能够有效改善重建质量与效率。

papers.title: FlexComposer: Unified Video Compositing from Images to Dynamic Footage with Flexible Trajectory Control
papers.abstract_en: Generative video compositing, which involves inserting external assets seamlessly into existing video sequences, is essential for content creation and visual effects. However, existing approaches suffer from a control-fidelity trade-off: they either hallucinate motion from static images, failing to preserve the dynamics of pre-animated assets, or lack fine-grained spatial control for precise asset placement along user-defined trajectories. We propose FlexComposer, a unified framework that standardizes video compositing as a trajectory-guided conditional generation task, enabling the seamless integration of both static images and dynamic footage. Our approach introduces three key designs: (1) a Unified Canonical Foreground Representation that decouples an object's intrinsic motion from its global displacement, standardizing heterogeneous inputs into a stabilized, centered latent space; (2) a Spatial-Aware Latent Injection strategy that exploits the translation equivariance of VAE latent spaces to transport canonical features onto target trajectories via a parameter-free mechanism; and (3) a Hybrid Dataset and Synthetic-to-Real Curriculum that synergizes procedural simulation, real-world cinematic footage, and generative data to implicitly learn physically plausible illumination and shadow harmonization. This unified design handles diverse inputs from product photos to dynamic subjects achieving high-fidelity motion control and environmental integration without the need for explicit 3D reconstruction or auxiliary learnable adapters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlexComposer outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual quality, temporal consistency, and trajectory adherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlexComposer，将生成式视频合成 (generative video compositing) 统一为轨迹引导的条件生成任务，可同时无缝集成静态图像与动态视频素材。方法通过统一规范前景表示解耦物体的内在运动与全局位移，利用 VAE 潜空间的平移等变性将规范特征注入目标轨迹，并设计混合数据集与合成到真实的课程学习来隐式学习光照和阴影协调。实验表明该方法在视觉质量、时间一致性和轨迹遵循上优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有生成式视频合成存在控制保真度的权衡：从静态图像生成时只能幻觉运动，无法保留预动画素材的动态；同时又缺乏沿用户定义轨迹精确放置素材的细粒度空间控制。
Method: 提出三个关键设计：统一规范前景表示 (Unified Canonical Foreground Representation)、空间感知潜注入 (Spatial-Aware Latent Injection) 以及混合数据集与合成到真实课程 (Hybrid Dataset and Synthetic-to-Real Curriculum)，无需显式 3D 重建或额外可学习适配器。
Result: 摘要报告 FlexComposer 在视觉质量、时间一致性和轨迹遵循方面均优于现有最先进方法。

papers.title: AgentHPOBench: A Benchmark For Evaluating LLM Agents as Sequential Hyperparameter Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs evolve from code completion systems into autonomous scientific agents, evaluating their ability to conduct experiments has become increasingly important. Existing benchmarks typically focus on static code generation, paper replication, or final answer correctness, but do not directly assess whether agents can interpret experimental evidence and use it to guide subsequent hyperparameter decisions. To address this gap, we introduce AgentHPOBench, a sequential benchmark comprising 30 executable machine learning tasks across seven research categories. Each task begins with a validated baseline run, after which an agent performs several sequential interventions. At each step, the agent observes the accumulated configurations, metrics, and logs before proposing the next valid configuration. We evaluate 12 widely used agents and conventional HPO baselines under a unified protocol. The results show that current agents exhibit measurable experimental optimization ability across domains, but still face clear limitations in sustained iterative refinement, complex log diagnosis, and consistent progress toward reported reference performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentHPOBench，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体作为顺序超参数优化器（sequential hyperparameter optimizer）的基准，包含 30 个可执行机器学习任务、覆盖 7 个研究类别。每个任务从验证过的基线运行开始，智能体在每步观察累积配置、指标和日志后提议下一个有效配置。作者在统一协议下评估了 12 种常用智能体和传统 HPO 基线，结果显示当前智能体具备可测量的实验优化能力，但在持续迭代细化、复杂日志诊断以及稳定逼近参考性能方面仍有明显局限。
Motivation: 现有基准多关注静态代码生成、论文复现或最终答案正确性，不能直接评估智能体能否解释实验证据并据此指导后续超参数决策。
Method: 构建顺序基准 AgentHPOBench，包含 30 个可执行机器学习任务；每个任务以验证过的基线运行开始，智能体逐步观察累积配置、指标和日志后提议下一个有效配置，并在统一协议下对比多种 LLM 智能体与常规 HPO 基线。
Result: 在 12 种常用智能体与传统 HPO 基线上的评估表明，现有智能体在各领域展现出可测量的实验优化能力，但在持续迭代细化、复杂日志诊断以及一致达到参考性能方面仍存在明显不足。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前智能体作为顺序超参数优化器仍有清晰局限，该基准可用于评估和推动 LLM 智能体实验能力的发展。

papers.title: The Theoretical Foundation of Socratic Tests: Dynamic, Multimodal, Conversational Examinations
papers.abstract_en: Traditional static assessments rely on a subtractive, deficit-based grading model that often penalizes ambition and obscures diagnostic feedback. Conversely, traditional face-to-face oral examinations introduce severe construct-irrelevant variance by exacerbating performative anxiety and the sociological power imbalances inherent to academic hierarchies. This paper presents the theoretical foundation for the "Socratic Test," an automated, computer-mediated conversational assessment. By integrating Dynamic Assessment principles, multimodal workspaces, Bloom's Taxonomy for real-time proctoring, and the SOLO Taxonomy for structural evaluation, the Socratic Test actively maps a student's cognitive boundaries. This paper formalizes the use of graduated scaffolding to quantify the Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) and details a non-compensatory, additive grading architecture that prioritizes mastery over penalty and human-AI alignment to ensure unprecedented measurement reliability.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 1 figure, submitted to Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“苏格拉底测试”(Socratic Test) 的理论基础，一种自动化、计算机中介的对话式评估方法。它整合动态评估 (Dynamic Assessment) 原则、多模态工作区、Bloom 分类法用于实时监考、SOLO 分类法用于结构评价，并用渐进式脚手架 (graduated scaffolding) 形式化量化最近发展区 (ZPD)。同时提出一种非补偿性、加性评分架构，强调掌握而非扣分，并借助人类-AI 对齐追求测量可靠性。
Motivation: 传统静态评估采用减分式、缺陷导向的评分模型，常常惩罚学生的进取心并掩盖诊断性反馈；传统面对面口试则因表现焦虑和学术层级中的权力不对等而引入严重的构念无关方差 (construct-irrelevant variance)。作者旨在为自动化的对话式评估建立理论框架，以主动测绘学生的认知边界。
Method: 论文提出 Socratic Test 的理论设计，将动态评估、多模态工作区、Bloom 分类法 (实时监考) 与 SOLO 分类法 (结构评价) 相结合；通过渐进式脚手架量化 ZPD，并设计一种非补偿性、加性的评分架构，优先考察掌握程度而非扣分，同时引入人类-AI 对齐以提升测量可靠性。
Result: 摘要未报告实证实验数据；其理论性成果包括形式化地用渐进式脚手架度量 ZPD，以及提出以掌握为本的非补偿性加性评分模型，并声称借助人类-AI 对齐可实现前所未有的测量可靠性 (unprecedented measurement reliability)。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Socratic Test 能弥补静态评估和传统口试各自的缺陷，为自动化对话式评估提供统一的理论基础；本工作的范围限于理论框架，摘要中未包含实证验证或系统实现细节。

papers.title: RayViT: Ray-Conditioned Visual Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Visual imitation learning enables robots to acquire visuomotor skills directly from images, yet RGB observations lack explicit geometric cues, making learned policies brittle to camera perturbations. To address this, we propose \textbf{Ray-conditioned Vision Transformer Encoder (RayViT)}, a lightweight architecture that injects camera geometry into pretrained ViT backbones. RayViT represents camera geometry as a Plücker ray map, patchifies it into ray features, and uses gated cross-attention to produce a ray-conditioned class token. These ray features are added as dense positional embeddings, while the ray class token replaces the original ViT class token to provide a geometry-aware summary representation. We combine this approach with an auxiliary cosine similarity loss to consistently improve the performance and robustness for geometry-aware tokens. Experiments on sim- and real-robot tasks demonstrate that RayViT improves robustness by approximately 13 percentage points under camera perturbations in multi-task RoboCasa benchmark and by 1.78 average completed stages in real-world multi-task success rate compared to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RayViT（Ray-conditioned Vision Transformer Encoder），一种轻量级架构，将相机几何信息注入预训练 ViT 主干，以提升视觉模仿学习对相机扰动的鲁棒性。方法将相机几何表示为 Plücker ray map，分块为 ray features，通过门控交叉注意力生成 ray-conditioned class token，并配合辅助余弦相似度损失。实验显示在 RoboCasa 多任务基准上相机扰动下鲁棒性提升约 13 个百分点，在真实世界多任务成功率上平均完成阶段数提升 1.78。
Motivation: RGB 观测缺乏显式几何线索，使视觉模仿学习策略对相机扰动脆弱，现有方法难以应对视点变化。作者目标是注入相机几何信息以使表示对视角鲁棒。
Method: 提出 RayViT：将相机几何编码为 Plücker ray map，patchify 成 ray features，作为密集位置嵌入加入；通过门控交叉注意力生成 ray-conditioned class token 替代原始 ViT class token，并用辅助余弦相似度损失增强几何感知 token 的鲁棒性。
Result: 在仿真和真实机器人任务上评估：RoboCasa 多任务基准中相机扰动下鲁棒性提升约 13 个百分点；真实世界多任务成功率方面平均完成阶段数比基线高 1.78。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将相机几何显式注入预训练 ViT 表示并结合辅助损失，可以有效提升跨视角的模仿学习鲁棒性，且架构轻量。论文未在摘要中提及明显局限。

papers.title: CENDRe: Concept Extraction with Natural Domain Representations
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are widely used for time-series classification, but their deployment in critical domains requires understanding the temporal and spectral patterns that drive their predictions. Concept extraction (CE) methods identify such patterns by analyzing representations within the models' latent space. However, existing time-series CE methods have three limitations: they operate only in the time domain and overlook frequency features, predefine the number of concepts, and produce localizations misaligned with the regions the model uses. We address these limitations by proposing CENDRe, a concept extraction method for CNNs. It first discovers concepts by clustering per-timestep latent representations in two stages, where silhouette-guided aggregation selects the number of concepts automatically. Then, it localizes each concept through gradients of a presence score that contrasts the latent representations with their prototypes, producing masks that concentrate on the regions driving the concept. These gradients, propagated through a differentiable invertible mapping of the input such as a Fourier transform, yield localizations for the same concepts in the frequency domain. Finally, each concept receives a relevance score that quantifies its contribution to each class. On synthetic benchmarks, CENDRe achieves representation correctness comparable to state-of-the-art CE methods and significantly higher importance correctness. On real bearing-fault data, CENDRe extracts the frequency bands driving the model's predictions, located in regions commonly inspected for fault diagnosis, producing evidence to assess the model that time-domain CE methods cannot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CENDRe，一种面向 CNN 时间序列分类的概念提取 (concept extraction) 方法。它通过两阶段聚类 per-timestep 潜在表征、并用 silhouette 引导自动确定概念数量，随后利用对比原型 (prototypes) 的 presence score 梯度生成时域定位掩码，再经可微可逆映射（如傅里叶变换）获得同一概念的频域定位，最后为每个概念计算对各类别的相关性分数。在合成基准上，CENDRe 的表征正确性与现有方法相当，重要性正确性显著更高；在真实轴承故障数据上，它提取出驱动模型预测的频带，为模型评估提供了时域概念提取方法无法给出的证据。
Motivation: 现有时间序列概念提取方法只作用于时域、忽略频率特征，且需要预先设定概念数量，生成的定位也与模型实际使用的区域不对齐；而 CNN 在关键领域的部署要求理解驱动预测的时间与频谱模式。
Method: CENDRe 首先通过两阶段聚类发现概念，并用 silhouette 引导的聚合自动选择概念数量；然后通过一个与原型对比的 presence score 的梯度生成集中于驱动区域的掩码以定位概念；这些梯度经可微可逆映射传播后，得到同一概念在频域的定位；最后为每个概念分配量化其对各类别贡献的相关性分数。
Result: 在合成基准上，CENDRe 达到与最先进概念提取方法相当的表征正确性，并显著更高的重要性正确性；在真实轴承故障数据上，它提取出驱动模型预测的频带，且这些频带位于故障诊断通常检查的区域。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CENDRe 通过同时提供时域和频域定位、自动选择概念数以及对齐模型实际使用区域的掩码，改进了时间序列 CNN 的可解释性，能产出评估模型所需的证据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning (IL)---training an agent to replicate expert behavior from demonstrations---underpins applications from robotics to language model training. Standard approaches such as Behavior Cloning (BC) are known to suffer from compounding errors and performance plateaus, particularly when the learner cannot perfectly represent the expert's policy (as is typical, e.g., in distillation). Two interventions are widely understood empirically to improve performance: querying the expert interactively along the learner's own trajectories, and using value function estimation en route to generating a policy rather than directly fitting the expert's full action distribution. We investigate the nature of these improvements and their potentially surprising interplay. Our main finding is that expert interaction relaxes the representational demands on the learner: one only needs a model capable of realizing the expert's value function, bypassing the (often stricter) requirement of realizing the expert's policy itself. Concretely, we introduce OVI, an interactive on-policy IL algorithm that is statistically efficient whenever the learner can represent the expert's value function and computationally efficient given access to a linear maximization oracle. We complement this with a negative result showing that interaction is necessary. Namely, without stronger assumptions beyond expert-value realizability alone, any offline IL algorithm must scale with the complexity of the expert policy class. Our findings bear out empirically. OVI outperforms offline policy-based (BC), interactive policy-based (DAgger), and offline value-based IL methods, with the largest gains when the learner network is substantially less expressive than the expert's.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于值的模仿学习（IL）中两种经验有效的干预——沿学习者自身轨迹交互式查询专家、以及借助价值函数估计生成策略而非直接拟合专家完整动作分布——的改进来源及其相互作用。作者提出交互式在策略 IL 算法 OVI，理论上证明专家交互能放宽学习者的表示要求：只需能够实现专家的价值函数，而无需实现专家策略本身。同时给出负结果：仅凭 expert-value realizability 而不加更强假设时，任何离线 IL 算法都必须随专家策略类复杂度扩展。实验显示 OVI 优于离线策略型、交互式策略型和离线价值型 IL 基线，且当学习者网络表达能力远低于专家时收益最大。
Motivation: 标准行为克隆（BC）等 IL 方法在无法完美表示专家策略时会出现复合误差和性能平台期，而离线 IL 的样本效率常受限于专家策略类的复杂度。作者希望弄清交互式专家查询和价值函数估计这两个干预为何有效、如何相互作用，并刻画它们对表示需求的影响。
Method: 提出 OVI，一种交互式在策略 IL 算法：其统计效率只要求学习者能表示专家价值函数（expert-value realizability），计算效率则依赖于线性最大化 oracle（linear maximization oracle）。作者还构造负结果，说明在只有 expert-value realizability 而无更强假设时，任何离线 IL 算法都必须随专家策略类的复杂度扩展，因此交互是必要的。
Result: 摘要报告 OVI 在实验中优于离线策略型（BC）、交互式策略型（DAgger）和离线价值型 IL 方法；当学习者网络表达能力显著弱于专家时，改进幅度最大。
Conclusion: 核心结论是专家交互将表示需求从实现专家策略放宽为实现专家价值函数，并且这种放宽在缺乏更强假设时必须以交互为代价（负结果）。摘要未报告具体数值指标或数据集细节，也未讨论 OVI 在实际连续控制或语言模型场景中的表现。

papers.title: A Human-Centered Validation of the Explainability-Performance Coefficient
papers.abstract_en: The rapid adoption of deep learning models in high-risk domains has intensified the need for trustworthy Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI). However, objectively evaluating explanation fidelity and aligning XAI metrics with human-centered understanding remain critical open challenges. In this work, we propose a model-agnostic metric, the EPC score, which is an extension of the Explainability-Performance Coefficient (EPC), that quantifies explanation quality by explicitly balancing the trade-off between feature selection sparsity and preserved model performance. Through an empirical validation across tabular, text, and image modalities, we show that the EPC score effectively uncovers operational dependencies among network activations, data dimensionality, and explainer performance. Furthermore, we validate the EPC score against independent human-based explanations, proving that higher EPC scores strongly align with human lexical sentiment judgments and spatial visual annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模型无关的可解释性质量度量 EPC score，它是 Explainability-Performance Coefficient (EPC) 的扩展，通过显式平衡特征选择稀疏性与模型性能保持之间的权衡来量化解释质量。作者在表格、文本和图像三种模态上进行了实证验证，并利用独立的人工解释进行对照，证明更高的 EPC 分数与人类词汇情感判断和空间视觉标注高度一致。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在高风险领域的快速应用增强了对可信 XAI 的需求，但客观评估解释保真度以及让 XAI 指标与人类中心理解对齐仍是关键开放挑战。
Method: 提出模型无关的 EPC score，作为 EPC 系数的扩展，核心思想是显式权衡特征选择的稀疏性和保留的模型性能，从而对解释质量进行量化评分。
Result: 在表格、文本和图像模态的实证中，EPC score 能有效揭示网络激活、数据维度与解释器性能之间的操作依赖；与独立人工解释对比显示，较高的 EPC 分数与人类词汇情感判断和空间视觉标注强烈一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EPC score 可以在模型性能保持与人类可理解性之间建立联系，是一种经过人工验证的解释质量度量。

papers.title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has shown strong promise for robotic manipulation. Among RL methods, critic-based approaches rely on a value estimator that predominantly operates on single-frame observations or single-frame VLM backbone latents, which is a fundamental mismatch with the partially observable nature of robot control. A naive approach to incorporate observation history into the critic incurs exponential complexity with high-dimensional visual space, and still fails because pure scalar-return regression provides insufficient supervision for learning cross-temporal dynamics. We identify the root cause as a state approximation problem: without an explicit world modeling objective, the critic's representation cannot capture the temporal structure needed for accurate value estimation. To address this, we propose the World Critic Model (WCM), built on a lightweight LeJEPA architecture; WCM jointly predicts future latent state and estimates values, such that the critic's representation is explicitly trained to capture temporal dynamics rather than merely regress scalar returns. WCM integrates seamlessly into both on-policy and off-policy training pipelines and is compatible with state-of-the-art VLA backbones including Pi0, Pi0.5, and OpenVLA-OFT. Extensive experiments on 149 tasks across four benchmarks demonstrate that WCM consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, with particularly strong generalization gains. We further validate WCM on seven real-world manipulation tasks using OpenVLA-OFT and Pi0.5 with off-policy RL, confirming stable deployment across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 World Critic Model (WCM)，一种面向视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型强化学习后训练的世界评论家模型。作者认为现有 critic 基于单帧观测或单帧 VLM 骨干潜变量做价值估计，与机器人控制的部分可观测特性不匹配，其根因是状态近似问题。WCM 基于轻量 LeJEPA 架构，联合预测未来潜状态并估计价值，使 critic 表征显式学习时序动态而非仅回归标量回报。实验覆盖四个基准 149 个任务以及 7 个真实世界操作任务，在分布内与分布外场景均取得最优性能。
Motivation: VLA 模型 RL 后训练中，critic-based 方法依赖主要基于单帧观测或单帧 VLM 骨干潜变量的价值估计器，这与机器人控制的部分可观测性存在根本性不匹配。简单地把观测历史引入 critic 会带来高维视觉空间的指数级复杂度，且纯标量回报回归无法为跨时序动态学习提供足够监督；作者将根因归结为状态近似问题，即缺少显式世界建模目标时，critic 表征无法捕获价值估计所需的时序结构。
Method: 提出 World Critic Model (WCM)，构建在轻量 LeJEPA 架构上。WCM 联合预测未来潜状态 (future latent state) 并估计价值，使 critic 表征被显式训练以捕获时序动态，而不是仅仅回归标量回报。该方法可无缝集成到 on-policy 与 off-policy 训练流程中，并兼容 Pi0、Pi0.5、OpenVLA-OFT 等先进 VLA 骨干。
Result: 在四个基准共 149 个任务上的大量实验表明，WCM 在分布内和分布外设置下均持续取得最优性能，并带来特别强的泛化提升。此外，作者使用 OpenVLA-OFT 和 Pi0.5 结合 off-policy RL 在 7 个真实世界操作任务上验证了 WCM，确认其在多种设置下可稳定部署。
Conclusion: WCM 通过显式世界建模目标改进 critic 表征的时序动态捕获能力，从而解决 VLA RL 后处理中的状态近似问题，并在仿真与真实机器人操作任务中验证了有效性和泛化性。摘要未提及具体数值或与其他方法的定量差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QASP: Query-Adaptive Robust Vector Search Policy
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge of vector search is achieving consistently high recall while minimizing computational costs. Fixed search parameters cause significant performance variance across queries, and conventional evaluation on average recall masks these per-query disparities. We introduce QASP (Query-Adaptive robust vector Search Policy), which predicts the complete recall progression curve per query via a single upfront supervised regression, from which a search policy is derived for any recall target; this avoids iterative model invocations during search or separate predictors per target. By predicting normalized recall values with scale-invariant features and pre-search inference, QASP generalizes across recall targets, index configurations, and datasets. Its fine-grained progress predictions further enable a lightweight reactive complement that adjusts search depth based on predicted-versus-observed deviations without additional inference. We prove that QASP requires a finite training sample independent of dataset size and dimensionality, that its loss exceeds the irreducible lower bound of any fixed policy by a vanishing margin, and that its data access savings over fixed probing grow exponentially in intrinsic dimensionality. Experimentally, QASP achieves significantly lower recall variance and deviation from target, higher query satisfaction rate, and scales to large data and hierarchical indices without retraining, achieving 99% recall with 80% less data access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QASP (Query-Adaptive robust vector Search Policy)，针对向量检索中固定搜索参数导致的逐查询召回率波动问题，通过一次性的前置监督回归预测每个查询的完整召回率进展曲线，并据此为任意召回率目标推导搜索策略。作者证明该方法所需训练样本量有限且与数据集规模和维度无关，并实验显示在达到 99% 召回率时数据访问量减少 80%。
Motivation: 向量检索的核心挑战是在高召回率与低计算成本之间取得平衡，但固定搜索参数会造成不同查询间的显著性能差异，而基于平均召回率的常规评估会掩盖这种逐查询的不均衡。
Method: QASP 通过一次前置监督回归预测每个查询的归一化召回率进展曲线，使用尺度不变特征与搜索前推断，从而为任意召回率目标导出搜索策略，避免搜索过程中的迭代模型调用或为目标单独训练预测器；此外利用细粒度进度预测提供轻量级反应式补充，根据预测与观测偏差调整搜索深度，无需额外推断。
Result: 理论上证明 QASP 的训练样本规模有限且不依赖数据集大小和维度，其损失与任何固定策略的不可约下界之差趋于零，且相对于固定探测 (fixed probing) 的数据访问节省随本征维度指数增长；实验上实现更低的召回率方差和目标偏差、更高的查询满意度，无需重训练即可扩展到大数据与分层索引，达到 99% 召回率时减少 80% 的数据访问。
Conclusion: 作者强调 QASP 能够跨召回率目标、索引配置和数据集泛化，并通过一次回归与轻量级反应式机制实现稳健且低开销的逐查询搜索策略。摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FriendBench: Benchmarking Dyadic Familiarity Inference in Humans and Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reading a social situation often depends on behavior, not words alone. We introduce FriendBench, a benchmark for inferring whether two people are already familiar or are meeting as strangers, from a 20-second clip of a dyadic ice-breaker conversation. Every pair answers the same type of prompt, so only the manner of interaction can reveal the answer. Across text, audio, and video, we compare 26 models from seven companies against matched human panels over 96 balanced dyads. The best model and the human crowd are statistically indistinguishable on accuracy in every modality, but reach it differently: humans stay balanced across the two answers, while the strongest models lean toward "stranger"---a difference in effective prior, not discrimination. Richer channels help both unequally, and only humans gain from visible behavior on top of speech. We release the stimuli, human ratings, and model predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FriendBench，一个用于推断两人是熟人还是陌生人的基准，基于 20 秒双人破冰对话片段。所有被试回答相同的提示，因此只能通过互动方式揭示答案。作者在文本、音频和视频三个模态上比较了来自 7 家公司的 26 个模型与匹配的人类小组，共覆盖 96 个平衡二元组。结果显示最佳模型与人类群体在每个模态上的准确率统计上无差异，但二者的决策偏好不同：人类在两个答案间保持平衡，而最强模型倾向于回答“陌生人”。
Motivation: 社交情境理解往往依赖行为而非仅凭语言，现有工作缺少一个控制提示内容、仅靠互动方式来评估熟悉度推断能力的标准化基准。
Method: 构建 FriendBench 基准，使用 96 个平衡的双人破冰对话片段，每个二元组回答相同类型的提示；在文本、音频、视频三种模态上对比 26 个模型（来自 7 家公司）与匹配的人类小组，并发布刺激材料、人类评分和模型预测。
Result: 最佳模型与人类群体在每种模态的准确率上统计不可区分；但人类在两个答案间保持平衡，最强模型则偏向“陌生人”，作者将这种偏差归因于有效先验（effective prior）差异而非判别能力差异。更丰富的通道对两者帮助不均，只有人类能从可见行为叠加语音中获益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模型与人类在熟悉度推断上的差异在于先验而非判别力，并指出更丰富模态带来的收益在模型与人类之间并不一致。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Parts Are Greater Than the Sum: Automated Task Sequencing for Efficient Training of Multi-Policy LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) commonly adapts large language models using a single shared Low-Rank Adapter (LoRA). This shared optimization space often suffers from interference when adapting heterogeneous task sequences, leading to poor transfer and catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches mainly improve adapter expressiveness by increasing parameter capacity or composing multiple adapters, yet they still rely on a shared optimization path. In this paper, we propose an optimization-path organization framework for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, implemented as an automatic multi-policy PEFT architecture. Specifically, optimization-compatible adaptation paths are automatically organized through task grouping and task sequencing under a fixed parameter budget. The organized optimization paths are implemented as independent Quantized Low-Rank Adapters (QLoRA), enabling heterogeneous tasks to be optimized in decoupled adaptation spaces while preserving positive transfer among compatible tasks. Experiments on the TRACE benchmark demonstrate that performance consistently improves from conventional single-policy PEFT to multi-policy PEFT, with the proposed automatic multi-policy framework achieving the best performance of 44.78 under the same trainable capacity. This suggests that optimization-path organization is more effective than simply increasing adapter capacity for heterogeneous parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向大语言模型参数高效微调（PEFT）的优化路径组织框架，以自动多策略 PEFT 架构实现。方法通过任务分组与任务排序，在固定参数预算下将优化兼容的路径组织为独立的量化低秩适配器（QLoRA），使异构任务在解耦的适配空间中优化并保持兼容任务间的正迁移。在 TRACE 基准上，从单一策略 PEFT 到多策略 PEFT 性能持续提升，所提自动多策略框架在相同可训练容量下取得最佳性能 44.78。
Motivation: 共享单个 LoRA 适配器的 PEFT 在异构任务序列上存在优化空间干扰，导致迁移差和灾难性遗忘；现有方法主要扩大参数容量或组合多个适配器，但仍依赖共享优化路径。
Method: 提出优化路径组织框架：在固定参数预算下通过任务分组和任务排序自动组织优化兼容的适配路径，并实现为独立的 QLoRA，使异构任务在去耦的适配空间中优化，同时保持兼容任务间的正迁移。
Result: 在 TRACE 基准上的实验表明，从传统单策略 PEFT 到多策略 PEFT 性能持续提升，所提出的自动多策略框架在相同可训练容量下达到最佳性能 44.78。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，对于异构任务的参数高效微调，优化路径组织比单纯增加适配器容量更有效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: FibVLA: An Efficient Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model with Fibonacci Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs), which leverage the cognition of multimodal information to infer physical-world actions, provide a generalized solution for embodied AI applications. Conventional VLAs usually concentrate on current digital cognition. While some efforts are made to enhance VLAs' reasoning capabilities by capturing temporal information, encoding the long-context history causes an efficiency-decreasing issue. To reconcile the conflict between capturing temporal information and maintaining inference efficiency in VLAs, this paper introduces FibVLA, an efficient framework featuring temporal perception of long-context history. Specifically, we leverage logarithmic hindsight sampling to both proprioceptive states and visual frames to capture long-term temporal dependencies with minimal redundancy. For the action expert, we introduce the flow matching to produce action distributions, and the Fibonacci recurrent inference strategy to generate long-range planning steps based on real-time closed-loop feedback. Experiments demonstrate that FibVLA significantly improves action smoothness and success rates without retraining large-scale visual encoders. Efficiency analysis demonstrates superior real-time responsiveness compared to video-based baselines in real-world evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FibVLA，一个面向长上下文历史的高效时序视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA)。核心做法是用对数滞后采样 (logarithmic hindsight sampling) 同时处理本体感觉状态和视觉帧，以最小冗余捕获长期时序依赖；动作专家使用流匹配 (flow matching) 生成动作分布，并用斐波那契循环推理策略基于实时闭环反馈生成长程规划步骤。实验表明该方法能显著提升动作平滑度和成功率，且无需重训大规模视觉编码器，在真实世界评估中的实时响应优于基于视频的基线。
Motivation: 传统 VLA 主要关注当前数字感知，而增强时序推理能力时编码长上下文历史会导致效率下降；该工作旨在调和“捕获时序信息”与“保持推理效率”之间的矛盾。
Method: 对本体感觉状态和视觉帧采用对数滞后采样以捕获长期时序依赖并减少冗余；动作专家引入流匹配生成动作分布；采用斐波那契循环推理策略，基于实时闭环反馈生成长范围规划步骤。
Result: 实验显示 FibVLA 在不重新训练大规模视觉编码器的前提下显著改善了动作平滑度和成功率；效率分析表明其在实际评估中的实时响应优于基于视频的基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能在 VLA 中兼顾时序感知和推理效率，并且避免了大规模视觉编码器的重训开销。

papers.title: CoDe-SSM: Context-Detail Decoupled State Space Model for Efficient UHD Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-high-definition (UHD) image restoration must balance the aggregation of spatially recurring degradation cues with the preservation of localized image structures. Compact aggregation can reduce redundant processing but may attenuate edges, textures, and other fine structures. Existing approaches manage UHD restoration cost through downsampling, window partitioning, or cluster-based token reduction; yet many of them do not explicitly retain information that is poorly represented by shared aggregation. In this study, we propose a Context-Detail Decoupled State Space Model (CoDe-SSM) for UHD restoration, which processes aggregated context and clustering residuals in separate pathways. The context modeling pathway, implemented by the Global Cluster Scan Module (GCSM), aggregates features into $K$ input-dependent cluster centers and applies selective SSM reasoning over the resulting fixed-order sequence, enabling cross-region context sharing while decoupling computational cost from spatial resolution. The detail recovery pathway, implemented by the Local High-Frequency Module (LHFM), processes the clustering residual with an input-derived high-frequency mask and a sparse mixture of convolutional experts. Extensive experiments on five UHD benchmarks and five degradation types demonstrate that our explicit context-detail decoupling strategy yields substantial gains in restoration quality while maintaining desirable efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Context-Detail Decoupled State Space Model (CoDe-SSM)，用于超高清（UHD）图像恢复。该方法将聚合上下文与聚类残差分两条路径处理：Global Cluster Scan Module (GCSM) 将特征聚合为 K 个输入相关的聚类中心，并对固定顺序序列施加选择性 SSM 推理，实现跨区域上下文共享并解耦计算成本与空间分辨率；Local High-Frequency Module (LHFM) 用输入推导的高频掩码和稀疏混合卷积专家处理聚类残差。在五个 UHD 基准和五种退化类型上报告了恢复质量的显著提升。
Motivation: UHD 图像恢复需要在聚合空间上重复出现的退化线索与保留局部结构（边缘、纹理）之间取得平衡。现有方法通过下采样、窗口划分或基于聚类的 token 缩减控制成本，但多数未显式保留难以被共享聚合表征的信息。
Method: 提出上下文-细节解耦的状态空间模型，包含两条路径：GCSM 用 K 个输入相关的聚类中心聚合特征并通过选择性 SSM 处理固定顺序序列；LHFM 用输入推导的高频掩码和稀疏混合卷积专家恢复聚类残差中的细节。
Result: 在五个 UHD 基准和五种退化类型上的实验表明，显式的上下文-细节解耦策略在恢复质量上带来显著增益，同时保持理想的效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将聚合上下文与聚类残差分离处理的思路可同时获得高质量恢复与效率优势。

papers.title: Convergence and Regret of the Policy Gradient for Multi-Armed Bandits in Diffusion Environment
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the policy gradient update for a multi-arm bandit problem in diffusion environment that is described by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) under the continuous-time reinforcement learning framework by Wang et al. (2020), Jia and Zhou (2022b). With the logit parameterization for the stochastic policy, we show that it converges almost surely to the optimal arm under an arbitrary constant learning rate. Furthermore, we derive the non-asymptotic regret upper bound when the constant learning rate is below a time-invariant threshold; and the regret bound has order $O(\log T)$. We improve the analysis in Lattimore (2026a) for the same SDE by constructing a novel Lyapunov function and demonstrate the transparency of analyzing policy gradient using the tools in SDEs. In addition, the same Lyapunov function is also helpful in analyzing the discrete-time policy gradient algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散环境（由随机微分方程描述的 SDE）中多臂老虎机问题的策略梯度更新，在连续时间强化学习框架下采用 logit 参数化随机策略。作者证明在任意常数学习率下算法几乎必然收敛到最优臂，并在学习率低于一个与时间无关的阈值时给出非渐近遗憾上界 O(log T)。文中通过构造新的 Lyapunov 函数改进了 Lattimore (2026a) 对同一 SDE 的分析，并展示 SDE 工具在策略梯度分析中的透明性。
Motivation: 在连续时间强化学习的扩散环境中，已有策略梯度分析存在改进空间，作者希望以更透明的 SDE 工具改进 Lattimore (2026a) 的结论，并放宽常数学习率的条件。
Method: 采用 logit 参数化的随机策略，在连续时间 SDE 框架下分析策略梯度更新；核心是构造一个新的 Lyapunov 函数，用于证明收敛性和推导遗憾界，并说明该函数同样适用于离散时间策略梯度算法分析。
Result: 摘要报告在任意常数学习率下策略梯度几乎必然收敛到最优臂；当常数学习率低于某个与时间无关的阈值时，非渐近遗憾上界为 O(log T)。
Conclusion: 作者认为构造的 Lyapunov 函数同时有助于离散时间策略梯度算法的分析，并展示了用 SDE 工具进行策略梯度分析的透明性。

papers.title: TOOD: Task-Aware Out-of-Distribution Score Calibration for Continual Learners
papers.abstract_en: The primary challenge of continual learning (CL) systems is to learn new tasks while remaining performant on previously learned tasks. A similarly important though less well-studied aspect of CL systems is their ability to distinguish inputs that are unlikely to come from within the set of tasks the system has already encountered, often called out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. This paper presents several findings related to the dynamics of OOD detection in CL systems, causes of performance degradation over time which we call OOD forgetting (OODF), and proposed mitigation strategies for this degradation. Chiefly, we find the unintuitive result that OODF is only weakly anti-correlated with classification performance on previous tasks, suggesting that the underlying mechanisms producing OODF are distinct. Moreover, this effect is observed for both energy-based and feature-based OOD detection methods. Energy-based detectors suffer a drop in logit scale as additional tasks are learned, which we term the Confidence Gap, while feature-based detectors also degrade under a complementary effect we call Manifold Crowding. Motivated by these observations, we propose TOOD, a training-free post-hoc method that decomposes logits into per-task energy scores and re-calibrates them using replay-buffer statistics. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and a 100-task ImageNet-1K stream show that TOOD improves OOD detection performance over uncalibrated energy in most settings and ranks first or second in nine of ten CIFAR configurations, with the largest gains when the confidence gap is most severe. These results suggest that a substantial portion of OOD deterioration in continual learning arises from score miscalibration rather than from a complete loss of discriminative structure.

papers.title: TraceViT: Grounded Trace Supervision for Visual Abstract Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) tests whether a model can infer an unseen transformation from a few input-output examples and apply it to a new grid. Looped visual reasoners refine predictions over multiple iterations, but conventional training constrains only the final output, leaving intermediate refinements unconstrained. We propose that these refinements should instead follow the transformation step by step. We introduce TraceViT, a looped visual reasoner trained with semantically monotonic transformation chains. We obtain these chains by rewriting and verifying programmatic task implementations, decomposing each solution into intermediate grid states. Each iteration is grounded by a task reference derived from the few-shot demonstrations and an object workspace representing the current grid state. Because these chains may differ in length from the loop, soft trace alignment enforces only their ordering, letting the model allocate iterations freely. TraceViT achieves 67.8% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 and 24.3% on ARC-AGI-2. Controlled ablations on ARC-AGI-1 show that trace supervision becomes beneficial only when paired with grounding. Code and data will be available at https://github.com/LiuBinnan/TraceViT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TraceViT，一种用语义单调变换链 (semantically monotonic transformation chains) 训练的循环视觉推理器 (looped visual reasoner)，针对 ARC 视觉抽象推理任务。作者通过重写并验证程序化任务实现，把每个解决方案分解成中间网格状态；每次迭代由少样本演示得到的任务参考 (task reference) 和表示当前网格状态的对象工作空间 (object workspace) 做接地。软迹对齐 (soft trace alignment) 只约束顺序而非长度，让模型自由分配迭代次数。摘要在 ARC-AGI-1 上报告 pass@2 为 67.8%，在 ARC-AGI-2 上为 24.3%。
Motivation: ARC 要求模型从少数输入输出示例推断未知变换并应用到新网格。循环视觉推理器会多次迭代细化预测，但传统训练只约束最终输出，中间细化过程完全不受约束；作者认为这些中间细化应当逐步跟随真实变换。
Method: 引入 TraceViT，训练时构造语义单调的变换链作为中间监督信号。具体做法是重写并验证程序化任务实现，将每个解决方案分解为若干中间网格状态；每次迭代由一个从少样本演示推导出的任务参考和一个表示当前网格状态的对象工作空间共同接地。由于变换链长度可能与循环迭代数不同，软迹对齐只强制二者的偏序关系。
Result: 摘要报告 TraceViT 在 ARC-AGI-1 上达到 67.8% 的 pass@2，在 ARC-AGI-2 上达到 24.3%。针对 ARC-AGI-1 的受控消融显示，迹监督只有与 grounding 配合时才带来收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为 trace supervision 与 grounding 的组合是循环视觉推理训练中的有效设计，并计划公开代码和数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explaining AI-Image Detection: What the Heatmap Actually Shows
papers.abstract_en: A marketplace review photograph is a document: platforms approve refunds on it, and generative models drove the cost of forging one to zero. We study that detection problem, so we build a detector and attach an attribution map as its evidence, then measure what that pair delivers on 186,527 images under controls designed to change our conclusions when something is wrong. Compression history, not synthesis, drives naive evaluation: our strongest model reaches 0.9999 PR-AUC (area under the precision-recall curve) on a product-disjoint split, yet falls to 0.7254 once we re-encode synthetics into the real class's format, while five public detectors move by at most 0.07. Aligning one class relocates the cue rather than removing it, and the repaired model then assigns native files a median probability of synthesis of 0.0004. One identical final encode for both classes repairs that, and a three-seed factorial credits the encoding change with the whole gain (+0.176 +- 0.009 PR-AUC). That encode equalises the last stage only: forensic features alone still separate the classes at 0.7145 against a base rate of 0.254. For evidence we test maps causally, against controls that never consult the detector. Whether an attribution ranking exists at all depends on whether the detector reacts to the image. On our first-fix detector, which calls 96 of 100 edited frames real, no map beats a random one. On the detector we selected, twelve of seventeen maps clear that control on edited images and eight on generated ones; perturbation leads both axes and no gradient-CAM variant shows a positive advantage. The trivial controls never clear it, and on generated images the centre prior is worse than random. Our ensembled regional map clears both axes and takes the top pixel AP at 12.4 s per map against 44.9 for occlusion. Clearing a detector-blind control is not yet a faithful explanation, and we demonstrate none.
papers.comment: 8 pages of main text; 27 pages including references and appendix. 9 figures, 21 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 生成图片检测及其归因图（attribution map）的可信度，场景是平台审核市场评论照片的真伪。作者构建检测器并附上归因图作为证据，在 186,527 张图片上测量该组合的表现，发现压缩历史（compression history）而非合成本身驱动了朴素的评测结果。最强的模型在产品不相交划分（product-disjoint split）上达到 0.9999 PR-AUC，但把合成图重编码为真实类别格式后跌至 0.7254；对归因图做因果对照测试后，作者认为没有一种地图能通过全部对照，即未证明任何解释是忠实的。
Motivation: 市场评论照片可被平台作为退款凭证，而生成模型使伪造成本趋近于零；因此检测 AI 生成图并给出可核查的证据很重要。现有评测容易被压缩历史等非合成因素误导，归因图是否真正解释检测结果也缺乏因果验证。
Method: 作者构建检测器并用归因图作为证据，然后设计不查询检测器的对照（controls）来因果检验归因排序是否存在。实验包括将合成图重编码进真实类别格式、用三种子析因（three-seed factorial）把性能提升归因到编码变化，并比较扰动（perturbation）与多种 gradient-CAM 变体及集成区域图。
Result: 最强模型在 product-disjoint split 上 PR-AUC 为 0.9999，但合成图重编码后降至 0.7254，五个公开检测器最多移动 0.07；三种子析因实验把全部增益归因于编码变化（+0.176 ± 0.009 PR-AUC），仅对齐最后一步后取证特征仍以 0.7145 分离类别（基线 0.254）。在第一版修复检测器上（96/100 编辑帧被判为真实）没有地图胜过随机；所选检测器上 17 个地图中有 12 个在编辑图、8 个在生成图上通过对照，扰动方法领先，集成区域图以每张 12.4 秒的代价取得最高像素 AP（遮挡法为 44.9 秒）。
Conclusion: 摘要明确指出，通过检测器盲对照（detector-blind control）并不等于忠实的解释，本文未能展示任何忠实的归因图；即使修复检测器后，取证特征仍足以区分两个类别，说明解释与检测证据之间仍有差距。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DungeonBench: A Benchmark for Rules-Rich Tactical Reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons Combat
papers.abstract_en: Games and simulators make valuable benchmarks by turning decisions into measurable outcomes, but many current suites under-test rules-rich tactical reasoning: the ability to choose well when geometry, timing, resources, objectives, and rule interactions all matter at once. We introduce DungeonBench, a benchmark for tactical reasoning in Dungeons & Dragons combat, built to cover the vast majority of combat-relevant 2014 System Reference Document content whose effects can be resolved by the simulator while retaining mechanics that simplified combat simulators often abstract away. At each step, DungeonBench exposes a complete tactical observation, a pending decision, and an indexed list of executable options spanning movement, attacks, spells, reactions, objectives, preparation, and scarce resources. The task is to value legal choices whose consequences depend on action economy, creature traits, battlefield geometry, timing windows, and future encounters. DungeonBench has two tracks: Encounter, which evaluates local tactical play in single fights, and Day, which links encounters through persistent hit points, spell slots, consumables, preparation, and short-rest timing, forcing policies to trade off immediate tactical advantage against future survivability. The same engine-generated decision stream supports heuristic controllers, language-model policies, learned option rankers, and masked-action reinforcement-learning agents. We evaluate frontier language-model policies on this shared decision stream. Results show that full tactical observations do not saturate the benchmark: frontier policies often win direct encounters, but linked encounter days expose failures in resource budgeting, rest timing, and rule-aware tactical discipline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DungeonBench，一个基于龙与地下城 (Dungeons & Dragons) 战斗的规则密集战术推理基准，覆盖 2014 System Reference Document 中大部分可被模拟器解析的战斗相关内容。基准在每一步暴露完整战术观测、待决决策和索引化的可执行选项列表，并设 Encounter 与 Day 两个赛道，前者评估单场战斗的局部战术，后者通过持久生命值、法术位、消耗品、准备与短休息时间将战斗串联，迫使策略权衡即时战术优势与后续生存能力。对前沿语言模型策略的评估显示，完整战术观测并未使基准饱和：模型常能直接赢下遭遇战，但在关联遭遇的 Day 赛道中暴露出资源预算、休息时机与规则感知战术纪律上的失败。
Motivation: 现有游戏与模拟器基准常低估规则密集的战术推理能力，即需要在几何、时机、资源、目标和规则交互同时起作用的场景下做出好决策；DungeonBench 旨在填补这一测评空白。
Method: 作者构建基于 D&D 战斗的模拟器基准，每一步提供完整战术观测、待决策和涵盖移动、攻击、法术、反应、目标、准备与稀缺资源的可执行选项索引列表。同一引擎生成的决策流支持启发式控制器、语言模型策略、学习型选项排序器和掩码动作强化学习智能体，并设 Encounter 与 Day 两个赛道。
Result: 摘要报告了对前沿语言模型策略的评估：完整战术观测未使基准饱和，模型通常能赢得直接遭遇战，但在串联遭遇的 Day 赛道中暴露了资源预算、休息计时和规则感知战术纪律方面的失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调此类基准需要策略能妥善处理动作经济、生物特性、战场几何、时机窗口与后续遭遇的长期后果，并指出当前前沿语言模型在规则密集的战术推理上仍明显不足。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DynoDINO: Harnessing Dynamic Latent Information from DINO Features for Multi-Phase Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-phase Contrast-Enhanced Computed Tomography (CECT) plays a central role in the diagnosis and characterization of focal lesions by capturing temporal enhancement patterns across multiple acquisition phases. Accurate lesion segmentation from such data remains challenging because clinically relevant contrast kinetics are distributed across phases, while anatomical inconsistencies, respiratory motion, and incomplete acquisitions often lead to inter-phase misalignment and interrupted temporal information. Conventional segmentation frameworks typically process each phase independently or rely on simple fusion strategies, limiting their temporal reasoning capability. To address these challenges, we propose DynoDINO, a unified framework tailored to address the core challenges of multi-phase medical image segmentation. DynoDINO first performs slice-level alignment to establish inter-phase anatomical correspondence and then employs a Multi-phase Fusion Model to jointly enhance temporal correlations across phases. Our fusion model incorporates a Mix-attention (MA) mechanism for efficient multi-phase feature calibration and an Adaptive Gating Mechanism with difference-based residual learning to selectively preserve diagnostically relevant contrast variations while suppressing artifacts caused by residual misalignment. In addition, the adaptive gating mechanism improves training stability by preventing feature degradation caused by unguided subtraction operations. Experiments on three large-scale datasets, including LiTS, PLC-CECT, and WAW-TACE, demonstrate that DynoDINO consistently improves boundary delineation and structural fidelity under standard, shifted, and missing-phase conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynoDINO，一个面向多相位增强 CT（CECT）病灶分割的统一框架。该方法先进行切片级配准建立相位间解剖对应，再通过多相位融合模型增强时间相关性，其中包含 Mix-attention（MA）机制和基于差分残差学习的自适应门控机制。在 LiTS、PLC-CECT 和 WAW-TACE 三个大规模数据集上，DynoDINO 在标准、偏移相位和缺失相位条件下均持续改善边界描绘与结构保真度。
Motivation: 多相位 CECT 中临床相关的对比剂动力学信息分布在多个相位，而呼吸运动、解剖不一致和不完整采集常导致相位间错位与时间信息中断；现有方法通常逐相位处理或采用简单融合策略，时间推理能力有限。
Method: DynoDINO 先执行 slice-level alignment 建立相位间解剖对应，再使用 Multi-phase Fusion Model 联合增强相位间时间相关性；融合模型包含 Mix-attention（MA）机制用于高效多相位特征校准，以及带差分残差学习的 Adaptive Gating Mechanism，用于选择性保留诊断相关的对比变化并抑制残余错位伪影，同时通过防止无引导减法导致的特征退化来提升训练稳定性。
Result: 在 LiTS、PLC-CECT 和 WAW-TACE 三个大规模数据集上的实验表明，DynoDINO 在标准、偏移相位和缺失相位条件下均一致地改善边界描绘与结构保真度。
Conclusion: DynoDINO 为多相位医学图像分割提供了一种统一框架，能够处理相位间错位和时间信息不完整的问题，并同时改善分割质量与训练稳定性。

papers.title: MOT-SR: Multi-Objective Tool-Augmented Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic Regression (SR) aims to discover analytical equations from observational data and plays a central role in scientific modeling. While recent Large Language Model (LLM) based approaches show promise, they face two limitations. First, they lack data analysis mechanisms for uncovering variable dependencies, which reduces the efficiency of equation discovery. Second, most methods rely on single-objective evaluation focused solely on fitting error. This neglect of structural complexity and generalization often causes models to converge prematurely to local optima, limiting their ability to explore the broader equation space. We propose Multi-Objective Tool-augmented Symbolic Regression (MOT-SR), a unified framework that integrates external analytical tools to extract structural priors and guide equation generation, while jointly optimizing for accuracy, complexity, and generalization via a multi-objective evaluation module that maintains a dynamic Pareto front. MOT-SR employs two collaborative LLM modules: a Meta Strategy Generator, which selects tools and synthesizes structural optimization strategies based on Pareto-optimal equations, and an Equation Generator, which produces new candidate equations accordingly. The system operates in a closed-loop manner, continuously refining both strategies and equation structures. Across 40 standard tasks, MOT-SR outperforms existing SR methods in accuracy, generalization, and efficiency. We further validate MOT-SR on extreme mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) orbital modeling, an important problem in space-based gravitational-wave astronomy where small local errors can accumulate substantially over long-term evolution. The discovered interpretable correction achieves the lowest trajectory-level integration error on held-out configurations. These results demonstrate the potential of MOT-SR to enable reliable modeling of long-horizon scientific dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOT-SR（Multi-Objective Tool-augmented Symbolic Regression），一个面向科学方程发现的统一框架，用外部分析工具提取结构先验，并通过多目标评估模块联合优化拟合精度、复杂度和泛化能力，维护动态 Pareto front。系统由 Meta Strategy Generator 与 Equation Generator 两个协作 LLM 模块组成，以闭环方式持续精化策略与方程结构。摘要报告在 40 个标准任务上精度、泛化和效率均优于现有 SR 方法，并在极端质量比旋进（EMRI）轨道建模上获得最低的轨迹级积分误差。
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的符号回归方法缺乏数据依赖关系分析机制，且多数采用仅关注拟合误差的单目标评估，忽略结构复杂度与泛化性，容易过早收敛到局部最优，限制了对更大方程空间的探索。
Method: MOT-SR 整合外部分析工具以提取结构先验并引导方程生成，同时通过维护动态 Pareto front 的多目标评估模块联合优化精度、复杂度与泛化。框架包含两个协作 LLM 模块：Meta Strategy Generator 基于 Pareto 最优方程选择工具并综合结构优化策略，Equation Generator 据此生成新的候选方程，系统以闭环方式持续迭代。
Result: 在 40 个标准任务上，MOT-SR 在精度、泛化和效率方面优于现有符号回归方法；在空间引力波天文学中的 EMRI 轨道建模问题上，所发现的可解释修正项在保留配置上取得最低的轨迹级积分误差。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该结果表明 MOT-SR 有潜力支持长时间尺度科学动力学（如 EMRI 轨道演化）的可靠建模。

papers.title: LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning from Preference Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) systems are typically trained using a single, well-specified scalar reward function. However, real-world decision-making tasks often involve multiple, competing objectives, such as performance versus efficiency, where ground-truth reward functions are difficult to specify or inaccessible. While Multi-Objective RL (MORL) addresses such trade-offs by modeling rewards as vectors, existing approaches typically assume access to a well-specified reward function for each objective, inheriting the same challenges faced by single-objective RL. Meanwhile, Preference-based RL (PbRL) has shown great potential in solving complex tasks without access to a pre-defined reward function through reward learning from human feedback, yet has largely been studied in single-objective settings. In this work, we bridge this gap with LEMUR: Learning to Align with Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Preference feedback, a novel framework where an agent interactively learns from the preferences of multiple humans to learn optimal multi-objective policies. Our approach jointly learns policies and multiple objective-specific reward models from human feedback, enabling agents to effectively balance competing objectives during learning. We evaluate LEMUR on a variety of benchmark multi-objective tasks, and empirical results demonstrate its superior performance over baseline methods. Our method presents a promising direction for solving multi-objective decision-making tasks without pre-defined reward functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEMUR 框架，将多目标强化学习 (MORL) 与基于人类偏好反馈的奖励学习 (PbRL) 结合，使智能体在没有预定义奖励函数的情况下，从多个人类的偏好反馈中学习多目标策略。方法联合学习策略和多个目标特定的奖励模型，并在多种多目标基准任务上优于基线方法。
Motivation: 真实世界决策常涉及多个相互竞争的目标，而现有 MORL 方法通常假设每个目标都有明确指定的奖励函数，单目标 PbRL 又无法处理多目标权衡。LEMUR 旨在填补这一空白，实现在无预定义奖励函数条件下学习最优多目标策略。
Method: LEMUR 是一个交互式学习框架：智能体从多个人类的偏好反馈中学习，联合学习策略 (policy) 与多个目标特定的奖励模型 (objective-specific reward models)，从而在训练过程中有效平衡竞争目标。
Result: 在多种基准多目标任务上的实验表明，LEMUR 的性能优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为无需预定义奖励函数的多目标决策任务提供了有前景的解决方向。

papers.title: Pyramidal Width Can Increase Under Vertex Insertion
papers.abstract_en: Lacoste-Julien and Jaggi conjectured in 2015 that the pyramidal width of a polytope cannot increase when a vertex is added, provided that every old point remains a vertex. We give an exact counterexample with six integer points in $\R^3$. For \[ P=\conv\{v_0,\ldots,v_4\},\qquad Q=\conv\{v_0,\ldots,v_5\}, \] where \[ \begin{aligned} v_0&=(-1,-3,-1), & v_1&=(3,2,-2), & v_2&=(0,2,1),\\ v_3&=(-1,-3,3), & v_4&=(-2,0,1), & v_5&=(-1,0,-2), \end{aligned} \] all five vertices of $P$ remain vertices of $Q$, but \[ \PWidth(P)^2=\frac{48}{353} \quad\text{and}\quad \PWidth(Q)^2=\frac{36}{133}. \] Thus vertex insertion increases pyramidal width by the factor $\sqrt{1059/532}\approx 1.410886779$. The proof uses the equivalence between pyramidal width and facial distance, certifies both face lattices by integer supporting hyperplanes, and evaluates every facial distance by a finite rational calculation. A dependency-free exact verifier accompanies the paper.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Lacoste-Julien 与 Jaggi 在 2015 年提出的猜想给出精确反例：在保持所有旧点仍为顶点的条件下，向多胞形插入一个顶点可以使锥形宽度 (pyramidal width) 增大。作者构造了 R^3 中六个整数点的两个多胞形 P 与 Q，P 的五个顶点在 Q 中仍为顶点，但平方锥形宽度从 48/353 增至 36/133，增大约 sqrt(1059/532)≈1.410886779 倍。证明利用了锥形宽度与面距离 (facial distance) 的等价性，并通过整数支撑超平面与有限有理计算验证全部面格。
Motivation: 该猜想如果成立，会为锥形宽度在顶点迭代中的单调性提供理论依据，而锥形宽度与 Frank-Wolfe 类算法的收敛性相关；本工作要检验这一基础假设是否可靠。
Method: 构造带整数坐标的显式反例多胞形，利用锥形宽度与面距离的等价性进行证明：用整数支撑超平面 (integer supporting hyperplanes) 认证两个多胞形的面格，并对每个面距离做有限有理计算；同时提供一个无依赖的精确验证器 (dependency-free exact verifier) 伴随论文。
Result: 精确反例表明 PWidth(P)^2=48/353，PWidth(Q)^2=36/133，因此插入顶点后锥形宽度按因子 sqrt(1059/532)≈1.410886779 增加，直接否定原猜想。
Conclusion: 即使旧点全部保持为顶点，插入顶点也可能使锥形宽度增大，因此该猜测不成立；论文强调其证明与验证过程是完全精确的、不依赖数值近似。
