papers.title: Exponential Capacity in Multilayer Hetero-Associative Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Exponential Hopfield networks store a number of patterns that grows exponentially with the number of neurons, and in their classical formulation they are auto-associative: they complete a corrupted copy of a memory into the memory itself. Many of the tasks one wants such a network to perform are instead hetero-associative, mapping a cue to a different target. We introduce and analyse an exponential neural network of $L$ layers of $N$ binary neurons, each layer carrying its own dataset, whose energy is an exponential of the product of the per-layer Mattis overlaps, so that it is minimised precisely when every layer retrieves the pattern of the same index; the stored association must be a surjective function of the cue, and we show why nothing else can be stored at all. A cavity/signal-to-noise analysis, made exact at leading order by a large-deviation evaluation of the noise, shows that the aligned hetero-associative state is a fixed point of the zero-temperature dynamics up to a number of stored patterns $P_c\sim e^{Nρ_L}$, exponential in the layer size, with an explicit rate $ρ_L$ that grows like $L\log 2$; enlarging the basins of attraction lowers the rate but never destroys its exponential character. Comparing the theory with structured data we find that the exponential capacity and the predicted basins survive correlated, many-to-one patterns: the network is a near-perfect content-addressable memory. The same closed forms describe, without refitting, a synthetic manifold, real T-cell-receptor/epitope triples and natural-language intent data, so the mechanism is domain-universal. Generalisation to unseen cues, though significantly above chance, stays below memorisation, and it is the geometry of the encoding, rather than the data domain, that sets how far above chance it reaches. In this family, exponential storage and strong generalisation are distinct capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并分析了一类多层异联想指数 Hopfield 网络：L 层、每层 N 个二值神经元，能量取为各层 Mattis 重叠乘积的指数函数，从而在每层检索到相同索引的模式时能量最小。摘要报告其对齐的异联想态在零温动力学下可存储 P_c~e^{Nρ_L} 个模式，其中指数速率 ρ_L 近似为 L log 2，且该特性对相关多对一模式仍然成立。同一闭式无需重拟合即可描述合成流形、T 细胞受体/表位三元组和自然语言意图数据。
Motivation: 经典指数 Hopfield 网络是自联想模型，只能把带噪副本补全为记忆本身，但许多实际任务需要异联想映射，即从线索映射到不同的目标模式。
Method: 构造 L 层 N 个二值神经元的指数网络，能量为每层 Mattis 重叠乘积的指数函数，并证明存储的关联必须是线索的满射函数。作者用空腔/信噪比分析，并通过大偏差评估噪声使领先阶精确，从而刻画零温动力学的固定点。
Result: 零温动力学下对齐的异联想态在 P_c~e^{Nρ_L} 个存储模式内是固定点，速率 ρ_L 随 L 近似线性增长（L log 2）；扩大吸引域会降低速率但不破坏其指数特征。对相关、多对一模式以及多种真实数据（TCR/表位三元组、自然语言意图数据），指数容量和预测的吸引域仍然成立。
Conclusion: 作者认为该存储机制是领域通用的，且未见线索上的泛化显著高于随机但低于记忆水平，泛化程度由编码几何而非数据领域决定；在该网络家族中，指数存储与强泛化是相互独立的能力。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一类多层异联想指数 Hopfield 网络：L 层、每层 N 个二值神经元，能量取为各层 Mattis 重叠乘积的指数函数，从而在每层检索到相同索引的模式时能量最小。摘要报告其对齐的异联想态在零温动力学下可存储 P_c~e^{Nρ_L} 个模式，其中指数速率 ρ_L 近似为 L log 2，且该特性对相关多对一模式仍然成立。同一闭式无需重拟合即可描述合成流形、T 细胞受体/表位三元组和自然语言意图数据。
summary_sections.motivation: 经典指数 Hopfield 网络是自联想模型，只能把带噪副本补全为记忆本身，但许多实际任务需要异联想映射，即从线索映射到不同的目标模式。
summary_sections.method: 构造 L 层 N 个二值神经元的指数网络，能量为每层 Mattis 重叠乘积的指数函数，并证明存储的关联必须是线索的满射函数。作者用空腔/信噪比分析，并通过大偏差评估噪声使领先阶精确，从而刻画零温动力学的固定点。
summary_sections.result: 零温动力学下对齐的异联想态在 P_c~e^{Nρ_L} 个存储模式内是固定点，速率 ρ_L 随 L 近似线性增长（L log 2）；扩大吸引域会降低速率但不破坏其指数特征。对相关、多对一模式以及多种真实数据（TCR/表位三元组、自然语言意图数据），指数容量和预测的吸引域仍然成立。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该存储机制是领域通用的，且未见线索上的泛化显著高于随机但低于记忆水平，泛化程度由编码几何而非数据领域决定；在该网络家族中，指数存储与强泛化是相互独立的能力。

papers.title: COntExt: Towards Context-Aware Ontology Extension from Operational Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Organizations increasingly define operational metrics in structured, machine-readable formats to monitor systems, processes, and compliance. These metric definitions implicitly encode domain knowledge, such as referencing concepts, properties, and relationships, that often extends what is captured in formal ontologies. Yet the connection between operational metric catalogues and ontological knowledge remains manual, ad-hoc, and labor-intensive. We present COntExt, a framework for context-aware ontology extension that takes structured metric definitions as input and suggests how referenced concepts and properties should be integrated into an existing ontology, utilizing the context of these metrics. The framework defines the extension problem as three sub-tasks: parent class prediction, relation type prediction, and data property assignment. Across four cybersecurity ontologies, we evaluate different algorithms for each task. Our results show that metric-derived context improves the suggestions over ontology-context baselines for relation type prediction and data property assignment. Our work demonstrates that operational metric catalogues are a practical and underexploited source for ontology extension. This work enables organizations to maintain their ontologies at a significantly lower cost than manual engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COntExt 框架，以结构化操作指标 (operational metrics) 定义为输入，利用这些指标的上下文建议如何将其中引用的概念和属性集成到现有本体中。框架将本体扩展分解为父类预测 (parent class prediction)、关系类型预测 (relation type prediction) 和数据属性分配 (data property assignment) 三个子任务，并在四个网络安全本体上评估不同算法。结果显示，指标派生上下文在关系类型预测和数据属性分配上优于仅基于本体上下文的基线。
Motivation: 组织常以结构化、机器可读格式定义操作指标来监控系统、流程与合规，这些定义隐式编码了引用概念、属性和关系等领域知识，往往超出正式本体已捕获的范围。然而指标目录与本体知识之间的连接目前依赖手动、临时且劳动密集的工作。
Method: COntExt 将本体扩展问题形式化为三个子任务：父类预测、关系类型预测和数据属性分配，并以指标定义的上下文作为主要信号，建议把引用的概念和属性整合进现有本体。
Result: 在四个网络安全本体上对每个任务评估不同算法，结果表明由指标派生的上下文 (metric-derived context) 在关系类型预测和数据属性分配任务上优于基于本体上下文的基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为操作指标目录是实用且未被充分利用的本体扩展来源，该框架可以帮助组织以显著低于人工工程的成本维护本体。

papers.title: AMTFV: Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification for LLM Self-Correction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have demonstrated strong mathematical problem-solving capabilities, yet reliably verifying their candidate answers remains challenging. Existing representative methods mainly revise outputs through natural-language reflection or assist verification by directly generating verification programs; the former may not reliably support exact computation, whereas the latter prematurely couples mathematical modeling with low-level implementation. We propose AMTFV (Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification). By introducing Mathematical Tool Flow (MTF) as an interrupt--execute--resume interface, AMTFV decouples verification modeling from concrete execution and supports exact computation through a mathematical toolbox. Specifically, the verification agent first constructs a verification workflow, encodes the mathematical objects and computational intent requiring reliable execution in an MTF request, and sends it to the mathematical toolbox agent. The latter parses the request, generates executable calls, and dispatches them to the backend for exact computation. Tool outputs then support candidate-answer adjudication, answer revision, and verification-workflow revision. We evaluate AMTFV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with seven model configurations from DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini. Experimental results show that AMTFV outperforms the representative baselines evaluated in this study overall; under an individual model configuration, it improves average accuracy over the strongest baseline by up to 8.3 percentage points, with larger gains on samples of medium and high verification complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AMTFV（Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification），一种面向大语言模型的智能体数学工具流验证方法。通过引入数学工具流（MTF）作为中断-执行-恢复（interrupt-execute-resume）接口，AMTFV 将验证建模与具体执行解耦，并借助数学工具箱支持精确计算。作者在五个数学推理数据集和七种模型配置（DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini）上评估，结果显示 AMTFV 整体优于所比较的代表性基线。
Motivation: 现有答案验证方法要么通过自然语言反思来修订输出，难以可靠支持精确计算；要么直接生成验证程序，过早地将数学建模与底层实现耦合。这促使作者设计一种能分离建模与执行、同时支持精确计算的验证机制。
Method: 验证代理首先构建验证工作流，将需要可靠执行的数学对象和计算意图编码为 MTF 请求并发送给数学工具箱代理；工具箱代理解析请求、生成可执行调用并分派到后端进行精确计算，工具输出随后用于候选答案裁决、答案修订以及验证工作流修订。
Result: 在五个挑战性数学推理数据集上的实验显示，AMTFV 整体优于评估中的代表性基线；在单个模型配置下，相比最强基线的平均准确率最高提升 8.3 个百分点，且在中、高验证复杂度的样本上收益更大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将验证建模与具体执行解耦并利用数学工具箱进行精确计算，可以有效改善 LLM 的答案验证与自我纠错能力。

papers.title: MoRoute: Dynamic Routing for In-Context Multimodal Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal video generation aims to generate and edit videos conditioned on arbitrary combinations of text, images, and videos within a single model, allowing diverse tasks to share complementary data and generative priors. Unifying these tasks requires multimodal understanding of diverse conditions, which is typically provided by a pretrained vision-language model (VLM). A key challenge is how to connect the VLM's hierarchical multimodal representations with a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT). Existing methods either inject features from only the final or a few manually selected VLM layers, or jointly train architecture-matched understanding and generation streams, making it difficult to reuse heterogeneous pretrained backbones. We introduce MoRoute, a unified multimodal video generation framework that formulates a frozen VLM and a pretrained video DiT with different architectures as heterogeneous experts connected through dynamic layer routing. For each input, a lightweight block-wise router enables every DiT block to select the VLM layer most relevant to its generation stage, thereby learning an adaptive correspondence between multimodal understanding and video synthesis. MoRoute further incorporates reference images and source videos directly into the DiT token sequence through unified in-context conditioning, preserving fine-grained visual details across diverse generation and editing tasks. Experiments on IntelligentVBench, OpenVE-Bench, and RefVIE-Bench show that MoRoute consistently surpasses the best competing method on each benchmark, improving the average score by 0.15, 0.18, and 0.34 on a 1-5 scale, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoRoute，一个统一的多模态视频生成框架，通过动态层路由将冻结的视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 与预训练视频扩散 Transformer (DiT) 这两个异构专家连接起来。每个 DiT 块由一个轻量级块级路由器选择与其生成阶段最相关的 VLM 层，同时参考图像和源视频通过统一上下文条件直接加入 DiT token 序列。在 IntelligentVBench、OpenVE-Bench 和 RefVIE-Bench 上，MoRoute 持续超过各基准的最强对比方法，1-5 量表下平均分分别提升 0.15、0.18 和 0.34。
Motivation: 多模态视频生成需要将 VLM 的分层多模态表示与预训练视频 DiT 连接，但现有方法要么只注入最后或少数人工选择的 VLM 层特征，要么联合训练架构匹配的理解与生成流，导致难以复用异构预训练骨干。
Method: 将不同架构的冻结 VLM 与预训练视频 DiT 建模为异构专家，通过动态层路由连接；轻量级路由器让每个 DiT 块按输入和生成阶段选择最相关的 VLM 层，并采用统一上下文条件把参考图像与源视频直接放入 DiT token 序列以保留细粒度视觉细节。
Result: 在 IntelligentVBench、OpenVE-Bench 和 RefVIE-Bench 三个基准上，MoRoute 均超过各自最强的对比方法，1-5 量表上的平均分分别提高 0.15、0.18 和 0.34。
Conclusion: 摘要表明动态层路由与统一上下文条件能够有效复用异构预训练骨干并适配多种视频生成与编辑任务，但没有提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: The K-Space Signature: Frequency-Domain Representation Learning for Medical Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: In medical imaging, generative models are increasingly deployed to synthesize realistic data and augment limited datasets. Unfortunately, while beneficial for privacy-preserving data sharing, these synthesized images can be repurposed for malicious intents, threatening public health through the creation of Medical Deepfakes. To address this threat, we introduce the K-Space Signature (KSS), a novel forensic framework that isolates hardware and generative traces within the spectral domain. By shifting analysis to the frequency domain, the KSS suppresses macroscopic anatomical variance by subtracting an empirical global anatomical prior computed in the Logarithmic Power Spectral Density (Log-PSD) space. To effectively process these globally distributed spectral artifacts without the local spatial bias inherent to Convolutional Neural Networks, we pair the KSS representation with a novel 3D MLP-Mixer architecture equipped with an ArcFace metric-learning head. Extensive experiments on multi-center 3D MRI datasets demonstrate that this combined approach achieves exceptional detection performance, exceeding 0.99 Accuracy and ROC-AUC on multi-generator synthetic datasets. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robust zero-shot generalization, maintaining strong discriminative power (up to 0.93 Accuracy) on independent datasets acquired from entirely unseen scanners. To ensure full reproducibility, the complete source code and pre-trained models will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 K-Space Signature (KSS)，一种面向医学影像深度伪造检测的频域取证框架。该方法在对数功率谱密度空间减去经验全局解剖先验以抑制宏观解剖差异，并结合 3D MLP-Mixer 与 ArcFace 度量学习头处理全局分布的频谱伪影。在多种生成器合成的多中心 3D MRI 数据集上，检测准确率和 ROC-AUC 超过 0.99，并在未见过的扫描仪数据集上实现最高 0.93 的零样本准确率。
Motivation: 生成模型在医学影像中用于数据增强和隐私保护共享，但合成图像可能被恶意利用为 Medical Deepfakes，威胁公共健康。现有方法主要依赖空间域局部特征，难以处理全局分布的频谱生成痕迹。
Method: 提出 KSS 取证框架，在频域分离硬件与生成痕迹：在 Log-PSD 空间减去经验全局解剖先验以消除宏观解剖差异；并设计 3D MLP-Mixer 结构搭配 ArcFace 度量学习头，避免 CNN 的局部空间偏置并处理全局频谱伪影。
Result: 在多生成器合成的多中心 3D MRI 数据集上，检测准确率和 ROC-AUC 均超过 0.99；在完全未见过的扫描仪所得独立数据集上保持强判别力，零样本准确率最高达 0.93。
Conclusion: 作者强调 KSS 与 3D MLP-Mixer 结合可高效检测医学深度伪造并具备跨扫描仪泛化能力；完整源代码和预训练模型将在论文被接收后公开以保障可复现性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ARB: A Matched Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark Dataset for AI-Text Detector Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Standard AI-text detection benchmarks compare human-written text against text generated directly by large language models (LLMs). While prior work has shown that rewriting and paraphrasing can degrade detector performance, it remains unclear whether performance measured on this conventional benchmark predicts detector behavior when human-authored content is rewritten by an LLM. To address this gap, we introduce Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB), built from 1,800 human source texts (600 each from XSum, WritingPrompts, and OpenWebText) and four open-weight generators (Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Gemma-2-9B). Each source item yields four matched variants: human-written (HUMAN), direct LLM generation (Free-LLM), LLM-rewritten human text (H2L), and same-generator LLM-rewritten LLM text (LLM2L). We evaluated five detectors (FastDetectGPT, Binoculars-falcon-7b, RADAR, BERT-Defense, RoBERTa-Defense) at a strict 1%-false-positive operating point (TPR@1%FPR). FastDetectGPT and Binoculars-falcon-7b detected 91.2% and 93.5\% of direct LLM text, but only 30.8% and 15.1% of human text an LLM had rewritten, a drop of 60-78 percentage points. The same detectors retained 78.3% and 83.0% recall when LLM text was rewritten by the same model, a much smaller decline of 10-13 points. RADAR followed the same pattern (66.8% to 12.2%), while BERT-Defense and RoBERTa-Defense stayed below 3% recall across all regimes. These results show that detector performance measured on the conventional human-vs-LLM benchmark does not transfer to human-authored text revised by an LLM, even though the same detectors remain largely robust to LLM-only rewriting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Authorship-Rewriting Benchmark (ARB)，一个用于评估 AI 文本检测器在作者改写场景下性能的匹配基准数据集。基准由 1,800 篇人类源文本（分别来自 XSum、WritingPrompts、OpenWebText）和四个开源生成器（Llama-3.2-3B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Gemma-2-9B）构建，每个源文本生成四个变体：人工写作、直接 LLM 生成、LLM 改写人类文本、同生成器改写 LLM 文本。评测五个检测器在严格 1% 假阳性率下的召回率，发现常规基准上的性能不能迁移到 LLM 改写的人类文本场景。
Motivation: 现有 AI 文本检测基准只比较人类文本与 LLM 直接生成的文本，但真实场景中人类文本常被 LLM 改写；先前工作表明改写会降低检测性能，但常规基准测得的性能能否预测这类改写场景下的检测行为尚不清楚。
Method: 构建 ARB 基准，每个源文本提供四个匹配变体：HUMAN、Free-LLM、H2L（LLM 改写人类文本）、LLM2L（同生成器改写 LLM 文本），并在 1% 假阳性率操作点（TPR@1%FPR）下评估 FastDetectGPT、Binoculars-falcon-7b、RADAR、BERT-Defense、RoBERTa-Defense 五个检测器。
Result: FastDetectGPT 和 Binoculars-falcon-7b 对直接 LLM 文本的检测率分别为 91.2% 和 93.5%，但对 LLM 改写的人类文本仅检测出 30.8% 和 15.1%，下降 60-78 个百分点；对同模型改写的 LLM 文本保持 78.3% 和 83.0% 召回率，仅下降 10-13 个百分点。RADAR 从 66.8% 降至 12.2%，而 BERT-Defense 和 RoBERTa-Defense 在所有场景下召回率均低于 3%。
Conclusion: 常规人类对 LLM 直接生成文本的检测性能不能迁移到 LLM 改写人类文本的场景，但检测器对纯 LLM 改写仍较鲁棒，说明现有评估协议低估了实际改写场景的检测难度。

papers.title: OSAGEN: Object-Aware Mask Priors and Multistage Decoupled Diffusion for Industrial Anomaly Generation
papers.abstract_en: Industrial anomaly detection and localization are limited by scarce real anomalies and pixel-level annotations, a bottleneck that synthetic image-mask pairs can alleviate. However, existing few-shot mask-guided generation may over-follow mask geometry, produce weak anomalies, or use condition masks incompatible with the current object instance. We propose OSAGEN, which combines object-aware mask priors with multistage decoupled diffusion. Its three-stage adaptation sequentially learns normal appearance, defect appearance under coarse conditions, and fine-grained mask calibration, improving defect realization and local control. QBG injects object structure from a matched normal image into mask diffusion to produce object-aware priors, while ISC restricts anomaly propagation and preserves normal content during sampling. A lightweight materialization step recovers pixel-level labels aligned with the realized defects. On MVTec AD and VisA, OSAGEN achieves AP-P/F1-P scores of 88.1/82.2 and 68.5/66.1, respectively, under a unified downstream localization protocol. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OSAGEN，一种用于工业异常生成的框架，将对象感知掩码先验与多阶段解耦扩散相结合。通过三阶段适应依次学习正常外观、粗条件下的缺陷外观和细粒度掩码校准，并利用 QBG 注入对象结构、ISC 限制异常传播。在 MVTec AD 和 VisA 上，OSAGEN 在统一下游定位协议下达到 AP-P/F1-P 为 88.1/82.2 和 68.5/66.1。
Motivation: 工业异常检测与定位受制于真实异常样本和像素级标注稀缺，现有少样本掩码引导生成方法可能过度遵循掩码几何、产生弱异常，或使用与当前对象实例不兼容的条件掩码，导致生成质量受限。
Method: OSAGEN 包含三阶段适应：先学习正常外观，再在粗条件下学习缺陷外观，最后进行细粒度掩码校准。QBG 将匹配的正常图像中的对象结构注入掩码扩散以生成对象感知先验，ISC 在采样过程中限制异常传播并保留正常内容，最后通过轻量级物化步骤恢复与已实现缺陷对齐的像素级标签。
Result: 在 MVTec AD 和 VisA 数据集上，OSAGEN 在统一下游定位协议下的 AP-P/F1-P 分别达到 88.1/82.2 和 68.5/66.1。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 OSAGEN 通过对象感知掩码先验和多阶段解耦扩散改善了缺陷实现效果与局部控制能力，代码将在论文被接收后发布。

papers.title: Multi-Source Multi-View Graph Domain Adaptation with Hyperbolic Residual Encoding for Cross-Site MDD Identification from rs-fMRI
papers.abstract_en: Cross-site identification of major depressive disorder (MDD) from resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) is hindered by inter-site distribution shifts and heterogeneous functional connectivity (FC) views. These views capture complementary neural relationships but exhibit distinct site biases and graph topologies, complicating alignment without sacrificing disease-relevant information or cross-view consistency. Existing studies largely treat multi-view connectome learning and cross-site adaptation separately. To the best of our knowledge, few studies have jointly modeled multiple FC views under multi-source unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-site rs-fMRI-based MDD classification. We construct Pearson correlation, sparse representation, and Granger causality graphs, each encoded by a view-specific graph attention network. Dual-stream adaptive fusion explicitly integrates pairwise cross-view interactions, followed by lightweight hyperbolic residual encoding for curvature-aware representation refinement. Class-wise Cauchy--Schwarz alignment reduces inter-source and source-target discrepancies, complemented by adversarial learning, information maximization, and confidence-aware pseudo-labeling. Across seven unlabeled target domains, our framework achieves 73.60% mean accuracy and 71.90% AUC, demonstrating effective generalization under heterogeneous acquisition conditions. These results highlight the effectiveness of unified heterogeneous-view modeling, curvature-aware refinement, and multi-source domain adaptation for cross-site MDD identification.The source code is at https://github.com/OPUS-Lightphenexx/MM-HyperGDA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对静息态功能磁共振成像（rs-fMRI）跨中心识别重度抑郁症（MDD）时面临的跨站点分布偏移与异构功能连接（FC）视图问题，提出一种多源多视图图域自适应框架。框架用视图专属图注意力网络编码 Pearson 相关、稀疏表示和 Granger 因果三类 FC 图，通过双流自适应融合、双曲残差编码以及类间 Cauchy-Schwarz 对齐等机制，在七个未标记目标域上实现 73.60% 的平均准确率和 71.90% 的 AUC。
Motivation: 跨站点 rs-fMRI 的 MDD 识别受站点间分布偏移和异构 FC 视图影响，而现有研究大多将多视图连接组学习与跨站点自适应分开处理，很少在无监督域自适应下联合建模多个 FC 视图。
Method: 构建 Pearson 相关、稀疏表示和 Granger 因果三类 FC 图，每个图由视图专属图注意力网络（graph attention network）编码；随后进行双流自适应融合以整合成对跨视图交互，并用轻量双曲残差编码做曲率感知表示细化；最后以类间 Cauchy-Schwarz 对齐减少源域间及源-目标域差异，辅以对抗学习、信息最大化和置信度感知伪标签。
Result: 在七个未标记目标域上，该方法达到 73.60% 的平均准确率与 71.90% 的 AUC，表明在异构采集条件下具备有效泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一异构视图建模、曲率感知细化与多源域自适应对跨站点 MDD 识别有效，并公开了源代码。

papers.title: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Explainable Early Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: Identifying reliable Alzheimer's disease (AD) markers typically requires manual, labor-intensive transcription and expert analysis, limiting its scale. We introduce an automated pipeline that extracts qualitative knowledge about potential AD progression indicators directly from audio recordings of verbal fluency tests. Our method uses pretrained foundation models to process raw audio and extract clinically relevant variables to construct a Bayesian Network (BN); this BN is used to reason about the AD progression markers and infer their qualitative relationships. Our system successfully recovers known clinical knowledge and identifies novel relationships between linguistic markers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号 (neurosymbolic) 的自动化流水线，直接从言语流畅性测试 (verbal fluency test) 的音频记录中提取关于阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 进展指标的定性知识。方法利用预训练基础模型 (pretrained foundation models) 处理原始音频并提取临床相关变量，进而构建贝叶斯网络 (Bayesian Network, BN) 来推理 AD 进展标志物并推断其定性关系。摘要称系统成功恢复了已知的临床知识，并识别出语言标志物之间的新关系。
Motivation: 识别可靠的 AD 标志物通常依赖人工转录和专家分析，过程耗时且难以规模化；本文目标是将这一过程自动化，直接从自然语音中获取关于 AD 进展指标的定性临床知识。
Method: 提出完整自动化管线：先用预训练基础模型处理原始音频并提取临床相关变量，再以这些变量构建贝叶斯网络，利用该 BN 推理 AD 进展标志物并学习它们之间的定性关系。
Result: 摘要报告该系统能够恢复已知的临床知识，并发现语言标志物之间的新颖关系；但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 本文表明神经符号方法可以从音频中自动提取可解释的 AD 进展知识，有潜力减少人工转录与专家分析的负担，并提升 AD 早期诊断标志物发现的可扩展性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TerraNova: A Foundation Model for the Anthropocene
papers.abstract_en: A defining problem of the Anthropocene is to model the physical Earth and human societies as one coupled system, yet no learned representation spans their observational breadth. We argue the obstacle is geometric: the physical Earth is measured as continuous fields that ignore political borders, whereas societies are reported for administrative units. Earth-system foundation models serve the first geometry; coupling it to the second has required lossy averaging over borders. We introduce TerraNova, a foundation model trained on 1,024 physical and societal records in their native geometries: 512 gridded Earth-system fields and 512 national indicators. Dedicated encoders represent location, country, time and task, cross-modal transformers fuse them into a shared spatiotemporal state, and a hypernetwork generates a per-query decoder whose evidential head returns a predictive distribution. Two contrastive objectives couple the representation: a population-weighted alignment between each country and coordinates in its territory, and one to pretrained geospatial embeddings carrying image-derived semantics. Read out through that decoder, the representation is competitive with purpose-built geospatial encoders while spanning axes they do not represent (time, oceans and uncertainty) and supporting country-level capabilities. The frozen backbone reconstructs dense fields from sparse observations and adapts to unseen variables in minutes on consumer hardware.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 16 figures. Supplementary Information (full methodological specification, ablation programme, extended results, computational cost; 157 pages) available at the project page: https://carlosrodriguezpardo.es/projects/TerraNova/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TerraNova，一种在 1,024 个物理与社会经济记录上训练的地球系统基础模型，目标是建模人类世中物理地球与人类社会的耦合系统。核心论点是当前障碍在于几何不匹配：物理场是连续网格、社会数据按行政单元报告，而现有地球系统基础模型只服务前者，耦合需要跨边界的损失性平均。模型用专用编码器刻画位置、国家、时间和任务，经跨模态 transformer 融合成共享时空状态，并由超网络生成带证据头的逐查询解码器；摘要称该表示在覆盖时间、海洋与不确定性等额外轴的同时与专用地理空间编码器相当，并支持国家层面能力。
Motivation: 人类世的一个核心问题是将物理地球与人类社会视为单一耦合系统进行建模，但现有学习表示无法覆盖这两类观测的广度；作者认为根本障碍是几何不一致，即物理场连续且无视政治边界，而社会数据按行政单元报告，这要求在该类基础模型中进行损失性平均。
Method: TerraNova 在 512 个网格化地球系统场和 512 个国家指标的原始几何上训练；位置、国家、时间和任务由专用编码器表示，跨模态 transformer 将其融合为共享时空状态，超网络（hypernetwork）生成逐查询解码器，其证据头（evidential head）输出预测分布。两个对比目标分别做人口加权的国家-领土坐标对齐，以及与携带图像语义的预训练地理空间嵌入对齐。
Result: 摘要报告该冻结主干从稀疏观测重建稠密场，并能在消费级硬件上于数分钟内适应未见变量；其表示与专用地理空间编码器竞争，同时覆盖时间、海洋和不确定性等这些编码器未表示的轴，并具备国家级能力。
Conclusion: 作者主张以原生几何建模代替跨边界的有损平均，能够将物理与社会观测耦合进共享表示；摘要未提及降水、临近预报或数据同化等具体任务，范围限定在地球系统基础模型。
Relevance: 30

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 TerraNova，一种在 1,024 个物理与社会经济记录上训练的地球系统基础模型，目标是建模人类世中物理地球与人类社会的耦合系统。核心论点是当前障碍在于几何不匹配：物理场是连续网格、社会数据按行政单元报告，而现有地球系统基础模型只服务前者，耦合需要跨边界的损失性平均。模型用专用编码器刻画位置、国家、时间和任务，经跨模态 transformer 融合成共享时空状态，并由超网络生成带证据头的逐查询解码器；摘要称该表示在覆盖时间、海洋与不确定性等额外轴的同时与专用地理空间编码器相当，并支持国家层面能力。
summary_sections.motivation: 人类世的一个核心问题是将物理地球与人类社会视为单一耦合系统进行建模，但现有学习表示无法覆盖这两类观测的广度；作者认为根本障碍是几何不一致，即物理场连续且无视政治边界，而社会数据按行政单元报告，这要求在该类基础模型中进行损失性平均。
summary_sections.method: TerraNova 在 512 个网格化地球系统场和 512 个国家指标的原始几何上训练；位置、国家、时间和任务由专用编码器表示，跨模态 transformer 将其融合为共享时空状态，超网络（hypernetwork）生成逐查询解码器，其证据头（evidential head）输出预测分布。两个对比目标分别做人口加权的国家-领土坐标对齐，以及与携带图像语义的预训练地理空间嵌入对齐。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该冻结主干从稀疏观测重建稠密场，并能在消费级硬件上于数分钟内适应未见变量；其表示与专用地理空间编码器竞争，同时覆盖时间、海洋和不确定性等这些编码器未表示的轴，并具备国家级能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张以原生几何建模代替跨边界的有损平均，能够将物理与社会观测耦合进共享表示；摘要未提及降水、临近预报或数据同化等具体任务，范围限定在地球系统基础模型。

papers.title: From Code Review to Code Critique: Intent, Drift, and Spotlight for AI-Generated Diffs at Scale
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are generating code at volumes that exceed the capacity of traditional peer review. At the same time, existing AI code review tools over-index on low-value suggestions such as style and best practices while under-indexing on the concerns human reviewers prioritize most: correctness, security, and performance. We present ARCTIC, an AI-powered Code Critique system that reframes code review around three capabilities: intent prediction, which infers why a change was made from conversation logs and metadata; drift detection, which measures divergence between the developer's intent and the agent's output via backtranslation; and code spotlight, which ranks the regions of a diff most warranting human scrutiny. We ground these capabilities in a six-theme taxonomy derived from 18,000 code reviews. Offline evaluation shows that intent prediction achieves 0.86 F1, drift detection reaches near-perfect ordinal agreement with human annotators (QWK = 0.907), and spotlight outperforms the baseline AI reviewer by 2.4x on quality estimation at 5x fewer tokens. In the experimental rollout, the drift scores reduces code misalignment by an additional 5.76 points (p = 0.026), intent prediction receives 90.2% approval, and zero defects have been attributed to self-reviewed diffs since launch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARCTIC，一个面向 AI 生成代码变更的代码批判 (code critique) 系统，将传统代码审查重构为三个能力：意图预测 (intent prediction)、漂移检测 (drift detection) 和代码聚光灯 (code spotlight)。系统基于从 18,000 条代码审查中提炼的六主题分类法，离线评估显示意图预测 F1 为 0.86，漂移检测与人工标注的序数一致性 QWK=0.907，spotlight 在质量估计上以 5 倍更少的 token 超越基线 AI 审查器 2.4 倍；实验部署中漂移分数额外降低代码错位 5.76 分 (p=0.026)，意图预测获得 90.2% 认可，且上线以来无缺陷归因于自审查 diff。
Motivation: AI 编码智能体生成的代码量超过传统同行评审能力，而现有 AI 代码审查工具过度关注风格和最佳实践等低价值建议，对正确性、安全性和性能等人类审阅者最关心的问题关注不足。
Method: 提出 ARCTIC 系统，包含三个核心能力：从对话日志和元数据推断变更原因的意图预测；通过反向翻译 (backtranslation) 度量开发者意图与智能体输出之间分歧的漂移检测；以及对 diff 中最需要人工审查的区域进行排序的代码聚光灯。这些能力基于从 18,000 条代码审查中得出的六主题分类法。
Result: 离线评估中，意图预测达到 0.86 F1，漂移检测与人工标注的序数一致性接近完美 (QWK=0.907)，spotlight 在质量估计上以 5 倍更少的 token 比基线 AI 审查器提升 2.4 倍。实验部署中，漂移分数额外降低代码错位 5.76 分 (p=0.026)，意图预测获得 90.2% 审批率，且自发布以来没有缺陷被归因于自审 diff。
Conclusion: 基于意图、漂移和聚光灯三要素的代码批判框架能更好地对齐 AI 代码审查与人类优先关注点，并在大规模自审场景中减少代码错位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ordered-to-disordered transfer learning with graph neural networks for formation-energy and HOMO-LUMO gap prediction in high-entropy perovskite oxides
papers.abstract_en: High-entropy perovskite oxides (HEPOs) represent a chemically complex class of materials with promising functional properties, yet their vast compositional space and, chemical/structural disorder pose significant challenge for accurate property prediction. Graph neural networks (GNNs) enable rapid exploration of materials space but are often limited by the availability of representative training data. Here, we investigate ordered-to-disordered transfer learning using GNNs for formation-energy and HOMO-LUMO gap prediction in HEPOs by transferring knowledge learned from chemically ordered perovskites. Four representative GNN models, including CGCNN, GATGNN, ALIGNN and M3GNet are evaluated to understand the role of structural representations, spanning pairwise two-body and angular three-body interactions in transfer performance. We find strong property-dependent transfer behavior: formation-energy prediction transfers effectively to disordered HEPOs, whereas HOMO-LUMO gap prediction shows limited transferability due to its sensitivity to local chemical environments. Incorporating a small HEPO-specific training dataset substantially improves HOMO-LUMO gap prediction. Representation-level analysis using UMAP further highlights the importance of encoding three-body geometric information such as in ALIGNN for capturing complex structure-property relationships and improving transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用图神经网络（GNN）将化学有序钙钛矿的知识迁移到无序高熵钙钛矿氧化物（HEPOs），用于形成能和HOMO-LUMO带隙预测。作者评估了CGCNN、GATGNN、ALIGNN和M3GNet四种模型，发现形成能预测能够有效迁移到无序HEPOs，而HOMO-LUMO带隙预测迁移效果有限；加入少量HEPO特定训练数据可显著改善带隙预测。UMAP表示分析表明编码三体几何信息（如ALIGNN）有助于捕捉复杂结构-性能关系并提升迁移性。
Motivation: 高熵钙钛矿氧化物（HEPOs）化学组成复杂且存在化学/结构无序，巨大的组分空间给性能预测带来挑战；GNN虽能加速材料空间探索，但受限于代表性训练数据的缺乏。
Method: 提出有序到无序的迁移学习框架，将化学有序钙钛矿上训练的知识迁移到无序HEPOs；系统评估CGCNN、GATGNN、ALIGNN和M3GNet四种GNN，并引入少量HEPO特定数据微调，结合UMAP分析结构表示（两体、三体相互作用）对迁移性能的影响。
Result: 形成能预测能有效迁移至无序HEPOs，而HOMO-LUMO带隙预测因对局部化学环境敏感而迁移性有限；加入小规模HEPO训练集显著提升带隙预测。UMAP分析显示包含三体几何信息（如ALIGNN）的表示对迁移性更有利。
Conclusion: 迁移学习对形成能预测有效，但HOMO-LUMO带隙预测仍需HEPO特定数据；编码三体几何信息有助于提升GNN在复杂无序材料上的迁移能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leveraging Transfer Learning with Class-Specific Decoders for Laparoscopic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Effective multi-organ segmentation in surgical data requires learning the intricate anatomical features and alleviating the challenge of class imbalance, which results from relatively lower proportions of small and limitedly exposed structures. Recent works on laparoscopic multi-organ segmentation focus on learning structure-specific features through class-specific decoder architectures and report favorable results. This work extends the decoder-focused architectures to investigate knowledge sharing in the cross-surgical domain. We utilize two datasets representing different surgical domains, rectal and cholecystectomy surgeries, to explore how surgical conceptual knowledge transfers under partially common anatomical representations. Additionally, we compare the feature adaptation for the encoder and decoder at different training stages to analyse the knowledge adaptation and retention in the network. Our results corroborate previous findings on decoder-specific architectures and demonstrate that the organ-specific decoder model (CEMD), fully fine-tuned after cross-domain pre-training, achieves the highest segmentation performance (62.4\% dice) while converging substantially faster than training from scratch. However, we also find that class imbalance in surgical data remains a persistent challenge that transfer learning does not fully resolve for underrepresented anatomical structures.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究腹腔镜多器官分割中的分类专用解码器架构，并探索跨手术领域的知识迁移。作者使用直肠手术和胆囊切除术两个代表不同手术领域的数据集，比较编码器与解码器在不同训练阶段的特征适应。摘要报告器官专用解码器模型（CEMD）在跨域预训练后全量微调取得最高分割性能（62.4% dice），且比从零训练收敛明显更快，但类别不平衡问题仍未完全解决。
Motivation: 腹腔镜多器官分割需要学习复杂的解剖特征，并缓解因小器官和暴露有限结构占比较低而带来的类别不平衡挑战。已有工作通过分类专用解码器学习结构特定特征并取得较好结果，本文将该类架构扩展到跨手术领域的知识共享研究。
Method: 利用直肠手术与胆囊切除术两个数据集，在部分共享解剖表征下探索手术概念知识的迁移；对比编码器和解码器在不同训练阶段的特征适应情况，并评估跨域预训练后全量微调的 organ-specific decoder model（CEMD）。
Result: 摘要报告 CEMD 在跨域预训练后全量微调达到最高分割性能（62.4% dice），并比从零训练显著更快收敛；同时发现迁移学习无法完全解决低表示解剖结构上的类别不平衡问题。
Conclusion: 结果印证了以往关于解码器专用架构的发现，表明跨域预训练加全量微调能提升分割表现并加速收敛，但类别不平衡仍是手术数据中迁移学习未能彻底解决的持续挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Grokked Illusion: True Equilibrium Mitigates Catastrophic Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: While neural networks are typically evaluated by their training and test performance, these metrics do not reveal how robust a learned representation is. Recent studies have shown that solutions occupying larger volumes in parameter space, as quantified by Boltzmann entropy, often exhibit superior generalizability compared to those reached by conventional optimization, a phenomenon known as the high entropy advantage. Here we ask whether this advantage persists beyond generalization. Specifically, we investigate models' robustness, the ability to retain the learned knowledge when the model is subsequently trained to acquire new information. Using grokking in modular arithmetic as a controlled setting, we design a noise injection experiment to evaluate the robustness difference between AdamW-trained transformers and high-entropy model sampled from Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics with identical saturated performance. By forcing both models to fully remember new data with random labels, we find that AdamW-trained models suffer from catastrophic forgetting, with original task test accuracy dropping from 100% to below 75%, whereas the high-entropy models maintain approximately 95% test accuracy. We term this hidden fragility behind apparent generalization the "grokked illusion." Through singular value decomposition of the neural network weights, we discover that high-entropy neural networks possess significantly higher effective rank in attention and MLP layers both before and after noise injection, indicating richer feature representations can serve as a buffer against catastrophic forgetting. Our findings demonstrate that perfect generalization does not imply equal robustness, offering a new perspective on what makes a trained model robust to interference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络在完美泛化下的鲁棒性差异，以模运算上的 grokking 为受控实验，对比 AdamW 训练的 Transformer 与基于 Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics 采样的高玻尔兹曼熵模型。通过注入随机标签的新数据迫使模型记忆，发现 AdamW 模型发生灾难性遗忘，原始任务测试准确率从 100% 降至 75% 以下，而高熵模型仍保持约 95%。作者将这种隐藏的脆弱性称为“grokked illusion”，并用权重奇异值分解发现高熵网络在 attention 和 MLP 层具有更高的有效秩。
Motivation: 现有评估通常只看训练和测试性能，无法揭示学习表示的鲁棒性；作者追问高熵优势是否超越泛化，即模型在后续学习新信息时能否保留已有知识。
Method: 在模运算 grokking 这一受控设置中，设计噪声注入实验，比较饱和性能相同的 AdamW 训练模型与从 Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics 采样的高熵模型，并让两者被迫完全记住带随机标签的新数据以评估鲁棒性；同时通过权重奇异值分解分析有效秩。
Result: AdamW 训练模型在注入噪声后原始任务测试准确率从 100% 降至 75% 以下，而高熵模型保持约 95%；高熵网络在 attention 和 MLP 层中的有效秩显著更高，且该差异在噪声注入前后均存在。
Conclusion: 研究表明完美泛化并不等同于同等鲁棒性，更丰富的特征表示可作为抵抗干扰的缓冲，为训练模型的鲁棒性提供了新视角。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 在模运算 grokking 这一受控设置中，设计噪声注入实验，比较饱和性能相同的 AdamW 训练模型与从 Wang-Landau Molecular Dynamics 采样的高熵模型，并让两者被迫完全记住带随机标签的新数据以评估鲁棒性；同时通过权重奇异值分解分析有效秩。
summary_sections.result: AdamW 训练模型在注入噪声后原始任务测试准确率从 100% 降至 75% 以下，而高熵模型保持约 95%；高熵网络在 attention 和 MLP 层中的有效秩显著更高，且该差异在噪声注入前后均存在。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究表明完美泛化并不等同于同等鲁棒性，更丰富的特征表示可作为抵抗干扰的缓冲，为训练模型的鲁棒性提供了新视角。

papers.title: Transcript-Managed Transformers: Monotone Multi-Agent Collapse and Universality with Two Pop-Enabled Transcripts
papers.abstract_en: We study transcript management for fixed, finite-precision causal Transformers. A transcript is partitioned into channels of bounded blocks. Each transition consults a fixed visible suffix and may append one block, leaving the model, weights, and token protocol unchanged. The operation $P_c:=\PopContext(c)$ deletes the newest block on channel $c$ and exposes its predecessor. We model the layer by the Transcript-Managed Transducer $\TMTn{k}$: one finite controller, $k$ channels, and per-round actions from stay, push, and pop under a caller-driven status map. Fixed visible windows encode as finite symbols. The pop-free Restricted Transcript-Managed Transducer $\RTMTn{k}$ is the standard append-only layer and, for every fixed $k$, realizes exactly the deterministic finite-state transductions. The same holds for every fixed finite agent population under a monotone protocol that appends, routes, and copies visible blocks. Admitting $\{P_c\}_{c=1}^k$ restores pop. Newest-first, a pop-enabled channel is a stack; compiling to the Hopcroft--Ullman presentation transfers the classical hierarchy: $\DCFL$ for $k=1$ and $\RE$ for every $k\ge2$. Orchestrated one-channel agents match one controller with $k$ channels, so two pop-enabled transcripts---in one agent or two---suffice for universality. Simulation costs and invariance to fixed block size and visible radius are stated. The bounds fix precision, alphabets, blocks, visibility, controller state, and population; growing exact context, hidden-block access, writable stores, and unbounded \textbf{Spawn} add further state.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 tables, 0 figures. Theoretical results on transcript management for fixed-precision Transformers: monotone multi-agent collapse to finite-state transducers, and universality with two pop-enabled transcript channels
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从形式语言与自动机理论角度研究固定、有限精度因果 Transformer 的 transcript 管理能力。作者定义 Transcript-Managed Transducer TMT_n^k：一个有限控制器、k 个通道，每轮可选择 stay、push、pop 动作；禁用 pop 的受限版本 RTMT_n^k 对每个固定 k 恰好实现确定性有限状态转导 (deterministic finite-state transduction)。启用 pop 后，通道成为栈：k=1 时给出 DCFL，k≥2 时给出 RE；因此两个 pop-enabled transcript 即可达到通用性 (universality)。
Motivation: 固定精度因果 Transformer 的可见上下文本质上是纯追加的，其表达能力可能停留在有限状态层面。作者希望在不改变模型、权重与 token 协议的前提下，仅通过有界块的通道划分与 pop 操作来恢复更强的计算层次。
Method: 提出 transcript 管理框架：transcript 被划分为有界块的多个通道，每次转移查看固定可见后缀并追加一个块，PopContext(c) 删除通道 c 的最新块并暴露其前驱。分层由 TMT_n^k 建模，配合调用方驱动的状态映射；将 pop-enabled 通道编译到 Hopcroft–Ullman 表示，从而迁移经典语言层次，并用一个控制器匹配多个单通道 agent 的编排来证明通用性。
Result: 摘要报告：pop-free 的 RTMT_n^k 对每个固定 k 恰好实现确定性有限状态转导，固定的单调多 agent 协议（追加、路由、复制可见块）下同样成立；加入 pop 后，k=1 时达到 DCFL，k≥2 时达到 RE。两个 pop-enabled transcript（单个 agent 或两个 agent）足以实现通用性，并给出了模拟代价以及对于固定块大小和可见半径的不变性。
Conclusion: 结论强调所有上界都固定了精度、字母表、块、可见性、控制器状态与群体规模；若引入增长的精确上下文、隐藏块访问、可写存储或无界 Spawn，则会进一步增加状态。作者的核心论断是两个 pop-enabled transcript 足以覆盖通用计算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive FastOPD: Progress-Aware Rollout Horizon Expansion for Efficient On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense teacher supervision along student-generated trajectories, but its online rollout process incurs substantial computational cost, particularly when a few long responses delay batch completion. Existing acceleration methods typically control rollout length using fixed budgets or absolute teacher--student agreement thresholds, which may not reflect learning progress across different models and training stages. We propose Adaptive FastOPD, a progress-aware strategy that expands the rollout horizon only when learning near the current boundary region has plateaued and the current horizon is sufficiently utilized. The former is determined from four teacher--student signals measured relative to their values upon entering each horizon, making expansion responsive to stage-specific progress rather than a predefined step interval or an absolute threshold on the raw agreement signals, while the latter prevents a small number of long responses from triggering increases in rollout cost. Across two teacher--student pairs, Adaptive FastOPD achieves the highest average performance while reducing training time by 49.1--71.2\% relative to OPD 15K, and remains robust across a range of hyperparameter settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adaptive FastOPD，一种用于在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation, OPD）的进度感知 rollout 视野扩展策略：仅当当前边界区域附近的学习已趋于平台期、且当前视野已被充分使用时才扩展 rollout 视野。摘要报告在两个教师-学生（teacher-student）组合上取得最高平均性能，并相对 OPD 15K 将训练时间减少 49.1–71.2%，且对超参数设置保持稳健。
Motivation: OPD 沿学生生成轨迹提供密集教师监督，但在线 rollout 计算成本高，尤其少数长响应会拖慢批次完成。现有加速方法使用固定预算或绝对教师-学生一致阈值控制 rollout 长度，无法反映不同模型和训练阶段的学习进度。
Method: 提出 Adaptive FastOPD：由四个教师-学生信号相对于进入每个视野时的值来判断学习是否平台化，从而决定是否扩展视野；同时要求当前视野被充分利用，避免少数长响应导致 rollout 成本上升。
Result: 在两个教师-学生组合上，方法取得最高平均性能，并将训练时间相对 OPD 15K 降低 49.1–71.2%，且在多种超参数设置下表现稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于阶段特异的进度信号（而非固定步长间隔或原始一致信号的绝对阈值）来响应 rollout 扩展，可以更高效地加速 OPD；其验证范围限于两个教师-学生组合和 8 页篇幅内的实验设置。

papers.title: DreamQAS: Learning a Decision-Useful World Model for VQE-Efficient Quantum Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning-based quantum architecture search (RL-QAS) repeatedly optimizes a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) after extending a circuit, although circuit construction and action legality are deterministic and known. We introduce DreamQAS, a model-based RL framework that preserves these exact circuit dynamics and learns only the expensive post-VQE feedback. A recurrent randomized-prior ensemble predicts an oracle-free score relative to an empirical energy frontier and supports multi-step imagined policy learning over explicit legal circuits. Ranking-based activation, uncertainty-aware pessimism and truncation, and selective real-VQE verification form a reliability-controlled learning loop. Under a common 15,000-episode budget and frozen evaluation for the RL methods, DreamQAS has the lowest mean frozen-policy energy error on four of five molecular tasks and the second-lowest on one. At fine-error targets reached by all seeds of both methods, it uses 1.6x to 2.0x fewer real VQE calls on four tasks and 10.6x fewer on BeH2-8q. Counterfactual action-ranking utility increases across all five tasks, with a mean increase of 0.346 and a 95 percent confidence interval of [0.185, 0.507], while direct greedy and beam use of the same model does not recover the gains of imagined policy learning. Ensemble disagreement also improves risk-coverage over random rejection on all three probed tasks. These results establish a world-model design for QAS whose value lies in decision-useful feedback rather than exact energy prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamQAS，一个基于模型的强化学习框架，用于变分量子本征求解器（VQE）下的量子架构搜索（QAS）。框架保留精确的电路动力学，只学习昂贵的 VQE 后反馈，并用循环随机先验集成（recurrent randomized-prior ensemble）预测相对经验能量前沿的无 oracle 分数。在 15,000 幕预算下，DreamQAS 在五个分子任务中的四个取得最低平均 frozen-policy 能量误差，并以更少的真实 VQE 调用达到细误差目标。
Motivation: 强化学习量子架构搜索（RL-QAS）在扩展电路后反复优化 VQE，但电路构建与动作合法性是确定且已知的；昂贵的 VQE 后反馈成为主要瓶颈，现有方法未利用这些确定性的电路动力学。
Method: 提出 model-based RL 框架，保留精确电路动力学，仅学习昂贵的 VQE 后反馈；使用循环随机先验集成预测相对能量前沿的无 oracle 分数，并支持显式合法电路上的多步想象策略学习，配合基于排名的激活、不确定性感知的悲观与截断，以及选择性真实 VQE 验证。
Result: 在常见 15,000 幕预算下，DreamQAS 在五个分子任务中的四个取得最低平均 frozen-policy 能量误差，一个为次低；在四个任务上使用 1.6x–2.0x 更少的真实 VQE 调用，在 BeH2-8q 上减少 10.6x。反事实动作排名效用在所有五个任务上平均提升 0.346（95% CI [0.185, 0.507]），集成分歧在三个任务上改进了风险覆盖；直接贪心或 beam 使用同一模型无法恢复想象策略学习的收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作的价值在于为 QAS 建立一种以决策有用反馈而非精确能量预测为核心的世界模型设计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evidence-Type Competition: When Can Interventional Data Teach Language Models Causal Direction?
papers.abstract_en: Interventional data is widely regarded as the gold standard for teaching models causal reasoning. We test this assumption in a fully controlled synthetic environment pitting observational correlation against causal effect, and find it fails instructively. In Simpson's-paradox worlds, where the two have systematically opposite signs, increasing the fraction of interventional samples in pretraining does not improve causal direction: the magnitude of the model's do()-response grows monotonically, yet its sign is copied from the observational context. What governs whether interventional evidence is used is not the training mixture but the evidence type present in the context at inference time. Under an identical training recipe, a purely observational context induces systematic sign reversal in 29/50 worlds, a mixed context in 19/50, while aligned interventional probes alone yield 41/50 correct. Erasing observational evidence from the context immediately releases the suppressed causal interpolation ability (ratio_true = +0.56); a four-state content manipulation shows the switch is content-mediated and graded. The suppression is stable across training seeds (11/11 strong reversals persist on a matched-protocol second seed) and robust as a rate at 0.93B parameters (31.8% vs. 6% reversals in the matched probe-only arm), even as absolute gains shrink four-fold. An external audit on CLadder exposes a learned positive-effect prior with a two-layer structure: sign-randomized retraining removes it in-distribution but not out-of-distribution. We summarize: the capability lives in the weights; the switch lives in the context, and activation patching localizes the switch to the middle layers' observational rows. We further quantify the sampling noise floor of probe-based causal evaluation and an evidence-averaging protocol that cuts sign errors from 26% to 9%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在完全受控的合成环境中检验“干预数据 (interventional data) 是教授模型因果方向的金标准”这一假设，并发现其失败方式很有启发性：在辛普森悖论 (Simpson's paradox) 世界中，观测相关与因果效应符号相反，增大预训练中干预样本比例并不会改善因果方向，模型 do() 响应的幅度单调增长但符号仍复制自观测上下文。作者定位到决定干预证据是否被使用的是推理时上下文中的证据类型，并通过激活修补 (activation patching) 将这一开关定位到中间层的观测行。
Motivation: 干预数据通常被视为训练模型因果推理的金标准，但该假设缺少严格受控的验证；在观测相关与因果效应方向冲突的情境下，增大干预数据比例是否真的教会模型因果方向，是本文要回答的问题。
Method: 构建辛普森悖论世界的完全受控合成环境，比较纯观测上下文、混合上下文与对齐的干预探针下的因果方向；用四状态内容操纵验证开关的内容中介性与渐变性质，用激活修补定位负责切换的网络层，并在 CLadder 上做外部审计。
Result: 在相同训练配方下，纯观测上下文在 29/50 世界中导致系统性符号反转，混合上下文为 19/50，而对齐干预探针得到 41/50 正确；从上下文删除观测证据后因果插值能力立即释放 (ratio_true = +0.56)；该抑制在 11/11 个训练种子下稳定，并在 0.93B 参数规模下以 31.8% 对 6% 的反转率保持稳健；CLadder 审计显示学到的正效应先验具有两层结构，符号随机化重训练可移除分布内但非分布外先验；提出的证据平均协议将符号错误从 26% 降至 9%。
Conclusion: 作者总结为：能力存在于权重中，而开关存在于上下文中；观测证据对因果方向的压制是可复现、规模稳健且由内容中介的，且外部基准审计揭示该行为来自分布外的正效应先验。

summary_sections.motivation: 干预数据通常被视为训练模型因果推理的金标准，但该假设缺少严格受控的验证；在观测相关与因果效应方向冲突的情境下，增大干预数据比例是否真的教会模型因果方向，是本文要回答的问题。
summary_sections.method: 构建辛普森悖论世界的完全受控合成环境，比较纯观测上下文、混合上下文与对齐的干预探针下的因果方向；用四状态内容操纵验证开关的内容中介性与渐变性质，用激活修补定位负责切换的网络层，并在 CLadder 上做外部审计。
summary_sections.result: 在相同训练配方下，纯观测上下文在 29/50 世界中导致系统性符号反转，混合上下文为 19/50，而对齐干预探针得到 41/50 正确；从上下文删除观测证据后因果插值能力立即释放 (ratio_true = +0.56)；该抑制在 11/11 个训练种子下稳定，并在 0.93B 参数规模下以 31.8% 对 6% 的反转率保持稳健；CLadder 审计显示学到的正效应先验具有两层结构，符号随机化重训练可移除分布内但非分布外先验；提出的证据平均协议将符号错误从 26% 降至 9%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者总结为：能力存在于权重中，而开关存在于上下文中；观测证据对因果方向的压制是可复现、规模稳健且由内容中介的，且外部基准审计揭示该行为来自分布外的正效应先验。

papers.title: MolGVR: A Chemistry-Grounded Framework for Text-to-Molecule Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-molecule generation is typically formulated as a one-shot sequence generation problem, where a model directly maps target descriptions to molecular representations. However, molecular descriptions often contain informative structural constraints, and violating such constraints can change the molecular identity. This makes chemical verification and error correction important but underexplored. To fill this gap, we propose MolGVR, a chemistry-grounded Generator--Verifier--Refiner framework. The Generator infers structural evidence and generates candidate molecules. The Verifier addresses the lack of chemical validation by converting descriptions into chemical constraints and checking candidates against them. The Refiner addresses generation failures by revising candidates rejected by the Verifier. Experiments on ChEBI-20 and PCDes show that MolGVR improves exact-match performance. These results suggest that coupling generation with executable verification and feedback-guided refinement is an effective way to improve text-to-molecule generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MolGVR，一个面向文本到分子生成 (text-to-molecule generation) 的化学感知 Generator–Verifier–Refiner 框架。Generator 推断结构证据并生成候选分子，Verifier 将描述转为化学约束并核查候选，Refiner 对有问题的候选进行修订。在 ChEBI-20 和 PCDes 上的实验表明该方法提升了 exact-match 性能。
Motivation: 现有文本到分子生成通常被建模为一次性序列生成，但分子描述常包含结构约束，违反约束会改变分子身份，因此化学验证与纠错很重要却未被充分探索。
Method: 提出三阶段框架 MolGVR：Generator 先推断结构证据并生成候选分子；Verifier 把自然语言描述转换为化学约束并对候选分子逐一核查；Refiner 针对被 Verifier 拒绝的候选进行修订，形成反馈引导的生成闭环。
Result: 在 ChEBI-20 和 PCDes 两个基准上的实验显示，MolGVR 相比基线提升了 exact-match 性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将生成与可执行的化学验证及反馈引导的修订相结合，是改善文本到分子生成任务的有效途径。

papers.title: Lightweight Neural Networks for Affordance Segmentation: Enhancement of the Decoder Module
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of deep neural networks for visual affordance segmentation on wearable robots poses may prove critical, due to some conflicting aspects of the problem. On one hand, affordance segmentation requires high-level abstraction capabilities, that typically involve large-size models. On the other hand, computing resources hosted on wearable robots prevent to run large-size models in real-time. The paper presents an analysis of the role of the segmentation head in the trade-off between generalization performance and compute cost. The obtained models outperform modern baseline solutions in well-known, real-world datasets while meeting low computing requirements.
papers.journal_ref: S. Lugani, E. Ragusa, R. Zunino, and P. Gastaldo, "Lightweight Neural Networks for Affordance Segmentation: Enhancement of the Decoder Module" in Applications in Electronics Pervading Industry, Environment and Society. ApplePies 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究可穿戴机器人上视觉可供性分割 (affordance segmentation) 的轻量级神经网络，重点分析分割头 (segmentation head) 在泛化性能与计算成本之间的权衡。摘要报告其模型在公开真实世界数据集上优于现代基线，同时满足低计算需求。
Motivation: 可供性分割需要高层抽象能力，通常依赖大模型，但可穿戴机器人上的计算资源无法实时运行大模型，这构成一对矛盾。
Method: 论文对分割头模块进行增强，并系统分析分割头在泛化性能与计算开销权衡中的作用，以在轻量网络条件下提升分割能力。
Result: 在公开真实世界数据集上，所得模型优于现代基线方案，同时保持较低的计算需求。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过优化解码器/分割头可以在轻量级模型中取得良好性能，适用于资源受限的可穿戴机器人场景。

papers.title: Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Search Agents that Pose, Solve, and Remember
papers.abstract_en: Self-play agents can generate training problems without questions from target benchmarks, but their curricula lack persistent state: failures affect gradients yet do not explicitly shape future practice. External skill memories preserve procedural experience but are typically learned from fixed task distributions. We introduce \textbf{SESA} (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent), which makes procedural memory an evolving state of tool-augmented search self-play. A challenger poses problems, while a separately parameterized solver alone retrieves skills. Informative failures are distilled into reusable skills and written back to memory. The updated memory changes solver behavior and success, which changes the challenger's reward and the distribution of future problems; the resulting frontier produces new failures that rewrite memory. This bidirectional loop makes task generation and skill memory co-evolve. Because retrieved skills shape on-policy training trajectories, their benefits can enter the model parameters as well as remain in the external bank, enabling memory-free deployment and optional inference-time retrieval. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, SESA improves average accuracy over SSP by 1.2--3.2 points across multiple backbones and surpasses the skill-augmented SkillRL baseline by 0.9 points under a unified evaluation protocol. On Qwen3 models, SESA-Off retains 1.8--2.2 points of improvement over SSP, while the final skill bank adds a further 0.5--1.0 points. These results show that evolving skill memory is not merely an inference-time plug-in: it changes policy learning and the future training distribution while retaining value as optional external memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zenghuang-Fu/SESA-Self-Evolving-Search-Agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SESA（Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent），将程序性记忆作为工具增强搜索自对弈（self-play）中的演化状态：挑战者（challenger）提出问题，独立参数化的求解者（solver）唯一负责检索技能；信息性失败被蒸馏为可复用技能写回记忆，记忆更新改变求解者行为与成功，进而改变挑战者奖励和未来问题分布，形成双向共同演化循环。在七个开放域和多跳问答基准上，SESA 在多个骨干网络上相对 SSP 平均提升 1.2–3.2 个点。
Motivation: 自对弈智能体可以生成训练问题，但其课程缺乏持久状态：失败影响梯度却不显式塑造未来练习；外部技能记忆能保留程序性经验，但通常从固定任务分布中学习。该方法针对的问题是让任务生成与技能记忆共同演化，而不仅是把记忆当作推理时插件。
Method: 提出 SESA：一个挑战者负责提出问题，一个单独参数化的求解者负责检索技能；失败的样本被蒸馏为技能并写回记忆库，更新的记忆改变求解者的行为与成功，从而改变挑战者的奖励和未来问题分布。检索技能塑造 on-policy 训练轨迹，收益既能进入模型参数，也能留在外部技能库中，从而支持无记忆部署和可选的推理时检索。
Result: 在七个开放域和多跳问答基准上，SESA 相比 SSP 在多个骨干上平均提升 1.2–3.2 个准确率点，并在统一评估协议下超过技能增强的 SkillRL 基线 0.9 个点。在 Qwen3 模型上，SESA-Off 相对 SSP 保留 1.8–2.2 个点提升，最终技能库额外带来 0.5–1.0 个点提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调演化技能记忆不仅是推理时插件：它改变策略学习和未来训练分布，同时保留作为可选外部记忆的价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Weight-Space Mixture-of-Experts for Implicit Neural Representation Classification
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) encode signals as the weights of a coordinate-based neural network and have recently been proposed as an alternative domain for downstream learning. While promising, classification directly in weight space remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and complex structure of INR parameters. Furthermore, the way discriminative information is distributed across INR weights remains poorly understood. We propose a hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (HMoE) Transformer that processes INR weights using conditional computation aligned with the structure of the underlying implicit network. Coupled with a meta-learning framework that shapes INR parameters for downstream tasks, our model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across standard benchmarks, ranging from low-resolution datasets to high-resolution ImageNet-1K. To gain insight into how INRs encode discriminative information, we develop weight-space attribution and pruning methods that identify parameters most relevant for classification. These analyses reveal how class-specific structure emerges within INR layers and support the suitability of MoE architectures for weight-space learning. Our approach advances both the performance and interpretability of weight-space classifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种层次化混合专家（Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts, HMoE）Transformer，直接在隐式神经表示（INR）的权重空间中做分类，并用元学习框架塑造INR参数以适应下游任务。摘要称该方法在从低分辨率数据集到ImageNet-1K的标准基准上达到当前最优准确率，同时通过权重空间归因与剪枝方法揭示判别信息在INR各层中的分布。
Motivation: 权重空间高维且结构复杂，直接对INR参数进行分类仍然困难；此外，判别信息如何分布在INR权重中尚不清楚，这限制了权重空间学习的理解和设计。
Method: 提出与底层隐式网络结构对齐的层次化MoE Transformer，以条件计算方式处理INR权重；配合元学习框架调整INR参数使其更适合下游任务；并开发权重空间归因与剪枝方法，用于定位对分类最重要的参数。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个标准基准（最高到ImageNet-1K）上取得最先进准确率；归因和剪枝分析显示类别特定结构会在INR层内出现，并支持MoE架构适用于权重空间学习。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法同时推进了权重空间分类器的性能与可解释性，并验证了MoE架构在权重空间学习中的适用性。

papers.title: MoPET: Parameter-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts for Unified Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Adapting deep learning models to profound clinical heterogeneity typically relies on parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to avoid the severe overfitting associated with full end-to-end network updates. Although PEFT successfully navigates limited data scenarios, it inherently forces the training of a separate, isolated adapter for every specific diagnostic task. Consolidating these isolated adapters into a single generalist network risks negative transfer, as optimization gradients from conflicting visual domains interfere. To address this, we propose MoPET, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) method that uses a learned sparse router to direct each input through a small subset of low-rank PEFT experts injected into a frozen foundation model, sharing capacity across datasets while limiting cross-domain gradient conflict. Through selected evaluations on the MedMNIST benchmark, we first establish that PEFT outperforms full network updates, improving average accuracy from 86.50% to 88.97%. We then show that a single MoPET model consolidates four heterogeneous datasets into one network, improving average accuracy over the best isolated PEFT adapters (93.46% versus 92.83%). Finally, we show that co-training with auxiliary datasets improves accuracy on data-constrained clinical targets, raising average target accuracy over the strongest isolated adapter from 81.58% to 83.58%. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sdoerrich97/mopet .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoPET，一种基于稀疏路由的混合专家 (MoE) 参数高效微调方法，用于在单个冻结基础模型上统一多个医学图像分类任务。在 MedMNIST 基准上，单一 MoPET 模型整合四个异构数据集，平均准确率 93.46% 超过最佳独立 PEFT 适配器的 92.83%；辅助数据集联合训练将数据受限目标的平均准确率从 81.58% 提升至 83.58%。
Motivation: 针对临床数据异质性，PEFT 通常避免全量更新带来的过拟合，但会为每个诊断任务训练独立适配器；将这些隔离适配器整合为单一网络时，来自冲突视觉域的优化梯度会相互干扰，导致负迁移 (negative transfer)。
Method: 提出 MoPET，一种混合专家方法：利用学习到的稀疏路由器 (sparse router) 将每个输入导向注入冻结基础模型的少量低秩 PEFT 专家，从而在数据集间共享模型容量，同时限制跨域梯度冲突。
Result: MedMNIST 上 PEFT 优于全量网络更新（平均准确率由 86.50% 提升至 88.97%）；单个 MoPET 模型整合四个异构数据集，平均准确率 93.46% 优于最佳独立 PEFT 适配器的 92.83%；与辅助数据集联合训练可将数据受限临床目标的平均准确率从最强独立适配器的 81.58% 提升至 83.58%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过稀疏专家路由共享容量可以在避免跨域负迁移的同时，将多个医学影像诊断任务整合进一个通用网络，并利用辅助数据改善数据受限目标的表现；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 MoPET，一种基于稀疏路由的混合专家 (MoE) 参数高效微调方法，用于在单个冻结基础模型上统一多个医学图像分类任务。在 MedMNIST 基准上，单一 MoPET 模型整合四个异构数据集，平均准确率 93.46% 超过最佳独立 PEFT 适配器的 92.83%；辅助数据集联合训练将数据受限目标的平均准确率从 81.58% 提升至 83.58%。
summary_sections.motivation: 针对临床数据异质性，PEFT 通常避免全量更新带来的过拟合，但会为每个诊断任务训练独立适配器；将这些隔离适配器整合为单一网络时，来自冲突视觉域的优化梯度会相互干扰，导致负迁移 (negative transfer)。
summary_sections.method: 提出 MoPET，一种混合专家方法：利用学习到的稀疏路由器 (sparse router) 将每个输入导向注入冻结基础模型的少量低秩 PEFT 专家，从而在数据集间共享模型容量，同时限制跨域梯度冲突。

papers.title: Parameter-Free Heavy-Tailed Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Heavy-tailed distributions arise naturally in sequential decision-making problems such as financial investment, online advertising, and network management, where rare but extreme outcomes can dominate performance. Heavy-tailed bandits model online decision-making in these settings by assuming only that rewards $X$ satisfy $\mathbb{E}[|X|^{1+ε}]\leq u$, for some tail exponent $ε\in(0,1]$ and moment bound $u<+\infty$. However, most existing regret minimization algorithms require these parameters to be known. This assumption is particularly restrictive in practice: $ε$ and $u$ govern the frequency and magnitude of rare events and are therefore precisely the quantities that are hardest to infer reliably from limited observations. Motivated by an open problem posed by Genalti and Metelli at COLT 2025, we resolve the assumption-free adaptation problem for heavy-tailed bandits and characterize the price in the regret of not knowing the tail parameters. We first study adaptation to the moment bound $u$ for a fixed tail exponent $ε$. We prove that every algorithm unaware of $u$, or of any upper bound on it, must obey a sharp trade-off between its distribution-dependent and distribution-free regret guarantees. We then introduce a scheduled-exploration algorithm that requires no knowledge of $u$ and matches the resulting adaptation frontier up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we show that the same algorithm can be instanced without knowing $ε$ by calibrating its exploration schedule to the endpoint $ε=1$. It achieves sublinear regret for every fixed $ε>0$, while no algorithm can guarantee sublinear regret uniformly over all $ε\in(0,1]$. Altogether, our results resolve the COLT open problem without additional distributional assumptions and provide a sharp characterization of the statistical cost of adapting to unknown heavy tails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重尾分布 (heavy-tailed) 多臂老虎机中尾参数未知时的自适应遗憾最小化问题。作者针对固定尾指数 ε 证明，任何不知道矩界 u 或其上界的算法都必须在分布相关与分布无关遗憾之间满足一种尖锐权衡，并据此提出一种无需 u 的调度探索 (scheduled-exploration) 算法，使其匹配该自适应边界至多相差对数因子。随后该算法通过将探索调度校准到端点 ε=1，可在无需知道 ε 的情况下实例化，对每个固定 ε>0 达到次线性遗憾。这些结果解决了 Genalti 和 Metelli 在 COLT 2025 提出的开放问题。
Motivation: 现有重尾 bandit 遗憾最小化算法大多要求事先知道尾指数 ε 和矩界 u，而这些参数恰恰控制罕见极端事件的发生频率与幅度，在实践中是最难从有限观测中可靠推断的量，因此无假设自适应问题具有实际重要性。
Method: 作者先对固定 ε 研究对矩界 u 的自适应，证明不知 u 的算法必须服从分布相关与分布无关遗憾之间的权衡；随后提出调度探索算法，它不需要 u 的知识即可匹配该自适应边界至对数因子；最后将同一算法的探索调度校准到端点 ε=1，使其在不需知道 ε 的情况下也能运行。
Result: 论文证明了不知 u 的算法存在分布相关与分布无关遗憾之间的尖锐权衡，所提算法匹配该边界至对数因子；校准到 ε=1 后，算法对每个固定 ε>0 取得次线性遗憾，同时作者证明不存在算法能对所有 ε∈(0,1] 一致保证次线性遗憾。
Conclusion: 这些结果在无需额外分布假设的情况下完整解决了 COLT 2025 的开放问题，并刻画了适应未知重尾参数在遗憾中的统计代价。

papers.title: TFGformer: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting via Time-Frequency Graph Learning and Covariate Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale multivariate time series from heterogeneous IoT sensors demand accurate long-term forecasting for resource scheduling and predictive maintenance. While recent time series foundation models exhibit strong generalization, they rely on static parametric knowledge and lack dynamic access to external historical patterns during inference. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers a potential remedy, yet its application to time series forecasting is challenged by magnitude variations across heterogeneous sources and the mismatch between historical similarity and future consistency. We propose CrossRAG, a retrieval-augmented forecasting framework that integrates Shape-Aware Memory (SAM) with RevIN normalization for magnitude-robust shape-level retrieval, Future-Consistent Contrastive (FCC) learning to distinguish informative references from hard negatives with similar history but divergent futures, and Cross-Attention Temporal Fusion (CATF) to fuse retrieved historical--future reference pairs into the backbone's representations at the representation level. Experiments on seven public benchmarks show that CrossRAG consistently outperforms both parametric-only baselines and existing retrieval-augmented forecasting methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异构 IoT 传感器产生的大规模多元时间序列，提出检索增强的预测框架 CrossRAG。它结合 Shape-Aware Memory (SAM) 与 RevIN 归一化实现幅值鲁棒的形状级检索，用 Future-Consistent Contrastive (FCC) 学习区分历史相似但未来不一致的难负样本，并通过 Cross-Attention Temporal Fusion (CATF) 在表示层融合检索到的历史-未来参考对。在七个公开基准上，该方法一致优于纯参数化基线和现有检索增强预测方法。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型泛化能力强，但依赖静态参数知识，推理时无法动态访问外部历史模式；RAG 虽有潜力，却面临异构来源幅值差异大、历史相似性与未来一致性不匹配的问题。
Method: 提出 CrossRAG 框架：SAM 配合 RevIN 归一化用于幅值鲁棒的形状级检索；FCC 对比学习用于区分信息量高的参考与历史相似但未来发散的难负样本；CATF 在表示层面将检索到的历史-未来参考对融合进骨干网络的表征。
Result: 在七个公开基准上的实验显示，CrossRAG 一致优于仅参数化的基线和已有的检索增强预测方法；摘要未给出具体数据集名称与数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过形状级检索、未来一致性对比学习和跨注意力融合，可以在表示层面增强多元时间序列预测，但未报告基准细节或局限性。

papers.title: Analytical and Bootstrap Confidence Intervals of Double Machine Learning: Simulation studies and an application to rural-urban difference in obesity prevalence
papers.abstract_en: Double Machine Learning (DML) is a popular approach for treatment effect estimation in various settings, which allows a wide range of flexible machine learning methods to be used for nuisance parameter estimation while preserving valid inference. In practice, however, applied researchers must choose among many machine learning algorithms for nuisance models, and the impact of this choice on the variance estimation of DML is not well characterized. We conduct a comprehensive simulation study to compare the coverage probability of DML confidence intervals across different machine learning algorithms. In this study, we compare (1) analytical confidence intervals derived by DML theory versus (2) bootstrap confidence interval. We use a set of learners including ordinary least squares, LASSO, Random Forest, LightGBM, and Neural Networks under different data generation settings. We evaluate the performance across difference settings by bias, confidence interval width, and most importantly, coverage probability. Our results show substantial variability in coverage performance across analytical and bootstrap confidence intervals, highlighting that learner choice plays a critical role in reliable DML inference. Surprisingly, we find that in many settings, when sample size increases, the coverage probability of both DML analytical and bootstrap confidence interval decreases. We further investigate coverage probabilities using a real dataset on rural urban differences among U.S. counties. The real data analysis discovers that (1) the model performance still varies by the learner choices and (2) greater rurality has a statistically significant increasing effect on county level obesity prevalence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过大规模模拟研究比较双机器学习 (Double Machine Learning, DML) 中由理论推导的分析置信区间与 bootstrap 置信区间在不同机器学习 nuisance 模型选择下的覆盖概率。研究覆盖 OLS、LASSO、Random Forest、LightGBM 与 Neural Networks 等多种学习器及多种数据生成设置，并应用于美国县级农村-城市肥胖率差异的真实数据。结果显示置信区间覆盖性能对学习器选择高度敏感，且在许多设定下随样本量增大覆盖概率反而下降。
Motivation: DML 允许使用灵活的机器学习方法估计 nuisance 参数并保持有效推断，但实际应用中研究者需要在众多机器学习算法中做选择，而这一选择对 DML 方差估计的影响尚未被充分刻画。
Method: 开展综合模拟研究，对比 DML 理论导出的分析置信区间与 bootstrap 置信区间；在多种数据生成设置下比较 OLS、LASSO、Random Forest、LightGBM 和 Neural Networks 等学习器，并基于偏差、置信区间宽度和覆盖概率进行评估，随后在真实数据集上进一步考察。
Result: 模拟结果显示分析置信区间与 bootstrap 置信区间的覆盖表现存在显著差异，学习器选择对可靠 DML 推断至关重要；令人意外的是，在许多设定下样本量增大时两种置信区间的覆盖概率均下降。真实数据分析发现模型表现仍随学习器选择而变化，且更高的 rurality 对县级肥胖患病率具有统计显著的递增效应。
Conclusion: 作者强调学习器选择在 DML 推断中起关键作用，实际应用中需要谨慎对待置信区间的可靠性；研究同时为农村-城市肥胖差异提供了基于 DML 的实证证据。

papers.title: QR-Structured Thermal Triggers for Targeted Semantic Attacks on Infrared Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Infrared vision-language models (IR-VLMs) extend thermal perception to open-vocabulary classification, image captioning, and visual question answering. However, their robustness to structured thermal perturbations and the stability of cross-modal semantic alignment remain insufficiently studied. We propose QR-Structured Thermal Triggers (QR-STT), a stealthy, training-free, black-box framework for targeted semantic steering of IR-VLMs. QR-STT preserves the functional regions of a QR pattern while optimizing its internal modules, each of which is assigned a cold, neutral, or hot thermal state. The framework jointly searches module topology and rendering parameters, including position, scale, rotation, intensity, blur, and roundness. A three-stage gradient-free procedure with greedy module-flip refinement efficiently handles the mixed discrete and continuous search space. The objective promotes alignment with an attacker-selected target, suppresses source-class evidence, and regularizes QR structure and visual similarity. Experiments on multiple CLIP-style encoders show that QR-STT consistently redirects image-text alignment toward chosen concepts while maintaining visual stealth. Perturbations optimized for classification also transfer to image captioning and VQA, causing target-consistent semantic drift in generated outputs. These results identify QR-structured thermal patterns as an interpretable attack surface for language-driven infrared perception and highlight the need for robustness evaluation against structured cross-task semantic attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 QR-Structured Thermal Triggers (QR-STT)，一种无需训练、黑盒的针对红外视觉语言模型 (IR-VLMs) 的定向语义攻击框架。攻击者保留 QR 图案的功能区域，为其内部模块分配冷、中、热三种热状态，并联合搜索模块拓扑与渲染参数。实验表明该攻击能在多个 CLIP 风格编码器上稳定地将图像-文本对齐转向目标概念，且扰动可迁移至图像描述和视觉问答任务。
Motivation: 红外视觉语言模型被用于开放词汇分类、图像描述和视觉问答，但针对结构化热扰动以及跨模态语义对齐稳定性的鲁棒性研究不足，存在被恶意语义操纵的风险。
Method: 提出 QR-STT 框架，通过保持 QR 图案功能区域并优化内部模块的热状态（冷/中/热），联合搜索模块拓扑和位置、尺度、旋转、强度、模糊、圆角等渲染参数；采用三阶段无梯度流程配合贪心模块翻转细化，处理混合离散与连续搜索空间，目标函数兼顾对齐攻击者选定目标、抑制源类别证据及正则化 QR 结构与视觉相似性。
Result: 在多个 CLIP 风格编码器上的实验显示，QR-STT 能稳定地将图像-文本对齐重定向至选定概念并保持视觉隐蔽性；针对分类优化的扰动可迁移到图像描述和 VQA，使生成输出产生与目标一致的内容偏移。
Conclusion: 作者指出 QR 结构热模式构成了语言驱动红外感知的可解释攻击面，并强调需要对结构化跨任务语义攻击进行鲁棒性评估；摘要未提及具体数值、数据集或与现有攻击方法的定量对比。

summary_sections.method: 提出 QR-STT 框架，通过保持 QR 图案功能区域并优化内部模块的热状态（冷/中/热），联合搜索模块拓扑和位置、尺度、旋转、强度、模糊、圆角等渲染参数；采用三阶段无梯度流程配合贪心模块翻转细化，处理混合离散与连续搜索空间，目标函数兼顾对齐攻击者选定目标、抑制源类别证据及正则化 QR 结构与视觉相似性。
summary_sections.result: 在多个 CLIP 风格编码器上的实验显示，QR-STT 能稳定地将图像-文本对齐重定向至选定概念并保持视觉隐蔽性；针对分类优化的扰动可迁移到图像描述和 VQA，使生成输出产生与目标一致的内容偏移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者指出 QR 结构热模式构成了语言驱动红外感知的可解释攻击面，并强调需要对结构化跨任务语义攻击进行鲁棒性评估；摘要未提及具体数值、数据集或与现有攻击方法的定量对比。

papers.title: End-to-End Fairness Optimization with Fair Decision-Focused Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world systems rely on predictive models to inform decisions, and fairness concerns arise in both the prediction and decision stages. We introduce end-to-end fairness optimization (E2EFO) as a unifying framework that integrates fairness across the prediction-to-decision pipeline. We focus on resource allocation with group-based fairness: the prediction task estimates allocation impacts while limiting accuracy disparity across groups, and the decision task distributes those impacts equitably by optimizing a group-based alpha-fairness measure. Within this framework, we propose fair decision-focused learning (FDFL), a training paradigm that jointly accounts for prediction accuracy, prediction fairness, and decision regret -- the loss in decision fairness due to imperfect predictions. FDFL trains the predictor by gradient descent, combining the objective gradients through multi-task learning techniques. The core computational challenge is the decision Jacobian with respect to the predictor parameters: we derive exact closed-form formulas for a tractable class of fair allocation and apply a differentiable optimization layer in the general case. We further establish a finite-sample generalization bound for the scalarized FDFL objective. Numerical experiments on a healthcare-based single resource allocation and a synthetic multiple resource allocation illustrate the value of jointly accounting for prediction fairness and decision fairness in prediction-informed decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出端到端公平性优化（E2EFO）框架，将公平性整合到从预测到决策的完整流水线中，并在此基础上提出公平决策聚焦学习（FDFL）训练范式。FDFL 通过多任务学习联合优化预测精度、预测公平性和决策后悔（decision regret），并针对可解的一类公平分配问题推导了决策雅可比矩阵的闭式解，一般情形则使用可微优化层。作者还给出了标量化 FDFL 目标函数的有限样本泛化界。
Motivation: 现实系统常依赖预测模型辅助决策，而公平性问题同时出现在预测阶段和决策阶段；现有方法往往只单独处理某一阶段的公平性，缺乏端到端的统一优化框架。
Method: 提出 E2EFO 统一框架和 FDFL 训练范式：预测任务估计分配影响同时限制跨组精度差异，决策任务通过优化基于组的 alpha-公平性度量来公平分配资源；训练时用梯度下降联合优化多任务目标，核心是对预测器参数求决策雅可比矩阵，其中对可处理的一类公平分配推导精确闭式公式，一般情况采用可微优化层（differentiable optimization layer）。
Result: 摘要报告在基于医疗的单资源分配和合成的多资源分配数值实验上，联合考虑预测公平性与决策公平性有助于改善预测驱动的决策效果，并建立了标量化 FDFL 目标的有限样本泛化界。
Conclusion: 作者认为 E2EFO 与 FDFL 展示了在预测驱动决策中联合考虑预测公平与决策公平的价值；摘要未提及实际部署限制或失败案例。

papers.title: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring multimodal observations into queryable structures supporting filtering, aggregation, ranking, and temporal comparison. We present AdaMM, a framework that jointly supports retrieval and analytic memory. Rather than relying on application-defined schemas, AdaMM extracts provenance-linked attribute-value observations from dialogue, images, and contextual metadata, discovers recurring field structures, and materializes them for analytical access. At inference time, a memory-aware planner decomposes queries into retrieval and analytic operations and routes each operation to the appropriate tools. Experiments on two long-term multimodal memory benchmarks, MemEye and MemGallery, show that AdaMM improves performance by up to 11.3\% and 7.3\%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将长期多模态记忆从单纯的检索记忆扩展为联合支持的检索与分析记忆，并给出 AdaMM 框架。AdaMM 从对话、图像和上下文元数据中抽取带溯源链接的属性-值观察，挖掘重复出现的字段结构并物化以供分析访问；推理时由记忆感知规划器把查询分解为检索与分析操作并路由到相应工具。在 MemEye 和 MemGallery 两个长期多模态记忆基准上，AdaMM 分别提升最多 11.3% 和 7.3%。
Motivation: 现有长期多模态记忆系统主要强调检索记忆，通过摘要和索引返回多粒度查询相关信息，但难以对跨交互累积的观测进行过滤、聚合、排序和时间比较等计算。
Method: 提出 analytic memory 作为检索记忆的互补抽象，并实现 AdaMM 框架：自动抽取带溯源链接的属性-值观察、发现重复字段结构并物化；推理阶段使用记忆感知规划器将查询分解为检索与分析操作并路由到相应工具。
Result: 在两个长期多模态记忆基准 MemEye 和 MemGallery 上，AdaMM 分别将性能提升最多 11.3% 和 7.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分析记忆与检索记忆联合可以更好地支持长期多模态记忆中的计算型查询，AdaMM 的实验结果验证了该互补设计的有效性。

papers.title: ModelEquivBench: Certifying Multi-Relational Evaluation of LLM-Generated Optimization Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly generate optimization models from natural language, but existing evaluation often reduces a generated model and its ground truth to a single equivalent/not-equivalent verdict or an execution-success rate--labels that are neither independently checkable nor faithful to the multiple distinct senses in which two formulations can agree. We present ModelEquivBench, a certifying, multi-relational evaluation system that reports a per-pair semantic profile E0--E6: model construction and exact ingestion (E0), verified representation alignment (E1), same-space and projected feasible-set relations (E2, E3), objective-order equivalence (E4), optimal-value equality (E5), and optimizer-set equivalence (E6). Each decided entry carries relation-appropriate, independently re-checkable evidence: replayable traces or explicit maps for E0--E1, exact-rational certificates for positive E2--E6 conclusions, and explicit witnesses for supported negatives. Incomplete mapping search, unsupported structure, and resource limits produce typed UNKNOWN or N/A outcomes rather than guesses, while unmet prerequisites are reported as ABSENT. Using ModelEquivBench to evaluate three model snapshots--GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B--on the same frozen cohort of 173 base problems (346 cells per model) under a no-repair protocol, the resulting profiles expose distinctions that coarse baselines do not represent: 49, 35, and 25 cells contain executable candidates that are nevertheless certified negative on at least one supported relation, and 25, 8, and 18 structural rejections occur on pairs for which E2 certifies mapped feasible-set equality under a verified map. The three model snapshots fail at different stages of the profile and therefore cannot be meaningfully reduced to a single accuracy score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ModelEquivBench 是一个面向大语言模型生成的优化模型的多关系评测系统。它不再将生成模型与地面真值简化为单一等价/不等价标签，而是输出逐对的语义剖面 E0--E6（建模构建与精确摄入、已验证的表示对齐、同空间与投影可行集关系、目标序等价、最优值相等、优化器集等价），并为每条已判定记录附带可独立复核的证据（可重放轨迹、精确有理证书或显式反例）。作者用该系统在无修复协议下评测 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 在 173 个基础问题上的快照，结果显示三者在不同阶段失败，无法用单一准确率分数有意义地概括。
Motivation: 现有评估常把 LLM 生成的优化模型与地面真值归约为一个等价/不等价判断或执行成功率，这类标签既不可独立核验，也无法反映两个公式可在多种不同意义上一致的判断。需要一个能区分多种语义关系并提供可验证证据的评测框架。
Method: 提出 ModelEquivBench，一种可认证的多关系评测系统，对每对（生成模型、地面真值）生成语义剖面 E0--E6；对已判定条目分别用可重放追踪、显式映射、精确有理数证书（exact-rational certificates）和显式反例（witnesses）提供关系适配的证据；对不完整映射搜索、不支持结构、资源限制给出 UNKNOWN/N/A 的 typed 结果，未满足前提时报告 ABSENT。
Result: 在 173 个基础问题、每模型 346 个单元的无修复协议下，GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 分别有 49、35、25 个单元包含可执行候选但仍被至少一个受支持关系认证为负，并有 25、8、18 个结构拒绝发生在 E2 已验证映射下认证可行集相等的单元对；三个模型快照在不同剖面阶段失败，不能简化成单一准确率。
Conclusion: 作者强调，将三类模型快照的评测结果归约为单一分数会丢失关键区分度；ModelEquivBench 的可独立复核层次化证据可用于更细致地刻画 LLM 生成的优化模型。来源未提及超越该评测框架的更多结论或泛化主张。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgenticRepair: Multi-Faceted Program Context Engineering for Agentic Vulnerability Repair
papers.abstract_en: Automated vulnerability repair aims to reduce the time and effort required to patch security flaws from a vulnerability triage report. Recent agentic AI approaches have shown promising results in automated program repair. However, vulnerability repair demands richer program context than general bug repair - context that security engineers routinely assemble in practice but that existing agentic approaches do not engineer. We identify three critical gaps: code-structure context capturing cross-file data flows and memory operation patterns, runtime-execution context revealing crash semantics and memory origins, and commit-history context recovering how fragile code patterns were introduced. We present AgenticRepair, an agentic vulnerability repair framework that addresses the gaps through multi-faceted program context engineering. AgenticRepair orchestrates three specialized LLM subagents to engineer the contexts, which are then embedded into the memory of a dedicated repair subagent for context-conditioned patch synthesis. Evaluated on SEC-Bench comprising 300 real-world instances with sanitizer-based patch verification, AgenticRepair achieves a 73% success rate, substantially outperforming the strongest baseline by 29%. Our ablation study confirms that the three context facets are mutually complementary, and that multi-agent scaffolding and base-model capacity each play an essential role. Collectively, these findings establish multi-faceted program context engineering as a promising design direction for agentic vulnerability repair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticRepair，一个面向自动化漏洞修复的智能体框架。作者指出漏洞修复比一般 bug 修复需要更丰富的程序上下文，并识别出代码结构、运行时执行与提交历史三类关键上下文缺口。框架用三个专门 LLM 子代理工程化这些上下文，再嵌入修复子代理的记忆用于补丁合成。在 SEC-Bench 的 300 个真实漏洞实例上达到 73% 成功率，比最强基线高 29%。
Motivation: 自动化漏洞修复需要比通用程序修复更丰富的程序上下文，而现有 agentic 方法没有工程化这类信息；具体缺口包括跨文件数据流与内存操作模式的代码结构上下文、揭示崩溃语义与内存来源的运行时执行上下文，以及恢复脆弱代码模式引入历史的提交历史上下文。
Method: 提出多面程序上下文工程（multi-faceted program context engineering）框架 AgenticRepair：编排三个专门 LLM 子代理分别构造三类上下文，并将其嵌入一个专用修复子代理的记忆，实现上下文条件下的补丁合成（context-conditioned patch synthesis）。
Result: 在包含 300 个真实世界实例、使用 sanitizer 进行补丁验证的 SEC-Bench 基准上，AgenticRepair 达到 73% 成功率，比最强基线高出 29%。消融实验显示三类上下文相互补充，且多智能体脚手架与基础模型容量都起关键作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为多面程序上下文工程是 agentic 漏洞修复中一个有前景的设计方向；三类上下文互补，多智能体架构和基础模型容量二者均不可或缺。

summary_sections.result: 在包含 300 个真实世界实例、使用 sanitizer 进行补丁验证的 SEC-Bench 基准上，AgenticRepair 达到 73% 成功率，比最强基线高出 29%。消融实验显示三类上下文相互补充，且多智能体脚手架与基础模型容量都起关键作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为多面程序上下文工程是 agentic 漏洞修复中一个有前景的设计方向；三类上下文互补，多智能体架构和基础模型容量二者均不可或缺。

papers.title: Longitudinal Adaptive Experimental Design for Learning Multiple Target Estimands with Semiparametric Efficient Inference
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive designs are increasingly used in clinical trials and digital experiments to improve estimation efficiency by updating treatment randomization probabilities as data accumulate. While most existing work focuses on settings with a single-stage treatment, adaptive designs for longitudinal studies with multi-stage, time-varying treatments remain relatively underexplored. In this work, we develop a general semiparametric efficiency framework for designing longitudinal adaptive experiments to optimize the estimation efficiency of a broad class of target estimands of interest. An efficiency-oriented design criterion is proposed to accommodate both single-estimand targets and joint optimization across multiple estimands. We demonstrate that optimal randomization at earlier stages depends on later-stage allocations, yielding a backward-recursive strategy for deriving the oracle design, and propose a longitudinal adaptive design to sequentially learn and target the oracle design using accumulating data. We further develop an adaptive-design-likelihood-based longitudinal targeted maximum likelihood estimator (ADL-LTMLE) for asymptotically normal and semiparametric efficient estimation of statistical estimands from dependent data collected from adaptive experiments, without relying on parametric model assumptions. Applying the framework to time-to-treatment-initiation effects that compare initiating treatment at a given stage with delaying initiation until a subsequent stage, we show that designs optimized for a particular stage-specific effect can substantially compromise estimation efficiency for effects defined at other stages, highlighting the design trade-offs addressed by our framework. Simulation studies show the proposed design and estimation approaches achieve substantial variance reductions relative to non-adaptive designs, with performance close to that of the oracle design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出纵向自适应实验设计的半参数效率框架，用于优化多个目标估计量（target estimands）的估计效率。作者提出效率导向的设计准则，推导出最优设计的后向递归策略，并开发基于自适应设计似然的纵向目标最大似然估计量（ADL-LTMLE），在无参数模型假设下实现渐近正态和半参数有效推断。模拟显示相对非自适应设计，该设计显著降低方差，且性能接近oracle设计。
Motivation: 现有自适应设计多关注单阶段处理设置，而对多阶段时变处理的纵向自适应设计研究不足；同时，针对某一阶段特定效应的设计优化可能严重损害其他阶段效应的估计效率，需要统一框架来处理这种权衡。
Method: 建立一般性半参数效率框架，提出兼容单一估计量和多估计量联合优化的效率导向设计准则；证明早期阶段的最优随机化依赖后期分配，从而给出后向递归的oracle设计推导；提出逐步学习并逼近oracle设计的纵向自适应设计；发展ADL-LTMLE以处理自适应实验产生的依赖数据，无需参数模型假设。
Result: 摘要报告模拟研究中该设计相对非自适应设计实现显著方差缩减，性能接近oracle设计；并展示针对特定阶段效应（如time-to-treatment-initiation effects）优化的设计会损害其他阶段效应的估计效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提框架能够处理多目标估计量之间的设计权衡，并为纵向自适应实验提供无需参数假设的有效推断方法。
Relevance: 5
