papers.title: Tool Specifications Matter: Uncovering and Mitigating Safety Risks in AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents extend large language models (LLMs) with external tools, enabling them to perform complex tasks and translate model outputs into consequential real-world actions. Yet LLMs often become substantially less safe when deployed as agents, and the source of this degradation remains poorly understood. In this paper, we identify schema-formatted tool specifications as a primary source of agent safety degradation and show, through white-box representation analysis, that they weaken the model's internal refusal signals and contribute to unsafe tool execution. Building on this finding, we propose SafeKeep, an inference-time safeguard that decouples safety judgment from tool execution: it assesses requests using flattened textual tool specifications while retaining the original schema-formatted specifications for execution. Across two representative benchmarks and four LLMs, including both white-box and black-box models, SafeKeep increases the average refusal rate for harmful requests from 23.8% to 70.6% and reduces the average attack success rate under observation-level prompt injection from 25.6% to 2.5%. It also outperforms existing safeguards and preserves task-handling capability. We release the code and data at https://github.com/snowcatsmoking/SafeKeep .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI agent中工具规格（tool specifications）导致的安全退化问题。作者通过白盒表示分析发现，schema格式的工具规格会削弱LLM内部的拒绝信号（refusal signals），从而增加不安全工具执行的风险。基于此提出SafeKeep，一种推理时防护方法，将安全检查与工具执行解耦：用扁平化文本工具规格评估请求，而执行时仍保留原始schema格式。在两个基准和四个LLM（含白盒与黑盒）上，SafeKeep将有害请求的平均拒绝率从23.8%提高到70.6%，并将观察级提示注入下的平均攻击成功率从25.6%降至2.5%，同时优于现有防护方法并保持任务处理能力。
Motivation: LLM在作为agent部署时安全性显著下降，但这一退化的根源尚不明确。本文识别出schema格式的工具规格是导致agent安全退化的主要原因，并解释其通过削弱内部拒绝信号促使不安全工具执行，因此有必要针对该机制设计防护。
Method: 通过白盒表示分析（white-box representation analysis）验证工具规格对拒绝信号的影响，并提出SafeKeep：一种推理时防护方法，将安全检查与工具执行解耦，使用扁平化文本工具规格评估请求，而执行时保留原始schema格式规格。
Result: 在两个代表性基准和四个LLM（包括白盒与黑盒模型）上，SafeKeep将有害请求的平均拒绝率从23.8%提高到70.6%，在观察级提示注入下将平均攻击成功率从25.6%降至2.5%，并优于现有防护方法且保持任务处理能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调schema格式的工具规格是agent安全退化的关键来源，SafeKeep通过解耦安全判断与工具执行可显著提升agent安全性。代码和数据已公开于GitHub。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CBCT-IQ: A Publicly Available Annotated Cone-Beam CT Dataset for Image Quality Assessment and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: Medical image quality plays a critical role in diagnostic accuracy, especially in X-ray-based imaging modalities such as cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT), where image quality must be balanced against radiation dose. While expert visual evaluation remains the clinical standard for image quality evaluation, it is time-consuming, subjective and affected by inter-observer variability, emphasizing the need for reliable quantitative image quality assessment (IQA) methods. However, the development and validation of such IQA methods have been limited by the lack of publicly available CBCT datasets with expert image quality annotations. In this study, we provide the first open-access CBCT IQA dataset containing 1,764 annotated image slices acquired using systematic variations in image acquisition and reconstruction parameters. Three clinical experts graded the overall image quality and a predefined regions of interest (ROI) using a four-level scoring scheme. In addition, we benchmark 26 full reference- and no reference-based IQA measures against expert annotations and introduce an exploratory IQA measure-based ranking capable of distinguishing subtle image quality differences. This dataset introduced a standardized benchmark for future CBCT IQA research and provides a valuable resource for the development and validation of new IQA methods, enabling reproducible research and advancing CBCT IQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍首个公开可用的 CBCT 图像质量评估（IQA）数据集，包含通过系统变化采集与重建参数获取的 1,764 张标注切片。三位临床专家使用四级评分方案对整体图像质量和预定义 ROI 进行评分，作者还基准测试了 26 种全参考与无参考 IQA 度量，并提出一种基于 IQA 度量的探索性排序方法。该数据集为 CBCT IQA 研究提供标准化基准，可用于开发与验证新的定量评估方法。
Motivation: CBCT 图像质量与辐射剂量之间需要权衡，而临床标准专家视觉评估耗时、主观且存在观察者间差异，因此需要可靠的定量 IQA 方法；但缺少带专家质量标注的公开 CBCT 数据集限制了此类方法的发展与验证。
Method: 作者构建了一个开放存取的 CBCT IQA 数据集，通过系统地改变图像采集和重建参数获得 1,764 张切片，并由三位临床专家按四级评分方案对整体图像质量和预定义 ROI 进行标注；随后用专家标注基准测试 26 种全参考和基于无参考的 IQA 度量，并引入一种基于 IQA 的探索性排序方法以区分细微质量差异。
Result: 摘要未报告具体性能数值；主要结果是提供了首个带专家标注的公开 CBCT IQA 数据集，并对 26 种 IQA 度量做了基准测试，且提出的排序方法能区分细微的图像质量差异。
Conclusion: 该数据集为未来 CBCT IQA 研究建立了标准化基准，并为新 IQA 方法的开发与验证提供资源，有助于可复现研究和领域推进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CalibratedRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubric Banks for Open-Ended LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of open-ended LLM outputs requires fine-grained rubrics, yet expert curation is costly and difficult to scale. Existing automated pipelines rely on strict judge unanimity and binary variance filters, which cannot distinguish measurable rubrics from informative ones. We introduce CalibratedRubric, a task-adaptive framework that combines type-specific scoring, Bayesian rubric-measurability filtering, and item response theory (IRT)-based bank assembly. CalibratedRubric estimates each rubric's measurability with a Beta--Bernoulli agreement posterior and uses a submodular information-coverage objective to construct compact rubric banks over the observed capability range. Across financial, healthcare, general, and legal benchmarks, measurability filtering improves human-gold agreement on JudgmentBench from $κ=0.604$ to $0.743$. IRT-based greedy selection improves cross-fitted rank fidelity over random selection across all six evaluated response blocks and requires only 49 rather than 131 rubrics to reach the target correlation on FinResearchBench decision-support tasks. Task-label perturbations further reduce system separation, confirming the practical relevance of task-adaptive scoring. These results support CalibratedRubric as an efficient, uncertainty-aware approach to open-ended LLM evaluation, with calibration gains depending on sufficient judge redundancy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CalibratedRubric，一个面向开放式 LLM 评测的任务自适应评分框架，组合类型特定评分、贝叶斯 rubric 可测性过滤与基于项目反应理论 (IRT) 的条目库组装。作者用 Beta-Bernoulli 一致后验估计每个 rubric 的可测性，并以子模信息覆盖目标在观测能力范围内构建紧凑 rubric 库。在金融、医疗、通用与法律基准上的实验显示，可测性过滤将 JudgmentBench 上的人-金标准一致度从 κ=0.604 提升到 0.743，IRT 贪心选取在 FinResearchBench 上仅需 49 条而非 131 条 rubric 即达到目标相关。
Motivation: 开放式 LLM 输出的可靠评测需要细粒度 rubric，但专家人工制定成本高且难以扩展；现有自动管线依赖严格的评判者一致性和二元方差过滤，无法区分可测的 rubric 与有信息的 rubric。
Method: 提出 CalibratedRubric 框架：结合类型特定评分、基于 Beta-Bernoulli 一致后验的贝叶斯可测性过滤，以及基于 IRT 的 rubric 库组装；用子模信息覆盖目标在观测能力范围内选取紧凑 rubric 库。
Result: 在金融、医疗、通用与法律基准上，可测性过滤把 JudgmentBench 的人-金标准一致度从 κ=0.604 提高到 0.743；IRT 贪心选取在所有六个响应块上超过随机选取的交叉拟合排序保真度，并在 FinResearchBench 决策支持任务上只需 49 条（而非 131 条）rubric 就达到目标相关；任务标签扰动降低系统分离度，确认了任务自适应评分的实际作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CalibratedRubric 是一种高效、不确定性感知的开放式 LLM 评测方法，并指出其校准收益依赖于足够的评判者冗余度（judge redundancy）这一条件。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Don't Mix Rewards, Mix Policies: Policy Decomposition and Optimization for Multi-Reward RL
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) are expected not just to answer correctly, but to adapt their behavior to different human values and use cases. As a result, multi-reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become an increasingly important problem for LLMs, where each reward captures a different aspect of desired behavior. However, optimizing with multiple rewards suffers from a more severe alignment tax issue, where different optimization objectives can trade off or even conflict with each other, leading to unstable and inefficient post-training. In this work, we propose PRISM, a new multi-reward RL framework built upon the idea of policy-space decomposition and composition. Instead of compositing different rewards, PRISM optimizes a set of standalone positive policies and a global negative policy. This alleviates the potential conflict during multi-reward policy optimization, while enabling controllability during inference by flexible policy composition. Experiments on scientific reasoning, tool-use reasoning, and helpfulness-safety alignment show that PRISM consistently outperforms existing multi-reward RL baselines, with extra controllability for inference-time preference control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRISM，一个面向大语言模型（LLM）多奖励强化学习（multi-reward RL）的框架，核心思想是从奖励空间转向策略空间：不混合多个奖励，而是优化一组独立的正向策略和一个全局负向策略，再通过推理时的策略组合实现偏好控制。在科学推理、工具使用推理和 helpfulness-safety 对齐任务上，PRISM 一致优于现有多奖励 RL 基线，并额外提供推理时的偏好可控性。
Motivation: LLM 需要适配不同的人类价值观和使用场景，多奖励 RL 因此日益重要，但多个优化目标之间会相互权衡甚至冲突，导致对齐税（alignment tax）更严重、后训练不稳定且低效。
Method: PRISM 基于策略空间分解与组合的思路：不去合成多个奖励，而是分别优化一组独立的正向策略以及一个全局负向策略，以缓解多奖励策略优化中的潜在冲突，并在推理阶段通过灵活的策略组合实现可控性。
Result: 在科学推理、工具使用推理与 helpfulness-safety 对齐等实验上，PRISM 持续优于现有的多奖励 RL 基线，并额外提供推理时的偏好控制能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过策略分解与组合替代奖励混合，可以缓解多奖励 RL 中的优化冲突并带来推理期可控性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: LLM 需要适配不同的人类价值观和使用场景，多奖励 RL 因此日益重要，但多个优化目标之间会相互权衡甚至冲突，导致对齐税（alignment tax）更严重、后训练不稳定且低效。
summary_sections.method: PRISM 基于策略空间分解与组合的思路：不去合成多个奖励，而是分别优化一组独立的正向策略以及一个全局负向策略，以缓解多奖励策略优化中的潜在冲突，并在推理阶段通过灵活的策略组合实现可控性。
summary_sections.result: 在科学推理、工具使用推理与 helpfulness-safety 对齐等实验上，PRISM 持续优于现有的多奖励 RL 基线，并额外提供推理时的偏好控制能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，通过策略分解与组合替代奖励混合，可以缓解多奖励 RL 中的优化冲突并带来推理期可控性。

papers.title: Simple-regret rates and minimax optimality of fixed-prior expected improvement in Matérn and squared-exponential RKHSs
papers.abstract_en: We study the expected improvement (EI) policy for minimizing a deterministic objective function $f$ on a nonempty compact set $\mathcal X \subset\mathbb R^d$. We assume that $f$ belongs to the RKHS $\mathcal H_k$ of a continuous positive-semidefinite kernel $k$ on $\mathcal X$. Function values are observed exactly, and EI is computed from a fixed zero-mean Gaussian-process model with covariance $σ^2k$. After an initial design, the policy queries a point whose EI is at least a fixed positive fraction of its maximum. We identify the normalized posterior standard deviation at a candidate point $x$ with the norm of the corresponding innovation in the canonical feature space, namely the component of $k(x,\cdot)$ orthogonal to the span of the preceding evaluation representers. Sequential separation radii bound the ranked innovation norms along arbitrary query sequences. We estimate these radii using Gram determinants and Kolmogorov widths for subspaces of different dimensions, then combine the estimates with a one-step regret inequality to obtain finite-budget bounds for simple regret. After $N$ post-initial queries, simple regret is $O(N^{-ν/d})$ for isotropic Matérn kernels of smoothness $ν>0$. For the isotropic squared-exponential kernel, simple regret is $O(\exp[-c_1\min\{N, N^{1/d}\log(eN)\}])$ for some $c_1>0$. With exact EI maximization, it is $O(\exp[-c_2N^{1/d} \log(eN)])$ for some $c_2>0$. For every fixed $B\geq0$, these bounds are uniform over the RKHS ball of radius $B$. If $\mathcal X$ has nonempty interior and $B>0$, then, among deterministic methods whose final recommendation may be any point of $\mathcal X$, the exact EI policy is minimax-rate optimal over the RKHS ball of radius $B$ for Matérn kernels and minimax-rate optimal up to constants in the exponent for squared-exponential kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论角度分析固定高斯过程先验下的期望改进 (expected improvement, EI) 策略在确定函数最小化中的简单遗憾 (simple regret)。作者假设目标函数属于连续半正定核的 RKHS，观测无噪声，并允许 EI 只达到其最大值的固定正比例。通过将归一化后验标准差识别为特征空间中创新的范数，利用序列分离半径、Gram 行列式与 Kolmogorov 宽度，得到有限预算下的简单遗憾界。
Motivation: 期望改进是贝叶斯优化中最常用的采集函数之一，但其在固定先验、非精确 EI 最大化情形下的简单遗憾率及极小极大最优性此前缺乏系统刻画。该文针对这一理论缺口，在一般紧集和 RKHS 假设下给出量化的收敛速率。
Method: 将候选点 x 的归一化后验标准差与典型特征空间中对应创新的范数建立联系，即以 k(x,·) 中与先前评价表示子空间正交的分量来刻画。作者用 Gram 行列式和不同维度子空间的 Kolmogorov 宽度估计连续查询序列上的排序创新范数，再结合一步遗憾不等式得到简单遗憾的有限预算上界。
Result: 在 N 次初始后查询后，各向同性 Matérn 核（光滑度 ν>0）的简单遗憾为 O(N^{-ν/d})；各向同性平方指数核为 O(exp[-c_1 min{N, N^{1/d} log(eN)}])，若精确最大化 EI 则提升为 O(exp[-c_2 N^{1/d} log(eN)])。这些界对任意 B≥0 在半径 B 的 RKHS 球上一致成立；当定义域有非空内部且 B>0 时，精确 EI 策略在 Matérn 核下达到极小极大最优率，在平方指数核下达到指数中常数意义上的极小极大最优。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，即使只按最大 EI 的固定比例进行查询，固定先验 EI 也能获得可证明的简单遗憾界，且精确 EI 在 Matérn 与平方指数 RKHS 上分别达到或接近极小极大最优。该结论局限于确定性、无噪声观测、紧集定义域以及固定零均值高斯过程先验的设定。

papers.title: TAVI-TEC: An AI-Based Tool for Procedural Planning of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation
papers.abstract_en: Computed tomography angiography (CTA) is crucial for preprocedural TAVI planning, providing the anatomical information required for prosthesis sizing and vascular access assessment. As the volume of TAVI procedure increases, improving efficiency and standardizing annotations is becoming essential in clinical practice. This study presents TAVI-TEC, a fully automated artificial intelligence-based framework integrated into a web based DICOM viewer for routine preoperative TAVI planning. Pre-procedural CTA scans from patients undergoing TAVI with SAPIEN 3 Ultra (S3U) prostheses were processed using a fully automated pipeline. Deep learning-based segmentation of cardiovascular structures, calcification detection, centerline extraction, landmark identification, and annular plane definition was implemented to quantify key annular and aortic root measurements and color-coded maps of lumen reduction and vessel diameter for vascular access. A multilayer perceptron classifier was trained to predict prosthesis size prior to the TAVI procedure. Results revealed that TAVI-TEC enabled pre-procedural measurements in approximately 2-6 min. Strong agreement with clinician-derived measurements was observed for annular area (coefficient of concordance, CCC = 0.934; interclass correlation coefficient, ICC = 0.935; R^2 = 0.881) and perimeter (CCC = 0.909; ICC = 0.909; R^2 = 0.854). The valve-size prediction model achieved 82% overall accuracy, with most misclassifications occurring between adjacent prosthesis sizes. Though further multicenter validation and extension to additional measurements and valve platforms are required, the TAVI-TEC methodology may reduce operator variability in pre-TAVI measurements and streamline the preoperative workflows of the Heart Team for decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TAVI-TEC，一个集成于基于 Web 的 DICOM 查看器中的全自动 AI 框架，用于经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）的术前规划。该框架对术前 CTA 影像执行深度学习分割、钙化检测、中心线提取、关键地标识别和瓣环平面定义，并训练多层感知机（MLP）分类器预测瓣膜尺寸。摘要报告流程耗时约 2-6 分钟，瓣环面积和周长与临床医生测量的一致性较强，瓣膜尺寸预测总体准确率为 82%。
Motivation: 随着 TAVI 手术量增加，临床实践中提升效率并标准化标注变得日益重要；而术前 CTA 规划依赖人工测量，耗时且存在操作者间差异。
Method: 构建全自动管线，包括基于深度学习的的心血管结构分割、钙化检测、中心线提取、地标识别与瓣环平面定义，用于量化瓣环和主动脉根部关键测量值，并生成血管入路的管腔缩减与血管直径彩色编码图；使用多层感知机分类器在术前预测瓣膜尺寸，系统集成到 Web 版 DICOM 查看器中。
Result: TAVI-TEC 可在约 2-6 分钟内完成术前测量；与临床医生测量相比，瓣环面积的一致性为 CCC=0.934、ICC=0.935、R^2=0.881，瓣环周长的一致性为 CCC=0.909、ICC=0.909、R^2=0.854；瓣膜尺寸预测总体准确率为 82%，多数错分发生在相邻瓣膜尺寸之间。
Conclusion: 作者指出该方法仍需进一步多中心验证，并扩展到更多测量指标和瓣膜平台；但 TAVI-TEC 可能减少术前 TAVI 测量的操作者变异性，并简化 Heart Team 的术前决策工作流程。

papers.title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing modern recommender models still depends heavily on engineers manually iterating over architectural, objective, and training-strategy changes. While LLM-based agents can automate this trial-and-error process, allowing the LLM to both select modification directions and generate concrete hypotheses often leads to unstable search under limited experiment budgets. Inspired by the above challenge, we propose RecHarness, a Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for automated recommender model optimization. RecHarness separates the optimization process into two steps: a bandit router selects the next modification direction according to historical validation feedback, while the LLM generates a concrete optimization hypothesis and executable code edit within the selected direction. To sustain long-horizon exploration, RecHarness uses a jump-basin mechanism to activate a structural-jump arm when local edits stagnate. Across multiple recommendation tasks, datasets, and model backbones, RecHarness achieves more stable performance improvements and uses limited trial budgets more effectively than LLM-reasoning search. During a 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale short-video advertising platform, the selected candidate improves ADVV by 2.084%, Revenue by 0.534%, and Exposure by 0.559%. Code is available at https://github.com/6lyc/RecHarness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RecHarness，一个基于 Bandit 路由的智能体框架，用于自动化推荐模型优化。它把优化过程解耦为两步：Bandit 路由器根据历史验证反馈选择下一步修改方向，LLM 在选定方向内生成具体优化假设与可执行代码编辑；当局部编辑停滞时，通过 jump-basin 机制激活结构跳转臂以维持长程搜索。摘要称该方法在多个推荐任务、数据集和模型骨干上比 LLM 推理搜索更稳定、更高效地利用有限试验预算，并在短视频广告平台 7 天线上 A/B 测试中取得指标提升。
Motivation: 现代推荐模型优化仍高度依赖工程师手动迭代架构、目标和训练策略；LLM 智能体虽然能自动化试错，但若让 LLM 同时选择修改方向并生成具体假设，在有限试验预算下搜索往往不稳定。
Method: RecHarness 将优化过程分离为两个步骤：bandit router 依据历史验证反馈选择下一个修改方向，LLM 在该方向内生成具体的优化假设和可执行的代码编辑；并引入 jump-basin 机制，在局部编辑停滞时激活结构跳转臂以保持长期探索。
Result: 在多个推荐任务、数据集和模型骨干上，RecHarness 相比 LLM-reasoning search 获得更稳定的性能提升并更有效地利用有限试验预算；在大型短视频广告平台的 7 天在线 A/B 测试中，候选方案使 ADVV 提升 2.084%、Revenue 提升 0.534%、Exposure 提升 0.559%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将方向选择与假设生成解耦能显著提升自动化推荐模型优化的稳定性和预算效率，并开源了代码。

papers.title: When Model Priors Conflict with Visual Evidence: Mitigating Commonsense-Driven Hallucinations by Selective Prior Calibration
papers.abstract_en: In vision--language models, commonsense-driven hallucination (CDH) occurs when a model's commonsense prior overrides clear visual evidence of an atypical state. For example, a model may report that a visibly six-fingered hand has five fingers. We show that these errors are systematically directed: when a model answers a question about a counterfactual (CF) image incorrectly, its answer often coincides with the candidate it prefers without access to the image. Suppressing this prior indiscriminately can repair CF errors, but may also disrupt correct answers on matched commonsense (CS) images, where the same prior is helpful. We therefore propose Selective Prior Calibration (SPC), which subtracts candidate-level prior-preference estimates from image-conditioned scores with an instance-dependent strength and revises the original prediction only when the resulting score pattern strongly supports an alternative. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPC substantially improves accuracy on CF images while largely preserving accuracy on matched CS images. Furthermore, these gains generalize across CDH categories, candidate-answer permutations, and other conflict benchmarks, while SPC rarely alters predictions on benchmarks without such conflicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型中的常识驱动幻觉 (commonsense-driven hallucination, CDH)：当反事实 (counterfactual, CF) 图像与常识先验冲突时，模型常忽略清晰视觉证据，例如把可见的六指手说成五指。作者提出选择性先验校准 (Selective Prior Calibration, SPC)，以实例依赖的强度从图像条件分数中减去候选级先验偏好估计，并仅在分数模式强烈支持替代答案时修订原始预测。实验表明 SPC 在 CF 图像上显著提升准确率，同时基本保持匹配常识 (CS) 图像的准确率，并且增益可泛化到其他冲突基准。
Motivation: 反事实图像上的幻觉错误是系统性的：模型答错时往往选择它无图像输入时也偏好的候选。然而无差别地抑制常识先验虽然能修复 CF 错误，却可能破坏匹配 CS 图像上的正确回答，因为同一先验在正常场景下是有用的。因此需要选择性而非全局性的先验校准。
Method: 提出选择性先验校准 (Selective Prior Calibration, SPC)，按实例依赖的强度从图像条件分数中减去候选级别的先验偏好估计，并且只在修订后的分数模式强烈支持某个替代答案时才改变原始预测。
Result: 大量实验显示 SPC 在 CF 图像上大幅提升准确率，同时基本保持匹配 CS 图像上的准确率；这些增益泛化到不同 CDH 类别、候选答案排列以及其他冲突基准，而在无冲突基准上 SPC 很少改变预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调选择性抑制常识先验是缓解 CDH 的关键，SPC 能够在纠正反事实错误的同时避免损害正常常识推理。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型中的常识驱动幻觉 (commonsense-driven hallucination, CDH)：当反事实 (counterfactual, CF) 图像与常识先验冲突时，模型常忽略清晰视觉证据，例如把可见的六指手说成五指。作者提出选择性先验校准 (Selective Prior Calibration, SPC)，以实例依赖的强度从图像条件分数中减去候选级先验偏好估计，并仅在分数模式强烈支持替代答案时修订原始预测。实验表明 SPC 在 CF 图像上显著提升准确率，同时基本保持匹配常识 (CS) 图像的准确率，并且增益可泛化到其他冲突基准。
summary_sections.motivation: 反事实图像上的幻觉错误是系统性的：模型答错时往往选择它无图像输入时也偏好的候选。然而无差别地抑制常识先验虽然能修复 CF 错误，却可能破坏匹配 CS 图像上的正确回答，因为同一先验在正常场景下是有用的。因此需要选择性而非全局性的先验校准。
summary_sections.method: 提出选择性先验校准 (Selective Prior Calibration, SPC)，按实例依赖的强度从图像条件分数中减去候选级别的先验偏好估计，并且只在修订后的分数模式强烈支持某个替代答案时才改变原始预测。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验显示 SPC 在 CF 图像上大幅提升准确率，同时基本保持匹配 CS 图像上的准确率；这些增益泛化到不同 CDH 类别、候选答案排列以及其他冲突基准，而在无冲突基准上 SPC 很少改变预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调选择性抑制常识先验是缓解 CDH 的关键，SPC 能够在纠正反事实错误的同时避免损害正常常识推理。

papers.title: Small Is Enough: Per-User Style Rewriting of AI-Edited Text via LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract_en: InMyStyle is a privacy first, single user system that adapts small language models to rewrite AI-edited text towards an individual user's writing style without an instruction prompt at inference. Given a user's documents, it uses multiple local helper LLMs to construct paired training examples and fine tunes LoRA adapters on base models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters. Length aware generation budgets and automatic chunking support inputs of different lengths. On 219 evaluation pairs from a scientific-paper corpus, the automatic composite score plateaus at 0.69 [scale 0-1] across all model sizes under both greedy and sampled decoding. This observed plateau suggests that small models are sufficient for the measured rewriting task, with model size determining trade-offs rather than a stable quality ranking. As a secondary evaluation, 400 ratings from five LLM judges give InMyStyle outputs a mean perceived AI-ness score over 20% lower than their helper-AI generated inputs, while mean perceived AI-ness scores decrease with model size within InMyStyle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InMyStyle，一个隐私优先的单用户系统，用小语言模型将 AI 编辑过的文本改写成用户个人写作风格，推理时无需指令提示。系统用多个本地辅助 LLM 构造配对训练样本，在 0.5B 到 7B 参数的基座模型上微调 LoRA 适配器。在 219 个科学论文语料评估对上，自动综合分数在 0.69（0–1 量表）处趋于平台，表明小模型对该重写任务足够，模型规模主要影响权衡而非质量排名。
Motivation: AI 编辑文本往往丢失用户的个人写作风格，且将私密文档发送到云端存在隐私风险；需要一个无需指令提示、适配单用户风格并注重隐私的本地改写方案。
Method: 使用多个本地辅助 LLM 基于用户文档构造配对训练样本，在 0.5B 至 7B 参数的基座模型上微调 LoRA 适配器；通过长度感知的生成预算和自动分块支持不同长度的输入，推理时不使用指令提示。
Result: 在 219 个科学论文语料评估对上，自动综合评分在 0.69 处平台化，各模型规模在贪心与采样解码下表现一致。次要评估中，五名 LLM 评委的 400 条评分显示 InMyStyle 输出的平均感知 AI-ness 比辅助 AI 生成的输入低 20% 以上，且模型越大感知 AI-ness 分数越低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调小模型对该重写任务已足够，模型规模决定的是折衷而非稳定质量排名；系统定位为单用户、隐私优先的使用场景。

papers.title: CorrelationFlow: A Training-Free Geometric Approach for LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR scene flow estimation has settled into a monoculture: nearly all recent methods share the same feed-forward architecture and the same family of self-supervised losses, inheriting each other's assumptions, and each other's blind spots. When those assumptions fail, as they do for sparse, distant, or fast-moving objects, every method built on them fails together, and adding parameters or simulated training data does not fix what the formulation itself gets wrong. This paper takes the opposite path. We present CorrelationFlow, a training-free geometric framework that reduces scene flow to two textbook operations: connected-component labeling and correlation maximization on bird's-eye-view occupancy images. Objects are isolated as spatio-temporal connected components, their motions recovered as correlation peaks, and the resulting velocities propagated to all member points. However, this dense correlation evaluates every candidate displacement of every cluster and requires a window of past sweeps; therefore, we develop a sparse counterpart that operates on a single sweep pair by matching lightweight occupancy descriptors at boundary key points. Because nothing is trained, nothing is inherited: on the multi-domain test set of the Argoverse 2 2026 Scene Flow Challenge, spanning five datasets with heterogeneous sensors and platforms, CorrelationFlow ranked second among unsupervised methods and degrades most gracefully at long range, where the shared assumptions of learned methods break down. Our results suggest that a substantial share of the scene flow problem is solvable by classical computer vision, and that progress may require questioning the formulation, not scaling it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CorrelationFlow，一个无需训练的几何框架，用于 LiDAR 场景流估计，将问题简化为连通分量标记（connected-component labeling）和鸟瞰图（bird's-eye-view）占用图像上的相关最大化。物体被当作时空连通分量分离，运动由相关峰恢复，速度再传播到所有成员点。在 Argoverse 2 2026 Scene Flow Challenge 的多域测试集上，该方法在无监督方法中排名第二，并在远距离处退化最平滑。
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR 场景流方法几乎都采用相同的前馈架构和自监督损失族，继承了彼此的假设和盲点，导致在稀疏、远处或快速移动物体上集体失效；作者认为增加参数或模拟训练数据无法修复公式本身的问题。
Method: 将场景流估计还原为两个经典操作：时空连通分量标记和鸟瞰图占用图像上的相关最大化。密集版本需要过去若干扫描窗口，因此作者进一步提出稀疏版本，仅使用单个扫描对，通过在边界关键点上匹配轻量占用描述符来工作。
Result: 在 Argoverse 2 2026 Scene Flow Challenge 的多域测试集（涵盖五个数据集、异构传感器与平台）上，CorrelationFlow 在无监督方法中排名第二，并且在远距离处性能退化最平缓，而该区域正是学习方法共享假设失效之处。
Conclusion: 作者认为相当大一部分场景流问题可由经典计算机视觉解决，并指出进步可能需要质疑公式本身而非扩大模型规模。

papers.title: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
papers.abstract_en: Although world-action models (WAMs) enhance long-horizon robot control by predicting visual evolution before acting, long-horizon reliability demands repeated re-grounding in real observations--not recursive rollout. Existing WAMs address this by refreshing history or KV cache with ground-truth data between chunks. However, such chunk-wise feedback operates at a coarse temporal granularity and thus fails to correct prediction errors at the individual time-step level. To address this, we propose Feedback Flow Matching (FBFM), a training-free inference mechanism that pushes re-grounding inside the actively generated chunk. During flow matching, FBFM applies a masked pseudoinverse correction to the conditional velocity field: it leverages the preceding action chunk to guide generation of the next action chunk, and uses the image observed after executing that preceding chunk to guide the next frame prediction. This cross-chunk pairing--where feedback from one chunk arrives in time to shape the next--creates an asynchronous loop that corrects errors without waiting for chunk boundaries. Being training-free, the mechanism improves responsiveness to unexpected events and suppresses drift in long-horizon tasks. We evaluate FBFM on both a joint-generation WAM (DreamZero) and a stage-wise WAM (LingBot-VA). On selected LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0 tasks, it improves success rates by over 5% in favorable settings, and real-world robot observation-prediction diagnostics show notably better tracking. We argue that FBFM offers a new paradigm for fine-grained online correction, bridging open-loop flow generation with closed-loop real-world dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FBFM（Feedback Flow Matching），一种无需训练的异步反馈推理机制，用于世界动作模型（WAM）的长时程机器人控制。FBFM 在 flow matching 过程中对条件速度场施加掩码伪逆校正，将前一动作块的实际执行反馈用于引导下一块帧预测，从而在块边界之内逐时间步纠正预测误差，抑制长时程漂移。在 DreamZero 与 LingBot-VA 两类 WAM 上的 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin2.0 任务中，成功率可提升超过 5%，真实机器人观测预测诊断也显示更好的跟踪。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型通过分块（chunk-wise）刷新历史或 KV 缓存来重新接地，但反馈粒度较粗，无法在单个时间步层面修正预测错误，长时程可靠性仍然受限。
Method: 提出训练无关的推理期机制 FBFM：在 flow matching 生成过程中，利用前一个动作块引导下一个动作块的生成，并用执行前一块后观测到的图像引导下一帧预测；通过对条件速度场施加掩码伪逆校正构成异步反馈回路，无需等待块边界即可纠错。
Result: 在 DreamZero（联合生成 WAM）和 LingBot-VA（分阶段 WAM）上，于选定的 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin2.0 任务中，有利设置下成功率提高超过 5%；真实世界机器人观测预测诊断显示跟踪显著改善。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FBFM 提供了细粒度在线校正的新范式，将开环流生成与闭环真实世界动力学连接起来，且训练无关，对突发事件响应更快并能抑制长时程任务中的漂移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear Proposal Operators and Stochastic Search Geometry in SOMA and Differential Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Swarm and evolutionary algorithms are usually analyzed as complete procedural systems in which nonlinear selection, replacement, and adaptation obscure simpler structure within candidate generation. This paper introduces an operator--selection factorization that separates objective-independent variation from boundary repair and fitness-dependent selection, and uses it to study the proposal geometry of the Self-Organizing Migrating Algorithm (SOMA) and Differential Evolution (DE). The canonical SOMA proposal is shown to be affine in the search space and exactly linear in an augmented migrant--leader state. In leader-relative coordinates, the resulting operator provides a direct interpretation of interpolation, projection, overshooting, and coordinate masking. Under Bernoulli perturbation masks, we derive closed-form expressions for the proposal mean, covariance, expected squared step length, expected squared distance from the leader, active dimensionality, and coordinate coverage. For canonical DE/rand/1/bin, we derive the finite-population moments of differential mutation and characterize the additional covariance and coordinate dependence induced by forced-coordinate binomial crossover. Exact enumeration and Monte Carlo experiments verify the analytical identities and quantify the effects of mask conditioning, boundary repair, and fitness-based selection. The analysis further motivates geometry-controlled and rotation-aware SOMA variants, together with an adaptive population-reducing extension of iSOMA. Experiments on the complete noiseless BBOB benchmark show that these operator-guided variants substantially improve upon canonical SOMA and are competitive with established DE methods in several dimension--budget regimes. The results demonstrate how proposal-level operator analysis can support both the interpretation and design of population-based optimizers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种算子-选择分解（operator–selection factorization），将候选解生成中与目标无关的变异、边界修复和依赖适应度的选择分离，并据此研究 SOMA（Self-Organizing Migrating Algorithm）与差分进化（Differential Evolution）的提议几何。作者证明标准 SOMA 提议在搜索空间是仿射的，在增广的 migrant–leader 状态中严格线性，并在 leader 相对坐标下给出插值、投影、过冲和坐标掩码的直接解释。基于伯努利扰动掩码推导出提议均值、协方差、期望平方步长、期望到 leader 距离、有效维度和坐标覆盖的闭式表达式，并用精确枚举和蒙特卡洛实验验证。
Motivation: 群体与进化算法通常被当作完整的过程系统来分析，非线性选择、替换和自适应掩盖了候选生成内部的更简单结构；本文试图把目标无关的变异机制与适应度相关的选择机制分开，从而在提议层面理解算法行为。
Method: 引入算子-选择分解，将变异（variation）和边界修复与适应度选择解耦；在 leader 相对坐标下分析 SOMA 提议的线性/仿射结构，并针对伯努利扰动掩码推导提议的均值、协方差等闭式矩；对 DE/rand/1/bin 推导有限群体下差分变异（differential mutation）的矩，并刻画强制坐标二项交叉带来的额外协方差与坐标依赖；还据此提出几何控制、旋转感知的 SOMA 变体和自适应缩减群体的 iSOMA 扩展。
Result: 精确枚举与蒙特卡洛实验验证了分析恒等式，并量化了掩码条件、边界修复和适应度选择的影响。在完整无噪声 BBOB 基准上，这些算子引导的变体显著优于标准 SOMA，并在多个维度-预算区间与既有 DE 方法具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 结果显示，提议级别的算子分析既能帮助解释群体优化器的行为，也能指导其设计；作者强调这种分解框架支持对 SOMA 和差分进化的几何理解。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 结果显示，提议级别的算子分析既能帮助解释群体优化器的行为，也能指导其设计；作者强调这种分解框架支持对 SOMA 和差分进化的几何理解。

papers.title: Frugal Bayesian Optimization: Scalable Surrogates for Data- and Resource-Limited Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization (BO) is widely adopted for data-efficient optimization in scientific and engineering applications, yet its computational cost is rarely evaluated alongside optimization performance. Here we present a systematic, compute-aware study of BO that evaluates surrogate models along two axes: optimization quality and computational frugality. Across eight benchmark functions and nine real-world datasets spanning materials science, mechanics, robotics, chemistry, and machine learning, we benchmark four surrogate models: Gaussian Processes, Random Forests, NGBoost, and Bayesian Adaptive Spline Surfaces. We show that Gaussian Process-based BO consistently incurs the highest time and memory overhead without delivering superior optimization or sample efficiency. In contrast, scalable alternatives achieve equal or better performance at a fraction of the computational cost. Motivated by these findings, we introduce a surrogate-recommendation framework that predicts the most suitable BO surrogate from inexpensive dataset characteristics. Together, these results establish FruBO as a reproducible, compute-aware baseline for Bayesian Optimization and provide practical guidance for surrogate selection under limited computational and experimental budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一项计算感知 (compute-aware) 的贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian Optimization, BO) 系统性研究，在八个基准函数和九个真实世界数据集（涵盖材料科学、力学、机器人、化学和机器学习）上同时评价代理模型的优化质量与计算节俭性。基准覆盖高斯过程 (Gaussian Processes)、随机森林 (Random Forests)、NGBoost 和贝叶斯自适应样条曲面 (Bayesian Adaptive Spline Surfaces)。结果表明基于高斯过程的 BO 始终具有最高的时间和内存开销，却并未带来更优的优化或样本效率；可扩展替代方法以极小计算成本达到同等或更好性能。作者进一步提出代理模型推荐框架 FruBO，依据廉价的数据集特征预测最合适的代理模型。
Motivation: BO 被广泛用于数据和资源有限的科学工程优化，但其计算成本很少与优化性能一起被评估，导致用户在选择代理模型时缺乏计算预算视角的指导。
Method: 沿优化质量和计算节俭性两个轴对四种代理模型进行系统基准测试，并据此提出一个代理模型推荐框架，利用廉价易得的数据集特征预测最合适的 BO 代理模型。
Result: 摘要报告基于高斯过程的 BO 在每个基准上都产生最高的时间和内存开销，但没有表现出更优的优化性能或样本效率；可扩展替代方法在计算成本的一小部分下达到同等或更好的表现。
Conclusion: 作者将 FruBO 定位为可复现、计算感知的 BO 基线，并为有限计算和实验预算下的代理模型选择提供实践指导。

papers.title: Is It Time for the Renaissance of Salient Object Detection in the Era of MLLMs?
papers.abstract_en: The zero-shot capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are pushing salient object detection (SOD) beyond task-specific supervision. To disentangle MLLMs beyond conventional mask-based evaluation, we decompose SOD into localization and segmentation, and re-engineer datasets with phrases, boxes, and attributes, establishing a diagnostic benchmark for MLLM saliency perception (SaliLLM). SaliLLM uncovers a striking capability mismatch: MLLMs outperform state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in localization, yet remain substantially weaker in segmentation. Further analyses attribute this gap primarily to mismatches between MLLMs and annotations over foreground cardinality, granularity, and extent. Motivated by this diagnosis, we recast zero-shot SOD as protocol-aligned Foreground Organization and introduce the first training-free framework that leverages Gestalt-inspired Collaborative attention for Unified SOD (FOCUS). FOCUS couples top-down Bayesian-surprise calibration of protocol-conditioned foreground granularity with bottom-up propagation of MLLMs evidence over entity-centric perceptual manifolds induced by self-supervised features, yielding coherent object extents as prompts for a general segmenter. Across 13 RGB, RGB-D, and RGB-T SOD benchmarks, FOCUS generally surpasses SOTA methods without training, reducing mean absolute error by 11\%, 34\%, and 48\% compared with fully, weakly, and self-supervised methods, respectively. Our findings signal the renaissance of SOD: from task-specific supervision to zero-shot foreground organization. Code is available in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 MLLM 时代重新审视显著目标检测 (SOD)，将 SOD 分解为定位与分割两个子任务，并构建 SaliLLM 诊断基准以评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的零样本显著性感知。诊断发现 MLLM 在定位上超过现有最先进方法，但在分割上明显偏弱，差距主要源于前景基数、粒度与范围的标注不匹配。据此提出无需训练的 FOCUS 框架，基于格式塔启发的协作注意力实现零样本前景组织，在 13 个 RGB、RGB-D、RGB-T 基准上普遍超过现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 SOD 依赖任务特定监督，而 MLLM 的零样本能力尚未被传统基于掩码的评估方式充分解耦和理解。作者希望诊断 MLLM 在 SOD 上究竟强在哪、弱在哪，从而推动从任务特定监督转向零样本前景组织。
Method: 首先提出 SaliLLM 诊断基准，将 SOD 解耦为定位与分割，并用短语、边界框和属性重新设计数据集；随后提出 FOCUS 框架，将自上而下的贝叶斯显著性校准与自监督特征诱导的实体中心感知流形上的自下而上证据传播相结合，生成连贯的目标范围并交给通用分割器。
Result: 摘要报告 MLLM 在定位上优于最先进方法但在分割上明显不足，归因于前景基数、粒度和范围的标注不匹配；FOCUS 在 13 个 RGB、RGB-D 和 RGB-T SOD 基准上无需训练即普遍超越现有方法，相对全监督、弱监督和自监督方法分别降低平均绝对误差 11%、34% 和 48%。
Conclusion: 作者认为研究信号表明 SOD 正从任务特定监督转向零样本前景组织，FOCUS 是首个无需训练的协议对齐统一 SOD 框架。代码在补充材料中提供。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MOSAIC: Masked Outsourcing of Secure AI Computations
papers.abstract_en: We address the challenge of securely and efficiently outsourcing AI computations from a trusted but computationally weak client to an untrusted but powerful server, in the setting where the client holds both the input and the model, and the server must learn neither. We present MOSAIC, whose core is a novel matrix-multiplication masking protocol that scales to far larger matrices than prior work, enabling the safe outsourcing of modern workloads such as large transformer inference. By introducing small amounts of noise to the multiplication result and thereby relaxing correctness, MOSAIC achieves optimal asymptotic client overhead and concrete runtimes orders of magnitude faster than prior work. Its security reduces to the decisional LWE and LPN assumptions. Because this noise accumulates across the many layers of a transformer, a key technical challenge is bounding error growth; MOSAIC addresses this with an error-scaling mechanism based on random Hadamard rotations. On large 70B transformer models, MOSAIC's perplexity is comparable to popular quantization approaches and even matches full-precision BF16 inference on HumanEval. Finally, we present an end-to-end implementation showing how ideas like MOSAIC can promise a path towards large-scale confidential AI in modern data centers. Non-confidential inference is already distributed across phase (prefill/decode), layer, and time to maximize utilization of heterogeneous hardware, using RDMA-like networking to move activations, cached KV values, and weights across nodes. MOSAIC enables scaling of confidential compute by keeping the trusted computing base (TCB) small and outsourcing the bulk of the AI computation to untrusted accelerators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOSAIC 提出一种安全外包 AI 计算的矩阵乘法掩蔽协议，允许计算能力受限但可信的客户端将包含模型和输入的推理任务外包给不可信但强大的服务器，同时服务器无法学习输入或模型。该方法通过向乘法结果引入少量噪声放松正确性，获得渐近最优的客户端开销和比先前工作快多个数量级的运行时，安全性基于 decisional LWE 与 LPN 假设。针对噪声在 Transformer 多层中累积的问题，作者提出基于随机 Hadamard 旋转的误差缩放机制；在 70B Transformer 模型上，困惑度与常见量化方法相当，在 HumanEval 上匹配 BF16 全精度推理，并给出端到端实现以说明大规模机密 AI 的可行路径。
Motivation: 现有安全外包方案难以扩展到现代大规模模型（如大型 Transformer 推理）所需的矩阵规模，且需要在客户端资源有限、服务器不可信且双方信息均须保密的前提下，兼顾安全性与效率。
Method: 核心是新的矩阵乘法掩蔽协议，通过向结果注入少量噪声来放松正确性约束，从而实现最优渐近客户端开销；结合基于随机 Hadamard 旋转的误差缩放机制，控制噪声在多层 Transformer 中的累积；安全性归约到 decisional LWE 和 LPN 假设，并配套端到端实现以支持在异构加速器之间迁移激活、缓存 KV 值与权重。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在客户端开销上达到渐近最优，具体运行时间比先前工作快数个数量级；在 70B Transformer 模型上困惑度与流行量化方法相当，在 HumanEval 上达到与全精度 BF16 推理一致的结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过保持小的可信计算基（TCB）并将大部分 AI 计算外包给不受信任的加速器，MOSAIC 可以扩展机密计算规模；同时指出引入噪声放松正确性是以一定精度为代价，因此控制误差增长是关键技术难点。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MirrorCraft: Paired Evaluation under Hidden Rule Changes in Minecraft
papers.abstract_en: With the prosperity of the large language models (LLMs), it has become an interesting topic: how do LLM-based agents work in Minecraft? Unfortunately, most existing benchmarks evaluate them under fixed game mechanics. High performance in these settings does not show whether an agent can continue making progress when familiar recipes, drops, and other rules change. In this paper, we introduce MirrorCraft, a paired benchmark for evaluating agents under hidden rule changes in Minecraft. Each Mirror world is a copy of its paired Vanilla world, with selected server-side rules modified by the corresponding datapack. Terrain, spawn, resource placement, objective, interface, and action budget remain matched within every Vanilla-Mirror pair. MirrorCraft includes five controlled biomes, six rule suites, three progression objectives, two model families, and six agent configurations under a shared Mineflayer interface. We evaluate task progress with deterministic advancement milestones and success rate and use the Rule Intervention Effect (RIE) to measure the performance change between matched Vanilla and Mirror worlds. The experiments show that hidden rule changes have strongly different effects across suites. Among the configurations evaluated without rule descriptions, ReAct achieves the highest pooled Mirror score. Providing the exact rules yields modest gains in average progress and completion across all three objectives. MirrorCraft extends Minecraft evaluation beyond fixed mechanics and provides a controlled setting for studying how agents use gameplay outcomes when the rules of the current world differ from familiar ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MirrorCraft，一个在 Minecraft 中评估大语言模型智能体在隐藏规则变化下表现的配对基准。每个 Mirror 世界是配对 Vanilla 世界的副本，仅通过 datapack 修改选定的服务端规则；配对内地形、出生点、资源分布、目标、接口和行动预算保持一致。基准包含五种受控生物群系、六套规则、三个进度目标、两个模型家族和六种智能体配置，并用确定性里程碑进度、成功率以及规则干预效应 (Rule Intervention Effect, RIE) 衡量 Vanilla 与 Mirror 世界之间的表现差异。实验显示隐藏规则变化对不同规则套件的影响差异显著，且在不提供规则描述时 ReAct 获得最高的综合 Mirror 得分。
Motivation: 现有 Minecraft 基准大多在固定游戏机制下评估 LLM 智能体，高分表现并不能说明智能体在熟悉配方、掉落物和其他规则改变后能否继续取得进展，因此缺乏对规则变化适应能力的受控评测。
Method: 构建 Vanilla-Mirror 配对世界，每个 Mirror 世界由对应 datapack 修改服务端规则，并保证配对间地形、生成、资源、目标、接口和行动预算匹配。涵盖多个规则套件、目标与智能体配置，统一使用 Mineflayer 接口，并用 RIE 量化规则变化带来的表现差异。
Result: 摘要报告隐藏规则变化对各规则套件的影响强弱不一；在不提供规则描述的所有配置中，ReAct 取得最高的综合 Mirror 得分；向智能体提供确切规则后，三个目标上的平均进度与完成率仅有适度提升。
Conclusion: MirrorCraft 将 Minecraft 评测从固定机制扩展到规则变化场景，为研究智能体在规则不同于熟悉世界时如何利用游戏对局结果提供了受控实验环境。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告隐藏规则变化对各规则套件的影响强弱不一；在不提供规则描述的所有配置中，ReAct 取得最高的综合 Mirror 得分；向智能体提供确切规则后，三个目标上的平均进度与完成率仅有适度提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: MirrorCraft 将 Minecraft 评测从固定机制扩展到规则变化场景，为研究智能体在规则不同于熟悉世界时如何利用游戏对局结果提供了受控实验环境。

papers.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommender systems in food delivery increasingly leverage multimodal signals, including images, text, and user interaction histories, to enhance user experience, yet effective fusion of these heterogeneous modalities remains challenging, hindering both the joint modeling of multimodal signals and adaptation to evolving user intent. In mainstream two-stage approaches, the separation between content-semantic pretraining of image-text encoders and behavior-driven ranking models limits alignment between semantic understanding and user behavior patterns. To address these issues, we present GALA, a three-stage pipeline whose core innovation lies in an intermediate "generative RL alignment" stage that constructs multimodal pretraining data from user behavior and refines it via conversion-based rewards, effectively bridging the pretraining-fine-tuning gap to align with downstream objectives. GALA comprises three stages: first, behavior-aware triplet pretraining on query-image-text pairs from search logs to early capture user intent and content preferences; second, a novel intermediate stage that refines multimodal embeddings through reward-driven optimization (GRPO) to dynamically align them with user behavior and bridge the pretraining-fine-tuning gap; and finally, integration of multimodal and ID embeddings via adaptive gating with a hybrid loss, preserving multimodal contributions under long-term ID-dominant training. GALA has been deployed in the production environment at Taobao Shangou, serving over 200 million daily active users. Compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, it delivers consistent offline gains of +0.12/+0.20 AUC along with better PCOC metrics. Large-scale online A/B tests further report a 0.55 percent increase in order volume, confirming GALA's effectiveness at industrial scale and its robustness across diverse demand patterns.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE 2026), Industry and Applications Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GALA，一个面向外卖推荐系统的三阶段多模态表征学习流水线，核心是中间的“生成式 RL 对齐”阶段，用基于转化奖励的强化学习（GRPO）微调多模态嵌入，以弥合内容语义预训练与行为驱动精排之间的 gap。GALA 已在淘宝上购（Taobao Shangou）生产环境部署，服务超 2 亿日活用户。摘要报告其在离线指标上相对 SOTA 获得 +0.12/+0.20 AUC 的稳定提升，在线 A/B 测试中订单量增加 0.55%。
Motivation: 外卖推荐系统中的图像、文本和用户交互历史等多模态信号难以有效融合；主流两阶段方法将图像-文本编码器的内容语义预训练与行为驱动排序模型分离，导致语义理解与用户行为模式之间缺乏对齐，也难以适应不断变化的用户意图。
Method: GALA 采用三阶段流水线：第一阶段在搜索日志的 query-image-text 三元组上进行行为感知的三元组预训练；第二阶段引入新颖的中间阶段，通过基于转化奖励的 GRPO 优化多模态嵌入，使其动态对齐用户行为并弥合预训练与微调之间的差距；第三阶段通过自适应门控（adaptive gating）和混合损失整合多模态嵌入与 ID 嵌入，在长期 ID 主导训练下保留多模态贡献。
Result: 与 SOTA 方法相比，GALA 在离线评测中取得一致的 +0.12/+0.20 AUC 提升以及更好的 PCOC 指标；大规模在线 A/B 测试显示订单量增长 0.55%，验证了其在工业规模下的有效性和对不同需求模式的稳健性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GALA 已在淘宝上购生产环境部署并服务超过 2 亿日活用户，说明通过生成式 RL 对齐的中间阶段能够有效弥合预训练与微调之间的 gap，并在工业规模上带来可量化的订单量提升。

papers.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) broadcasts a single response-level reward to every token, while on-policy distillation (OPD) scores each token against a stronger teacher for a dense advantage but caps performance at teacher quality and discourages exploration beyond it. Their complementarity makes combining RLVR and OPD promising, but we find that fusing the two advantages with a fixed coefficient triggers entropy collapse from two miscalibrations: a magnitude mismatch, where token-level OPD advantages can spike far beyond the bounded RLVR advantage and erase its signal, and a temporal mismatch, where sustained full-strength OPD keeps pulling the student toward the teacher and limits exploration needed to surpass it. We propose SAF, a Stable Advantage Fusion framework that resolves both issues via a lightweight, four-stage pipeline applied only to the OPD advantage: a sparsify-then-compress mechanism for magnitude control paired with a warm-up-then-anneal mechanism for temporal control, with each stage independently switchable and adding negligible overhead. Instantiating RLVR with GRPO, we evaluate SAF across seven mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B: SAF avoids entropy collapse and consistently outperforms fixed-coefficient GRPO+OPD fusion, improving the aggregate score by 0.51-2.70% across all six model-domain settings while achieving more stable training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAF（Stable Advantage Fusion），一种用于在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）的稳定优势融合框架。作者发现将 RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）与 OPD 的优势以固定系数融合会导致熵坍缩，原因是幅度失配（magnitude mismatch）和时间失配（temporal mismatch）。SAF 通过对 OPD 优势施加轻量级四阶段管道来同时解决这两个问题，并在多个数学推理与代码生成基准上稳定地优于固定系数融合。
Motivation: RLVR 将单一 response-level 奖励广播给每个 token，而 OPD 用更强的教师为每个 token 提供稠密优势，但性能受限于教师质量且抑制超越教师的探索；二者互补，但固定系数融合会产生两类失配，导致熵坍缩并破坏 RLVR 信号。
Method: 提出 SAF 框架，仅对 OPD 优势应用轻量级四阶段管道：sparsify-then-compress 机制处理幅度控制，warm-up-then-anneal 机制处理时间控制；每个阶段可独立开关，额外开销可忽略。
Result: 以 GRPO 实例化 RLVR，在七个数学推理和代码生成基准上使用 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 评估：SAF 避免熵坍缩，在全部六个模型-领域设置中均优于固定系数 GRPO+OPD 融合，聚合分数提升 0.51-2.70%，且训练更稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SAF 通过分离的幅度与时间控制机制解决固定系数融合的熵坍缩问题，各阶段可独立切换且开销可忽略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification with Dual Semantic Guidance and Global-Local Mutual Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal object Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve target instances by leveraging complementary information across modalities. However, existing methods suffer from two challenges. First, they often fail to exploit well-aligned and reliable semantic priors, making them vulnerable to background clutter and cross-modal misalignment. On the other hand, they typically rely on holistic feature modeling, overlooking the synergy between global and local representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a robust multi-modal ReID framework with dual semantic guidance and global-local mutual modulation, which mainly consists of three key components, namely the Text-Semantic Injector (TSI), the Masked Global-Local Modulator (MGLM), and the Hierarchical MoE Fusion (HMF). The TSI enhances semantic awareness by integrating clean and coherent textual features into visual tokens. The MGLM enables part-aware cross-modal interaction through joint guidance from soft masks and global context, improving fine-grained feature alignment. Finally, the HMF adaptively aggregates multi-spectral features under local semantic supervision, yielding discriminative and robust representations. Extensive experiments on three multi-modal ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/zw-absin/DSGM upon acceptance.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE TCSVT 2026. The version of record may differ slightly
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多模态目标重识别 (multi-modal object Re-ID) 框架，通过双语义引导与全局-局部互调制来提升跨模态检索性能，核心组件包括 Text-Semantic Injector (TSI)、Masked Global-Local Modulator (MGLM) 和 Hierarchical MoE Fusion (HMF)。TSI 将文本语义特征注入视觉 token，MGLM 利用软掩码与全局上下文实现部分级跨模态交互，HMF 在局部语义监督下自适应聚合多光谱特征。在三个多模态 ReID 基准上的实验验证了方法的有效性，代码将在论文录用后公开。
Motivation: 现有跨模态 ReID 方法难以利用对齐良好且可靠的语义先验，容易受背景杂波与跨模态错位影响；同时通常只依赖整体 (holistic) 特征建模，忽视了全局与局部表征之间的协同。
Method: 提出包含三个关键组件的框架：TSI 将干净连贯的文本特征整合进视觉 token 以增强语义感知；MGLM 通过软掩码和全局上下文的联合引导实现部分感知 (part-aware) 的跨模态交互，改善细粒度特征对齐；HMF 在局部语义监督下自适应聚合多光谱特征，得到判别性强且鲁棒的表征。
Result: 在三个多模态 ReID 基准上的大量实验表明所提方法有效；摘要未报告具体数值或对比基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调同时利用文本语义先验和全局-局部互调制可以增强多模态 ReID 的判别性与鲁棒性，并承诺开源代码。

papers.title: Domain-Division based Progressive Learning for Source-Free Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: With growing privacy and portability concerns, source-free domain adaptation requires only a source pre-trained model and an unlabeled target domain, allowing for effective adaptation to the target data. Most existing self-training methods focus on selecting and exploiting samples with reliable predictions, often neglecting others. Inspired by the finding that deep models learn clean samples faster than noisy ones, we propose a domain-division based progressive learning method named DPL. Specifically, our approach consists of two alternating stages, each beginning with the division of the target domain into easy-to-adapt and hard-to-adapt subdomains based on adaptation difficulty, followed by neighborhood-based pseudo label assignment. In stage one, we enhance classification accuracy through uncertainty-aware self-training and alignment of corresponding classes between subdomains. Stage two then applies tailored learning strategies to each subdomain, starting with consistency learning on the easy-to-adapt samples and progressing to utilizing local structural information for the more challenging ones, thereby mining the intrinsic properties of the target data. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/iamjingli/DPL.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia 2025
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Multimedia, vol. 27, pp. 7081-7092, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对源自由域适应 (source-free domain adaptation) 提出一种基于域划分的渐进学习方法 DPL，仅利用源预训练模型和无标注目标域。方法交替进行两个阶段，每阶段先按适应难度将目标域划分为易适应和难适应子域，再执行基于邻域的伪标签分配；实验在多个常用基准上验证了优于现有方法的效果。
Motivation: 现有自训练方法大多只关注预测可靠的样本，忽略了其余样本。作者利用深度模型对干净样本学习快于噪声样本的观察，希望更充分地挖掘目标域数据的内在结构。
Method: 提出 DPL，包含两个交替阶段：先按适应难度划分易/难子域并做邻域伪标签分配；阶段一用不确定性感知自训练和子域间对应类别对齐提升分类精度；阶段二对易适应样本做一致性学习，对难适应样本利用局部结构信息，从而渐进挖掘目标数据特性。
Result: 摘要报告在多个广泛使用的基准上进行了大量实验，效果优于现有最先进方法，但未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 通过域划分和针对子域的差异化渐进学习可以提升源自由域适应性能；代码已公开。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: UltraSAM3: A Concept-Driven Foundation Model for Universal Ultrasound Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound imaging has become increasingly widespread in clinical practice due to its portability, low cost and real-time capability, making ultrasound image segmentation important. However, ultrasound images differ substantially from CT, MRI, and other medical imaging modalities, as they are often affected by speckle noise, low contrast, acoustic shadows and ambiguous boundaries. Existing ultrasound segmentation methods are still mainly limited to task-specific models or visual-prompt-based foundation models, which are either tailored to particular tasks or require expert-provided visual prompts, making them inconvenient for flexible clinical use. To address these challenges, we propose UltraSAM3, a concept-driven foundation model for universal ultrasound image segmentation. Unlike conventional models, UltraSAM3 enables text-based target specification by adapting SAM3 to ultrasound-specific image--mask--concept triplets. The model is trained on a large-scale ultrasound segmentation corpus covering 37 public datasets and 13 anatomical categories, allowing it to align ultrasound visual patterns with clinically meaningful concepts across diverse organs and lesions. To further improve usability under realistic clinical interaction, we propose an instruction-guided agent that parses complex natural language queries into concise ultrasound concept prompts for UltraSAM3. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraSAM3 consistently outperforms representative concept- and text-driven biomedical segmentation models on multi-organ ultrasound benchmarks, external datasets, and visual-prompt-enhanced settings. Moreover, the agent improves segmentation robustness for complex user instructions. These results indicate that ultrasound-specific concept adaptation is effective for building generalizable and interactive ultrasound segmentation foundation models.

Conclusion: 作者认为针对超声的概念适配 (concept adaptation) 对构建可泛化且可交互的超声分割基础模型是有效的。

papers.title: Locally Consistent Transductive Information Maximization for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing scene classification is increasingly relying on foundation models pre-trained on large-scale Earth-observation data. Moreover, transductive inference, which exploits the collective statistical structure of the entire unlabeled query set, appears to naturally match remote sensing pipelines where large images are routinely split into patches and inferred as a batch. In this work, we introduce LC-TIM (Locally Consistent Transductive Information Maximization), which extends the state-of-the-art Transductive Information Maximization for Few-Shot CLIP (TIM++) objective with a local consistency regularizer that enforces prediction agreement between each query sample and its $κ$ nearest feature-space neighbors. The regularizer enters as a single multiplicative factor in the closed-form $q$-update, adding negligible computational overhead. We further propose a multi-source extension that fuses the affinity graph from multiple remote sensing foundation model, further boosting classification accuracy. To assess these methods, we establish the first comprehensive, open-source benchmark for transductive few-shot RS scene classification, evaluating LP++, TransCLIP, TIM++, and LC-TIM across ten diverse datasets, two remote sensing vision-language models, and across various few-shot settings. Our experiments show that transductive methods consistently outperform zero-shot baselines, and that LC-TIM achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, with the largest gains in the low-shot regime where neighborhood cues are most informative. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/elkhouryk/LC-TIM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LC-TIM（Locally Consistent Transductive Information Maximization），在面向少样本 CLIP 的直推式信息最大化目标 TIM++ 上加入局部一致性正则项，要求每个查询样本与其 κ 个最近特征空间邻居的预测保持一致。该正则项以单个乘法因子形式进入闭合形式的 q-update，计算开销可忽略；作者还提出多源扩展，融合多个遥感基础模型的亲和图。作者建立首个开源的综合直推式少样本遥感场景分类基准，评估 LP++、TransCLIP、TIM++ 与 LC-TIM，并报告 LC-TIM 取得最先进精度。
Motivation: 遥感场景分类日益依赖在大规模地球观测数据上预训练的基础模型，而直推式推理（transductive inference）天然契合遥感中大批量切块预测的流程；现有 TIM++ 目标未利用查询样本间的局部近邻一致性，低样本条件下存在提升空间。
Method: 在 TIM++ 目标中引入局部一致性正则化，强制每个查询样本与其 κ 个最近特征空间邻居的预测一致，该正则项作为单一乘法因子进入闭合形式的 q 更新；另提出多源扩展，将来自多个遥感基础模型的亲和图融合以进一步提升分类精度。
Result: 在十个数据集、两个遥感视觉-语言模型以及多种少样本设置下的实验表明，直推式方法一致优于零样本基线；LC-TIM 达到最先进精度，且增益在低样本（low-shot）区域最大，因为此时邻域线索最具信息量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部一致性正则化能以极低额外计算代价提升少样本遥感场景分类精度，并发布了公开代码与基准库；局限性未在摘要中展开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAGE: Certified Authorization under Typed-Return Uncertainty for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents act on typed tool returns, records pairing provenance and categorical fields with numerical values. Runtime permission gates generally authorize the observed return and action, leaving the decision unprotected against small errors in how the return was bound to its source. We ask whether a candidate action stays authorized over a declared neighborhood of plausible correctly bound returns: one admissible binding fault plus bounded numerical drift. We prove that certifying the categorical and numerical channels separately does not compose: perturbations that are safe on each channel alone can jointly turn the same action unsafe. CAGE certifies this joint neighborhood directly, enumerating the discrete branches exactly and certifying the continuous perturbation within each branch. Across synthetic, policy-as-code, regulatory, and real-transaction settings, CAGE removes the in-budget false allows that accurate pointwise gates admit, while keeping a useful fraction of decisions autonomous. When the policy is executable, CAGE-Exact certifies the policy itself; otherwise CAGE-Lip and CAGE-RS certify a learned gate under an explicit, measured fidelity assumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAGE，一种针对工具使用型 LLM agent 的授权认证框架，处理类型化工具返回（typed tool returns）上的不确定性。作者证明对类别通道和数值通道分别认证无法组合成整体安全性，因此 CAGE 直接认证两者的联合邻域：精确枚举离散分支，并在每个分支内认证连续扰动。实验涵盖合成、策略即代码、监管和真实交易设置，表明 CAGE 能消除点式门控（pointwise gates）在预算内允许的错误授权，同时保留可用比例的自主决策。
Motivation: 现有运行时权限门控（permission gates）基于观测到的返回值和动作进行授权，未防护返回结果在绑定到其来源时的小误差；这种绑定错误与数值漂移的联合扰动可能使原本安全的动作变得不安全。
Method: CAGE（Certified Authorization under Typed-Return Uncertainty）直接对类别离散分支进行精确枚举，并在每个分支内对连续数值漂移进行认证；在策略可执行时使用 CAGE-Exact 认证策略本身，否则使用 CAGE-Lip 和 CAGE-RS 在显式、可测量的保真度假设下认证学习到的门控。
Result: 在合成、策略即代码、监管和真实交易等设置中，CAGE 消除了点式授权在预算内产生的错误允许（false allows），同时保留了有用比例的决策自主性。
Conclusion: 作者强调对类别和数值通道的单独认证不能组合，必须对联合邻域进行认证；CAGE 通过精确枚举离散分支和分支内连续扰动认证实现安全授权，并在策略不可执行时依赖显式保真度假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Few-shot Deep Learning for Phase-Amplitude Aberration Correction in Transcranial Focused Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) is a non-invasive technique that delivers focused acoustic energy through the skull for neuromodulation and therapeutic applications. However, the heterogeneous structure of the skull induces complex, patient-specific phase and amplitude aberrations that distort the acoustic focus and deviate it from the intended target, compromising therapeutic efficacy and safety. Conventional time-reversal (TR) simulations can correct these aberrations but rely on computationally expensive full-wave solvers, making them impractical for real-time use and iterative treatment planning. We propose a few-shot deep surrogate framework that predicts per-element phase and amplitude corrections for a 96-element 3D phased-array transducer from patient CT images. A geometry-aware encoder extracts skull-path features shared across dedicated phase classification and amplitude regression branches, where phase periodicity is handled via circular expectation decoding. The framework is pretrained on diverse skull geometries and fine-tuned with only ten target points, enabling rapid adaptation to unseen patients without full patient-specific simulation. Evaluated via leave-one-out cross-validation across 12 skulls, it achieves a mean phase CMAE of 0.155 rad and amplitude rMAE of 9.089%, a focal centroid error of 0.467 mm, Dice score of 94.422%, and peak pressure ratio of 92.332%, with an approximately 2,535 times speedup over TR simulation. The code is available at https://github.com/Minju-Seol/fewshot-tfus-correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种少样本 (few-shot) 深度代理框架，用于经颅聚焦超声 (tFUS) 的相位与幅度像差校正，从患者 CT 图像直接预测 96 元 3D 相控阵换能器逐单元校正量。框架采用几何感知编码器提取颅骨路径特征，并以圆期望解码处理相位周期性。通过留一交叉验证，在 12 例颅骨上实现平均相位 CMAE 0.155 rad、幅度 rMAE 9.089%，焦点质心误差 0.467 mm，Dice 分数 94.422%，峰值压力比 92.332%，且较时间反转 (TR) 模拟加速约 2535 倍。
Motivation: 颅骨异质性导致患者特异性相位和幅度像差，使声学焦点偏离目标，影响治疗效果与安全性。传统 TR 模拟依赖计算昂贵的全波求解器，难以用于实时和迭代治疗规划。
Method: 提出几何感知编码器提取共享的颅骨路径特征，分别接入相位分类分支和幅度回归分支，并用圆形期望解码处理相位周期性。框架在多样颅骨几何上预训练，仅用十个目标点微调即可适应未见患者，无需完整患者特定模拟。
Result: 在 12 例颅骨的留一交叉验证中，平均相位 CMAE 为 0.155 rad，幅度 rMAE 为 9.089%；焦点质心误差 0.467 mm，Dice 分数 94.422%，峰值压力比 92.332%；相比 TR 模拟约快 2535 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该少样本深度代理框架能在无需全波患者特定仿真的情况下快速校正相位与幅度像差，具备临床实时 tFUS 规划潜力。

papers.title: SERUM: State Extraction and Refinement for User Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Agentic assistants capable of proactive, personalized interactions require structured models of user intent and workflow. However, building these models from raw, unstructured screen activity remains an open challenge. We present SERUM, a multi-pass framework that extracts finite-state behavioral models directly from unstructured egocentric video using hierarchical VLM annotation. Processing screen recordings through a sliding window, SERUM alternates between activity-recognition and intent-inference passes, with each pass refining labels using accumulated prior context to reduce hallucination and temporal conflation seen in single-pass annotation. Synonymous states are then merged via sentence embeddings and human-calibrated thresholds into a compact, coherent taxonomy. We evaluate behavioral structure by fitting first-order Markov models over the resulting label sequences (both actions and intents) and measuring predictive accuracy against frequency baselines. Across 61 egocentric videos in four domains (coding, cooking, physical activities, and daily life), we find: (1) iterative label refinement converges to a stable state vocabulary, which we term schematic equilibrium, after several passes; (2) normalized Markov models achieve substantially lower perplexity and higher action predictions than frequency baselines, with the largest gains on structured tasks like coding; and (3) human annotators rate final-pass labels as accurate and meaningfully improved over first-pass labels. To our knowledge, SERUM is the first system to produce interpretable process models from unstructured egocentric screen video without manual annotation, opening a scalable pathway for user modeling and behavioral understanding in the wild. Our demo, code, and results are publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SERUM 是一个从无结构的自我中心屏幕视频中提取有限状态用户行为模型的多轮框架，利用分层 VLM 标注 (hierarchical VLM annotation) 交替进行活动识别与意图推断，并通过滑动窗口逐步精炼标签。作者在四个领域共61段自我中心视频上评估，发现迭代精炼会收敛到稳定的状态词汇（称为 schematic equilibrium），归一化马尔可夫模型的困惑度和动作预测显著优于频率基线，人工评估也认为最终标签更准确。作者称这是首个无需人工标注即可从无结构自我中心屏幕视频生成可解释流程模型的系统。
Motivation: 智能体助手需要结构化的用户意图与工作流模型，但从原始、无结构的屏幕活动数据构建这类模型仍然是一个开放挑战。现有单遍标注容易产生幻觉和时间混淆，且人工标注难以扩展。
Method: 提出 SERUM，一种多遍框架：通过滑动窗口处理屏幕录像，交替执行活动识别与意图推断两轮标注，每轮利用累积的先前上下文来精炼标签；随后使用句子嵌入 (sentence embeddings) 和人工校准阈值合并同义状态，形成紧凑连贯的分类体系；最后通过一阶马尔可夫模型 (first-order Markov models) 对标签序列建模并评估预测准确率。

papers.title: MoRAE: Flow-Friendly Self-Supervised Latents for Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation must produce motions that are semantically correct, temporally coherent, and physically plausible. A natural approach is to first project motion data into a structured semantic space and then train a generative model within that space. Such a paradigm has been highly successful in image generation through Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), where a frozen self-supervised encoder provides semantic features for diffusion or flow models to learn from. However, direct transfer of such a paradigm to motion space using Motion-JEPA as the frozen encoder fails dramatically. We diagnose this failure geometrically and identify two motion-specific bottlenecks: (1) the JEPA feature space is spectrally ill-conditioned, making the Gaussian-to-data transport unstable; and (2) even with a well-conditioned spectrum, flow residuals tend to align with decoder-sensitive directions, where small latent errors are amplified into large motion artifacts after decoding. Based on these insights, we propose MoRAE. MoRAE addresses the two bottlenecks separately. A compact bottleneck distills the structured JEPA representation while removing weak and redundant directions, bringing the latent spectrum into a transport-stable regime. Motion-coupled training then aligns the retained latent geometry with the decoder, making characteristic flow errors less costly after decoding. With this flow-friendly latent, a standard non-autoregressive Flow-Matching DiT achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MoRAE，一种面向文本驱动运动生成的流友好自监督潜空间方法。作者诊断了将表示自编码器 (RAE) 范式从图像迁移到运动空间时 Motion-JEPA 编码器失败的两个几何原因：特征谱病态导致高斯到数据的传输不稳定，以及流残差与解码器敏感方向对齐导致小潜变量误差被放大。MoRAE 通过紧凑瓶颈蒸馏 JEPA 表示并去除弱/冗余方向，再用运动耦合训练对齐潜空间几何与解码器，最终使标准非自回归 Flow-Matching DiT 达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 文本到运动生成需要语义正确、时间连贯且物理合理的输出；图像生成中 RAE（冻结自监督编码器 + 扩散/流模型）范式非常成功，但直接迁移到运动空间（使用 Motion-JEPA）会失败，作者希望从几何角度诊断并解决这一失败。
Method: MoRAE 分两步解决两个瓶颈：先用紧凑瓶颈 (compact bottleneck) 蒸馏结构化的 JEPA 表示，去除弱且冗余的方向，使潜空间谱进入传输稳定区间；再通过运动耦合训练 (motion-coupled training) 将保留的潜空间几何与解码器对齐，使特征性的流误差在解码后代价更小。
Result: 摘要报告使用该流友好潜空间后，标准非自回归 Flow-Matching DiT 在文本到运动生成上取得最先进 (state-of-the-art) 性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调运动特定的两个瓶颈需要分别处理，且通过潜空间几何与解码器对齐可以让标准生成模型直接达到最先进水平；摘要未明确讨论局限。

papers.title: MBDiff: Multi-view Behavior-aware Diffusion Model for Probabilistic Utility Data Imputation
papers.abstract_en: Utility data (e.g., electricity, water, and gas consumption), collected by ubiquitous sensors and embedded devices, often contains substantial missing values due to various factors such as device failures and data transmission issues. The data missingness can severely impact utility billing accuracy, hinder demand forecasting, and disrupt efficient utility supply management. As a result, utility data imputation has attracted much interest from both industry and academia. While many studies have attempted to address this issue, most of them rely on aggregated datasets for training, overlooking rich user behavior information, which could provide valuable insights for more accurate imputation. However, learning comprehensive user behavior from long-term, diverse, and incomplete utility data remains a significant challenge. Moreover, leveraging user behavior information to guide imputation is nontrivial due to the indirect nature of the correlations. To address these challenges, we propose MBDiff, a Multi-view Behavior-aware Diffusion Model for Probabilistic Utility Data Imputation. MBDiff incorporates two key technical components: (i) a multi-view User Behavior Extraction module that learns comprehensive user behavior from multiple perspectives, including global, local, and instance-level views; and (ii) a behavior-aware conditional diffusion model consisting of a reference selection module and a conditional attentional denoising network to impute utility data in a computationally efficient manner. We implement and evaluate MBDiff by collaborating with one of the largest municipal utility providers in Florida. Experimental results demonstrate our proposed MBDiff effectively outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, e.g., it improves 7.04% and 29.1% on the electricity and water usage datasets for block missingness imputation, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MBDiff，一个多视角行为感知扩散模型（Multi-view Behavior-aware Diffusion Model），用于概率性公用事业数据填补。针对电、水、气等消费数据中因设备故障和传输问题导致的缺失值，MBDiff 从全局、局部和实例级视角提取用户行为，并用行为感知的条件扩散模型进行填补。作者与佛罗里达州一家大型市政公用事业供应商合作评估，结果显示在电力和用水数据集的块缺失填补任务上分别比现有基线提升 7.04% 和 29.1%。
Motivation: 公用事业数据常含有大量缺失值，会严重影响计费准确性、需求预测和供应管理。现有填补方法大多在聚合数据集上训练，忽略了可提供更精确填补线索的丰富用户行为信息；而从长期、多样且不完整的数据中学习用户行为，并利用间接的行为相关性指导填补，仍然具有挑战性。
Method: MBDiff 包含两个关键技术组件：一是多视角用户行为提取模块，从全局、局部和实例级视角学习综合用户行为；二是行为感知的条件扩散模型，由参考选择模块和条件注意力去噪网络构成，以计算高效的方式完成数据填补。
Result: 在与佛罗里达州大型市政公用事业供应商的合作实验中，MBDiff 在电力和用水数据集的块缺失填补上分别较最先进基线提升 7.04% 和 29.1%，有效性优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，利用多视角用户行为信息并结合条件扩散模型，可以显著提升公用事业数据块缺失填补的精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: While robot foundation models are growing increasingly capable, the strongest models are typically trained on proprietary data and remain closed-source, limiting downstream users' ability to adapt them to new tasks, embodiments, and deployment settings. Following the LLM community, an emerging access paradigm for closed-weight robot foundation models is the managed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) API, where users submit training data and receive a tuned policy without access to model weights, gradients, or training internals. While such APIs let downstream users leverage powerful proprietary foundation models, they restrict policy improvement to pure imitation, ruling out reinforcement learning and other closed-loop methods that rely on internal training signals. This limitation is particularly acute for agile, contact-rich humanoid manipulation, where the gap between policy outputs and deployed behavior is large due to novel states, action tracking dynamics, latency, and controller-specific failure modes. We study how effective this managed-API regime is for humanoid adaptation, and how closed-loop improvement can be realized within it to push policies toward task mastery. We conduct one of the first empirical studies of managed-API adaptation on a real humanoid, instantiated on Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD). We find that direct SFT through the API substantially outperforms a leading open-weight VLA trained on the same demonstrations, yet still falls short of deployment-level mastery on agile, contact-rich tasks. To close this gap, we introduce CLIFT: Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning, which turns deployment-time reward feedback into API-compatible supervised data and enables closed-loop policy improvement without accessing weights, gradients, likelihoods, or losses-pushing GROD to near-perfect success after two flywheel cycles, all without "opening the model box."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究封闭权重机器人基础模型在托管式监督微调（managed SFT API）范式下的人形机器人适配问题，并以 Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD) 在真实人形机器人上开展实证研究。直接通过 API 进行 SFT 明显优于基于相同示范训练的开源权重 VLA，但仍未达到敏捷、接触丰富任务的部署级掌握水平。作者提出 CLIFT（Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning），把部署时的奖励反馈转化为 API 兼容的监督数据，在不访问权重、梯度、似然或损失的情况下实现闭环策略改进，两个飞轮循环后将 GROD 推向近乎完美的成功率。
Motivation: 最强的机器人基础模型通常在专有数据上训练且保持闭源，下游用户只能通过托管 SFT API 适配，无法获得权重、梯度或训练内部信号，因而只能做纯模仿学习，无法使用强化学习等闭环方法。这一限制在敏捷且接触丰富的类人操作任务中尤为严重，因为策略输出与部署行为之间存在由新状态、动作跟踪动力学、延迟和控制器特定故障模式造成的巨大差距。
Method: 提出 CLIFT：Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning，将部署阶段的奖励反馈转化为 API 兼容的监督数据，使策略改进形成闭环，同时完全不需要访问模型权重、梯度、似然或损失。该方法在托管 API 约束内迭代运行飞轮循环，逐步提升策略表现。
Result: 实验发现直接通过托管 API 的 SFT 显著优于以相同示范训练的开源权重 VLA，但仍未达到部署级熟练度；引入 CLIFT 后，经过两个飞轮循环即可将 GROD 提升到近乎完美的成功率，全程无需打开模型内部。
Conclusion: 作者认为闭环改进可以在托管 API 的受限访问范式内实现，使下游用户无需访问权重或内部训练信号即可对封闭权重机器人基础模型进行专业化适配。

papers.title: ActFovea: Runtime Safeguarding for VLA Policies via Spatiotemporal Visual-Action Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to runtime disturbances that break the temporal alignment among visual observations, robot states, and executed actions. We introduce ActFovea, a plug-and-play safeguarding framework that detects and mitigates such failures without retraining or modifying the underlying VLA policy. ActFovea uses robot kinematics, proprioceptive states, and recent actions to construct action-conditioned foveated regions that retain contact-relevant areas and predicted motion corridors while suppressing task-irrelevant visual content. It detects runtime risks by evaluating whether visual motion and observation freshness remain consistent with geometric, proprioceptive, and action transitions. For recoverable disturbances, ActFovea constructs disturbance-specific candidate observations and accepts a recovery only after verifying the resulting action chunk. When stale or replayed observations make reliable recovery impossible, it invokes a bounded safe-failure procedure. In closed-loop evaluations of $π_0$ across multiple LIBERO suites, ActFovea increases success under localized visual overlays from 49.3\% to 90.3\%, closing 93.7\% of the gap to clean performance. It further improves success under action drift and visual delay by 7.0 and 9.8 percentage points, respectively, while preserving clean-task performance. Under frozen-observation replay, ActFovea triggers timely safe failure in all trials, with no unprotected failures. These results demonstrate that spatiotemporal visual-action consistency provides an effective basis for runtime safeguarding of VLA policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ActFovea 是一个即插即用的运行时保护框架，用于检测并缓解视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略在机器人操作中遇到的运行时干扰，且无需重新训练或修改底层策略。它利用机器人运动学、本体感受状态和近期动作构建动作条件化的注视区域，并通过时空视觉-动作一致性来评估风险。在多个 LIBERO 套件上对 π0 的闭环评估中，局部视觉叠加下的成功率从 49.3% 提升到 90.3%，缩小了 93.7% 与干净性能的差距，同时保持干净任务性能并支持有界安全失败。
Motivation: VLA 策略虽在机器人操作中表现良好，但容易受到破坏视觉观测、机器人状态与执行动作之间时间对齐的运行时干扰。现有方法缺乏一种不改变底层策略、可在线运行的统一保障机制来检测和缓解这类失败。
Method: ActFovea 使用运动学、本体感受状态和近期动作构建动作条件化注视区域 (action-conditioned foveated regions)，保留接触相关区域和预测运动走廊，同时抑制任务无关视觉内容。它通过检查视觉运动与观测新鲜度是否与几何、本体感受和动作转换一致来检测运行时风险；对可恢复扰动构造干扰特定的候选观测，并在验证动作块后才接受恢复，否则触发有界安全失败。
Result: 在 π0 的闭环评估中，ActFovea 将局部视觉叠加下的成功率从 49.3% 提高到 90.3%，缩小了 93.7% 与干净性能的差距；动作漂移和视觉延迟下的成功率分别提高 7.0 和 9.8 个百分点。在冻结观测重放场景下，所有试验均及时触发安全失败，没有出现未受保护的失败。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，时空视觉-动作一致性为 VLA 策略的运行时保护提供了有效基础，ActFovea 能够在无需重训练的前提下检测并缓解多种运行时扰动。该框架主要面向机器人操作场景，具体方法细节和更广泛任务上的表现需参考原文。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Memory Provenance Laundering in LLM Agents: A Non-Amplification Firewall for Persistent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory lets large language model(LLM) agents reuse prior preferences and work flows, but it also turns untrusted observations into persistent action context. We identify memory provenance laundering: during LLM-based memory consolidation, an external observation may be rewritten as apparent user history or workflow support, preserving an action trigger while erasing the low-trust source that should limit its authority. Existing prompt filters, content sanitizers, and tool guards do not enforce source-authority non-amplification after lossy memory consolidation. We formalize this boundary and instantiate it as Provenance-Preserving Memory Fire wall (PPMF), a lightweight memory middleware that preserves platform-maintained provenance and authorizes tool calls by matching action risk to the authority of action-relevant memories. In our schema-grounded evaluation with fixed risk policies, vulnerable consolidated memories reach up to 1.000 attack success rate(ASR); with intact platform-maintained provenance, confirmation, and risk labels, no evaluated unauthorized high-risk action passes the PPMF gate while confirmed benign actions and targeted low-risk memory use remain executable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM agent 长期记忆中的安全风险，提出记忆来源清洗 (memory provenance laundering) 问题：外部观察在记忆整合 (memory consolidation) 过程中可能被改写成看似可信的用户历史或工作流支持，从而保留动作触发条件却抹掉低信任来源。作者将安全边界形式化为来源权威非放大 (source-authority non-amplification)，并实现为轻量级记忆中间件 Provenance-Preserving Memory Firewall (PPMF)，在固定风险策略下评估其门控效果。
Motivation: 长期记忆让 LLM agent 复用历史偏好与工作流，但也把不可信观察变成持久的行动上下文；现有提示过滤、内容清洗和工具防护 (tool guards) 无法在有损记忆整合后强制来源权威不放大，导致外部观察可能绕过信任边界触发高风险动作。
Method: 提出 PPMF，一种保留平台维护的来源 (platform-maintained provenance) 的记忆中间件：在记忆写入时保留来源信息，并在工具调用授权时将动作风险与相关记忆的权威等级匹配，从而对高风险动作施加来源权威约束。
Result: 在基于固定风险策略的 schema-grounded 评估中，易受攻击的整合后记忆可达 1.000 的攻击成功率 (attack success rate, ASR)；而保留完整平台来源、确认信息和风险标签时，所有被评估的未授权高风险动作都无法通过 PPMF 门控，同时确认的良性动作和有明确目标的小风险记忆使用仍可执行。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要通过保留来源的记忆中间件来强制执行来源权威非放大，以防范有损记忆整合后的权限提升；论文为此类长期记忆安全边界提供了形式化定义与可行性验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Implicit Machine Learning Force Fields Accelerate Molecular Dynamics Simulations
papers.abstract_en: We introduce implicit machine learning force fields (I-MLFFs), which replace explicit stacks of neural network layers with self-consistent fixed-point equations. In molecular simulations, this formulation enables intermediate representations to be reused across successive timesteps, thereby warm-starting force evaluation. The resulting models effectively combine the computational footprint of a shallow, single-layer MLFF with the representational capacity and accuracy of a deep neural network. Our approach unlocks architecture-agnostic efficiency gains that are inaccessible when force prediction and trajectory integration are considered separately. We demonstrate this across three major classes of graph neural networks: invariant, equivariant Cartesian tensor, and SO(3)-equivariant spherical-tensor architectures. Each yields a two- to five-fold reduction in compute and memory footprint. Crucially, these gains are achieved while retaining full atomistic resolution and the original integration timestep, avoiding spatial or temporal coarse graining. Our contribution therefore advances the scaling frontier of quantum-mechanically faithful molecular simulation, enabling longer trajectories and larger atomistic systems within fixed GPU memory and compute budgets, and thereby opening access to new insights across biomolecular and material systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出隐式机器学习力场（implicit machine learning force fields, I-MLFFs），用自洽不动点方程替代显式神经网络层堆叠，使中间表示可在分子动力学模拟的逐时间步中复用，从而热启动力评估。该方法在不变、等变笛卡尔张量和 SO(3) 等变球张量三类图神经网络架构上均实现两到五倍的计算与内存开销降低，同时保持全原子分辨率和原始积分时间步长。
Motivation: 分子动力学模拟中，力预测与轨迹积分被分开考虑时，深度网络在每个时间步的显式计算成本较高；需要一个能跨时间步复用中间表示、兼具浅层网络开销与深层网络表达能力的方法。
Method: 引入 I-MLFFs，将显式神经网络层替换为自洽固定点方程，并利用相邻时间步的中间表示对力评估进行 warm-start；该框架与具体图神经网络架构无关，并在不变、等变笛卡尔张量和球张量架构上验证。
Result: 在三类图神经网络架构上，计算与内存占用均降低两至五倍，且不牺牲原子级分辨率或原始积分时间步长，避免空间或时间粗粒化。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法推进了量子力学保真分子模拟的扩展边界，可在固定 GPU 计算与内存预算下支持更长轨迹和更大原子系统，从而适用于生物分子与材料体系。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Progressive Decision-Making for Localizing Open-Ended AI-Generated Image Forgeries
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image forgeries are becoming increasingly realistic and difficult to characterize with fixed manipulation patterns. As generative models continue to evolve, it is impractical to expect a localization model to exhaustively learn all possible forgery appearances from large-scale training data alone. Nevertheless, many AI-generated forgeries still leave subtle forensic traces, although these cues are often weak and unevenly reliable across regions. Therefore, robust localization requires not only extracting informative forensic traces, but also making reliable decisions from incomplete and ambiguous evidence. In this paper, we move beyond static one-shot prediction and reformulate final forgery localization as an adaptive sequential decision-updating process, where the localization map is treated as an intermediate state rather than a fixed output. Rather than producing the final mask via one-shot pixel-wise prediction, our method progressively updates the localization state guided by available evidence, uncertainty, and boundary conditions. Specifically, we first transform mesoscopic traces into compact decision evidence via a lightweight decision evidence projector, and then introduce Evidence-Guided Mamba (EG-Mamba) to perform uncertainty- and boundary-aware state updating. This design allows reliable manipulated and background regions to be preserved, while ambiguous regions are cautiously revised according to the available evidence. Extensive experiments on both conventional and AI-generated manipulation benchmarks validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Notably, even when trained only on conventional manipulation data, our method brings larger gains on unseen AI-generated forgeries, indicating that progressive decision-updating is especially useful for heterogeneous and hard-to-exhaustively-learn manipulation traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放式 AI 生成图像伪造的定位问题，提出将最终伪造定位重构为自适应顺序决策更新过程，把定位图当作中间状态而非一次性输出。方法先用轻量级决策证据投影器将中尺度痕迹转换为紧凑决策证据，再引入 Evidence-Guided Mamba (EG-Mamba) 进行不确定性与边界感知的状态更新，保留可靠区域并谨慎修正模糊区域。在常规与 AI 生成伪造基准上的实验验证了有效性，且仅用常规伪造数据训练时，对未见过的 AI 生成伪造带来更大提升。
Motivation: AI 生成伪造越来越逼真且难以用固定操纵模式刻画，生成模型持续演进，期望定位模型仅靠大规模训练数据穷尽学习所有伪造外观并不现实；同时许多 AI 生成伪造仍留有微弱、跨区域可靠性不均的法医痕迹，因此需要在信息不完整且证据模糊的情况下做出可靠决策。
Method: 将最终伪造定位建模为自适应顺序决策更新过程，定位图作为中间状态逐步更新；先通过轻量级决策证据投影器把中尺度痕迹转化为紧凑决策证据，再引入 Evidence-Guided Mamba (EG-Mamba) 进行不确定性感知与边界感知的状态更新，实现可靠操纵区与背景区保留、模糊区依据证据谨慎修订。
Result: 在常规与 AI 生成操纵基准上的大量实验验证了方法有效性；尤其当仅用常规操纵数据训练时，方法在未见过的 AI 生成伪造上带来更大增益，说明渐进式决策更新对异质且难以穷尽学习的操纵痕迹尤为有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调渐进式决策更新优于静态一次性预测，特别适用于难以穷尽学习的异质操纵痕迹场景。
Relevance: 2
