papers.title: Transpiler Autotuning with Predictive Models for Quantum Circuit Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Quantum software engineering is an emerging research field focusing on efficiently embedding the quantum programming paradigm into existing software ecosystems. A key aspect of this field is the realization of quantum algorithms using gate-based programming and the subsequent low-level optimization of the resulting quantum circuits, a process that is commonly performed by so-called transpilation pipelines. One significant challenge in these pipelines is determining which optimizations to apply to a given circuit. This decision is usually based on fixed default configurations that are uniformly applied to all circuits, frequently resulting in missed opportunities for more aggressive circuit optimization. In this work, we tackle this challenge by applying autotuning with supervised machine learning to develop an automated method for selection of transpiler passes. To train our machine-learning models, we employ feature-model based sampling to generate a representative dataset that examines how different combinations of Qiskit transpiler passes perform across thousands of circuits drawn from the state-of-the-art benchmarking suite MQT Bench. Using these data, we build a predictive model extension for the Qiskit transpilation pipeline that uses a machine learning model to automatically select combinations of transpiler passes aiming to achieve a maximum reduction in two-qubit gates. Our empirical evaluation shows that the combinations selected by our model are never outperformed by Qiskit's optimization levels, achieve on average an additional 19.1$\%$ - 32.4$\%$ reduction in two-qubit gates, and for some circuits finds reductions of up to $95.8\%$ in cases where Qiskit achieves no reduction at all.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子电路编译中 transpilation pipeline 的优化决策问题，提出用监督机器学习自动选择 Qiskit transpiler passes 的组合。作者基于特征模型采样 (feature-model based sampling) 从 MQT Bench 基准套件生成涵盖数千条电路的数据集，训练预测模型并作为 Qiskit 编译管线的扩展。摘要报告该方法选择出的 pass 组合在双量子门 (two-qubit gates) 缩减上表现优于 Qiskit 的默认优化水平。
Motivation: 现有量子电路编译通常采用固定的默认配置并统一应用于所有电路，经常错过更激进的电路优化机会，需要一种自动化的方法来决定对给定电路应用哪些优化。
Method: 使用特征模型采样构建代表性数据集，研究不同 Qiskit transpiler pass 组合在数千条来自 MQT Bench 的电路上的表现；基于这些数据训练机器学习预测模型，并作为 Qiskit transpilation pipeline 的扩展，自动选择以最大化双量子门缩减为目标的 pass 组合。
Result: 经验评估表明，模型选出的组合从未被 Qiskit 的优化水平超越，平均额外减少 19.1% 至 32.4% 的双量子门，在 Qiskit 完全无法减少双量子门的部分电路上，该方法最多可达到 95.8% 的缩减。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将自动调优 (autotuning) 与监督学习结合用于 transpiler pass 选择，可以显著改进量子电路的编译优化效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Have I Seen You? Embedding Behavior Signals Synthetic Face Dataset Membership
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic face datasets are increasingly used to reduce privacy exposure and data access constraints in biometric recognition. Yet the generators that produce these datasets are trained on real faces, so synthetic data may still reveal their real source data. We study this risk through a dataset-level membership inference attack that first identifies the synthetic dataset used to train a face recognizer and then infers the real dataset used to train the generator. Across 11 face recognition models, 11 synthetic datasets, and 7 real datasets, the attack recovers the synthetic training dataset in 100% of cases and identifies the generator's source dataset in 54.5% of cases. These results show that synthetic data can retain dataset-level traces of real training data and that privacy-preserving deployment requires stronger leakage mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成人脸数据集中的数据集级成员泄露风险，提出一种数据集级成员推断攻击（membership inference attack）：先识别训练目标人脸识别器的合成数据集，再推断该合成数据生成器所用的真实人脸数据集。在11个人脸识别模型、11个合成数据集和7个真实数据集上，攻击在100%的情况下恢复合成训练数据集，并在54.5%的情况下识别出生成器的源数据集。作者认为合成数据仍保留真实训练数据的数据集级痕迹，隐私保护部署需要更强的泄漏缓解。
Motivation: 合成人脸数据集被广泛用于降低隐私暴露和数据访问限制，但由于生成器基于真实人脸数据训练，合成数据可能泄露真实源数据。现有多数隐私研究聚焦样本级泄露，对数据集级成员信息的风险缺乏系统评估，形成盲区。
Method: 提出一种两阶段数据集级成员推断攻击，利用嵌入行为信号（embedding behavior signals）先识别用于训练目标人脸识别器的合成数据集，再据此推断生成该合成数据所使用的真实数据集。
Result: 在11个识别模型、11个合成数据集和7个真实数据集上的实验显示，该攻击以100%的准确率恢复合成训练数据集，并以54.5%的准确率识别出生成器对应的真实源数据集。
Conclusion: 实验结果表明合成数据会保留真实训练数据的数据集级痕迹，作者强调隐私保护部署需要更强的泄漏缓解措施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Efficacy of Self-Supervised Point Cloud Encoders for Efficient 3D Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: 3D point cloud-language models (3D-LLMs) enable 3D understanding by pairing point cloud encoders with large language models, but existing methods rely on costly multi-modal encoders (e.g., ULIP-2) that require image-text-point cloud alignment on 8x A100-scale compute, creating high barriers for research and deployment. In this work, we systematically investigate whether low-cost self-supervised point cloud encoders, specifically PCP-MAE and Point-MAE, can serve as effective alternatives. Using MiniGPT-3D as our testbed, we evaluate 7 encoder initialization/pre-training setups (1 multi-modal baseline, 5 self-supervised, 1 random init) under frozen and unfrozen fine-tuning (12 total groups), across 2 architectures (MaskTransformer, PointTransformer), 3 objectives (PCP-MAE, Point-MAE, random init), and 2 datasets (Objaverse 660K, ShapeNet55-34 approximately 50K). Our experiments reveal three key findings: (1) The four-stage MiniGPT-3D pipeline can effectively train a 3D encoder from random initialization: an end-to-end trained random init encoder reaches 52.50% open-vocabulary accuracy and 44.45 captioning score, approaching top pre-trained variants; (2) Architecture and pre-training objective show strong crossover interaction: PCP-MAE + MaskTransformer achieves 59.00% accuracy (best self-supervised), while Point-MAE + MaskTransformer drops to 46.50%, with the pattern reversed for PointTransformer; (3) Closed-set ModelNet40 classification remains a core weakness of purely geometric encoders, reaching only ~13-18% accuracy vs. ~62% for the multi-modal baseline, even after end-to-end fine-tuning. Our results offer practical guidelines for cost-effective 3D-LLM design and reveal interaction patterns between self-supervised objectives and encoder architectures.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures. This work has been previously released as a preprint on ChinaXiv (No. ChinaXiv:202607.00167, DOI: 10.12074/202607.00167)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估低成本自监督点云编码器（PCP-MAE、Point-MAE）能否替代昂贵的多模态编码器（如 ULIP-2）用于 3D 大语言模型（3D-LLM）。以 MiniGPT-3D 为测试平台，作者比较了 7 种编码器初始化/预训练设定在冻结与非冻结微调下的表现。结果显示随机初始化的端到端训练即可接近最优预训练变体，且预训练目标与编码器架构之间存在强交叉交互。
Motivation: 现有 3D-LLM 依赖需要图像-文本-点云对齐的多模态编码器，训练成本高达 8xA100 级别，阻碍了研究与部署。作者希望验证低成本的纯几何自监督编码器能否作为有效替代。
Method: 以 MiniGPT-3D 为 testbed，系统比较 7 种编码器初始化/预训练方案（1 种多模态基线、5 种自监督、1 种随机初始化），覆盖冻结与非冻结微调共 12 组实验，涉及 2 种架构（MaskTransformer、PointTransformer）、3 种目标（PCP-MAE、Point-MAE、随机初始化）和 2 个数据集（Objaverse 660K、ShapeNet55-34 约 50K）。
Result: 三个关键发现：一是四阶段 MiniGPT-3D 流水线可以有效地从随机初始化端到端训练编码器，达到 52.50% 的开放词汇准确率和 44.45 的 captioning 分数，接近最优预训练变体；二是架构与预训练目标存在强交叉交互，PCP-MAE + MaskTransformer 达到 59.00% 准确率（最佳自监督组合），而 Point-MAE + MaskTransformer 降至 46.50%，在 PointTransformer 上模式反转；三是纯几何编码器在封闭集 ModelNet40 分类上仍是核心短板，仅约 13-18% 准确率，而多模态基线约 62%。
Conclusion: 作者给出的结论是，低成本自监督点云编码器在 3D-LLM 中可行但存在架构-目标依赖，封闭集分类仍是其显著弱点；研究为经济高效的 3D-LLM 设计提供了实用指导，并揭示了自监督目标与编码器架构之间的交互模式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HERO: History-Enriched Rollout Training for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) by applying a learned evolution operator recursively to its own predictions, but this autoregressive rollout feeds every prediction error back as input, so local errors accumulate. Existing rollout-training strategies reduce the mismatch between training inputs and self-generated states, yet their supervision still measures only the absolute discrepancy from the ground-truth trajectory. Such supervision is therefore uninformative about whether the operator has overcome the long-horizon failure behaviors it exhibited earlier during optimization. We propose history-enriched rollout training (HERO), which augments conventional absolute trajectory supervision with relative supervision derived from the model's optimization history. HERO ranks detached candidate rollouts from a periodically refreshed lagged operator, the current model, and a perturbed input by rollout error, spectral discrepancy, energy drift, and error growth, and selects the strongest failure trajectory as reference. This reference enters a margin-based objective as a fixed comparison baseline, inducing a bounded, sample-dependent reweighting of the ground-truth rollout gradient rather than an independent gradient direction, which we further analyze theoretically. Experiments on nine PDE benchmarks with spectral and attention-based backbones show that HERO consistently improves long-horizon accuracy, stable rollout length, and out-of-distribution robustness at no inference-time cost. These results indicate that history-enriched relative supervision is effective for stabilizing long-horizon autoregressive prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出历史增强的展开训练 (HERO)，用于长时程自回归神经算子 (neural operators)。传统展开训练只以与真实轨迹的绝对误差作为监督，难以反映模型是否克服了早期优化中出现的长时程失败行为。HERO 从优化历史中提取相对监督，选择最强失败轨迹作为参考并纳入基于 margin 的目标函数，在九个 PDE 基准上提升长期精度、稳定展开长度与分布外鲁棒性，且不增加推理开销。
Motivation: 神经算子递归作用于自身预测时，预测误差会被不断回灌，局部误差逐渐累积。现有展开训练虽然缓解了训练输入与自生成状态之间的分布失配，但其监督仍只衡量与真实轨迹的绝对偏差，无法告知算子是否已摆脱优化早期表现出的长时程失败行为。
Method: 提出 history-enriched rollout training (HERO)，在传统绝对轨迹监督之上加入源于模型优化历史的相对监督。该方法对来自周期刷新的滞后算子、当前模型和扰动输入的候选展开结果，按展开误差、谱差异 (spectral discrepancy)、能量漂移和误差增长进行排序，选出最强失败轨迹作为固定比较基准；该基准进入 margin-based 目标，产生有界、样本相关的真值展开梯度重加权，而非独立的梯度方向，并对此给出理论分析。
Result: 在九个 PDE 基准上，以谱方法 (spectral) 和注意力 (attention) 为骨干的实验中，HERO 一致改善了长时程精度、稳定展开长度和分布外鲁棒性，且推理时无额外开销。
Conclusion: 实验表明，基于历史信息的相对监督能有效稳定长时程自回归预测。摘要并未讨论具体数值或局限性，也未涉及降水、临近预报等具体应用场景。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: InferQ: A Database-Oriented Benchmark for Quantum Circuits Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that relational database management systems (RDBMSs) can execute quantum circuit simulation by compiling the simulation into SQL workloads (primarily join-and-aggregate tensor contractions). While early results are promising, they largely focus on a narrow set of highly structured circuits and offer limited support for systematic database research, such as query optimization, physical design, and engine-level evaluation across a broad range of circuits. We present InferQ, a database-oriented benchmark for quantum circuit simulation. InferQ generates general, compositional circuits by assembling subcircuits from a set of circuit templates, emits each simulation task as an RDBMS-ready SQL workload, and extracts circuit and query features (static, graph, SQL, and dynamic) for workload characterization. InferQ also releases a large dataset of 202,975 circuits online, with a web-based viewer to support searching, filtering, and downloading circuits and feature records. In experiments across RDBMS engines (PostgreSQL, SQLite, DuckDB, and Umbra) and the widely used Qiskit Aer simulator, we find that RDBMSs achieve better peak memory usage than Qiskit Aer on more than 50% of the circuits generated by InferQ. Moreover, using InferQ features, lightweight machine learning models (linear and tree-based models) can accurately predict when SQL execution is preferable (with accuracy up to 95.3% for runtime and 97.4% for memory), enabling data-centric simulator selection and opening the door to principled optimization of SQL-based quantum circuit simulation.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at ACM SIGMOD 2027 and publication in the Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (PACMMOD). This arXiv version is an extended technical report that includes the complete appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InferQ 是一个面向量子电路模拟的数据库基准，通过从电路模板组装生成通用组合电路，并将每个模拟任务编译为 RDBMS 可执行的 SQL 工作负载（主要是 join-and-aggregate 张量收缩），同时提取静态、图、SQL 和动态特征用于负载刻画。论文公开了 202,975 个电路的数据集及网页查看器，并在 PostgreSQL、SQLite、DuckDB、Umbra 和 Qiskit Aer 上实验，发现 RDBMS 在超过 50% 的 InferQ 电路上峰值内存优于 Qiskit Aer，且轻量级机器学习模型可高精度预测何时应选择 SQL 执行。
Motivation: 已有的关系数据库执行量子电路模拟研究集中于少量高度结构化的电路，缺乏面向数据库研究的系统性支持，如查询优化、物理设计和跨多种电路的引擎级评估。需要一个通用、可组合且可供数据库社区使用的基准来推动该方向。
Method: InferQ 从一组电路模板组装子电路以生成通用组合电路，将每个模拟任务生成为 RDBMS 就绪的 SQL 工作负载，并提取静态、图、SQL 和动态四类电路与查询特征。还发布包含 202,975 个电路的大型数据集和网页查看器，支持搜索、过滤和下载。

papers.title: First Investigation of Deep Learning for Intraoperative Gauze Segmentation in Minimally Invasive Abdominal Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Surgical gauze is an essential part of surgical procedures, primarily used for controlling bleeding and absorbing bodily fluids. The post-surgical retention of gauze can lead to serious complications and necessitate additional surgery for its removal. Despite the clinical significance, research on gauze segmentation using real-world surgical data remains underexplored, owing in part to the scarcity of annotated datasets. In this work, we investigate the use of deep learning methods for gauze segmentation in robot-assisted minimally invasive abdominal surgeries, utilizing an in-house surgical dataset prepared at a university hospital. The training data reflects realistic surgical settings and captures extensive diversity in spatial, morphological, and visual attributes across three different gauze categories. We evaluate several widely used segmentation architectures, including CNN-based, transformer-based, and hybrid architectures, to establish a proof-of-concept for gauze segmentation in a realistic clinical setting. In addition, we investigate the influence of sub-optimally annotated, auto-tracked segmentation masks as a strategy to address data scarcity and improve performance. Our results demonstrate the efficacy of real-world training data in countering the main challenge reported by prior works, the trade-off between blood presence and gauze detection. The incorporation of auto-tracked annotations yields performance enhancements, particularly in generic surgical scenarios. The integration of effective segmentation approaches can benefit robot-guided surgical procedures and various downstream applications by providing precise delineation of foreign objects, thereby enhancing patient safety and surgical outcomes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对机器人辅助微创腹部手术中术中纱布分割的深度学习方法的首次探究。作者利用大学医院自备的真实手术数据集，覆盖三种纱布类别在空间、形态和视觉上的多样性，评估了 CNN、Transformer 及混合架构，并研究了次优标注的自动跟踪分割掩码作为缓解数据稀缺的手段。结果表明真实世界训练数据能有效应对血液存在与纱布检测之间的权衡，自动跟踪注释在通用手术场景中带来性能提升。
Motivation: 手术纱布术后滞留会导致严重并发症并需要二次手术，但基于真实手术数据的纱布分割研究很少，主要原因是标注数据集稀缺。该工作希望在真实临床环境中为纱布分割建立概念验证。
Method: 使用大学医院准备的自有内镜手术数据集，包含三种纱布类别与现实手术条件中的多样性；系统评估多种主流分割架构（CNN、Transformer 和混合架构）。此外，将自动跟踪生成、可能次优标注的分割掩码纳入训练，作为应对数据稀缺并改进性能的策略。
Result: 实验证明使用真实世界训练数据可以缓解先前工作报告的主要挑战，即血液存在与纱布检测之间的权衡；引入自动跟踪注释能带来性能提升，尤其在通用手术场景中。
Conclusion: 作者认为，有效的分割方法能够为机器人引导手术及下游应用提供对异物的精确勾画，从而提升患者安全与手术结果。该工作属于临床场景下的概念验证性研究。

papers.title: PluRel-to-RDB-PFN: Schema-Guided Synthetic Relational Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Relational Foundation Models (RFMs) require large-scale synthetic relational databases for pretraining, but existing approaches tightly couple data generation with the model training pipeline. We study whether PluRel, a general-purpose synthetic relational database generator, can serve as an external data source for RDB-PFN, a relational in-context learner originally pretrained with a 600K-task single-table warm-up followed by an approximately 1.8M-task adaptation stage. We build a conversion pipeline that maps PluRel-generated databases, including externally constructed binary prediction tasks, into the RDB-PFN training format and evaluate three curriculum strategies: SCHEMA-GUIDED FIRST (real-world schema then fully synthetic), FULLY SYNTHETIC (diverse synthetic schemas throughout), and SCHEMA-GUIDED LAST (fully synthetic then real-world schema). Using only approximately 5,500 relational databases (approximately 33K tasks), roughly 55x fewer tasks than the original protocol, and no single-table warm-up, our best curriculum (SCHEMA-GUIDED FIRST) achieves 0.6346 average ROC-AUC across 19 real benchmark tasks at 1024-shot context, recovering 87.6% of the published RDB-PFN performance (0.7245). At 64-shot context, the gap narrows to 93.8% (0.6116 vs. 0.6517). Our results demonstrate that external synthetic generators can provide useful pretraining signals for RFMs when combined with appropriate curriculum design and that exposure to a real-world schema early in training is substantially more effective than late-stage schema adaptation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究通用型合成关系数据库生成器 PluRel 能否作为外部数据源，替代 RDB-PFN 原有的联合训练管线。作者构建了将 PluRel 生成的数据库（含外部构造的二分类任务）转换为 RDB-PFN 训练格式的流水线，并比较三种课程策略：SCHEMA-GUIDED FIRST、FULLY SYNTHETIC 与 SCHEMA-GUIDED LAST。仅用约 5,500 个关系数据库（约 33K 任务）且无单表热身阶段，最优课程 SCHEMA-GUIDED FIRST 在 19 个真实基准任务上取得 0.6346 的平均 ROC-AUC（1024-shot 上下文），恢复已发表 RDB-PFN 性能（0.7245）的 87.6%；在 64-shot 下差距缩小至 93.8%（0.6116 对 0.6517）。
Motivation: 现有关系基础模型（Relational Foundation Models, RFMs）的预训练依赖大规模合成关系数据库，但已有方法将数据生成与模型训练管线紧密耦合，难以利用外部通用生成器。本文目标是检验 PluRel 这类通用合成生成器能否独立为 RDB-PFN 提供有效预训练信号。
Method: 作者搭建将 PluRel 生成的数据库（包括外部构造的二元预测任务）映射到 RDB-PFN 训练格式的转换流水线，并评估三种课程学习策略：先真实世界模式后全合成、全程多样合成模式、先全合成后真实世界模式。训练使用约 5,500 个关系数据库、约 33K 任务，且不包含原始协议中的单表热身阶段。
Result: 最优课程 SCHEMA-GUIDED FIRST 在 19 个真实基准任务的 1024-shot 上下文中达到 0.6346 平均 ROC-AUC，恢复已发表 RDB-PFN 性能（0.7245）的 87.6%；在 64-shot 下恢复至 93.8%（0.6116 对 0.6517），且所用任务数约为原始协议的 1/55。
Conclusion: 结果表明，恰当的课程设计可使外部合成生成器为 RFMs 提供有用的预训练信号；训练早期接触真实世界模式（schema）比后期进行模式适配更有效。

papers.title: SciFigPlag-Bench: A Benchmark for Provenance-Aware Scientific Figure Plagiarism Detection
papers.abstract_en: Scientific figures often encode the visual evidence behind scientific findings, yet figure plagiarism remains underexplored as a benchmarked multimodal evaluation problem. We present SciFigPlag-Bench, a benchmark for provenance-aware reasoning over scientific figures in scholarly documents. Unlike general image-similarity or image-forensics benchmarks, SciFigPlag-Bench evaluates whether a suspicious figure reuses evidence from a specific source figure, how the reused content has been transformed, and where the reused evidence appears. We introduce a factorized taxonomy that separates what is reused from how it is transformed, covering material-preserving reuse, such as full-figure and subfigure reuse, as well as abstract-content reuse, such as data re-expression and structural redraw. Guided by this taxonomy, we construct a hybrid benchmark with 2,582 positive pairs and 2,541 negative pairs, combining documented real-world cases, taxonomy-guided synthetic examples, and visually similar negatives. The benchmark supports four diagnostic tasks: pairwise detection, source attribution, hierarchical reuse-type classification, and reuse correspondence localization. Experiments with diverse vision-language models establish initial baselines and reveal persistent challenges in fine-grained provenance reasoning, reuse-type understanding, and spatial evidence grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciFigPlag-Bench，一个面向学术文献中科学图像 (scientific figures) 的溯源感知 (provenance-aware) 抄袭检测基准。与通用图像相似度或图像取证基准不同，该基准考察可疑图是否复用了特定源图中的证据、复用内容如何被变换以及复用证据出现在何处。基准包含 2,582 个正样本对和 2,541 个负样本对，并支持成对检测、来源归因、层次化复用类型分类和复用对应定位四个诊断任务。作者在多种视觉语言模型上建立了初始基线，并指出细粒度溯源推理仍是难点。
Motivation: 科学图像编码了研究发现背后的视觉证据，但图像抄袭作为多模态评价问题长期缺乏基准。现有通用图像相似度或取证基准不足以判断证据来源、变换方式与出现位置。
Method: 提出因子化分类法 (factorized taxonomy)，将“复用了什么”与“如何变换”分离，覆盖保留材料的复用（整图与子图复用）和抽象内容复用（数据重表达与结构重绘）。据此构建混合基准，融合文献记载的真实案例、分类法引导的合成样本以及视觉上相似的负样本，并设计四个诊断任务。
Result: 基准含 2,582 个正样本对与 2,541 个负样本对；多类视觉语言模型 (vision-language models) 上的实验建立了初始基线，并揭示模型在细粒度溯源推理、复用类型理解和空间证据定位上仍存在持续困难。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该基准暴露出现有视觉语言模型在细粒度溯源推理上的不足，可为后续研究提供评测基础设施。

papers.title: A Frozen Pixel-Space Diffusion Model Can Guide Itself with Its Own Samples
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space diffusion models aim to learn an end-to-end generator directly over raw pixels. This is challenging because a single model must capture both global structure and local texture in the same high-dimensional space. While recent work improves pixel diffusion through alternative prediction targets, training objectives, and architectures, these advances typically require training a new model from scratch. We show there is a cheaper, complementary strategy: \textbf{a frozen, pretrained pixel diffusion model can guide itself}. Our key observation is that intermediate layers of a pretrained pixel diffusion transformer can be decoded into coarse predictions that capture the main low-frequency structure, while the final layers progressively refine local, high-frequency details. We therefore attach a lightweight prediction head to an intermediate layer, keep the backbone frozen, and use the discrepancy between the intermediate and final predictions as a self-guidance direction during sampling. To train this head, we further find that real images are not necessary. Instead, model-generated samples suffice and even outperform real images for training the head, especially in enhancing the high-frequency components that pixel diffusion tends to underfit. Across multiple pixel diffusion models on ImageNet, our \textbf{Synthetic Self-Guidance (SSG)} consistently improves generation while adapter training requires less than 1$\%$ of full-model training compute: it reduces FID by over 50$\%$ across the evaluated JiT variants without classifier-free guidance (CFG) and further improves strong baselines with CFG, e.g., JiT-H/16 from 1.86 to 1.67 and PixelREPA-H/16 from 1.81 to 1.59. Our code is available at https://github.com/zfu006/SSG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文提出 Synthetic Self-Guidance (SSG)，利用冻结的预训练像素空间扩散模型在中间层与最终层预测之间的差异作为采样时的自引导方向，从而无需重新训练主干网络即可提升生成质量。作者发现用模型自生成样本训练轻量预测头即可，且效果优于真实图像，尤其在增强高频细节方面。在 ImageNet 的多个像素扩散模型上，SSG 显著降低 FID，且适配器训练计算量不到全模型训练的 1%。
Motivation: 像素空间扩散模型需在同一个高维空间中同时捕获全局结构与局部纹理，训练成本极高；现有改进（如新预测目标、训练目标和架构）通常需要从头训练新模型，代价昂贵。论文目标是寻找一种更便宜的互补策略，在不训练新模型的前提下提升已有预训练像素扩散模型的生成质量。
Method: 关键观察是预训练像素扩散 Transformer 的中间层可以解码出捕获低频主体结构的粗略预测，而最终层逐步细化高频细节。据此在中间层附加轻量预测头，保持主干冻结，并将中间层与最终层预测之间的差异作为采样时的自引导方向。预测头用模型自身生成的样本训练，无需真实图像。

papers.title: Curriculum Matters: Data-Efficient Relational PFN Pretraining with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: Relational Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as RDB-PFN approximate Bayesian inference over multi-table relational databases by pretraining on millions of synthetic tasks. We investigate three intertwined questions about this paradigm. First, can a structurally different synthetic generator PluRel substitute for RDB-PFN's prior? Second, how much does the order in which synthetic data is presented to the PFN affect downstream performance? Third, how much relational reasoning can a PFN acquire from single-table synthetic pretraining alone, before any relational data is introduced? Using PluRel as the sole synthetic data source across all experiments, we find: (i) a progressive single-table curriculum that gradually widens schema complexity from 7 to 17 columns reaches 0.703 average ROC-AUC on the 23-task tabular benchmark using only approximately 13,300 synthetic tables (approximately 45x fewer single-table datasets than RDB-PFN's reported warm-up recipe), while the same data trained all-at-once collapses to 0.541 ROC-AUC; (ii) a relational curriculum trained from scratch on only approximately 5,500 PluRel databases reaches 0.638 average ROC-AUC on the 19-task RelBench/4DBInfer benchmark, recovering 88% of RDB-PFN's reported performance with approximately 220x less relational synthetic data; and (iii) the single-table curriculum model, evaluated directly on the relational benchmark without any relational adaptation, achieves 0.631, nearly matching the dedicated relational pipeline. Together, these findings suggest that curriculum design and synthetic data diversity may matter more for relational PFN pretraining than the specific relational generator or raw synthetic scale alone.
papers.comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Very Large Databases (VLDB 2026), Tabular Data Analysis (TaDA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究关系型 Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) 的预训练范式，围绕三个相互关联的问题展开：结构不同的合成数据生成器 PluRel 能否替代 RDB-PFN 的先验、合成数据呈现顺序对下游性能的影响、以及仅用单表合成预训练能获得多少关系推理能力。实验表明，从 7 列逐步扩展到 17 列的渐进式单表课程 (curriculum) 仅用约 13,300 张合成表即可在 23 任务表格基准上达到 0.703 平均 ROC-AUC，而相同数据一次性训练则崩坏至 0.541；仅用约 5,500 个 PluRel 数据库的关系课程在 19 任务 RelBench/4DBInfer 基准上达到 0.638，以约 220 倍更少的数据恢复了 RDB-PFN 报告性能的 88%。
Motivation: 关系型 PFN 预训练通常依赖在数百万合成任务上的大规模训练，但学界对合成数据生成器的可替代性、数据呈现顺序的重要性以及单表预训练能带来的关系推理能力缺乏系统理解。
Method: 以 PluRel 作为唯一合成数据源开展实验：设计从 7 列逐渐加宽到 17 列的渐进式单表课程，并构建从零训练的关系课程；同时对比一次性 (all-at-once) 训练与课程式训练的效果。
Result: 渐进式单表课程在 23 任务表格基准上达到 0.703 平均 ROC-AUC，比 RDB-PFN 报告的热身方案少约 45 倍的单表数据；关系课程在 19 任务 RelBench/4DBInfer 上达到 0.638，恢复 RDB-PFN 报告性能的 88% 且仅用约 5,500 个数据库；单表课程模型未经关系适配直接在关系基准上得到 0.631，几乎追平专门的关系管线。
Conclusion: 作者强调，对于关系型 PFN 预训练，课程设计和合成数据多样性可能比特定的关系生成器或原始合成数据规模更重要。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Position Embedding of Graphs via Granular-Ball for Link Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Link prediction aims to identify potential or future connections within a given graph structure. Position information is essential for link prediction, as it distinguishes homogeneous nodes through their relative relationships, facilitating the accurate capture of structural patterns and implicit connections. Previous studies derive node positional information as distances to single-granularity landmarks, defined as the centers of homophilic regions, while neglecting the multi-granularity nature of homophilic structures and their hierarchical interrelations. We propose the Multi-Granularity Position Embedding of Graphs via Granular-Ball for Link Prediction (MGLP) method to obtain multi-granularity position embedding of graphs. Specifically, MGLP introduces an Adaptive Granular-Ball Graph Refinement mechanism to adaptively refine the graph into homophilic subdomains with optimal levels of granularity. The central nodes within subdomains are treated as landmarks, which form a Hierarchical Central Graph. Moreover, a novel Multi-granularity Hierarchical Distance encoding mechanism is proposed to capture both the homophilic structures within a graph and their hierarchical correlations, improving the discriminative power of nodes. Experimental results demonstrate that the multi-granularity position embedding generated by our method exhibits excellent performance and strong competitiveness compared to baseline algorithms for link prediction. Our codes are available in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MGLP-D3C5/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MGLP，一种基于粒度球 (granular-ball) 的多粒度位置嵌入方法，用于图链接预测。方法将图自适应细化为同质子域，以子域中心节点为地标构建层次中心图，并通过多粒度层次距离编码捕获同质结构与层次关联。摘要报告该方法在链接预测上相比基线算法表现出优秀且具竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有研究将节点位置信息建模为到单一粒度地标（同质区域中心）的距离，忽略了同质结构的多粒度特性及其层次关联，限制了结构模式与隐式连接的刻画能力。
Method: MGLP 提出自适应粒度球图细化 (Adaptive Granular-Ball Graph Refinement) 机制，将图自适应细化为具有最优粒度水平的同质子域；子域中心节点作为地标构成层次中心图 (Hierarchical Central Graph)，并用多粒度层次距离编码机制捕获同质结构与层次相关性。
Result: 摘要报告，在链接预测任务上与基线算法相比，该方法生成的多粒度位置嵌入表现出优秀性能与较强竞争力；摘要未给出具体数据集或数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为多粒度位置嵌入能够利用图的同质结构与层次关系提升节点区分度，从而改善链接预测表现；代码已在匿名链接公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DoubleHelix: Structured Cross-Modal Fusion for Audio-Visual Speech Recognition with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) relies on effective fusion of audio and visual modalities, yet existing approaches treat cross-modal interaction as a single-step operation without structured iterative refinement. We present DoubleHelix, a multimodal fusion framework that reformulates fusion as an iterative cross-modal interaction process with adaptive degradation-aware enhancement. The framework comprises three components including ReverseParallelHelix for multi-turn structured interaction with learned alignment constraints, QualitySensor for learning degradation-aware gating signals, and HelixReplication for consistency-guided conditional feature enhancement. Experiments on LRS3 demonstrate that DoubleHelix achieves 0.68% WER on clean audio, outperforming previous best results by 5.6% relative improvement under matched backbone settings. Comprehensive ablation studies validate each component contribution, including targeted analysis of design choices such as asymmetric pathway weighting. The framework shows improved robustness under evaluated babble-noise conditions, achieving 11.6% WER at SNR -5dB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DoubleHelix，一种面向音视频语音识别 (AVSR) 的结构化跨模态融合框架，将跨模态融合建模为带退化感知增强的迭代交互过程。框架包含 ReverseParallelHelix、QualitySensor 和 HelixReplication 三个组件，在 LRS3 上干净音频取得 0.68% 的 WER。
Motivation: 现有 AVSR 方法把跨模态交互当作单步操作，缺少结构化的迭代精炼，难以同时处理模态对齐和音频退化（如噪声）问题。
Method: 提出三组件框架：ReverseParallelHelix 利用多轮结构化交互与学习的对齐约束实现融合；QualitySensor 学习退化感知的门控信号；HelixReplication 进行一致性引导的条件特征增强。
Result: 在 LRS3 上干净音频达到 0.68% WER，在匹配骨干设置下相对此前最优结果提升 5.6%；消融实验验证了各组件贡献，并分析了非对称路径加权等设计选择；在评估的 babble 噪声条件下 SNR -5dB 时 WER 为 11.6%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调迭代结构化交互与退化感知增强相结合能提升 AVSR 的性能和鲁棒性，实验证据来自 LRS3 及特定 babble 噪声条件。

papers.title: Forwardrobe: Garment-Aware Gaussian Avatars from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing animatable 3D human avatars from a single image remains particularly challenging for loose garments, whose geometry and motion cannot be adequately represented by body-aligned topology and skinning. We present Forwardrobe, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing garment-aware Gaussian avatars from a single image. Forwardrobe explicitly separates clothing from the body in canonical Gaussian space and equips the garment layer with continuity-aware geometry and skinning initialization, pose-conditioned non-rigid deformation, and appearance adaptation. These designs improve garment reconstruction and visual quality during animation, particularly for skirts and dresses. The separated garment layer additionally forms an independently controllable 3D asset, enabling garment editing, transfer, and 3D virtual try-on. Experiments demonstrate improved garment reconstruction quality and greater flexibility in garment manipulation compared with existing single-image avatar reconstruction methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Forwardrobe，一个从单张图像重建衣着感知高斯虚拟形象（garment-aware Gaussian avatars）的前馈框架，专门针对宽松衣物难以用身体对齐拓扑与蒙皮表示的问题。该方法在规范高斯空间中将衣物与身体显式分离，并为衣物层引入连续感知的几何与蒙皮初始化、姿态条件非刚性形变及外观自适应，从而提升动画中的衣物重建质量，尤其对裙装有效。分离出的衣物层还可作为独立可控的三维资产，支持衣物编辑、迁移和三维虚拟试穿。
Motivation: 从单张图像重建可动画化的三维人体虚拟形象时，宽松衣物的几何与运动难以被身体对齐的拓扑和蒙皮（skinning）充分表达，导致重建和动画效果不佳。
Method: 在规范高斯空间中将衣物与身体显式分离，并为衣物层设计连续感知的几何与蒙皮初始化、姿态条件非刚性形变（pose-conditioned non-rigid deformation）以及外观自适应（appearance adaptation）。
Result: 实验表明，与现有单图虚拟形象重建方法相比，该方法提升了衣物的重建质量和动画视觉效果，特别是在裙子与连衣裙上，并带来衣物编辑、迁移与三维虚拟试穿等更灵活的操作能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调分离的衣物层可作为独立可控的三维资产，增强衣物操控灵活性；方法的收益主要面向宽松衣物的单图重建与动画场景。

papers.title: StraightDP: Geometry-Aware Differential Privacy for Rectified-Flow Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Differentially private (DP) training of text-conditioned generative models suffers a utility cliff at strong privacy. We revisit this problem through the geometry of rectified flows: along the straight interpolation between noise and data, the Bayes-optimal velocity is governed to leading order at the noise end by a few class-conditional moments, and increasingly sample-specific structure matters toward the data end. StraightDP exploits this heterogeneity end to end. A small budget share releases whitened class-conditional moments once, to be distilled into the weights or injected at sampling time. The rest is spent by pre-declared DP-SGD toward the data end, beyond the moments' reach. At $\varepsilon=1$ on MNIST, the released moments alone already attain $0.76$ downstream accuracy with prototype-like samples and an FID of $237$, and uniform DP-SGD attains $0.21$. The pipeline built on the release reaches $0.81$ accuracy at FID $56$ in a public latent space. Constraining per-token stream norms of the multimodal backbone leaves the pretraining loss unchanged yet improves downstream accuracy in the extreme-noise pixel-space regime, and its accuracy effect becomes monotonically more favorable as privacy strengthens. The released moments also port to frozen SD3-medium, where sampling-time injection beats DP-LoRA training at a fraction of the budget.

TL;DR: 本文针对文本条件生成模型在强隐私预算下差分隐私（DP）训练出现效用悬崖（utility cliff）的问题，从 rectified flow 的几何结构出发提出 StraightDP。其思路是沿噪声到数据的直线插值，在噪声端释放白化的类条件矩（class-conditional moments），在数据端用预声明的 DP-SGD 训练。摘要报告在 MNIST、ε=1 下，仅释放矩即可达到 0.76 的下游准确率和 FID 237，而统一 DP-SGD 为 0.21；完整流水线在公开隐空间达到 0.81 准确率和 FID 56。
Motivation: 带文本条件的生成模型在强隐私（strong privacy）下的差分隐私训练存在显著的效用悬崖，现有方法难以在保护隐私的同时保持生成和下游任务质量。
Method: 利用 rectified flow 的几何异质性：噪声端的最优速度主要由少量类条件矩决定，数据端则需要越来越具体的样本结构。StraightDP 先用较小的隐私预算份额一次性释放白化后的类条件矩，可蒸馏进权重或在采样时注入；剩余预算用于数据端的预声明 DP-SGD。此外，对多模态骨干网络的每 token 流范数施加约束，并探索将释放的矩迁移到冻结的 SD3-medium 上。
Result: 在 MNIST 且 ε=1 时，仅释放的矩即达到 0.76 的下游准确率（原型式样本，FID 237），统一 DP-SGD 为 0.21；构建的流水线在公开隐空间达到 0.81 准确率和 FID 56。约束每 token 流范数不改变预训练损失，但在极端噪声的像素空间提升下游准确率，且隐私越强该效果越有利；释放的矩迁移到冻结 SD3-medium 后，采样时注入能以更小预算优于 DP-LoRA 训练。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，沿 rectified flow 路径区分噪声端与数据端的隐私预算分配，并结合矩释放与注入，能够有效缓解强隐私下的效用悬崖。

papers.title: PiDDM: Physics-Informed Differentiable Degradation Modeling for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of lithium-ion battery state of health (SOH) is essential for reliable energy storage operation. However, purely data-driven models may generalize poorly across cycling protocols and produce physically implausible behavior during long-term extrapolation. We developed a physics-informed differentiable degradation modeling framework (PiDDM) for battery SOH prediction. PiDDM incorporates empirical Arrhenius degradation kinetics associated with solid electrolyte interphase growth and loss of lithium inventory into the training objective, encouraging physically consistent capacity fade under diverse operating conditions. The framework was evaluated using a public dataset of 55 batteries cycled under six operating protocols. PiDDM achieved the lowest average prediction error among the evaluated models and substantially reduced mean squared error relative to a multilayer perceptron and a baseline physics-informed neural network. For extrapolation, the models were trained on the first 90% of each battery's cycle life and evaluated on the unseen final 10%. PiDDM captured accelerated end-of-life degradation while avoiding the nonphysical capacity regeneration produced by the baseline models. These results show that incorporating degradation physics into neural network training improves predictive accuracy and physical consistency, providing a promising approach for practical battery health monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理信息可微分退化建模框架 (PiDDM)，用于锂离子电池健康状态 (SOH) 预测。PiDDM 将与固体电解质界面膜生长和锂库存损失相关的经验 Arrhenius 退化动力学纳入训练目标，促使模型在不同循环工况下产生物理一致的容量衰减。在包含 55 块电池、六种循环协议的数据集上，PiDDM 取得最低的平均预测误差，并在外推测试中避免了基线模型出现的非物理容量再生现象。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动模型在跨循环协议泛化时可能表现不佳，并在长期外推中产生物理上不合理的容量行为，因此需要将退化物理知识融入预测模型以提升准确性和物理一致性。
Method: PiDDM 将经验 Arrhenius 退化动力学（针对固体电解质界面膜生长和锂库存损失）嵌入神经网络训练目标，鼓励模型在多种工况下给出物理一致的容量衰减；模型在公开数据集的 55 块电池、六种循环协议上进行评估。
Result: 在评估的模型中，PiDDM 取得最低的平均预测误差，其均方误差相比多层感知机和基线物理信息神经网络有显著降低。在外推测试（训练前 90% 循环寿命、评估后 10%）中，PiDDM 捕捉到加速的寿命末期退化，同时避免了基线模型产生的非物理容量再生。
Conclusion: 在神经网络训练中融入退化物理能够同时提升预测精度和物理一致性，为实际电池健康监测提供了一种有前景的方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: metasignal: A Python Package for Comprehensive Metacognitive Analysis and Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Metasignal is an open-source Python package for signal detection theory (SDT) and metacognitive measurement. It implements the 17 metacognitive measures evaluated by Rahnev (2025), together with the reference variables d' (perceptual sensitivity), response criterion c (response bias), and mean confidence. The 17 measures comprise three meta-d' family estimates, meta-d', M-ratio, and M-difference; four nonparametric Type-2 measures, the Type-2 area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC2), Gamma, Phi, and delta confidence, together with their eight SDT-normalized ratio and difference forms; and two model-based measures, meta-noise and meta-uncertainty. A single function computes the complete set from trial-level stimulus, response, and confidence arrays. `metasignal` currently supports binary (two-alternative) discrimination tasks, in which each trial's stimulus and response are coded with exactly two categories. The package also provides a command-line interface, group summaries, bootstrap confidence intervals, permutation tests, optional hierarchical Bayesian models, and information-theoretic measures. `metasignal` unifies these measures in a single platform to encourage broader metacognition research and adoption in decision-making studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 metasignal，一个面向信号检测理论 (SDT) 与元认知测量的开源 Python 包，实现了 Rahnev (2025) 评估的 17 种元认知指标，包括 meta-d'、M-ratio、M-difference、非参数 Type-2 指标（AUC2、Gamma、Phi、delta confidence）及其 SDT 归一化比值/差值形式，以及 meta-noise 与 meta-uncertainty 两种基于模型的指标。单个函数即可从 trial 水平的刺激、反应和置信度数组计算完整指标集，并附带命令行界面、组汇总、bootstrap 置信区间、置换检验、可选层次贝叶斯模型和信息论度量。当前仅支持二元（两选一）辨别任务。
Motivation: 元认知测量领域存在多种彼此分散的指标，研究者难以在不同工具间进行比较和统一使用；metasignal 将 17 种指标整合到单一平台，旨在促进元认知研究及决策研究中的广泛采用。
Method: 抽象出统一计算流程：输入 trial 级刺激、反应与置信度数组，一次调用计算全部元认知指标；此外提供命令行接口、组级汇总、bootstrap 置信区间、置换检验、层次贝叶斯模型以及信息论度量。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准性能，主要内容为软件包的功能设计和可用范围，强调其覆盖了 17 种指标的完整集合。
Conclusion: metasignal 将多种元认知测量统一在一个开源工具中，但当前适用范围限于二元（两类别）辨别任务，这构成现阶段的主要边界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Is Missing in Surgical Risk Stratification and Outcome Prediction: A Scoping Review of End-to-End Machine Learning Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Postoperative adverse events, including mortality and morbidity, remain a major global burden, many of which are preventable through early identification of high-risk patients and targeted perioperative care. Accurate risk stratification is therefore essential. With the growing availability of large-scale electronic health records (EHRs), machine learning (ML) provides a data-driven approach to model complex clinical patterns. However, existing studies vary widely in design, and methodological practices remain fragmented. This scoping review characterizes ML pipelines for surgical risk stratification and outcome prediction using EHR data. We reviewed 190 studies covering the ML workflow, including data preprocessing, algorithm selection, model evaluation, and explainability. Most studies relied on single-center private datasets with limited data modalities, while the scarcity of open-access surgical datasets constrained reproducibility and generalizability. Reporting of key preprocessing steps, including missing data handling, feature selection, and class imbalance, was often incomplete. Conventional ML models and simple neural networks predominated, whereas deep learning and multimodal approaches remained uncommon. Benchmark datasets and standardized evaluation protocols were largely absent, hindering cross-study comparisons. Only about one-third of studies incorporated explainability methods. This review identifies methodological gaps limiting clinically robust postoperative ML tools and provides a structured reference to support more rigorous, reproducible, and clinically meaningful ML development for perioperative care.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE JBHI for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇范围综述 (scoping review)，系统梳理了190项基于电子健康档案 (EHR) 做手术风险分层与术后结局预测的机器学习研究，涵盖数据预处理、算法选择、模型评估和可解释性等流程环节。综述发现多数研究依赖单中心私有数据且数据模态有限，开放数据稀缺；关键预处理步骤报告不完整，传统机器学习与简单神经网络占主导，深度学习与多模态方法较少，且缺乏基准数据集与标准化评估协议。
Motivation: 术后不良事件（包括死亡率和并发症）是全球重大负担，许多可通过早期识别高风险患者和针对性围手术期护理来预防，因此准确的风险分层至关重要；但现有研究设计差异大、方法学实践碎片化，缺乏系统性梳理。
Method: 作者对190项研究进行范围综述，刻画EHR数据下手术风险分层与结局预测的端到端机器学习工作流，重点考察数据预处理、算法选择、模型评估与可解释性四个环节。
Result: 多数研究使用单中心私有数据，开放获取手术数据集稀缺，限制了可复现性与泛化性；缺失数据处理、特征选择和类别不平衡等预处理步骤的报告常不完整；约三分之一的研究采用了可解释性方法。
Conclusion: 综述识别出限制临床稳健术后机器学习工具的方法学缺口，并为围手术期护理中更严谨、可复现且具有临床意义的机器学习开发提供结构化参考。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Harnessing the Wisdom of LLM Crowds through Complementarity-Driven Iterative Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise settings, yet individual models remain bounded by model-specific capability limitations. These heterogeneous boundaries pose a deployment challenge, but also create an opportunity: strategically coordinating multiple LLMs may unlock collective intelligence exceeding any single model. Existing approaches fix how models are combined in advance, overlooking the dynamic, state-dependent role of complementarity in complex problem solving. Drawing on the wisdom-of-crowds paradigm, we reconceptualize collective LLM intelligence as relay-style complementarity: a sequential process in which each successor model is selected to address the specific bottleneck identified in its predecessor's output. To operationalize this, we propose WILC (Wisdom Integration of LLM Crowds), a framework grounded in two design principles. First, iterative reflection-and-refinement establishes a state-preserving workflow through which models diagnose and refine prior outputs. Second, complementarity-driven model selection governs transitions via a dual-gate mechanism: prospective complementarity fit (PCF) identifies the worker most suited to the current bottleneck, while posterior complementarity gain (PCG) evaluates whether the selected transition improves the evolving solution. Experiments across four diverse benchmarks show that WILC outperforms existing approaches, including single-model self-refinement, ensemble methods, and query-routing methods. Under standardized pricing assumptions, WILC matches the average benchmark performance of GPT-5.2 at roughly 7 times lower estimated per-query cost, while facilitating data sovereignty through self-hosted deployment. This study extends wisdom-of-crowds theory from static aggregation to sequential AI complementarity and provides transferable design principles for multi-AI coordination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WILC（Wisdom Integration of LLM Crowds）框架，把多个大语言模型（LLM）的集体智能重新理解为中继式互补（relay-style complementarity）：后继模型被选中去解决前驱模型输出中的特定瓶颈。框架包含两个设计原则：迭代反思与精炼（iterative reflection-and-refinement）的保状态工作流，以及由双重门控机制驱动的互补性模型选择——前瞻互补适配（PCF）挑选最适合当前瓶颈的 worker，后验互补增益（PCG）判断该转移是否确实改进演化中的解。实验在四个基准上显示 WILC 优于单模型自精炼、集成方法和查询路由方法。
Motivation: 单个 LLM 受模型特有能力的边界限制，而现有方法预先固定模型组合方式，忽视了复杂问题求解中动态、状态依赖的互补性，因此无法充分发挥多模型协作的集体智能。
Method: 提出 WILC 框架，通过迭代反思与精炼建立保状态的工作流，使模型诊断并改进先前输出；通过双重门控机制（PCF 选择最适配当前瓶颈的 worker，PCG 评估转移是否改善演化中的解）管理模型间的状态转移。
Result: 在四个多样基准上，WILC 优于现有方法（包括单模型自精炼、集成方法和查询路由方法）；在标准化定价假设下，以约 7 倍更低的估计单次查询成本达到 GPT-5.2 的平均基准性能，并支持通过自托管部署实现数据主权。
Conclusion: 该研究将智慧众包（wisdom-of-crowds）理论从静态聚合扩展到顺序式 AI 互补，并为多 AI 协调提供了可迁移的设计原则。

papers.title: MHRGait: Gait Recognition from Momentum Human Rig Pose
papers.abstract_en: Gait recognition is shaped by its input representation. Silhouettes encode projected body shape, skeletons encode sparse joint coordinates, and 3D meshes encode dense surface geometry. In each case, identity-bearing articulation is observed through geometric carriers that also vary with clothing, skeletal scale, or body shape. We investigate whether gait can instead be recognized from compact articulated controls. We introduce Momentum Human Rig (MHR) pose as a gait representation, describing each frame using 184 semantically organized body and hand parameters estimated from monocular video. MHRGait groups these heterogeneous controls by anatomy, models their intra-frame coordination and temporal evolution, and produces compact body and hand descriptors. We further introduce MHRGait++, which combines MHR pose with silhouettes through modality-balanced distance fusion, preventing descriptor count from determining modality importance. Experiments on four benchmarks show that MHRGait attains the best overall performance among compared model-based methods on CCPG and SUSTech1K and transfers effectively across datasets, while its recognition network requires only 2.76M parameters and 0.69 GFLOPs for a 30-frame input. MHRGait++ consistently improves silhouette recognizers with a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. These results establish rig-space articulation as an effective standalone gait representation and a complementary cue to projected body shape. Our code is available at https://github.com/duanhuiran/MHRGait.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Momentum Human Rig (MHR) pose 作为步态表示，用 184 个语义组织的身体与手部参数描述单目视频的每帧。MHRGait 按解剖部位分组建模这些控制的帧内协调与时间演化，生成紧凑描述子；MHRGait++ 通过模态平衡距离融合将 MHR pose 与剪影结合。实验表明 MHRGait 在 CCPG 和 SUSTech1K 上取得模型类方法中的最佳整体性能，识别网络仅需 2.76M 参数和 0.69 GFLOPs（30 帧输入），MHRGait++ 也稳定提升剪影识别器。
Motivation: 现有步态表示（剪影、骨架、3D 网格）都通过几何载体观察身份相关的关节运动，而这些载体同时受衣物、骨骼尺度或体型干扰；论文想验证是否可以直接从紧凑的关节控制参数中识别步态。
Method: 引入 MHR pose，从单目视频估计每帧 184 个按解剖部位组织的身体与手部参数；MHRGait 对这些异质控制参数按 anatomy 分组，建模帧内协调与时间演化并输出紧凑身体/手部描述子。MHRGait++ 采用模态平衡距离融合 (modality-balanced distance fusion) 组合 MHR pose 与剪影，避免描述子数量主导模态重要性。
Result: 在四个基准上，MHRGait 在模型类方法中于 CCPG 和 SUSTech1K 取得最佳整体性能，并展示跨数据集迁移能力；其识别网络仅需 2.76M 参数和 0.69 GFLOPs（30 帧输入）。MHRGait++ 以有利的精度-效率权衡持续提升剪影识别器。
Conclusion: 结果表明 rig-space articulation（骨架空间姿态参数）可成为有效的独立步态表示，并能作为投影体形的补充线索；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DASH-OPD: Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains student models on their own rollouts to reduce exposure bias. However, in multi-turn agent scenarios, early student errors can lead a trajectory away from the teacher's familiar domain. Existing curriculum learning methods regulate how much teacher support is used according to training progress, but cannot determine when it is needed. In light of this, we propose DASH-OPD, Discrepancy-Aware Switching with Hysteresis for OPD, a new agentic OPD method that can switch executors adaptively and bidirectionally. On each turn, DASH-OPD calculates a mean log-probability ratio between the two executors over action tokens as their discrepancy. Student-to-teacher ratios on student turns form drift signals, while teacher-to-student ratios on teacher turns form recovery signals. These signals are normalized and accumulated over multiple turns into drift and recovery evidence. DASH-OPD switches executors when the evidence exceeds its corresponding switching threshold. This multi turn accumulation makes the switching hysteretic, preventing high-frequency switches caused by transient fluctuations. On ALFWorld, DASH-OPD outperforms all the baselines and demonstrates superior training and deployment efficiency. This paper is a work in progress. Code, training logs, and model checkpoints will be released later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DASH-OPD，一种用于 on-policy distillation (OPD) 的自适应双向执行器切换方法。该方法在每个回合计算学生与教师执行器在动作 token 上的平均 log-probability 比值作为差异，并将学生回合和教师回合的比值分别累积为 drift 和 recovery 证据，当证据超过阈值时切换执行器。多回合累积使切换具有迟滞性，避免高频抖动。在 ALFWorld 上该方法优于所有基线，并展现出更好的训练与部署效率。
Motivation: 在多轮 agent 场景中，学生的早期错误可能使轨迹偏离教师熟悉的领域，而现有 curriculum learning 方法只能按训练进度调节教师支持的程度，无法判断何时真正需要教师支持。
Method: 在每个回合计算两个执行器在动作 token 上的平均 log-probability 比值作为差异；学生回合的学生到教师比值形成 drift 信号，教师回合的教师到学生比值形成 recovery 信号；将信号归一化并在多回合上累积为证据，当证据超过对应切换阈值时切换执行器，从而形成带迟滞的双向切换机制。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 基准上，DASH-OPD 超过所有基线方法，并展现出更优的训练和部署效率。
Conclusion: 摘要将该方法定位为一种可以自适应、双向切换执行器的 agentic OPD 方法，并注明本文为进行中的工作，代码、训练日志和模型检查点将在之后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Generalized-Bayes Perspective on Counterfactual Explanations: Posterior-Based Decision-Making and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual explanations (CEs) enhance the interpretability of machine learning models by identifying the smallest change to an input required to obtain a desired output. Although CEs are conventionally formulated as a distance-minimization problem, the theoretical basis of this formulation has received limited attention. We show that a distance-minimization-based CE is mathematically equivalent to the maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate of a Gibbs posterior within the generalized Bayes framework, specifically when a distance-based prior is used. We call this formulation the Distance-Prior Generalized Bayes CE (DP-GBCE). Building on this posterior perspective, we introduce two decision rules beyond MAP within a unified framework: a Bayes decision that minimizes expected decision loss and CVaR-CE, a risk-averse decision rule. We also propose an extension that uses Bayesian model weights to mix the posterior distributions of multiple models, thereby accounting for model multiplicity, where several models have comparable predictive performance. Finally, we define metrics for evaluating both individual CEs and the posterior distribution as a whole, and use experiments on simulated data and Google Trends data to quantify the trade-offs among the decision rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从广义贝叶斯 (generalized Bayes) 角度重新审视反事实解释 (counterfactual explanations, CEs)，证明基于距离最小化的 CE 等价于使用距离先验的 Gibbs 后验的最大后验 (MAP) 估计，并将其命名为 Distance-Prior Generalized Bayes CE (DP-GBCE)。在此基础上，作者提出统一框架下的两种额外决策规则：最小化期望决策损失的贝叶斯决策，以及风险规避的 CVaR-CE；还提出用贝叶斯模型权重混合多个模型的后验分布以处理模型多样性 (model multiplicity)。最后定义评估单个 CE 和后验分布整体的指标，并在模拟数据和 Google Trends 数据上量化不同决策规则之间的权衡。
Motivation: 反事实解释通常被形式化为距离最小化问题，但该形式化的理论基础很少被仔细研究；缺乏统一的概率视角来支持 CE 的生成、决策规则选择和评估。
Method: 将距离最小化 CE 重新解释为 Gibbs 后验的 MAP 估计，提出 DP-GBCE；并在此后验视角下引入贝叶斯决策规则和风险规避的 CVaR-CE 决策规则，同时用贝叶斯模型权重混合多模型后验以处理模型多样性，并定义了针对单个 CE 与整体后验分布的评估指标。
Result: 在模拟数据和 Google Trends 数据上的实验量化了不同决策规则之间的权衡，说明新的后验视角能够支持多种决策规则并评估其表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于广义贝叶斯后验的框架可以统一反事实解释的生成、决策规则与评估，并为模型多样性问题提供自然处理方式。

papers.title: Federated Foundation Models Fine-Tuning with Heterogeneous Compressed Clients
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning of foundation models faces a fundamental resource-asymmetry challenge: the institutions holding the most valuable domain-specific data cannot host billion-parameter models. Existing heterogeneous federated approaches attempt to bridge this gap through parameter-efficient tuning, model pruning, or knowledge distillation, yet each trades away a critical property, whether full-model memory reduction, architectural self-containedness, or representational fidelity, leaving the core tension unresolved. We propose FedSLM, a parameter-centric framework for federated fine-tuning with heterogeneous compressed clients. FedSLM uses SVD-based decomposition to produce self-contained client models, whose low-rank subspaces form nested manifolds that are structurally compatible for aggregation. It then applies a two-stage protocol that synchronizes lightweight adapters within compression groups and fuses full-rank reconstructions across groups via structural alignment. Finally, a weak-to-strong elicitation step with auxiliary confidence loss transfers the aggregated knowledge to the full-scale server, while an explicit bias--variance trade-off mitigates compression artifacts. We provide theoretical guarantees for adapter-level aggregation, subspace-alignment bounds for cross-group fusion, and a characterization of how the confidence loss mitigates weak-supervision noise. Experiments on natural language and vision--language benchmarks show that FedSLM outperforms existing federated baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions, while client models operate at roughly 50% of the GPU memory required by the full model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedSLM，一个面向异构压缩客户端的联邦 Foundation Model 微调框架，核心思路是参数中心化 (parameter-centric)。FedSLM 用 SVD 分解生成自包含的客户端模型，其低秩子空间构成嵌套流形以支持聚合，再通过两阶段协议在压缩组内同步轻量适配器、跨组用结构对齐融合全秩重建，最后用带辅助置信度损失的弱到强 (weak-to-strong) 引导把聚合知识迁移到全规模服务器。摘要给出适配器级聚合的理论保证、跨组融合的子空间对齐界以及置信度损失缓解弱监督噪声的刻画，并在 NLP 和视觉-语言基准上验证了其优于现有联邦基线。
Motivation: 联邦学习基础模型面临资源不对称：拥有最有价值领域数据的机构往往无法部署十亿参数模型。已有的异构联邦方案（参数高效微调、模型剪枝、知识蒸馏）各自牺牲了全模型内存缩减、架构自包含性或表征保真度，核心矛盾尚未解决。
Method: 提出 FedSLM 框架：采用 SVD 分解得到自包含客户端模型，使低秩子空间形成结构兼容的嵌套流形；设计两阶段协议，先在压缩组内同步轻量适配器，再通过结构对齐融合跨组的全秩重建；最后用带辅助置信度损失的弱到强引导把聚合知识迁移到全规模服务器，并引入显式的偏差-方差权衡来缓解压缩伪影。
Result: 摘要报告 FedSLM 在自然语言和视觉-语言基准上、IID 与非 IID 划分下均优于现有联邦基线，且客户端模型运行所需 GPU 内存约为全模型的 50%；理论上给出了适配器级聚合、子空间对齐界和置信度损失降噪的刻画。
Conclusion: FedSLM 通过参数中心化与分层聚合，在不牺牲模型内存缩减、架构自包含性和表征保真度的前提下解决了异构压缩客户端联邦微调问题，并提供相应的理论保证。

summary_sections.motivation: 联邦学习基础模型面临资源不对称：拥有最有价值领域数据的机构往往无法部署十亿参数模型。已有的异构联邦方案（参数高效微调、模型剪枝、知识蒸馏）各自牺牲了全模型内存缩减、架构自包含性或表征保真度，核心矛盾尚未解决。
summary_sections.method: 提出 FedSLM 框架：采用 SVD 分解得到自包含客户端模型，使低秩子空间形成结构兼容的嵌套流形；设计两阶段协议，先在压缩组内同步轻量适配器，再通过结构对齐融合跨组的全秩重建；最后用带辅助置信度损失的弱到强引导把聚合知识迁移到全规模服务器，并引入显式的偏差-方差权衡来缓解压缩伪影。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 FedSLM 在自然语言和视觉-语言基准上、IID 与非 IID 划分下均优于现有联邦基线，且客户端模型运行所需 GPU 内存约为全模型的 50%；理论上给出了适配器级聚合、子空间对齐界和置信度损失降噪的刻画。
summary_sections.conclusion: FedSLM 通过参数中心化与分层聚合，在不牺牲模型内存缩减、架构自包含性和表征保真度的前提下解决了异构压缩客户端联邦微调问题，并提供相应的理论保证。

papers.title: Semantics of Subterfuge: Benchmarking Legal Deception Detection Against General-domain State-of-the-Art
papers.abstract_en: Deception detection has critical implications for legal proceedings, law enforcement, and online security. Although human judgment is limited in accuracy and scalability, Natural Language Processing (NLP) offers a data-driven alternative. We present a survey and comparative analysis of NLP-based Automatic Deception Detection (ADD) focusing on the legal domain, reviewing the evolution from feature-based machine learning to Large Language Model (LLM) approaches. We conduct a unified empirical evaluation across seven datasets (two legal, five general-domain), comparing six fine-tuned transformer models and seven LLMs under four prompting strategies. The results show strong domain sensitivity, with fine-tuned models excelling in data-rich general domains and few-shot LLMs remaining competitive in low-resource legal settings. Chain-of-Thought prompting often underperforms direct classification. These findings highlight the need for domain adaptation and interpretable systems in high-stakes legal contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是针对法律领域自动欺骗检测（ADD）的综述与实证比较研究，回顾从基于特征的机器学习到大型语言模型（LLM）方法的演进，并在两个法律数据集和五个通用数据集上统一评估六种微调Transformer模型和七种LLM、四种提示策略。结果显示强领域敏感性：微调模型在数据丰富的通用领域占优，而少样本（few-shot）LLM在低资源法律场景中保持竞争力，且Chain-of-Thought提示常不如直接分类。作者以此强调高风险法律语境下领域适配与可解释系统的必要性。
Motivation: 欺骗检测对法律程序、执法和在线安全至关重要，但人类判断在准确性和可扩展性上受限，NLP提供了数据驱动的替代方案；作者希望系统梳理法律领域的NLP自动欺骗检测进展，并通过统一实验比较通用与法律领域的表现差距。
Method: 开展综述性调查并设计统一的实证评估：在七个数据集（两个法律、五个通用）上比较六种微调Transformer模型与七种LLM，LLM采用四种提示策略（包括Chain-of-Thought）。
Result: 结果显示强领域敏感性：微调模型在数据丰富的通用领域表现更好，少样本LLM在低资源法律环境中保持竞争力；Chain-of-Thought提示通常不如直接分类。
Conclusion: 摘要强调亟需针对法律领域的领域适配（domain adaptation）和可解释系统，以满足高利害法律场景的需求。

papers.title: Benchmarking Frontier Large Language Models Against Official Crash Database Coding Using Police Crash Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Police crash narratives contain information that may supplement structured crash databases, but manual review is labor-intensive and it remains unclear how well large language models (LLMs) reproduce official crash coding. This study benchmarked six frontier LLMs by comparing narrative-derived crash attribute codes with corresponding fields in the Arkansas fatal-crash database. The analysis linked 5,587 fatal-crash narratives with 5,889 structured crash records from Arkansas (2015-2025), yielding 4,194 matched crashes. Six LLMs were evaluated using an identical zero-shot prompt to code crash manner, non-motorist relation, intersection type, work-zone relation, roadway surface condition, and light condition. Performance was evaluated using agreement, macro-averaged F1 score, Cohen's kappa, coverage, selective agreement, and comparisons with always-majority, always-Unknown, and keyword-rule baselines. Repeated-measures analyses and a generalized estimating equations model assessed differences among models and attributes. GPT-5.5 High achieved the highest agreement among the evaluated LLMs, but the always-majority baseline produced higher raw agreement and the keyword-rule baseline achieved macro-averaged F1 score and Cohen's kappa comparable to the best-performing LLM. Agreement was highest for non-motorist relation and crash manner and lowest for light condition, roadway surface condition, and work-zone relation. Differences across crash attributes exceeded differences across models. These results provide a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based crash coding and show that deployment should be evaluated on an attribute-specific basis using transparent baselines and human review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对六个前沿大语言模型 (LLM) 进行基准测试，考察其能否从警方碰撞叙述 (police crash narratives) 中复现官方碰撞数据库的属性编码。作者将阿肯色州 2015-2025 年 5,587 条致命碰撞叙述与 5,889 条结构化记录关联，得到 4,194 条匹配碰撞，并用相同的零样本提示让六个 LLM 编码碰撞方式、非机动车当事人关系、交叉口类型、工作区关系、路面状况和光照条件六个属性。结果显示 GPT-5.5 High 在 LLM 中取得最高一致性，但 always-majority 基线的原始一致性更高，keyword-rule 基线的宏平均 F1 和 Cohen's kappa 与最优 LLM 相当，且属性间的差异大于模型间的差异。
Motivation: 警方碰撞叙述含有可补充结构化碰撞数据库的信息，但人工审核成本高，且 LLM 能否准确复现官方碰撞编码尚不明确；该研究旨在填补这一评估空白。
Method: 用统一的零样本提示让六个 LLM 对六类碰撞属性进行编码，并以官方阿肯色州致命碰撞数据库字段为基准，采用一致性、宏平均 F1、Cohen's kappa、覆盖率 (coverage)、选择性一致性 (selective agreement) 以及 always-majority、always-Unknown 和 keyword-rule 基线进行对比；使用重复测量分析和广义估计方程 (GEE) 模型检验模型与属性间的差异。
Result: GPT-5.5 High 在 LLM 中一致性最高，但 always-majority 基线获得了更高的原始一致性，keyword-rule 基线的宏平均 F1 和 Cohen's kappa 与最佳 LLM 相当；非机动车当事人关系和碰撞方式一致性最高，光照条件、路面状况和工作区关系一致性最低，且碰撞属性间的差异超过模型间的差异。
Conclusion: 该研究为基于 LLM 的碰撞编码提供了基准，并表明部署时应按属性逐一评估，配合透明基线和人工审核，而非整体信任单一模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Generalization of Steering Vectors for Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: Model capabilities have improved in large part due to scaling chain of thought. This has been a promising development for AI safety--where models verbalize their reasoning, it is possible to monitor it. However, in some cases, models do not verbalize important steps in their reasoning process. For example, models prompted with a cue suggesting the incorrect answer may fail to acknowledge that cue, even when it appears instrumental to their conclusion. When chain of thought (CoT) fails to disclose instrumental reasoning steps, we describe it as unfaithful. Prior work has shown that activation steering can be a useful method to improve faithfulness in CoT. We extend this line of work by studying how well steering for faithfulness generalizes across cue types, datasets, and methods of constructing the steering vector for three models (Gemma-3 4B, Qwen-3.5 9B, Gemma-3 12B) in a cued question-answering setting. While steering reliably increases cue acknowledgment for only the largest model (Gemma-3 12B), we find that when steering is effective, its effect generalizes broadly across cue types and datasets--in cross-cue and cross-dataset analyses, effect size is determined primarily by the evaluation setting, rather than the vector's train setting. How the vector is built also matters little--four construction methods, including one whose optimization target mentions no specific cue, yield similar effect sizes. Finally, we consider the possibility that steering promotes the salience of the cue and causes greater cue use, rather than targeting verbalization behaviors. However, we find no evidence for this--steering leaves the rate of cue use roughly unchanged while reducing hidden cue use, i.e., cue use that is not acknowledged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究激活转向（activation steering）能否提高链式思维（chain-of-thought, CoT）的忠实度，并在三个模型（Gemma-3 4B、Qwen-3.5 9B、Gemma-3 12B）上，针对提示问答（cued question-answering）场景，考察转向效果在跨线索类型、跨数据集以及不同转向向量构建方法下的泛化性。摘要发现转向仅在最大的模型上可靠地提升线索承认（cue acknowledgment），但当转向有效时，其效果能广泛泛化，效果大小主要由评估设置而非向量训练设置决定；四种构建方法效果相似，转向并未提高线索使用率，而是减少了未被承认的隐藏线索使用。
Motivation: 当模型被给予暗示错误答案的线索时，有时不会在推理中承认该线索，这种遗漏关键推理步骤的 CoT 被视为不忠实。先前工作表明激活转向可以改善 CoT 忠实度，但对其在不同线索类型、数据集和向量构建方法下的泛化性尚不清楚。
Method: 在提示问答设置中，使用三种模型和四种转向向量构建方法（包括一种优化目标不提及特定线索的方法），进行跨线索和跨数据集分析，评估转向对线索承认和线索使用行为的影响。
Result: 转向仅在最大的模型（Gemma-3 12B）上可靠地增加线索承认；当转向有效时，其效果在跨线索和跨数据集分析中广泛泛化，效果大小主要由评估设置决定，而非向量训练设置。四种构建方法产生相似的效果大小，且转向不改变线索使用率，同时降低隐藏线索使用。
Conclusion: 摘要认为转向向量提升 CoT 忠实度的效果主要依赖于评估设置，并在较大模型上更可靠；转向的作用并非增加线索使用，而是减少未被承认的隐藏线索使用，即它针对的是言语化行为而非线索显著性。

papers.title: Learning from Adversity: Semantic-Aware Mask Refinement through Adversarial Perturbation
papers.abstract_en: Despite significant advances in image segmentation, even state-of-the-art models produce masks with imperfect boundaries, semantic inconsistencies, and structural errors. Mask refinement addresses these limitations, yet current approaches rely on simplistic synthetic noise that fails to capture the complex error patterns of real segmentation models. We introduce Phoenix, a novel framework that leverages adversarial learning to generate semantically meaningful noise patterns and contrastive learning to model refinement relationships. Our approach consists of two key innovations: (1) Adversarial Mask Perturbation, which employs embedding attacks to create semantic-aware noise that mimics real segmentation errors, and (2) Contrastive Mask Refinement Learning, which establishes a tri-directional framework that ensures feature consistency within semantic regions while maintaining separation between classes. Experiments demonstrate that Phoenix significantly outperforms existing methods across diverse tasks, while consistently enhancing state-of-the-art segmentation models with substantial improvements. Our code and project page are publicly available at https://phoenix-eccv26.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Phoenix，一个用于图像分割掩码细化的框架，利用对抗学习生成语义相关的噪声模式，并结合对比学习建模细化关系。方法包含对抗掩码扰动 (Adversarial Mask Perturbation) 和对比掩码细化学习 (Contrastive Mask Refinement Learning) 两个关键组件，目的是修复分割模型输出中的边界不完美、语义不一致与结构错误。摘要报告该方法在多种任务上显著优于现有方法，并能持续提升已有最先进分割模型。
Motivation: 现有分割模型即使达到最先进水平，其掩码仍存在边界不完美、语义不一致和结构错误；已有的掩码细化方法依赖简单的合成噪声，无法刻画真实分割模型的复杂错误模式。
Method: 提出 Phoenix 框架，包含两项核心创新：一是对抗掩码扰动，通过嵌入攻击 (embedding attacks) 生成模拟真实分割错误的语义感知噪声；二是对比掩码细化学习，建立三方向 (tri-directional) 对比框架，在语义区域内保持特征一致性并维持类间分离。
Result: 实验表明 Phoenix 在多种任务上显著优于现有方法，并以实质性提升持续增强最先进的语义分割模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，以语义感知的对抗性噪声模拟真实分割错误、并结合对比学习进行掩码细化，是提升分割模型性能的有效途径；代码与项目页面已公开。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Phoenix 框架，包含两项核心创新：一是对抗掩码扰动，通过嵌入攻击 (embedding attacks) 生成模拟真实分割错误的语义感知噪声；二是对比掩码细化学习，建立三方向 (tri-directional) 对比框架，在语义区域内保持特征一致性并维持类间分离。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明 Phoenix 在多种任务上显著优于现有方法，并以实质性提升持续增强最先进的语义分割模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，以语义感知的对抗性噪声模拟真实分割错误、并结合对比学习进行掩码细化，是提升分割模型性能的有效途径；代码与项目页面已公开。

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded Constraint Checking in Construction Documents
papers.abstract_en: Professional-document review is a constraint-checking problem in which decisions depend on relations among text, geometry, pages, and document revisions. We present an evidence-grounded pipeline that normalizes extracted facts, executes four-state rules deterministically, retains source spans, and escalates unresolved cases. We evaluate its PDF evidence allocator on 160 reference-based tasks from 29 construction projects using a repeated four-system test and a disjoint two-system breadth extension. In the repeated test, reallocating a four-image budget from retrieved page overviews to one overview and three overlapping tiles improves project-family standardized decision accuracy by 10.6 percentage points (95% project-cluster bootstrap CI: 4.3 to 18.0; exact p = 0.031). This effect does not persist in the broader block: Region-RAG changes accuracy by -4.1 points (95% CI: -10.2 to 1.9; exact p = 0.209), while an equal-image sensitivity favors page breadth. Exact finding-set recovery remains low, false passes remain common, and repeated-run agreement is poorly calibrated. The results identify a resolution-breadth trade-off rather than a universal advantage for region-focused evidence, motivating rule-aware evidence routing and expert review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把建筑文档审查建模为约束检查问题，提出一个证据驱动（evidence-grounded）的流水线：规范化抽取事实、确定性执行四态规则、保留源文本片段并对未决案例升级。作者重点评估其 PDF 证据分配器在 29 个建筑项目、160 个基于参考的任务上的表现，发现将四图预算从检索到的页面概览改为一张概览加三张重叠瓦片可使项目族标准化决策准确率提升 10.6 个百分点，但更广的测试块中该效应不持续，呈现分辨率-广度权衡。
Motivation: 专业文档审查的决策依赖文本、几何、页面和修订版本之间的关系，现有方法缺乏证据锚定，导致过程不透明且难以升级处理。
Method: 提出证据驱动流水线，包含事实抽取与规范化、确定性四态规则执行、保留源跨度（source spans）以及未决案例的升级机制，并设计了 PDF 证据分配器来分配图像预算。
Result: 重复测试中，四图预算从检索页面概览改为一张概览加三张重叠瓦片，使项目族标准化决策准确率提升 10.6 个百分点（95% 项目簇 bootstrap CI 4.3–18.0，精确 p=0.031）；但在更广的两系统广度测试中 Region-RAG 改变为 -4.1 点（95% CI -10.2 至 1.9，p=0.209），等图像敏感性测试偏向页面广度。精确发现集恢复率仍低，漏报（false passes）常见，重复运行一致性校准不佳。
Conclusion: 结果显示区域聚焦证据并无普遍优势，而是存在分辨率与广度之间的权衡，作者由此主张规则感知的证据路由和专业评审介入。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Autonomous Repair for Multi-Agent Systems via Monte-Carlo Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) are increasingly deployed to solve complex tasks. In case of incorrect or unsatisfactory outputs, users have to manually locate agent mistakes by inspecting agent trajectories (i.e., {\em failure attribution}) and provide feedback to refine the outputs (i.e., {\em repair}). Despite some recent work in MAS failure attribution, automated mechanisms to recover from such mistakes remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose MARS, a search-based framework that formulates MAS repair as a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) process and navigates the vast space of potential repairs via diagnosis-guided expansion with taxonomy-augmented evaluation. Unlike standard MCTS, which evaluates a complete simulation via full rollout, MARS evaluates the agent trajectory using partial rollout to reduce token consumption. Furthermore, we introduce StateMAS, a large-scale MAS repair benchmark with 1,310 replayable multi-agent failure trajectories spanning four types of agent architectures and four LLM backbones. Experiments on StateMAS demonstrate that MARS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an absolute improvement from 3.0\% to 12.1\% across all settings, while maintaining a comparable token consumption cost. The ablation study further confirms that taxonomy-augmented evaluation and diagnosis-guided expansion are critical to achieving these performance gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARS，一个基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的多智能体系统（MAS）修复框架，将 MAS 修复建模为搜索过程，通过诊断引导的扩展（diagnosis-guided expansion）和分类学增强的评估（taxonomy-augmented evaluation）在潜在修复空间中导航。作者还构建了 StateMAS 基准，包含 1,310 条可重放的多智能体失败轨迹，覆盖四种智能体架构和四种 LLM 后端。实验显示 MARS 在所有设置上相对现有方法有 3.0% 到 12.1% 的绝对提升，同时保持相当 token 消耗。
Motivation: 现有工作主要集中在 MAS 失败归因，但自动化修复机制尚未被充分探索；用户仍需手动检查轨迹、定位错误并给出反馈，成本高昂。
Method: MARS 将 MAS 修复表述为 MCTS 过程，用诊断引导扩展来指引搜索方向，并用分类学增强评估来评价候选修复。与标准 MCTS 不同，MARS 采用部分 rollout（partial rollout）评估智能体轨迹，以降低 token 消耗。
Result: 在 StateMAS 基准上，MARS 一致优于最先进方法，绝对提升范围为 3.0% 到 12.1%，且 token 消耗与基线相当。消融实验确认分类学增强评估和诊断引导扩展对性能提升至关重要。
Conclusion: 作者认为搜索式修复框架 MARS 能有效实现 MAS 自动修复，并配合 StateMAS 基准为后续研究提供基础；摘要未讨论明显局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Who Wins Where? Conformal Model Comparison for Local Superiority
papers.abstract_en: Standard model comparison is global, aggregating losses across the covariate space to declare a single winner. This can obscure heterogeneous performance, where different models are preferable in different regions. We introduce conformalized local model comparison, a split-sample framework for constructing calibrated local best-model maps. Given a model comparison score, such as the difference between two squared losses, the method uses three disjoint splits to fit competing models, estimate local centers and scales from out-of-sample scores, and conformally calibrate residual uncertainty. At a target point, the procedure declares a local winner only when a one-sided conformal bound excludes a tie, with the score's sign determining the favored model. We prove finite-sample marginal control for one-sided erroneous declarations on the realized future comparison score, establish pointwise consistency of the localized mean-score estimator away from tie boundaries, show that aggregate comparison can disagree sharply with the prevalence of local superiority, and derive a squared-loss bias--variance decomposition that clarifies how model structure affects local wins. Synthetic and real-data experiments show that the method recovers heterogeneous winner regions, abstains under uncertainty, and yields higher conditional gain than global selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种共形化局部模型比较 (conformalized local model comparison) 的拆分样本框架，用于构造经校准的局部最优模型图 (calibrated local best-model maps)。给定模型比较分数，该方法用三个不相交划分分别拟合竞争模型、估计局部中心与尺度并做共形校准；在目标点仅当单侧共形界排除平局时才宣布局部胜者，由分数符号决定偏好模型。作者证明了一次侧错误声明的有限样本边际控制、局部均值分数估计在平局边界外的点态一致性，并指出全局聚合比较与局部优越性盛行度可能严重不一致。合成与真实数据实验表明该方法能恢复异质胜出区域、在不确定时弃权，并获得比全局选择更高的条件增益。
Motivation: 标准模型比较是全局的，在协变量空间上聚合损失并声明单一胜者，这会掩盖不同模型在不同区域各有优势的异质表现。本文针对这一缺口，引入具有校准保证的局部胜者识别框架。
Method: 采用三个不相交的数据划分 (three disjoint splits)：一个用于拟合竞争模型，一个用于从样本外比较分数中估计局部中心与尺度，一个用于共形校准 (conformal calibration) 残差不确定性。在目标点，仅当单侧共形界排除平局时才宣布局部赢家，比较分数的符号决定偏好哪个模型。
Result: 摘要报告该方法证明了一次侧错误声明的有限样本边际控制，建立了局部化均值分数估计在平局边界外的点态一致性，并推导了平方损失偏差-方差分解以解释模型结构如何影响局部获胜。合成与真实数据实验显示方法能恢复异质胜出区域、在不确定下弃权，并产生比全局选择更高的条件增益 (conditional gain)。
Conclusion: 作者强调全局聚合比较可能与局部优越性的普遍性严重冲突，而所提出的共形局部比较框架只在证据充分时声明局部赢家、在平局时弃权。摘要未给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Lookahead Lemmas for Neural Network Verification
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art neural network verifiers use the branch-and-bound procedure as their core solving mechanism. We introduce an inprocessing framework for neural network verification driven by the lookahead procedure. Under this framework, lookahead derives new lemmas over the phases of unstable ReLUs, which are collected into an implication graph that is used to prune the search space and vivify boolean cuts. We instantiate the framework in two state-of-the-art verifiers, Marabou and $α$-$β$-CROWN, and demonstrate that it improves performance in both, proving up to 34% more instances unsatisfiable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于神经网络验证的 inprocessing 框架，核心是 lookahead 过程，在 unstable ReLU 的相位上派生新引理，并收集到蕴含图 (implication graph) 中，用于剪枝搜索空间和活化布尔割 (vivify boolean cuts)。作者将该框架实例化到 Marabou 和 α-β-CROWN 两个最先进验证器中，摘要报告两者性能均有提升，最多可多证明 34% 的实例为不可满足 (unsatisfiable)。
Motivation: 现有最先进的神经网络验证器以分支定界 (branch-and-bound) 为核心求解机制，但搜索空间剪枝和割的质量仍有提升空间；本文试图通过 lookahead 派生的引理来增强该求解机制。
Method: 提出由 lookahead 过程驱动的 inprocessing 框架：对不稳定 ReLU 的相位做前瞻推理以派生新引理，将这些引理收集为蕴含图，并利用蕴含图剪枝搜索空间、活化布尔割；在 Marabou 和 α-β-CROWN 两个验证器中完成实例化。
Result: 摘要报告在 Marabou 和 α-β-CROWN 两个最先进验证器上均改进性能，证明的不可满足实例数最多增加 34%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 lookahead 派生的引理和蕴含图驱动的 inprocessing 技术能有效提升神经网络验证器的分支定界求解效率；论文未提及其在具体数据集上的局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Spiking Point Cloud Models
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer energy-efficient solutions for point cloud analysis on resource-constrained devices through event-driven computation. However, existing pre-trained spiking point cloud models rely on full fine-tuning for downstream task adaptation, incurring substantial parameter and storage overhead. Furthermore, binary spike propagation suppresses task-relevant sub-threshold information. To address these issues, we propose SpikePEFT, the first parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework for spiking point cloud models. Specifically, Intrinsic Dynamics Tuning (IDT) adaptively modulates membrane decay and firing thresholds, enabling efficient neuron-intrinsic adaptation while keeping the pre-trained synaptic transformations frozen. Moreover, Silent-State Disambiguation Adaptation (SSDA) recovers task-relevant information from informative silent states, thereby providing richer evidence for downstream adaptation. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of SpikePEFT. In particular, our method achieves 92.4% accuracy on ModelNet40 and 85.6\% on the most challenging classification split ScanObjectNN(PB\_T50\_RS) while updating only about 5% of the trainable parameters and preserving the energy efficiency of SNNs. This work provides a promising step toward parameter-efficient adaptation of neuromorphic vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpikePEFT，据称是首个面向脉冲点云模型的参数高效微调框架，目标是在资源受限设备上降低下游任务适配的参数与存储开销。方法包括 Intrinsic Dynamics Tuning (IDT) 和 Silent-State Disambiguation Adaptation (SSDA)，在 ModelNet40 上达到 92.4% 准确率，在 ScanObjectNN(PB_T50_RS) 上达到 85.6%，仅更新约 5% 的可训练参数并保持 SNN 的能效。
Motivation: 现有预训练脉冲点云模型依赖全量微调来适配下游任务，造成大量参数和存储开销；此外，二值脉冲传播会抑制与任务相关的阈下信息，影响适配效果。
Method: 提出 SpikePEFT 框架，包含两个组件：IDT 通过自适应调节膜衰减和发放阈值实现神经元内在动力学的微调，同时冻结预训练突触变换；SSDA 从信息性静默状态中恢复任务相关信息，为下游适配提供更丰富的证据。
Result: 多个基准实验表明 SpikePEFT 有效且高效：在 ModelNet40 上取得 92.4% 准确率，在最难的分类划分 ScanObjectNN(PB_T50_RS) 上取得 85.6%，仅更新约 5% 的可训练参数，并保持 SNN 的能效优势。
Conclusion: 该工作为神经形态视觉模型的参数高效适配迈出一步，摘要未明确讨论方法在其他模态或更大模型上的局限。

papers.title: Adaptive Emotional Video Captioning via Affective Heterogeneous Graph Reasoning and Multi-task Joint Learning
papers.abstract_en: Emotional video captioning (EVC) aims to describe a video with both factual correctness and affective expressiveness. It requires a model to perceive subtle, ambiguous, and temporally varying emotional cues and translate them into natural language without weakening objective visual content. Existing methods have progressively introduced contextual attention, emotion interpretation, emotion priors, dynamic emotion perception and emotion-cause reasoning. Nevertheless, most of them still depend on either global emotion vectors or rigid hierarchical priors. In recent methods, the tree-structured emotion prior establishes a coarse-to-fine connection between psychological emotion categories and daily emotion words, but its hard subordinate masking may irreversibly suppress correct lexical emotions once the coarse category prediction is inaccurate. It is also limited in representing mixed or overlapping emotions that frequently occur in real videos. To address the issues, we propose SAGML, an adaptive EVC framework via affective heterogeneous graph and multi-task language modeling. Instead of treating the emotion prior as a discrete tree, SAGML constructs a soft affective heterogeneous graph containing catalog-level emotion nodes and lexical-level emotion word nodes. The soft gate is injected into video-to-emotion graph attention as a continuous bias, allowing visually supported lexical emotions to remain recoverable rather than being removed by a hard mask. The resulting affective representation is fed together with visual tokens into a causal language decoder, while dual catalog and lexical heads impose explicit emotion distribution learning on the prompt hidden states. The overall model is trained with a joint objective that combines autoregressive caption generation and emotion distribution supervision. SAGML provides an error-resilient and multi-emotion-aware baseline for EVC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGML，一个用于情感视频描述（emotional video captioning, EVC）的自适应框架，基于情感异质图（affective heterogeneous graph）与多任务语言建模。与把情感先验当作离散树的方法不同，SAGML 构建包含目录级情感节点和词汇级情感词节点的软图，并用软门控（soft gate）作为视频到情感图注意力中的连续偏置，使视觉支撑的词汇情感可恢复。整体以自回归字幕生成和情感分布监督的联合目标训练，作者称其为错误鲁棒且多情感感知的 EVC 基线。
Motivation: 现有 EVC 方法多依赖全局情感向量或刚性层级先验；树状情感先验的硬式下属掩码在粗粒度情感预测不准时会不可逆地抑制正确的词汇级情感，且难以表示真实视频中常见的混合或重叠情感。
Method: 提出 SAGML：构造包含目录级情感节点与词汇级情感词节点的软情感异质图；在视频到情感图注意力中注入软门控作为连续偏置，替代硬掩码。情感表示与视觉 token 一起送入因果语言解码器，并设双头（catalog 头与 lexical 头）对 prompt 隐状态施加显式情感分布学习；整体用字幕生成与情感分布监督的联合目标训练。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果；方法层面声称该框架具有错误鲁棒性并能感知混合或重叠情感。
Conclusion: 作者将 SAGML 定位为 EVC 的错误鲁棒且多情感感知基线；摘要未讨论局限性或更广泛的适用范围。

papers.title: Improving scDiffusion with Sparsity-Biased Classifier-Free Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has become an essential tool in modern cellular biology, and generating accurate synthetic scRNA-seq data is becoming increasingly important. Although diffusion models have achieved promising results in conditional scRNA-seq generation, existing guidance strategies, including classifier guidance and classifier-free guidance (CFG), rely on an unconditional branch trained to approximate the true marginal distribution, which may retain substantial gene-specific structure and limit guidance effectiveness. Inspired by recent work showing that diffusion models can be effectively guided using intentionally degraded references, we propose a sparsity-biased classifier-free guidance (SB-CFG) strategy for scRNA-seq generation. Rather than approximating the assumed "neutral" marginal distribution, SB-CFG introduces a deliberately under-informative sparse reference for the unconditional branch, removing gene identity while preserving only coarse sparsity statistics. This "bad" reference amplifies the contrast between conditional and unconditional predictions, leading to stronger and more effective guidance during sampling. We evaluated SB-CFG as a training-free sampling modification on five publicly available scRNA-seq datasets. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over standard CFG-based sampling in terms of marker gene expression fidelity, cell-type consistency, and sparsity preservation, indicating that SB-CFG better captures biologically meaningful gene expression patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）条件生成中现有引导策略的局限，提出一种稀疏偏置的无分类器引导（SB-CFG，sparsity-biased classifier-free guidance）策略。不同于用无条件分支近似所谓中性边际分布，SB-CFG 刻意引入信息量稀少的稀疏参考，去除基因身份而只保留粗略稀疏统计，从而放大条件与无条件预测之间的对比。作为一种免训练（training-free）采样修改，该方法在五个公开 scRNA-seq 数据集上相对标准 CFG 采样带来一致改进。
Motivation: 扩散模型在条件 scRNA-seq 生成上已有不错表现，但现有 classifier guidance 与 classifier-free guidance（CFG）依赖一个近似真实边际分布的无条件分支，该分支可能保留大量基因特异结构，从而限制引导的有效性；而高质量合成 scRNA-seq 数据在细胞生物学中日益重要。
Method: 提出 SB-CFG：不要求无条件分支近似假定的中性边际分布，而是使用刻意欠信息（under-informative）的稀疏参考，移除基因身份并仅保留粗糙的稀疏统计。该“坏”参考可增强条件与无条件预测之间的对比，在采样时提供更强、更有效的引导，且作为免训练修改直接应用于已有模型。
Result: 在五个公开 scRNA-seq 数据集上的实验显示，相比基于标准 CFG 的采样，SB-CFG 在标记基因表达保真度、细胞类型一致性和稀疏性保持方面均取得一致改进。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 SB-CFG 能更好地捕获具有生物学意义的基因表达模式；该方法以免训练采样修改的形式呈现，并被 IEEE EMBC 2026 接收。

papers.title: Rethinking Detection Calibration: A Coordinate and Direction Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning based object detectors require trustworthiness beyond competitive detection performance, but deep neural networks are prone to overconfident predictions, assigning high confidence scores to predictions that are likely to be inaccurate. To improve the alignment between confidence scores and prediction accuracy, existing methods calibrate confidence scores based on box-level localization, such as precision or intersection over union with the ground truth bounding box. However, box-level localization reflects only a measure of agreement between the predicted box and the ground truth, resulting in calibrated confidence scores for box-level accuracy failing to capture the localization accuracy of coordinates of box. To tackle this issue, we propose a novel post-hoc calibration framework, rethinking detection calibration (ReDC), which provides reliable coordinate-level confidence scores, including directional information. The proposed framework defines coordinate-wise alignment and deviation direction between predictions and ground truth. Based on the alignment measure, confidence re-encoding produces reliable coordinate-level confidence scores, while directional displacement estimation predicts coordinate-wise deviation directions. Extensive experiments under in-domain and out-domain scenarios demonstrate that the proposed approach expresses the coordinate-wise localization of detected objects more precisely than existing methods. Furthermore, our method covers the representational scope of prior calibration approaches by aggregating coordinate-level confidence scores into box-level localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对目标检测中置信度校准仅基于框级定位（如precision或IoU）而忽略坐标级定位精度的问题，提出后处理的检测校准框架ReDC。该方法定义预测与真值之间的坐标级对齐与偏差方向，通过置信度重编码给出坐标级置信度，并用方向位移估计预测坐标偏差方向。实验表明该方法在域内与域外场景下能比现有方法更精细地表达检测目标的坐标级定位。
Motivation: 现有检测校准只对齐置信度与框级精度（如IoU），但框级度量仅反映预测框与真值框的重合程度，无法刻画单个坐标的定位精度，导致框级校准后的置信度不足以表达坐标级不确定性。
Method: 提出ReDC框架：先定义预测与真值之间的坐标级对齐度量（coordinate-wise alignment）和偏差方向（deviation direction），再基于该对齐度量进行置信度重编码以生成坐标级置信度，同时通过方向位移估计预测各坐标的偏差方向；此外将坐标级置信度聚合为框级置信度以覆盖现有方法的表示范围。
Result: 摘要报告在域内（in-domain）和域外（out-domain）场景下的实验表明，所提方法能比现有方法更精确地表达检测目标的坐标级定位；并且通过聚合坐标级置信度到框级，能够涵盖先前校准方法的表示范围。
Conclusion: 作者认为坐标级校准（含方向信息）能弥补框级校准的不足，且聚合后的方法可以作为更通用的校准框架。摘要未提及具体数值或基准。
