papers.title: ReMoE: Report-Guided Mixture-of-Experts for Multimodal OCT/OCTA Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal medical anomaly detection identifies samples deviating from normal patterns, where scarce abnormal cases make normality modeling from normal data practical. In retinal Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) and OCT Angiography (OCTA) anomaly detection, existing unsupervised methods rely on visual feature distributions, reconstruction residuals, or encoder-decoder discrepancies, making anomaly scores depend on appearance-level deviations, while multimodal normality also contains semantic organization described in normal medical reports. To this end, we propose Report-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (ReMoE), which distills normal report semantics into an image-to-text prior student, builds modality-aware priors, and uses Report-Guided Modality Modulation (RMM) to modulate features through mixture-of-experts routing. Experiments on a private OCT/OCTA dataset with paired normal reports and a public OCTA500-3MM setting using a fixed normal report demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出报告引导的混合专家模型 ReMoE，用于多模态眼科 OCT/OCTA 异常检测。其核心思路是将正常医学报告中的语义知识蒸馏到图像到文本的先验学生模型中，并构建模态感知先验，通过报告引导的模态调制（RMM）以混合专家路由方式调制特征。在配对的私有 OCT/OCTA 数据集和固定正常报告的公开 OCTA500-3MM 设置上取得了最优性能。
Motivation: 现有无监督多模态 OCT/OCTA 异常检测方法依赖视觉特征分布、重建残差或编码器-解码器差异，异常分数主要基于外观层面的偏差，而忽略了正常多模态数据中由正常医学报告所描述的语义组织结构。
Method: 提出 Report-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (ReMoE)：将正常报告语义蒸馏进图像到文本的先验学生模型，构建模态感知先验，并使用报告引导的模态调制（RMM）通过混合专家路由对特征进行调制。
Result: 在含配对正常报告的私有 OCT/OCTA 数据集以及使用固定正常报告的公开 OCTA500-3MM 设定上，实验达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将正常报告语义引入多模态异常检测可弥补外观层面偏差的不足，ReMoE 在医学影像异常检测场景下有效。

papers.title: DFSC: Error-Controlled Differentiable Mittag-Leffler Propagation for Fractional Scientific Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Fractional scientific machine learning requires numerical operators that can be differentiated, batched, accelerated, and composed with neural networks. When the dominant linear fractional evolution is known through a Mittag-Leffler propagator, repeatedly reconstructing that response with a history solver or relearning it from data is unnecessary. We present DFSC, a PyTorch environment organized around the Mittag-Leffler Spectral Layer (MLSL). The layer separates known fractional propagation from data-driven corrections, so neural modules learn only unresolved dynamics while fractional orders and residual-network parameters are optimized jointly. Its adaptive algorithm increases special-function truncation depth or Lanczos dimension until successive differentiable evaluations satisfy a requested tolerance. In the negative-real alternating-series regime, DFSC additionally returns a certified first-omitted-term bound; outside that regime it explicitly labels estimates as empirical. DFSC supports dense, sparse, matrix-free, self-adjoint, generalized, and controlled complex operator paths; trainable fractional orders; direct inverse problems; residual neural composition; and CPU/GPU execution. The certified series bound covers all 59 eligible reference cases, with median bound/error effectivity 1.246 for resolved errors. Reusing a prepared batched Lanczos basis gives identical fixed-path values and reduces repeated-query time by 4.61--7.11 times on CPU and 13.07--16.22 times on an RTX 5070, excluding one-time preparation. A 27-case inverse matrix finds full-rank local curvature throughout, while remaining explicitly model-conditional. External solver and mixed real-data results support DFSC as an error-aware optional primitive for matched fractional structure, rather than a general replacement for fractional solvers or neural models.

TL;DR: 本文提出 DFSC，一个围绕 Mittag-Leffler 谱层 (MLSL) 组织的 PyTorch 环境，用于分数阶科学机器学习。该层将已知的分数阶传播与数据驱动修正分离，使神经网络模块只学习未解析动力学，并联合优化分数阶阶数与残差网络参数。自适应算法增加特殊函数截断深度或 Lanczos 维度直到满足容差；在负实交替级数区域返回认证的省略项界，其他区域显式标记为经验估计。
Motivation: 分数阶科学机器学习需要可微分、可批处理、可加速且能与神经网络组合的数值算子；当主导线性分数阶演化已由 Mittag-Leffler 传播子给出时，反复用历史求解器重构或从数据重新学习该响应是不必要的。
Method: 提出 DFSC 环境，围绕 Mittag-Leffler 谱层 (MLSL) 组织：分离已知传播与数据驱动修正，联合优化分数阶阶数与残差网络参数；自适应算法调节特殊函数截断深度或 Lanczos 维度直到满足容差，并在负实交替级数区返回认证的首项省略界，否则将估计标记为经验性。
Result: 认证级数界覆盖全部 59 个合格参考算例，对于已求解误差的中位 effectivity 为 1.246；复用预备的批处理 Lanczos 基可得到相同固定路径值，并将在 CPU 上重复查询时间降低 4.61–7.11 倍，在 RTX 5070 上降低 13.07–16.22 倍（不含一次性准备）。27 个算例的逆矩阵显示全秩局部曲率，但保持显式模型条件性。

papers.title: GO-PRE: Goal-Oriented Next-Best-View Selection via Predictive Rendering Entropy for Active 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Active 3D reconstruction relies on active view selection to maximize reconstruction fidelity under limited capture budgets. However, most existing methods rely on surrogate signals such as parameter uncertainty or geometric heuristics, but these signals are often misaligned with the ultimate goal: the fidelity of rendered predictions. We propose GO-PRE, a goal-oriented next-best-view selection framework that explicitly targets information gain in the prediction space. Specifically, we formulate the objective as maximizing the reduction of the average marginal predictive entropy over a user-specified target view manifold. GO-PRE supports interactive goal specification and yields an efficient acquisition rule that enables real-time computation of information gain. Extensive experiments across benchmarks demonstrate that GO-PRE consistently improves active reconstruction performance and provides more reliable uncertainty quantification compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GO-PRE，一个面向主动 3D 重建的目标导向 next-best-view 选择框架，直接在预测空间中显式优化信息增益，即最大化用户指定目标视角流形上平均边际预测熵的减少。框架支持交互式目标指定，并推导出高效获取规则以支持实时计算。实验表明，相比现有方法，GO-PRE 在多个基准上持续提升主动重建性能，并提供更可靠的不确定性量化。
Motivation: 现有主动视图选择方法多依赖参数不确定性或几何启发式等代理信号，但这些信号与最终目标——渲染预测的保真度——往往不一致。
Method: 将 next-best-view 选择目标形式化为最大化目标视角流形上的平均边际预测熵减少量；支持交互式目标指定，并设计高效获取规则，使信息增益可实时计算。
Result: 摘要报告在多个基准上，GO-PRE 相比 state-of-the-art 方法持续提升主动重建性能，并提供更可靠的不确定性量化，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要认为直接在预测空间中度量信息增益、以目标为导向进行视角选择，能够替代代理信号，从而改善主动 3D 重建效果与不确定性估计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Dynamics-aware identification of governing equations from sparse and noisy data
papers.abstract_en: Sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) and PDE functional identification (PDE-FIND) recover parsimonious ordinary and partial differential equations (ODEs and PDEs) from data. However, sparse and noisy temporal measurements can make derivative estimates unreliable. To address this problem, we evaluate Koopman-based upsampling techniques implemented with dynamic mode decomposition (DMD), extended DMD (EDMD), and optimized DMD. These methods learn finite-dimensional approximations of Koopman evolution on selected observables and are used to interpolate and denoise snapshots inside the observed time window before derivative estimation and sparse regression. The empirical benchmark comprises two ODE systems, Lorenz-63 and Van der Pol, and three periodic PDE systems, Burgers, Fisher-Kolmogorov-Petrovskii-Piskunov (Fisher-KPP), and linear advection-diffusion, over sparse and noisy sampling regimes. Polynomial EDMD gives the strongest ODE results, especially in coefficient accuracy. The PDE results are system-dependent: low-rank DMD-assisted reconstructions improve Burgers and advection-diffusion discovery, while the raw baseline (without upsampling) remains competitive for the Fisher-KPP data. A comparison against linear and smoothing-spline interpolation techniques shows that the selected Koopman-based preprocessors provide overall performance gains over these non-dynamical alternatives. We also demonstrate that DMD-assisted upsampling can stabilize Pareto-based non-oracle support-size selection. Overall, Koopman-based upsampling is best viewed as a dynamics-aware preprocessing step that can reduce derivative-estimation error when its observable representation and low-rank structure are appropriate for the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 SINDy 与 PDE-FIND 在稀疏、含噪时间测量下导数估计不可靠的问题，评估了基于 Koopman 的上采样技术：用 DMD、EDMD 和 optimized DMD 学习选定可观测量上的有限维 Koopman 演化，在导数估计与稀疏回归前对观测窗口内的快照进行插值和去噪。基准涵盖 Lorenz-63、Van der Pol 两个 ODE 系统以及 Burgers、Fisher-KPP、线性对流扩散三个周期 PDE 系统，并考察稀疏与含噪采样场景。结果表明多项式 EDMD 在 ODE 上系数精度最强；PDE 结果依赖系统，低秩 DMD 辅助重建利于 Burgers 和对流扩散发现，而 Fisher-KPP 上原始基线仍有竞争力。
Motivation: 稀疏、含噪的时间测量会使 SINDy/PDE-FIND 所需的导数估计不可靠，进而影响控制方程识别的准确性与稀疏回归的稳定性。
Method: 作者采用 Koopman-based 上采样作为动力学感知的预处理步骤，比较 DMD、EDMD 与 optimized DMD 实现的插值和去噪效果，并用其输出作为后续导数估计和稀疏回归的输入；同时与线性插值和平滑样条插值等非动力学方法对比，并测试 DMD 辅助上采样对 Pareto 式非 oracle 支撑集大小选择的影响。
Result: 实验中多项式 EDMD 在 ODE 系统上给出最强的系数精度；PDE 结果因系统而异，低秩 DMD 辅助重建改善 Burgers 与线性对流扩散的发现，而 Fisher-KPP 数据上未上采样的原始基线仍具竞争力。Koopman-based 预处理总体上优于线性插值与平滑样条插值，并能在 Pareto 式支撑集选择中带来稳定化收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，Koopman-based 上采样应视为一种动力学感知的预处理手段，只有在可观测量表示和低秩结构适合数据时，才能有效降低导数估计误差。

papers.title: SAM+D: Parameter-Efficient Dimensional Lifting of SAM-Family Models via Depth-Routed LoRA and Depth Shifting
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for adapting 2D foundation models such as SAM to 3D volumes either process slices independently---ignoring inter-slice context---or require substantial architectural changes and retraining. In this paper, we present \textbf{SAM+D}, a parameter-efficient framework that lifts SAM-family models by one spatial dimension---enabling 3D volumetric segmentation from 2D SAM and, for the first time via parameter-efficient fine-tuning, end-to-end 4D (3D+T) spatiotemporal segmentation from video-based SAM2---while keeping the vast majority of pre-trained parameters frozen. SAM+D introduces two lightweight, model-agnostic modules into frozen transformer blocks: (1)~\textbf{Depth-Routed LoRA (DRLoRA)} experts with learned routing for spatially adaptive low-rank updates, and (2)~\textbf{Depth Shift Modules (DSM)} for cross-slice feature exchange at zero additional parameter cost. Together, they provide volume-level context while tuning only ${\sim}$2.8\% of parameters for SAM and ${\sim}$3.7\% for SAM2. We evaluate SAM+D in two distinct settings, each lifting the base model by one spatial dimension: 3D segmentation, where SAM(2D$\,\to\,$3D) is evaluated on four CT benchmarks (KiTS, Pancreas, LiTS, Colon), and 4D segmentation, where SAM2 (2D+T$\,\to\,$3D+T) is evaluated on a cell tracking challenge (CTC) dataset (Fluo-N3DH-SIM+). In both settings SAM+D achieves competitive or superior results under the single-point prompt setting while using fewer trainable parameters than existing methods, demonstrating that SAM+D generalizes across SAM-family architectures, target dimensionalities (3D, 4D), and domains spanning medical imaging and bio-scene understanding. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/JerrySongCST/SAM-Plus-D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAM+D，一种参数高效的维度提升框架，将 SAM 系列模型从 2D 提升到 3D（以及从 2D+T 提升到 3D+T），在冻结绝大多数预训练参数的前提下实现 3D 体分割和 4D 时空分割。方法是在冻结的 Transformer 块中插入两类轻量模块：带学习路由的 Depth-Routed LoRA (DRLoRA) 专家和零参数成本的 Depth Shift Modules (DSM)，对 SAM 仅微调约 2.8% 参数、对 SAM2 约 3.7% 参数。在四个 CT 基准（KiTS、Pancreas、LiTS、Colon）和细胞追踪挑战数据集（Fluo-N3DH-SIM+）的单点提示 (single-point prompt) 设置下取得有竞争力或更优的结果。
Motivation: 现有将 SAM 等 2D 基础模型适配到 3D 体积的方法要么逐切片独立处理而忽略切片间上下文，要么需要大量架构改动和重新训练。作者希望以参数高效方式为 2D 模型增加一个空间维度，同时保留绝大多数预训练参数。
Method: SAM+D 在冻结的 Transformer 块中引入两个模型无关的轻量模块：DRLoRA 专家通过学习路由实现空间自适应的低秩更新，DSM 以零额外参数代价完成跨切片特征交换。二者共同提供体积级上下文，使 SAM 仅调优约 2.8%、SAM2 约 3.7% 的参数。
Result: 在 3D 分割（SAM 从 2D 提升到 3D）的四个 CT 基准和 4D 分割（SAM2 从 2D+T 提升到 3D+T）的细胞追踪数据集上，SAM+D 在单点提示设置下取得与现有方法相当或更优的结果，且可训练参数更少。
Conclusion: 作者强调 SAM+D 能泛化到不同的 SAM 系列架构、目标维度（3D 与 4D）以及医学影像和生物场景理解等不同领域，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Auto-JEPA: A Latent World Model of Continuous Intent for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Existing autonomous-driving world models typically perform dense prediction of future videos, occupancy states, BEV representations, or agent motion. We argue that planning need not reconstruct the complete future world, but only focus on scene features that affect future ego action. Based on this perspective, we propose Auto-JEPA, an action-oriented latent world model that learns continuous future driving intent through joint-embedding prediction. Given visual observations, egomotion history, and navigation commands, Auto-JEPA predicts an intent embedding aligned with the latent representation of the future ego trajectory. The predicted intent retrieves executable trajectories from a fixed trajectory memory, which are then ranked by a scene-conditioned candidate selection module. Auto-JEPA keeps the visual encoder frozen, requires no explicit perception annotations, and uses no learned trajectory generator. By optimizing only task-specific modules for trajectory representation, intent prediction, and candidate selection, Auto-JEPA achieves 91.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2. Semantic occlusion experiments show that masking dynamic-agent regions induces an average intent change 2.97x that of equal-area random masking. Moreover, occluding vehicles that affect future driving substantially changes the predicted intent and selected trajectory, whereas both remain essentially unchanged when non-influential vehicles are occluded. These results show that future-intent prediction encourages the model to focus on planning-relevant visual features and supports high-quality planning without dense future-world modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Auto-JEPA，一种面向自动驾驶的动作导向潜在世界模型 (action-oriented latent world model)，通过联合嵌入预测 (joint-embedding prediction) 学习连续的未来驾驶意图，而不再做稠密的未来世界重建。模型在固定轨迹记忆中检索可执行轨迹，并用场景条件候选选择模块排序；视觉编码器冻结，无需显式感知标注，也不使用学习式轨迹生成器。摘要报告其在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 91.3 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 89.1 EPDMS。
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶世界模型通常对未来的视频、占用状态、BEV 表示或智能体运动进行稠密预测，但作者认为规划并不需要重建完整的未来世界，只需关注影响未来自我动作的场景特征。
Method: Auto-JEPA 给定视觉观测、自我运动历史和导航命令，预测一个与未来自我轨迹的潜在表示对齐的意图嵌入；该预测意图从固定的轨迹记忆中检索可执行轨迹，再由场景条件候选选择模块排序。方法仅优化轨迹表示、意图预测和候选选择等任务特定模块，保持视觉编码器冻结，不使用显式感知标注或学习式轨迹生成器。
Result: 摘要报告 Auto-JEPA 在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 91.3 PDMS，在 NAVSIM v2 上达到 89.1 EPDMS。语义遮挡实验显示，遮挡动态智能体区域导致的平均意图变化是等面积随机遮挡的 2.97 倍；遮挡影响未来驾驶的车辆会显著改变预测意图和所选轨迹，而遮挡不影响驾驶的车辆则基本保持不变。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，未来意图预测会促使模型关注与规划相关的视觉特征，并在不需要稠密未来世界建模的情况下支持高质量规划。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evaluation-Verification Reward for Consistent Multi-Reference Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: While recent image editing models have made rapid progress, multi-reference editing remains challenging, particularly in maintaining visual consistency across references and ensuring overall visual harmony. Reinforcement learning has proven highly effective for text-to-image generation and single-image editing, but its extension to multi-reference editing is hindered by the absence of suitable reward models that capture multi-image relational constraints. Moreover, naively using multimodal large language models(MLLMs) as zero-shot evaluators faces a key tension between hallucination-prone long-form reasoning and the limited deductive power of short-form judgments. We address these issues with a Multi-dimensional Evaluation-Verification Reward(EVR). EVR decomposes evaluation into distinct visual criteria; for each criterion, an MLLM Evaluator generates multiple candidate hypotheses, and a Verifier grounds each claim in concrete visual evidence to accept or reject it, producing reliable and fine-grained reward signals. Together with a scalable data pipeline, our method enables RL fine-tuning of off-the-shelf editors without architectural changes. Extensive experiments show substantial gains over the base Qwen-Image-Edit, improving consistency and harmony to match or surpass NanoBanana.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多参考图像编辑中跨参考一致性与整体视觉和谐性难以保持的问题，提出多维度评估-验证奖励 (EVR)。EVR 将评估分解为多个视觉标准，每个标准由 MLLM 评估器生成多个候选假设，再由验证器以具体视觉证据接受或拒绝，从而产生可靠且细粒度的奖励信号。结合可扩展数据流水线，该方法无需架构改动即可对现成编辑器进行强化学习微调；实验显示相比基线 Qwen-Image-Edit 有显著提升，一致性与和谐性达到或超过 NanoBanana。
Motivation: 多参考图像编辑缺少能捕捉多图关系约束的合适奖励模型，而直接使用多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 作为零样本评估器，又面临长程推理易产生幻觉与短程判断推理能力不足之间的矛盾。
Method: 提出多维度评估-验证奖励 (EVR)，将评估分解为不同视觉标准；对每个标准，由 MLLM 评估器生成多个候选假设，并由验证器基于具体视觉证据接受或拒绝，以产生可靠且细粒度的奖励信号。结合可扩展的数据流水线，无需修改架构即可对现成编辑器进行强化学习微调。
Result: 大量实验表明，该方法相比基础 Qwen-Image-Edit 有显著提升，在一致性与和谐性方面达到或超过 NanoBanana。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EVR 能提供可靠且细粒度的奖励信号，使强化学习可有效应用于多参考图像编辑，且不需要对编辑器架构做改动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Persistent Convolution: A Topological Framework for AI Alignment Testing and Semantic Space Characterization
papers.abstract_en: Modern opaque AI models prize performance over interpretability, which makes testing difficult. However, formal statistical tests conducted on a model's embedding space can provide robust characterizations of semantic structure, concept separation, and knowledge graph alignment. Model developers would benefit from a model comparison technique that leverages human-curated knowledge structures to test alignment. The scale of the input space for even relatively simple tasks motivates the need for alignment checks that augment standard outcome reasoning. This work develops and demonstrates a topology-based multi-modal alignment test to make deployment, selection, and comparison of opaque models more interpretable. These methods also offer an intuitive connection to possibility theory and a unified decision theoretic framework from data to deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于拓扑的框架 Persistent Convolution，用于对不透明 AI 模型的嵌入空间做形式化统计检验，以刻画语义结构、概念分离与知识图谱对齐，并在此基础上构建多模态对齐检验 (topology-based multi-modal alignment test)。作者将该检验方法连接到可能性理论 (possibility theory) 与统一的决策理论框架，目标是让黑箱模型在部署、选择与比较时更可解释。摘要未给出具体实验数据集或数值结果。
Motivation: 现代不透明 AI 模型以性能优先而难以测试和解释，模型开发者需要一种利用人工整理的知识结构来检验模型对齐的技术；同时，即使较简单任务的输入空间规模也很大，因此需要超越标准结果推理的对齐检验。
Method: 方法的核心是持久卷积 (persistent convolution) 这一拓扑工具，将其应用于模型嵌入空间，以形式化统计检验的方式表征语义结构、概念分离和知识图谱对齐；论文进一步将该方法发展为拓扑多模态对齐检验，并将其与可能性理论及从数据到部署的统一决策理论框架联系起来。
Result: 摘要仅说明该方法被开发并演示，能够使不透明模型的部署、选择与比较更可解释；未报告定量实验结果或基准对比数字。
Conclusion: 论文的要点是拓扑方法可以为 AI 对齐测试提供更可解释的路径，并在统一决策理论框架中连接数据与部署。摘要层面未涉及局限性和具体实验细节。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MMShopBench: A Real-Log Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Turn Shopping Agents
papers.abstract_en: Online shoppers increasingly turn to AI shopping assistants, using images and multi-turn dialogue to express and refine product needs that are difficult to articulate in text alone. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on text-only or synthetic requests, underrepresenting complex real-world shopping requirements jointly expressed through images and language. We introduce MMShopBench, the first real-log benchmark for multimodal, multi-turn shopping agents. Built from carefully cleaned and manually annotated shopping logs, MMShopBench provides ground-truth annotations of each request's purchase intent and mandatory product requirements. Agents must infer these requirements jointly from user images and multi-turn dialogue, retrieve candidate products through image and text search, and verify that each candidate satisfies all requirements using its product images and structured attributes. We evaluate representative open-source and proprietary models using an evidence-grounded multimodal protocol and construct a companion training set for fine-tuning an open-source model. To ensure reproducible experimentation, we build an offline shopping sandbox, where fine-tuning substantially narrows the performance gap between our open-source model and leading proprietary models, demonstrating the effectiveness of our training data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMShopBench，一个基于真实购物日志的多模态、多轮购物智能体基准，所有日志经过清洗与人工标注，提供每次请求的购买意图和强制性商品需求标注。智能体需要联合解析用户图像与多轮对话，通过图像和文本检索候选商品，并利用商品图像与结构化属性逐一验证候选是否满足全部需求。作者还构建了配套训练集与离线购物沙箱，微调后开源模型与领先专有模型的性能差距显著缩小。
Motivation: 现有购物智能体基准大多依赖纯文本或合成请求，难以覆盖用户通过图像与语言共同表达的复杂真实购物需求，导致对真实场景能力的评估不足。
Method: 基于人工清洗和标注的真实购物日志构建基准，包含购买意图与强制性需求的金标准标注；设计证据化 (evidence-grounded) 多模态评测协议，并构建离线购物沙箱与配套训练集，用于微调开源模型。
Result: 摘要报告在证据化多模态协议下评估了若干开源和专有模型，微调使开源模型与领先专有模型之间的性能差距大幅缩小，验证了训练数据的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调离线购物沙箱保障实验可复现，并表明所构建训练数据能有效提升开源模型在真实购物场景下的表现；摘要未提及方法局限性的讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PaletteID: Prototype-Composed Semantic Identifiers for Multimodal CTR Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal information can improve the accuracy of click-through rate (CTR) prediction and effectively alleviate item cold-start and long-tail problems. Recent studies commonly discretize pretrained multimodal embeddings into semantic identifiers (SIDs), allowing the model to learn task-specific semantic representations for recommendation. However, existing methods still provide limited gains due to two major limitations. First, codebook assignment fails to preserve semantic relevance and discards fine-grained continuous signals in the original embedding space. Second, the residual code paths are highly dependent on prefix codes, which limits the effective representational scalability of hierarchical identifiers. To address these issues, we propose PaletteID (PID), a prototype-based semantic identifier. Inspired by palette-based color composition, PID uses a compact set of representative prototype items as semantic anchors to bridge pretrained multimodal content space and recommendation models. Specifically, we first construct a prototype palette with Semantic Quality-Aware Determinantal Point Process (SQ-DPP), which jointly considers local content density and global semantic diversity. Then, for each target item, PID retrieves a sequence of semantically related prototypes and aggregates them into an informative PID representation, enabling rich and complementary semantic modeling. Extensive experiments on two public datasets demonstrate that PID consistently improves CTR prediction and yields larger gains for long-tail items. PID also produces more robust identifier assignments and provides more interpretable token semantics than existing residual SID methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PaletteID (PID)，一种基于原型 (prototype) 的多模态语义标识符，用于点击率 (CTR) 预测。PID 先用 Semantic Quality-Aware Determinantal Point Process (SQ-DPP) 构造由代表性商品组成的原型调色板，再为每个目标商品检索并聚合语义相关的原型序列，生成信息丰富的 PID 表示。两个公开数据集上的实验显示，PID 一致提升 CTR 预测，对长尾商品增益更大，并比现有残差式语义标识符 (residual SID) 方法更鲁棒、可解释。
Motivation: 现有方法将预训练多模态嵌入离散化为语义标识符 (SID)，但码本分配会丢失细粒度连续信号，且残差码路径强依赖前缀码、限制层次标识符的可扩展性，导致增益有限。
Method: 提出基于调色板颜色合成启发的原型式标识符 PID：先以 SQ-DPP 联合考虑局部内容密度与全局语义多样性来构建紧凑的原型调色板；再为每个目标商品检索语义相关的原型序列并聚合成 PID 表示，以桥接预训练多模态内容空间与推荐模型。
Result: 在两个公开数据集上，PID 一致改善 CTR 预测，并在长尾商品上取得更大提升；相比现有残差 SID 方法，PID 的标识符分配更鲁棒，token 语义更可解释。
Conclusion: 作者总结，PID 通过紧凑原型集与可解释的 token 语义实现更鲁棒的多模态 CTR 预测，尤其适用于长尾场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在两个公开数据集上，PID 一致改善 CTR 预测，并在长尾商品上取得更大提升；相比现有残差 SID 方法，PID 的标识符分配更鲁棒，token 语义更可解释。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者总结，PID 通过紧凑原型集与可解释的 token 语义实现更鲁棒的多模态 CTR 预测，尤其适用于长尾场景。

papers.title: SULAND v2: A Refined RGB Dataset and Deep Learning Object Detection Benchmark for UAV/UGV-Based SUrface LANDmine Detection Under Domain Shift
papers.abstract_en: RGB imagery offers a practical, low-cost option for Unmanned Aerial/Ground Vehicle (UAV/UGV) survey support in surface-landmine detection, but object detectors remain underexplored in this safety-critical domain. Limited cross-architecture benchmarking and insufficient out-of-distribution (OOD) analysis obscure whether detectors generalize across deployment conditions. This challenge is amplified by the scarcity of public RGB landmine datasets, making SULAND a key benchmark for PFM-1 and PMA-2 detection. However, inspection reveals missing/false annotations, localization errors, inconsistent visibility criteria, visual artifacts, temporal labeling inconsistencies, and an inverted OOD class-ID convention in SULAND. We present SULAND_v2, a refined RGB surface-landmine dataset and benchmark. Preserving original images and splits, we manually revise annotations to ensure completeness, precise localization, label validity, and class consistency. SULAND_v2 contains 33,771 images and 12,433 bounding boxes. We benchmark 35 detector configurations across nine families. Annotation refinement improves YOLOv8 in-distribution (IID) test mAP@50 by 14.6-19.6 percentage points, while fixing the OOD class-ID convention increases mean YOLOv8 OOD mAP@50 by ~25 percentage points. On SULAND_v2, YOLOv12-Small achieves the highest IID mAP@50 (0.908), while RF-DETR-Large yields the strongest OOD performance (0.799 mAP@50, 0.675 recall). Our results demonstrate that high IID accuracy does not guarantee operational readiness. SULAND_v2 provides a reliable benchmark for evaluating domain-shift robustness in RGB-based mine-action survey support.

Result: 标注修正使 YOLOv8 的 IID mAP@50 提升 14.6-19.6 个百分点；修正 OOD 类别 ID 约定使平均 YOLOv8 OOD mAP@50 提升约 25 个百分点。在 SULAND_v2 上，YOLOv12-Small 取得最高 IID mAP@50 (0.908)，RF-DETR-Large 取得最强 OOD 性能 (0.799 mAP@50，0.675 recall)。
Conclusion: 结果表明高 IID 精度并不能保证实际部署中的操作就绪性；SULAND_v2 为评估 RGB 地雷调查支持中的域移鲁棒性提供了可靠基准。

papers.title: Point2Radio: A Foundation Model for Cross-Scene Radio Fields from Material-Aware Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity radio fields are typically simulated for every scene--transmitter configuration or fitted separately to each scene, failing to exploit propagation structures shared across environments. We present Point2Radio, a foundation model that learns a transferable propagation prior from multiple environments. Given a material-aware point cloud and a transmitter (TX) setting, a common encoder produces a TX-conditioned scene representation that can be queried at arbitrary receiver (RX) locations. Task-specific query decoders map this representation to different radio quantities, e.g., three-dimensional (3D) path-gain (PG) fields and power angular spectra (PAS). At inference for a new scene, the model uses only a material-aware point cloud and transceiver queries, running in milliseconds on a single GPU without meshes or explicit path tracing. We evaluate PG prediction on a scene-disjoint split of a 337-scene corpus containing 86,272 TX-conditioned fields. Point2Radio achieves 0.871 dB mean absolute error (MAE), reducing error by 76.7% relative to a same-split UNet-style baseline. The same encoder also supports PAS prediction via a task-specific decoder. Experiments further show that light target-scene fine-tuning improves adaptation to a specific environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Point2Radio 是一个跨场景无线电场预测的基础模型，从多个环境中学习可迁移的传播先验。给定材质感知点云 (material-aware point cloud) 与发射机 (TX) 设置，公共编码器生成 TX 条件化的场景表示，并可在任意接收机 (RX) 位置查询；任务特定的解码器将该表示映射为三维路径增益 (path-gain, PG) 场和功率角谱 (power angular spectra, PAS)。在 337 个场景、86,272 个 TX 条件化场的数据集上，PG 预测的 MAE 为 0.871 dB，相对同一划分下的 UNet 风格基线误差降低 76.7%。
Motivation: 高保真无线电场通常需要针对每个场景和发射机构型单独仿真或逐场景拟合，无法利用不同环境之间共享的传播结构，导致效率低且泛化差。
Method: 提出 Point2Radio：以材质感知点云和 TX 设置为输入，公共编码器生成 TX 条件化的场景表示；该表示可被任意 RX 位置查询，并由任务特定的查询解码器输出不同无线电量，如三维 PG 场和 PAS。推理时仅需点云与收发端查询，无需网格或显式光线追踪，可在单 GPU 上毫秒级运行。
Result: 在场景不相交划分的 337 场景语料库（含 86,272 个 TX 条件化场）上，PG 预测达到 0.871 dB 的平均绝对误差 (MAE)，相比同划分的 UNet 风格基线误差降低 76.7%；同一编码器通过任务特定解码器也支持 PAS 预测，且轻量目标场景微调可改善对特定环境的适应。
Conclusion: 作者认为学习跨场景传播先验可以显著加速新场景的无线电场预测，并通过少量微调进一步适配特定环境；相关工作仍以无线电传播建模为主，未涉及天气或降水领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ST-WAM: Semantic-Temporal World Action Model for Robust Manipulation under Visual Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm by jointly modeling robot actions and future visual dynamics. However, their reliance on pixel-generative future supervision can entangle action-relevant state transitions with task-irrelevant visual content, limiting robustness under visual distribution shifts. We identify Training-Distribution Hallucination, a recurring phenomenon in which futures conditioned on visually shifted observations hallucinate training-domain content rather than remain faithful to the current scene. A controlled frame-triplet diagnosis further shows that DINOv3 features remain more stable across visual shifts while better preserving task-state distinctions than Wan-VAE latents. Rather than correcting the predicted futures, we propose Semantic-Temporal WAM (ST-WAM) to improve action robustness by using DINOv3 as a shared semantic representation for future prediction and history retrieval while retaining fine-grained VAE dynamics. Its Dual-Space Future Experts (DSFE) jointly predict future VAE latents and DINO features, while Current-Anchored Intent Retrieval (CAIR) retrieves task-relevant evidence from recent DINO history under the current visual-language context. ST-WAM is trained end-to-end without additional embodied pretraining or task-specific annotations, and requires no explicit future generation at inference. It achieves 98.7% on LIBERO and 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0; more importantly, compared with Fast-WAM, it improves zero-shot LIBERO-Plus performance by 21.3 percentage points and more than doubles real-world success under visual shifts from 25.8% to 61.5%. These results demonstrate that semantic-temporal modeling effectively complements pixel-generative dynamics for robust manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义-时序世界动作模型 ST-WAM，针对世界动作模型 (WAM) 在像素生成式未来监督下对视觉分布偏移鲁棒性差的问题。作者识别出训练分布幻觉现象，并用 DINOv3 作为共享语义表征进行未来预测与历史检索，同时保留细粒度 VAE 动态。实验显示该方法在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到高成功率，并在零样本 LIBERO-Plus 和真实视觉偏移场景下显著超过 Fast-WAM。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型通过联合建模动作与未来视觉动态来提升操作能力，但像素生成式未来监督会把动作相关状态变化与任务无关视觉内容纠缠在一起，导致视觉分布偏移下不鲁棒。
Method: 提出 ST-WAM：用 DINOv3 作为未来预测和历史检索的共享语义表征，保留 VAE 细粒度动态；通过双空间未来专家 (DSFE) 联合预测未来 VAE 潜变量和 DINO 特征，并用当前锚定的意图检索 (CAIR) 在当前视觉-语言上下文下从近期 DINO 历史中获取任务相关证据；端到端训练，推理时无需显式生成未来。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上达到 98.7%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 92.8%；相比 Fast-WAM，零样本 LIBERO-Plus 提升 21.3 个百分点，真实场景视觉偏移下成功率从 25.8% 提升至 61.5%。
Conclusion: 作者认为语义-时序建模能有效补充像素生成式动态，提升视觉分布偏移下的操作鲁棒性；该方法不需额外具身预训练或任务级标注，推理时也不需要显式未来生成。

papers.title: CAER: Conflict-Aware Evidence Routing with Dual Prefix Experts for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding and generation. However, when textual inputs conflict with visual evidence, they still suffer from hallucinations and produce responses inconsistent with visual content. Existing approaches mainly rely on decoding strategies, additional training, verification methods, or prompting techniques, but often lack fine-grained conflict localization and conflict-aware generation. In this work, we propose CAER, a backbone-agnostic framework for visual-language conflict detection and conflict-aware generation. CAER introduces a span-grounded evidence router that transforms claim representations into soft textual queries and retrieves corresponding evidence from frozen visual tokens, enabling fine-grained conflict estimation. Furthermore, we design a dual-prefix expert routing mechanism that learns separate experts for visually supported and contradicted inputs, enabling conflict-aware generation through explicit expert selection. Experiments on the public MMMC benchmark and our newly curated AgriConflict dataset demonstrate that CAER effectively detects visual-language conflicts and improves the reliability of open-source MLLMs without updating their backbone parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAER，一个与骨干网络无关的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 视觉-语言冲突检测与冲突感知生成框架。CAER 通过 span-grounded evidence router 将声明表示转为软文本查询并从冻结的视觉 token 中检索证据，实现细粒度冲突估计；同时设计 dual-prefix expert routing 机制，为视觉支持与视觉矛盾的输入分别学习专家，通过显式专家选择实现冲突感知生成。实验在 MMMC 基准和作者新建的 AgriConflict 数据集上表明，CAER 能在不更新骨干参数的情况下提升开源 MLLM 的可靠性。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在文本输入与视觉证据矛盾时仍会出现幻觉，产生与视觉内容不一致的响应；现有方法多依赖解码策略、额外训练、验证或提示技术，缺乏细粒度的冲突定位与冲突感知生成能力。
Method: 提出 CAER 框架，包含两个核心组件：span-grounded evidence router 将声明表征转化为软文本查询并从冻结视觉 token 中检索证据以估计冲突；dual-prefix expert routing 机制为视觉支持与视觉矛盾输入分别学习专家，并通过显式专家选择进行冲突感知生成。
Result: 在公开的 MMMC 基准和作者新构建的 AgriConflict 数据集上，CAER 能够有效检测视觉-语言冲突，并在不更新骨干参数的前提下提升开源 MLLM 的可靠性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CAER 是 backbone-agnostic 的框架，可以在不更新骨干参数的情况下改善 MLLM 的冲突检测与生成可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Scientific Discovery Environments for Turn-Level Agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents have shown promising capabilities in data-driven scientific discovery tasks, where an agent interacts with an execution environment and produces a statistical claim. Long-horizon scientific analysis remains constrained by the lack of process supervised environments over real-world scientific data. This paper introduces SciDisco, a scalable framework for training Scientific Discovery agents in process-verifiable environments. SciThèque compiles hypotheses, datasets, hidden evidence graphs, and verifiers into task environments where analytical progress can be checked during interaction. DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis uses these environments to construct verifier-filtered multi-turn demonstrations. DiscoPO then uses the environment as the source of training signal, assigning turn-level credit to actions that produce verifiable analytical evidence. Experiments show that SciDisco-14B reaches state-of-the-art on hypothesis-driven scientific data analysis benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciDisco，一个用于训练科学发现智能体的可扩展框架，聚焦于可过程验证的环境。框架包含 SciThèque 环境编译器、基于 DAG 的轨迹合成以及 DiscoPO 轮次级 (turn-level) 强化学习信号，使长周期科学数据分析过程中的分析进展可在交互中检验。摘要报告 SciDisco-14B 在假设驱动的科学数据分析基准上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 长周期 (long-horizon) 科学分析受限于缺乏基于真实世界科学数据的过程监督环境，现有智能体难以在交互中检验分析进展并获取细粒度训练信号。
Method: 提出三部分框架：SciThèque 将假设、数据集、隐藏证据图 (hidden evidence graphs) 和验证器 (verifiers) 编译成任务环境；DAG-grounded trajectory synthesis 利用这些环境构造经验证器过滤的多轮演示；DiscoPO 以环境为训练信号来源，对产生可验证分析证据的动作分配轮次级信用 (turn-level credit)。
Result: 实验表明 SciDisco-14B 在假设驱动的科学数据分析基准上达到最先进水平 (state-of-the-art)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可过程验证的环境结合轮次级信用分配能够扩展科学发现智能体的训练；其适用场景为假设驱动的科学数据分析任务。

papers.title: SILVA Networks as Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors via Dynamic Interaction Fields
authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
papers.abstract_en: Many learning problems require representations that reconcile direct input, nearby structure, and broader context. In implicit neural layers, these influences are usually absorbed into a single fixed-point update, making it hard to identify what enters from the stimulus, what propagates locally, what comes from global context, and what is produced by solver dynamics. Here we introduce SILVA Networks, Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors via Dynamic Interaction Fields. SILVA separates stimulus, local interaction, global interaction, damping, and readout inside one fixed-point architecture. The same template is instantiated for images, molecules, citation networks, and long-range graph benchmarks through domain-specific definitions of nodes, neighborhoods, and global summaries. Experiments and ablations show task-dependent roles for these terms: local interactions are load-bearing in the graph tasks, MNIST gains little from recurrence at the tested capacity, and the clearest global benefit appears in a long-range node-classification benchmark. SILVA therefore provides an implicit representation whose internal interaction dynamics can be trained, ablated, visualized, and diagnosed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SILVA Networks（Structured Implicit Layers and Vector Attractors via Dynamic Interaction Fields），将隐式神经层中的直接输入、局部邻居结构与全局上下文显式分离为刺激项、局部交互项、全局交互项、阻尼项和读出项，置于同一个不动点（fixed-point）架构中，并针对图像、分子、引文网络和长程图基准构造领域特定的节点、邻域和全局摘要。实验与消融显示这些项的作用因任务而异：局部交互在图任务中承担主要作用，MNIST 在测试容量下从循环中获益有限，最明显的全局收益出现在长程节点分类基准上。
Motivation: 现有隐式神经层通常把输入刺激、局部结构、全局上下文与求解器动力学全部混入单一不动点更新，难以辨别各来源对表征的贡献，导致内部交互动力学不可解释、难以诊断。
Method: SILVA 网络在一个不动点架构中分离刺激、局部交互、全局交互、阻尼与读出五个部分，并用统一模板在不同领域（图像、分子、引文网络、长程图基准）通过领域特定的节点、邻域和全局摘要定义来实例化。
Result: 消融实验表明各交互项的作用具有任务依赖性：局部交互在图任务中起关键作用，MNIST 在测试容量下几乎不因循环而获益，最明显的全局收益出现在长程节点分类基准上。
Conclusion: SILVA 提供了一种隐式表征，其内部交互动力学可以被训练、消融、可视化和诊断。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Adjudicated Captioning: Multi-Agent Alignment Scoring and Consensus-Distilled Beam Arbitration for Strict Zero-Shot Image Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot image captioning (ZIC) describes images without paired image-caption supervision during captioner training, relying on text-only corpora and frozen pretrained image-text scorers. Existing retrieval-augmented methods score image-text alignment once, at retrieval, then commit the captioner's autoregressive beam under language-model probability alone, leaving the decoder without further visual grounding feedback. Progress has stalled, with no method improving on the strict-regime best since 2024. We propose Adjudicated Captioning, an inference-time multi-agent framework that restores grounding feedback at multiple checkpoints over an unchanged IFCap captioner. First, we install a stronger frozen Retrieval Encoder at the input. Second, between retrieval and decoding we insert a frozen Cross-Attention Verifier that re-ranks the top-9 retrievals to top-5. Third, at the output beam we attach a learned Reranker pairing TriFuse, a multilayer perceptron, with MemAttend, a memory-attended transformer, the pipeline's only learned components; both are trained self-supervised by Borda-consensus distillation across the three frozen scorers, using no paired image-caption labels and no reference captions. Under the inductive headline protocol, with rerankers fit on the disjoint COCO Karpathy validation beam and applied frozen to test, the framework reaches CIDEr 117.6 and SPICE 21.9 on COCO Karpathy, up from 108.0 and 20.3 for IFCap, a +9.6 CIDEr gain, and +7.7 above NES, the strongest synthetic-image-augmented method at 109.9, without retraining the captioner. A training-free fixed-fusion baseline reaches 115.8 CIDEr, so +7.8 of the +9.6 gain comes from the non-learned architectural intervention and the remaining +1.8 from the learned rerankers. The same recipe transfers off-COCO without captioner retraining: +8.1 CIDEr on Flickr30k Karpathy and +5.7 on NoCaps overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adjudicated Captioning，一种针对零样本图像描述 (zero-shot image captioning) 的推理时多智能体框架，在保持底层 IFCap 描述器不变的前提下，于多个检查点恢复视觉 grounding 反馈。框架在输入侧引入更强的冻结检索编码器，在检索与解码之间加入冻结的 Cross-Attention Verifier 将 top-9 检索结果重排为 top-5，并在输出 beam 上附加由 TriFuse (MLP) 与 MemAttend (memory-attended transformer) 组成的学习重排器。摘要报告该方法在 COCO Karpathy 上达到 CIDEr 117.6，相比 IFCap 的 108.0 提升 +9.6，且无需重训描述器即可迁移到其他数据集。
Motivation: 现有零样本图像描述方法只在检索阶段对图像-文本对齐打分一次，随后仅凭语言模型概率做自回归 beam 解码，解码过程缺少进一步的视觉 grounding 反馈。作者指出该方向进展停滞，自 2024 年以来尚无方法在严格零样本设定下取得改进。
Method: 提出推理时多智能体流水线：先用更强的冻结 Retrieval Encoder 替换输入表示；再在检索与解码之间加入冻结的 Cross-Attention Verifier，将 top-9 检索候选重排为 top-5；最后在输出 beam 上附加学习式 Reranker（TriFuse + MemAttend）。该重排器是流水线中唯一的学习组件，通过三个冻结 scorer 之间的 Borda-consensus 蒸馏进行自监督训练，不依赖成对图像-描述标签或参考描述。
Result: 在归纳式 (inductive) 评估协议下，重排器仅在不相交的 COCO Karpathy 验证 beam 上拟合后冻结用于测试，COCO Karpathy 上 CIDEr 从 IFCap 的 108.0 提升到 117.6，SPICE 从 20.3 提升到 21.9；比最强合成图像增强方法 NES (109.9) 高 +7.7。无训练固定融合基线达到 115.8 CIDEr，说明 +9.6 增益中 +7.8 来自非学习式架构干预，其余 +1.8 来自学习重排器。无需重训描述器即可迁移：Flickr30k Karpathy 上 +8.1 CIDEr，NoCaps 整体 +5.7。
Conclusion: 作者强调在不重训描述器的前提下，通过在多个检查点恢复视觉 grounding 反馈可以突破零样本图像描述的停滞局面；实验还表明大部分增益来自非学习的架构干预，而非学习式重排器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PARALLEL: A Prefrontal-Aligned Reinforcement inspired Approach for Language-Model Learning under Explicit Limits
papers.abstract_en: Recent language models achieve strong performance across a variety of tasks, but conventional adaptation applies updates uniformly across training samples regardless of their local update benefit. We propose PARALLEL, a prefrontal-aligned reinforcement inspired approach for language-model learning. Inspired by the complementary roles of goal-related and uncertainty-related control, PARALLEL represents these forms of information as separate controller signals and combines them with the current model representation. A reinforcement-inspired controller assigns sample-dependent update intensity using immediate utility-cost feedback. PARALLEL therefore learns when and how strongly to adapt to each sample, prioritizing beneficial updates while limiting unnecessary parameter changes. PARALLEL uses available updates more efficiently than selective baselines while retaining 94.1--99.2\% of Full-adaptation performance. Beyond multiple-choice reasoning, experiments on XSum and CNN/DailyMail show that PARALLEL retains 96.9--98.6\% of the ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 scores achieved by Full adaptation and 98.8--98.9\% of the corresponding ROUGE-L scores. When compared at the same cumulative adaptation time or GPU energy, PARALLEL achieves higher ARC accuracy and exhibits a more stable late-stage adaptation trajectory than Full adaptation in the representative run. These results show that learning when and how strongly to update each sample supports stable and efficient post-deployment stream adaptation while avoiding unnecessary updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PARALLEL，一种受前额叶控制机制启发的强化式语言模型学习方法。该方法将目标相关与不确定性相关的控制信息表示为分离的控制器信号，并与当前模型表示结合，由强化式控制器根据即时效用-成本反馈为每个样本分配依赖样本的更新强度。实验表明，PARALLEL 在多个选择推理基准上以更高效的更新使用保留 Full-adaptation 表现的 94.1%–99.2%，并在 XSum 与 CNN/DailyMail 上保留 96.9%–98.6% 的 ROUGE-1/ROUGE-2 与 98.8%–98.9% 的 ROUGE-L 分数。
Motivation: 现有语言模型适应方法对所有训练样本施加均匀更新，而不考虑每个样本局部的更新收益，导致不必要的参数变化和低效的更新利用。论文针对学习每个样本何时更新以及以多强更新这一问题，目标是优先进行有益更新并限制无效参数改动。
Method: 提出一种前额叶对齐的强化启发式方法 PARALLEL，把目标相关控制与不确定性相关控制建模为独立的控制器信号，并与当前模型表示相组合；强化启发式控制器利用即时效用-成本反馈分配样本依赖的更新强度，从而决定每个样本的适应时机和程度。
Result: 在多个选择推理任务上，PARALLEL 比选择性基线更高效地使用可用更新，并保留 Full-adaptation 表现的 94.1%–99.2%；在 XSum 和 CNN/DailyMail 上保留 Full adaptation 的 ROUGE-1/ROUGE-2 分数的 96.9%–98.6% 和 ROUGE-L 分数的 98.8%–98.9%。在相同的累计适应时间或 GPU 能量下，代表性运行中 PARALLEL 达到更高的 ARC 准确率，并表现出比 Full adaptation 更稳定的后期适应轨迹。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，按样本学习何时更新以及更新强度，有助于在部署后流式适应中实现稳定且高效的更新，同时避免不必要的参数更新。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Distance Profile Embedding for Independence and Conditional Independence Testing of Random Objects
papers.abstract_en: Testing independence or conditional independence is fundamental to statistical inference, yet existing methods for non-Euclidean random objects often face a difficult trade-off between geometric flexibility and theoretical tractability. We introduce the Distance Profile Embedding (DPE), a novel representation that maps random objects from general metric spaces into a Hilbert space of square-integrable functions. We prove that this mapping is injective and preserves full distributional information without requiring isometric Hilbert embeddings or one-to-one correspondence conditions. Leveraging the DPE, we develop a unified framework for marginal and conditional independence testing of random objects that enjoys a rigorous asymptotic theory for both size and power. Notably, our framework is the first in the literature to accommodate object-valued conditioning variables when testing conditional independence, overcoming the Euclidean or Hilbertian constraints of existing methodologies. We facilitate the calculation of analytic $p$-values using closed-form asymptotic null distributions, which avoids the computational burden of permutation tests common in existing metric-based methods. The numerical properties of our methods are demonstrated through both simulations and two real-world applications involving gut microbiome compositions and global human mortality distributions, respectively.

Motivation: 面向非欧几里得随机对象的独立性检验常在地理灵活性与理论可处理性之间面临两难权衡，且现有方法在条件独立性检验中无法容纳对象型 (object-valued) 条件变量。
Method: 引入 DPE 表示，把一般度量空间中的随机对象映射到平方可积函数希尔伯特空间，并证明该映射单射且保留全部分布信息；在此表示上建立统一的边际与条件独立性检验框架，推导闭合形式的渐近零分布以计算解析 p 值。
Result: 该框架据称是文献中首个支持对象型条件变量的条件独立性检验方法，摆脱了现有方法对欧几里得或希尔伯特空间的约束；通过模拟以及肠道微生物组和全球人类死亡率两个真实应用展示了其数值性质。
Conclusion: 作者强调该检验框架在 size 和 power 上具备严格渐近理论，并能借助闭合形式零分布避免传统度量方法中置换检验的计算负担。

papers.title: Beyond Feature and Structure Alignment: Learning Transferable Propagation Knowledge for Graph Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling knowledge transfer across diverse domains. Unlike traditional graph learning methods that are typically designed for in-domain settings, GFMs aim to learn transferable knowledge that can generalize to unseen graph domains. However, unlike language or visual data, graphs lack intrinsic and unified representation units, such as tokens in language and patches in vision, making it challenging to identify transferable knowledge units for building graph foundation models. Existing graph foundation models mainly focus on mitigating domain discrepancies through feature alignment and structure alignment, while overlooking the exploration of transferable knowledge units underlying graph data. Moreover, these methods generally rely on fixed propagation mechanisms during message passing, overlooking the heterogeneity in propagation patterns, as different edges may exhibit distinct propagation patterns for different feature dimensions. To address these limitations, we propose a Propagation-aware Graph Foundation Model (ProGFM), which regards the propagation relationships between edges and feature dimensions as transferable knowledge units. Through a propagation relationship prototype bank, ProGFM learns cross-domain transferable propagation knowledge, enabling adaptive information aggregation in unseen graph domains. Extensive experiments across various cross-domain transfer scenarios demonstrate that ProGFM possesses strong cross-domain knowledge transfer capability and exhibits superior generalization performance compared with existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Propagation-aware Graph Foundation Model (ProGFM)，将边与特征维度之间的传播关系视为可迁移的知识单元，并借助传播关系原型库 (propagation relationship prototype bank) 学习跨域可迁移的传播知识，从而在未见图域中实现自适应信息聚合。摘要称在多种跨域迁移场景下，ProGFM 相比现有方法具有更强的跨域知识迁移能力和更优的泛化性能。
Motivation: 现有图基础模型主要依赖特征对齐和结构对齐来缓解域差异，却忽略了图数据中可迁移知识单元的探索；同时它们通常使用固定的消息传递传播机制，未能处理不同边对不同特征维度可能具有不同传播模式的异质性。
Method: ProGFM 将传播关系作为可迁移知识单元，通过传播关系原型库学习跨域可迁移的传播知识，并在推理时据此为未见图域自适应地聚合信息。
Result: 大量跨域迁移实验表明，ProGFM 具备较强的跨域知识迁移能力，且在泛化性能上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模传播关系与传播模式异质性可以帮助图基础模型在未见图域中实现更好的自适应聚合与泛化。

papers.title: Classification of COVID-19 cases from chest CT volumes using hybrid model of 3D CNN and 3D MLP-Mixer
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an automated classification method of COVID-19 chest CT volumes using improved 3D MLP-Mixer. Novel coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) spreads over the world, causing a large number of infected patients and deaths. Sudden increase in the number of COVID-19 patients causes a manpower shortage in medical institutions. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system provides quick and quantitative diagnosis results. CAD system for COVID-19 enables efficient diagnosis workflow and contributes to reduce such manpower shortage. In image-based diagnosis of viral pneumonia cases including COVID-19, both local and global image features are important because viral pneumonia cause many ground glass opacities and consolidations in large areas in the lung. This paper proposes an automated classification method of chest CT volumes for COVID-19 diagnosis assistance. MLP-Mixer is a recent method of image classification using Vision Transformer-like architecture. It performs classification using both local and global image features. To classify 3D CT volumes, we developed a hybrid classification model that consists of both a 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) and a 3D version of the MLP-Mixer. Classification accuracy of the proposed method was evaluated using a dataset that contains 1205 CT volumes and obtained 79.5% of classification accuracy. The accuracy was higher than that of conventional 3D CNN models consists of 3D CNN layers and simple MLP layers.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster presentation in SPIE Medical Imaging 2023
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of SPIE Medical Imaging 2023, Computer-Aided Diagnosis, Vol. 12465
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于 COVID-19 胸部 CT 体数据自动分类的混合模型，结合 3D CNN 与改进的 3D MLP-Mixer，利用局部与全局图像特征进行诊断辅助。在包含 1205 个体积 CT 的数据集上达到 79.5% 的分类准确率，高于由 3D CNN 层和简单 MLP 层构成的常规 3D CNN 模型。
Motivation: COVID-19 患者激增导致医疗机构人力短缺，需要计算机辅助诊断 (CAD) 系统提供快速且定量的诊断结果。病毒性肺炎在肺部大范围引起磨玻璃影和实变，因此分类时需要同时利用局部和全局图像特征。
Method: 提出一种混合分类模型，由 3D 卷积神经网络 (CNN) 和 3D 版本的 MLP-Mixer 组成，用于对胸部 CT 体数据进行 COVID-19 分类。MLP-Mixer 采用类似 Vision Transformer 的架构，可同时利用局部与全局图像特征。
Result: 在包含 1205 个 CT 体数据的数据集上，该方法取得 79.5% 的分类准确率，高于由 3D CNN 层和简单 MLP 层组成的常规 3D CNN 模型。
Conclusion: 摘要表明所提出的混合 3D CNN 与 3D MLP-Mixer 模型可有效提升 COVID-19 CT 体数据的分类准确率，有助于改善诊断工作流程。

papers.title: Extrapolating the emergence of Hamiltonian chaos with random-feature Hamiltonian neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning of Hamiltonian dynamics has driven growing interest in Hamiltonian neural networks (HNNs), which encode Hamilton's equations of motion into the learning architecture. Despite this progress, it remains unknown whether such networks can predict dynamical regimes absent from their training data, in particular the broad chaotic sea that emerges beyond the observed parameter interval. We address this question using a parameter-aware random-feature Hamiltonian neural network (RF-HNN). Trained using data from only a small number of control-parameter values at which invariant tori dominate, the RF-HNN predicts autonomous long-time dynamics at unseen parameter values where mixed phase space develops and chaotic regions expand, with no data from that regime used in training or model selection. The method is demonstrated across four two-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian families, including the Hénon-Heiles system. Using Poincaré-section geometry and finite-time Lyapunov exponents, we show that the RF-HNN reproduces the breakup of regular structures and the emergence and growth of chaotic regions, whereas conventionally trained HNNs with the same Hamiltonian structure remain too regular. These results show that what decides parameter extrapolation is not Hamiltonian structure alone but how the fitted Hamiltonian continues in the control parameter. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a learned Hamiltonian can qualitatively extrapolate from predominantly regular dynamics into a broad chaotic sea absent from training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究哈密顿神经网络（HNN）的参数外推能力，提出参数感知的随机特征哈密顿神经网络（RF-HNN）。仅用少数控制参数下不变环面主导的数据训练，RF-HNN 能预测未见参数处混合相空间与混沌区的产生和扩展；常规 HNN 在相同哈密顿结构下仍过于规则。作者在包括 Hénon-Heiles 系统的四个二自由度哈密顿族上，用 Poincaré 截面与有限时间 Lyapunov 指数验证了该行为。
Motivation: 现有 HNN 能否预测训练数据之外的动力学区域仍属未知，尤其是超越观测参数区间的混沌海；作者希望检验学习到的哈密顿量能否从以正则动力学为主的数据定性外推到混沌区域。
Method: 使用参数感知的随机特征哈密顿神经网络（random-feature Hamiltonian neural network, RF-HNN），训练与模型选择只使用少数控制参数值（不变环面主导区）的数据；评估采用 Poincaré 截面几何与有限时间 Lyapunov 指数。
Result: 在四个二自由度哈密顿族上，RF-HNN 重现规则结构的破裂以及混沌区的出现与增长，而相同哈密顿结构的常规 HNN 保持过于规则；作者称这是首次证明学习到的哈密顿量能定性外推到训练数据之外的广袤混沌海。
Conclusion: 决定参数外推能力的不是哈密顿结构本身，而是拟合哈密顿量在控制参数上的延拓方式；该结论强调外推有效性取决于参数依赖的建模而非仅有物理结构的先验。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: RAID: Towards Robust AI-Generated Image Detection with Bit-Reversed Images
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of image generation models has made it increasingly difficult for people to distinguish AI-generated images from real ones. To prevent the potential risks associated with the misuse of fake images, AI-generated image detection has gained significant attention. Existing methods neglect the inherent differences between real and fake images, thus lacking robustness and generalization ability. In this work, we innovatively investigate AI-generated image detection using bit-planes, and introduce the bit-reversed image. We propose a simple yet effective pipeline consisting of construction of bit-reversed images, gradient-based patch selection and a convolutional classifier. Besides, we provide a theoretical analysis from the mathematical perspective to demonstrate the validity of our approach. We also introduce two challenging datasets for AI-generated image detection. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness of our approach across different settings, including cross-generator generalization, cross-dataset generalization and zero-shot performance. Without bells and whistles, our approach outperforms existing methods on over 40 benchmarks, and is nearly 100 times faster than counterparts. The code is at https://github.com/renxi-seu/RAID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于位平面 (bit-plane) 的 AI 生成图像检测方法 RAID，引入位反转图像 (bit-reversed image)，并构建由位反转图像构造、基于梯度的补丁选择与卷积分类器组成的流水线。作者从数学角度给出理论分析，并引入两个具有挑战性的检测数据集；实验表明该方法在跨生成器、跨数据集和零样本设置下均有效，在 40 多个基准上超越现有方法，且速度比同类方法快近 100 倍。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测方法忽略了真实图像与伪造图像之间的内在差异，导致鲁棒性和泛化能力不足。
Method: 提出简单有效的检测流水线，包括构造位反转图像、基于梯度的补丁选择以及卷积分类器，并提供数学上的理论分析来论证方法有效性；同时引入两个新的 AI 生成图像检测数据集。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在超过 40 个基准上优于现有方法，跨生成器、跨数据集及零样本设置下均验证有效，且推理速度比同类方法快近 100 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于位平面的位反转图像能够利用真实与伪造图像的固有差异，从而提升检测的鲁棒性与泛化能力；代码已公开。

papers.title: Don't Contrast the Impossible: Region-Constrained Batching for Contrastive User Modeling on a Local Community Platform
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive learning is widely used for user modeling in large-scale recommender systems, where standard in-batch negatives implicitly assume universal exposure that any user can be shown any item. On local community platforms such as Karrot, however, exposure is geographically constrained; many user-item pairs are impossible by design yet still treated as negatives during training, diluting the contrastive learning signal. We address this impossible negatives problem and propose Region-Constrained Batch Sampling (RCBS), a simple yet effective batching method that constructs region-homogeneous mini-batches so that users are contrasted primarily against items they could feasibly see. By replacing impossible negatives with feasible ones, RCBS naturally introduces harder and more informative negatives under realistic exposure constraints. With offline evaluations and online A/B tests, we show that RCBS consistently improves user representation quality and consequently enhances home feed ranking, retrieval, and display ads ranking. The resulting user embeddings have been deployed in production across various applications.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 49th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '26), pages 4639-4643, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对本地社区平台（如 Karrot）中对比学习（contrastive learning）的"不可能负样本"问题，提出区域约束批次采样（Region-Constrained Batch Sampling, RCBS），通过构造区域同质的 mini-batch，使每个用户主要与地理位置可行看到的物品进行对比。离线评估与在线 A/B 测试表明，RCBS 一致地提升用户表征质量，并改进主页信息流排序、检索和展示广告排序；该用户嵌入已部署到生产环境。
Motivation: 标准 in-batch 负样本隐式假设任意用户可被展示任意物品，但在本地社区平台上曝光受地理约束，许多用户-物品对在设计中就不可能发生，却被当作负样本参与训练，稀释了对比学习信号。
Method: 提出区域约束批次采样（Region-Constrained Batch Sampling, RCBS），一种构建区域同质 mini-batch 的批处理策略，使用户主要与可行见的物品做对比，用可行的负样本替换不可能的负样本，从而在真实曝光约束下引入更难、更具信息量的负样本。
Result: 摘要报告离线评估和在线 A/B 测试均显示 RCBS 持续提升用户表征质量，并提升首页信息流排序、检索和展示广告排序的效果；生成的用户嵌入已在多个应用的生产环境中部署。
Conclusion: 作者认为在受约束的曝光平台中，通过区域约束构造批次可以缓解不可能负样本问题并改善对比学习效果；该工作已在 SIGIR 2026 Industry Track 发表。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: LegoQ: Density-Matrix Representation Learning with Spectral-Spatial State Transitions for Hyperspectral Classification
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral image classification is complicated by mixed pixels, spectral ambiguity, class imbalance, and limited annotations. Most current classifiers encode a pixel or patch as a deterministic vector and apply a linear or multilayer softmax head. Although effective for discrimination, this representation does not directly expose how mixed or uncertain a sample is. This paper presents \method, a classical density-matrix representation learning framework for hyperspectral images. The spectral bands are divided into groups and each group is mapped to a positive semi-definite, Hermitian, trace-normalized matrix state. A composable stack of spectral, spatial, and inter-group transitions then updates the states while repeatedly projecting them back to the valid state set. Instead of flattening the final features, \method\ aggregates the group states and compares them with learnable class-prototype density matrices through Uhlmann fidelity. The normalized eigenspectrum, von Neumann entropy, purity, and prototype fidelity provide sample-level diagnostics that are unavailable from a conventional vector head. On Indian Pines, ten runs yield an overall accuracy of $96.20\pm0.70\%$, an average accuracy of $95.57\pm1.29\%$, and a kappa coefficient of $95.66\pm0.80\%$. On WHU-Hi-LongKou, the best of ten runs reaches $97.52\%$ overall accuracy. Classification maps and feature projections show that the transition stack produces compact and better separated class structures. The results support constrained matrix-state learning as a practical alternative to vector-only hyperspectral classification without requiring quantum hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LegoQ，一种面向高光谱图像分类的经典密度矩阵表示学习框架。它将光谱波段分组并映射为半正定、Hermitian、迹归一化的矩阵态，用可组合的光谱、空间与组间过渡层更新状态，并反复投影回合法状态集合；最终用 Uhlmann fidelity 与可学习的类原型密度矩阵比较。摘要报告在 Indian Pines 上十次运行的整体准确率为 96.20±0.70%，在 WHU-Hi-LongKou 上十次运行最佳整体准确率为 97.52%。
Motivation: 高光谱分类受混合像元、光谱模糊、类别不均衡和标注有限困扰，现有方法通常把像元或块编码为确定性向量，无法直接暴露样本的混合程度与不确定性。
Method: 将光谱波段划分成组，每组映射为满足半正定、Hermitian、迹归一化约束的密度矩阵态；通过光谱、空间和组间三类可组合的状态转移层更新，并在每次转移后投影回合法状态集合。最终聚合各组状态，用 Uhlmann fidelity 与可学习的类原型密度矩阵比较，并利用归一化特征谱、von Neumann 熵、纯度和原型保真度提供样本级诊断。
Result: Indian Pines 十次运行得到整体准确率 96.20±0.70%、平均准确率 95.57±1.29%、kappa 系数 95.66±0.80%；WHU-Hi-LongKou 十次运行最佳整体准确率为 97.52%。分类图和特征投影显示过渡栈产生了更紧凑、分离更好的类结构。
Conclusion: 摘要认为受约束的矩阵态学习可以在不依赖量子硬件的情况下，作为纯向量式高光谱分类的实用替代方案，并提供传统向量分类头无法给出的样本级诊断信息。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SafeNexus: Discovering and Steering Modality-Universal Safety Neurons in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising safety performance, extending them to Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exposes a significant gap between expanded multimodal capabilities and existing safety mechanisms. Current defenses remain predominantly confined to specific modal settings, thereby limiting their robustness against broader cross-modal threats. To bridge this gap, we introduce SafeNexus, a cross-modal safety alignment framework that adopts a dedicated neuron-level intervention strategy. First, we formulate a neuron localization paradigm that identifies functionally specialized neurons by characterizing intermediate-layer activation patterns and quantifying their functional salience through importance scoring. Building upon this paradigm, we exploit contrastive data to identify modality-bound safety neurons (BS-Neurons), and validate their role in regulating safety behavior within each modality via targeted suppression. Further cross-modal analysis defines modality-universal safety neurons (US-Neurons) as the shared subset of BS-Neurons identified across individual modalities, serving as the core for defending against harmful cross-modal attacks. We observe that suppressing these neurons substantially degrades safety performance across modalities, while leaving overall utility largely unaffected. Building on these insights, we propose two safety alignment strategies: activation-level safety amplifier and safety neuron calibrator. The proposed strategies enhance model safety through two distinct routes: the former amplifies the activation magnitudes of US-Neurons, while the latter selectively calibrates them via targeted fine-tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms prevailing state-of-the-art approaches on safety benchmarks spanning diverse modality combinations, while effectively preserving utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeNexus，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的跨模态安全对齐框架，采用神经元级干预策略。作者通过中间层激活模式与重要性打分定位模态通用安全神经元 (US-Neurons)，并验证抑制这些神经元会显著降低各模态的安全性能而几乎不影响整体效用。基于此提出激活级安全放大器和安全神经元校准器两种对齐策略，实验表明其在多种模态组合的安全基准上优于现有最先进方法并保持效用。
Motivation: LLM 的安全性能在扩展到 MLLM 时暴露出模态能力扩展与现有安全机制之间的显著差距，而当前防御大多局限于特定模态设置，难以应对更广泛的跨模态威胁。
Method: 方法分为三步：先建立神经元定位范式，通过中间层激活模式与功能显著性打分识别功能性神经元；再利用对比数据识别模态绑定安全神经元 (BS-Neurons) 并验证其作用；最后将各模态共有的 BS-Neurons 定义为模态通用安全神经元 (US-Neurons)。在此基础上提出两种安全对齐策略：激活级安全放大器 (activation-level safety amplifier) 放大 US-Neurons 的激活幅度，以及安全神经元校准器 (safety neuron calibrator) 通过定向微调对其进行校准。
Result: 摘要报告，抑制 US-Neurons 会显著降低各模态的安全性能，但整体效用基本不受影响；SafeNexus 在覆盖多种模态组合的安全基准上优于现有最先进方法，同时有效保持效用。
Conclusion: 作者认为，针对模态通用安全神经元进行神经元级干预是提升 MLLM 跨模态安全性的有效途径，能以较小的效用代价实现更强的安全对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A robust association between LLM use and scientific productivity: Assessing stopping-time selection
papers.abstract_en: Renault, Bergeaud, and Bosquet (hereafter RBB) argue that dating LLM adoption as the first month in which an author's abstract is flagged induces a stopping-time selection that can produce a positive event-study path even when there is no causal effect. Although this mechanism is mathematically possible, it does not constitute proof of a null effect. Recalibrating RBB's own random placebo to the detector's realized flag rate, we show that the measured association stays well above this benchmark, so the artifact is too small to explain the productivity changes. We further re-estimate the association between LLM adoption and productivity with a series of complementary designs in which the timing artifact cannot bias the estimate: a before-and-after comparison that dates adoption in one year and measures output in another, a conservative control group for difference-in-differences, an intensity-based specification that never defines an adoption date, and a rank-based measurement holding the flag rate fixed. A positive productivity association persists across all of these estimates, while the same tests run on pre-ChatGPT placebo data return null effects. The artifact RBB identify is real but bounded, and it does not account for the pattern we report.
papers.comment: Response to Renault, Bergeaud, and Bosquet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 Renault, Bergeaud, and Bosquet (RBB) 批评的回应。RBB 认为按摘要首次被标记为 LLM 使用的月份来定义采纳时点，会引入 stopping-time selection，即使没有因果效应也可能产生正向的事件研究路径。作者将 RBB 的随机安慰剂按检测器实际标记率重新校准，并用多种不受该时序伪影影响的补充设计重新估计，发现 LLM 采纳与科研产出率之间的正向关联仍然稳健。
Motivation: RBB 指出基于首次标记月份定义 LLM 采纳会带来 stopping-time selection，可能在没有真实因果效应时产生正向事件研究路径；作者需要检验该伪影是否能解释其此前报告的生产率变化。
Method: 作者首先将 RBB 的随机安慰剂重新校准到检测器实际标记率，以量化伪影规模；随后采用一系列不会受采纳时点偏误影响的估计：隔年测量产出的前后对比、保守对照组的双重差分 (difference-in-differences)、不定义采纳日期的强度型设定，以及固定标记率的秩次测量；并在 ChatGPT 之前的安慰剂数据上运行同样检验。
Result: 重新校准后，所测关联仍显著高于随机基准，说明伪影过小，无法解释生产率变化；上述所有替代设计下正向产出关联均持续存在，而 ChatGPT 之前的安慰剂数据返回零效应。
Conclusion: RBB 所指出的伪影确实存在但有界，不足以解释作者此前报告的生产率提升模式；作者强调其正向关联不是由 stopping-time selection 单独造成的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Visual Distribution Anchoring for Efficient Prompt Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Prompt tuning adapts vision--language models with few trainable parameters, but existing approaches trade off efficiency and adaptation: static textual prompts can overfit source classes, image-conditioned prompts add per-instance computation, and multimodal tuning modifies the visual branch. We propose VDA (Visual Distribution Anchoring), a training-free target adaptation framework that augments a frozen semantic classifier with class-level visual prototypes estimated offline from an unlabeled target pool. We first ask whether prototypes can be synthesized from class names. A text-to-centroid mapper reconstructs held-out source prototypes but fails under dataset shift because class names specify semantic identity, not target-domain appearance. An oracle analysis confirms that true target prototypes are highly discriminative. VDA therefore uses frozen semantic and domain-template classifiers to partition unlabeled target images into class-correlated groups. Confidence-ranked image features form normalized prototypes, fused with the semantic classifier using one global weight. Adaptation requires no target labels, target-side optimization, uniform class-prior assumption, iterative refinement, or test-query access, and yields a fixed, cacheable classifier. Controlled experiments show that class-specific partitioning drives gains and that visually local pseudo-label errors can remain useful despite being class-incorrect. Across ten ImageNet-to-target transfers, the same frozen design improves zero-shot CLIP, TCP, and MaPLe by 3.22, 3.39, and 3.35 points, respectively, improving nine of ten targets in every setting. Its visual correction further improves leakage-free PromptKD by 2.79 points, complementing zero-shot, source-prompted, multimodal-prompted, and target-distilled classifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VDA（Visual Distribution Anchoring），一种免训练的目标域适配框架，用离线从无标注目标图像池估计的类级视觉原型增强冻结的语义分类器。VDA 用冻结的语义与域模板分类器将目标图像分组，取置信度排序特征构造归一化原型，再以单一全局权重融合。在十个 ImageNet 到目标域的迁移中，同一冻结设计分别将 zero-shot CLIP、TCP、MaPLe 提升 3.22、3.39、3.35 个点，并将免泄漏 PromptKD 提升 2.79 个点。
Motivation: 现有提示调优在效率与适配能力之间存在权衡：静态文本提示会过拟合源类，图像条件提示增加逐实例计算，多模态调优则修改视觉分支。本文针对无需目标标签、无需目标侧优化的训练免费目标域适配问题。
Method: VDA 先通过 text-to-centroid mapper 验证类名无法合成目标域原型（在数据集偏移下失效），随后利用冻结的语义与域模板分类器将无标注目标图像划分为类相关分组，将置信度排序的图像特征构造成归一化原型，并以单一全局权重与冻结语义分类器融合。该方法无需目标标签、目标侧优化、均匀类先验、迭代精化或测试查询访问，产出固定的可缓存分类器。
Result: 受控实验表明类特定分组是增益来源，且视觉局部的伪标签错误即使类不正确仍可能有用。在十个 ImageNet 到目标域的迁移上，VDA 将 zero-shot CLIP、TCP、MaPLe 分别提升 3.22、3.39、3.35 个点，并在每个设置中改善九个目标；其视觉纠正为免泄漏 PromptKD 带来 2.79 个点的提升。

papers.title: Efficient LLM Adversarial Training via Low-Rank Defense and Circuit-Guided Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training is one of the most effective defenses against adversarial attacks, yet the computational cost remains prohibitive at modern scales, especially for large language models (LLMs). While existing mitigation strategies, e.g., latent adversarial training (LAT), have been developed, they still incur a high computational cost. In this work, we comprehensively investigate computation-efficient strategies to speed up LAT from two complementary perspectives: (1) Defense-side optimization: We explore the representation fine-tuning (ReFT) within LAT, and reveal a potential issue if there is a mismatch on which tokens to apply ReFT and the attack. (2) Attack-side optimization: When computing adversarial attacks in each LAT iteration, we extract only the relevant circuits from the LLM to construct a lightweight surrogate model, avoiding the computation in the forward-backward passes through the full model during the attack generation. For both perspectives, we provide theoretical justifications and numerical evidence to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategies. Ultimately, compared to standard LAT with full fine-tuning, our method on average reduces per-step adversarial-training FLOPs by 48.1% while requiring only 0.0118% trainable parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何降低大语言模型（LLM）对抗训练的计算开销，围绕潜在对抗训练（latent adversarial training, LAT）提出两种互补的加速策略：防御侧优化（在 LAT 中使用表示微调 ReFT，并指出应用 ReFT 的 token 与攻击位置不匹配可能带来的问题）和攻击侧优化（只抽取 LLM 中的相关电路（circuits）构建轻量代理模型来生成对抗攻击，避免全模型前向-反向传播）。作者给出理论依据和数值证据，并报告相比标准 LAT 全参数微调，平均每步对抗训练 FLOPs 降低 48.1%，且仅需 0.0118% 的可训练参数。
Motivation: 对抗训练是有效的防御手段，但在大语言模型规模下计算成本过高；现有缓解方案如 LAT 仍然昂贵，需要进一步降低训练开销。
Method: 从两个视角优化 LAT：一是防御侧，在 LAT 中引入表示微调（ReFT）并分析 ReFT 应用 token 与攻击 token 不匹配的问题；二是攻击侧，每轮 LAT 迭代中仅提取 LLM 的相关电路构建轻量代理模型来生成对抗样本，避免全模型的前后向计算。
Result: 相比标准 LAT 全参数微调，该方法平均每步对抗训练 FLOPs 降低 48.1%，且只需 0.0118% 的可训练参数。
Conclusion: 作者通过理论论证和数值实验说明所提出的计算高效策略能显著加速 LAT，同时保持对抗训练的有效性。

papers.title: MerchantBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Long-Term Coherence in E-Commerce Operations
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly evaluated as autonomous tool users, yet most benchmarks focus on bounded tasks with immediate success criteria. Real-world deployments often require Long-Term Coherence, the capacity to preserve purposeful behavior across extended horizons while adapting decisions to accumulated evidence. Evaluating this capacity requires a persistent environment in which actions constrain future choices, feedback arrives at heterogeneous delays, and incoherent behavior produces measurable cumulative effects. Seller-side e-commerce provides a suitable setting for this evaluation through recurrent and interdependent decisions over Product Sourcing, Listing and Pricing Control, Cash-Flow Management, and Mixed-Latency Feedback Adaptation. We introduce MerchantBench, a 365-day order-level simulation grounded in 98,843 real e-commerce product records and equipped with 26 tools for agent interaction. MerchantBench couples promptly observable Upstream Supplier Events with delayed Downstream Order Outcomes, requiring agents to follow individual order lifecycles and revisit earlier decisions. We evaluate eight LLMs under two agent frameworks in 48 runs, each spanning 365 simulated days. Our results reveal a substantial gap between even the latest LLMs and human participants, with the best LLM configuration attaining only 27.3\% of the mean final net assets achieved by human participants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MerchantBench，一个面向电商运营场景的 LLM 智能体长期一致性 (Long-Term Coherence) 评测基准。它以 98,843 条真实电商商品记录为基础构建 365 天的订单级仿真环境，并提供 26 个工具供智能体交互，将即时可见的上游供应商事件与延迟反馈的下游订单结果耦合起来。作者在两种智能体框架下评测了 8 个 LLM，共 48 次、每次 365 天的运行，结果表明表现最好的 LLM 配置仅达到人类参与者平均最终净资产的 27.3%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准大多聚焦有即时成功标准的受限任务，而真实部署要求智能体在长时间跨度内保持目的性行为，并依据累积证据调整决策；这需要行动会约束未来选择、反馈延迟异构且非连贯行为产生可测累积效应的持久环境。卖家侧电商恰好通过重复且相互依赖的决策提供此类评测场景。
Method: 构建 MerchantBench 仿真平台：基于 98,843 条真实电商商品记录的 365 天订单级仿真，配备 26 个交互工具，覆盖商品采购、上架与定价控制、现金流管理以及混合延迟反馈适应等环节。环境将即时可观察的上游供应商事件与延迟出现的下游订单结果相耦合，要求智能体跟踪单个订单生命周期并重新审视早期决策。
Result: 在两种 agent 框架下对 8 个 LLM 展开 48 次、每次持续 365 个模拟日的评测；最佳 LLM 配置获得的平均最终净资产仅为人类参与者平均值的 27.3%，显示最新 LLM 与人类之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基准用于评测持久环境中智能体的长期一致性能力，并指出即便最新 LLM 在该任务上仍远逊于人类参与者。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Retrieval-Driven Training-Free AI-Generated Video Attribution
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated videos are becoming increasingly realistic and difficult to distinguish from authentic ones, which facilitates malicious misuse and poses growing threats to cybersecurity and social governance. Attributing AI-generated videos to their specific generative sources is therefore of critical importance for forensic investigation and legal regulation. However, most existing visual attribution methods focus on images and particularly rely on the image generation model, thereby lacking the ability to generalize to large-scale AI-generated video data. To address these limitations, we introduce an training-free AI-generated video attribution paradigm. Specifically, we formulates AI-generated video attribution as an instance retrieval task, and design a generative fingerprint-based pipeline. This pipeline consists of an adapted orthogonal color transformation, multi-scale quantized residual generation, and temporal-semantic aggregation, progressively capturing and integrating artifacts introduced by generative models across video frames. Extensive experiments on the GenVidBench benchmark demonstrate that our method achieves strong performance in both AI-generated video detection and attribution, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods with a Rank-1 accuracy of 20.5% and a mean Average Precision of 16.6%. The code is at https://github.com/renxi-seu/Video_Attribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的AI生成视频归因方法，将视频归因建模为实例检索任务，并设计基于生成指纹的流水线，包括正交颜色变换、多尺度量化残差生成和时序-语义聚合。在GenVidBench基准上，该方法在AI生成视频检测与归因任务上优于现有方法，Rank-1准确率为20.5%，平均精度均值为16.6%。
Motivation: 现有视觉归因方法大多针对图像且依赖图像生成模型，难以推广到大规模AI生成视频数据；而AI生成视频日益逼真，给取证调查和法律监管带来挑战。
Method: 将AI生成视频归因重构为实例检索任务，提出训练免费的生成指纹流水线，包含自适应正交颜色变换、多尺度量化残差生成和时序-语义聚合，逐步捕获并整合生成模型在视频帧间引入的伪影。
Result: 在GenVidBench基准上的实验显示，该方法在AI生成视频检测和归因任务上均取得强性能，Rank-1准确率为20.5%，平均精度均值（mAP）为16.6%，优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该训练免费的视频归因范式可有效泛化到大规模AI生成视频数据，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Mining Verdict Boundaries for Neural Network Verification
papers.abstract_en: Branch and Bound (BaB) aims to achieve complete verification of neural networks by adaptively partitioning the problem and applying off-the-shelf verifiers to subproblems. Its problem-splitting history can be represented as a tree, where each subproblem corresponds to a child node. A key problem of BaB lies in searching for the verdict boundaries across all the paths that divide the verified and unverified subproblems. We observe that the existing BaB approach tackles this problem by solving each expensive subproblem sequentially along the tree path as its depth increases, requiring costly bounds propagation at every visited BaB tree node (i.e., subproblem), which is inefficient. To address this issue, we propose effective search approaches that leverage the monotonicity of each path to efficiently and precisely locate the verdict boundary by simultaneously splitting multiple activation functions (e.g., ReLU), rather than processing them one at a time as in the classical approach. Our approach performs an effective exponential search along each path, allowing us to skip many boundary-unrelated subproblems when identifying the verdict boundary. The enhanced version further improves this process by estimating the boundary's position using quantitative information obtained from subproblem solving. We perform experimental evaluation on commonly-used benchmarks to assess our proposed techniques, and compare them with recent BaB-based approaches.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Published in the proceedings of the 27th International Symposium on Formal Methods (FM 2026)
papers.journal_ref: In: Sampaio, A., Stoelinga, M. (eds.), Formal Methods, FM 2026, Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16556, pp. 67-88, Springer Nature Switzerland, Cham, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于 Branch and Bound (BaB) 的神经网络完备验证问题，研究如何高效定位划分已验证与未验证子问题的判定边界 (verdict boundary)。作者观察到现有 BaB 沿树路径随深度递增逐个求解昂贵子问题，并在每个访问节点都需进行代价高昂的边界传播 (bounds propagation)，效率低下；为此提出利用路径单调性同时分裂多个激活函数 (如 ReLU) 的指数搜索方法，可跳过大量与边界无关的子问题，增强版本还用子问题求解得到的定量信息估计边界位置。实验在常用基准上评估并与近期 BaB 方法比较。
Motivation: 在 BaB 验证中，沿树路径逐层求解子问题并在每个节点进行边界传播来定位判定边界非常低效，而许多子问题与最终边界无关却仍会被求解。
Method: 利用每条路径的单调性，同时分裂多个激活函数 (如 ReLU) 而非逐个处理，并对每条路径执行有效的指数搜索 (exponential search) 以跳过与边界无关的子问题；增强版本通过子问题求解得到的定量信息估计边界位置，进一步加速定位。
Result: 论文在常用基准上对所提技术进行实验评估，并与近期基于 BaB 的方法作比较；摘要未报告具体的量化结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用路径单调性和指数搜索能够高效且精确地定位 verdict boundary，显著减少与边界无关子问题的求解开销。

papers.title: Automated classification method of COVID-19 cases from chest CT volumes using 2D and 3D hybrid CNN for anisotropic volumes
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes an automated classification method of chest CT volumes based on likelihood of COVID-19 cases. Novel coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) spreads over the world, causing a large number of infected patients and deaths. Sudden increase in the number of COVID-19 patients causes a manpower shortage in medical institutions. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system provides quick and quantitative diagnosis results. CAD system for COVID-19 enables efficient diagnosis workflow and contributes to reduce such manpower shortage. This paper proposes an automated classification method of chest CT volumes for COVID-19 diagnosis assistance. We propose a COVID-19 classification convolutional neural network (CNN) that has a 2D/3D hybrid feature extraction flows. The 2D/3D hybrid feature extraction flows are designed to effectively extract image features from anisotropic volumes such as chest CT volumes for diagnosis. The flows extract image features on three mutually perpendicular planes in CT volumes and then combine the features to perform classification. Classification accuracy of the proposed method was evaluated using a dataset that contains 1288 CT volumes. An averaged classification accuracy was 83.3%. The accuracy was higher than that of a classification CNN which does not have 2D and 3D hybrid feature extraction flows.
papers.comment: Oral Presentation in SPIE Medical Imaging 2022
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of SPIE Medical Imaging 2022, Computer-Aided Diagnosis, Vol. 12033
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于胸部CT体数据的COVID-19疑似病例自动分类方法，核心是设计具有2D/3D混合特征提取流的卷积神经网络（CNN），以适应胸部CT等各向异性体数据。该方法在包含1288个CT体数据的数据集上取得83.3%的平均分类准确率，高于不含2D/3D混合特征提取流的分类CNN。
Motivation: COVID-19患者激增导致医疗机构人手不足，需要快速且定量的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统来提升诊断流程效率。针对胸部CT体数据的各向异性特点，现有分类CNN难以有效提取图像特征，因此需要专门设计混合特征提取结构。
Method: 提出一种COVID-19分类CNN，具有2D/3D混合特征提取流：在CT体数据中三个互相垂直的平面上分别提取图像特征，然后将这些特征融合用于分类，以适配各向异性体数据。
Result: 在包含1288个CT体数据的数据集上，该方法平均分类准确率为83.3%，高于没有2D/3D混合特征提取流的分类CNN。
Conclusion: 作者认为2D/3D混合特征提取流能够有效提升胸部CT体数据上的COVID-19分类性能，可用于诊断辅助。摘要未提及方法在其他数据集或更多指标上的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overcoming the Weakest-Link Effect in LLM-Driven Program Optimization via Heterogeneous Edit Recombination
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to solve complex problems by searching over program space, offering a general paradigm for scientific problems that can be naturally represented and solved as programs. Despite recent progress, identifying effective optimization directions for a candidate program remains challenging. By analogy with automatic differentiation, existing methods typically guide the search using a textual ``gradient'': a first-order update direction expressed as textual edits. Such gradients are inferred either from previously evaluated programs or from LLM-generated feedback on the implicit program-score mapping. However, these estimates become increasingly unreliable as the program--score mapping grows more complex, limiting their practical utility. We argue that explicit gradients are not essential for effective program optimization. Leveraging their prior knowledge, LLMs can propose plausible atomic edits directly from the current program, thereby enabling a zeroth-order optimization strategy. However, zeroth-order search suffers from a \textit{weakest-link effect}: when a bundle of edits is accepted or rejected as a whole, a single harmful edit can negate the benefits of all remaining edits. To address this issue, we introduce HERO, a program optimizer that prompts an LLM to generate diverse, non-overlapping atomic edits and then systematically selects and composes them into coherent program improvements using evaluator scores. We evaluate HERO across algorithmic problems, strategy games, the design of LLM-based agentic systems, and robotic path planning. Across these domains, HERO consistently discovers higher-scoring programs and converges substantially faster than prior LLM-based optimizers, while consuming fewer tokens.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 驱动的程序优化问题，指出现有方法依赖由文本编辑构成的一阶“梯度”更新方向，但在程序-分数映射变复杂时这类估计并不可靠。作者提出 HERO，一种零阶优化策略：让 LLM 基于先验知识直接生成多样且互不重叠的原子编辑，再依据评估分数系统性选择并组合成连贯的程序改进。摘要报告 HERO 在算法问题、策略游戏、LLM 智能体系统设计和机器人路径规划等多个领域一致发现更高分数的程序，收敛更快且 token 消耗更少。
Motivation: 现有方法类比自动微分，通过由已评估程序或 LLM 反馈推断出来的文本梯度来引导搜索，但随着程序-分数映射复杂度上升，这些梯度估计变得不可靠。作者认为显式梯度并非程序优化所必需，并指出零阶搜索会遭受最弱环节效应（weakest-link effect）：当一组编辑被整体接受或拒绝时，单个有害编辑会抵消其余编辑的全部收益。
Method: 提出 HERO 程序优化器，核心是提示 LLM 生成多样化、互不重叠（non-overlapping）的原子编辑，然后利用评估器分数（evaluator scores）系统地筛选并组合这些编辑，以构造连贯的程序改进。
Result: 在算法问题、策略游戏、基于 LLM 的智能体系统设计以及机器人路径规划等领域的评估中，HERO 一致地发现更高分数的程序，收敛速度显著快于之前的 LLM 优化器，且消耗更少的 token。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式梯度并非 LLM 程序优化的必要条件，通过异构编辑重组可以克服最弱环节效应并提升优化效率；摘要未给出具体的量化数值或明确局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shapley-Value-Based Feature Attribution for Data Masking
papers.abstract_en: Despite its many benefits, widespread access to individuals' personal data also causes severe privacy concerns for consumers, companies, and policymakers. This study proposes a novel framework that adapts the Shapley-value-based feature attribution approach to the problem domain of data privacy by capturing the two crucial dimensions of data privacy---disclosure risk and data utility. Our proposed framework takes a holistic view of data masking through a fair feature attribution approach based on Shapley values. Different from the existing literature that mostly focuses on the risk-utility tradeoff at the dataset level, the proposed framework addresses the tradeoff at the feature level. Furthermore, the proposed framework is agnostic to data masking methods, statistical and machine learning methods, and data utility and disclosure risk evaluation metrics. Experimental results show that our proposed method can effectively reduce disclosure risk while preserving data utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于Shapley值的特征归因框架，用于数据脱敏（data masking），同时刻画披露风险（disclosure risk）和数据效用（data utility）两个维度。与现有研究主要在数据集层面权衡风险与效用不同，该框架在特征层面处理权衡，并且对脱敏方法、统计/机器学习方法以及评估指标不可知（agnostic）。实验表明该方法能在保持数据效用的同时有效降低披露风险。
Motivation: 个人数据的广泛获取引发严重隐私担忧，而现有数据脱敏文献大多在数据集层面（dataset level）权衡披露风险与数据效用，缺少在特征层面进行公平特征归因的框架。
Method: 提出一个基于Shapley值的特征归因框架，将Shapley值适应到数据隐私领域，同时捕获披露风险和数据效用两个维度；该框架对脱敏方法、统计/机器学习方法以及效用与风险评估指标均不可知。
Result: 实验结果显示，所提方法能够在保持数据效用的同时有效降低披露风险。
Conclusion: 该框架从特征层面解决风险-效用权衡，并与具体脱敏方法和评估指标无关；摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0
