papers.title: FlexPath: Adapting Learned Connectivity Guidance to Path Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Recent learning-based path planners use neural networks to process occupancy representations and approximate heuristics for classical search algorithms, yielding near-optimal paths with reduced search effort. However, these methods are tied to a fixed objective, usually the shortest-path objective, implicit in their supervision. This limits their flexibility to accommodate alternative criteria. We introduce $\textbf{FlexPath}$, a two-stage learned search-guidance framework that first learns a recall-oriented connectivity prior initialized from shortest-path planner demonstrations and then refines this prior using differentiable path-shape objectives, thereby separating demonstration-based learning of $\textbf{connectivity-biased guidance}$ from subsequent $\textbf{objective specific refinement}$. Beyond enabling adaptation to new routing preferences, the two-stage procedure improves standard shortest-path planning itself: on TMP, FlexPath improves optimal-path recovery from 75.0\% to 88.6\% over TransPath while reducing search expansions by 13.8\%. Ablations show that neither prior learning nor objective fine-tuning alone matches the full pipeline; their combination yields the strongest path cost and search efficiency. We further demonstrate the preference adaptation by adapting guidance to non-shortest-path objectives such as obstacle clearance, class-conditioned obstacle clearance and waypoint following. For clearance with $d_{\min}=2$, FlexPath achieves 96.2\% full clearance satisfaction on feasible instances while maintaining low search effort, and it reaches 98.4\% waypoint-following success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexPath 提出一个两阶段的 learned search-guidance 框架：先用最短路径规划器演示学习一个偏向连通性的先验，再用可微路径形状目标微调，从而把基于演示的连通性引导与面向特定目标的优化解耦。在 TMP 基准上，FlexPath 相比 TransPath 将最优路径恢复率从 75.0% 提升到 88.6%，并减少 13.8% 的搜索扩展。文章还展示该方法可适应非最短路径目标，如障碍物净空、类别条件净空和航点跟随。
Motivation: 现有学习型路径规划器通常隐式绑定最短路径目标，难以适应其他路径偏好；作者希望分离连通性先验学习与目标任务相关的引导优化，以提升灵活性和规划效果。
Method: 两阶段训练：第一阶段从最短路径规划器的演示中学习 recall-oriented 的连通性先验，第二阶段用可微路径形状目标（如障碍物净空、航点跟随）对该先验进行目标特定的精炼。
Result: 在 TMP 上，FlexPath 的最优路径恢复率从 TransPath 的 75.0% 提升到 88.6%，搜索扩展减少 13.8%；消融显示单一阶段无法匹敌完整流程。对 d_min=2 的净空目标，可行实例上达到 96.2% 的全净空满足率，航点跟随成功率达 98.4%。
Conclusion: 作者强调两阶段流程将演示驱动的连通性引导与目标特定精炼分离，二者组合带来最强的路径成本与搜索效率，并可适配多种非最短路径偏好。

papers.title: A Multi-Agent System for Motor Design Optimization via an FEA-AI Hybrid Approach
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework for interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) design optimization that mitigates limitations of conventional workflows: expertise-dependent problem setup and data preparation, the prohibitive computational cost of finite element analysis (FEA), and the unreliability of AI surrogates in unexplored regions. To this end, we first introduce a Design agent that formulates the optimization problem in natural language, leveraging retrieval-augmented generation to improve answer accuracy on motor design problems from below 50% to 67-80%. Furthermore, a Training agent autonomously repairs improperly defined design spaces by reasoning over solver failure history, raising the success ratio of the geometry sampling from 28% to 84% for AI training. Additionally, to resolve cost and reliability simultaneously, an Optimization agent employs an uncertainty-aware FEA-AI hybrid model: the AI surrogate is the primary evaluator, and FEA is selectively invoked where predictive uncertainty is high. Under the same FEA budget, this hybrid model achieves up to 44% lower iron loss in single-objective and 22.5% higher hypervolume in multi-objective optimization than conventional FEA-only search. Under the same evaluation budget, it reduces computation time by 52-55% while retaining 90-92% of FEA-only hypervolume. Conversely, AI-only search converges to false optima, leaving half its Pareto designs infeasible. Notably, a controller agent adaptively updates the uncertainty threshold that triggers FEA each round, eliminating manual tuning and achieving 5.8% lower single objective iron loss than with a fixed threshold. These results establish domain specialized LLM agents with uncertainty-aware hybrid evaluation as a reliable, scalable paradigm for simulation-driven design automation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的多智能体框架，用于内置式永磁同步电机 (IPMSM) 设计优化，核心是结合检索增强生成、自主设计空间修复和不确定性感知的 FEA-AI 混合评估。摘要报告该方法在相同 FEA 预算下实现更低的铁损和更高的多目标超体积，并在保持大部分性能的同时大幅减少计算时间。
Motivation: 传统电机设计工作流依赖专家进行问题设定和数据准备，有限元分析 (FEA) 计算成本高昂，而 AI 替代模型在未探索区域不可靠。作者希望用 LLM 智能体自动化问题构建、修复错误设计空间，并同时兼顾评估成本与可靠性。
Method: 提出多个智能体：Design agent 用自然语言形式化优化问题并借助检索增强生成 (RAG) 提升答案准确率；Training agent 根据求解器失败历史自动修复不恰当的设计空间；Optimization agent 使用不确定性感知的 FEA-AI 混合模型，以 AI 代理评估为主、在高预测不确定性处选择性调用 FEA；Controller agent 每轮自适应更新触发 FEA 的不确定性阈值。
Result: 摘要中的量化结果：RAG 将电机设计问题回答准确率从低于 50% 提升到 67-80%；几何采样成功率从 28% 提升到 84%；相同 FEA 预算下，单目标铁损最多降低 44%，多目标超体积提高 22.5%；相同评估预算下计算时间减少 52-55%，同时保留 90-92% 的 FEA-only 超体积。AI-only 搜索会收敛到伪最优点，留下半数 Pareto 设计不可行；自适应阈值比固定阈值的单目标铁损低 5.8%。
Conclusion: 作者总结，领域专用的 LLM 智能体配合不确定性感知的混合评估，可以为仿真驱动的设计自动化提供可靠且可扩展的范式。摘要未强调明显局限，主要论证其对 FEA 预算与可靠性的平衡价值。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network for Polymer Classification Using Terahertz Spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: Reliable polymer identification is essential for ensuring the quality and safety of recycled plastics, yet conventional sorting and spectroscopic techniques often struggle to deliver robust discrimination. Terahertz (THz) spectroscopy offers a promising alternative, providing high-resolution and non-destructive measurements. In this work, we leverage THz signals to classify 12 types of polymers, including pure polymers, multilayer films, commercial blends, and biopolymers. To handle the complexity of these spectral signals, we propose the Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network (MSFAN), a novel deep learning architecture tailored for THz data. The framework integrates feature gating for signal recalibration and multi-scale parallel convolutions to capture diverse frequency patterns. These features are further refined through cross-feature attention and attention pooling, enabling the model to intrinsically highlight the most informative THz regions. MSFAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, reaching a classification accuracy of 85.2%. This study demonstrates the potential of combining THz spectroscopy with deep learning techniques for effective, scalable, and interpretable polymer classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度特征注意力网络 (MSFAN)，利用太赫兹 (THz) 光谱对12类聚合物进行分类，涵盖纯聚合物、多层膜、商业共混物和生物聚合物。摘要报告该方法达到85.2%的分类准确率，持续优于现有最先进模型，并展示了太赫兹光谱与深度学习结合用于可扩展、可解释聚合物分类的潜力。
Motivation: 可靠识别聚合物对回收塑料的质量与安全至关重要，但传统分选和光谱技术难以提供稳健的判别；太赫兹光谱作为高分辨率、非破坏性的替代方案，其光谱信号复杂，需要专门设计的深度学习架构来处理。
Method: 提出MSFAN架构，集成特征门控 (feature gating) 进行信号重校准，使用多尺度并行卷积捕获不同的频率模式，并通过跨特征注意力 (cross-feature attention) 与注意力池化 (attention pooling) 进一步细化特征，使模型能内在突出最具信息量的太赫兹区域。
Result: MSFAN在12类聚合物分类任务上达到85.2%的准确率，摘要称其一致优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了太赫兹光谱与深度学习结合对有效、可扩展且可解释的聚合物分类的可行性；作为会议论文，其适用范围限于文中涉及的聚合物类别与实验设置。

papers.title: The Self-Correction Illusion: Role Relabeling Gates Explicit Error Flagging in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent works show that LLM agents struggle to correct errors in their own reasoning traces, despite their ability to correct errors from external sources. We ask whether this reflects a capability deficit or an artifact of the role labeling. To test this, we design a training-free intervention, source-conditioned role relabeling, that keeps the erroneous claim byte-identical and varies only its message role. The claim is presented inside the agent's "<thought>", a user message, a tool response, or a system "<memory>" block. We test 12 model-domain combinations spanning closed-weight APIs and open-weight models from 70B-class down to smaller families. Relabeling "<thought>" to an external role increases the explicit-correction rate by 23 to 93 percentage points, significant in 10 of 12 experimental settings. This suggests that these models' failure to detect a self-generated error is largely an artifact of how the claim is role-labeled in the chat template, rather than a pure cognitive deficit. The most effective role label is domain-dependent: "<memory>" dominates in most math experiments, while a user message dominates in logical deduction. Recognizing role-label handling as a key experimental variable in instruction tuning presents a more direct path to closing the self-correction gap.d
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑大语言模型（LLM）智能体无法纠正自身推理轨迹中的错误，究竟是能力缺陷还是角色标注（role labeling）的产物。作者提出一种无需训练（training-free）的干预手段——基于来源的条件角色重标注（source-conditioned role relabeling），保持错误声明逐字节不变，仅改变其在对话模板中的消息角色（如 <thought>、用户消息、工具响应、系统 <memory>）。在 12 个模型-领域组合上，将 <thought> 重标注为外部角色可使显式纠正率提升 23 到 93 个百分点，且在 10/12 的设置中显著，说明自我错误检测失败在很大程度上是角色标注导致的伪影而非纯粹认知缺陷。
Motivation: 已有研究表明 LLM 智能体难以纠正自身推理轨迹中的错误，却能纠正外部来源的错误；本文旨在判断这种不对称是能力缺陷还是角色标注带来的伪影。
Method: 设计训练无关的干预方法 source-conditioned role relabeling：将同一错误声明分别放入 <thought>、用户消息、工具响应或系统 <memory> 块中，仅改变消息角色而保持声明内容不变，再比较显式纠正率。

papers.title: Physics from Video: Identifiability of Time-Invariant Second-Order ODEs under Minimal Trajectory Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Bridging the gap between visual realism and physical understanding is a core challenge for video-based world models. We study the structural identifiability of continuous-time physical laws from raw pixels, focusing on whether an encoder-only pipeline can uniquely recover the parameters of second-order linear ODEs. We prove that a level-set slope-coverage condition ensures the learned latent space is locally affine to the true physical state, enabling exact parameter recovery. Our theory provides the first characterization of minimal data requirements across damping regimes, establishing that underdamped systems are identifiable from a single video clip, whereas other regimes require three diverse trajectories. We further introduce a variance-floor regularizer to stabilize the decoder-free objective and prevent latent collapse. Validated on synthetic and real-world data, our approach demonstrates that interpretable physical constants can be reliably estimated from video without the need for compute-intensive pixel reconstruction, ensuring both physical correctness and transparency. Code is available at https://github.com/wenjiewang3/PhysicsFromVideo.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Updated to the camera-ready version; main results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从原始视频像素中恢复连续时间物理定律的可辨识性（structural identifiability），聚焦于仅用编码器（encoder-only）管道能否唯一恢复二阶线性常微分方程的参数。作者证明一个基于水平集斜率覆盖（level-set slope-coverage）的条件可以保证学习到的隐空间与真实物理状态局部仿射，从而实现精确参数恢复，并首次刻画了不同阻尼 regime 下的最小数据需求。
Motivation: 视频世界模型需要在视觉真实感与物理理解之间架起桥梁，而现有方法通常依赖计算昂贵的像素重建。本文瞄准的问题是：在不重建像素的前提下，能否从原始视频可靠地估计物理常数。
Method: 提出对二阶线性 ODE 的可辨识性理论分析，证明水平集斜率覆盖条件能确保隐空间与真实物理状态的局部仿射关系；同时引入方差下限正则化器（variance-floor regularizer）来稳定无解码器（decoder-free）的训练目标并防止隐空间坍缩。
Result: 理论结果表明，欠阻尼（underdamped）系统可从单个视频片段辨识，而其他阻尼 regime 需要三条多样化轨迹；在合成和真实数据上的实验验证了无需像素重建即可可靠估计可解释的物理常数。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法能在不需要计算密集型像素重建的前提下保证物理正确性和透明性，代码已公开。

papers.title: Commit to the Bit: Reactive Reinforcement Learning Done Right
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning algorithms are commonly analyzed (and designed) under the Markov assumption. This is unrealistic, as most environments encountered in practice are either partially observable, or require function approximation that restricts the agent to access non-Markovian state features. We consider the problem of learning an optimal reactive policy in a finite environment with deterministic observations (or equivalently, hard state aggregation). We introduce a new algorithm, Committed Q-learning, and prove almost-sure convergence to the optimal reactive policy under an intuitive assumption we call rewire-robustness. This assumption is strictly weaker than the $q_\star$-realizability condition used in prior work. Our algorithm is a variant of classical Q-learning in which the behavior policy commits to a single action upon entering a feature, and only resamples actions when the observed feature changes. A crucial part of our analysis is the introduction of quasi-Markov environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在有限环境、确定性观测（或等价于硬状态聚合）下学习最优反应式策略（reactive policy）的问题，指出常见强化学习算法依赖的 Markov 假设在部分可观测或函数逼近受限时并不成立。作者提出 Committed Q-learning 算法，并证明在称为 rewire-robustness 的假设下几乎必然收敛到最优反应式策略，该假设严格弱于先前工作使用的 $q_\star$-realizability 条件。分析的关键是引入准 Markov 环境（quasi-Markov environments）这一概念。
Motivation: 大多数强化学习算法在 Markov 假设下分析和设计，但实际环境往往部分可观测，或函数逼近使智能体只能访问非 Markov 状态特征。为此，论文考虑在具有确定性观测的有限环境中学习最优反应式策略的问题，并希望放松先前收敛性分析所需的假设。
Method: 提出 Committed Q-learning，它是经典 Q-learning 的一种变体：行为策略在进入某个特征（feature）时承诺（commit）采用单个动作，仅在观测到的特征改变时才重新采样动作。理论分析引入准 Markov 环境，并证明在 rewire-robustness 假设下算法几乎必然收敛到最优反应式策略。
Result: 摘要报告该算法几乎必然收敛到最优反应式策略，且所需的 rewire-robustness 假设严格弱于先前工作中使用的 $q_\star$-realizability 条件。
Conclusion: 论文表明，通过让行为策略在特征内对动作做出承诺，可以在比既有可学习性条件更弱的假设下保证收敛到最优反应式策略。其适用范围限于有限环境与确定性观测（硬状态聚合）设定。

papers.title: RAPNet: Accelerating Algebraic Multigrid with Learned Sparse Corrections
papers.abstract_en: The scalable solution of large sparse linear systems is a bottleneck in scientific computing and graph analysis. While algebraic multigrid (AMG) offers optimal linear scaling, its performance is severely constrained by the trade-off between the sparsity and convergence quality of coarse-grid operators. Classical AMG heuristics struggle to balance these objectives, often sacrificing stability or performance for sparsity. We propose RAPNet, a graph neural network (GNN) framework that resolves this trade-off by learning to generate sparse, robust coarse operators directly from the sparse algebraic system. Key to our approach is a level-wise training strategy that enables learning from small subgraphs and generalization to million-node domains, bypassing the bottlenecks of prior neural AMG attempts. RAPNet executes exclusively during the solver setup phase, ensuring that the solve phase retains its favorable computational properties. We show that our method outperforms classical non-Galerkin baselines on diverse PDE discretizations and graph Laplacians, making it particularly effective for multi-query tasks such as eigenproblems, time-dependent simulations, and inverse or design problems.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea Code available at https://github.com/idoby/rapnet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAPNet，一个基于图神经网络 (GNN) 的框架，用于加速代数多重网格 (AMG) 求解大型稀疏线性系统。RAPNet 直接从稀疏代数系统中学习生成稀疏且鲁棒的粗网格算子，以解决经典 AMG 启发式方法在稀疏性与收敛质量之间的权衡。方法仅在求解器设置阶段执行，保持求解阶段的计算特性；分层训练策略使其能从小子图学习并泛化到百万节点规模的域。
Motivation: 大型稀疏线性系统的可扩展求解是科学计算和图分析中的瓶颈；AMG 虽具有最优线性扩展，但经典启发式方法难以同时保证粗网格算子的稀疏性和收敛质量，常牺牲稳定性或性能。
Method: 提出 RAPNet，一个 GNN 框架，通过从稀疏代数系统学习生成稀疏、鲁棒的粗网格算子；其核心是层级式 (level-wise) 训练策略，支持从小子图学习并推广到百万节点域，且训练/生成只在求解器设置阶段进行。
Result: 摘要报告 RAPNet 在多种 PDE 离散化和图拉普拉斯问题上优于经典非 Galerkin 基线，并且对特征值问题、时变模拟以及反问题或设计问题等多查询任务特别有效。
Conclusion: 作者强调 RAPNet 通过学习稀疏粗化算子解决了 AMG 中稀疏性与鲁棒性的权衡，且不损害求解阶段的计算优势。

papers.title: PixIE: Prompted Pixel-Space Low-Light Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Low-light images suffer from severe noise, contrast loss, and semantic ambiguity, making enhancement a joint problem of denoising and detail recovery. We propose PixIE, a feed-forward pixel-space LLIE framework semantically prompted by a foundation model (FM). PixIE first performs cross-scale denoising to suppress noise while preserving structure, then refines details using Prompted Pixel Blocks (PPBs), which inject intermediate FM features through a novel spatially continuous modulation (SCMo). To make pixel-space attention efficient across scales, we introduce Spatial-Channel Compaction (SCC), which jointly reduces the spatial token grid and channel dimension. We further propose Multi-Receptive-Field Pixel Embedding (MRPE) to provide neighborhood-aware pixel representations before semantic prompting, improving robustness to signal-dependent noise beyond point-wise embeddings. Experiments on standard LLIE benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, achieving the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on the challenging LOLv2-Real benchmark. Qualitative comparisons further show sharper details with more natural and consistent textures, improving both reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixIE，一种由基础模型语义提示的前馈像素空间低光图像增强（LLIE）框架。PixIE 先通过跨尺度去噪抑制噪声并保持结构，再利用 Prompted Pixel Blocks（PPBs）经空间连续调制（SCMo）注入基础模型的中间特征以细化细节。为提升跨尺度像素空间注意力的效率与鲁棒性，引入 Spatial-Channel Compaction（SCC）和 Multi-Receptive-Field Pixel Embedding（MRPE）。在标准 LLIE 基准上取得 SOTA 结果，并在 LOLv2-Real 上达到最佳 PSNR、SSIM 与 LPIPS。
Motivation: 低光图像同时遭受严重噪声、对比度损失和语义模糊，增强需要联合处理去噪与细节恢复；像素空间语义提示与跨尺度计算效率是其中的关键挑战。
Method: 提出 PixIE 框架，包含跨尺度去噪模块、Prompted Pixel Blocks（PPBs）与空间连续调制（SCMo）；通过 Spatial-Channel Compaction（SCC）联合压缩空间 token 网格与通道维度，并提出 Multi-Receptive-Field Pixel Embedding（MRPE）提供邻域感知的像素表示，以增强对信号相关噪声的鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告 PixIE 在标准 LLIE 基准上取得最先进性能，在 LOLv2-Real 上实现最佳 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS；定性比较显示更锐利的细节以及更自然一致的纹理。
Conclusion: 论文强调将像素空间语义提示与高效注意力机制结合，可在重建保真度与感知质量两方面同时取得改进。摘要未提及其局限。

papers.title: MARGIN: Runtime Confidence Calibration for Multi-Agent Foundation Model Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model pools are increasingly used as black-box responders in coordinated systems where a coordinator must decide which response to trust. Raw self-reported confidence is the natural signal, but is not comparable across models and becomes stale under distribution shift when corrected only at design time. We study runtime confidence calibration for multi-model coordination, where per-model corrections are learned online from deployment outcomes with no model access, no held-out calibration data, and no retraining. Across 18 open-weight foundation models, 8 benchmarks, and over 44,000 observations, we find that online adaptation is a family property: simple same-information online calibrators close most of the calibration gap left by frozen design-time methods under shift, and the forgetting schedule is the dominant design axis. We present MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation), a structured member of this family that maintains per-model, per-confidence-band multiplicative factors using symmetric exponentially weighted updates and shrinkage blending. MARGIN does not dominate the online family on expected calibration error (ECE) under abrupt shift. Its value lies in interpretable confidence-band trust factors, defined cold-start and returning-model behaviour, dynamic-pool support, and a scoped symmetric-update guarantee for fixed-policy non-strategic agents. Empirically, raw verbalized confidence is a weak or misleading pairwise selection signal on hard code-generation tasks, while online calibration substantially improves pairwise resolution and multi-model selection. We also evaluate delayed and selected-answer-only feedback; the latter materially degrades every same-information online method, MARGIN included. Runtime calibration acts as a coordination layer for heterogeneous foundation-model pools, and MARGIN is a practical inspectable instantiation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模型协同场景下的运行时置信度校准问题：在无模型访问、无留出校准数据、无重训练的条件下，从部署反馈中在线学习每个模型的逐置信度带修正。作者在 18 个开源基础模型、8 个基准、超过 44,000 条观测上发现在线自适应是一类具有共性性质的方法族，简单同信息在线校准器能弥补冻结式设计时方法在分布偏移下的大部分校准差距，并提出该族的结构化成员 MARGIN，采用对称指数加权更新与收缩混合维护逐模型、逐置信度带的乘性因子。
Motivation: 基础模型池常被当作黑盒应答器使用，协调者需要决定信任哪个响应；原始自报置信度跨模型不可比，且仅在设计时修正会在分布偏移下失效。论文旨在解决部署阶段无模型访问、无留出数据、无重训练条件下的运行时校准问题。
Method: 提出 MARGIN (Multi-Agent Runtime Grading via Incremental Normalisation)，一种在线校准方法族中的结构化成员，维护逐模型、逐置信度带的乘性因子，使用对称指数加权更新和收缩混合 (shrinkage blending)，并定义了冷启动行为、返回模型行为、动态池支持以及对固定策略非策略智能体的对称更新保证。
Result: 在 18 个开源基础模型、8 个基准和超过 44,000 条观测上，在线自适应表现出家族性质，能弥合冻结式方法在偏移下的大部分校准差距，遗忘调度是主导设计轴；MARGIN 在突然偏移下并未在 ECE 上支配整个在线家族，其价值在于可解释的置信带信任因子和动态池支持。此外，原始语言化置信度在困难代码生成任务上是较弱或误导性的成对选择信号，在线校准显著改善成对分辨率和多模型选择；延迟反馈与仅选择答案反馈会显著损害所有同信息在线方法。
Conclusion: 运行时校准可以作为异构基础模型池的协调层，MARGIN 是其中一种实用且可检查的具体实现；作者明确承认 MARGIN 并不在突然偏移下的 ECE 上支配在线方法族，其贡献更偏向可解释性和工程行为定义。

papers.title: DySink: Dynamic Frame Sinks for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive long video generation often adopts bounded-memory streaming for efficiency, typically combining local windows for short-term continuity with static early-frame sinks as long-range anchors. However, this fixed allocation keeps early frames cached even when the current visual state has substantially diverged from them, while discarding potentially more relevant intermediate history. As a result, the retained long-range context may become less adaptive and bias generation toward outdated cues; in severe cases, RoPE-induced phase re-alignment can homogenize inter-head attention and cause sink collapse, where content regresses toward sink frames. We propose DySink, a retrieval-based framework that maintains a compact memory bank and selects visually relevant historical frames as dynamic frame sinks. DySink couples adaptive retrieval with a sink anomaly gate that filters retrieved context exhibiting excessive inter-head consensus, an attention pattern associated with sink collapse. Experiments on 50--100-second videos show that DySink achieves the highest measured temporal quality among the evaluated autoregressive baselines, while retaining competitive text alignment and framewise quality. The code is available at https://github.com/yebo0216best/DySink.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自回归长视频生成中的有界内存流（bounded-memory streaming）策略，指出固定保留早期帧作为长期锚点（static early-frame sinks）的缺陷：当当前视觉状态已与早期帧显著偏离时，这些缓存会偏向过时线索，甚至因 RoPE 相位重对齐导致 sink collapse（内容向 sink 帧回归）。作者提出 DySink，一种基于检索的框架，维护紧凑记忆库并动态选择视觉相关的历史帧作为动态帧 sink，同时用 sink anomaly gate 过滤表现出过度跨头一致性的检索上下文。实验在 50–100 秒视频上取得所评估自回归基线中最高的时间质量，并保持有竞争力的文本对齐与逐帧质量。
Motivation: 现有自回归长视频生成采用局部窗口加静态早期帧 sink 的固定内存分配，无法适应视觉状态的大幅漂移，且可能丢弃更相关的中间历史，导致长期上下文适应性差；严重时发生 sink collapse，生成内容向早期帧回归。
Method: 提出 DySink，基于检索的框架：维护紧凑记忆库并选择视觉相关的历史帧作为动态帧 sink；将自适应检索与 sink anomaly gate 耦合，后者过滤表现出过度跨头间共识（inter-head consensus）的检索上下文，以抑制注意模式中与 sink collapse 相关的信号。
Result: 在 50–100 秒视频上，DySink 在所评估的自回归基线中取得最高的时间质量（temporal quality），同时保持有竞争力的文本对齐和逐帧质量。
Conclusion: 摘要认为动态选择相关历史帧并配合异常门控可以缓解静态 sink 带来的过时偏差与 sink collapse，提升长视频生成的时间一致性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CompoSE: Compositional Synthesis and Editing of 3D Shapes via Part-Aware Control
papers.abstract_en: Creating and editing high-quality 3D content remains a central challenge in computer graphics. We address this challenge by introducing CompoSE, a novel method for Compositional Synthesis and Editing of 3D shapes via part-aware control. Our method takes as input a set of coarse geometric primitives (e.g., bounding boxes) that represent distinct object parts arranged in a particular spatial configuration, and synthesizes as output part-separated 3D objects that support localized granular (i.e., compositional) editing of individual parts. The key insight that enables our method is our use of a diffusion transformer architecture that alternates between processing each part locally and aggregating contextual information across parts globally, and features a novel conditioning technique that ensures strong adherence to the user's input. Importantly, our method learns to infer part semantics and symmetries directly from the user's coarse layout guidance, and does not require part-level text prompts. We demonstrate that our method enables powerful part-level editing capabilities, including context-aware substitution, addition, deletion, and style-preserving resizing operations. We show through extensive experiments that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches on guided synthesis, as measured by objective metrics and LLM-based evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CompoSE，一种基于部件感知控制的 3D 形状组合式合成与编辑方法。方法以一组代表不同物体部件及其空间布局的粗略几何基元（如包围盒）为输入，输出支持对单个部件进行局部细粒度编辑的部件分离 3D 物体。其核心是一个扩散 Transformer 架构，在局部处理各部件与跨部件全局聚合上下文之间交替，并采用新颖的条件注入技术以保证对用户输入的强遵循；方法直接从用户粗略布局中推断部件语义与对称性，无需部件级文本提示。
Motivation: 创建和编辑高质量 3D 内容仍是计算机图形学的核心挑战；现有方法难以同时支持组合式合成与对单个部件进行局部可控编辑，本文旨在通过部件感知的粗略布局控制来解决这一问题。
Method: 采用扩散 Transformer 架构，交替进行每个部件的局部处理和跨部件的全局上下文聚合，并引入一种新的条件机制以确保生成结果严格遵循用户输入的粗略几何布局；训练中直接从布局学习部件语义和对称性，不使用部件级文本提示。
Result: 摘要报告，在引导式合成任务上，该方法在客观指标和基于 LLM 的评估中均显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为，该部件感知控制方法能实现强大的部件级编辑能力，包括上下文感知的替换、添加、删除和保持风格的重缩放操作，同时避免了对手工部件级文本提示的依赖。

papers.title: PAIR: Prefix-Aware Internal Reward Model for Multi-Turn Agent Optimization
papers.abstract_en: A significant hurdle for current LLMs is the execution of complex, multi-stage tasks. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been emerging as a leading choice, but its reliance on sparse outcome rewards severely limits credit assignment across intermediate steps. Existing remedies such as running full rollouts to assign step-level advantages, calling external LLM judges at each step, or computing intrinsic rewards that require ground-truth answers at every evaluation introduce significant costs or practical constraints. We hypothesize that internal correctness probing over LLM hidden states can be repurposed as a step-level reward signal, potentially addressing all of these limitations at once. However, existing probing research assumes clean inputs, and we first show that this assumption breaks down in multi-step settings: hidden-state probes degrade severely under prefix contamination tracking coherence with the (possibly corrupted) prefix rather than grounded correctness, while attention-based features remain robust to contamination but underperform on clean prefixes. Building on this complementary relationship, we propose the Prefix-Aware Internal Reward (PAIR), a two-stage model with a frozen hidden-state probe estimating belief-consistency and a lightweight attention-based head correcting it toward grounded correctness. Experimental results show that PAIR achieves the highest AUROC on contaminated trajectories while operating at negligible inference cost, enabling dense step-level reward signals for GRPO training without external model calls, ground-truth dependencies, or full-trajectory rollouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多步智能体任务中 GRPO 依赖稀疏结果奖励、难以进行中间步骤信用分配的问题，提出基于 LLM 内部隐藏状态探测的步骤级稠密奖励 PAIR（Prefix-Aware Internal Reward）。作者发现隐藏状态探测在多步前缀污染场景下会退化为追踪前缀一致性而非基于事实的正确性，而注意力特征对污染鲁棒但在干净前缀上表现较弱；PAIR 结合二者，用冻结的隐藏状态探测器和轻量注意力头校正出基于事实的正确性。实验显示 PAIR 在受污染轨迹上取得最高 AUROC，且推理开销可忽略，可为 GRPO 训练提供稠密步骤级奖励而无需外部模型调用、真值依赖或完整轨迹 rollout。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 执行复杂多阶段任务仍有困难，GRPO 虽常用但其稀疏结果奖励严重限制中间步骤的信用分配。已有的替代方案，包括运行完整 rollout 计算步骤级优势、每步调用外部 LLM 评判、或每步依赖真值计算内在奖励，都带来显著成本或实践约束。
Method: 提出 PAIR，一个两阶段模型：冻结的隐藏状态探测器（hidden-state probe）估计信念一致性（belief consistency），并结合一个轻量级基于注意力的头将其校正为基于事实的正确性（grounded correctness）。该方法利用隐藏状态探测与注意力特征在污染下的互补行为，生成稠密步骤级奖励信号。
Result: 实验表明 PAIR 在受污染轨迹上取得最高 AUROC，且推理开销可忽略；它能为 GRPO 训练提供稠密步骤级奖励，无需外部模型调用、真值依赖或完整轨迹 rollout。
Conclusion: 摘要强调内部正确性探测可被重用于步骤级奖励信号，同时规避现有方案的代价与约束；PAIR 验证了隐藏状态特征与注意力特征互补的有效性。该机制被定位为 GRPO 训练中的内部奖励信号来源，摘要未讨论超出该训练场景的推广。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemForest: An Efficient Agent Memory System with Hierarchical Temporal Indexing
papers.abstract_en: Memory is a fundamental component for long-context LLM agents, supporting persistent state across interactions through a continuous serve-and-update lifecycle. Despite substantial prior work, many stateful systems retain sequential autoregressive extraction or state-dependent maintenance on the write path, delaying when new evidence becomes queryable. To address these challenges, we present MemForest, a memory framework that reformulates agent memory as a write-efficient temporal data-management problem. MemForest breaks the sequential bottleneck via parallel extraction, decoupling memory construction into concurrent, independent operations. We further introduce MemTree, a hierarchical temporal index that organizes memory as time-ordered trees and replaces global rewrites with localized dirty-path refresh. Dirty summaries can be refreshed in parallel across nodes and trees. End-to-end work remains proportional to incoming content; the logarithmic bound applies only to structural insertion and level-dependent refresh depth in balanced trees. We evaluate MemForest on two long-context benchmarks, LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo. Experiments use Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-30B, and Gemma-4-12B-IT. With Qwen3-30B, MemForest reaches 81.8 percent pass at 1 on LongMemEval-S, while its input-normalized build rate is 6.0 times that of EverMemOS. On LoCoMo categories 1 to 4, it reaches 84.09 percent, within 0.13 percentage points of EverMemOS; on a matched conversation, its build rate is 9.5 times higher. These results show that MemForest reduces memory-freshness latency while retaining strong answer quality.

TL;DR: MemForest 是一个面向长上下文 LLM 智能体的记忆框架，将智能体记忆重构为写高效 (write-efficient) 的时序数据管理问题。它通过并行抽取打破顺序自回归瓶颈，并提出 MemTree 分层时序索引，用局部脏路径刷新 (dirty-path refresh) 替代全局重写。在 LongMemEval-S 与 LoCoMo 两个长上下文基准上，配合 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-30B、Gemma-4-12B-IT，MemForest 在保持答案质量的同时显著降低记忆新鲜度延迟。
Motivation: 现有有状态记忆系统在写路径上仍保留顺序自回归抽取或状态相关维护，导致新证据从写入到可查询存在延迟。
Method: 将记忆构建解耦为并行的独立抽取操作，并提出 MemTree 分层时序索引，以时间有序树组织记忆；用可跨节点和树并行刷新的局部脏路径刷新替代全局重写，使端到端工作量与输入内容成正比，对数界仅适用于平衡树中的结构插入和层级刷新深度。
Result: 使用 Qwen3-30B 时，MemForest 在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 81.8% 的 pass@1，输入归一化构建速率是 EverMemOS 的 6.0 倍；在 LoCoMo 类别 1 至 4 上达到 84.09%，与 EverMemOS 相差 0.13 个百分点，在匹配对话上构建速率高出 9.5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 MemForest 能在保持较强答案质量的同时降低记忆新鲜度 (memory-freshness) 延迟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Bits Break Recourse: Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Model quantization is widely used to reduce memory, latency, and deployment cost, and is typically judged by whether predictive accuracy is preserved. In decision systems that provide algorithmic recourse, however, accuracy preservation is not sufficient: a small actionable change that flips the decision of a full-precision model may fail after quantization, or require a substantially larger intervention. This paper studies this deployment mismatch and introduces counterfactual sensitivity under quantization, a framework for measuring how compression changes recourse behavior. We propose two metrics: Validity Drop (VD), which measures the fraction of full-precision recourse actions that no longer achieve the target outcome after quantization, and Counterfactual Recourse Gap (CRG), which measures the increase in minimal recourse cost under the quantized model. To mitigate this failure mode, we introduce Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization (CFQ), a quantization-aware training method that jointly learns quantizer parameters and mixed-precision bit allocation while preserving the target prediction at teacher-generated recourse points. CFQ is compatible with standard LSQ/PACT-style quantizers and mixed-precision policies, and can also be instantiated as a training-free calibration procedure for post-training quantization. Experiments on Adult, German Credit, and COMPAS show that standard QAT and mixed-precision baselines can preserve accuracy while substantially degrading recourse stability. At matched accuracy and bit budget, CFQ consistently reduces VD and CRG; for example, on Adult, CFQ reduces VD/CRG from $0.121/0.162$ for an accuracy-centric mixed-precision baseline to $0.061/0.071$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究模型量化对算法救济 (algorithmic recourse) 行为的影响，指出仅保持预测准确率不足以保证量化后反事实干预仍然有效。作者提出两个指标——Validity Drop (VD) 与 Counterfactual Recourse Gap (CRG)——来度量压缩带来的救济行为变化，并提出 Counterfactual-Faithful Quantization (CFQ) 方法，在训练中联合学习量化器参数和混合精度位分配，同时保持教师生成救济点处的目标预测。实验在 Adult、German Credit 和 COMPAS 上进行，显示 CFQ 在匹配准确率和比特预算下能一致降低 VD 与 CRG。
Motivation: 量化的常见评价标准是预测准确率是否保持，但对提供算法救济的决策系统而言，小幅且可执行的反事实改动在量化后可能失效或需要显著更大的干预代价，这种部署失配未被现有量化方法考虑。
Method: 提出 VD 和 CRG 两个指标分别衡量量化后失效的全精度救济动作比例以及最小救济成本的增长；并引入 CFQ，一种量化感知训练方法，联合学习量化器参数与混合精度位分配，兼容标准 LSQ/PACT 风格量化器，也可实例化为训练后量化 (post-training quantization) 的免训练校准流程。
Result: 在 Adult、German Credit 和 COMPAS 上，标准 QAT 与混合精度基线可以在保持准确率的同时显著损害救济稳定性；在相同准确率和比特预算下，CFQ 一致降低 VD 与 CRG，例如在 Adult 上将精度导向混合精度基线的 VD/CRG 从 0.121/0.162 降至 0.061/0.071。
Conclusion: 摘要强调量化评价不能只看精度保持，还必须考虑对反事实救济行为的影响；CFQ 展示了同时维持准确率与救济有效性的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MI-CXR: A Benchmark for Longitudinal Reasoning over Multi-Interval Chest X-rays
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation requires reasoning over disease evolution across multiple patient visits, yet most existing medical VQA benchmarks focus on single images or short-horizon image pairs. We introduce MI-CXR, a benchmark for standardized evaluation of Multi-Interval longitudinal reasoning over multi-visit CXR sequences, without requiring free-form report generation or additional clinical context. MI-CXR comprises five-way multiple-choice questions over five-visit patient timelines and instantiates three complementary task families: Temporal Event Localization, Interval-wise Change Reasoning, and Global Trajectory Summarization, which assess clinically grounded visual reasoning over time. Evaluating 14 state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) shows low overall performance, with an average accuracy of 29.3%, only modestly above random guessing. Using stage-wise diagnostic probing, we find that models often produce locally plausible interval descriptions but fail to enforce temporal constraints or compose evidence into globally consistent decisions over the full timeline. These findings reveal key limitations of current VLMs and establish MI-CXR as a principled benchmark for longitudinal medical reasoning. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/AIDASLab/MI-CXR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MI-CXR，一个用于多就诊胸部 X 光片 (CXR) 纵向推理的基准，要求模型在五就诊时间线上回答五选一的多选题，无需自由文本报告或额外临床背景。基准包含三个互补任务族：Temporal Event Localization、Interval-wise Change Reasoning 和 Global Trajectory Summarization。14 个视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的平均准确率仅为 29.3%，略高于随机猜测；分阶段诊断探测显示模型常产生局部合理的区间描述，但无法满足时间约束或在完整时间线上组合出全局一致的决策。
Motivation: 现有医学 VQA 基准大多局限于单张图像或短时程的图像对，难以评估跨多次就诊的疾病演变推理，缺乏标准化的多区间纵向推理评测。
Method: 构建 MI-CXR 基准，包含五就诊时间线和五选一多项选择题，并设计三个任务族分别考察时间事件定位、区间级变化推理和全局轨迹概括；同时采用分段式诊断探测 (stage-wise diagnostic probing) 分析模型的推理失败模式。
Result: 摘要报告 14 个 SOTA 视觉语言模型在 MI-CXR 上平均准确率仅 29.3%，只略高于随机水平；探测结果表明模型能给出局部合理的区间描述，但难以强制执行时间约束并将证据组合为全局一致的决策。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现揭示了当前 VLM 在纵向医学推理上的关键局限，并将 MI-CXR 确立为评估该能力的基准；数据与代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Dimensional Consistency: Balancing Budget and Quality in Adaptive Inference-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable abilities in reasoning. However, maximizing their potential through inference-time scaling faces challenges in trade-off between sampling budget and reasoning quality. Current strategies remain inefficient as they typically treat sampling width and depth as orthogonal objectives, where width consensus methods risk reinforcing hallucinations, while depth pruning mechanisms prematurely truncate complex yet valid reasoning chains. Therefore, we propose Dual-Dimensional Consistency (DDC), a unified framework that bridges path quality with adaptive termination. By coupling Confidence-Weighted Bayesian protocol with a Trend-Aware Stratified Pruning, our method ensures that computational resources are concentrated on high quality reasoning paths, filtering hallucinations while accelerating consensus. Evaluations across five benchmarks demonstrate that this approach reduces token consumption by over 10 times while maintaining or exceeding the accuracy of strong baselines across various LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Dimensional Consistency (DDC)，一个统一的推理时间扩展框架，将路径质量与自适应终止相结合，以处理 LLM 推理中采样预算与推理质量之间的权衡。该方法将置信加权贝叶斯协议与趋势感知分层剪枝耦合，使计算资源集中在高质量推理路径上，同时过滤幻觉并加速共识。在五个基准上的评估显示，该方法在多种 LLM 上将 token 消耗降低 10 倍以上，同时保持或超过强基线的准确率。
Motivation: 现有推理时间扩展策略将采样宽度与深度视为正交目标：宽度共识方法可能强化幻觉，而深度剪枝机制会过早截断复杂但有效的推理链，导致效率与质量难以兼顾。
Method: 提出 DDC 统一框架，通过 Confidence-Weighted Bayesian protocol 与 Trend-Aware Stratified Pruning 的耦合，将计算资源集中于高质量推理路径，同时过滤幻觉并加速共识形成。
Result: 在五个基准上的评估表明，该方法在多种 LLM 上将 token 消耗降低超过 10 倍，同时保持或超过强基线的准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DDC 通过双维一致性在采样预算与推理质量之间取得平衡，为自适应推理时间扩展提供更高效的统一方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnosing and Correcting Concept Omission in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have achieved remarkable progress in text-to-image generation, yet they frequently suffer from concept omission, where specified objects or attributes fail to emerge in the generated image. By performing linear probing on text tokens, we demonstrate that text embeddings can distinguish a characteristic `omission signal' representing the absence of target concepts. Leveraging this insight, we propose Omission Signal Intervention (OSI), which amplifies the omission signal to actively catalyze the generation of missing concepts. Comprehensive experiments on FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Medium demonstrate that OSI significantly alleviates concept omission even in extreme scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态扩散 Transformer (MM-DiT) 在文生图任务中的概念遗漏问题，通过线性探测 (linear probing) 发现文本 token 的嵌入中存在可区分的“遗漏信号”，并据此提出 Omission Signal Intervention (OSI) 来放大该信号以促使缺失概念被生成。实验在 FLUX.1-Dev 和 SD3.5-Medium 上验证了 OSI 能显著缓解极端场景下的概念遗漏。
Motivation: 多模态扩散 Transformer 在文生图中尽管性能出色，却经常遗漏指定对象或属性，生成图像中缺少目标概念，这一问题尚未得到针对性诊断与修正。
Method: 作者先对文本 token 做线性探测，证明嵌入能编码表示目标概念缺失的遗漏信号，然后提出 OSI 方法，在采样过程中放大该信号，从而主动催化缺失概念的生成。
Result: 在 FLUX.1-Dev 和 SD3.5-Medium 上的综合实验表明，OSI 显著缓解了概念遗漏，即使在极端场景下也有效。
Conclusion: 摘要指出文本嵌入中的遗漏信号可被探测并用于干预生成过程，OSI 提供了一种不需额外训练或修改模型参数就能改善概念覆盖的途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dynamic Execution Commitment of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predominantly adopt action chunking, i.e., predicting and committing to a short horizon of consecutive low-level actions in a single forward pass, to amortize the inference cost of large-scale backbones and reduce per-step latency. However, committing these multi-step predictions to real-world execution requires balancing success rate against inference efficiency, a decision typically governed by fixed execution horizons tuned per task. Such heuristics ignore the state-dependent nature of predictive reliability, leading to brittle performance in dynamic or out-of-distribution settings. In this paper, we introduce A3, an Adaptive Action Acceptance mechanism that reframes dynamic execution commitment as a self-speculative prefix verification problem. A3 first computes a trajectory-wise consensus score of actions via group sampling, then selects a representative draft and prioritizes downstream verification. Specifically, it enforces: (1) consensus-ordered conditional invariance, which validates low-consensus actions by judging whether they remain consistent when re-decoded conditioned on high-consensus actions; and (2) prefix-closed sequential consistency, which guarantees physical rollout integrity by accepting only the longest continuous sequence of verified actions starting from the beginning. Consequently, the execution horizon emerges as the longest verifiable prefix satisfying both internal model logic and sequential execution constraints. Experiments across diverse VLA models and benchmarks demonstrate that A3 eliminates the need for manual horizon tuning while achieving a superior trade-off between execution robustness and inference throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 A3（Adaptive Action Acceptance），一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的动态执行承诺机制，将固定执行视界（execution horizon）的选择重构为自推测前缀验证（self-speculative prefix verification）问题。A3 通过组采样计算轨迹级动作共识分数，选取代表性草案并优先验证下游动作。它强制两种约束：共识排序的条件不变性（consensus-ordered conditional invariance）和前缀闭包的顺序一致性（prefix-closed sequential consistency），最终将执行视界定义为满足模型内部逻辑与顺序执行约束的最长可验证前缀。实验表明 A3 无需人工调节视界，并在执行鲁棒性与推理吞吐量之间取得更优权衡。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型普遍采用动作分块（action chunking），在单次前向中预测并承诺一小段连续动作，以摊销大模型推理成本；但多步预测的执行承诺需要在成功率与推理效率间权衡，通常由逐任务调参的固定执行视界决定。这种启发式忽略了预测可靠性的状态依赖性，导致在动态或分布外（out-of-distribution）场景下性能脆弱。
Method: A3 先把动态执行承诺建模为自推测前缀验证问题：通过组采样（group sampling）计算轨迹级动作共识分数，选出代表性草案并优先做下游验证；随后强制 (1) 共识排序的条件不变性，即对低共识动作，在以高共识动作为条件重新解码后检验其一致性；(2) 前缀闭包的顺序一致性，即只接受从起点开始的最长连续已验证动作序列。由此执行视界成为满足内部模型逻辑与顺序执行约束的最长可验证前缀。
Result: 在多种 VLA 模型和基准上的实验表明，A3 消除了人工视界调节的需要，并在执行鲁棒性与推理吞吐量之间取得了更优的权衡。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调执行视界可以内生地涌现为满足模型一致性与顺序执行约束的最长可验证前缀，从而替代逐任务固定视界的启发式调参。该方法针对 VLA 模型的动作执行承诺问题，属于动作分块决策层面的改进，不涉及外部环境建模。

papers.title: P-Flow: Proxy-gradient Flows for Linear Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Generative models based on flow matching have emerged as a powerful paradigm for inverse problems, offering straighter trajectories and faster sampling compared to diffusion models. However, existing approaches often necessitate differentiating through unrolled paths, leading to numerical instability and prohibitive computational overhead. To address this, we propose P-Flow, a framework that stabilizes the reconstruction process by leveraging a proxy gradient to update the source point. This approach effectively circumvents the numerical instability and memory overhead of long-chain differentiation. To ensure consistency with the prior distribution, we employ a Gaussian spherical projection motivated by the concentration of measure phenomenon in high-dimensional spaces. We further provide a theoretical analysis for P-Flow based on Bayesian theory and Lipschitz continuity. Experiments across diverse restoration tasks demonstrate that P-Flow delivers competitive performance, especially under extreme degradations such as severely ill-posed conditions and high measurement noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P-Flow，一个基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的线性逆问题求解框架。P-Flow 用代理梯度 (proxy gradient) 更新源点，避开对展开路径 (unrolled paths) 求导带来的数值不稳定和巨大内存开销，并借助高斯球面投影维护先验一致性。作者给出了基于贝叶斯理论和 Lipschitz 连续性的理论分析，实验表明在严重 ill-posed 和高测量噪声等极端退化条件下性能有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有流匹配生成模型用于逆问题时，通常需要对展开路径进行微分，导致数值不稳定和很高的计算开销，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出 P-Flow：通过代理梯度更新源点来稳定重建过程，规避长链微分的数值不稳定与内存开销；受高维空间中测度集中现象 (concentration of measure) 启发，采用高斯球面投影 (Gaussian spherical projection) 保持重建结果与先验分布一致；并基于贝叶斯理论和 Lipschitz 连续性提供了理论分析。
Result: 摘要报告在多种图像恢复任务上 P-Flow 取得有竞争力的性能，尤其在极端退化条件下，例如严重 ill-posed 的场景和高质量测量噪声。
Conclusion: 摘要强调代理梯度与高斯球面投影的组合可以有效稳定流匹配框架下的线性逆问题求解；其适用范围限定在逆问题建模的线性设定，理论与实验都围绕这一范围展开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DRIP-R: A Benchmark for Decision-Making and Reasoning Under Real-World Policy Ambiguity in the Retail Domain
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed for routine but consequential tasks in real-world domains, where their behavior is governed by inherently ambiguous domain policies that admit multiple valid interpretations. Despite the prevalence of such ambiguities in practice, existing agent benchmarks largely assume unambiguous, well-specified policies, leaving a critical evaluation gap. We introduce DRIP-R, a benchmark that systematically exploits real-world retail policy ambiguities to construct scenarios in which no single correct resolution exists. DRIP-R comprises a curated set of policy-ambiguous return scenarios paired with a realistic customer personas, a full-duplex conversational simulation with tool-calling capabilities and a multi-judge evaluation framework covering policy adherence, dialogue quality, behavioral alignment, and resolution quality. Our experiments show that frontier models fundamentally disagree on identical policy-ambiguous scenarios, confirming that ambiguity poses a genuine and systematic challenge to LLM decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DRIP-R，一个面向零售领域政策歧义场景的决策与推理基准。基准系统性地利用真实零售退换货政策中的内在歧义，构造不存在唯一正确答案的场景，并配套人工客服画像、全双工对话模拟（含工具调用）以及多裁判评估框架。实验表明，前沿模型在相同的政策歧义场景上产生根本性分歧，说明歧义对 LLM 决策构成真实且系统的挑战。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 基准大多假设领域政策明确且无歧义，而真实世界的常规但重要的任务往往受制于允许多种合理解释的模糊政策，导致评估空白。该工作旨在填补这一关键缺口。
Method: DRIP-R 包含一组策略歧义的退货场景（return scenarios），配以 realistic customer personas，并实现全双工对话模拟与 tool-calling 能力；评估采用多裁判框架，覆盖政策遵从（policy adherence）、对话质量、行为对齐与解决质量。
Result: 实验显示前沿模型（frontier models）在相同的政策歧义场景上根本性分歧，证实政策歧义对 LLM 决策构成系统性挑战。
Conclusion: 作者强调政策歧义是 LLM 决策面临的真实挑战，DRIP-R 可作为该方向的评估基准；摘要未报告具体数值结果或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Differentially Private Auditing Under Strategic Response
papers.abstract_en: Regulatory audits of AI systems increasingly rely on differential privacy (DP) to protect training data and model internals. We study audit design when the audited developer can strategically respond to the privacy-constrained audit interface. We formalize privacy-constrained auditing as a bilevel Stackelberg game, in which an auditor commits to a query policy and DP budget allocation across harm dimensions, and a strategic developer reallocates mitigation efforts in response. We introduce the welfare-weighted under-detection gap $B_w$, the welfare-weighted true residual harm the audit fails to detect at the developer's strategic best response, and prove that naive DP auditing (uniform or harm-proportional allocation) induces a strictly larger $B_w$ than any non-strategic mitigation baseline whenever effective detectability is heterogeneous, the welfare weights are not comonotone with detectability, and the developer's optimum is interior. We characterize the optimal auditor allocation as a four-factor balance of welfare weight, audit miss-probability, detectability elasticity, and mitigation-cost curvature, and provide a single-level reformulation of the bilevel problem via the developer's KKT system. We propose Strategic Private Audit Design (SPAD), a projected-gradient algorithm with hypergradients computed through the developer's best response.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究受差分隐私约束的AI监管审计设计，在被审计开发者可以策略性地响应隐私受限审计接口的背景下，将审计形式化为双层Stackelberg博弈。作者引入福利加权漏检缺口B_w，证明当可检测性异质、福利权重与可检测性非共单调且开发者最优解为内点时，朴素DP审计（均匀或按危害比例分配）诱导出的B_w严格大于任何非策略性缓解基线，并提出SPAD投影梯度算法求解该双层问题。
Motivation: 监管审计日益依赖差分隐私（DP）来保护训练数据和模型内部，但现有审计设计未考虑被审计开发者会针对隐私受限的审计接口策略性地重新分配缓解努力，从而可能使审计失效。
Method: 将隐私约束审计建模为审计者（领导者）与开发者（跟随者）的双层Stackelberg博弈；审计者承诺查询策略和跨危害维度的DP预算分配，开发者随后最优化缓解努力配置。作者刻画最优分配为福利权重、审计漏检概率、可检测性弹性和缓解成本曲率的四因子平衡，并通过开发者的KKT系统将双层问题重构为单层形式，提出SPAD（Strategic Private Audit Design）投影梯度算法，其超梯度经由开发者最优反应计算。
Result: 理论结果表明，在可检测性异质、福利权重与可检测性非共单调、开发者最优解为内点的条件下，朴素DP审计（均匀或危害比例分配）产生的福利加权漏检缺口B_w严格大于任何非策略性缓解基线。
Conclusion: 摘要指出DP审计设计必须考虑审计者与开发者之间的战略性互动，不能停留在均匀或按危害比例分配预算；SPAD为在开发者策略响应下计算最优隐私审计分配提供了可操作的算法框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quotient Semivalues for False-Name-Resistant Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Data valuation methods allocate payments and audit training data's contribution to machine-learning pipelines; however, they often assume passive contributors. In reality, contributors can split datasets across pseudonymous identities, duplicate high-value examples, create near-duplicates, or launder synthetic variants to inflate their share. We formalize this as false-name manipulation in ML data attribution. Our main construction is the quotient semivalue mechanism: compute Shapley-, Banzhaf-, or Beta-style values over evidence-backed attribution clusters instead of raw identities, using a canonical-representative operator to absorb within-cluster duplication. We prove an impossibility: on a fixed monotone data-value game, exact Shapley-fair attribution over reported identities is incompatible with unrestricted false-name-proofness, even on binary-valued instances, and characterize the split-gain of a general semivalue on a unanimity counter-example. The mechanism is exactly false-name-proof under two structural conditions: false-name-neutral within-cluster allocation and quotient-stable manipulations. Under imperfect provenance, when these conditions hold approximately, manipulation gain and fairness loss are bounded by three measurable quantities: escaped-cluster mass, value-estimation error, and clustering distance. We instantiate the mechanisms in DataMarket-Gym, a benchmark for attribution under strategic provider attacks. On synthetic classification tasks, quotient semivalues with example-level evidence reduce manipulation gain on duplicate and near-duplicate Sybil attacks from $1.74$ under baseline Shapley to $0.96$, near the honest level. The cosine-threshold and (false-merge, false-split) rate sweeps trace the corresponding fairness--Sybil frontier.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器学习数据归因中的假名操纵（false-name manipulation）问题，即贡献者可以通过拆分身份、重复或近似复制数据来虚增贡献。作者提出商半值（quotient semivalue）机制，在证据支撑的聚类上计算 Shapley、Banzhaf 或 Beta 风格的值，并证明精确的 Shapley 公平分配与无限制的假名可证明性不相容；在特定结构条件下机制可达到精确假名可证明性，近似情况下操纵收益与公平损失由三个可测度量界定。作者在 DataMarket-Gym 基准上验证，示例级证据的商半值可将重复与近似重复 Sybil 攻击下的操纵收益从基线 Shapley 的 1.74 降至 0.96。
Motivation: 现有数据估值方法假设贡献者是被动的，但现实中贡献者可以拆分数据集、重复高价值样本、制造近似重复或清洗合成变体来虚增份额。论文将此形式化为机器学习数据归因中的假名操纵问题，并指出缺乏对此类策略性攻击的鲁棒分配机制。
Method: 提出商半值机制：用规范代表算子（canonical-representative operator）吸收聚类内重复，在基于证据的归因聚类上计算 Shapley、Banzhaf 或 Beta 风格值。论文证明在固定单调数据值博弈上，精确 Shapley 公平与无限制假名可证明性不相容；当满足聚类内分配假名中性与商稳定操纵两个结构条件时机制精确假名可证明，近似情况下操纵增益和公平损失由逃逸聚类质量、值估计误差和聚类距离界定。
Result: 在合成的分类任务上，使用示例级证据的商半值在重复和近似重复 Sybil 攻击下将操纵增益从基线 Shapley 的 1.74 降至 0.96，接近诚实水平。余弦阈值以及（假合并、假拆分）率扫描刻画了公平性与 Sybil 攻击之间的权衡前沿。
Conclusion: 摘要指出数据归因中的假名操纵需要显式建模，商半值机制结合证据聚类的伪名可证明性在实践近似条件下可实现有界的操纵收益与公平损失，并在 DataMarket-Gym 基准中展示有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Benchmark for Strategic Auditee Gaming Under Continuous Compliance Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Continuous post-deployment compliance audits, mandated by emerging regulations such as the EU AI Act and Digital Services Act, create a class of strategic gaming distinct from the one-shot input/output gaming studied in prior work. Regulated systems can delay outcome reporting, drift their reports within plausible noise envelopes, exploit longitudinal sample attrition, and cherry-pick among ambiguous metric definitions. We formalize continuous auditing as a $T$-round Stackelberg game between an auditor that commits to a temporal policy and an adaptive auditee, and identify a structural feature of any noise-aware static-auditor design: a cover regime in which coverage gaps and granularity gaps cannot be closed simultaneously. We make this formal as Observation 1 and show that two minimal extension policies, each derived from the observation, close the regime along orthogonal axes: a sample-size-aware static rule (Periodic-with-floor) closes the granularity-failure case, while a history-conditioned suspicion-escalation policy closes the coverage-failure case for the naive Drift strategy -- and neither closes both, exactly as the observation predicts; an audit-aware OffAuditDrift strategy that exploits Stackelberg commitment defeats both. To support empirical study we contribute a non-additive harm decomposition (welfare loss $W$, coverage loss $C$) that exposes how attrition shifts harm from the regulator-accountable surface to a regulator-invisible one; an initial library of five auditee strategies (Delay, Drift, Cherry-pick, Attrition, OffAuditDrift) and five auditor policies, calibrated to summary statistics from published audits of the DSA Transparency Database; and a reproducible simulator with a small, extensible Python interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把持续部署后的合规审计建模为 T 轮 Stackelberg 博弈：审计方先承诺时间策略，被审计方可自适应地策略性应对。作者指出任何噪声感知的静态审计设计都存在一个覆盖区间 (cover regime)，在该区间内覆盖率缺口与粒度缺口无法同时闭合，并提出两种最小扩展策略分别从正交方向逼近该边界；审计感知的 OffAuditDrift 策略则能利用 Stackelberg 承诺同时击败两者。论文还附带一个基于 DSA 透明度数据库审计统计校准的可复现模拟器与攻击/防御策略库。
Motivation: EU AI Act 和 Digital Services Act 等新规要求的持续部署后审计，会催生不同于以往一次性输入/输出审计的一类策略性博弈：受监管系统可以延迟结果报告、在合理噪声包络内漂移、利用纵向样本流失，并在模糊的指标定义间择优。现有工作缺乏对这种持续监控场景的系统化基准。
Method: 作者将持续审计形式化为审计方承诺时间策略、被审计方自适应应对的 T 轮 Stackelberg 博弈，并给出 Observation 1：噪声感知的静态审计设计存在 coverage gaps 与 granularity gaps 不可同时闭合的覆盖区间。由此提出两种最小扩展策略——样本量感知的静态规则 Periodic-with-floor（闭合粒度失败情形）和历史条件化的怀疑升级策略（闭合针对 naive Drift 的覆盖率失败情形）；此外定义了非加性危害分解（welfare loss W、coverage loss C），并构建包含五种被审计策略（Delay、Drift、Cherry-pick、Attrition、OffAuditDrift）与五种审计策略的策略库，以及可扩展的 Python 模拟器。
Result: 摘要报告 Observation 1 的预测得到验证：两种扩展策略均不能同时闭合两类失败情形，而审计感知的 OffAuditDrift 策略利用 Stackelberg 承诺同时击败两者。危害分解揭示了 attrition 如何把危害从监管者可见的表层转移到监管者不可见的层面；模拟器参数依据已发表的 DSA 透明度数据库审计汇总统计进行校准。
Conclusion: 作者认为持续合规监控产生了一类结构上不同于一次性博弈的策略性作弊，并以形式化观测、策略库和模拟器形式提供了一个可复现的基准，支持后续实证研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Detecting AI-Generated Videos with Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI-generated videos are photorealistic at the single-frame level, leaving inter-frame dynamics as the main remaining axis for detection. Existing detectors typically handle this temporal evidence in three ways: feeding the full frame sequence to a generic temporal backbone, reducing one dominant temporal cue to fixed video-level descriptors, or comparing temporal features to real-video statistics through a detection metric. These strategies degrade sharply under cross-generator evaluation, where artifact type and timescale vary across generators. On caption-paired benchmark, GenVidBench, we identify two signatures that prior detectors do not jointly exploit: AI-generated videos exhibit smoother frame-to-frame temporal residuals at the pixel level, and more compact trajectories in the semantic feature space, indicating a temporal smoothness gap at both levels. We further observe that, when raw video is fed into a Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs), fake clips elicit firing predominantly at object and motion boundaries, unlike real clips, suggesting that the SNN responds to temporal artifacts localized at edges. These cues are sparse, asynchronous, and concentrated at moments of change, which makes SNNs a natural choice for this task: their event-driven, sparsely-activated dynamics align with the structure of the residual signal in a way that dense ANN backbones do not. Building on this observation, we propose MAST, a detector that processes multi-channel temporal residuals with a spike-driven temporal branch alongside a frozen semantic encoder for cross-generator generalization. On the GenVideo benchmark, MAST achieves 93.14\% mean accuracy across 10 unseen generators under strict cross-generator evaluation, matching or surpassing the strongest ANN-based detectors and demonstrating the practical applicability of SNNs to AI-generated video detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAST，一种基于脉冲神经网络 (Spiking Neural Network, SNN) 的 AI 生成视频检测器。作者在 GenVidBench 上发现 AI 生成视频在像素级帧间残差和语义特征空间轨迹上都更平滑，且 SNN 对伪造片段主要在物体与运动边界产生脉冲。MAST 使用 spike-driven 时间分支处理多通道时间残差并配合冻结的语义编码器，在 GenVideo 基准的严格跨生成器评估中达到 93.14% 平均准确率。
Motivation: 现有检测器要么用通用时间骨干处理整段帧序列，要么把单一时间线索压缩成固定视频级描述符，要么用检测度量与真实视频统计比较，这些策略在跨生成器评估中性能大幅下降。作者希望利用 AI 生成视频在时间动态上的独特痕迹，并借助 SNN 的事件驱动特性捕捉稀疏、异步且集中在变化时刻的时间伪影。
Method: 提出 MAST 检测器：使用 spike-driven 时间分支处理多通道时间残差，同时搭配冻结的语义编码器以实现跨生成器泛化；SNN 对时间残差信号的响应以物体与运动边界的脉冲为主，利用这一特性替代稠密 ANN 骨干。
Result: 在 GenVideo 基准的严格跨生成器评估中，MAST 在 10 个未见生成器上取得 93.14% 平均准确率，匹配或超过最强的基于 ANN 的检测器，展示了 SNN 在该任务上的实用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SNN 的事件驱动、稀疏激活特性与 AI 生成视频时间残差结构相匹配，可作为跨生成器视频伪造检测的有效方案；但未说明对更广泛视频类型或数据集的泛化性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Leveraging Image Generators to Address Data Scarcity: The Gen4Regen Dataset for Forest Regeneration Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Sustainable forest management relies on precise species composition mapping, yet traditional ground surveys are labour-intensive and geographically constrained. While Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offer scalable data collection, the transition to deep learning-based interpretation is bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of expert-annotated imagery, particularly in complex, visually heterogeneous regeneration zones. This paper addresses the dual challenges of data scarcity and extreme class imbalance in the fine-grained semantic segmentation of plants by providing a scalable framework that reduces reliance on manual photo-interpretation for high-resolution, millimetre-level aerial imagery. Importantly, we leverage the large-scale Nano Banana Pro model to simultaneously generate high-fidelity images and their corresponding pixel-aligned semantic masks from prompts. We introduce WilDReF-Q-V2, an expansion of a natural forest dataset with 13 977 new unlabelled and 50 hand-labelled real images, as well as the Gen4Regen dataset, featuring 2101 pairs of synthetic images and semantic masks. Our methodology integrates real-world data with AI-generated images, highlighting that AI-generated data is highly complementary to real-world data, with unified training yielding an F1 score improvement of over 15 %pt compared to purely supervised baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate that even small quantities of prompt-generated data significantly improve performance for underrepresented classes, some of which see per-class F1 score gains of over 30 %pt. We conclude that large-scale vision models can serve as agile data generators, effectively bootstrapping perception tasks for niche AI domains where expert labels are scarce or unavailable. Our datasets, source code, and models will be available at https://norlab-ulaval.github.io/gen4regen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对森林再生区植物细粒度语义分割中专家标注图像稀缺和类别极端不平衡的双重问题，利用 Nano Banana Pro 大型图像生成模型从提示词同时生成高保真图像及像素级对齐的语义掩码，构建了包含 2101 对合成图像与语义掩码的 Gen4Regen 数据集，并扩展了含 13977 张未标注和 50 张人工标注真实图像的 WilDReF-Q-V2 数据集。将真实数据与 AI 生成数据统一训练后，F1 分数相比纯监督基线提升超过 15 个百分点，部分欠表征类别的单类 F1 提升超过 30 个百分点。作者认为大规模视觉模型可作为灵活的数据生成器，为专家标签稀缺的垂直感知领域提供数据引导。
Motivation: 传统地面调查劳动密集且受地理限制，无人机（UAV）虽能规模化采集数据，但深度学习解读严重受限于专家标注影像的匮乏，尤其在视觉异质性强、复杂的森林再生区域，同时面临数据稀缺与极端类别不平衡的双重挑战。
Method: 提出一个可扩展框架：利用大规模图像生成模型 Nano Banana Pro 根据提示词同时合成高保真图像及其像素对齐的语义掩码，并引入真实与合成数据联合训练策略；同时发布 WilDReF-Q-V2 与 Gen4Regen 两个数据集。
Result: 统一训练相较纯监督基线将 F1 分数提升超过 15 个百分点；即使少量提示词生成的合成数据也能显著改善欠表征类别的性能，部分类别单类 F1 提升超过 30 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为大规模视觉模型可以充当敏捷的数据生成器，有效引导专家标签稀缺的细分 AI 领域中的感知任务，并计划公开数据集、源代码和模型。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出一个可扩展框架：利用大规模图像生成模型 Nano Banana Pro 根据提示词同时合成高保真图像及其像素对齐的语义掩码，并引入真实与合成数据联合训练策略；同时发布 WilDReF-Q-V2 与 Gen4Regen 两个数据集。
summary_sections.result: 统一训练相较纯监督基线将 F1 分数提升超过 15 个百分点；即使少量提示词生成的合成数据也能显著改善欠表征类别的性能，部分类别单类 F1 提升超过 30 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者总结认为大规模视觉模型可以充当敏捷的数据生成器，有效引导专家标签稀缺的细分 AI 领域中的感知任务，并计划公开数据集、源代码和模型。

papers.title: Predict-then-Diffuse: Adaptive Response Length for Compute-Budgeted Inference in Diffusion LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based Large Language Models (D-LLMs) represent a promising frontier in generative AI, offering fully parallel token generation that can lead to significant throughput advantages and superior GPU utilization over the traditional autoregressive paradigm. However, this parallelism is constrained by the requirement of a fixed-size response length prior to generation. This architectural limitation imposes a severe trade-off: oversized response length results in computational waste on semantically meaningless padding tokens, while undersized response length causes output truncation requiring costly re-computations that introduce unpredictable latency spikes. To tackle this issue, we propose Predict-then-Diffuse, a simple and model-agnostic framework that enables compute-budgeted inference per input query by first estimating the response length and then using it to run inference with D-LLM. At its core lies an Adaptive Response Length Predictor (AdaRLP), which estimates the optimal response length given an input query. As a measure against under-estimating the response length and re-running inference with a higher value, we introduce a data-driven safety mechanism based on a small increase of the predicted length. As a whole, our framework avoids wasting computation on padding tokens, at the same time preserving output quality. Experimental validation on multiple datasets demonstrates that Predict-then-Diffuse significantly reduces computational costs (FLOP) compared to the default D-LLM inference mechanism, while being robust to skewed data distributions.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IJCNN 2026 (International Joint Conference on Neural Networks)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散式大语言模型 (D-LLM) 需在生成前预设固定响应长度的架构限制，提出模型无关的 Predict-then-Diffuse 框架：先估计每个输入查询的最优响应长度，再据此执行 D-LLM 推理。核心组件是自适应响应长度预测器 (AdaRLP)，并配以数据驱动的小幅长度上浮作为防低估机制。多数据集实验表明，相比默认 D-LLM 推理，该方法显著降低 FLOP 计算成本，同时保持输出质量并对偏斜数据分布鲁棒。
Motivation: D-LLM 的并行生成要求推理前确定固定响应长度，长度过大会在无意义的 padding token 上浪费计算，长度过小则导致输出截断并触发昂贵的重新计算，带来不可预测的延迟尖峰。
Method: 提出 Predict-then-Diffuse 框架，先用 AdaRLP 估计输入查询所需的响应长度，再以该长度运行 D-LLM 推理；针对低估响应长度需重跑推理的风险，引入基于数据的安全机制，即对预测长度做小幅增加。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验验证显示，该方法与默认 D-LLM 推理机制相比显著降低计算成本 (FLOP)，同时保持输出质量，并对偏斜数据分布具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调先预测长度再生成可以避免 padding token 上的计算浪费以及长度不足引发的重计算，从而在不牺牲输出质量的前提下实现按查询预算化的 D-LLM 推理。

papers.title: Escaping Mode Collapse in LLM Generation via Geometric Regulation
papers.abstract_en: Mode collapse is a persistent challenge in generative modeling and appears in autoregressive text generation as behaviors ranging from explicit looping to gradual loss of diversity and premature trajectory convergence. We take a dynamical-systems view and reinterpret mode collapse as reduced state-space accessibility caused by *geometric collapse*: during generation, the model's internal trajectory becomes confined to a low-dimensional region of its representation space. This implies mode collapse is not purely a token-level phenomenon and cannot be reliably solved by symbolic constraints or probability-only decoding heuristics. Guided by this perspective, we propose *Reinforced Mode Regulation* (RMR), a lightweight, online state-space intervention that regulates dominant self-reinforcing directions in the Transformer value cache (implemented as low-rank damping). Across multiple large language models, RMR substantially reduces mode collapse and enables stable generation at extremely low entropy rates (down to 0.8 nats/step), whereas standard decoding typically collapses near 2.0 nats/step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从动力系统视角重新解释大语言模型自回归生成中的模式坍缩 (mode collapse)，将其归因于生成过程中内部轨迹在表征空间中收缩到低维区域，即几何坍缩 (geometric collapse)。作者提出 Reinforced Mode Regulation (RMR)，一种轻量级在线状态空间干预，通过对 Transformer value cache 中主导的自强化方向施加低秩阻尼 (low-rank damping) 来恢复生成多样性。实验显示 RMR 在多个大语言模型上显著降低模式坍缩，并支持低至 0.8 nats/step 的极低熵率稳定生成，而标准解码通常在约 2.0 nats/step 即坍缩。
Motivation: 模式坍缩是生成建模中的持续难题，在自回归文本生成中表现为显式循环、多样性逐渐丢失以及轨迹过早收敛。作者认为现有符号约束或仅基于概率的解码启发式无法可靠解决，因为模式坍缩并非纯粹 token 层面的现象。
Method: 提出 Reinforced Mode Regulation (RMR)，一种轻量级在线状态空间干预方法，通过低秩阻尼调节 Transformer value cache 中自我强化的主导方向，从而抑制状态空间可达性的几何坍缩。
Result: 在多个大语言模型上，RMR 大幅减少模式坍缩，并能在极低熵率 (低至 0.8 nats/step) 下保持稳定生成，而标准解码通常在接近 2.0 nats/step 时坍缩。
Conclusion: 作者主张模式坍缩具有几何本质，需在状态空间层面干预；RMR 表明对 value cache 的轻量在线调控是一种有效且低成本的正则手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FieryGS: In-the-Wild Fire Synthesis with Physics-Integrated Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of synthesizing photorealistic, physically plausible combustion effects in in-the-wild 3D scenes. Traditional CFD and graphics pipelines can produce realistic fire effects but rely on handcrafted geometry, expert-tuned parameters, and labor-intensive workflows, limiting their scalability to the real world. Recent scene modeling advances like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable high-fidelity real-world scene reconstruction, yet lack physical grounding for combustion. To bridge this gap, we propose FieryGS, a physically-based framework that integrates physically-accurate and user-controllable combustion simulation and rendering within the 3DGS pipeline, enabling realistic fire synthesis for real scenes. Our approach tightly couples three key modules: (1) multimodal large-language-model-based physical material reasoning, (2) efficient volumetric combustion simulation, and (3) a unified renderer for fire and 3DGS. By unifying reconstruction, physical reasoning, simulation, and rendering, FieryGS removes manual tuning and automatically generates realistic, controllable fire dynamics consistent with scene geometry and materials. Our framework supports complex combustion phenomena -- including flame propagation, smoke dispersion, and surface carbonization -- with precise user control over fire intensity, airflow, ignition location and other combustion parameters. Evaluated on diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, FieryGS outperforms all comparative baselines in visual realism, physical fidelity, and controllability. Project page can be found at https://pku-vcl-geometry.github.io/FieryGS/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FieryGS，一个将物理燃烧模拟与 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）相结合的框架，用于在真实世界场景中生成照片级真实且物理可信的火焰效果。框架把基于多模态大语言模型的物理材质推理、高效体积燃烧模拟和统一渲染器紧密耦合，支持火焰传播、烟雾扩散和表面碳化等燃烧现象，并允许用户控制火势强度、气流、点火位置等参数。在多种室内外场景上的评估显示，其在视觉真实感、物理保真度和可控性上优于对比基线。
Motivation: 传统 CFD 和图形学管线能生成逼真的火焰效果，但依赖手工几何、专家调参和繁琐工作流，难以扩展到真实世界场景；而 3DGS 等场景建模方法能高质量重建真实场景，却缺乏燃烧的物理基础。FieryGS 旨在弥合这一鸿沟，在不需手动调参的情况下自动生成与场景几何和材质一致的火焰动态。
Method: FieryGS 是一个物理基础框架，将三个关键模块紧密耦合：多模态大语言模型驱动的物理材质推理、高效的体积燃烧模拟，以及把火焰与 3DGS 统一起来的渲染器。通过把重建、物理推理、模拟和渲染统一在一起，框架去除了手动调参，并支持对火势强度、气流、点火位置等燃烧参数的精细控制。
Result: 在多种室内外场景的评估中，FieryGS 在视觉真实感、物理保真度和可控性方面优于所有对比基线。摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将物理燃烧模拟与 3DGS 统一可以自动生成与场景几何和材质一致的可控火焰动态，并支持火焰传播、烟雾扩散和表面碳化等复杂燃烧现象；该框架面向 in-the-wild 真实场景，评估覆盖室内外场景，但摘要未讨论明确的局限性。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Evaluating the Alignment Between GeoAI Explanations and Domain Knowledge in Satellite-Based Flood Mapping
papers.abstract_en: The increasing number of satellites has improved the temporal resolution of Earth observation, making satellite-based flood mapping a promising approach for operational flood monitoring. Deep learning-based approaches for flood mapping using satellite imagery, an important application within Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI), have shown improved predictive performance by learning complex spatial and spectral patterns from large volumes of remote sensing data. However, the opaque decision-making processes of deep learning models remain a major barrier to their integration into critical scientific and operational workflows. This highlights the need for a systematic assessment of whether model explanations align with established domain knowledge in remote sensing. To address this research gap, this study introduces the ADAGE (Alignment between Domain Knowledge and GeoAI Explanation Evaluation) framework. The proposed framework is designed to systematically evaluate how well explanations of deep learning models align with established remote sensing knowledge, particularly regarding the distinctive spectral properties of the Earth's surface. The ADAGE framework employs Channel-Group SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) method to estimate the contributions of grouped input channels to pixel-level predictions. Experiments on two satellite-based flood mapping tasks demonstrate that the ADAGE framework can (1) quantitatively assess the alignment between model explanations and reference explanations derived from domain knowledge, and (2) help domain experts identify misaligned explanations through the proposed alignment scores. This study contributes to bridging the gap between explainability and domain knowledge in GeoAI for Earth observation, enhancing the applicability of GeoAI models in scientific and operational workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ADAGE（Alignment between Domain Knowledge and GeoAI Explanation Evaluation）框架，用于系统评估 GeoAI 深度学习模型在卫星洪水制图任务中的解释与遥感领域知识的一致性。框架采用 Channel-Group SHAP 方法估计分组输入通道对像素级预测的贡献，并在两个卫星洪水制图任务上验证其能够定量评估解释对齐程度并帮助专家识别不对齐的解释。
Motivation: 基于深度学习的洪水制图模型预测性能良好，但其决策过程不透明，阻碍其融入关键科学与业务工作流；目前缺乏对模型解释是否与遥感领域知识一致的系统评估手段。
Method: 提出 ADAGE 框架，采用 Channel-Group SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）方法估计分组输入通道对像素级预测的贡献，并将这些解释与从领域知识导出的参考解释进行定量对齐比较。
Result: 在两个卫星洪水制图任务上的实验表明，ADAGE 能够（1）定量评估模型解释与领域知识参考解释之间的对齐程度，（2）通过提出的对齐分数帮助领域专家识别解释不一致之处。
Conclusion: 该研究弥合了 GeoAI 中可解释性与领域知识之间的鸿沟，旨在增强 GeoAI 模型在科学和业务工作流中的适用性。

papers.title: Do LLMs Hold Their Values? MANTA: A Multi-Turn Adversarial Benchmark for Animal Welfare Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating animal welfare reasoning in LLMs remains an open challenge despite rapid deployment in consumer and professional contexts where welfare considerations appear implicitly in everyday queries. Existing benchmarks such as AnimalHarmBench evaluate this through single-turn, explicitly framed questions, measuring whether models avoid harmful content when directly asked. This approach overlooks two failure modes: alignment degradation under sustained adversarial pressure, and moral sensitivity (whether a model spontaneously surfaces welfare stakes in everyday queries). To fill this gap, we construct MANTA, a benchmark of 1,088 five-turn conversations progressing from an implicit Turn-1 scenario through an explicit welfare prompt to three adversarial pressure rounds drawn from a five-type taxonomy: Social, Cultural, Economic, Pragmatic, and Epistemic. We score conversations on two dimensions: Animal Welfare Value Stability (AWVS, primary) and Animal Welfare Moral Sensitivity (AWMS, diagnostic). We evaluate seven frontier models: Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, DeepSeek V4, Llama 3.3 70B, Mistral Small, Grok 4.3, and Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite. Multi-turn evaluation captures behavior single-turn benchmarks miss: 4 of 7 models change rank relative to Turn 1 scores, including Gemini Flash Lite, which drops from fifth on AWMS to last on AWVS. AWMS and AWVS are positively but imperfectly correlated, suggesting moral-recognition tests capture a stable but incomplete component of model behavior under pressure. MANTA also enables a species-by-pressure interaction matrix unavailable to prior benchmarks, showing welfare robustness depends jointly on the animal and pressure applied; companion animals score above wild animals, which score above farmed animals and invertebrates. We release the dataset, scripted pressure plans, judge prompts, and analysis code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MANTA，一个包含 1,088 段五轮对话的多轮对抗基准，用于评估大语言模型在动物福利推理中的价值稳定性（Animal Welfare Value Stability, AWVS）和道德敏感性（Animal Welfare Moral Sensitivity, AWMS）。作者评估了七个前沿模型，发现多轮评估能捕捉到单轮基准遗漏的行为，例如 7 个模型中有 4 个的相对排名在 Turn 1 之后发生变化。基准还支持物种与压力类型的交互分析，并公开了数据集和分析代码。
Motivation: 现有基准（如 AnimalHarmBench）仅通过单轮、明确框架的问题评估模型是否避免有害内容，忽略了两种失败模式：持续对抗压力下的对齐退化，以及模型在日常查询中自发浮现福利问题的道德敏感性。
Method: 构建 MANTA 基准，对话结构为：隐式的 Turn-1 场景、明确的福利提示，随后是来自五种类型（社会、文化、经济、实用、认识论）的三轮对抗压力。对话从 AWVS（主要）和 AWMS（诊断性）两个维度打分，并评估 Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.5、DeepSeek V4、Llama 3.3 70B、Mistral Small、Grok 4.3 和 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 七个模型。
Result: 多轮评估改变了模型排名：7 个模型中有 4 个相对 Turn 1 分数发生变化，其中 Gemini Flash Lite 从 AWMS 第五名降至 AWVS 最后一名。AWMS 与 AWVS 呈正相关但不完全一致，表明道德识别测试只能捕捉模型在压力下行为的稳定但不完整部分。物种-压力交互矩阵显示，伴侣动物得分高于野生动物，后者高于农场动物和无脊椎动物。
Conclusion: 作者强调多轮评估能捕获单轮基准遗漏的行为，动物福利稳健性取决于动物种类和所施加压力类型的共同作用；论文同时公开了数据集、脚本化压力计划、评判提示词和分析代码。

papers.title: TimeRFT: Stimulating Generalizable Time Series Forecasting for TSFMs via Reinforcement Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have demonstrated strong generalization capability and data efficiency in time series forecasting through large-scale pretraining. However, adapting TSFMs to downstream forecasting tasks remains challenging due to temporal distribution shifts and varying data availability. Specifically, the non-stationary and uncertain nature of time series data leads to discrepancies between historical training and future forecasting distributions, making existing Supervised FineTuning (SFT)-based adaptation vulnerable to overfitting and limited generalization. Moreover, forecasting tasks often operate under varying data regimes, requiring TSFMs to extract generalizable temporal patterns from limited training samples. To address these challenges, we propose Time series Reinforcement FineTuning (TimeRFT), a reinforcement learning-based adaptation paradigm for TSFMs. TimeRFT introduces two forecasting-oriented training recipes: (i) A quality-aware temporal reward mechanism providing fine-grained credit assignment by holistically evaluating the contribution of each prediction step to overall forecasting performance. (ii) A difficulty-aware data selection strategy prioritizing informative time series samples with generalizable forecasting patterns. Extensive experiments on diverse real-world forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that TimeRFT consistently surpasses SFT-based adaptation methods across various real-world forecasting tasks with different data regimes, achieving improved prediction accuracy and enhanced generalization against unforeseen distribution shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TimeRFT，一种面向时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的强化学习微调范式，用于替代监督微调 (SFT) 并提升下游预测的泛化能力。方法包含质量感知的时序奖励机制和难度感知的数据选择策略。实验在多个真实世界预测基准上显示，TimeRFT 在不同数据规模条件下一致优于 SFT 式适应方法，并增强对未知分布漂移的鲁棒性。
Motivation: TSFM 通过大规模预训练具备强泛化与数据效率，但下游适应时面临时间分布漂移和数据可用性变化，导致 SFT 容易过拟合并缺乏泛化。文章希望让模型从有限训练样本中提取可泛化的时间模式。
Method: 提出基于强化学习的 TimeRFT，包含两个训练设计：(i) 质量感知的时间奖励机制，逐预测步进行细粒度信用分配，以整体评估每一步对最终预测质量的贡献；(ii) 难度感知的数据选择策略，优先选择具有可泛化预测模式的信息量大的时间序列样本。
Result: 在多个真实世界预测基准上的大量实验表明，TimeRFT 在不同数据规模的多种任务中一致超过 SFT 式适应方法，取得更高的预测精度，并对未见过的分布漂移表现出更强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为强化微调可作为 TSFM 适应下游预测任务的有效范式，能够缓解分布漂移与数据稀缺带来的泛化问题。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: PEFT of SLM for Telecommunications Customer Support: A Comparative Study of LoRA Configurations with Energy Consumption Analysis
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) show strong performance in natural language understanding and generation, their evaluation and adaptation to domain-specific constraints in telecommunications customer support remain limited. In addition, data sovereignty, regulatory constraints, and the handling of sensitive customer and network information complicate the use of externally hosted foundation models in this domain. We present a systematic study of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) applied to Qwen2.5-3B to build a domain-specific conversational assistant. We introduce a combinatorial synthetic data generation approach based on a glossary of 52 industry-specific terms, producing approximately 30,000 training examples across 1,560 distinct problem scenarios via a generative pipeline powered by Gemini 2.0 Flash. We evaluate 16 LoRA configurations by varying hyperparameters and target modules. Our evaluation extends beyond standard metrics by incorporating energy consumption analysis and qualitative assessment using an LLM-as-a-judge framework with GPT-5.2 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet. Results show a clear divergence between quantitative and qualitative performance: models achieving the lowest validation loss do not necessarily obtain the best human-aligned rankings. The best validation loss (0.5024) ranks only 6th-7th in qualitative evaluation, while the worst loss (0.6807) ranks first according to both judges. This work contributes (1) a combinatorial method for synthetic dataset construction, (2) insights into the impact of target module selection for LoRA injection, (3) evidence that validation loss alone is insufficient for selecting fine-tuning configurations in conversational AI, and (4) an energy-performance trade-off analysis for sustainable LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 Qwen2.5-3B 应用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 进行参数高效微调 (PEFT)，面向电信客户支持构建领域对话助手。作者基于 52 个行业术语词汇表，用 Gemini 2.0 Flash 生成约 30,000 条训练样本、覆盖 1,560 个问题场景，并评估 16 种 LoRA 配置（变化超参数与目标模块）。评估除标准指标外还加入能耗分析和基于 GPT-5.2 与 Claude 4.5 Sonnet 的 LLM-as-a-judge 定性评估。结果显示定量与定性性能明显背离：最低验证损失 (0.5024) 的配置在定性排名中仅列第 6-7 位，而最差验证损失 (0.6807) 被两个评判器均排为第一。
Motivation: LLM 在自然语言理解与生成上表现强，但在电信客服领域特定约束下的评估与适配仍有限；同时数据主权、监管约束和敏感客户/网络信息使得外部托管的基座模型难以使用，需要系统研究领域内的参数高效微调方案。
Method: 提出一种组合式合成数据生成方法，以 52 个行业术语为词汇表、通过 Gemini 2.0 Flash 生成约 30,000 条训练样本和 1,560 个问题场景；随后对 Qwen2.5-3B 进行 16 种 LoRA 配置的系统对比，变化超参数与目标注入模块，并引入能耗分析以及 LLM-as-a-judge 定性评估框架。
Result: 摘要报告验证损失与人类对齐排名不一致：最佳验证损失 (0.5024) 的模型在定性评估中仅排第 6-7 名，而最差验证损失 (0.6807) 的模型被 GPT-5.2 和 Claude 4.5 Sonnet 两位评判器一致排为第一。
Conclusion: 论文贡献包括：组合式合成数据集构建方法、LoRA 目标模块选择影响的洞察、验证损失不足以单独用于对话 AI 微调配置选择的证据，以及面向可持续 LLM 部署的能耗-性能权衡分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PEMAND: Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Household Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Modeling household-level decisions is central to many real-world applications, including trip planning, residential mobility and migration, disaster management, etc. Existing studies primarily rely on classical machine learning models with limited predictive capacity, while recent LLM-based approaches have yet to incorporate behavioral theory or intra-household interaction dynamics, both of which are essential for modeling realistic household decisions. To address these limitations, we propose Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for household Decision-making (PEMAND), a novel LLM-based framework that integrates behavioral theory into individualized, household-aware persona modeling and simulates household-level decision-making through structured multi-agent negotiation. Specifically, PEMAND transforms static sociodemographic attributes into coherent narrative profiles that explicitly encode household-level attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral controls, following our proposed Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior (HA-CoPB) framework. Building on these theory-grounded personas, PEMAND captures real-world household decision negotiation via a structured two-phase multi-agent conversation framework with a novel persona-alignment control mechanism. Evaluated on national and regional household decision datasets across two major domains, including travel behavior and residential mobility, PEMAND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEMAND，一个基于 LLM 的家庭决策建模框架，将行为理论融入个体化、家庭感知的角色建模，并通过结构化多智能体协商模拟家庭层面的决策过程。摘要称该方法在旅行行为和居住流动性两大领域的全国及区域家庭决策数据集上一致优于现有基准。
Motivation: 现有家庭决策研究主要依赖预测能力有限的经典机器学习模型，而近期基于 LLM 的方法尚未纳入行为理论或家庭内部的交互动态，这两者对建模真实家庭决策都至关重要。
Method: PEMAND 基于提出的 Household-Aware Chain-of-Planned-Behavior (HA-CoPB) 框架，将静态社会人口学属性转化为连贯的叙事画像，显式编码家庭层面的态度、主观规范和感知行为控制；随后通过带新颖的 persona-alignment 控制机制的两阶段多智能体对话框架来刻画真实家庭决策协商。
Result: 在旅行行为与居住流动性两个主要领域的全国和区域家庭决策数据集上，PEMAND 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基准。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将行为理论支撑的角色建模与结构化多智能体协商结合，可以有效改进家庭层面的决策建模效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpsLLM: Construction of Large Language Model for Software Operations with Multi-stage Learning
papers.abstract_en: In the field of software operations, Large Language Models (LLMs) have attracted increasing attention. However, existing research has not yet achieved efficient and effective endto-end intelligent operations due to low-quality data, fragmented knowledge and insufficient learning. To explore the potential of LLMs in software operations, we propose OpsLLM, a domainspecific LLM that supports both knowledge-based question answering (QA) and root cause analysis (RCA). Moreover, we disclose the detailed workflow for building LLMs specifically in the software operations domain. First, a Human-in-the-Loop mechanism is introduced to curate high-quality data from a large collection of operational data and construct a fine-tuning dataset. Then, based on the data, supervised fine-tuning is conducted to achieve a base model. Furthermore, we introduce a domain process reward model (DPRM) during the reinforcement learning stage to optimize the accuracy and reliability of the fine-tuned model on RCA tasks. Experimental results on the tasks with diverse difficulties demonstrate that OpsLLMs effectively learns and aligns with the operational domain knowledge infused, outperforming existing open-source and closed-source LLMs in accuracy with improvements of 0.2%~11.9% on QA tasks and 8.5%~70.3% on RCA tasks, while exhibiting strong transferability. Moreover, we will open-source three versions of OpsLLM with 7B, 14B and 32B parameters, along with a 15K fine-tuning dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpsLLM 是一个面向软件运维领域的专用大语言模型，同时支持基于知识的问答（QA）和根因分析（RCA）。作者公开了构建该领域 LLM 的完整流程：先通过 Human-in-the-Loop 机制从运维数据中筛选高质量数据并构造微调数据集，再进行监督微调得到基座模型，最后在强化学习阶段引入领域过程奖励模型（DPRM）优化 RCA 任务的准确性与可靠性。实验表明 OpsLLM 在 QA 任务上准确率提升 0.2%~11.9%，在 RCA 任务上提升 8.5%~70.3%，并展现出较强的迁移能力；作者将开源 7B、14B、32B 三个版本及 15K 微调数据集。
Motivation: 现有研究尚未实现高效且有效的端到端智能运维，主要受限于低质量数据、碎片化知识以及不充分的学习过程，需要探索 LLM 在软件运维领域的潜力。
Method: 提出 OpsLLM 构建流程：引入 Human-in-the-Loop 机制从大规模运维数据中筛选高质量数据并构造微调数据集；基于该数据进行监督微调得到基座模型；在强化学习阶段引入领域过程奖励模型（DPRM）以提升 RCA 任务的准确性和可靠性。
Result: 在多种难度的任务上，OpsLLM 在 QA 任务上的准确率较现有开源与闭源 LLM 提升 0.2%~11.9%，在 RCA 任务上提升 8.5%~70.3%，并表现出较强的迁移性。
