papers.title: Compiled AI: Deterministic Code Generation for LLM-Based Workflow Automation
authors: Walter A. De Brouwer (2) ((1) this http URL Labs
(4) Brigham and Women's Hospital / Harvard Medical School
papers.abstract_en: We study compiled AI, a paradigm in which large language models generate executable code artifacts during a compilation phase, after which workflows execute deterministically without further model invocation. This paradigm has antecedents in prior work on declarative pipeline optimization (DSPy) and hybrid neural-symbolic planning (LLM+P); our contribution is a systems-oriented study of its application to high-stakes enterprise workflows, with particular emphasis on healthcare settings where reliability and auditability are critical. By constraining generation to narrow business-logic functions embedded in validated templates, compiled AI trades runtime flexibility for predictability, auditability, cost efficiency, and reduced security exposure. We introduce (i) a system architecture for constrained LLM-based code generation, (ii) a four-stage generation-and-validation pipeline that converts probabilistic model output into production-ready code artifacts, and (iii) an evaluation framework measuring operational metrics including token amortization, determinism, reliability, security, and cost. We evaluate on two task types: function-calling (BFCL, n=400) and document intelligence (DocILE, n=5,680 invoices). On function-calling, compiled AI achieves 96% task completion with zero execution tokens, breaking even with runtime inference at approximately 17 transactions and reducing token consumption by 57x at 1,000 transactions. On document intelligence, our Code Factory variant matches Direct LLM on key field extraction (KILE: 80.0%) while achieving the highest line item recognition accuracy (LIR: 80.4%). Security evaluation across 135 test cases demonstrates 96.7% accuracy on prompt injection detection and 87.5% on static code safety analysis with zero false positives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 compiled AI 范式，即大语言模型在编译阶段生成可执行代码工件，之后工作流以确定性方式运行而不再调用模型。作者将这一范式应用到医疗等高风险企业工作流中，通过约束生成到验证过的模板内的窄业务逻辑函数，换取可预测性、可审计性、成本效率和更小的安全暴露面。论文在函数调用（BFCL, n=400）和文档智能（DocILE, n=5,680 张发票）两类任务上评估，并报告了 token 摊销、确定性、可靠性、安全性和成本等运营指标。
Motivation: 高风险企业工作流（尤其是医疗场景）对可靠性和可审计性要求极高，而运行时反复调用 LLM 会带来灵活性、成本和安全方面的代价。现有工作如 DSPy 和 LLM+P 已有声明式管线优化与神经符号规划的雏形，但缺少针对这种编译模式在关键业务中的系统化研究。
Method: 提出受限 LLM 代码生成的系统架构，以及一个四阶段生成与验证流水线，将概率模型输出转换为生产就绪的代码工件。此外构建了一个评估框架，衡量 token 摊销、确定性、可靠性、安全性和成本等运营指标。
Result: 在函数调用上，compiled AI 达到 96% 任务完成率且零执行 token，约 17 笔交易即与运行时推理打平，在 1,000 笔交易时 token 消耗降低 57 倍。在文档智能上，Code Factory 变体在关键字段抽取（KILE）上与 Direct LLM 持平（80.0%），并取得最高的行项目识别准确率（LIR: 80.4%）。安全评估在 135 个测试用例上实现 96.7% 的提示注入检测准确率和 87.5% 的静态代码安全性分析准确率，且零误报。
Conclusion: 作者认为 compiled AI 通过交易运行时灵活性换取可预测性、可审计性、成本效率与更低安全暴露，适用于医疗等高风险企业工作流；论文的贡献是面向系统的架构、流水线和评估框架。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: What Makes a Sale? Simulating End-to-End Seller--Buyer Retail Dynamics with LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating retail strategies before deployment is difficult, as outcomes are determined across multiple stages, from seller-side persuasion through buyer-seller interaction to purchase decisions. However, existing retail simulators capture only partial aspects of this process and do not model cross-stage dependencies, making it difficult to assess how early decisions affect downstream outcomes. We present RetailSim, an end-to-end retail simulation framework that models this pipeline in a unified environment, explicitly designed for simulation fidelity through diverse product spaces, persona-driven agents, and multi-turn interactions. We evaluate RetailSim with a dual protocol comprising human evaluation of behavioral fidelity and meta-evaluation against real-world economic regularities, showing that it successfully reproduces key patterns such as demographic purchasing behavior, the price-demand relationship, and heterogeneous price elasticity. We further demonstrate its practical utility via decision-oriented use cases, including persona inference, seller-buyer interaction analysis, and sales strategy evaluation, showing RetailSim's potential as a controlled testbed for exploring retail strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RetailSim，一个端到端的零售模拟框架，将卖家说服、买卖双方交互到购买决策的完整流程统一建模，并通过多样化商品空间、人格驱动的智能体 (persona-driven agents) 和多轮交互提升模拟保真度。作者用人类行为保真度评估和针对真实经济规律 (如人口统计购买行为、价格-需求关系、异质价格弹性) 的元评估进行验证，并展示了其在人格推断、交互分析与销售策略评估中的实用价值。
Motivation: 现有零售模拟器只覆盖销售流程的部分环节，没有建模跨阶段依赖，难以评估早期决策如何影响下游结果；这导致部署前的零售策略评估困难。
Method: 提出 RetailSim 统一模拟端到端零售流程，结合多样化商品空间、人格驱动的智能体和多轮交互；评估采用双协议：人类对行为保真度的评估，以及对照真实世界经济规律的元评估。
Result: RetailSim 成功复现了人口统计购买行为、价格-需求关系和异质价格弹性等关键模式，并通过决策导向用例（人格推断、买卖交互分析、销售策略评估）展示其作为受控测试平台的能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RetailSim 有潜力成为探索零售策略的受控测试平台，但摘要未明确讨论其局限或适用范围。

papers.title: TRACE: High-Fidelity 3D Scene Editing via Tangible Reconstruction and Geometry-Aligned Contextual Video Masking
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) editing methods primarily focus on appearance modification and often struggle to support flexible geometry editing while preserving structural integrity and scene-consistent appearance. To address this limitation, we present TRACE, a mesh-guided 3DGS editing framework that automatically aligns explicit 3D geometry with Gaussian scenes and decouples Geometric Anchoring from Appearance Harmonization. First, Multi-view 3D-Anchor Synthesis, trained on our MV-TRACE dataset for scene-coherent object addition and modification, generates geometrically aligned editing anchors, while Tangible Geometry Alignment (TGA) performs coarse-to-fine mesh-scene registration. Then, Contextual Video Masking (CVM) integrates projected 3D anchors into an autoregressive video diffusion pipeline, harmonizing their appearance with the surrounding scene while maintaining multi-view consistency. We evaluate TRACE on eight held-out scenes across six editing categories. TRACE completes each edit in approximately 10 minutes on a single NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPU. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods in editing versatility, structural integrity, semantic alignment, multi-view consistency, and visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一个基于网格引导的 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 编辑框架，用于在保持几何与外观一致性的前提下进行灵活的三维场景编辑。框架将显式 3D 几何与 Gaussian 场景自动对齐，并解耦几何锚定与外观协调两个阶段：多视角 3D 锚点合成在自建的 MV-TRACE 数据集上训练，Tangible Geometry Alignment 执行由粗到细的网格—场景配准，Contextual Video Masking 将投影后的 3D 锚点集成到自回归视频扩散流程中以协调外观并保持多视角一致性。作者在八个保留场景、六类编辑任务上评估，单块 NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPU 上约 10 分钟完成一次编辑，并在编辑多样性、结构完整性、语义对齐、多视角一致性和视觉质量上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 编辑方法主要聚焦外观修改，难以在保持结构完整性和场景一致外观的同时支持灵活的几何编辑。
Method: TRACE 采用网格引导的框架，先通过 Multi-view 3D-Anchor Synthesis 生成几何对齐的编辑锚点，再用 Tangible Geometry Alignment 进行粗到细的网格—场景注册，最后用 Contextual Video Masking 将锚点融入自回归视频扩散流程，完成外观协调与多视角一致性维护。
Result: 在八个保留场景、六类编辑类别上的实验表明，TRACE 在编辑多样性、结构完整性、语义对齐、多视角一致性和视觉质量上较现有方法有一致提升，且每次编辑约 10 分钟完成（单块 NVIDIA RTX Pro 6000 GPU）。
Conclusion: 作者认为将几何锚定与外观协调解耦、并引入场景对齐的视频扩散式遮罩协调，可以同时支持灵活几何编辑与一致的外观融合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Physics to Surrogate Intelligence: A Unified Electro-Thermo-Optimization Framework for TSV Networks
papers.abstract_en: High-density through-substrate vias (TSVs) enable 2.5D/3D heterogeneous integration but introduce significant signal-integrity and thermal-reliability challenges due to electrical coupling, insertion loss, and self-heating. Conventional full-wave finite-element method (FEM) simulations provide high accuracy but become computationally prohibitive for large design-space exploration. This work presents a scalable electro--thermal modeling and optimization framework that combines physics-informed analytical modeling, graph neural network (GNN) surrogates, and full-wave sign-off validation. A multi-conductor analytical model computes broadband S-parameters and effective anisotropic thermal conductivities of TSV arrays, achieving $5\%$--$10\%$ relative Frobenius error (RFE) across array sizes up to $15\times15$. A physics-informed GNN surrogate (TSV-PhGNN), trained on analytical data and fine-tuned with HFSS simulations, generalizes to larger arrays with mean RFE below $5\%$ in-distribution. The surrogate is integrated into a multi-objective Pareto optimization framework targeting reflection coefficient, insertion loss, worst-case crosstalk (NEXT/FEXT), and effective thermal conductivity. Millions of TSV configurations can be explored within minutes, enabling exhaustive layout and geometric optimization that would be infeasible using FEM alone. Final designs are validated with Ansys HFSS and Mechanical, showing strong agreement. The proposed framework enables rapid electro--thermal co-design of TSV arrays while reducing per-design evaluation time by more than six orders of magnitude.
papers.comment: Published in the IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (IEEE TCAD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向高密度TSV阵列的电-热建模与优化框架，结合物理信息解析建模、图神经网络（GNN）代理模型和全波sign-off验证。多导体解析模型在15×15阵列上实现5%–10%的相对Frobenius误差，物理信息GNN代理TSV-PhGNN在分布内更大阵列上平均误差低于5%。该框架被集成到多目标Pareto优化流程中，可在几分钟内探索数百万种TSV配置，并将单次设计评估时间降低超过6个数量级。
Motivation: 高密度TSV实现2.5D/3D异构集成，但带来信号完整性和热可靠性问题；传统全波FEM仿真虽然准确，但在大规模设计空间探索中计算代价过高，难以支撑快速电热协同设计。
Method: 提出一个三部分组成的框架：多导体解析模型用于计算宽带S参数和有效各向异性热导率；基于解析数据训练并用HFSS仿真微调的物理信息GNN代理（TSV-PhGNN）用于泛化到更大阵列；代理模型被嵌入多目标Pareto优化框架，同时优化反射系数、插入损耗、最坏情况串扰（NEXT/FEXT）和有效热导率。
Result: 解析模型在15×15阵列上达到5%–10%的相对Frobenius误差；TSV-PhGNN在分布内更大阵列上平均RFE低于5%。框架可数分钟内探索数百万配置，最终设计经Ansys HFSS和Mechanical验证与仿真一致，单设计评估时间减少超过6个数量级。
Conclusion: 该框架使TSV阵列的快速电热协同设计成为可能，能够执行FEM单独难以完成的穷举式布局与几何优化，并以全波仿真验证最终设计。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种面向高密度TSV阵列的电-热建模与优化框架，结合物理信息解析建模、图神经网络（GNN）代理模型和全波sign-off验证。多导体解析模型在15×15阵列上实现5%–10%的相对Frobenius误差，物理信息GNN代理TSV-PhGNN在分布内更大阵列上平均误差低于5%。该框架被集成到多目标Pareto优化流程中，可在几分钟内探索数百万种TSV配置，并将单次设计评估时间降低超过6个数量级。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架使TSV阵列的快速电热协同设计成为可能，能够执行FEM单独难以完成的穷举式布局与几何优化，并以全波仿真验证最终设计。

papers.title: Maximum Entropy Behavior Exploration for Sim2Real Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms aim to learn a family of policies from a reward-free dataset, and recover optimal policies for any reward function directly at test time. Naturally, the quality of the pretraining dataset determines the performance of the recovered policies across tasks. However, pre-collecting a relevant, diverse dataset without prior knowledge of the downstream tasks of interest remains a challenge. In this work, we study $\textit{online}$ zero-shot RL for quadrupedal control on real robotic systems, building upon the Forward-Backward (FB) algorithm. We observe that undirected exploration yields low-diversity data, leading to poor downstream performance and rendering policies impractical for direct hardware deployment. Therefore, we introduce FB-MEBE, an online zero-shot RL algorithm that combines an unsupervised behavior exploration strategy with a regularization critic. FB-MEBE promotes exploration by maximizing the entropy of the achieved behavior distribution. Additionally, a regularization critic shapes the recovered policies toward more natural and physically plausible behaviors. We empirically demonstrate that FB-MEBE achieves and improved performance compared to other exploration strategies in a range of simulated downstream tasks, and that it renders natural policies that can be seamlessly deployed to hardware without further finetuning. Videos and code available on our website.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究真实四足机器人上的在线零样本强化学习（zero-shot RL），基于 Forward-Backward (FB) 算法提出 FB-MEBE。该方法将无监督的行为探索策略（最大化已达行为分布的熵）与正则化评论家（regularization critic）结合，以提升预训练数据多样性并生成更自然、物理上合理的策略。摘要在多个模拟下游任务上报告了相较其他探索策略更优的性能，并称策略无需微调即可直接部署到硬件。
Motivation: 零样本 RL 依赖无奖励预训练数据集的质量，但在不知道下游任务的情况下预先收集相关且多样的数据仍有挑战；观察发现无导向探索产生的数据多样性低，导致下游性能差且策略难以直接用于硬件部署。
Method: 提出 FB-MEBE，一种在线零样本 RL 算法：通过最大化已实现行为分布的熵来促进探索，并引入正则化评论家来塑造恢复出的策略，使其更接近自然且有物理合理性的行为。
Result: 摘要报告 FB-MEBE 在一系列模拟下游任务中优于其他探索策略，并生成自然的策略，可在不进一步微调的情况下无缝部署到真实硬件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将熵最大化的行为探索与正则化评论家结合，可以将零样本 RL 学到的策略落地到实际四足机器人硬件上。

papers.title: Estimating near-verbatim extraction risk in language models with decoding-constrained beam search
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that standard greedy-decoding extraction methods for quantifying memorization in LLMs miss how extraction risk varies across sequences. Probabilistic extraction -- computing the probability of generating a target suffix given a prefix under a decoding scheme -- addresses this, but is tractable only for verbatim memorization, missing near-verbatim instances that pose similar privacy and copyright risks. Quantifying near-verbatim extraction risk is expensive: the set of near-verbatim suffixes is combinatorially large, and reliable Monte Carlo (MC) estimation can require ~100,000 samples per sequence. To mitigate this cost, we introduce decoding-constrained beam search, which yields deterministic lower bounds on near-verbatim extraction risk at a cost comparable to ~20 MC samples per sequence. Across experiments, our approach surfaces information invisible to verbatim methods: many more extractable sequences, substantially larger per-sequence extraction mass, and patterns in how near-verbatim extraction risk manifests across model sizes and types of text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 decoding-constrained beam search 来估计语言模型中的近逐字提取风险（near-verbatim extraction risk），以约 20 个 Monte Carlo 样本的代价得到确定性下界，而可靠的 MC 估计每序列通常需要约 10 万次采样。实验表明该方法能揭示逐字（verbatim）提取方法看不到的信息：更多可提取序列、更大的每序列提取质量，以及近逐字提取风险随模型规模和文本类型变化的模式。
Motivation: 现有基于贪心解码的提取方法会遗漏风险随序列的变化，而概率提取方法虽能刻画这种变化，却只适用于逐字记忆，无法处理组合空间巨大的近逐字实例；可靠的 MC 估计代价过高。
Method: 提出 decoding-constrained beam search，在解码约束下执行束搜索，为近逐字提取风险计算确定性下界，计算开销与约 20 次 MC 采样相当。
Result: 实验显示该方法比逐字方法发现更多可提取序列、更大的每序列提取质量，并呈现近逐字提取风险在不同模型规模和文本类型上的分布模式。
Conclusion: 该方法为量化近逐字提取风险提供了一种廉价且确定性的工具，能够补足逐字提取方法的盲区。

papers.title: I3DM: Implicit 3D-aware Memory Retrieval and Injection for Consistent Video Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Despite remarkable progress in video generation, maintaining long-term scene consistency upon revisiting previously explored areas remains challenging. Existing solutions rely either on explicitly constructing 3D geometry, which suffers from error accumulation and scale ambiguity, or on naive camera Field-of-View (FoV) retrieval, which typically fails under complex occlusions. To overcome these limitations, we propose I3DM, a novel implicit 3D-aware memory mechanism for consistent video scene generation that bypasses explicit 3D reconstruction. At the core of our approach is a 3D-aware memory retrieval strategy, which leverages the intermediate features of a pre-trained Feed-Forward Novel View Synthesis (FF-NVS) model to score view relevance, enabling robust retrieval even in highly occluded scenarios. Furthermore, to fully utilize the retrieved historical frames, we introduce a 3D-aligned memory injection module. This module implicitly warps historical content to the target view and adaptively conditions the generation on reliable warping regions, leading to improved revisit consistency and accurate camera control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving superior revisit consistency, generation fidelity, and camera control precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 I3DM，一种面向一致视频场景生成的隐式 3D 感知记忆机制，用于在重新访问已探索区域时保持长期场景一致性，并绕过显式 3D 重建。该方法利用预训练前馈新视图合成 (FF-NVS) 模型的中间特征进行 3D 感知记忆检索，以在复杂遮挡下稳健评估视图相关性；同时引入 3D 对齐的记忆注入模块，将历史内容隐式变形到目标视图并自适应地以可靠变形区域为条件进行生成。实验表明该方法在重访一致性、生成保真度和相机控制精度上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 视频生成在重新访问先前探索区域时难以维持长期场景一致性；显式构建 3D 几何会带来误差累积和尺度歧义，而朴素的相机视场 (FoV) 检索在复杂遮挡下通常失效。
Method: 提出 I3DM 机制：3D 感知记忆检索利用预训练 FF-NVS 模型的中间特征对视图相关性打分，实现遮挡场景下的稳健检索；3D 对齐记忆注入模块隐式地将历史内容变形到目标视图，并自适应地以可靠变形区域为条件引导生成。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在重访一致性、生成保真度和相机控制精度上均优于现有最先进方法，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调绕过显式 3D 重建的隐式 3D 感知记忆机制能改善重访一致性并实现准确相机控制，应对复杂遮挡场景。

papers.title: Shaping Scientific Explanations to Expert Perspectives with Persona-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Explainable AI is increasingly important to scientific discovery. However, existing methods largely ignore that explanation quality is not universal: experts differ in how they assess evidence, prioritize mechanisms, and construct explanatory narratives. We introduce perspective-conditioned explanations, a framework for adapting explanation generation to epistemic variation in expert judgment. Using knowledge graph reasoning paths in drug discovery, we show that preferences organize into coherent epistemic perspectives that can be captured by agentic personas, representations of how experts evaluate explanations. Persona-aligned rewards then guide reinforcement learning-based explanation generation without large-scale expert supervision. Expert user studies show that perspective-conditioned explanations are preferred over general-purpose explanations and improve perceived relevance and validity. Moreover, they match or exceed state-of-the-art predictive performance and reduce expert feedback time by two orders of magnitude. Together, these findings demonstrate that explanation quality is perspective-dependent and that modeling this variation enables scalable and human-aligned explanation generation for scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出"视角条件化解释"(perspective-conditioned explanations)框架，针对科学发现中不同专家对证据评估和机制优先级的认知差异，用agentic personas刻画专家的评价偏好，并以persona对齐的奖励引导基于强化学习(reinforcement learning)的解释生成。在以药物发现知识图谱推理路径为场景的专家用户研究中，该方法生成的解释比通用解释更受偏好，感知相关性和有效性更高，同时预测性能达到或超过现有最优水平，并将专家反馈时间降低两个数量级。
Motivation: 可解释AI对科学发现日益重要，但现有方法基本忽略了解释质量并非普适的事实：专家在如何评估证据、如何给机制排序以及如何构建解释叙事上存在系统差异。
Method: 引入视角条件化解释框架，将专家判断中的认知差异组织为可捕获的认知视角(epistemic perspectives)，用agentic personas表征专家如何评价解释；在此基础上构造persona对齐的奖励，指导基于强化学习的解释生成，避免大规模专家监督。
Result: 专家用户研究显示，视角条件化解释比通用解释更受偏好，并提升感知相关性和有效性；此外在药物发现场景中预测性能达到或超过state-of-the-art，且专家反馈时间减少约两个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果表明解释质量是视角依赖的，建模这种认知差异能够为科学发现提供可扩展且与人类对齐的解释生成方式。

papers.title: Agentic Harness for Real-World Compilers
papers.abstract_en: Compilers are critical to modern computing, yet fixing compiler bugs is difficult. While recent large language model (LLM) advancements enable automated bug repair, compiler bugs pose unique challenges due to their complexity, deep cross-domain expertise requirements, and sparse, non-descriptive bug reports, necessitating compiler-specific harnesses. To bridge the gap, we introduce llvm-harness, the first harness designed to assist LLM agents in understanding and fixing compiler bugs. Our current focus is on the middle end of LLVM, one of the most widely used compiler infrastructures. Central to llvm-harness are agent-friendly LLVM tools, a benchmark llvm-bench of 334 reproducible LLVM middle-end bugs, and a tailored mini agent llvm-autofix-mini for fixing LLVM middle-end bugs automatically. We evaluate five frontier models and find that they exhibit a performance decline when tackling compiler bugs with the state-of-the-art agent. With llvm-harness' enhancement, their performance improves by 62%. Our specialized mini agent llvm-autofix-mini further outperforms the llvm-harness-enhanced state-of-the-art by 22%. This emphasizes the necessity for specialized harnesses like ours to assist LLMs in compiler engineering tasks. Despite promising results, our expert review also reveals several open challenges that remain when applying LLMs for compiler engineering tasks. GitHub: https://github.com/dtcxzyw/llvm-harness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 llvm-harness，声称是首个帮助 LLM 智能体理解和修复编译器 bug 的专用 harness，当前聚焦 LLVM 中端 (middle end)。其核心包括 agent-friendly 的 LLVM 工具、包含 334 个可复现 LLVM 中端 bug 的基准 llvm-bench，以及专用小智能体 llvm-autofix-mini。摘要报告，五个前沿模型配合现有 SOTA agent 处理编译器 bug 时性能会下降，而经过 llvm-harness 增强后性能提升 62%，llvm-autofix-mini 又比增强后的 SOTA 高出 22%。
Motivation: 编译器 bug 修复困难，LLM 自动修复虽已进展，但编译器 bug 因复杂度高、需跨领域专长且 bug 报告稀疏且缺乏描述性，需要编译器专用的 harness 来弥合这一差距。
Method: 提出 llvm-harness，由三个部分组成：面向智能体友好的 LLVM 工具、包含 334 个可复现 LLVM 中端 bug 的基准 llvm-bench，以及用于自动修复 LLVM 中端 bug 的专用小智能体 llvm-autofix-mini。
Result: 评估五个前沿模型时发现它们在 SOTA agent 处理编译器 bug 的任务上表现下降；加入 llvm-harness 后性能提升 62%；专用智能体 llvm-autofix-mini 相比增强后的 SOTA 再提升 22%。
Conclusion: 作者强调专用 harness 对 LLM 编译器工程任务的必要性，但专家评审也指出将 LLM 应用于编译器工程仍存在多个开放挑战；当前范围限于 LLVM 中端。

papers.title: PhyUnfold-Net: Advancing Remote Sensing Change Detection with Physics-Guided Deep Unfolding
papers.abstract_en: Bi-temporal change detection is highly sensitive to acquisition discrepancies, including illumination, season, and atmosphere, which often cause false alarms. We observe that genuine changes exhibit higher patch-wise singular-value entropy (SVE) than pseudo changes in the feature-difference space. Motivated by this physical prior, we propose PhyUnfold-Net, a physics-guided deep unfolding framework that formulates change detection as an explicit decomposition problem. The proposed Iterative Change Decomposition Module (ICDM) unrolls a multi-step solver to progressively separate mixed discrepancy features into a change component and a nuisance component. To stabilize this process, we introduce a staged Exploration-and-Constraint loss (S-SEC), which encourages component separation in early steps while constraining nuisance magnitude in later steps to avoid degenerate solutions. We further design a Wavelet Spectral Suppression Module (WSSM) to suppress acquisition-induced spectral mismatch before decomposition. Experiments on four benchmarks show improvements over state-of-the-art methods, with gains under challenging conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhyUnfold-Net，一个面向双时相遥感影像变化检测 (change detection) 的物理引导深度展开框架。作者观察到在特征差分空间中，真实变化比伪变化具有更高的分块奇异值熵 (singular-value entropy, SVE)，并据此将变化检测建模为显式分解问题，把混合差异特征逐步拆分为变化分量与干扰分量。实验在四个基准数据集上超过现有方法，尤其在光照、季节、大气等采集差异造成的困难条件下增益明显。
Motivation: 双时相变化检测对采集条件差异（光照、季节、大气等）高度敏感，这些差异常导致误报；摘要指出这是需要解决的突出问题。
Method: 提出物理引导的深度展开框架，包含迭代变化分解模块 (ICDM)，将多步求解器展开以渐进分离变化分量与干扰分量；设计分阶段探索-约束损失 (S-SEC) 稳定分解过程，前期鼓励分量分离、后期约束干扰幅度以避免退化解；并设计小波谱抑制模块 (WSSM) 在分解前抑制采集引起的光谱失配。
Result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于现有最优方法 (state-of-the-art)，并在具有挑战性的条件下取得增益；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于 SVE 物理先验的显式分解思路可缓解采集差异导致的伪变化，提升变化检测的鲁棒性，但未在摘要中报告详细数值或局限分析。

papers.title: Demystifying Video Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation have revealed an unexpected phenomenon: diffusion-based video models exhibit non-trivial reasoning capabilities. Prior work attributes this to a Chain-of-Frames (CoF) mechanism, where reasoning is assumed to unfold sequentially across video frames. In this work, we challenge this assumption and uncover a fundamentally different mechanism. We show that reasoning in video models instead primarily emerges along the diffusion denoising steps. Through qualitative analysis and targeted probing experiments, we find that models explore multiple candidate solutions in early denoising steps and progressively converge to a final answer, a process we term Chain-of-Steps (CoS). Beyond this core mechanism, we identify several emergent reasoning behaviors critical to model performance: (1) working memory that supports tasks requiring consistent reference, such as object permanence; (2) self-correction and enhancement, allowing recovery from incorrect intermediate solutions; and (3) perception before action, where early steps establish semantic grounding and later steps perform structured manipulation. Moreover, analysis of Diffusion Transformer layers shows that middle layers conduct key reasoning procedures. Motivated by these insights, we present a simple Training-Free Ensemble (TFE) as a proof-of-concept, demonstrating how reasoning can be improved by ensembling latent trajectories from identical models with different random seeds. Overall, our work provides the first systematic dissection of the mechanisms underlying video reasoning, offering a foundation to guide future research in better exploiting the inherent reasoning dynamics of video models as a new substrate for intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战先前将视频生成模型推理能力归因于 Chain-of-Frames (CoF) 跨帧顺序展开的假设，通过定性分析和定向探针实验发现，扩散视频模型的推理主要沿去噪步骤 (denoising steps) 展开，并称之为 Chain-of-Steps (CoS)。作者进一步识别出工作记忆、自我修正与增强、先感知后行动等涌现推理行为，并发现 Diffusion Transformer 的中间层承担关键推理。作为概念验证，作者提出无需训练的集成方法 Training-Free Ensemble (TFE)，通过对同一模型不同随机种子的隐轨迹做集成来改进推理。
Motivation: 现有研究将视频扩散模型的推理能力归因于跨帧顺序推理，但这一机制解释可能不准确；理解真实推理机制对利用视频模型作为智能新基座至关重要。
Method: 采用定性分析与定向探针实验，对扩散去噪步骤和 Diffusion Transformer 各层进行机制剖析；在此基础上提出 Training-Free Ensemble (TFE)，集成同一模型不同随机种子的隐轨迹以提升推理。
Result: 摘要显示推理主要在早期去噪步骤探索多个候选解、后期逐步收敛，即 Chain-of-Steps (CoS)，而非跨帧展开；此外识别出工作记忆、自我修正与增强、先感知后行动等关键涌现行为，且中间层承担主要推理过程。
Conclusion: 该工作首次对视频推理机制进行系统剖析，为后续研究如何更好利用视频模型的内在推理动力学提供了基础。

papers.title: Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation
papers.abstract_en: Although debiased large language models (LLMs) excel at handling known or low-bias prompts, they often fail on unfamiliar and high-bias prompts. We demonstrate via out-of-distribution (OOD) detection that these high-bias prompts cause a distribution shift, degrading static model performance. To enable real-time correction, we propose CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework. CAP-TTA triggers context-aware LoRA updates only when a bias-risk score exceeds a set threshold. By utilizing an offline precomputed diagonal preconditioner, it ensures fast and stable optimization. Across multiple benchmarks and human evaluations, CAP-TTA effectively reduces toxicity/bias score with significantly lower latency than standard optimization methods (e.g., AdamW or SGD). Furthermore, it prevents catastrophic forgetting, and substantially improves narrative fluency over state-of-the-art baselines without compromising debiasing performance.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted to ACL2026 main conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAP-TTA，一个面向大语言模型（LLM）的测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）框架，用于处理叙述生成中高偏置且分布外（OOD）的提示。框架只在偏置风险分超过阈值时触发上下文感知的 LoRA 更新，并利用离线预计算的 diagonal preconditioner 实现快速且稳定的优化。摘要报告称在多个基准和人工评估中，CAP-TTA 能以显著低于 AdamW/SGD 的延迟降低毒性/偏置分数，同时避免灾难性遗忘并提升叙述流畅度。
Motivation: 去偏后的 LLM 在熟悉或低偏置提示上表现良好，但在陌生且高偏置的提示上经常失败；OOD 检测显示这些提示引发分布偏移，导致静态模型性能下降。为此需要测试时的实时纠正机制来应对这类分布外高偏置输入。
Method: 提出 CAP-TTA 测试时自适应框架：通过 OOD 检测评估偏置风险，仅当偏置风险分超过设定阈值时才触发上下文感知的 LoRA 更新；采用离线预计算的 diagonal preconditioner 来保障优化的快速与稳定。
Result: 在多个基准和人工评估中，CAP-TTA 相较标准优化方法（如 AdamW 或 SGD）以显著更低的延迟降低毒性/偏置分数；同时防止灾难性遗忘，并在不牺牲去偏性能的情况下大幅提升叙述流畅度。
Conclusion: 作者强调，基于阈值触发的 LoRA 更新和预条件化优化可以实现对 OOD 高偏置提示的实时去偏，同时保持流畅性并避免灾难性遗忘。该文已被 ACL 2026 主会接收。

papers.title: Distance-aware Soft Prompt Guidance for Multimodal Valence-Arousal Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Valence-arousal (VA) estimation is crucial for capturing the nuanced nature of human emotions in naturalistic environments. While pre-trained vision-language models such as CLIP have demonstrated remarkable semantic alignment capabilities, their application to continuous regression tasks is often limited by the discrete nature of text prompts. In this paper, we propose a novel multimodal framework for VA estimation that introduces Distance-aware Soft Prompt Guidance to bridge the gap between semantic representations and continuous affective dimensions. Specifically, we partition the VA space into multiple discrete regions, each associated with distinct textual descriptions. Rather than relying on hard categorization, we employ a Gaussian kernel to compute soft labels based on the Euclidean distance between the ground-truth coordinates and the region centers, allowing the model to learn fine-grained emotional transitions. For multimodal integration, our architecture utilizes a CLIP image encoder and an Audio Spectrogram Transformer to extract robust visual and acoustic features. These features are temporally modeled using Gated Recurrent Units and integrated through a hierarchical fusion scheme that sequentially combines cross-modal attention for alignment and gated fusion for adaptive refinement. Experimental results on the Aff-Wild2 dataset show that the proposed semantic-guided approach outperforms the official baseline and demonstrates robust performance on in-the-wild data.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops (CVPRW), 2026, pp. 5294-5301
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向自然场景下的 valence-arousal (VA) 连续情感回归任务，提出 Distance-aware Soft Prompt Guidance，用高斯核软标签将离散文本提示与连续情感空间衔接，并结合 CLIP 图像编码器、Audio Spectrogram Transformer、GRU 与层次化多模态融合。在 Aff-Wild2 数据集上的实验显示其优于官方基线，且在野外数据上表现稳健。
Motivation: 预训练视觉-语言模型如 CLIP 具备强大的语义对齐能力，但文本提示的离散本质使其难以直接用于连续的 VA 回归任务，论文旨在弥合语义表征与连续情感维度之间的鸿沟。
Method: 将 VA 空间划分为多个离散区域并关联文本描述，用高斯核依据 ground-truth 坐标与区域中心的欧氏距离计算软标签以学习细粒度情感过渡；多模态架构采用 CLIP 图像编码器和 Audio Spectrogram Transformer 提取视觉与声学特征，经 Gated Recurrent Units 建模时序，再通过跨模态注意力对齐与门控融合的层次化方案进行整合。
Result: 在 Aff-Wild2 数据集上，该语义引导方法优于官方基线，并在 in-the-wild 数据上表现出稳健性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于语义引导的软提示方法能有效桥接离散文本语义与连续情感维度，为多模态 VA 估计提供可行方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ELISA: An Interpretable Hybrid Generative AI Agent for Expression-Grounded Discovery in Single-Cell Genomics
papers.abstract_en: Translating single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data into mechanistic biological hypotheses remains a critical bottleneck, as agentic AI systems lack direct access to transcriptomic representations while expression foundation models remain opaque to natural language. Here we introduce ELISA (Embedding-Linked Interactive Single-cell Agent), an interpretable framework that unifies scGPT expression embeddings with BioBERT-based semantic retrieval and LLM-mediated interpretation for interactive single-cell discovery. An automatic query classifier routes inputs to gene marker scoring, semantic matching, or reciprocal rank fusion pipelines depending on whether the query is a gene signature, natural language concept, or mixture of both. Integrated analytical modules perform pathway activity scoringacross 60+ gene sets, ligand-receptor interaction prediction using 280+ curated pairs, condition-aware comparative analysis, and cell-type proportion estimation all operating directly on embedded data without access to the original count matrix. Benchmarked across six diverse scRNA-seq datasets spanning inflammatory lung disease, pediatric and adult cancers, organoid models, healthy tissue, and neurodevelopment, ELISA significantly outperforms CellWhisperer, a classical lexical retriever (BM25), and a random baseline in cell type retrieval (combined permutation test, $p < 2\times10^{-5}$ for each), with particularly large gains on gene-signature queries (Cohen's $d = 5.98$ for MRR). ELISA replicates published biological findings (mean composite score 0.88), and generates candidate hypotheses through grounded LLM reasoning, bridging the gap between transcriptomic data exploration and biological discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ELISA（Embedding-Linked Interactive Single-cell Agent），一个可解释的单细胞基因组学发现智能体，将 scGPT 表达嵌入与基于 BioBERT 的语义检索及 LLM 介导的解释统一起来。自动查询分类器根据查询类型（基因签名、自然语言概念或混合）将输入路由到基因标记评分、语义匹配或倒数排名融合流水线，并直接对嵌入数据执行通路活性、配体-受体互作、条件对比分析和细胞类型比例估计，无需访问原始计数矩阵。在六个 scRNA-seq 数据集上的基准测试显示，ELISA 在细胞类型检索上显著优于 CellWhisperer、经典词法检索器 BM25 和随机基线，并复现了已发表生物学发现。
Motivation: 将 scRNA-seq 数据转化为机制性生物学假设仍是关键瓶颈，因为智能体 AI 系统无法直接访问转录组表示，而表达基础模型对自然语言不透明。
Method: ELISA 将 scGPT 表达嵌入与 BioBERT 语义检索和 LLM 介导的解释统一为一个可解释框架。自动查询分类器将输入路由到基因标记打分、语义匹配或倒数排名融合（reciprocal rank fusion）流水线，取决于查询是基因签名、自然语言概念还是两者混合；集成模块在嵌入数据上直接进行 60 多个基因集的通路活性打分、基于 280 多对 curated 配体-受体对的互作预测、条件感知比较分析和细胞类型比例估计。
Result: 在覆盖炎症性肺病、儿童与成人癌症、类器官模型、健康组织和神经发育的六个 scRNA-seq 数据集上，ELISA 在细胞类型检索上显著优于 CellWhisperer、BM25 和随机基线（每项组合置换检验 p < 2×10⁻⁵），在基因签名查询上增益尤为突出（MRR 的 Cohen's d = 5.98）。ELISA 复现已发表生物学发现的平均综合得分为 0.88，并通过有依据的 LLM 推理生成候选假设。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法弥合了转录组数据探索与生物学发现之间的差距，证明了将表达嵌入、语义检索与 LLM 推理结合的可解释框架在单细胞发现中的价值。

papers.title: Towards Automated Initial Probe Placement in Transthoracic Teleultrasound Using Human Mesh and Skeleton Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac and lung ultrasound are technically demanding because operators must identify patient-specific intercostal acoustic windows and then navigate between standard views by adjusting probe position, rotation, and force across different imaging planes. These challenges are amplified in teleultrasound, where the examination proceeds without in-person expert assistance: once the probe is approximately positioned, the expert can navigate in ultrasound image space, but guiding the initial placement remotely remains difficult given the limited 3D perception of the patient. We present a framework for automating patient registration and anatomy-informed initial probe placement guidance (PIPG) using RGB images obtained from a calibrated camera and a point cloud accumulated from depth images. The novice first captures the patient using the camera on a mixed reality (MR) head-mounted display (HMD), and an edge server then infers a patient-specific body-surface and skeleton model. By leveraging the patient's spatial and temporal consistency across multiview and point cloud data, we achieved robust, training-free human registration, verified in a healthcare setting. Using bony landmarks from the predicted skeleton, we estimate the intercostal region and project the guidance back onto the reconstructed body surface. To validate the framework, we rendered the reconstructed body mesh and the virtual probe pose guidance in the MR headset across multiple transthoracic echocardiography scan planes in situ and measured the quantitative placement error. Pilot experiments with five healthy volunteers suggest that the proposed probe placement prediction and MR guidance yield consistent initial placement, with a mean surface error of 15 mm, positional error to palpated anatomical landmarks of 41.0 mm, and torso orientation errors within 9 deg, acceptable for the teleultrasound setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化框架，用于经胸远程超声（transthoracic teleultrasound）中的患者注册与基于解剖结构的初始探头放置指导（PIPG）。系统通过混合现实（MR）头显上的摄像头采集 RGB 图像，并结合深度图像累积的点云，在边缘服务器上推断患者特定的体表和骨骼模型，随后利用多视角与点云数据的时空一致性实现无需训练的注册，再根据骨骼标志估计肋间区域并将引导投影到重建体表上。初步实验在五位健康志愿者上测得平均表面误差 15 mm、到触诊解剖标志的位置误差 41.0 mm、躯干方向误差在 9 deg 以内。
Motivation: 心脏和肺部超声操作难度高，操作者需要找到患者特定的肋间声窗并不断调整探头位置、旋转和压力；在远程超声中缺少现场专家协助，初始探头放置的远程引导因对患者缺乏 3D 感知而尤为困难。
Method: 提出结合校准相机 RGB 图像与深度图像累积点云的框架，由边缘服务器推断患者个体化的体表和骨骼模型，利用多视角和点云数据的时空一致性实现无需训练的鲁棒患者注册；基于预测骨骼的骨性标志估计肋间区域，并将引导信息投影回重建体表，在 MR 头显中渲染重建网格和虚拟探头姿态引导。
Result: 在医疗环境中验证了框架，并在五位健康志愿者的初步实验中，跨多个经胸超声心动图扫描平面测量放置误差：平均表面误差 15 mm，到触诊解剖标志的位置误差 41.0 mm，躯干方向误差在 9 deg 以内，被认为对远程超声设置可接受。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架能够为远程超声提供一致的初始探头放置，误差水平可接受；但目前仅报告了五位健康志愿者的初步实验验证。

papers.title: Wrong Code, Right Structure: Learning Netlist Representations from Imperfect LLM-Generated RTL
papers.abstract_en: Learning effective netlist representations is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of labeled datasets, as real designs are protected by Intellectual Property (IP) and costly to annotate. Existing work therefore focuses on small-scale circuits with clean labels, limiting scalability to realistic designs. Meanwhile, Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate Register-Transfer-Level (RTL) at scale, but their functional incorrectness has hindered their use in circuit analysis. In this work, we make a key observation: even when LLM-Generated RTL is functionally imperfect, the synthesized netlists still preserve structural patterns that are strongly indicative of the intended functionality. Building on this insight, we propose a cost-effective data augmentation and training framework that systematically exploits imperfect LLM-Generated RTL as training data for netlist representation learning, forming an end-to-end pipeline from automated code generation to downstream tasks. We conduct evaluations on circuit functional understanding tasks, including sub-circuit boundary identification and component classification, across benchmarks of increasing scales, extending the task scope from operator-level to IP-level. The evaluations demonstrate that models trained on our noisy synthetic corpus generalize well to real-world netlists, matching or even surpassing methods trained on scarce high-quality data and effectively breaking the data bottleneck in circuit representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用功能不完美的 LLM 生成 RTL 所综合出的网表作为训练数据，用于网表表示学习 (netlist representation learning)。核心观察是：即使 LLM 生成的 RTL 功能有误，综合后的网表仍保留与预期功能强相关的结构模式。作者构建了从自动化代码生成到下游任务的端到端 pipeline，并在子电路边界识别与组件分类等电路功能理解任务上验证，证明噪声合成语料训练的模型可匹配甚至超过稀缺高质量数据训练的结果。
Motivation: 网表表示学习受限于标注数据稀缺：真实设计受知识产权 (IP) 保护且标注成本高，现有工作只能依赖小规模、干净标签电路，难以扩展到真实规模设计；LLM 能大规模生成 RTL，但其功能不正确一直阻碍其在电路分析中的使用。
Method: 基于“功能不完美的 LLM 生成 RTL 其综合网表仍保留结构模式”这一观察，提出一种低成本数据增强与训练框架，系统地将不完美 LLM 生成 RTL 用作网表表示学习的训练数据，形成从自动化代码生成到下游任务（如子电路边界识别、组件分类）的端到端 pipeline。
Result: 在规模递增的多组 benchmark 上评估电路功能理解任务，任务范围从 operator 级扩展到 IP 级；结果表明在噪声合成语料上训练的模型能良好泛化到真实网表，匹配甚至超过在稀缺高质量数据上训练的方法，从而打破电路表示学习的数据瓶颈。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有效缓解了网表表示学习中标注数据稀缺的瓶颈；摘要未提及超出所评估电路功能理解任务之外的适用边界或具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DuetHOI: Language-Guided Bimanual Hand--Object Motion Generation with Articulation Planning and Contact Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Bimanual articulated-object interaction generation requires a model to capture the evolution of object articulation, coordination between the two hands, and fine-grained hand--object contact. Existing methods typically encode object and hand motion as a unified high-dimensional sequence, making it difficult to explicitly accommodate the different scales of manipulation progress, relative bimanual motion, and local hand pose. We propose \textbf{DuetHOI}, a structured framework for bimanual articulated-object interaction generation. DuetHOI first uses ContactVAE to predict contact intent on the object surface from language and object geometry. Conditioned on this spatial intent, ArtPlanner provides a trajectory-level articulation reference, and DualFormer generates the global interaction using object states, object-centered hand positions, and compact hand-pose tokens learned by ManiVAE. After global generation, ProxiRefine fixes the object trajectory and residually corrects the two hands using current hand--object proximity, improving local surface alignment. Experiments across articulated and rigid objects and single- and bimanual settings show that DuetHOI outperforms three adapted baselines on most contact and hand--object consistency metrics, with particularly strong results in bimanual articulated interaction generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DuetHOI，一个用于双手与铰接物体交互生成的结构化框架。框架先通过 ContactVAE 从语言和物体几何预测物体表面的接触意图，再由 ArtPlanner 提供轨迹级铰接参考，DualFormer 使用物体状态、以物体为中心的手位置和 ManiVAE 学到的紧凑手姿 token 生成全局交互，最后 ProxiRefine 基于当前手-物体邻近度对双手进行残差修正。实验覆盖铰接与刚体物体、单手与双手设定，在大多数接触和手-物体一致性指标上优于三个改编基线。
Motivation: 现有方法通常将物体和手的运动编码为统一的高维序列，难以显式容纳操作进度、双手相对运动与局部手姿态的不同尺度，导致双手铰接物体交互生成不准确。
Method: 提出 DuetHOI：ContactVAE 从语言和物体几何预测物体表面的接触意图；ArtPlanner 基于该空间意图提供轨迹级铰接参考；DualFormer 利用物体状态、物体中心手位置和 ManiVAE 学习的紧凑手姿 token 生成全局交互；ProxiRefine 固定物体轨迹并以手-物体邻近度为条件残差修正双手，改善局部表面对齐。
Result: 摘要报告在铰接与刚体物体、单手与双手设定下，DuetHOI 在多数接触和手-物体一致性指标上优于三个改编基线，在双手铰接交互生成上表现尤其突出。
Conclusion: 作者认为分层式的接触意图预测、铰接规划、全局生成与接触细化相结合，能够更好地处理双手铰接物体交互生成中不同尺度的运动。

papers.title: Step-Level Visual Grounding Faithfulness Predicts Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Long-Horizon Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We uncover a behavioral law of long-horizon vision-language models: models that maintain temporally grounded beliefs generalize better. Standard benchmarks measure only final-answer accuracy, which obscures how models use visual information; a model can guess correctly while its step-by-step reasoning is entirely unanchored to the visual input. We formalize this as behavioral faithfulness over long horizons, an empirically measurable property that quantifies whether a model's intermediate reasoning remains consistent with the evolving visual state. Across eight models on three long-horizon benchmarks, we demonstrate that temporal grounding quality is a leading indicator of robustness: the Step Grounding Rate (SGR) predicts out-of-distribution retention with $r = 0.83$ (permutation test $p = 0.003$), a relationship that holds within capacity-matched models and cannot be explained by scale or in-distribution accuracy. Critically, grounding quality varies by up to 10.8 percentage points within parameter-matched 7B models despite similar accuracy, revealing it as an independent axis of model capability. Multiple robustness checks confirm the signal reflects genuine visual reliance: counterfactual traces drop SGR by 26--41 percentage points, cross-architecture verifiers agree at $ρ= 0.96$, random reasoning scores near chance ($\sim 18\%$), and the predictor remains strong even without explicit reasoning disclosure ($r = 0.78$).
papers.comment: Following the initial submission, we conducted additional experiments that materially changed our understanding of the problem. These new results do not support the central claim of the current manuscript. To avoid disseminating conclusions that we no longer consider adequately supported, we are withdrawing this version while we reassess the findings and prepare a substantially revised manuscript

TL;DR: 本文提出长时程视觉-语言模型中的行为学规律：保持时间接地信念 (temporally grounded beliefs) 的模型泛化性更好。作者形式化了行为忠实度 (behavioral faithfulness)，引入 Step Grounding Rate (SGR) 度量中间推理与视觉状态的一致性，并在 8 个模型、3 个长时程基准上报告 SGR 与分布外保留率显著相关。需要特别注意的是，作者在 arXiv 评论中声明，追加实验不再支持该核心主张，已撤回当前版本并准备大幅修订。
Motivation: 现有基准只评测最终答案准确率，掩盖了模型如何使用视觉信息；模型可能猜对答案但逐步推理完全未锚定于视觉输入，因此需要可测量的中间过程忠实度指标。
Method: 将行为忠实度形式化为可测量性质，量化模型中间推理与不断变化的视觉状态的一致性；提出 SGR 作为指标，并通过反事实轨迹、跨架构验证器等稳健性检验确认信号反映真实的视觉依赖。
Result: 摘要报告 SGR 预测分布外保留率的相关性为 r=0.83（置换检验 p=0.003）；在参数匹配的 7B 模型中接地质量差异达 10.8 个百分点；反事实轨迹使 SGR 下降 26–41 个百分点，跨架构验证器一致度 ρ=0.96，随机推理约 18%，无显式推理披露时预测仍达 r=0.78。
Conclusion: 摘要认为时间接地质量是独立于规模与分布内准确率的能力轴，但作者在后续声明中表示新增实验结果不支持该核心主张，因此撤回当前版本并正在重新评估与修订。

papers.title: Stem: Rethinking Causal Information Flow in Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic computational complexity of self-attention remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long contexts, particularly during the pre-filling phase. In this paper, we rethink the causal attention mechanism from the perspective of information flow. Due to causal constraints, tokens at initial positions participate in the aggregation of every subsequent token. However, existing sparse methods typically apply a uniform top-k selection across all token positions within a layer, ignoring the cumulative dependency of token information inherent in causal architectures. To address this, we propose Stem, a novel, plug-and-play sparsity module aligned with information flow. First, Stem employs the Token Position-Decay strategy, applying position-dependent top-k within each layer to retain initial tokens for recursive dependencies. Second, to preserve information-rich tokens, Stem utilizes the Output-Aware Metric. It prioritizes high-impact tokens based on approximate output magnitude. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Stem achieves superior accuracy with reduced computation and pre-filling latency.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Lin Niu and Xin Luo contributed equally to this work. Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stem，一个即插即用的稀疏注意力模块，从信息流角度重新审视因果注意力中的稀疏化。Stem 在每层内采用依赖位置的 top-k（Token Position-Decay 策略）保留初始 token 以维持递归依赖，并用输出感知度量（Output-Aware Metric）优先保留高影响 token。摘要报告该方法在降低计算量与 pre-filling 延迟的同时取得更优精度。
Motivation: 自注意力的二次计算复杂度是大语言模型扩展到长上下文的主要瓶颈，尤其在 pre-filling 阶段。现有稀疏方法通常在同一层内对所有 token 位置做统一的 top-k 选择，忽略了因果架构中 token 信息的累积依赖。
Method: Stem 包含两个核心设计：一是 Token Position-Decay 策略，按位置施加依赖位置的 top-k，在每层保留初始 token 以支持递归依赖；二是 Output-Aware Metric，基于近似输出幅度优先选择信息量大的 token。
Result: 大量评估显示 Stem 在降低计算量和 pre-filling 延迟的同时取得更优的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者主张与信息流对齐的因果稀疏化比统一 top-k 更有效，Stem 作为即插即用模块可应用于现有模型。

papers.title: LightningRL: Breaking the Accuracy-Parallelism Trade-off of Block-wise dLLMs via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for parallel token generation, with block-wise variants garnering significant research interest. Despite their potential, existing dLLMs typically suffer from a rigid accuracy-parallelism trade-off: increasing the number of tokens per forward (TPF) via aggressive parallel decoding often leads to performance degradation and increased generation instability. We identify that this limitation stems from the model's inability to navigate high-parallelism regimes where approximation errors and local corruptions accumulate, ultimately undermining the reliability of parallel generation. To address this, we propose LightningRL, a post-training framework designed to directly optimize the speed-quality Pareto frontier of pre-trained dLLMs. Instead of forcing uniform parallelization, our approach leverages reinforcement learning to identify and reinforce high-parallelism trajectories that maintain generation accuracy. Built upon the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework, LightningRL introduces several enhancements tailored for dLLMs: (1) stabilized training via per-reward decoupled normalization; (2) token-level negative log-likelihood (NLL) regularization on correct trajectories to anchor model performance; and (3) a dynamic sampling strategy with TPF-aware filtering to enhance training efficiency. Experimental results across mathematical and coding benchmarks demonstrate that LightningRL consistently advances the Pareto frontier, achieving competitive task accuracy while significantly increasing parallelism, reaching an average TPF of 7.32 (with a peak of 11.10 on the MBPP dataset). Our code is available at https://github.com/SJTU-DENG-Lab/LightningRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LightningRL，一个面向分块扩散大语言模型 (block-wise dLLMs) 的后训练框架，用强化学习直接优化预训练 dLLMs 的速度-质量 Pareto 前沿。作者指出 dLLMs 存在刚性的准确率-并行度权衡，即增大每前向 token 数 (TPF) 会带来性能下降和生成不稳定，并将原因归结为高并行度下近似误差与局部损坏的累积。基于 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)，LightningRL 引入逐奖励解耦归一化、正确轨迹上的 token 级 NLL 正则化以及 TPF 感知过滤的动态采样策略；在数学和代码基准上，该方法以平均 TPF 7.32（MBPP 上峰值 11.10）在保持竞争性准确率的同时显著提升并行度。
Motivation: 现有 dLLMs 受困于准确率与并行度之间的刚性权衡：通过激进并行解码增加 TPF 往往导致性能下降和生成不稳定。作者识别出其根源是模型无法应对高并行度机制下近似误差和局部损坏的累积，从而削弱并行生成的可靠性。
Method: 提出 LightningRL 后训练框架，不强制统一并行化，而是利用强化学习识别并强化能保持生成准确率的高并行轨迹。该框架基于 GRPO，并针对 dLLMs 加入三项增强：逐奖励解耦归一化以稳定训练、对正确轨迹施加 token 级负对数似然 (NLL) 正则化以锚定性能、以及带 TPF 感知过滤的动态采样策略以提高训练效率。
Result: 在数学与代码基准上的实验表明，LightningRL 持续推进速度-质量 Pareto 前沿，在取得竞争性任务准确率的同时显著提高并行度，平均 TPF 达到 7.32，在 MBPP 数据集上峰值 TPF 为 11.10。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过强化学习识别并强化保持准确率的高并行轨迹，可以打破 dLLMs 的准确率-并行度权衡；该方法属于后训练框架，适用于预训练 dLLMs 的并行生成优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Curvature-Weighted Capacity Allocation: A Minimum Description Length Framework for Layer-Adaptive Large Language Model Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Layer-wise capacity in large language models is highly non-uniform: some layers contribute disproportionately to loss reduction, whereas others are nearly redundant. Existing layer-scoring methods provide sensitivity estimates but do not give a principled rule for converting those estimates into allocation or pruning decisions under a global hardware budget. We introduce a curvature-aware, MDL-inspired framework built around the layer gain $ζ_k^2=g_k^\top\widetilde H_{kk}^{-1}g_k$. This quantity equals twice the maximal decrease predicted by the regularized layer-restricted quadratic model and incorporates inverse local curvature; it is therefore a local surrogate for reducible risk, not a universal dominance claim over gradient-norm scores. After normalizing the gains into scores $q_k$, we formulate two convex programs: one allocates expert slots under diminishing returns, and the other assigns layer-wise pruning ratios while protecting high-score layers. Both continuous programs have unique globally optimal solutions characterized by one dual variable and computable in $O(K\log(1/\varepsilon))$ time by bisection. We also prove a quadratic transfer-regret bound: when source and target score vectors differ by at most $δ$, the target surrogate cost of the transferred decision is within $O(δ^2)$ of the target optimum. Experiments on Mistral-7B and Gemma-7B show clear allocation gains in some settings and competitive, though mixed, pruning performance. The framework therefore replaces an empirical score-to-decision heuristic with a budget-feasible optimization procedure whose guarantees apply to the stated continuous surrogates. Code is available on github repo - [TKAI-LAB-Mali/Curvature-Weighted-Capacity-Allocation](https://github.com/TKAI-LAB-Mali/Curvature-Weighted-Capacity-Allocation.git)
papers.comment: Accepted to UAI 2026. To be published in PMLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于曲率感知与最小描述长度 (MDL) 思想的框架，用于在大语言模型中按层分配容量。作者定义层增益 ζ_k^2=g_k^\top \widetilde H_{kk}^{-1}g_k，将其归一化为分数后构造两个凸优化问题，分别用于在硬件预算下分配专家槽位和逐层剪枝比例，并给出唯一全局最优解的表征与 O(K log(1/ε)) 求解算法。实验在 Mistral-7B 和 Gemma-7B 上显示分配增益在某些设置下明显，而剪枝性能有竞争力但不稳定。
Motivation: 大语言模型的逐层容量高度不均匀，部分层对损失下降贡献大，另一些层近乎冗余；现有的层评分方法只给出敏感性估计，却没有一种原则性规则在全局硬件预算下将这些估计转化为分配或剪枝决策。
Method: 引入曲率感知的层增益 ζ_k^2，它等于正则化层受限二次模型预测的最大下降量的两倍，并纳入局部逆曲率；将增益归一化为分数 q_k 后，构造两个连续凸规划，分别处理带边际递减效应的专家槽位分配与保护高分数层的逐层剪枝比例分配，并用单一对偶变量刻画唯一全局最优解，通过二分法在 O(K log(1/ε)) 时间内求解。
Result: 论文证明了二次迁移遗憾界：当源与目标分数向量相差不超过 δ 时，迁移决策的目标替代成本与目标最优值的差距为 O(δ^2)；在 Mistral-7B 和 Gemma-7B 上的实验显示分配收益在某些设置下清晰，而剪枝表现有竞争力但结果混合。
Conclusion: 该框架用预算可行的优化流程取代了经验性的分数到决策启发式，但作者明确表示其保证仅适用于所陈述的连续替代目标 (continuous surrogates)，而非对梯度范数评分的普遍优势声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enabling Low-Latency Machine learning on Radiation-Hard FPGAs with hls4ml
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an end-to-end demonstration of a viable, ultra-fast, radiation-hard machine learning (ML) application on FPGAs, which could be used in future high-energy physics experiments. We present a three-fold contribution, with the PicoCal calorimeter, planned for the LHCb Upgrade II experiment, used as a test case. First, we develop a lightweight autoencoder to compress a 32-sample timing readout, representative of that of the PicoCal, into a two-dimensional latent space. Second, we introduce a systematic, hardware-aware quantization strategy and show that the model can be reduced to 10-bit weights with minimal performance loss. Third, as a barrier to the adoption of on-detector ML is the lack of support for radiation-hard FPGAs in the High-Energy Physics community's standard ML synthesis tool, hls4ml, we develop a new backend for this library. This new back-end enables the automatic translation of ML models into High-Level Synthesis (HLS) projects for the Microchip PolarFire family of FPGAs, one of the few commercially available and radiation hard FPGAs. We present the synthesis of the autoencoder on a target PolarFire FPGA, which indicates that a latency of 25 ns can be achieved. We show that the resources utilized are low enough that the model can be placed within the inherently protected logic of the FPGA. Our extension to hls4ml is a significant contribution, paving the way for broader adoption of ML on FPGAs in high-radiation environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出一个端到端的高能物理场景演示：在抗辐射 FPGA 上实现超低延迟机器学习应用，以 LHCb Upgrade II 计划的 PicoCal 量热器为测试用例。贡献有三：将 32 采样时间读出压缩为二维隐空间的轻量自编码器；系统化的硬件感知量化策略，可将模型降到 10-bit 权重且性能损失极小；为 hls4ml 开发新后端，支持将 ML 模型自动翻译为 Microchip PolarFire 系列抗辐射 FPGA 的 HLS 工程。目标 PolarFire FPGA 上的综合结果显示延迟可达 25 ns，且资源占用低到可放入 FPGA 固有的受保护逻辑区。
Motivation: 在探测器中部署 ML 的一个障碍是高能物理社区标准 ML 综合工具 hls4ml 缺乏对辐射加固 FPGA 的支持，而这对于未来高辐射环境下的高能物理实验至关重要。
Method: 面向 PicoCal 量热器构建轻量自编码器，设计硬件感知的量化策略将权重缩减到 10-bit，并开发了 hls4ml 的新后端，使 ML 模型能自动转换到 Microchip PolarFire 系列 FPGA 的 High-Level Synthesis (HLS) 工程。
Result: 在目标 PolarFire FPGA 上综合自编码器，摘要报告可实现 25 ns 延迟，且资源占用足够低，可使模型放置在 FPGA 固有的受保护逻辑中；10-bit 量化仅带来很小性能损失。
Conclusion: 作者认为对 hls4ml 的扩展是显著贡献，为在高辐射环境中更广泛地采用 FPGA 上的 ML 铺平道路；演示范围以 PicoCal 为案例，面向 LHCb Upgrade II 实验。

papers.title: AIvilization v0: Toward Large-Scale Artificial Social Simulation with a Unified Agent Architecture and Adaptive Agent Profiles
papers.abstract_en: AIvilization v0 is a publicly deployed large-scale artificial society that couples a resource-constrained sandbox with a unified LLM-agent architecture, aiming to sustain long-horizon autonomy while remaining executable under a rapidly changing environment. To mitigate the tension between goal stability and reactive correctness, keeping long-horizon objectives on course while each action remains valid in a fast-changing shared world, we introduce (i) a hierarchical branch-thinking planner that decomposes life goals into parallel objective branches and uses simulation-guided validation plus tiered re-planning to ensure feasibility; (ii) an adaptive agent profile with dual-process memory that separates short-term execution traces from long-term semantic consolidation, enabling persistent yet evolving identity; and (iii) a human-in-the-loop steering interface that injects long-horizon objectives and short commands at appropriate abstraction levels, with effects propagated through memory instead of brittle prompt overrides. The environment integrates physiological survival costs, non-substitutable multi-tier production, an AMM-based price mechanism, and a gated education-occupation system. In a large-scale public deployment with tens of thousands of agents, high-frequency transactions from the platform's mature phase reveal stable markets that reproduce key stylized facts of real economies and structured wealth stratification driven by education and access constraints. At the agent level, portraits evolve coherently over long horizons, and human steering is associated with measurably larger short-horizon profile updates. Controlled ablation experiments complement the deployment evidence, showing that our agent architecture is robust in multi-objective, long-horizon settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AIvilization v0，一个公开部署的大规模人工社会模拟系统，将资源受限沙盒与统一 LLM 智能体架构结合，目标是维持长期自主性并在快速变化环境中保持动作有效。系统提出分层分支思考规划器、带双过程记忆的自适应智能体画像，以及人机协同干预接口；在数万智能体的公开部署中，市场行为复现了真实经济的关键典型事实，并出现由教育与准入约束驱动的财富分层。
Motivation: 长时程智能体既要保持长期目标稳定，又要在快速变化的共享世界中保证每个动作反应正确，这两个需求之间存在张力；现有方法难以兼顾目标连续性与反应式正确性。
Method: 提出三类核心机制：一是分层分支思考规划器 (hierarchical branch-thinking planner)，将人生目标分解为并行目标分支，用模拟引导验证与分层重规划保证可行性；二是带双过程记忆 (dual-process memory) 的自适应智能体画像，区分短期执行痕迹与长期语义整合；三是人机协同转向接口，在适当抽象层级注入长期目标与短指令，并通过记忆而非脆弱的提示词覆盖传播效果。环境整合了生理生存成本、不可替代的多层生产、基于 AMM 的价格机制和门控的教育-职业系统。
Result: 在包含数万智能体的大规模公开部署中，平台成熟期的高频交易显示出稳定市场，复现真实经济的关键典型事实，并由教育与准入约束导致结构化财富分层。智能体画像在长时程中连贯演化，人机转向与可测量的更大短期画像更新相关；受控消融实验表明该智能体架构在多目标、长时程情境下具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一智能体架构与自适应画像能够支撑大规模、长时程的人工社会模拟，并通过部署证据与消融实验共同验证了其在多目标长时程场景下的稳健性。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Derive New Knowledge? A Dynamic Benchmark for Biological Knowledge Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable potential in automatic knowledge discovery. However, rigorously evaluating an AI's capacity for knowledge discovery remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks predominantly rely on static datasets, leading to inevitable data contamination where models have likely seen the evaluation knowledge during training. Furthermore, the rapid release cycles of modern LLMs render static benchmarks quickly outdated, failing to assess the ability to discover truly new knowledge. To address these limitations, we propose DBench-Bio, a dynamic and fully automated benchmark designed to evaluate AI's biological knowledge discovery ability. DBench-Bio employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) data acquisition of rigorous, authoritative paper abstracts; (2) QA extraction utilizing LLMs to synthesize scientific hypothesis questions and corresponding discovery answers; and (3) QA filter to ensure quality based on relevance, clarity, and centrality. We instantiate this pipeline to construct a monthly-updated benchmark covering 12 biomedical sub-domains. Extensive evaluations of SOTA models reveal current limitations in discovering new knowledge. Our work provides the first dynamic, automatic framework for assessing the new knowledge discovery capabilities of AI systems, establishing a living, evolving resource for AI research community to catalyze the development of knowledge discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DBench-Bio，一个动态且全自动的基准，用于评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在生物学领域的知识发现能力。该基准采用月度更新的流水线，覆盖 12 个生物医学子领域，并通过对 SOTA 模型的评估揭示现有模型在发现新知识方面的局限。
Motivation: 现有知识发现基准多依赖静态数据集，导致数据污染（模型可能在训练中已见过评测知识），且 LLM 快速迭代使静态基准迅速过时，难以评测模型发现真正新知识的能力。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：权威论文摘要的数据获取；利用 LLM 进行 QA 抽取，合成科学假设问题和对应的发现答案；基于相关性、清晰度和中心性进行 QA 过滤，构建月度更新的基准。
Result: 对 SOTA 模型的广泛评估显示，当前模型在发现新知识方面仍存在明显局限。
Conclusion: 该工作提供首个动态、自动化的 AI 新知识发现能力评估框架，为研究社区建立持续演进的资源以推动知识发现发展。

papers.title: Generative AI in Action: Field Experimental Evidence from Alibaba's Customer Service Operations
papers.abstract_en: In collaboration with Alibaba, we study how a generative AI assistant affects service performance in e-commerce after-sales operations. In a large-scale field experiment, human agents providing digital chat support were randomly assigned access to a gen AI assistant. The assistant drafts issue diagnoses and solution proposals in the opening stage only; agents can adopt, modify, or disregard them. Because of this discretion, we estimate the effects of both gen AI access and usage. On average, gen AI improves service speed and subjective service quality, measured by customer ratings, but has no significant effect on objective service quality, measured by customer retrials. These gains come from more than automation. Gen AI reshapes agent-customer interactions: treated agents respond faster and take a more proactive role, while customers provide less input; both patterns persist into later chat stages. These average effects, however, mask heterogeneity across agents. Lower-performing agents benefit the most, indicating that gen AI can narrow performance gaps. Top-performing agents experience declines in both subjective and objective service quality. This decline is consistent with workflow disruption: among top performers, gen AI use increases shift-away time, response delays, and immediate customer retrials, suggesting weakened service continuity in the focal chat. Successful gen AI deployment therefore requires careful performance evaluation and rollout tailored to agent skill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文与阿里巴巴合作，通过大规模实地实验研究生成式AI助手对电商售后数字客服绩效的影响。客服被随机分配是否可使用该助手，助手仅在开场阶段起草问题诊断与解决方案，客服可选择采纳、修改或忽略。平均而言，生成式AI提升了服务速度与主观服务质量（客户评分），但对客观服务质量（客户重复求助）无显著影响，且效应存在显著的客服个体异质性。
Motivation: 生成式AI在真实客服运营中的效果缺乏严格的因果证据，尤其是当人类客服保有采纳、修改或忽略AI建议的裁量权时，其访问效应与使用效应如何区分尚不清楚。
Method: 在阿里巴巴的大规模实地实验中，将数字聊天支持客服随机分配获得生成式AI助手权限；助手只在开场阶段生成问题诊断与解决方案建议，作者分别估计生成式AI访问与使用的处理效应，并分析客服与客户交互模式的变化。
Result: 平均来看，生成式AI提高了服务速度和客户评分，但对客户重复求助衡量的客观服务质量没有显著影响；低绩效客服受益最大，而高绩效客服的主观与客观服务质量均出现下降。高绩效客服使用生成式AI伴随离席时间增加、响应延迟和即时重复求助上升，与工作流中断的解释一致。
Conclusion: 生成式AI的收益不止来自自动化，还通过改变客服与客户的交互方式实现；但平均效应掩盖了客服技能层面的异质性，因此成功部署需要针对客服技能水平进行谨慎的绩效评估与分阶段推广。

papers.title: RAPiD: Reward-Guided Consistency Distillation of Diffusion Planners for Real-Time Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based trajectory planners can model multi-modal driving behavior, but their iterative denoising process introduces a latency bottleneck for real-time closed-loop deployment. We present RAPiD, a reward-guided consistency distillation framework that distills a pretrained DiffusionPlanner into a few-step consistency student while retaining multi-modal trajectory generation. The student is trained using deterministic teacher denoising steps from the frozen diffusion planner, together with a low-noise data anchor that keeps generated trajectories grounded in expert demonstrations. To make distillation safety-aware, we train an Implicit Q-Learning critic on a balanced mixture of ground-truth log-replay and DiffusionPlanner rollout trajectories, each scored using a modified PDM-style reward, providing trajectory-level supervision beyond conventional imitation learning. During deployment, the 2-step student generates K trajectories, and the trained critic performs best-of-K trajectory selection conditioned on the latent state. On nuPlan, RAPiD maintains comparable performance to the diffusion teacher on non-reactive closed-loop splits and remains competitive on reactive splits, while reducing complete-pipeline inference latency from 100.91 ms to 18.41 ms, corresponding to a 5.5x speedup. On interPlan, RAPiD achieves the highest aggregate score among learning-based methods, demonstrating competitive generalization in interactive long-tail scenarios. These results show that reward-guided consistency distillation can convert a pretrained diffusion planner into a few-step closed-loop planner that substantially reduces inference cost while preserving safety-oriented trajectory selection. The official website of this work is: https://github.com/ruturajreddy/RAPiD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RAPiD，一种奖励引导的一致性蒸馏 (reward-guided consistency distillation) 框架，将预训练的 DiffusionPlanner 蒸馏为少步一致性学生模型，同时保留多模态轨迹生成能力。学生模型利用冻结扩散规划器的确定性教师去噪步骤和低噪声数据锚点训练，并引入基于 PDM 风格奖励的 Implicit Q-Learning 评论器进行轨迹级监督。在 nuPlan 上，RAPiD 与非反应式闭环分割上的扩散教师性能相当，在反应式分割上仍具竞争力，同时将完整推理延迟从 100.91 ms 降至 18.41 ms（约 5.5 倍加速）；在 interPlan 上取得学习方法中的最高聚合分数。
Motivation: 扩散式轨迹规划器能够建模多模态驾驶行为，但其迭代去噪过程带来延迟瓶颈，难以满足实时闭环部署需求。
Method: 将预训练 DiffusionPlanner 蒸馏为少步一致性学生：使用冻结扩散规划器的确定性教师去噪步骤与低噪声数据锚点训练；另训练一个 Implicit Q-Learning 评论器，在真实日志回放与 DiffusionPlanner 滚动轨迹的混合数据上以修改后的 PDM 风格奖励打分，部署时由 2 步学生生成 K 条轨迹并由评论器基于潜在状态执行 best-of-K 轨迹选择。
Result: 在 nuPlan 非反应式闭环分割上性能与扩散教师相当，在反应式分割上保持竞争力；完整流水线推理延迟从 100.91 ms 降到 18.41 ms，对应 5.5 倍加速。在 interPlan 上取得学习方法中的最高聚合分数，展示出交互式长尾场景下的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，奖励引导的一致性蒸馏可以将预训练扩散规划器转化为少步闭环规划器，在显著降低推理成本的同时保留面向安全的轨迹选择能力。

papers.title: Prompt Reinjection: Alleviating Prompt Forgetting in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MMDiTs) for text-to-image generation maintain separate text and image branches, with bidirectional information flow between text tokens and visual latents throughout denoising. In this setting, we observe a prompt forgetting phenomenon: the semantics of the prompt representation in the text branch is progressively forgotten as depth increases. We further verify this effect on three representative MMDiTs--SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.1 by probing linguistic attributes of the representations over the layers in the text branch. Motivated by these findings, we introduce a training-free approach, prompt reinjection, which reinjects prompt representations from early layers into later layers to alleviate this forgetting. Experiments on GenEval, DPG, and T2I-CompBench++ show consistent gains in instruction-following capability, along with improvements on metrics capturing preference, aesthetics, and overall text--image generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态扩散 Transformer (MMDiT) 文生图模型中的 prompt 遗忘现象，发现去噪过程中文本分支的 prompt 语义随层数增加逐渐丢失，并在 SD3、SD3.5、FLUX.1 三个代表性模型上验证。作者提出无需训练的 prompt reinjection 方法，把早期层的 prompt 表示重新注入后续层以缓解遗忘。在 GenEval、DPG、T2I-CompBench++ 上取得一致的指令跟随能力提升，并改善偏好、美学和整体文生图质量指标。
Motivation: MMDiT 中文本分支与图像分支分开，随着去噪层数加深，文本分支里的 prompt 表示语义被逐步遗忘，进而损害指令跟随能力。作者希望验证该现象并提供一种无需重新训练的缓解手段。
Method: 提出训练无关的 prompt reinjection 方法：将来自早期层的 prompt 表示重新注入到后续层中，以保持深层中的 prompt 语义；同时通过对各层表示做 linguistic probing 来验证 prompt 遗忘现象。
Result: 在 GenEval、DPG、T2I-CompBench++ 上，该方法在指令跟随能力上获得一致提升，并带来偏好、美学和整体文生图质量指标的改善。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 prompt reinjection 是缓解多模态扩散 Transformer 中 prompt 遗忘的简单且无需训练的方法；不过摘要未讨论该方法在文生图之外的适用性或具体局限。

papers.title: The Geometric Observability Index: Influence, Fisher Information, and Weak Observability in $\SE$ Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Geometric Observability Index (GOI), a per-feature sensitivity measure for pose estimation on SE(3): the metric norm of the pose perturbation that a single measurement induces through the (possibly rank-deficient) Gauss-Newton curvature, restricted to the observable subspace. We prove that GOI equals the norm of the M-estimator influence function, that the underlying curvature operator coincides with the Fisher information, and that its smallest observable eigenvalue governs both the worst-case amplification of a measurement's effect and a finite-sample stability radius O(sigma/sqrt(n*lambda_min)). Operationally the theory cuts both ways. GOI is the exact per-measurement attribution, predicting the true leave-one-out pose shift with log-correlation r = 1.00; yet the influence standardized by its inlier null covariance collapses exactly to the classical chi-square residual statistic. Residual gating is thus the leverage-corrected influence test -- a first-principles explanation of its robustness -- while raw-influence gating conflates a measurement's information with its harm and is predicted to over-reject high-leverage inliers in weakly observable geometry. Controlled synthetic experiments validate every quantitative claim, and studies on five TUM RGB-D sequences (four dynamic, one static control) and two KITTI odometry sequences confirm the prediction: parity of the two criteria under well-conditioned geometry, and significant degradation of raw-influence gating at cond(H) of order 10^4. All code is released for reproducibility.
papers.comment: v2: corrected the operator treatment for general metrics G (index raising A = G^{-1}H; the v1 identities hold only for G = I); sharpened the stability rate from sigma/lambda_min to sigma/sqrt(n*lambda_min); added the studentized-influence/chi-square equivalence, real-data studies on TUM RGB-D and KITTI, and released code; author list updated. 18 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何可观测性指标 (Geometric Observability Index, GOI)，一种用于 SE(3) 位姿估计的逐特征灵敏度度量：单个测量通过（可能秩亏的）Gauss-Newton 曲率在可观测子空间上诱发的位姿扰动的度量范数。作者证明 GOI 等于 M-估计量影响函数 (influence function) 的范数，底层曲率算子与 Fisher 信息一致，且其最小可观测特征值同时控制测量效应的最坏情况放大和有限样本稳定性半径 O(sigma/sqrt(n*lambda_min))。实验中 GOI 以 log-correlation r=1.00 精确预测留一 (leave-one-out) 位姿变化，而按内点零协方差标准化的影响量恰好退化为经典卡方残差统计量。
Motivation: 位姿估计中单次测量既携带信息也可能造成危害，原始影响量门控在弱可观测几何下会混淆二者并过度拒绝高杠杆内点；作者希望从第一性原理解释残差门控的鲁棒性，并给出逐测量可观测性的量化指标。
Method: 以 SE(3) 上度量范数定义 GOI，即测量通过 Gauss-Newton 曲率在可观测子空间上的扰动大小；理论上建立 GOI 与影响函数范数、Fisher 信息以及最小可观测特征值的关系，并推出有限样本稳定性半径；通过受控合成实验以及 TUM RGB-D 与 KITTI 真实数据验证。
Result: 摘要报告 GOI 对真实留一位姿变化的预测达到 log-correlation r=1.00；标准化影响量精确等价于经典卡方残差统计量，即残差门控是杠杆校正后的影响检验；在五个 TUM RGB-D 序列（四个动态、一个静态控制）和两个 KITTI 里程计序列上，当 cond(H) 约 10^4 时原始影响量门控显著退化，而两种准则在良态几何下表现相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GOI 提供精确的逐测量属性归因，并从原理上解释残差门控为何鲁棒；所有代码已发布以保证可复现性。

papers.title: Progressive Checkerboards for Autoregressive Multiscale Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in autoregressive image generation is to efficiently sample independent locations in parallel, while still modeling mutual dependencies with serial conditioning. Some recent works have addressed this by conditioning between scales in a multiscale pyramid. Others have looked at parallelizing samples in a single image using regular partitions or randomized orders. In this work we examine a flexible, fixed ordering based on progressive checkerboards for multiscale autoregressive image generation. Our ordering draws samples in parallel from evenly spaced regions at each scale, maintaining full balance in all levels of a quadtree subdivision at each step. This enables effective conditioning both between and within scales. Intriguingly, we find evidence that in our balanced setting, a wide range of scale-up factors lead to similar results, so long as the total number of serial steps is constant. On class-conditional ImageNet, our method achieves competitive performance compared to recent state-of-the-art autoregressive systems with like model capacity, using fewer sampling steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于渐进棋盘格 (progressive checkerboards) 的固定顺序多尺度自回归图像生成方法。方法在四叉树细分的每一层从均匀分布的区域并行采样，并保持所有层级的完整平衡，从而在尺度间和尺度内都进行条件建模。在类条件 ImageNet 上，该方法以与近期最先进自回归系统相当的模型容量和更少的采样步数取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 自回归图像生成的关键挑战是如何在并行采样独立位置的同时，用串行条件建模来捕捉相互依赖。现有工作要么在尺度间做条件化，要么用规则划分或随机顺序在单张图像内并行化；本文关注一种灵活固定顺序的并行化方案。
Method: 提出基于渐进棋盘格的多尺度自回归顺序，在每个尺度上从均匀间隔的区域并行采样，并在每一步维持四叉树细分所有层级的完整平衡，从而同时在尺度间和尺度内实现条件化。摘要还提到在平衡设置下，只要串行步总数恒定，较宽的放大因子范围会产生相似结果。
Result: 在类条件 ImageNet 上，与同等模型容量的近期最先进自回归系统相比，该方法以更少的采样步数取得有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调平衡的四叉树采样顺序能够同时保持尺度内外的有效条件建模，并且串行步数恒定下对放大因子不敏感。

papers.title: Expert-Data Alignment Governs Generation Quality in Decentralized Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Diffusion Models (DDMs) route denoising through experts trained independently on disjoint data clusters, which can strongly disagree in their predictions. What governs the quality of generations in such systems? We present the first ever systematic investigation of this question. A priori, the expectation is that minimizing denoising trajectory sensitivity -- minimizing how perturbations amplify during sampling -- should govern generation quality. We demonstrate this hypothesis is incorrect: a stability-quality dissociation. Full ensemble routing, which combines all expert predictions at each step, achieves the most stable sampling dynamics and best numerical convergence while producing the worst generation quality (FID 47.9 vs. 22.6 for sparse Top-2 routing). Instead, we identify expert-data alignment as the governing principle: generation quality depends on routing inputs to experts whose training distribution covers the current denoising state. Across two distinct DDM systems, we validate expert-data alignment using (i) data-cluster distance analysis, confirming sparse routing selects experts with data clusters closest to the current denoising state, and (ii) per-expert analysis, showing selected experts produce more accurate predictions than non-selected ones, and (iii) expert disagreement analysis, showing quality degrades when experts disagree. For DDM deployment, our findings establish that routing should prioritize expert-data alignment over numerical stability metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对去中心化扩散模型（Decentralized Diffusion Models, DDMs）中生成质量的决定因素做了首次系统性研究。作者推翻了预期的“最稳定的采样动力学带来最好生成质量”假设：全集成路由（full ensemble routing）数值最稳定但生成质量最差（FID 47.9），而稀疏 Top-2 路由反而更优（FID 22.6）。作者提出专家-数据对齐（expert-data alignment）才是主导原则，即路由应将输入送到其训练数据覆盖当前去噪状态的专家，并通过三类分析在两种不同 DDM 系统上验证了这一结论。
Motivation: DDM 中的专家在互不相交的数据簇上独立训练，其预测可能严重不一致；此前普遍认为最小化去噪轨迹敏感性（即采样中的扰动放大）应决定生成质量。作者用实验证明这一假设不成立，存在稳定性-质量解离，因此需要重新寻找真正决定生成质量的因素。
Method: 作者对比了全集成路由与稀疏 Top-2 路由等采样策略，并提出并使用三类分析方法验证专家-数据对齐原则：数据簇距离分析（确认稀疏路由选择的专家数据簇最接近当前去噪状态）、逐专家分析（被选专家比未选专家预测更准确）、专家分歧分析（专家分歧增大时质量下降）。
Result: 核心实验结果表明，全集成路由具有最稳定的采样动力学和最好的数值收敛，却产生最差的生成质量（FID 47.9），而稀疏 Top-2 路由的 FID 为 22.6；相关工作在两种不同 DDM 系统上一致支持专家-数据对齐是生成质量的主导因素。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，在 DDM 部署中，路由策略应当优先保证专家-数据对齐，而不是追求数值稳定性指标；摘要未给出除上述两个 FID 数值以外的更多实验细节或明确局限。

papers.title: Matterhorn: Masked Time-to-First-Spike Encoding by Reassigning the Silent State for Sparse and Energy-Efficient Spiking Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient inference for large language models (LLMs), yet most reported savings rely on compute-operation counts that overlook data movement. Energy characterization of representative spiking transformers on a commercial 22-nm process shows that accumulation contributes less than 3% of total energy, while spike-triggered inter-core transfers and weight reads dominate the cost. This makes time-to-first-spike (TTFS) encoding a natural choice, as it limits each neuron to at most one spike. However, standard TTFS maps the silent state, an all-zero spike train that transmits no events, to the rarely occurring smallest value, while the most common activations still spike. This raises a simple question: why reserve the only cost-free codeword for a rare value? This choice inverts a basic principle of energy-aware coding, under which the zero-event codeword should represent the most common value, rather than a rare extreme. Thus, we introduce masked time-to-first-spike encoding (M-TTFS), which uses a temporal mask to reassign the silent state to the most common activation value, and a dead-zone extension that trades a controlled amount of information for greater sparsity. Built on M-TTFS with dead-zone radius $k{=}1$, our spiking transformer Matterhorn reaches an overall spike rate of 1.64% on GLUE at an average score of 84.64, exceeding the best prior spiking transformer by 1.42 percentage points while consuming 67% less energy, with consistent gains on spiking LLaMA models from 7B to 70B parameters. Together, these results show that under hardware-faithful accounting, the energy advantage of SNNs is not a given: it is earned by encodings that align spikes with the data distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）用于大语言模型推理时的能耗核算问题，指出传统基于计算操作数的估算忽略了数据移动，在商业22-nm工艺上累加能耗占比不足3%，而spike触发的核间传输与权重读取才是能耗主导。作者提出掩蔽时间到首脉冲编码（M-TTFS），将零成本的静默状态重新分配给最常见的激活值，并加入dead-zone扩展以换取更高稀疏性。据此构建的脉冲Transformer Matterhorn在GLUE上达到1.64%的整体spike率和84.64的平均分，超过最佳先前脉冲Transformer 1.42个百分点且节能67%，在7B至70B的脉冲LLaMA模型上也有一致提升。
Motivation: 现有SNN能耗优势的报道多基于计算操作计数，忽略了数据移动成本；而标准TTFS编码把唯一的零事件码字（静默状态）分配给罕见的最小值，违反了能量感知编码中零事件码字应代表最常见值的基本原则。作者质疑为何将唯一的零成本码字保留给罕见值，因此需要一种使脉冲与数据分布对齐的编码方案。
Method: 提出掩蔽时间到首脉冲编码（M-TTFS），通过时间掩码将静默状态重新分配给最常见的激活值；并引入dead-zone扩展，以受控的信息损失换取更大稀疏性。基于dead-zone半径k=1的M-TTFS构建了脉冲Transformer模型Matterhorn。
Result: 在22-nm工艺能量表征中，累加能耗不到总能耗的3%，spike触发的核间传输和权重读取占主导。Matterhorn在GLUE上整体spike率为1.64%，平均得分84.64，比最佳先前脉冲Transformer高1.42个百分点，能耗降低67%；在7B到70B参数的spiking LLaMA模型上均取得一致性增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在硬件忠实的能耗核算下，SNN的能量优势并非天然成立，而是需要通过使脉冲编码与数据分布对齐来赢得。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Towards the Holographic Characteristic of LLMs for Efficient Short-text Generation
papers.abstract_en: The recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have attracted interest in exploring their in-context learning abilities and chain-of-thought capabilities. However, there are few studies investigating the specific traits related to the powerful generation capacity of LLMs. This paper aims to delve into the generation characteristics exhibited by LLMs. Through our investigation, we have discovered that language models tend to capture target-side keywords at the beginning of the generation process. We name this phenomenon the Holographic Characteristic of language models. For the purpose of exploring this characteristic and further improving the inference efficiency of language models, we propose a plugin called HOLO, which leverages the Holographic Characteristic to extract target-side keywords from language models within a limited number of generation steps and complements the sentence with a parallel lexically constrained text generation method. To verify the effectiveness of HOLO, we conduct massive experiments on language models of varying architectures and scales in the short-text generation scenario. The results demonstrate that HOLO achieves comparable performance to the baselines in terms of both automatic and human-like evaluation metrics and highlight the potential of the Holographic Characteristic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的生成特性，发现模型在生成过程初期往往会捕获目标端关键词，作者将此现象命名为全息特性（Holographic Characteristic）。基于该特性，作者提出插件 HOLO，在有限生成步数内提取目标端关键词，并用并行词汇约束文本生成方法补全句子。作者在不同架构和规模的语言模型上进行短文本生成实验，结果显示 HOLO 在自动评估与类人评估指标上均达到与基线相当的性能。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注 LLM 的上下文学习与思维链能力，但很少探讨与其强大生成能力相关的具体特性。本文旨在深入考察 LLM 展现出的生成特性，以理解其生成机制。
Method: 提出一个名为 HOLO 的插件，利用全息特性在有限的生成步数内从语言模型中提取目标端关键词，再通过并行的词汇约束文本生成方法（lexically constrained text generation）补全整个句子，以提升推理效率。
Result: 在短文本生成场景下，对多种架构和规模的语言模型进行了大量实验；结果表明 HOLO 在自动评估和类人评估指标上均与基线性能相当，并展示了全息特性的潜力。
Conclusion: 作者强调全息特性在提升语言模型推理效率方面具有潜力，HOLO 作为插件在短文本生成任务上可行且有效；摘要未提及局限性或超出短文本生成场景的扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Incorporating data drift to perform survival analysis on credit risk
authors: Stefan Lessmann (1 and 2) ((1) Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin
papers.abstract_en: Survival analysis has become a standard approach for modelling time to default by time-varying covariates in credit risk. Unlike most existing methods that implicitly assume a stationary data-generating process, in practise, mortgage portfolios are exposed to various forms of data drift caused by changing borrower behaviour, macroeconomic conditions, policy regimes and so on. This study investigates the impact of data drift on survival-based credit risk models and proposes a dynamic joint modelling framework to improve robustness under non-stationary environments. The proposed model integrates a longitudinal behavioural marker derived from balance dynamics with a discrete-time hazard formulation, combined with landmark one-hot encoding and isotonic calibration. Three types of data drift (sudden, incremental and recurring) are simulated and analysed on mortgage loan datasets from Freddie Mac. Experiments and corresponding evidence show that the proposed landmark-based joint model consistently outperforms classical survival models, tree-based drift-adaptive learners and gradient boosting methods in terms of discrimination and calibration across all drift scenarios, which confirms the superiority of our model design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据漂移（data drift）对信用风险中生存分析建模的影响，并提出一个动态联合建模框架以提升非平稳环境下的鲁棒性。该框架将来自余额动态的纵向行为标记与离散时间风险（hazard）公式结合，配合 landmark one-hot 编码和保序校准（isotonic calibration）。在 Freddie Mac 抵押贷款数据上模拟突发、渐进和周期性三类数据漂移后，实验表明所提模型在区分度和校准度上一致优于经典生存模型、树类漂移自适应学习器和梯度提升方法。
Motivation: 现有生存分析模型大多隐含假设数据生成过程平稳，但现实抵押贷款组合会因借款人行为变化、宏观经济条件、政策制度等遭受多种数据漂移，从而损害模型表现。
Method: 提出动态联合建模框架：整合由余额动态衍生的纵向行为标记，采用离散时间风险公式，并结合 landmark one-hot 编码与保序校准来处理非平稳环境。
Result: 在 Freddie Mac 抵押贷款数据集上模拟三种数据漂移（突发、增量、周期性），实验证据显示该 landmark 联合模型在所有漂移场景下的区分度（discrimination）和校准度（calibration）均一致优于经典生存模型、树类漂移自适应学习器及梯度提升方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将数据漂移显式纳入生存建模能够提升信用风险模型在非平稳环境下的稳健性，并认为所提模型设计在多个对照方法中具有优越性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Iterative RAG Beats Ideal Evidence: A Diagnostic Study in Scientific Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) extends large language models (LLMs) beyond parametric knowledge, yet it is unclear when iterative retrieval-reasoning loops meaningfully outperform static RAG, particularly in scientific domains requiring multi-hop reasoning over sparse, heterogeneous evidence. We provide the first controlled, mechanism-level diagnostic evaluation of whether synchronized iterative retrieval and reasoning can surpass even an idealized static upper bound (Gold Context) RAG. We benchmark eleven state-of-the-art LLMs under three regimes: (i) No Context, measuring reliance on parametric memory; (ii) Gold Context, where all oracle evidence is supplied at once; and (iii) Iterative RAG, a training-free controller that alternates retrieval, hypothesis refinement, and evidence-aware stopping. Using the chemistry-focused ChemKGMultiHopQA dataset, we isolate questions requiring genuine retrieval and analyze retrieval coverage gaps, anchor carry drop, query quality, composition fidelity, and control calibration. Iterative RAG consistently outperforms Gold Context, with gains up to 25.6 percentage points, especially for non-reasoning fine-tuned models. Staged retrieval reduces late-hop failures, mitigates context overload, and enables dynamic correction of early hypothesis drift, but failure modes remain, including incomplete hop coverage, distractor latch trajectories, early stopping miscalibration, and high composition failure rates even with perfect retrieval. Overall, the process of staged retrieval is often more influential than the mere presence of ideal evidence. We provide practical guidance for deploying and diagnosing RAG in specialized scientific settings. Code and evaluation results are available at https://github.com/Matroid1998/Iterative-rag

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对科学多跳问答场景下的迭代式RAG（Iterative RAG）进行机制级诊断评估，检验同步的迭代检索与推理是否能超越理想化静态上界（Gold Context）RAG。作者在化学领域数据集ChemKGMultiHopQA上，对11个SOTA LLM在无上下文、金标上下文、迭代RAG三种条件下进行基准测试，发现迭代RAG一致优于Gold Context，最高提升25.6个百分点，并分析了检索覆盖缺口、锚点漂移、查询质量、组合保真度与控制校准等失败模式。
Motivation: 现有研究不清楚迭代检索-推理循环在何时能实质性地优于静态RAG，尤其是在需要跨稀疏异质证据进行多跳推理的科学领域；作者希望通过受控的机制级诊断来回答这一开放问题。
Method: 提出一种免训练的控制器，交替进行检索、假设精化和证据感知停止（evidence-aware stopping），形成迭代RAG；并以No Context（参数记忆）、Gold Context（一次性提供全部oracle证据）和Iterative RAG三种机制进行对比，在ChemKGMultiHopQA数据集上对11个LLM做系统诊断。
Result: 迭代RAG一致优于Gold Context，尤其对非推理微调模型最高提升25.6个百分点；分阶段检索减少了后期跳失败，缓解上下文过载，并支持对早期假设漂移的动态修正；但仍存在跳覆盖不完整、干扰项锁死轨迹、提前停止校准偏差以及即使检索完美时仍高的组合失败率等失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者强调在专有科学场景中，分阶段检索的过程本身往往比是否提供理想证据（理想证据的存在）更具影响力，并据此给出了部署和诊断RAG的实用建议；代码与评估结果已公开。
Relevance: 3
