papers.title: Embedding of Low-Dimensional Sensory Dynamics in Recurrent Networks: Implications for the Geometry of Neural Representation
papers.abstract_en: Neural population activity in sensory cortex is organized on low-dimensional manifolds, but why such manifolds arise and what determines their geometry remain unclear. We model cortical populations as recurrent circuits driven by low-dimensional regular sensory dynamics (circles, tori). Combining generalized synchronization and delay-embedding theory, we show that contracting recurrent networks generically develop smooth internal manifolds embedding the sensory dynamics. The dimensional requirement is modest: N>2d suffices, where d is the intrinsic sensory dimension (compatible with Whitney and Takens bounds). We prove a prediction-separation result linking representational geometry to predictive performance without assuming contraction: accurate prediction forces state separation up to a resolution set by prediction error, yielding categorical boundaries, metameric equivalence, and discrimination thresholds. Numerical experiments with trained tanh RNNs recover ring- and torus-shaped hidden manifolds; state separation improves sharply at the 2d+1 threshold. Training pushes networks beyond strict contraction, yet embedding persists, indicating sufficient but not necessary conditions. These results provide a mechanistic account of why sensory manifolds emerge in recurrent circuits and how prediction constrains their resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究感觉皮层中神经群体活动为何组织在低维流形上以及流形几何由什么决定。作者将皮层群体建模为受低维规则感觉动力学（圆、环面）驱动的循环网络，结合广义同步（generalized synchronization）与延迟嵌入（delay-embedding）理论，证明收缩循环网络普遍发展出嵌入感觉动力学的光滑内部流形，维度需求仅为 N>2d。数值实验在训练的 tanh RNN 中恢复出环状和环面状隐藏流形，状态分离在 2d+1 阈值处显著改善。
Motivation: 感觉皮层的神经群体活动被组织在低维流形上，但这些流形为何出现以及什么决定其几何仍不清楚；论文旨在给出机制性解释。
Method: 将皮层群体建模为受低维感觉动力学驱动的循环网络，结合广义同步和延迟嵌入理论分析收缩网络；此外证明一个不假设收缩的预测-分离（prediction-separation）结果，把表征几何与预测性能联系起来，并用训练的 tanh RNN 进行数值验证。
Result: 摘要证明 N>2d 即足以嵌入感觉动力学（与 Whitney 和 Takens 界一致）；预测-分离结果表明准确预测迫使状态分离达到由预测误差决定的分辨率，从而产生类别边界、metameric 等价和判别阈值。数值实验恢复环和环面状隐藏流形，状态分离在 2d+1 阈值处急剧改善；训练使网络超出严格收缩但嵌入仍然存在。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些结果提供了感觉流形为何在循环回路中涌现以及预测如何约束其分辨率的机制性解释，并指出收缩是充分但非必要条件。

papers.title: Knowledge Restoration-driven Prompt Optimization: Unlocking LLM Potential for Open-Domain Relational Triplet Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Open-domain Relational Triplet Extraction (ORTE) aims to mine structured knowledge without predefined relation schemas. Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced ORTE toward a prompt-driven paradigm through powerful in-context learning. However, adapting their extraction behavior to varying open-domain contexts remains challenging. Existing methods typically rely on manually crafted prompts that remain fixed across inputs, despite substantial variation in linguistic expressions and contextual structures. This mismatch may lead to unsupported triplets, while the absence of ground-truth annotations makes such deficiencies difficult to identify and correct. Moreover, free-form relation generation produces non-canonical relation surface forms, undermining knowledge graph consistency. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge Restoration-driven Prompt Optimization (KRPO), a framework for label-free target-corpus adaptation. KRPO restores extracted triplets into textual statements and evaluates their semantic consistency with the source inputs, deriving intrinsic feedback without gold annotations. This feedback is transformed into natural-language optimization guidance for batch-wise prompt optimization and adaptation. KRPO further introduces a Memory-augmented Relation Canonicalizer that aligns free-form relations with a dynamically updated schema memory, improving relation consistency. Experiments on three ORTE benchmarks with multiple LLM backbones demonstrate strong overall performance, with KRPO achieving the best average F1 score across the evaluated settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Knowledge Restoration-driven Prompt Optimization (KRPO)，一个面向开放域关系三元组抽取 (Open-domain Relational Triplet Extraction, ORTE) 的无标签目标语料适配框架。KRPO 将抽取出的三元组还原为文本陈述，并与源输入做语义一致性评估，从而在不依赖金标注的情况下生成内在反馈，再转化为自然语言优化指导用于批量式 prompt 优化。文中还引入 Memory-augmented Relation Canonicalizer，将自由形式的关系表达对齐到动态更新的 schema 记忆，以提升知识图谱一致性。在三个 ORTE 基准和多种 LLM 主干上的实验显示，KRPO 在评估设置中取得最佳平均 F1。
Motivation: 现有 ORTE 方法多依赖固定的人工 prompt，难以适应开放域中语言表达和上下文结构的显著变化，容易产生无依据的三元组；同时缺少 ground-truth 标注使得这些缺陷难以识别和纠正，且自由形式的关系生成会导致非规范的关系表面形式，破坏知识图谱一致性。
Method: KRPO 先把抽取出的三元组恢复成文本陈述，通过与源输入的语义一致性评估获得无需金标注的内在反馈，并将此反馈转化为自然语言优化指导，对 prompt 进行批量优化和适配；此外引入 Memory-augmented Relation Canonicalizer，用动态更新的 schema 记忆来规范自由形式的关系表达。
Result: 在三个 ORTE 基准上结合多种 LLM 主干的实验中，KRPO 表现强劲，并在所评估的设置中取得最佳平均 F1 分数。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种标签免费的 prompt 优化框架能够有效提升开放域三元组抽取的准确性与关系一致性，但其具体数值和消融细节在摘要中未给出。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Low-Cost Hard-Label Adversarial Attack with Theoretical Foundations
papers.abstract_en: Hard-label black-box attacks, relying solely on top-1 predictions, represent one of the most challenging yet practically threat models. Despite recent progress, existing approaches face two key limitations: (1) they overlook the critical role of initialization, focusing primarily on optimization strategies; and (2) they rely heavily on empirical heuristics without theoretical guarantees. To bridge this gap, we establish a unified theoretical framework showing that existing sign-flipping hard-label attacks can be understood as approximating the true gradient sign. Guided by this principled analysis, we propose a novel attack framework featuring a zero-query initialization strategy and a Pattern-Driven Optimization (PDO) algorithm. We provide theoretical guarantees that our initialization yields higher cosine similarity to the true gradient sign than random baselines, and our PDO module achieves significantly lower query complexity than baseline search methods. Extensive experiments across CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and ObjectNet-covering standard and adversarially trained models, commercial APIs, and CLIP models-demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms SOTA hard-label attacks in both success rate and efficiency, particularly under low query budgets. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust generalization across corrupted data (ImageNet-C), biomedical images (PathMNIST), and dense prediction tasks such as segmentation. Notably, it bypasses the stateful defense Blacklight, achieving a 0% detection rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅依赖 top-1 预测的 hard-label 黑盒对抗攻击，建立统一理论框架将现有 sign-flipping 攻击解释为对真实梯度符号的近似，并据此提出零查询初始化策略与 Pattern-Driven Optimization (PDO) 算法。实验覆盖 CIFAR-10、ImageNet、ObjectNet，包括对抗训练模型、商业 API 和 CLIP 模型，结果显示该方法在成功率和效率上一致超越现有 SOTA，尤其在低查询预算下，并能绕过 Blacklight 防御（0% 检测率）。
Motivation: 现有 hard-label 黑盒攻击存在两个关键局限：忽视初始化的作用而只关注优化策略，以及依赖经验启发式而缺乏理论保证。
Method: 建立统一理论框架解释现有 sign-flipping 攻击，并在其指导下提出 zero-query 初始化策略和 Pattern-Driven Optimization (PDO) 算法；初始化策略在理论上保证比随机基线有更高的真实梯度符号余弦相似度，PDO 模块的理论查询复杂度低于基线搜索方法。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、ImageNet、ObjectNet 以及对抗训练模型、商业 API、CLIP 模型上一致优于 SOTA hard-label 攻击，低查询预算下优势明显；在 ImageNet-C、PathMNIST 和分割等稠密预测任务上表现出鲁棒泛化，并绕过有状态防御 Blacklight，实现 0% 检测率。
Conclusion: 以理论分析指导设计可以同时提升 hard-label 攻击的成功率与查询效率，且方法具备跨数据集和任务的泛化能力。

papers.title: GeoRA: Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation for RLVR
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key paradigm for improving large-scale reasoning models. Unlike supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RLVR exhibits distinct optimization dynamics and is sensitive to the preservation of pre-trained geometric structures. However, existing parameter-efficient methods face key limitations in this regime. Low-rank adaptation methods, such as PiSSA, are primarily designed for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and do not account for the distinct optimization dynamics and geometric structures of RLVR. Conversely, directly fine-tuning the unstructured sparse parameter subspace favored by RLVR encounters efficiency bottlenecks on modern hardware. To address these challenges, we propose GeoRA (Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation), a low-rank adaptation method tailored for RLVR. Specifically, GeoRA exploits the anisotropic and compressible structure of RL update subspace, and extracts its principal directions via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to initialize low-rank adapters, while freezing residual components as a structural anchor during training. This design preserves the pre-trained structure and enables efficient dense computation. Experiments on Qwen and Llama models from 1.5B to 32B parameters show that GeoRA consistently outperforms strong low-rank baselines across RLVR settings in mathematics, medicine, and coding, while showing stronger generalization and less forgetting on out-of-domain tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoRA，一种面向可验证奖励强化学习 (RLVR) 的几何感知低秩适配 (low-rank adaptation) 方法。GeoRA 利用 RL 更新子空间各向异性且可压缩的结构，通过奇异值分解 (SVD) 提取主方向来初始化低秩适配器，并在训练中冻结残差分量作为结构锚点。在 Qwen 和 Llama 从 1.5B 到 32B 参数的模型上，GeoRA 在数学、医学和编码等 RLVR 设置中一致优于强低秩基线，并在分布外任务上表现出更强的泛化与更少的遗忘。
Motivation: RLVR 与监督微调 (SFT) 的优化动态不同，且对预训练几何结构的保持敏感；现有低秩方法如 PiSSA 主要面向 SFT 设计，未考虑 RLVR 的优化动态与几何结构，而直接微调 RLVR 偏好的非结构化稀疏参数子空间在现代硬件上又存在效率瓶颈。
Method: GeoRA 先刻画 RL 更新子空间各向异性和可压缩的结构，利用 SVD 提取其主方向来初始化低秩适配器，同时冻结残差分量作为训练期间的结构锚点，从而兼顾预训练结构保持与高效稠密计算。
Result: 在 Qwen 与 Llama 从 1.5B 到 32B 参数的模型上，GeoRA 在数学、医学、编码三类 RLVR 设置中一致优于强低秩基线，并在分布外任务上表现出更强的泛化能力和更少的遗忘。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，面向 RLVR 专门设计的低秩适配方法能够在保持预训练几何结构的同时获得性能与泛化收益，而直接沿用面向 SFT 的参数高效方法是其局限所在。

papers.title: GPU-Accelerated ANNS: Quantized for Speed, Built for Change
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is a core problem in machine learning and information retrieval applications. GPUs offer a promising path to high-performance ANNS: they provide massive parallelism for distance computations, are readily available, and can co-locate with downstream applications. Despite these advantages, current GPU-accelerated ANNS systems face three key limitations. First, real-world applications operate on evolving datasets that require fast batch updates, yet most GPU indices must be rebuilt from scratch when new data arrives. Second, high-dimensional vectors strain memory bandwidth, but current GPU systems lack efficient quantization techniques that reduce data movement without introducing costly random memory accesses. Third, the data-dependent memory accesses inherent to greedy search make overlapping compute and memory difficult, leading to reduced performance. We present Jasper, a GPU-native ANNS system with both high query throughput and updatability. Jasper builds on the Vamana graph index and overcomes existing bottlenecks via three contributions: (1) a CUDA batch-parallel construction algorithm that enables lock-free streaming insertions, (2) a GPU-efficient implementation of RaBitQ quantization that reduces memory footprint up to 8x without the random access penalties, and (3) an optimized greedy search kernel that increases compute utilization, resulting in better latency hiding and higher throughput. Our evaluation across five datasets shows that Jasper achieves up to 1.84x higher query throughput than CAGRA and achieves up to 80% peak utilization as measured by the roofline model. Jasper's construction scales efficiently and constructs indices an average of 7x faster than CAGRA while providing updatability that CAGRA lacks. Compared to BANG, the previous fastest GPU Vamana implementation, Jasper delivers 10-74x faster queries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Jasper，一个基于 Vamana 图索引的 GPU 原生近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）系统，兼顾高查询吞吐与可更新性。Jasper 通过 CUDA 批量并行构建、GPU 高效的 RaBitQ 量化以及优化的贪心搜索内核，解决了现有 GPU 索引重建开销大、内存带宽受限和数据相关访存难以隐藏延迟的问题。实验显示其在五个数据集上比 CAGRA 最高提升 1.84 倍查询吞吐，构建平均快 7 倍，并支持 CAGRA 不具备的更新能力。
Motivation: 现实应用的数据集不断演化，需要快速批量更新，但多数 GPU 索引在新数据到达时必须从头重建；高维向量消耗内存带宽而现有 GPU 系统缺乏高效量化；贪心搜索中的数据相关内存访问使计算与访存难以重叠，限制性能。
Method: Jasper 构建在 Vamana 图索引之上，包含三项贡献：一是 CUDA 批量并行构建算法，支持无锁流式插入；二是 GPU 高效的 RaBitQ 量化实现，将内存占用降低最多 8 倍且不引入随机访问开销；三是优化贪心搜索内核以提高计算利用率，改善延迟隐藏和吞吐。
Result: 在五个数据集上的评估中，Jasper 相比 CAGRA 实现最高 1.84 倍查询吞吐，达到 roofline 模型下最高 80% 的峰值利用率；索引构建平均比 CAGRA 快 7 倍，同时提供 CAGRA 所缺乏的更新能力；相比之前最快的 GPU Vamana 实现 BANG，查询速度提升 10-74 倍。

papers.title: M3MAD-Bench: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Multi-Agent Debate Across Domains and Modalities
papers.abstract_en: As an agent-level reasoning and coordination paradigm, Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) orchestrates multiple agents through structured debate to improve answer quality and support complex reasoning. However, existing research on MAD suffers from two fundamental limitations: evaluations are conducted under fragmented and inconsistent settings, making fair comparison difficult, and are largely confined to text-only scenarios, leaving its effectiveness in multimodal settings underexplored. To address these gaps, we introduce M3MAD-Bench, a unified and extensible benchmark for evaluating MAD methods across Multi-domain tasks, Multi-modal inputs, and Multi-dimensional metrics. M3MAD-Bench establishes standardized protocols over five core task domains, including Knowledge, Mathematics, Medicine, Natural Sciences, and Complex Reasoning, covering a total of 13 datasets, and systematically includes both pure text and vision-language data, enabling controlled cross-modality comparison. We evaluate MAD methods on 9 base models spanning different architectures, scales, and modality capabilities. Beyond accuracy, M3MAD-Bench incorporates efficiency-oriented metrics such as token consumption and inference time, providing a holistic view of performance--cost trade-offs. Through extensive experiments, we derive nine key insights, revealing that MAD is not uniformly effective: collaborative methods are generally more robust than adversarial ones, especially on reasoning-intensive and multimodal tasks, but often incur substantial efficiency costs. These findings provide practical guidance for selecting and designing MAD strategies in real-world applications. We believe M3MAD-Bench offers a reliable foundation for future research on standardized and reproducible MAD evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/liaolea/M3MAD-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 M3MAD-Bench，一个统一且可扩展的多智能体辩论 (MAD) 评测基准，旨在对 MAD 方法进行跨领域、跨模态、多维指标的评估。基准在知识、数学、医学、自然科学和复杂推理五个核心任务领域、共 13 个数据集上建立标准化协议，并同时纳入纯文本与视觉-语言数据。作者在 9 个基础模型上评测 MAD 方法，并补充 token 消耗、推理时间等效率指标，得出九条关键洞察。
Motivation: 现有 MAD 研究存在两处根本局限：评估在碎片化且不一致的设置下进行，难以公平比较；且大多局限于纯文本场景，多模态设置下的有效性尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建统一可扩展的评测基准 M3MAD-Bench，为五个核心任务领域和 13 个数据集制定标准化协议，并系统包含纯文本和视觉-语言数据以支持受控的跨模态比较。评测覆盖 9 个不同架构、规模和模态能力的基础模型，同时在准确率之外引入 token 消耗和推理时间等面向效率的指标。
Result: 大量实验得出九条关键洞察，显示 MAD 并非普遍有效：协作式方法通常比对抗式方法更稳健，尤其在推理密集和多模态任务上，但往往带来显著的效率成本。
Conclusion: 作者认为 M3MAD-Bench 为未来标准化、可复现的 MAD 评测提供了可靠基础，并为真实应用中选择和设计 MAD 策略提供实践指导。

papers.title: WebCoderBench: Benchmarking Web Application Generation with Comprehensive and Interpretable Evaluation Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Web applications (web apps) have become a key arena for large language models (LLMs) to demonstrate their code generation capabilities and commercial potential. However, building a benchmark for LLM-generated web apps remains challenging due to the need for real-world user requirements, generalizable evaluation metrics without relying on ground-truth implementations or test cases, and interpretable evaluation results. To address these challenges, we introduce WebCoderBench, the first real-world-collected, generalizable, and interpretable benchmark for web app generation. WebCoderBench comprises 1,572 real user requirements, covering diverse modalities and expression styles that reflect realistic user intentions. WebCoderBench provides 24 fine-grained evaluation metrics across 9 perspectives, combining rule-based and LLM-as-a-judge paradigm for fully automated, objective, and general evaluation. Moreover, WebCoderBench adopts human-preference-aligned weights over metrics to yield interpretable overall scores. Experiments across 12 representative LLMs and 2 LLM-based agents show that there exists no dominant model across all evaluation metrics, offering an opportunity for LLM developers to optimize their models in a targeted manner for a more powerful version.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WebCoderBench，据称是首个从真实世界收集、具备通用性与可解释性的 Web 应用生成基准。基准包含 1,572 条真实用户需求，覆盖多种模态和表达风格；提供跨 9 个视角的 24 个细粒度评估指标，结合基于规则与 LLM-as-a-judge 的范式实现全自动评估，并用对齐人类偏好的权重合成可解释总分。在 12 个代表性 LLM 和 2 个基于 LLM 的智能体上的实验表明，没有任何模型在所有指标上占优。
Motivation: 为 LLM 生成的 Web 应用构建基准面临三个挑战：需要真实世界用户需求、需要不依赖 ground-truth 实现或测试用例的通用评估指标，以及需要可解释的评估结果。
Method: 提出 WebCoderBench，包含 1,572 条真实用户需求；设计 24 个细粒度评估指标（9 个视角），将基于规则的评测与 LLM-as-a-judge 结合以实现全自动、客观且通用的评估，并通过人类偏好对齐的指标权重得到可解释的整体得分。
Result: 对 12 个代表性 LLM 和 2 个 LLM-based agents 的实验显示，不存在在所有评估指标上均占优的单一模型。
Conclusion: 由于没有模型全面占优，基准为 LLM 开发者提供了有针对性地优化模型、从而获得更强版本的机会。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Symplectic Representation of Legendre Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Modern learning systems act on internal representations of data, yet how these representations encode underlying physical or statistical structure is often left implicit. In physics, symplecticity keeps Hamiltonian systems faithful to their phase-space geometry. Recent learning methods impose such geometric structure either in the dynamics or through training losses. Here we ask a different question: what would it mean for the representation itself to obey a symplectic conservation law? We pose this representation-level constraint through Legendre duality: the relation $p = dψ(q)$ between primal and dual coordinates, which in exponential family models is the information-geometric pairing of natural and expectation parameters. We formalize Legendre dynamics as stochastic processes whose trajectories remain on Legendre graphs, where the evolving primal-dual parameters stay Legendre dual. We show that this class includes linear time-invariant Gaussian process regression and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics. Geometrically, we characterize the symplectomorphisms of cotangent bundles that preserve all Legendre graphs. We show that these maps are exactly cotangent lifts of base diffeomorphisms followed by exact fibre translations. This gives an explicit normal form for Legendre-preserving representation updates. Dynamically, we prove that the normal form is realized by Hamiltonians that are at most linear in the momentum. This realization principle is used to construct linear and nonlinear Hamiltonian Symplectic Reservoirs (SR) whose recurrent updates preserve Legendre graphs by construction. This is the only normal form that preserves Legendre duality, so the architecture follows from the invariant. Numerical experiments confirm the normal-form identities and distinguish Legendre preserving Hamiltonian SRs from generic symplectic and standard reservoir baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个表示层面的问题：数据表示本身能否满足辛守恒律（symplectic conservation law），并通过 Legendre 对偶（Legendre duality）将其形式化为 Legendre 动力学，即轨迹保持在 Legendre 图上的随机过程。作者刻画了保持所有 Legendre 图的余切丛辛同胚，证明其恰为底微分同胚的余切提升再复合精确纤维平移，并给出该正规形的动力学实现。基于此构造线性和非线性 Hamiltonian Symplectic Reservoirs (SR)，数值实验验证了正规形恒等式，并将其与一般辛和标准储备池基线区分开。
Motivation: 现有学习方法要么在动力学中、要么通过训练损失来施加辛结构，而表示本身是否应遵循辛守恒律这一问题尚未被直接处理；作者希望从表示层面给出几何约束。
Method: 利用指数族中自然参数与期望参数的信息几何配对 p = dψ(q) 定义 Legendre 图，将 Legendre 动力学建模为保持对偶关系的随机过程；从几何上证明 Legendre 图保持辛同胚等价于余切提升加精确纤维平移，并证明该正规形由至多对动量线性的 Hamiltonian 实现，据此设计 Hamiltonian Symplectic Reservoirs。
Result: 该框架包含线性时不变高斯过程回归和 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 动力学；作者给出 Legendre 保持表示更新的显式正规形，数值实验确认正规形恒等式，并表明 Legendre 保持的 Hamiltonian SR 与一般辛储备池及标准储备池基线可区分。
Conclusion: 由于该正规形是保持 Legendre 对偶的唯一形式，所提出的储备池架构直接从不变性导出；摘要强调架构由不变量决定，而非依赖启发式设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent Sculpting for Zero-Shot Generalization: A Manifold Learning Approach to Out-of-Distribution Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Detecting previously unseen attacks remains a major challenge for machine learning-based intrusion detection systems. Deep models trained on network traffic often achieve high accuracy on known attacks but fail under distributional shift because their decision boundaries are tightly coupled to the training data distribution. We introduce Latent Sculpting, a two-stage anomaly detection framework that improves robustness by explicitly structuring the latent representation before density estimation. The first stage trains a Transformer-based tabular encoder using a novel Binary Latent Sculpting loss, which encourages benign traffic to form a compact latent cluster while enforcing separation from anomalous patterns. The second stage fits a Masked Autoregressive Flow to the resulting latent space to produce calibrated probabilistic anomaly scores. Under a strict zero-shot evaluation protocol on the CIC-IDS-2017 benchmark, Stage 1 attains an F1-score of 0.98 on known attacks, while Stage 2 -- evaluated at the balanced threshold (85th-percentile) -- achieves a zero-shot OOD F1-score of 0.867 and AUROC of 0.913. The model successfully detects difficult distribution shifts including stealthy infiltration attacks (78.7% recall, peaking at 97.2%) and low-volume DoS variants (>94% recall), scenarios where conventional approaches often fail. Our results suggest that explicitly separating latent geometry learning from density modeling provides a stable approach for detecting zero-day cyber threats.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 0 figures. Accepted for publication in the 35th International Conference on Computer Communications and Networks (ICCCN 2026). Code available at: https://github.com/Rajeeb321123/Latent_sculpting_using_two_stage_method
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Sculpting，一种两阶段异常检测框架，用于网络入侵检测中的零样本泛化。第一阶段用 Transformer 表格编码器配合 Binary Latent Sculpting loss，将良性流量聚成紧凑簇并与异常模式分离；第二阶段在潜在空间上拟合 Masked Autoregressive Flow，输出校准的概率异常分数。在 CIC-IDS-2017 的严格零样本协议下，阶段 1 对已知攻击的 F1 为 0.98，阶段 2 在 85 分位平衡阈值下取得零样本 OOD F1 0.867、AUROC 0.913。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的入侵检测系统在已知攻击上准确率高，但决策边界与训练数据分布紧耦合，面对分布偏移（distributional shift）时对未见攻击失效。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用 Transformer 表格编码器与 Binary Latent Sculpting loss 显式塑造潜在表征，使良性流量形成紧凑簇并与异常分离；第二阶段在潜在空间拟合 Masked Autoregressive Flow 进行密度估计并生成概率化异常分数。
Result: 在 CIC-IDS-2017 上，阶段 1 对已知攻击 F1 为 0.98；阶段 2 在平衡阈值下取得零样本 OOD F1 0.867、AUROC 0.913，对隐蔽渗透攻击的召回达 78.7%（峰值 97.2%），对低流量 DoS 变体召回超过 94%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将潜在几何学习与密度建模显式分离，为检测零日网络威胁提供了稳定途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EMAG: Self-Rectifying Diffusion Sampling with Exponential Moving Average Guidance
papers.abstract_en: In diffusion and flow-matching generative models, guidance techniques are widely used to improve sample quality and consistency. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the de facto choice in modern systems and achieves this by contrasting conditional and unconditional samples. Recent work explores contrasting negative samples at inference using a weaker model, via strong/weak model pairs, attention-based masking, stochastic block dropping, or perturbations to the self-attention energy landscape. While these strategies refine the generation quality, they still lack reliable control over the granularity or difficulty of the negative samples, and target-layer selection is often fixed. We propose Exponential Moving Average Guidance (EMAG), a training-free mechanism that modifies attention at inference time in diffusion transformers, with a statistics-based, adaptive layer-selection rule. Unlike prior methods, EMAG produces harder, semantically faithful negatives (fine-grained degradations), surfacing difficult failure modes, enabling the denoiser to refine subtle artifacts, boosting the quality and human preference score (HPS) by +0.46 over CFG. We further demonstrate that EMAG naturally composes with advanced guidance techniques, such as APG and CADS, further improving HPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Exponential Moving Average Guidance (EMAG)，一种免训练 (training-free) 的推理期引导机制，在 diffusion transformer 采样时通过修改 attention 来生成更难且语义上更忠实的负样本（细粒度退化）。与固定目标层选择的方法不同，EMAG 使用基于统计量的自适应层选择规则，使 denoiser 能够修正细微伪影，从而提升生成质量。摘要报告该方法相比 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 将 human preference score (HPS) 提升 +0.46，并能与 APG、CADS 等高级引导技术自然组合以进一步改善 HPS。
Motivation: 现有基于负样本对比的引导方法（如强/弱模型对、attention 掩码、随机块丢弃、self-attention 能量扰动）缺乏对负样本粒度或难度的可靠控制，且目标层的选择往往是固定的，这限制了它们对生成质量的精细调节能力。
Method: EMAG 是一种在推理期修改 diffusion transformer attention 的免训练机制，其核心是基于统计量的自适应层选择规则，能生成更难、语义上更忠实的负样本，从而暴露困难失败模式并引导 denoiser 修正细微伪影。该方法还可与 APG、CADS 等现有引导技术自然组合使用。
Result: 摘要报告 EMAG 相比 CFG 将 human preference score 提升 +0.46，且与 APG、CADS 等先进引导技术组合后能进一步改善 HPS。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过自适应层选择和更难负样本，EMAG 提供了一种无需训练即可提升 diffusion 采样质量与人类偏好的引导方式，并具备与现有引导方法组合的兼容性。

papers.title: JoVA: Unified Multimodal Learning for Joint Video-Audio Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present JoVA, a streamlined framework that unifies joint video-audio generation and editing. While existing methods often rely on fragmented, task-specific architectures or complex fusion mechanisms, JoVA employs native joint representation learning for direct video, audio, and text interaction in a dual-branch architecture. This design eliminates redundant alignment modules and effectively unifies diverse multimodal tasks within a single model. Furthermore, we utilize channel-wise conditioning for flexible image and video reference to avoid massive token expansion, alongside a mouth-area loss to enhance lip alignment. To fully empower and systematically evaluate this framework, we construct a comprehensive training corpus encompassing video-audio generation and editing datasets, and introduce unified benchmarks tailored for these multimodal tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that JoVA achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks, establishing it as an extensible framework for versatile content creation. Project page: https://visual-ai.github.io/jova
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JoVA，一个统一的联合视频-音频生成与编辑框架，采用双分支架构进行视频、音频和文本的原生联合表示学习 (native joint representation learning)，避免了对齐模块和复杂融合机制。框架使用通道级条件 (channel-wise conditioning) 支持图像和视频参考以减少 token 膨胀，并引入嘴部区域损失 (mouth-area loss) 改善唇形对齐。作者构建了涵盖视频-音频生成与编辑的训练语料库和统一基准，实验显示 JoVA 在多个基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有视频-音频生成与编辑方法依赖碎片化、任务特定的架构或复杂融合机制，缺乏统一的模型设计，导致多模态任务难以在单一模型中高效完成。
Method: JoVA 采用双分支架构，通过原生联合表示学习直接实现视频、音频与文本的交互；利用通道级条件处理图像和视频参考，避免大量 token 扩展；并设计嘴部区域损失以增强视频中唇形与音频的对齐。同时构建了综合训练语料库和针对多模态任务的统一基准。
Result: 摘要报告 JoVA 在多个统一基准上取得最先进 (state-of-the-art) 性能，并被视为可扩展的内容创作框架。
Conclusion: JoVA 作为一个可扩展的统一框架，验证了在单一模型中联合完成视频-音频生成与编辑任务的可行性。

papers.title: Optimal Resource Allocation for ML Model Training and Deployment under Concept Drift
papers.abstract_en: We study how to allocate resources for training and deployment of machine learning (ML) models under concept drift and limited budgets. We consider a setting in which a model provider distributes trained models to multiple clients whose devices support local inference but lack the ability to retrain those models, placing the burden of performance maintenance on the provider. We introduce a model-agnostic framework that captures the interaction between resource allocation, concept drift dynamics, and deployment timing. We show that optimal training policies depend critically on the aging properties of concept durations. Under sudden concept changes, we derive optimal training policies subject to budget constraints when concept durations follow distributions with Decreasing Mean Residual Life (DMRL), and show that intuitive heuristics are provably suboptimal under Increasing Mean Residual Life (IMRL). We further study model deployment under communication constraints, prove that the associated optimization problem is quasi-convex under mild conditions, and propose a randomized scheduling strategy that achieves near-optimal client-side performance. These results offer theoretical and algorithmic foundations for cost-efficient ML model management under concept drift, with implications for continual learning, distributed inference, and adaptive ML systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究概念漂移（concept drift）和有限预算下，机器学习模型训练与部署的资源分配问题。作者提出一个模型无关的框架，刻画资源分配、概念持续时间动态与部署时机之间的交互，并在不同概念持续时间分布假设下推导最优训练策略。针对通信受限的模型部署，证明相应优化问题在温和条件下是拟凸的，并提出一种达到近似最优客户端性能的随机调度策略。
Motivation: 模型提供方将训练好的模型分发给多个客户端，客户端设备只能做本地推理而无法重新训练，因此维持模型性能的责任落在提供方。在概念漂移和预算受限的条件下，如何高效分配训练与部署资源缺乏系统性理解。
Method: 建立模型无关的分析框架，将资源分配、概念漂移动态和部署时机联合建模。利用概念持续时间的平均剩余寿命（Mean Residual Life）性质，在 Decreasing Mean Residual Life (DMRL) 分布下推导预算约束的最优训练策略，并分析 Increasing Mean Residual Life (IMRL) 情形下的启发式次优性。对部署问题，在通信约束下证明优化问题的拟凸性，并提出随机化调度策略。
Result: 摘要报告：概念持续时间的 aging 性质对最优训练策略有决定性影响；在 DMRL 分布下可推导预算约束的最优策略，而在 IMRL 下直觉式启发策略被证明是次优的；所提出的随机调度策略在客户端侧性能上达到近似最优。
Conclusion: 这些结果为概念漂移下成本高效的 ML 模型管理提供了理论与算法基础，对持续学习（continual learning）、分布式推理和自适应 ML 系统具有启示意义。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Provable Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Bayesian Inversion
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel diffusion-based posterior sampling method within a plug-and-play framework. Our approach constructs a probability transport from an easy-to-sample distribution to the target posterior via a diffusion process. To initialize the sampler efficiently, we introduce a warm-start strategy for the particles. The posterior score is then approximated using a Monte Carlo estimator in which samples are generated via Langevin dynamics, avoiding the heuristic approximations prevalent in prior work. The score function driving the Langevin dynamics is learned from data, enabling the model to capture rich structural features of the underlying prior. We also establish non-asymptotic error bounds in Wasserstein-2 distance guaranteeing convergence of the proposed method even for complex, multimodal posterior distributions. We corroborate our theoretical findings with numerical experiments demonstrating the effectiveness of the method across a variety of inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩散过程的贝叶斯反演后验采样方法，在 plug-and-play 框架下构造从易采样分布到目标后验的概率输运，并引入粒子 warm-start 策略。后验 score 通过基于 Langevin 动力学的 Monte Carlo 估计器近似，score 函数由数据学习得到。作者建立了 Wasserstein-2 距离下的非渐近误差界，并通过数值实验验证其在多种反问题上的有效性。
Motivation: 现有扩散后验采样工作常依赖启发式近似，缺乏严格的收敛保证；复杂多峰后验分布下的采样仍具挑战。本文旨在提供可证明收敛、且不依赖启发式近似的后验采样方法。
Method: 在 plug-and-play 框架下利用扩散过程构造概率输运，并用 warm-start 策略初始化粒子；后验 score 通过基于 Langevin 动力学生成样本的 Monte Carlo 估计器近似，且 score 函数从数据中学习以刻画先验的丰富结构。
Result: 建立了 Wasserstein-2 距离下的非渐近误差界，保证方法对复杂多峰后验分布的收敛；数值实验表明该方法在多种反问题中有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数据驱动 score 学习与理论误差界的结合，为贝叶斯反演中的后验采样提供可证明收敛的替代方案；摘要未提及具体应用领域（如天气或降水）。

papers.title: Spectral Joint Subspace Estimation for Heterogeneous Multi-View Data: Geometry and Reweighting
papers.abstract_en: Many modern datasets consist of multiple related matrices measured on a common set of units, with the goal of recovering a shared low-dimensional subspace. The Angle-based Joint and Individual Variation Explained (AJIVE) framework addresses this problem through equal-weight aggregation, which can be suboptimal when views exhibit statistical heterogeneity in signal-to-noise ratios and dimensions, as well as structural heterogeneity from individual components. For equal-weight AJIVE, we show that the previously identified ``non-diminishing'' error barrier is geometry dependent: under near-orthogonal deterministic loading orientations, the second-order term is reduced, whereas under sign-symmetric random loadings, it is centered and averages out, yielding a $K^{-1/2}$-type rate without iterative refinement. Under a majority sign-alignment condition in rank-one setting, a bias at the squared single-view perturbation scale can persist. For general weights, we establish error bounds that disentangle the two layers of heterogeneity, and propose HeteroJIVE, the weighted AJIVE estimator using an explicit weight that is optimal whenever its identifiability gap is constant. We also provide a data-driven plug-in implementation of HeteroJIVE, together with an optional geometry-adaptive extension of this data-driven procedure. Simulations and analyses of multi-omics and image data illustrate the practical benefits of HeteroJIVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多视图数据中共享低维子空间恢复问题，指出等权 AJIVE（Angle-based Joint and Individual Variation Explained）在视图信噪比、维度和个体成分结构存在异质性时并非最优。作者刻画了等权 AJIVE 中已知误差屏障的几何依赖性，并提出加权估计量 HeteroJIVE 及其数据驱动实现。模拟实验与多组学、图像数据分析展示了 HeteroJIVE 的实际优势。
Motivation: 现有 AJIVE 框架采用等权聚合，当视图在信噪比、维度以及个体成分结构上存在统计异质性时，等权策略会次优；此前识别的非消失误差屏障是否必然存在也尚未在几何层面厘清。
Method: 理论上建立了将两层异质性解耦的误差界，并提出 HeteroJIVE，即在可辨识间隙（identifiability gap）为常数时具有显式形式的最优权重加权 AJIVE 估计量；还给出数据驱动的插件式实现，以及可选的自适应几何扩展。
Result: 对等权 AJIVE 证明其误差屏障依赖几何：在近正交确定性载荷方向下二阶项被降低；在符号对称随机载荷下该项居中并平均掉，得到 K^{-1/2} 量级速率而无需迭代细化；在秩一设置的大多数符号对齐条件下，偏置可停留在单视图扰动平方量级。模拟与多组学、图像数据实验显示 HeteroJIVE 相比等权方案有实际收益。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式加权与几何自适应扩展能够缓解等权 AJIVE 在异质多视图中的次优性，但最优性依赖可辨识间隙为常数等条件，适用范围需结合数据特性判断。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 理论上建立了将两层异质性解耦的误差界，并提出 HeteroJIVE，即在可辨识间隙（identifiability gap）为常数时具有显式形式的最优权重加权 AJIVE 估计量；还给出数据驱动的插件式实现，以及可选的自适应几何扩展。
summary_sections.result: 对等权 AJIVE 证明其误差屏障依赖几何：在近正交确定性载荷方向下二阶项被降低；在符号对称随机载荷下该项居中并平均掉，得到 K^{-1/2} 量级速率而无需迭代细化；在秩一设置的大多数符号对齐条件下，偏置可停留在单视图扰动平方量级。模拟与多组学、图像数据实验显示 HeteroJIVE 相比等权方案有实际收益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为显式加权与几何自适应扩展能够缓解等权 AJIVE 在异质多视图中的次优性，但最优性依赖可辨识间隙为常数等条件，适用范围需结合数据特性判断。

papers.title: Embedded Universal Predictive Intelligence: a coherent framework for multi-agent learning
papers.abstract_en: The standard theory of model-free reinforcement learning assumes that the environment dynamics are stationary and that agents are decoupled from their environment, such that policies are treated as being separate from the world they inhabit. This leads to theoretical challenges in the multi-agent setting where the non-stationarity induced by the learning of other agents demands prospective learning based on prediction models. To accurately model other agents, an agent must account for the fact that those other agents are, in turn, forming beliefs about it to predict its future behavior, motivating agents to model themselves as part of the environment. Here, building upon foundational work on universal artificial intelligence (AIXI), we introduce a mathematical framework for prospective learning and embedded agency centered on self-prediction, where Bayesian RL agents predict both future perceptual inputs and their own actions, and must therefore resolve epistemic uncertainty about themselves as part of the universe they inhabit. We show that in multi-agent settings, self-prediction enables agents to reason about others running similar algorithms, leading to new game-theoretic solution concepts and novel forms of cooperation unattainable by classical decoupled agents. Moreover, we extend the theory of AIXI, and study universally intelligent embedded agents which start from a Solomonoff prior. We show that these idealized agents can form consistent mutual predictions and achieve infinite-order theory of mind, potentially setting a gold standard for embedded multi-agent learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在通用人工智能奠基工作 AIXI 的基础上，提出一个以自我预测 (self-prediction) 为核心的嵌入式主体 (embedded agency) 前瞻学习数学框架。该框架要求贝叶斯强化学习智能体同时预测未来感知输入和自身动作，从而把对自身的不确定性纳入对宇宙的建模。作者证明，在多智能体设定下，自我预测能让智能体推理其他运行类似算法的个体，产生经典解耦智能体无法获得的新博弈论解概念与合作形式。摘要还宣称该理论将 AIXI 推广到从 Solomonoff 先验出发的通用嵌入式智能体，可达无限阶心理理论 (infinite-order theory of mind)。
Motivation: 标准无模型强化学习理论假设环境动态是平稳的、智能体与环境解耦，这导致多智能体场景中由其他智能体学习引起的非平稳性难以处理。要准确建模其他智能体，必须考虑它们也在同时推断自己的行为，因此智能体需要把自身视为环境的一部分。
Method: 提出一个以自我预测为中心的贝叶斯智能体框架，智能体同时预测未来感知与自身动作，并解决关于自身的认知不确定性。作者将这一框架建立在 AIXI 理论上，并进一步研究从 Solomonoff 先验出发的通用智能体及其相互预测的一致性。
Result: 摘要报告，自我预测使多智能体能够推理其他运行类似算法的个体，进而产生经典解耦智能体无法实现的新合作形式；理想化的嵌入式智能体可以形成一致的相互预测并达到无限阶心理理论。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架可能为嵌入式多智能体学习树立一个黄金标准 (gold standard)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Priors in Bayesian Optimization for Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a widely used approach to hyperparameter optimization (HPO). However, most existing HPO methods only incorporate expert knowledge during initialization, limiting practitioners' ability to influence the optimization process as new insights emerge. This limits the applicability of BO in iterative machine learning development workflows. We propose DynaBO, a BO framework that enables continuous user control of the optimization process. Over time, DynaBO leverages provided user priors by augmenting the acquisition function with decaying, prior-weighted preferences while preserving asymptotic convergence guarantees. To enhance robustness, we introduce a surrogate-model-based safeguard that detects and, possibly, rejects misleading priors. We prove theoretical results on near-certain convergence, robustness to deceptive priors, and accelerated convergence when informative priors are provided. Extensive experiments across various HPO benchmarks show that DynaBO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art competitors across all benchmarks and for all prior kinds. Our results demonstrate that DynaBO enables reliable and efficient collaborative BO, bridging automated and manually controlled model development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaBO，一个允许用户在优化过程中持续提供先验的贝叶斯优化 (Bayesian optimization) 框架，用于超参数优化 (HPO)。它通过向采集函数中加入衰减的、先验加权的偏好来利用用户先验，同时保持渐近收敛保证，并引入基于代理模型的保护机制来检测和拒绝误导性先验。摘要报告在多个 HPO 基准上，DynaBO 在所有基准和所有先验类型上一致优于最先进的竞争对手。
Motivation: 现有 HPO 方法通常仅在初始化阶段纳入专家知识，限制了实践者在迭代式机器学习开发流程中随新见解出现而影响优化过程的能力，从而限制了 BO 在此类工作流中的适用性。
Method: DynaBO 随时间利用用户提供的先验，通过用衰减的、先验加权的偏好增强采集函数 (acquisition function)，同时保留渐近收敛保证；还引入一个基于代理模型的保护机制，用于检测并可能拒绝误导性先验。
Result: 摘要给出理论结果：近必然收敛 (near-certain convergence)、对欺骗性先验的鲁棒性，以及在提供信息性先验时加速收敛。实验上，在多种 HPO 基准上，DynaBO 在所有基准和所有先验种类上均一致优于最先进的竞争方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DynaBO 能够实现可靠且高效的协作式贝叶斯优化，弥合自动化与手动控制的模型开发之间的差距。

papers.title: Pay for The Second-Best Service: A Game-Theoretic Approach Against Dishonest LLM Providers
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) through Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) induces a critical vulnerability: the potential for dishonest manipulation by service providers. This manipulation can manifest in various forms, such as secretly substituting a proclaimed high-performance model with a low-cost alternative, or inflating responses with meaningless tokens to increase billing. This work tackles the issue through the lens of algorithmic game theory and mechanism design. We are the first to propose a formal economic model for a realistic user-provider ecosystem, where a user can iteratively delegate $T$ queries to multiple model providers, and providers can engage in a range of strategic behaviors. As our central contribution, we prove that for a continuous strategy space and any $ε\in(0,\frac12)$, there exists an approximate incentive-compatible mechanism with an additive approximation ratio of $O(T^{1-ε}\log T)$, and a guaranteed quasi-linear second-best user utility. We also prove an impossibility result, stating that no mechanism can guarantee an expected user utility that is asymptotically better than our mechanism. Furthermore, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our mechanism in simulation experiments with real-world API settings.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at WWW 2026; 12 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从算法博弈论与机制设计 (mechanism design) 的角度处理 LLM API 服务商的不诚实行为，如偷偷用低成本模型替换宣称的高性能模型，或注入无意义 token 以增加计费。作者首次提出一个形式化的用户-服务商经济模型，其中用户可迭代地向多个模型服务商委托 T 次查询，服务商可采取多种策略行为。核心结果是证明在连续策略空间下对任意 ε∈(0,1/2) 都存在一个近似激励相容机制，其可加近似比为 O(T^{1-ε}log T)，并保证拟线性次优用户效用，同时给出不可能性结果，并在真实 API 设置下用模拟实验展示机制有效性。
Motivation: LLM 通过 API 广泛部署导致用户面临服务商不诚实操纵的严重漏洞，包括模型替换和注入 token 增加计费；现有工作缺乏针对现实用户-服务商生态系统的形式化经济模型与激励相容机制。
Method: 以算法博弈论和机制设计为框架，建立用户可迭代委托 T 次查询给多个模型服务商的经济模型，考虑服务商的各类策略行为；在连续策略空间下构造近似激励相容机制，并分析其近似比与用户效用保证。
Result: 摘要报告：对任意 ε∈(0,1/2)，可达到 O(T^{1-ε}log T) 的加性近似比和拟线性次优用户效用；同时证明不存在任何机制能在期望用户效用上渐近优于该机制；在真实 API 设置下的模拟实验验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这是首次为不诚实 LLM 服务商问题提出形式化经济模型与可证明的激励相容机制，且该机制的效用保证在渐近意义下是最优的。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Novel XAI-Enhanced Quantum Adversarial Networks for Velocity Dispersion Modeling in MaNGA Galaxies
papers.abstract_en: Current quantum machine learning approaches often face challenges balancing predictive accuracy, robustness, and interpretability. To address this, we propose a novel quantum adversarial framework that integrates a hybrid quantum neural network (QNN) with classical deep learning layers, guided by an evaluator model with LIME-based interpretability, and extended through quantum GAN and self-supervised variants. In the proposed model, an adversarial evaluator concurrently guides the QNN by computing feedback loss, thereby optimizing both prediction accuracy and model explainability. Empirical evaluations show that the Vanilla model achieves RMSE = 0.27, MSE = 0.071, MAE = 0.21, and R^2 = 0.59, delivering the most consistent performance across regression metrics compared to adversarial counterparts. These results demonstrate the potential of combining quantum-inspired methods with classical architectures to develop lightweight, high-performance, and interpretable predictive models, advancing the applicability of QML beyond current limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合量子神经网络 (QNN) 与经典深度学习层的量子对抗框架，用于 MaNGA 星系的速度弥散建模。对抗评估器通过 LIME 可解释性计算反馈损失，同时优化预测准确性与可解释性；Vanilla 模型在回归指标上表现最稳定，RMSE=0.27、MSE=0.071、MAE=0.21、R²=0.59。
Motivation: 现有量子机器学习方法往往难以在预测精度、鲁棒性和可解释性之间取得平衡，本文旨在同时改进这三方面。
Method: 提出量子对抗框架，集成混合量子神经网络与经典深度学习层，由带 LIME 可解释性的评估器模型引导，并扩展出量子 GAN 和自监督变体；对抗评估器通过计算反馈损失同时指导 QNN 优化预测准确性与模型可解释性。
Result: 摘要报告 Vanilla 模型在回归指标上取得 RMSE=0.27、MSE=0.071、MAE=0.21、R²=0.59，性能比对抗变体更一致。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将量子启发方法与经典架构结合可以开发轻量、高性能且可解释的预测模型，从而扩展 QML 在当前限制之外的应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: In-situ Autoguidance: Eliciting Self-Correction in Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The generation of high-quality, diverse, and prompt-aligned images is a central goal in image-generating diffusion models. The popular classifier-free guidance (CFG) approach improves quality and alignment at the cost of reduced variation, creating an inherent entanglement of these effects. Recent work has successfully disentangled these properties by guiding a model with a separately trained, inferior counterpart; however, this solution introduces the considerable overhead of requiring an auxiliary model. We challenge this prerequisite by introducing In-situ Autoguidance, a method that elicits guidance from the model itself without any auxiliary components. Our approach dynamically generates an inferior prediction on the fly using a stochastic forward pass, reframing guidance as a form of inference-time self-correction. We demonstrate that this zero-cost approach is not only viable but also establishes a powerful new baseline for cost-efficient guidance, proving that the benefits of self-guidance can be achieved without external models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 In-situ Autoguidance，一种无需任何辅助模型即可从扩散模型自身提取 guidance 的方法。该方法在推理时通过随机前向传播动态生成一个次优预测，把 guidance 重新理解为推理时的自我修正。作者声称这种零成本方法可行，并能建立一种高效 guidance 的新 baseline。
Motivation: classifier-free guidance (CFG) 提升质量和 prompt 对齐，但以降低多样性为代价，且这些效应相互纠缠。近期工作用单独训练的劣质模型解耦质量与多样性，却引入了辅助模型的额外开销；本文挑战这一前提，试图消除对外部模型的需求。
Method: 在随机前向传播中动态生成 inferior prediction，使得 guidance 由模型自身产生，无需额外的训练或辅助组件；将 guidance 重构为一种 inference-time self-correction 形式。
Result: 摘要报告该方法不仅可行，而且为 cost-efficient guidance 建立了强有力的新 baseline，表明 self-guidance 的收益可以在没有外部模型的情况下实现。
Conclusion: 作者强调零成本的自引导可以替代依赖辅助模型的方案，支持从模型内部获得 guidance 的新范式。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 In-situ Autoguidance，一种无需任何辅助模型即可从扩散模型自身提取 guidance 的方法。该方法在推理时通过随机前向传播动态生成一个次优预测，把 guidance 重新理解为推理时的自我修正。作者声称这种零成本方法可行，并能建立一种高效 guidance 的新 baseline。

papers.title: Reinforced sequential Monte Carlo for amortised sampling
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a synergy of amortised and particle-based methods for sampling from distributions defined by unnormalised density functions. We state a connection between sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) and neural sequential samplers trained by maximum-entropy reinforcement learning (MaxEnt RL), wherein learnt sampling policies and value functions define proposal kernels and twist functions. Exploiting this connection, we introduce an off-policy RL training procedure for the sampler that uses samples from SMC -- using the learnt sampler as a proposal -- as a behaviour policy that better explores the target distribution. We describe techniques for stable joint training of proposals and twist functions and an adaptive weight tempering scheme to reduce training signal variance. Furthermore, building upon past attempts to use experience replay to guide the training of neural samplers, we derive a way to combine historical samples with annealed importance sampling weights within a replay buffer. On synthetic multi-modal targets (in both continuous and discrete spaces) and the Boltzmann distribution of alanine dipeptide conformations, we demonstrate improvements in approximating the true distribution as well as training stability compared to both amortised and Monte Carlo methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将摊销采样 (amortised sampling) 与粒子方法结合的采样框架，建立顺序蒙特卡洛 (SMC) 与最大熵强化学习 (MaxEnt RL) 训练的神经序列采样器之间的联系，并设计 off-policy RL 训练流程，用 SMC 样本作为行为策略以更好地探索目标分布。在连续与离散空间的合成多模态目标以及丙氨酸二肽构象的 Boltzmann 分布上，相比摊销采样和蒙特卡洛方法，该方法改进了分布逼近精度与训练稳定性。
Motivation: 从未归一化密度函数采样是贝叶斯推断与统计物理中的核心问题；现有摊销采样器训练不稳定且容易陷入单一模态，而粒子方法探索能力强但计算代价高。论文旨在通过结合两类方法各自的优势，提高对复杂目标分布的近似质量与训练鲁棒性。
Method: 作者先建立 SMC 与由最大熵强化学习训练的神经序列采样器之间的联系，将学习到的策略与价值函数分别解释为提案核 (proposal kernels) 与扭曲函数 (twist functions)。随后提出 off-policy RL 训练流程，将利用学习采样器作为提案得到的 SMC 样本用作行为策略，并引入稳定联合训练提案与扭曲函数的技术、自适应权重退火 (adaptive weight tempering)，以及结合退火重要性采样权重的经验回放 (replay buffer)。
Result: 在连续与离散空间的合成多模态目标以及丙氨酸二肽 (alanine dipeptide) 构象的 Boltzmann 分布上，实验表明该方法在逼近真实分布和训练稳定性方面均优于摊销采样方法及蒙特卡洛方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调摊销方法与粒子方法可以通过 SMC 与 MaxEnt RL 的等价联系有效协同，off-policy 训练与经验回放机制可提升神经采样器的性能；实验范围限定于合成多模态分布及小分子构象抽样。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Fisher Information, Training and Bias in Fourier Regression Models
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the growing interest in quantum machine learning, in particular quantum neural networks (QNNs), we study how recently introduced evaluation metrics based on the Fisher information matrix (FIM) are effective for predicting their training and prediction performance. We exploit the equivalence between a broad class of QNNs and Fourier models, and study the interplay between the \emph{effective dimension} and the \emph{bias} of a model towards a given task, investigating how these affect the model's training and performance. We show that for a model that is completely agnostic, or unbiased, towards the function to be learned, a higher effective dimension likely results in a better trainability and performance. On the other hand, for models that are biased towards the function to be learned a lower effective dimension is likely beneficial during training. To obtain these results, we derive an analytical expression of the FIM for Fourier models and identify the features controlling a model's effective dimension. This allows us to construct models with tunable effective dimension and bias, and to compare their training. We furthermore introduce a tensor network representation of the considered Fourier models, which could be a tool of independent interest for the analysis of QNN models. Overall, these findings provide an explicit example of the interplay between geometrical properties, model-task alignment and training, which are relevant for the broader machine learning community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）的评估指标能否有效预测量子神经网络（QNN）的训练与预测性能。作者利用 QNN 与傅里叶模型（Fourier models）的等价性，分析有效维度（effective dimension）与模型对任务的偏差（bias）如何影响训练和性能，并推导了傅里叶模型 FIM 的解析表达式。此外还引入一种张量网络表示，用于分析 QNN 模型。
Motivation: 量子机器学习尤其是 QNN 受到越来越多的关注，但缺乏能够可靠预测其训练和预测性能的指标；已有基于 FIM 的度量，但模型几何属性、模型-任务对齐与训练之间的相互作用仍不清楚。
Method: 利用广泛 QNN 与傅里叶模型之间的等价性，推导傅里叶模型的 FIM 解析表达式，识别控制有效维度的特征，并构造有效维度与偏差可调的模型来对比训练过程；同时给出所考虑傅里叶模型的张量网络表示。
Result: 对于对目标函数完全无偏（unbiased）的模型，较高的有效维度可能带来更好的可训练性和性能；而对于偏向目标函数的模型，较低的有效维度在训练中更可能有利。
Conclusion: 这些发现为几何性质、模型-任务对齐与训练之间的相互作用提供了一个显式例子，对更广泛的机器学习社区具有参考意义；张量网络表示可能作为分析 QNN 模型的独立工具。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Paris: A Decentralized Trained Open-Weight Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: We present Paris, the first publicly released diffusion model pre-trained entirely through decentralized computation. Paris demonstrates that high-quality text-to-image generation can be achieved without centrally coordinated infrastructure. Paris is open for research and commercial use. Paris required implementing our Distributed Diffusion Training framework from scratch. The model consists of 8 expert diffusion models (129M-605M parameters each) trained in complete isolation with no gradient, parameter, or intermediate activation synchronization. Rather than requiring synchronized gradient updates across thousands of GPUs, we partition data into semantically coherent clusters where each expert independently optimizes its subset while collectively approximating the full distribution. A lightweight transformer router dynamically selects appropriate experts at inference, achieving generation quality comparable to centrally coordinated baselines. Eliminating synchronization enables training on heterogeneous hardware without specialized interconnects. Empirical validation confirms that Paris's decentralized training maintains generation quality while removing the dedicated GPU cluster requirement for large-scale diffusion models. Paris achieves this using 14$\times$ less training data and 16$\times$ less compute than the prior decentralized baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Paris，据称是首个完全通过去中心化计算预训练并公开发布的扩散模型，面向文本到图像生成。模型由 8 个独立训练的专家扩散模型（每个 129M-605M 参数）组成，不进行梯度、参数或中间激活同步，而是将数据划分为语义聚类，由轻量 Transformer 路由器在推理时动态选择专家。摘要称其生成质量可与集中式训练基线相当，且比此前去中心化基线少用 14 倍训练数据和 16 倍计算量。
Motivation: 大规模扩散模型的预训练通常依赖集中式 GPU 集群和跨数千张 GPU 的同步梯度更新，这限制了异构硬件和缺乏专用互连的场景。本文旨在验证无需集中协调基础设施也能实现高质量文本到图像生成。
Method: 提出从零实现的分布式扩散训练框架（Distributed Diffusion Training framework）：将数据划分为语义上连贯的聚类，每个专家独立优化自己的子集，集体逼近完整数据分布；训练期间不共享梯度、参数或中间激活，仅在推理时由一个轻量 Transformer 路由器选择合适专家。
Result: 摘要报告 Paris 的去中心化训练在保持生成质量的同时，无需专用 GPU 集群；与先前的去中心化基线相比，训练数据减少 14 倍、计算量减少 16 倍，生成质量与集中式基线相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为这证明消除同步机制可以在异构硬件上不依赖专用互连训练扩散模型，去中心化预训练可作为大规模扩散模型集中式基础设施的可行替代方案。

papers.title: A Hamiltonian driven Geometric Construction of Neural Networks via the Lognormal family, Application to Financial Fraud Detection and to Network Security
papers.abstract_en: We presents a method for constructing neural networks intrinsically on statistical manifolds via the lognormal distribution. We demonstrate this approach by formulating a neural network architecture directly on statistical manifold. The construction is driven by the Hamiltonian system that is equivalent to the gradient flow on this manifold. We define the network's input values using the coordinate system of this Hamiltonian dynamics, naturally embedded in the Poincar$\acute{e}$ disk. The core of our contribution lies in the derivation of the network's components from geometric principles: the rotation component of the synaptic weight matrix is determined by the Lie group action of $SU(1,1)$ on the disk, while the activation function emerges from the symplectic structure of the system. We subsequently obtain the complete weight matrix, including its translation vector, and the resulting output values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在统计流形上、基于对数正态分布直接构造神经网络的几何方法。构造由与该流形上梯度流等价的哈密顿系统驱动，网络输入使用嵌入 Poincaré 圆盘的哈密顿动力学坐标定义；权重矩阵的旋转部分由 SU(1,1) 在圆盘上的李群作用决定，激活函数由辛结构导出，从而得到完整权重矩阵（含平移向量）与输出值。标题声称该方法可应用于金融欺诈检测和网络安全，但摘要未报告实验结果。
Motivation: 现有神经网络构造通常不显式利用数据所在的统计流形几何结构；本文目标是直接在统计流形上内在地构造网络，使网络组件从几何原理中推导出来。
Method: 通过对数正态分布在统计流形上直接构造神经网络，采用等价于该流形上梯度流的哈密顿系统驱动；网络输入取哈密顿动力学的坐标并嵌入 Poincaré 圆盘，旋转组件由 SU(1,1) 的李群作用确定，激活函数由系统的辛结构产生，随后求得包含平移向量的完整权重矩阵和输出值。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验、基准或对比结果，仅给出构造方法的理论描述。
Conclusion: 摘要强调网络各组件从几何原理（李群作用与辛结构）中自然涌现，并声称可得到完整的权重矩阵和输出值；标题提及金融欺诈检测与网络安全应用，但摘要未展开这些任务上的效果或验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fast Feature Field ($\text{F}^3$): A Predictive Representation of Events
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a mathematical argument and algorithms for building representations of data from event-based cameras, that we call Fast Feature Field ($\text{F}^3$). We learn this representation by predicting future events from past events and show that it preserves scene structure and motion information. $\text{F}^3$ exploits the sparsity of event data and is robust to noise and variations in event rates. It can be computed efficiently using ideas from multi-resolution hash encoding and deep sets - achieving 120 Hz at HD and 440 Hz at VGA resolutions. $\text{F}^3$ represents events within a contiguous spatiotemporal volume as a multi-channel image, enabling a range of downstream tasks. We obtain state-of-the-art performance on optical flow estimation, semantic segmentation, and monocular metric depth estimation, on data from three robotic platforms (a car, a quadruped robot and a flying platform), across different lighting conditions (daytime, nighttime), environments (indoors, outdoors, urban, as well as off-road) and dynamic vision sensors (resolutions and event rates). Our implementations can predict these tasks at 25-75 Hz at HD resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向事件相机数据的新型预测性表示 Fast Feature Field ($\text{F}^3$)，通过从过去事件预测未来事件来学习表示，并证明该表示保留场景结构与运动信息。$\text{F}^3$ 利用事件数据的稀疏性，结合多分辨率哈希编码 (multi-resolution hash encoding) 与 deep sets，可在 HD 分辨率下达到 120 Hz、VGA 分辨率下达到 440 Hz 的计算效率，并将连续时空体积内的事件表示为多通道图像。作者在光学流估计、语义分割和单目度量深度估计等下游任务上取得最先进性能，实验覆盖三种机器人平台、不同光照条件、环境与动态视觉传感器。
Motivation: 事件相机产生异步稀疏事件流，传统表示未能充分同时保留场景结构与运动信息，且需要高效且稳健的表示来支持多种下游任务。
Method: 提出 $\text{F}^3$ 表示，通过预测未来事件来学习事件数据的表征；采用多分辨率哈希编码和 deep sets 实现高效计算，将连续时空体积内的事件转化为多通道图像表示。
Result: 在光学流估计、语义分割和单目度量深度估计上取得最先进性能；实现能以 HD 分辨率 25-75 Hz 预测这些任务，表示本身在 HD 为 120 Hz、VGA 为 440 Hz 计算。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 $\text{F}^3$ 作为事件数据的预测性表示，兼具效率、鲁棒性和对多种下游任务的通用性，并已在多样化平台、环境和传感器条件下验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deformable Medical Image Registration with KAN-based Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Deformable image registration (DIR) is central to medical image analysis, supporting spatial alignment for longitudinal studies and multi-modal fusion. Learning-based methods such as CNNs and transformers provide rapid inference but often require large training datasets and can underperform classical iterative methods for specific anatomies or modalities. Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a data-efficient alternative by modeling deformation fields as continuous coordinate-to-displacement mappings, yet their per-pair optimization makes runtime efficiency and robustness to initialization essential. We introduce KAN-IDIR and RandKAN-IDIR, the first Kolmogorov--Arnold network (KAN)-based INR framework for pairwise-optimized, resolution-independent DIR, designed to improve seed stability and resource efficiency without dataset-level training. KANs use learnable activation functions that are well suited to continuous, physically structured deformation fields. RandKAN-IDIR further reduces cost through randomized basis sampling, preserving registration quality with fewer basis functions. We evaluate the methods on lung CT, brain MRI, and cardiac MRI datasets against pairwise INR approaches, dataset-trained deep models, and classical baselines. KAN-IDIR and RandKAN-IDIR achieve the highest accuracy among INR-based methods, with low computational overhead and superior stability across random initializations. RandKAN-IDIR slightly outperforms adaptive basis selection variants while avoiding their additional training-time complexity. This makes the approach practical for reproducible clinical research use. Source code is available at https://github.com/anac0der/KAN-IDIR.
papers.comment: Accepted at Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KAN-IDIR 与 RandKAN-IDIR，据称是首个基于 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络 (KAN) 的隐式神经表示 (INR) 框架，用于逐对优化、分辨率无关的可变形医学图像配准 (DIR)。方法在肺 CT、脑 MRI 与心脏 MRI 数据集上评估，无需数据集级训练，即可在 INR 类方法中取得最高精度，并具备低计算开销与跨随机初始化的稳定性。
Motivation: 基于 CNN 和 Transformer 的学习型配准方法推理快但常需大量训练数据，且在某些解剖结构或模态下可能不如经典迭代方法；INR 以连续坐标到位移映射建模提供数据高效替代，但其逐对优化对运行效率和初始化鲁棒性敏感。
Method: 提出 KAN-IDIR，用具有可学习激活函数的 KAN 建模连续且有物理结构的形变场；进一步提出 RandKAN-IDIR，通过随机基采样 (randomized basis sampling) 在更少基函数下保持配准质量、降低计算成本。两种方法均为逐对优化、不依赖数据集级训练。
Result: 在肺 CT、脑 MRI 和心脏 MRI 数据上，KAN-IDIR 与 RandKAN-IDIR 在 INR 类方法中取得最高精度，计算开销低且在不同随机初始化下稳定性更好；RandKAN-IDIR 略优于自适应基选择变体，同时避免了其额外的训练复杂度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法对可复现的临床研究具有实用性，并公开了源代码。

papers.title: Adaptive Policy Backbone via Shared Network
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved impressive results across domains, yet learning an optimal policy typically requires extensive interaction data, limiting practical deployment. A common remedy is to leverage priors, such as pre-collected datasets or reference policies, but their utility degrades under task mismatch between training and deployment. While prior work has sought to address this mismatch, it has largely been restricted to in-distribution settings. To address this challenge, we propose Adaptive Policy Backbone (APB), a meta-transfer RL method that inserts lightweight linear layers before and after a shared backbone, thereby enabling parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) while preserving prior knowledge during adaptation. Our results show that APB improves sample efficiency over standard RL and adapts to out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks where existing meta-RL baselines typically fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Adaptive Policy Backbone (APB)，一种元迁移强化学习方法，通过在共享骨干网络 (shared backbone) 前后插入轻量线性层，以参数高效微调 (PEFT) 的方式进行策略适应，同时保留前期学习到的先验知识。摘要报告 APB 相比标准 RL 提升了样本效率，并能在现有 meta-RL 基线通常失败的分布外 (OOD) 任务上完成适应。
Motivation: 强化学习通常需要大量交互数据才能学到最优策略，而利用预收集数据集或参考策略等先验知识时，训练与部署之间的任务不匹配会降低其效用；已有工作大多局限于分布内 (in-distribution) 设置。
Method: 提出 APB 方法，在共享骨干网络前后插入轻量线性层，使适应过程只需参数高效微调，从而在适应新任务时保留共享骨干所承载的先验知识。
Result: 实验显示 APB 在样本效率上优于标准 RL，并能在现有 meta-RL 基线通常失败的 OOD 任务上成功适应。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过共享网络结合参数高效微调的策略骨干能够有效应对 RL 中的任务不匹配问题，尤其是分布外适应场景。

papers.title: Shall We Play a Game? Language Models for Open-ended Wargames
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based social simulations can make a generated transcript look like a single behavioral signal, but the model behind that transcript may be doing several different jobs: choosing what an actor says or does, deciding what happens after an action, or both. The difference matters especially in open-ended wargames, where models are prized for handling unusual actions and ambiguous consequences. We report a scoping review of 223 de-duplicated AI-in-wargames and strategic-simulation papers retrieved through May 1, 2026, describing each simulation by its model-control profile: whether the language model has open-ended control over player actions, adjudication, or both. Only 20 of 223 studies (~9%) give language models both roles. Before treating LM outputs as social simulations, researchers need to know how much creative control the model has over actions and consequences. For open-ended simulations, fidelity depends not only on whether agents behave plausibly, but also on whether language models can reliably act as adjudicators or world models.
papers.comment: 49 pages (9-page body), 3 figures. Published at the Social Sim'26 Workshop at COLM 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对截至2026年5月1日检索到的223篇去重后的AI兵棋推演与战略模拟论文进行范围综述（scoping review），从模型控制档案（model-control profile）角度描述每个模拟：语言模型是否对玩家行动、判定（adjudication）或两者拥有开放式控制。结果显示仅约9%的研究（20/223）赋予语言模型双重角色，作者据此强调在将LM输出视为社会模拟之前，需明确模型对行动与后果的创造性控制程度。
Motivation: 基于LLM的社会模拟中，生成文本看似单一行为信号，但底层模型可能承担多个不同职责：选择角色言行、决定行动后果或两者兼有。这一区别在开放式兵棋中尤为关键，因为模型需处理非常规行动与模糊后果，而现有文献缺乏对这种控制配置的系统梳理。
Method: 作者对223篇去重论文进行范围综述，为每个模拟定义其模型控制档案：语言模型是否对玩家行动、判定或两者具有开放式控制，并据此分类统计。
Result: 在223项研究中仅有20项（约9%）让语言模型同时承担行动生成与后果判定两个角色，表明当前多数兵棋模拟并未充分利用LLM的开放式双重控制能力。
Conclusion: 研究者必须了解模型在行动和后果上拥有多少创造性控制权，才能恰当解释LM输出；开放式模拟的保真度不仅取决于智能体行为是否合理，还取决于语言模型能否可靠地充当判定器或世界模型（world model）。

papers.title: "Not in My Backyard": LLMs Uncover Online and Offline Social Biases Against Homelessness
papers.abstract_en: Homelessness is a persistent social challenge, impacting millions worldwide. Over 876,000 people experiencing homelessness (PEH) were recorded in the U.S. in 2025. Social bias is a significant barrier to alleviating homelessness, shaping public perception and influencing policymaking. Because online textual media and offline city council discourse both reflect and influence public opinion, they provide valuable signals for identifying and tracking social biases against PEH. We release the first multi-domain PEH bias corpus with a 16-category multi-label taxonomy: a 1,698-item stratified gold-standard set annotated by partner-trained raters, plus 48,389 GPT-4.1-labeled texts, drawn from Reddit, X (formerly Twitter), news, and council meeting transcripts across ten U.S. cities (2015-2025). We benchmark six prompted LLMs on the gold-standard set and complement F1 with prevalence-gap audits. Moderate F1 coexists with large miscalibration: every model over-tags "not in my backyard" (NIMBY) (+11.5 pp) and under-detects factual claims (-30.5 pp). Error analysis on consensus false positives reveals that models treat housing vocabulary and question form as opposition proxies, producing NIMBY false positives on pro-service text. The corpus and audit protocol support municipal PEH stigma monitoring without treating teacher labels as ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布首个跨领域（在线与离线）的“无家可归者（PEH）”偏见语料库，包含16类多标签体系：1,698条分层黄金标准（由合作方训练的标注员标注）和48,389条GPT-4.1标注文本，覆盖Reddit、X、新闻及十个美国城市的议会会议记录（2015-2025）。六个提示LLM在黄金标准上的F1中等，但存在严重校准偏差：所有模型均过度标记“不要在我后院”（NIMBY）（+11.5个百分点），并漏检事实性陈述（-30.5个百分点）。对一致误报的错误分析显示，模型将住房词汇和疑问句式视为反对的代理，从而对支持服务的文本产生NIMBY误报。
Motivation: 无家可归问题持续影响全球数百万人，社会偏见是缓解该问题的重要障碍，塑造公众认知并影响政策制定。在线文本媒体和线下市议会话语既反映又影响舆论，为识别和追踪针对PEH的社会偏见提供了有用信号，但此前缺少跨领域的偏见语料库。
Method: 构建第一个多领域PEH偏见语料库，采用16类多标签分类体系；由合作方训练的标注者标注1,698条分层黄金标准，另含48,389条GPT-4.1标注文本；在黄金标准上基准测试六个提示LLM，并用患病率差距审计（prevalence-gap audits）补充F1指标，同时进行错误分析。
Result: 摘要报告中等F1伴随较大校准误差：每个模型都过度标注NIMBY（+11.5个百分点）且漏检事实性声明（-30.5个百分点）；对一致误报的错误分析表明，模型把住房词汇和疑问形式当作反对的代理，导致对支持服务文本产生NIMBY误报。
Conclusion: 该语料库和审计协议支持城市层面的PEH污名监测，同时不把教师标签视为“黄金真理”（ground truth）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WaMo: Wavelet-Enhanced Multi-Frequency Trajectory Analysis for Fine-Grained Text-Motion Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Text-Motion Retrieval (TMR) aims to retrieve 3D motion sequences semantically relevant to text descriptions. However, matching 3D motions with text remains highly challenging, primarily due to the intricate structure of the human body and its spatiotemporal dynamics. Existing approaches often overlook these complexities, relying on general encoding methods that fail to distinguish different body parts and their dynamics, limiting precise semantic alignment. To address this, we propose WaMo, a novel wavelet-based multi-frequency feature extraction framework. It fully captures joint-specific and time-varying motion details at multiple resolutions for individual joint trajectories, extracting discriminative motion features to achieve fine-grained alignment with texts. WaMo has three key components: (1) Trajectory Wavelet Decomposition decomposes motion signals into frequency components that preserve both local kinematic details and global motion semantics. (2) Trajectory Wavelet Reconstruction uses learnable inverse wavelet transforms to reconstruct original joint trajectories from extracted features, ensuring the preservation of essential spatiotemporal information. (3) Disordered Motion Sequence Prediction reorders shuffled motion sequences to improve learning of inherent temporal coherence, enhancing motion-text alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate WaMo's superiority, achieving 17.0\% and 18.2\% relative improvements in $Rsum$ on HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets, respectively, outperforming existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Code is available at https://github.com/3DAgentWorld/WaMo/.

Method: WaMo 包含三个核心组件：轨迹小波分解 (Trajectory Wavelet Decomposition) 将运动信号分解为保留局部运动学细节与全局语义的频率成分；轨迹小波重建 (Trajectory Wavelet Reconstruction) 利用可学习逆小波变换重建原始关节轨迹以保留时空信息；乱序运动序列预测 (Disordered Motion Sequence Prediction) 通过重排打乱的运动序列来增强时序连贯性学习。

Conclusion: 摘要强调 WaMo 通过多分辨率关节轨迹分析实现了细粒度的文本-动作对齐，并已公开代码；摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: RePaCA: Leveraging Reasoning Large Language Models for Static Automated Patch Correctness Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Automated Program Repair (APR) seeks to automatically correct software bugs without requiring human intervention. However, existing tools tend to generate patches that satisfy test cases without fixing the underlying bug, those are known as overfitting patches. To address this issue, Automated Patch Correctness Assessment (APCA) attempts to identify overfitting patches generated by APR tools. It can be solved as a static approach, meaning that no additional information is needed beyond the original and fixed code snippets. Current static techniques often struggle with reliability, flexibility and transparency. To address these issues, we introduce RePaCA, a novel static APCA technique that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) specialized in thinking tasks. Our model is prompted with both buggy and fixed code snippets and guided to generate a Chain of Thought that analyses code differences, reasons about how the patch addresses the root cause, and ultimately provides a binary classification: correct or overfitting. To enhance these reasoning capabilities for the APCA task specifically, the LLM is finetuned using Reinforcement Learning with the Group Relative Policy Optimization algorithm. When evaluated on a standard Defects4J-derived test, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 83.1% accuracy and an 84.8% F1-score. Furthermore, our model demonstrates superior generalization capabilities when trained on different datasets, outperforming the leading technique. This reasoning capability also provides enhanced explainability for the patch assessment. These findings underscore the considerable promise of finetuned, reasoning LLMs to advance static APCA by enhancing accuracy, generalization, and explainability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RePaCA，一种基于推理型大型语言模型（LLM）的静态自动化补丁正确性评估（APCA）方法。该方法以缺陷代码与修复代码作为输入，提示模型生成思维链（Chain of Thought）来分析代码差异、推理补丁是否针对根本原因，并输出正确或过拟合的二元分类。模型通过 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 强化学习微调，在 Defects4J 衍生测试集上取得 83.1% 准确率和 84.8% F1-score，并展现出较强的泛化性与可解释性。
Motivation: 现有自动化程序修复（APR）工具常生成满足测试用例但未真正修复底层缺陷的过拟合补丁；静态 APCA 方法在可靠性、灵活性和透明性上存在不足。
Method: 提出 RePaCA，利用针对思考任务微调过的 LLM；提示模型同时接收错误和正确的代码片段，引导其生成思维链以分析代码差异、推理补丁如何解决根本原因，最终给出正确或过拟合的二元分类；并使用 GRPO 强化学习算法对 LLM 进行 APCA 任务特定的微调。
Result: 在 Defects4J 衍生的标准测试集上取得当时最优性能，准确率 83.1%，F1-score 84.8%；在不同数据集上训练时，模型展现出优于现有领先技术的泛化能力；推理能力提供了增强的可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者认为微调后的推理型 LLM 在提高静态 APCA 的准确性、泛化性和可解释性方面具有显著潜力。

papers.title: Towards White-Box Deep Wireless Sensing
papers.abstract_en: The empirical success of deep learning has spurred its application to the radio-frequency (RF) domain, leading to significant advances in Deep Wireless Sensing (DWS). However, most existing DWS models remain black boxes, with ad-hoc architectures and learned representations lacking explicit physical and mathematical grounding, which limits their reliability and generalizability in real-world deployments. We present RF-CRATE, an early step towards white-box DWS grounded in the complex sparse rate reduction principle. Using the CR-Calculus framework, we derive a fully complex-valued transformer with mathematically interpretable self-attention and residual modules. To address labeled data scarcity, we introduce subspace regularization to enhance representation diversity, yielding a 19.98% average improvement. We evaluate RF-CRATE across heterogeneous RF modalities and human sensing tasks, including activity, gait, and gesture recognition, pose estimation, and respiration monitoring. Experiments on five datasets show that RF-CRATE remains competitive with strong black-box models while providing mathematically interpretable architectures and representations. Moreover, the complex-valued design achieves a 3.39% gain in classification accuracy and a 10.34% reduction in regression error. Our results demonstrate that mathematically grounded models can achieve strong performance in wireless sensing, offering a promising step towards physically aligned white-box DWS systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RF-CRATE，一种基于复稀疏率缩减原理 (complex sparse rate reduction) 的白盒深度无线感知 (DWS) 模型。作者利用 CR-Calculus 框架推导出全复数值 Transformer，其自注意力和残差模块具有数学可解释性，并引入子空间正则化缓解标注数据稀缺。在五个数据集上的活动、步态、手势识别、姿态估计和呼吸监测等任务中，RF-CRATE 与强黑盒模型性能相当，同时提供了可解释的结构与表示。
Motivation: 现有 DWS 模型大多是黑盒，架构设计随意，学习到的表示缺乏物理和数学基础，限制了其在真实部署中的可靠性和泛化能力。
Method: 基于复稀疏率缩减原则，利用 CR-Calculus 推导出全复数值 Transformer 架构，使自注意力和残差模块具备数学可解释性；针对标签稀缺问题引入子空间正则化以增强表示多样性。
Result: 在异构 RF 模态和五种人体感知任务、五个数据集上的实验表明，RF-CRATE 与强黑盒模型保持竞争力；子空间正则化带来 19.98% 的平均提升，复数值设计在分类准确率上提高 3.39%，回归误差降低 10.34%。
Conclusion: 作者认为数学上有依据的模型能够在无线感知中取得强性能，是实现物理对齐的白盒 DWS 系统的有前景一步。

papers.title: ASVSim (AirSim for Surface Vehicles): A High-Fidelity Simulation Framework for Autonomous Surface Vehicle Research
papers.abstract_en: The transport industry has recently shown significant interest in unmanned surface vehicles (USVs), specifically for port and inland waterway transport. These systems can improve operational efficiency and safety, which is especially relevant in the European Union, where initiatives such as the Green Deal are driving a shift towards increased use of inland waterways. At the same time, a shortage of qualified personnel is accelerating the adoption of autonomous solutions. However, there is a notable lack of open-source, high-fidelity simulation frameworks and datasets for developing and evaluating such solutions. To address these challenges, we introduce AirSim for Surface Vehicles (ASVSim), an open-source simulation framework specifically designed for autonomous shipping research in inland and port environments. The framework combines simulated vessel dynamics with marine sensor simulation capabilities, including radar and camera systems and supports the generation of synthetic datasets for training computer vision models and reinforcement learning (RL) agents. Built upon Cosys-AirSim, ASVSim provides a comprehensive platform for developing autonomous navigation algorithms and generating synthetic datasets. The simulator supports research of both traditional control methods and deep learning-based approaches. Through experiments in waterway segmentation and autonomous navigation, we demonstrate the capabilities of the simulator in these research areas. ASVSim is provided as an open-source project under the MIT license, making autonomous navigation research accessible to a larger part of the ocean engineering community. See https://github.com/BavoLesy/ASVSim.
papers.comment: 18 Pages, 13 Figures. Accepted at IEEE ACCESS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ASVSim（AirSim for Surface Vehicles），一个基于 Cosys-AirSim 构建的开源高保真仿真框架，面向内河与港口环境中的自主水面船舶（USV）研究。框架将模拟船舶动力学与雷达、摄像头等船用传感器仿真相结合，支持为计算机视觉模型和强化学习（RL）智能体生成合成数据集，并通过水上分割与自主导航实验展示能力。项目以 MIT 许可证开源，代码位于 GitHub。
Motivation: 目前缺乏开源、高保真的仿真框架和数据集来开发和评估自主水面船舶方案，而欧盟绿色协议等倡议正推动内河航道应用，同时人员短缺加速了自主解决方案的采用。
Method: ASVSim 基于 Cosys-AirSim 构建，将模拟船舶动力学与船用传感器（雷达和摄像头）仿真结合，支持生成合成数据集以训练计算机视觉模型和强化学习智能体，同时覆盖传统控制方法与基于深度学习的方法。
Result: 摘要报告通过水上分割（waterway segmentation）和自主导航实验，展示了该仿真器在这两个研究领域中的能力，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者以 MIT 许可证开源 ASVSim，目标是让更大范围的海洋工程社区能够开展自主导航研究，并缓解自主航运研究中仿真资源和数据集匮乏的问题。

papers.title: Ultra-Short rPPG Estimation via Periodicity Guidance and Signal Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Many remote Heart Rate (HR) measurement methods focus on estimating remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) signals from video clips lasting around 10 seconds but often overlook the need for HR estimation from ultra-short video clips. In this paper, we aim to accurately measure HR from ultra-short 2-second video clips by specifically addressing two key challenges. First, to overcome the limited number of heartbeat cycles in ultra-short video clips, we propose an effective periodicity-guided rPPG estimation method that enforces consistent periodicity between rPPG signals estimated from ultra-short clips and their much longer ground truth signals. Next, to mitigate estimation inaccuracies due to spectral leakage, we propose including a generator to reconstruct longer rPPG signals from ultra-short ones while preserving their periodic consistency to enable more accurate HR measurement. Extensive experiments on four rPPG estimation benchmark datasets demonstrate that our proposed method not only accurately measures HR from ultra-short video clips but also outperform previous rPPG estimation techniques to achieve state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向超短 2 秒视频片段的远程心率 (HR) 估计问题，提出一种周期性引导的 rPPG 估计方法，并引入生成器将超短 rPPG 信号重建为更长信号以缓解频谱泄漏。摘要在四个 rPPG 基准数据集上报告了优于既有方法的准确率并达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有远程心率测量方法大多依赖约 10 秒的视频片段，忽视了从超短视频中估计 HR 的需求；超短视频中心跳周期数量有限，且频谱泄漏会导致估计误差。
Method: 提出周期性引导的 rPPG 估计方法，强制使超短视频片段估计出的 rPPG 信号与其较长的 ground truth 信号保持周期性一致；同时加入生成器，将超短 rPPG 信号重建为更长的 rPPG 信号，并在重建中保持周期性一致性以提升 HR 测量精度。
Result: 在四个 rPPG 估计基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法不仅能从超短视频片段准确测量 HR，还优于以往的 rPPG 估计技术，取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调周期性一致约束与信号长度重建相结合可有效支持超短 2 秒视频片段的 HR 测量，并宣称超越既有 rPPG 方法。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: StaQ: a Finite Memory Approach to Discrete Action Policy Mirror Descent
papers.abstract_en: In Reinforcement Learning (RL), regularization with a Kullback-Leibler divergence that penalizes large deviations between successive policies has emerged as a popular tool both in theory and practice. This family of algorithms, often referred to as Policy Mirror Descent (PMD), has the property of averaging out policy evaluation errors which are bound to occur when using function approximators. However, exact PMD has remained a mostly theoretical framework, as its closed-form solution involves the sum of all past Q-functions which is generally intractable. A common practical approximation of PMD is to follow the natural policy gradient or use actor-critic approaches, but this potentially introduces errors in the policy update. In this paper, we propose and analyze PMD-like algorithms for discrete action spaces that only keep the last $M$ Q-functions in memory. We show theoretically that for a finite and large enough $M$, an RL algorithm can be derived that introduces no errors from the policy update, yet keeps the desirable PMD property of averaging out policy evaluation errors. Using an efficient GPU implementation, we then show empirically on medium-scale RL benchmarks such as MinAtar that increasing $M$ improves performance up to a certain threshold after which the performance becomes close to that of exact PMD, reinforcing the theoretical findings that using an infinite sum might be unnecessary and that keeping in memory the last M Q-functions is a practical and theoretically grounded implementation of PMD.

papers.title: AniCrafter: Customizing Realistic Human-Centric Animation via Avatar-Background Conditioning in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion models have substantially enhanced character animation techniques. However, existing methods primarily depend on structural conditions, such as DWPose or SMPL-X, to animate character images, which limits their effectiveness in open-domain scenarios involving dynamic backgrounds or complex character-scene interactions. This study presents AniCrafter, a diffusion-based human-centric animation model designed to seamlessly integrate and animate a given character within open-domain dynamic backgrounds while adhering to specified human motion sequences. Built upon advanced Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion architectures, the model introduces an innovative "avatar-background" conditioning mechanism that reformulates open-domain human-centric animation as a restoration problem, thereby achieving versatile, occlusion-aware animation results. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms current state-of-the-art methods and exhibits an exceptional capability in handling challenging scenarios. Codes and model are available at: https://github.com/MyNiuuu/AniCrafter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AniCrafter，一种基于视频扩散模型 (video diffusion model) 的人类中心动画生成方法，能在开放域动态背景中无缝整合并驱动给定角色，同时遵循指定的动作序列。方法在 Image-to-Video (I2V) 扩散架构上引入“avatar-background”条件机制，将开放域人物动画重构为修复 (restoration) 问题。实验表明该方法在挑战性场景下优于当前 SOTA 方法，代码与模型已公开。
Motivation: 现有角色动画方法主要依赖 DWPose、SMPL-X 等结构条件来驱动角色图像，在涉及动态背景或复杂角色-场景交互的开放域场景中效果受限。
Method: 基于 I2V 扩散架构，提出“avatar-background”条件机制，将开放域人类中心动画形式化为一个修复问题，从而实现具有遮挡感知 (occlusion-aware) 能力的动画结果。
Result: 摘要报告实验评估显示该方法在开放域动态背景和复杂人景交互等挑战性场景中优于当前 SOTA 方法，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够将给定角色无缝地整合进动态背景并遵循指定人体动作序列，且代码和模型已开放。

papers.title: So-Fake: Benchmarking and Explaining Social Media Image Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in AI-powered generative models have enabled the creation of increasingly realistic synthetic images, posing significant risks to information integrity and public trust on social media platforms. While robust detection frameworks and diverse, large-scale datasets are essential to mitigate these risks, existing academic efforts remain limited in scope: current datasets lack the diversity, scale, and realism required for social media contexts, while detection methods struggle with generalization to unseen generative technologies. To bridge this gap, we introduce So-Fake-Set, a comprehensive social media-oriented dataset with over 2 million high-quality images, diverse generative sources, and photorealistic imagery synthesized using 35 state-of-the-art generative models. To rigorously evaluate cross-domain robustness, we establish a novel and large-scale (100K) out-of-domain benchmark (So-Fake-OOD) featuring synthetic imagery from commercial models explicitly excluded from the training distribution, creating a realistic testbed for evaluating real-world performance. Leveraging these resources, we present So-Fake-R1, an advanced vision-language framework that employs reinforcement learning for highly accurate forgery detection, precise localization, and explainable inference through interpretable visual rationales. Extensive experiments show that So-Fake-R1 outperforms the second-best method, with a 1.3% gain in detection accuracy and a 4.5% increase in localization IoU. By integrating a scalable dataset, a challenging OOD benchmark, and an advanced detection framework, this work establishes a new foundation for social media-centric forgery detection research. The code, models, and datasets will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向社交媒体场景的图像伪造检测，提出 So-Fake-Set 数据集（含超过 200 万张、由 35 个生成模型合成的图像）、So-Fake-OOD 基准（10 万张来自训练分布之外的商业模型图像）以及 So-Fake-R1 视觉语言检测框架。So-Fake-R1 采用强化学习进行伪造检测、定位和可解释推理，实验显示其检测准确率比次优方法高 1.3%，定位 IoU 高 4.5%。作者称相关工作将代码、模型和数据集公开。
Motivation: 现有数据集在规模、多样性和真实感上不足以反映社交媒体场景，且检测方法难以泛化到未见过的生成技术，这限制了 AI 生成图像伪造检测的实际部署。
Method: 构建社交媒体导向的大规模数据集 So-Fake-Set，并利用被排除在训练分布之外的商业模型生成 10 万张图像，建立跨域 OOD 基准 So-Fake-OOD；在此基础上提出 So-Fake-R1 视觉语言框架，通过强化学习实现准确的伪造检测、精确定位和基于可视化解释的推理。
Result: 广泛实验表明 So-Fake-R1 在检测准确率上较次优方法提升 1.3%，在定位 IoU 上提升 4.5%。
Conclusion: 该工作通过整合可扩展数据集、具有挑战性的 OOD 基准和先进检测框架，为社交媒体为中心的伪造检测研究建立新基础，并将公开代码、模型与数据集。
