papers.title: Artifact detection and localization in single-channel mobile EEG for sleep research using deep learning and attention mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Current methods for detecting artifacts in sleep EEG range from threshold-based algorithms to machine learning approaches, yet applications remain limited for single-channel mobile EEG. We propose a convolutional neural network (CNN) model incorporating a convolutional block attention module (CNN-CBAM) to detect and localize artifacts in sleep EEG using attention maps. We benchmarked this model against 6 other machine learning and signal processing approaches. We trained/tuned all models on 72 manually annotated EEG recordings obtained during home-based monitoring from 18 healthy participants with a mean (SD) age of 68.05 y ($\pm$5.02). We tested them on 26 separate recordings from 6 healthy participants with a mean (SD) age of 68.33 y ($\pm$4.08), which contained artifacts in 4\% of epochs. CNN-CBAM achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (0.88), sensitivity (0.81), and specificity (0.86) among the tested approaches. Under the ideal choice of an attention threshold of 0.66, the attention maps from CNN-CBAM localized artifacts within detected artifact epochs with a sensitivity of 0.61 and specificity of 0.63. This work demonstrates the feasibility of automating artifact detection and localization in wearable sleep EEG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单通道移动睡眠脑电（EEG）中的人工伪迹检测与定位问题，提出结合卷积块注意力模块（CNN-CBAM）的卷积神经网络，利用注意力图实现伪迹检测和定位。作者在72个手动标注的家庭监测睡眠脑电记录上训练/调参，并在26个独立记录（约4%的epoch含伪迹）上测试，将其与6种机器学习及信号处理方法对比。结果显示CNN-CBAM取得最高的AUC（0.88）、灵敏度（0.81）和特异性（0.86），并在最优注意力阈值0.66下实现伪迹定位的灵敏度0.61、特异性0.63。
Motivation: 现有睡眠脑电伪迹检测方法从阈值算法到机器学习均有局限，对单通道移动脑电的应用仍然有限；同时多数方法只做检测，缺乏定位能力。
Method: 提出一个基于卷积神经网络并集成卷积块注意力模块（CNN-CBAM）的模型，使用注意力图来同时检测和定位睡眠脑电中的伪迹，并与6种其他机器学习和信号处理方法进行基准比较。
Result: 在26个独立测试记录上，CNN-CBAM的AUC为0.88、灵敏度为0.81、特异性为0.86，均优于对比方法；在注意力阈值取0.66时，注意力图对已检测伪迹epoch的定位灵敏度为0.61、特异性为0.63。
Conclusion: 该工作证明了在可穿戴睡眠脑电中自动化实现伪迹检测与定位的可行性。

papers.title: Reproducing Human Individual Motor Signatures: A Data-Driven Approach for Repetitive Motion
papers.abstract_en: The deployment of autonomous virtual avatars (in extended reality) and robots in human group activities---such as rehabilitation therapy, sports, and manufacturing---is expected to increase as these technologies become more pervasive. Designing cognitive architectures and control strategies to drive these agents requires realistic models of human motion. Furthermore, recent research has shown that each person exhibits a unique velocity signature, highlighting how individual motor behaviors are both rich in variability and internally consistent. However, existing models only provide simplified descriptions of human motor behavior, hindering the development of effective cognitive architectures. In this work, we first show that motion amplitude provides a useful characterization of individual motor signatures, complementary to existing ones. Then, we propose a fully data-driven approach to generate original one-dimensional motion that captures the unique features of specific individuals, based on long short-term memory neural networks. We validate the architecture using real human data from participants performing spontaneous oscillatory motion. Thorough statistical analyses support that our model reproduces the velocity distribution and amplitude envelopes of the individual it was trained on, while remaining distinct from others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对虚拟化身与机器人在人类群体活动中需要真实人体运动模型的问题，提出一种完全数据驱动的、基于长短期记忆网络 (LSTM) 的方法，用以生成能捕捉特定个体运动特征的一维运动。作者先用真实参与者的自发振荡运动数据验证，结果表明运动幅度 (motion amplitude) 是对已有速度特征 (velocity signature) 的补充刻画。统计检验支持该模型能够再现被训练个体的速度分布与幅度包络，同时与其他人保持区分。
Motivation: 现有模型只能提供简化的人体运动行为描述，阻碍了面向康复、体育和制造等群体活动中自主智能体认知架构与控制策略的开发；同时已有研究显示每个人都有独特的速度特征，需要在模型中保持这种个体一致性。
Method: 首先论证运动幅度可作为个体运动签名 (motor signature) 的补充特征，然后提出基于 LSTM 神经网络的完全数据驱动框架，用于生成保留特定个体独有特征的一维运动序列。
Result: 使用参与者自发振荡运动的真实数据进行验证，充分的统计分析表明模型能重现被训练个体的速度分布和幅度包络，同时产生的运动与其他个体显著不同。
Conclusion: 摘要强调运动幅度是对现有速度特征的有效补充，且 LSTM 数据驱动方法能产生具有个体特异性的运动输出；其验证范围限于一维自发振荡运动。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dimensionality reduction for homological stability and global structure preservation
papers.abstract_en: We propose DiRe, a force-directed dimensionality reduction framework designed to preserve global structure and homological features while remaining practical on modern hardware. The method combines an initial embedding with a graph-based layout optimization and evaluates the resulting low-dimensional representation using local distortion, context preservation, and persistent homology measures. Across the benchmark suite considered here, DiRe provides a complementary tradeoff to UMAP and tSNE: it is designed less as a purely local visualization heuristic and more as a framework for embeddings whose large-scale geometry can be quantified through Betti curves and persistence diagrams.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables; Github repository available at https://github.com/sashakolpakov/dire-jax Reproducibility suite https://github.com/sashakolpakov/homological-stability-repro Package available on PyPi https://pypi.org/project/dire-jax/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiRe，一种基于力导向的降维框架，目标是在现代硬件上保持全局结构和同调特征 (homological features)。方法将初始嵌入与基于图的布局优化结合，并用局部失真、上下文保持和持续同调 (persistent homology) 指标评估低维表示。在基准测试中，DiRe 与 UMAP 和 tSNE 形成互补的权衡，更侧重于可量化的大尺度几何而非纯局部可视化。
Motivation: 现有降维方法如 UMAP 和 tSNE 偏向局部可视化启发式，难以量化嵌入的大规模几何结构；需要一个能保持全局结构与同调特征、且结果可通过 Betti 曲线和持续同调图评估的降维框架。
Method: 提出 DiRe 框架，将初始嵌入与基于图的力导向布局优化 (graph-based layout optimization) 相结合，并通过局部失真、上下文保持和持续同调指标来评价低维表示。
Result: 在基准数据集上，DiRe 提供了相对于 UMAP 和 tSNE 的互补权衡：它较少作为纯局部可视化工具，而更多用于生成可通过 Betti 曲线和持续同调图量化大尺度几何的嵌入。
Conclusion: 作者将 DiRe 定位为面向全局结构和同调特征保持的降维框架，并提供了 GitHub 可复现套件与 PyPI 包 (dire-jax)。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Combining Large Language Models and Symbolic Reasoning for Multi-Robot Temporal Planning through Explainable Knowledge Bases
papers.abstract_en: We present PLANTOR, a framework for generating and executing multi-robot task plans from natural-language task descriptions through LLM-assisted knowledge-base construction. The approach uses large language models to synthesize a structured Prolog knowledge-base, applies consistency checks to detect and repair modeling errors, generates a high-level symbolic plan, refines it into low-level robot actions, and computes a temporally optimized schedule that is converted into an executable behavior tree. The framework is designed to preserve inspectability by exposing the generated knowledge-base, intermediate plans, and scheduling constraints. We evaluate the approach on scenarios inspired by the Blocks World and Grippers benchmark across multiple language models, and we report both the quality of generated knowledge-bases and the runtime of the planning pipeline. We further demonstrate end-to-end execution in a real multi-arm assembly scenario. The results show that LLM-generated knowledge-bases can substantially reduce manual modeling effort, but may still require human correction. Overall, the paper argues for a hybrid workflow in which language models are used to produce structured symbolic artifacts, while correctness-critical planning and scheduling remain symbolic and inspectable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PLANTOR，一个从自然语言任务描述生成并执行多机器人任务计划的框架，核心是用大语言模型辅助构建结构化 Prolog 知识库，再经一致性检查、高层符号规划、低层动作细化、时序优化调度，最终转换为可执行行为树 (behavior tree)。作者在受 Blocks World 和 Grippers 启发的场景上评估了多种语言模型，并报告了生成知识库的质量与规划流水线运行时间，还展示了真实多臂装配场景的端到端执行。结果表明 LLM 生成的知识库可大幅减少手工建模工作量，但仍可能需要人工修正。
Motivation: 多机器人时序规划通常需要从自然语言任务描述进行大量手工建模，工作量大且易出错；论文希望在不牺牲规划与调度正确性的前提下，用 LLM 减少手工建模负担，同时保持系统的可检查性。
Method: 提出 PLANTOR 混合流程：LLM 将自然语言任务描述合成为结构化 Prolog 知识库，通过一致性检查检测并修复建模错误，生成高层符号规划，细化到低层机器人动作，并计算时序优化的调度，最终转为可执行行为树；框架通过暴露知识库、中间规划与调度约束来保持可检查性。
Result: 摘要报告了在 Blocks World 和 Grippers 相关场景上多种语言模型下生成知识库的质量与规划流水线运行时间，并在真实多臂装配场景中完成端到端执行；结果称 LLM 生成的知识库能显著减少手工建模工作量，但仍可能需要人工修正。
Conclusion: 论文主张一种混合工作流：用语言模型生成结构化符号制品，而正确性关键的规划与调度仍然保持符号化且可检查；其范围限于所评估的机器人规划场景，并明确承认 LLM 生成知识库仍可能需要人工校对。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dual-Force: Enhanced Offline Diversity Maximization under Imitation Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Offline diversity maximization under imitation constraints can transform demonstration data into a set of distinct behavioral policies, improving robustness to distribution shift without additional environment interaction. In practice, however, existing offline approaches often rely on mutual-information objectives that require training a skill discriminator and can become unstable under the non-stationary rewards induced by alternating Lagrangian optimization. We introduce Dual-Force, an offline algorithm that (i) maximizes diversity using an off-policy estimator of a Van der Waals (VdW) force objective computed from successor features, eliminating the skill discriminator, and (ii) stabilizes training under non-stationary intrinsic rewards by conditioning the value function and policy on a pre-trained Functional Reward Encoding (FRE). The FRE code also enables zero-shot recall of every encountered skill via its associated latent representation, removing the need to pre-specify a fixed number of skills. On two Solo12 simulation benchmarks (locomotion and obstacle navigation), Dual-Force recovers diverse high-performing behaviors while matching a target expert state occupancy and improves robustness in adversarial obstacle variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual-Force，一种离线强化学习算法，在模仿约束下最大化行为多样性。它用基于后继特征 (successor features) 的 Van der Waals (VdW) 力目标的无策略估计器替代互信息目标，从而去掉技能判别器，并通过预训练的 Functional Reward Encoding (FRE) 将价值函数与策略条件化，以稳定非平稳内在奖励下的训练。在 Solo12 仿真基准（运动与障碍导航）上，该方法恢复出多样且高性能的行为，同时匹配目标专家状态占用，并在对抗性障碍变化下提升鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有离线多样性最大化方法依赖互信息目标和技能判别器，在交替 Lagrangian 优化产生的非平稳奖励下容易训练不稳定。
Method: 提出 Dual-Force 算法：一方面用后继特征上的 Van der Waals 力目标的无策略估计器来最大化多样性，消除技能判别器；另一方面将价值函数和策略条件在预训练 Functional Reward Encoding 上，FRE 码还支持通过潜在表示零样本召回任意已遇到的技能，无需预先指定固定技能数量。
Result: 在 Solo12 的两个仿真基准（运动与障碍导航）上，Dual-Force 恢复出多样且高性能的行为，匹配目标专家状态占用，并在对抗性障碍变化下改善鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，消除技能判别器并稳定非平稳内在奖励下的训练能提升离线多样性学习效果，FRE 编码还免去了预设技能数量的需要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deepfake Media Generation and Detection in the Generative AI Era: A Survey and Outlook
papers.abstract_en: We survey deepfake generation and detection techniques, covering all deepfake media types: image, video, audio and multimodal content. We identify various kinds of deepfakes and construct taxonomies of deepfake generation and detection methods, illustrating the important groups of methods. Next, we gather datasets used for deepfake detection and provide updated rankings of the best performing detectors on the most popular datasets. In addition, we develop a novel multimodal benchmark to evaluate deepfake detectors on out-of-distribution content. The results indicate that state-of-the-art detectors fail to generalize to deepfakes generated by unseen generators. Our project page and new benchmark are available at https://github.com/CroitoruAlin/biodeep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是生成式 AI 时代下深度伪造 (deepfake) 生成与检测的综述，覆盖图像、视频、音频和多模态内容。作者构建了生成与检测方法的分类体系，汇总检测数据集并给出热门数据集上最优检测器的更新排名，同时还开发了一个新的多模态基准来评估检测器在分布外内容上的表现。结果表明，现有最先进的检测器无法泛化到未见生成器产生的深度伪造内容。
Motivation: 深度伪造技术在生成式 AI 推动下快速演变，覆盖多种媒体类型，而现有工作往往只聚焦单一模态或部分方法，缺乏系统性梳理与最新的检测性能对比，因此需要一份全面的综述和统一的评估基准。
Method: 以综述方式对深度伪造生成与检测方法进行分类学构建，识别重要的方法组；收集检测数据集并提供主流数据集上的检测器排名；此外构建一个新的多模态基准，专门测试检测器对分布外内容的泛化能力。
Result: 摘要报告了新基准上的评估结果：尽管现有检测器在各自评测数据集上表现良好，但面对未见过的生成器时无法有效泛化，检测性能显著下降。
Conclusion: 作者强调深度伪造检测需要更好应对生成器分布偏移，并公开了项目页面与新的基准 (biodeep) 供后续研究使用。本文定位为综述与基准贡献，而非提出新的检测算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contrastive Learning for Image Complexity Representation
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying and evaluating image complexity can be instrumental in enhancing the performance of various computer vision tasks. Supervised learning can effectively learn image complexity features from well-annotated datasets. However, creating such datasets requires expensive manual annotation costs. The models may learn human subjective biases from it. In this work, we introduce the MoCo v2 framework. We utilize contrastive learning to represent image complexity, named CLIC (Contrastive Learning for Image Complexity). We find that there are complexity differences between different local regions of an image, and propose Random Crop and Mix (RCM), which can produce positive samples consisting of multi-scale local crops. RCM can also expand the train set and increase data diversity without introducing additional data. We conduct extensive experiments with CLIC, comparing it with both unsupervised and supervised methods. The results demonstrate that the performance of CLIC is comparable to that of state-of-the-art supervised methods. In addition, we establish the pipelines that can apply CLIC to computer vision tasks to effectively improve their performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLIC（Contrastive Learning for Image Complexity），利用 MoCo v2 框架与对比学习（contrastive learning）来学习图像复杂度表征，避免监督学习中昂贵的人工标注成本与主观偏差。作者发现图像不同局部区域存在复杂度差异，并提出 Random Crop and Mix（RCM）来生成由多尺度局部裁剪构成的正样本，同时扩充训练集、增加数据多样性。实验表明 CLIC 的性能与最先进的监督方法相当，并建立了将 CLIC 应用于下游计算机视觉任务的流程。
Motivation: 监督学习可从标注良好的数据集有效学习图像复杂度特征，但构建此类数据集需要高昂的人工标注成本，且模型可能学到人类主观偏见。
Method: 引入 MoCo v2 框架，通过对比学习表示图像复杂度，并提出 Random Crop and Mix（RCM）方法，利用图像不同局部区域之间的复杂度差异生成包含多尺度局部裁剪的正样本，且不引入额外数据。
Result: 摘要报告 CLIC 与无监督和监督方法的大量对比实验，结果显示其性能与当前最先进的监督方法相当。
Conclusion: 作者还建立了将 CLIC 应用于计算机视觉任务的流程，以有效提升任务性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unified continuous-time q-learning for mean-field game and mean-field control problems
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies the continuous-time q-learning in mean-field jump-diffusion models in a setting where the environment simulator does not provide direct access to the population distribution. We propose the integrated q-function in decoupled form (decoupled Iq-function) and establish its martingale characterization, which provides a unified policy evaluation rule for both mean-field game (MFG) and mean-field control (MFC) problems. Moreover, we consider the learning procedure where population distribution is updated based on the representative agent's state values. Depending on the task to solve the MFG or MFC problem, we can employ the decoupled Iq-function differently to characterize the mean-field equilibrium policy or the mean-field optimal policy respectively. Based on these theoretical findings, we devise a unified parametric q-learning algorithm for both MFG and MFC problems by utilizing test policies and the averaged martingale orthogonality condition. In two applications within and beyond LQ framework, we illustrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our unified parametric q-learning algorithm for both MFG and MFC learning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间下的均值场跳扩散模型 (mean-field jump-diffusion) q-learning，并设定环境模拟器不直接提供群体分布。作者提出解耦形式的积分 q-函数 (decoupled Iq-function) 并建立其鞅刻画，从而为均值场博弈 (MFG) 和均值场控制 (MFC) 提供统一的策略评估规则，并进一步设计统一的参数化 q-learning 算法。摘要报告在 LQ 框架内外的两个应用中验证了该算法在两类学习任务上的有效性和效率。
Motivation: 在连续时间均值场模型中，环境模拟器通常无法直接给出群体分布，且 MFG 与 MFC 的策略评估与学习规则缺乏统一框架，阻碍了 q-learning 在两类问题上的通用应用。
Method: 提出解耦形式的积分 q-函数 (decoupled Iq-function)，建立其鞅刻画以统一 MFG 与 MFC 的策略评估；群体分布在学习过程中基于代表性智能体的状态值更新，并利用测试策略 (test policies) 与平均鞅正交条件 (averaged martingale orthogonality condition) 构造统一的参数化 q-learning 算法，分别刻画均值场均衡策略或均值场最优策略。
Result: 摘要未给出定量数值，仅在 LQ 框架内外的两个应用中说明所提统一参数化 q-learning 算法对 MFG 与 MFC 学习任务均有效且高效。
Conclusion: 作者认为解耦 Iq-函数的鞅刻画为 MFG 与 MFC 提供了统一的理论评估基础，并给出了可同时处理两类任务的参数化 q-learning 算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Expressive Power of Sparse Geometric MPNNs
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by applications in chemistry and other sciences, we study the expressive power of message-passing neural networks for geometric graphs, whose node features correspond to 3-dimensional positions. Recent work has shown that such models can separate generic pairs of non-isomorphic geometric graphs, though they may fail to separate some rare and complicated instances. However, these results assume a fully connected graph, where each node possesses complete knowledge of all other nodes. In contrast, often, in application, every node only possesses knowledge of a small number of nearest neighbors. This paper shows that generic pairs of non-isomorphic geometric graphs can be separated by message-passing networks with rotation equivariant features as long as the underlying graph is connected. When only invariant intermediate features are allowed, generic separation is guaranteed for generically globally rigid graphs. We introduce a simple architecture, EGENNET, which achieves our theoretical guarantees and compares favorably with alternative architecture on synthetic and chemical benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/yonatansverdlov/E-GenNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究几何图（节点特征为三维位置）上消息传递神经网络（MPNN）的表达能力，此前的工作表明这类模型能分离大多数非同构几何图，但依赖全连接图。作者证明在底层图连通且允许旋转等变特征时，通用非 isomorphic 几何图对仍可被分离；若只允许不变中间特征，则需要对一般性全局刚性的图才保证分离。论文还提出简单架构 EGENNET，在合成与化学基准上表现优于替代架构。
Motivation: 实际应用中每个节点通常只知道少量最近邻，而非全连接图；既有表达力结论建立在全连接假设上，不适用于稀疏图场景，因此需要研究稀疏连通几何图上 MPNN 的分离能力。
Method: 从理论上刻画稀疏几何图的可分离性条件：连通图加旋转等变中间特征可保证通用分离，仅含不变特征时要求图是 generically globally rigid。据此设计简单架构 EGENNET，并在合成与化学基准上与替代架构比较。
Result: 摘要报告：旋转等变特征的 MPNN 在底层图连通时可分离通用非 isomorphic 几何图对；仅用不变中间特征时，通用分离仅在 generically globally rigid 图上成立；EGENNET 在合成与化学基准上表现优于替代架构。
Conclusion: 论文的结论是稀疏连通结构足以保证大部分几何图的可分离性，并提供了可实现的架构 EGENNET；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Communication-Efficient Secure Aggregation in Decentralized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized learning (DL) enables participants to collaboratively train models without a central server, yet it faces significant scalability challenges that demand sparsification to reduce the prohibitive communication costs of peer-to-peer exchange. While secure aggregation effectively mitigates privacy risks in standard settings, it has remained fundamentally incompatible with sparsification in decentralized networks due to the mismatch of indices across local updates, forcing a trade-off between communication efficiency and privacy. This paper introduces CESAR, a novel protocol that resolves this incompatibility by integrating secure aggregation and sparsification to provide provable defense against honest-but-curious and colluding adversaries. By coordinating masks over parameter intersections, CESAR supports node dropouts and robust privacy without central aggregation. Empirical evaluations on models up to 124 million parameters demonstrate that CESAR matches the accuracy of non-private baselines while cutting total data exchange by 66.7 % compared to a standard full-parameter decentralized protocol (D-PSGD). With TopK sparsification on IID data, CESAR even exceeds by 0.3 % the accuracy achieved by D-PSGD with sparsification. Collectively, these results establish CESAR as the first decentralized protocol to achieve both privacy and communication efficiency through secure aggregation in DL.
papers.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at the 45th International Symposium on Reliable Distributed Systems (SRDS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CESAR，一个将安全聚合 (secure aggregation) 与稀疏化 (sparsification) 结合的去中心化学习协议，解决两者在去中心化网络中因局部更新索引不匹配而无法兼容的问题。协议通过对参数交集协调掩码，支持节点退出和针对诚实但好奇及合谋对手的隐私保证。在最多 1.24 亿参数的模型上，CESAR 匹配非隐私基线的精度，同时相比标准全参数去中心化协议 D-PSGD 将总数据交换量降低 66.7%。
Motivation: 去中心化学习 (DL) 因点对点通信成本高昂而需要稀疏化，但安全聚合与稀疏化在去中心化网络中因局部更新的索引不匹配而根本不相容，迫使在通信效率与隐私之间取舍。
Method: 引入 CESAR 协议，将安全聚合与稀疏化集成起来，通过协调参数交集上的掩码来提供针对诚实但好奇与合谋对手的可证明防御，并且在不依赖中心聚合的情况下支持节点退出和鲁棒隐私。
Result: 在多达 1.24 亿参数的模型上，CESAR 达到与非隐私基线相当的精度，相比全参数去中心化协议 D-PSGD 将总数据交换量削减 66.7%；在 IID 数据上使用 TopK 稀疏化时，其精度甚至比带稀疏化的 D-PSGD 高出 0.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要将 CESAR 定位为首个通过去中心化学习中的安全聚合同时实现隐私与通信效率的去中心化协议，消除了此前通信效率与隐私之间的强制取舍。

papers.title: Nonparametric Partial Disentanglement via Mechanism Sparsity: Sparse Actions, Interventions and Sparse Temporal Dependencies
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a novel principle for disentanglement we call mechanism sparsity regularization, which applies when the latent factors of interest depend sparsely on observed auxiliary variables and/or past latent factors. We propose a representation learning method that induces disentanglement by simultaneously learning the latent factors and the sparse causal graphical model that explains them. We develop a nonparametric identifiability theory that formalizes this principle and shows that the latent factors can be recovered by regularizing the learned causal graph to be sparse, under some assumptions such as the absence of instantaneous causal effects between latent factors. More precisely, we show identifiability up to a novel equivalence relation we call consistency, which allows some latent factors to remain entangled (hence the term partial disentanglement). To describe the structure of this entanglement, we introduce the notions of entanglement graphs and graph preserving functions. We further provide a graphical criterion which guarantees complete disentanglement, that is identifiability up to permutations and element-wise transformations. We demonstrate the scope of the mechanism sparsity principle as well as the assumptions it relies on with several worked out examples. For instance, the framework shows how one can leverage multi-node interventions with unknown targets on the latent factors to disentangle them. We further draw connections between our nonparametric results and the now popular exponential family assumption. Lastly, we propose an estimation procedure based on variational autoencoders and a sparsity constraint and demonstrate it on various synthetic datasets. This work is meant to be a significantly extended version of a work published at CLeaR 2022.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的解耦表示学习原则——机制稀疏正则化 (mechanism sparsity regularization)，适用于潜在因子稀疏依赖观测辅助变量和/或历史潜在因子的场景。方法同时学习潜在因子与解释它们的稀疏因果图，并发展非参数可辨识性理论，证明在无瞬时因果效应等假设下，正则化因果图稀疏即可恢复潜在因子，但只能辨识到新定义的"一致性" (consistency) 等价关系，允许多个潜在因子保持纠缠，故为部分解耦。文章还提出基于 VAE 与稀疏约束的估计流程，并在多个合成数据集上演示。
Motivation: 现有解耦表示学习的可辨识性往往依赖较强的分布或参数化假设；本文针对潜在因子对辅助变量或过去潜在因子具有稀疏依赖这一结构，提出机制稀疏正则化作为新的解耦原则，并在非参数设定下刻画潜在因子何时、以何种程度可被恢复。
Method: 提出联合学习潜在因子与解释它们的稀疏因果图的方法；发展非参数可辨识理论，引入"一致性"等价关系，并定义纠缠图 (entanglement graphs) 与保图函数 (graph preserving functions) 来描述残余纠缠的结构。进一步给出保证完全解耦（即置换与逐元素变换意义下的可辨识性）的图准则，并提出基于变分自编码器加稀疏约束的估计流程。
Result: 理论结果表明，在无潜在因子间瞬时因果效应等假设下，对学习到的因果图施加稀疏正则化即可恢复潜在因子（至多到 consistency 等价类）。文章通过多个实例说明该原则可利用潜在因子上目标未知的多节点干预来实现解耦，并用合成数据集验证了所提估计流程。
Conclusion: 作者将此工作定位为 CLeaR 2022 论文的显著扩展版本，强调机制稀疏原则的适用范围及其所依赖的假设，并将非参数可辨识结果与流行的指数族假设建立联系；摘要未报告真实世界数据集上的实验。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Information Processing by Neuron Populations in the Central Nervous System: A Theory of the Mathematical Structure of Data and Operations
papers.abstract_en: In the mammalian central nervous system, neurons are organized into populations communicating by spike trains propagating along axonal bundles. How such populations encode and transform information is only partially understood. In this study we introduce a mathematical framework derived from a mechanistic model of a single plastic neuron. Within this framework, an algebra of convex cones can rigorously characterize population-level activity. This algebra provides a natural language describing information representation and processing. Neuron populations are thereby interpreted not as passive transmitters but as operators acting within this algebraic structure. When interconnected, such populations realize compact algebraic expressions whose functional repertoire includes specialization, generalization, novelty detection, dimensionality reduction, inverse modeling, prediction, and associative memory. Finally, the approach highlights the role of matrix embeddings in extending representational capacity beyond that afforded by vector-based models. In particular, such embeddings support hierarchical concept formation and structured information processing, with potential implications for both cognitive neuroscience and artificial intelligence. This paper assumes familiarity with elementary functional analysis and algebras of operators.
papers.comment: 60 pages, 12 figures. Major revision. The neuron model is shown to perform online projected-gradient optimization for NNLS. New results connect neuron-local learning to conic projection and rejection through sparse, activity-selected mappings, strengthen the cone algebra with Moreau-based proofs, and characterize approximate invariance under sparse embeddings. Adds a sensorimotor application
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于单个可塑神经元机制模型的数学框架，用凸锥代数（algebra of convex cones）刻画哺乳动物中枢神经系统中神经元群体的编码与信息变换。作者将神经元群体解释为该代数结构上的算子，认为互联群体可以实现特化、泛化、新奇检测、降维、逆建模、预测和联想记忆等紧凑代数表达式。大修版本进一步证明该神经元模型执行非负最小二乘（NNLS）的在线投影梯度优化，并通过稀疏、活动选择映射将神经元局部学习与锥投影/拒绝联系起来，同时用 Moreau 方法加强锥代数证明并刻画稀疏嵌入下的近似不变性。
Motivation: 神经元群体如何通过轴突束上的脉冲序列来编码和变换信息仍只是部分被理解，缺乏一种能够严格刻画群体层面活动的数学语言。
Method: 从单个可塑神经元的机制模型出发推导出群体层面的凸锥代数框架，将神经元群体视为该代数结构中的算子，并引入矩阵嵌入（matrix embeddings）以扩展超越向量模型的表征能力。
Result: 摘要未报告数值实验，主要贡献是理论框架本身：该代数语言能统一描述多种神经计算功能；更新版本还补充了神经元模型与 NNLS 在线投影梯度优化的等价性、锥投影与拒绝机制、基于 Moreau 的证明以及稀疏嵌入下的近似不变性，并给出一个感觉运动应用。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为认知神经科学和人工智能中的层级概念形成与结构化信息处理提供了潜在启示，并假设读者熟悉泛函分析与算子代数的基础知识。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个基于单个可塑神经元机制模型的数学框架，用凸锥代数（algebra of convex cones）刻画哺乳动物中枢神经系统中神经元群体的编码与信息变换。作者将神经元群体解释为该代数结构上的算子，认为互联群体可以实现特化、泛化、新奇检测、降维、逆建模、预测和联想记忆等紧凑代数表达式。大修版本进一步证明该神经元模型执行非负最小二乘（NNLS）的在线投影梯度优化，并通过稀疏、活动选择映射将神经元局部学习与锥投影/拒绝联系起来，同时用 Moreau 方法加强锥代数证明并刻画稀疏嵌入下的近似不变性。
summary_sections.motivation: 神经元群体如何通过轴突束上的脉冲序列来编码和变换信息仍只是部分被理解，缺乏一种能够严格刻画群体层面活动的数学语言。
summary_sections.method: 从单个可塑神经元的机制模型出发推导出群体层面的凸锥代数框架，将神经元群体视为该代数结构中的算子，并引入矩阵嵌入（matrix embeddings）以扩展超越向量模型的表征能力。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该框架为认知神经科学和人工智能中的层级概念形成与结构化信息处理提供了潜在启示，并假设读者熟悉泛函分析与算子代数的基础知识。

papers.title: Beyond Black-Box Advice: Learning-Augmented Algorithms for MDPs with Q-Value Predictions
papers.abstract_en: We study the tradeoff between consistency and robustness in the context of a single-trajectory time-varying Markov Decision Process (MDP) with untrusted machine-learned advice. Our work departs from the typical approach of treating advice as coming from black-box sources by instead considering a setting where additional information about how the advice is generated is available. We prove a first-of-its-kind consistency and robustness tradeoff given Q-value advice under a general MDP model that includes both continuous and discrete state/action spaces. Our results highlight that utilizing Q-value advice enables dynamic pursuit of the better of machine-learned advice and a robust baseline, thus result in near-optimal performance guarantees, which provably improves what can be obtained solely with black-box advice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带不可信机器学习建议的单轨迹时变马尔可夫决策过程 (MDP) 中一致性与鲁棒性的权衡，与通常将建议视为黑盒的做法不同，考虑建议生成方式有额外信息可用的场景。作者在包含连续/离散状态动作空间的一般 MDP 模型下，首次给出基于 Q 值建议 (Q-value advice) 的一致性-鲁棒性权衡，并证明利用 Q 值建议可动态追求机器学习建议与鲁棒基线中较好者，获得近最优性能保证。
Motivation: 现有研究通常把机器学习建议当作黑盒处理，忽略了建议生成过程的额外信息。本文认为利用这类信息（如 Q 值）可以在单轨迹时变 MDP 中实现更好的一致性与鲁棒性权衡。
Method: 将建议建模为基于 Q 值的预测而非黑盒输出，在一般 MDP（含连续与离散状态/动作空间）下分析一致性与鲁棒性的权衡，提出动态选择学习建议与鲁棒基线中较好者的策略。
Result: 证明了一致性与鲁棒性权衡的首个结果，表明利用 Q 值建议能获得近最优性能保证，并严格优于仅用黑盒建议可达到的结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，当可获得关于建议生成的额外信息时，MDP 中学习增强算法可以超越黑盒建议的性能上限。

papers.title: POSSE-kNN: Pathwise Out-of-Bag Selected Subspace Ensembles for Binary Classification
papers.abstract_en: Nearest neighbour classification is attractive for tabular data, but its performance can deteriorate when a fixed query centred neighbourhood does not follow the local class geometry. This study evaluates POSSE-$k$NN, a pathwise $k$ nearest neighbour ensemble that combines bootstrap sampling, random feature subspaces, out-of-bag (OOB) screening, and selective voting. Within each randomized candidate, pathwise selection first chooses the training observation nearest to the query and then chooses each subsequent neighbour relative to the observation accepted at the preceding step. After the candidate is fully specified, its OOB error is computed. Five hundred candidates are generated, ranked by OOB error, and the best 25% are retained. The method is evaluated on ten binary benchmark datasets using repeated 70/30 train/test partitions and six established comparators. Across the dataset level means, POSSE-kNN attains an accuracy of 0.740, Cohen's kappa of 0.412, and a Brier score of 0.175, giving the best aggregate result for all three criteria. It has the highest unrounded mean accuracy and kappa on eight datasets; RkNN and SVM lead on the other two. A neighbourhood size analysis on three datasets shows stable behaviour for k={3, 5, 7} when the path geometry is informative and identifies a case in which alternative neighbourhood rules are preferable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 POSSE-kNN，一种结合自助采样、随机特征子空间、out-of-bag (OOB) 筛选和选择性投票的路径式 (pathwise) k 最近邻集成方法，用于表格数据的二分类任务。在十个二分类基准数据集上以重复 70/30 训练/测试划分评估，并与六个已有方法比较；POSSE-kNN 在准确率、Cohen's kappa 和 Brier score 三项平均指标上均取得最优。
Motivation: 以固定查询点为中心的邻近区域可能不符合局部类别几何结构，导致最近邻分类性能下降；该方法旨在通过路径式邻居选择与集成来缓解这一问题。
Method: 在每个随机化候选中，路径式选择先选出距离查询最近的训练样本，再相对于上一步接受的样本依次选择后续邻居；共生成 500 个候选，按 OOB 误差排序并保留最优的 25% 进行投票，同时结合自助采样 (bootstrap sampling) 与随机特征子空间 (random feature subspaces)。
Result: 在十个二分类基准数据集上，POSSE-kNN 的均值准确率为 0.740、Cohen's kappa 为 0.412、Brier score 为 0.175，三项聚合指标均为最佳；它在八个数据集上取得最高的未四舍五入平均准确率和 kappa，其余两个数据集上由 RkNN 和 SVM 领先。针对三个数据集的邻域大小分析显示，在路径几何信息充分时 k={3, 5, 7} 表现稳定，并识别出某些情况下更宜采用其他邻域规则。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该路径式集成策略在表格二分类上具有竞争力，并提示路径几何并非总是适用，存在需要替代邻域规则的情形。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SATViz: Real-Time Visualization of Clausal Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Visual layouts of graphs representing SAT instances can highlight the community structure of SAT instances. The community structure of SAT instances has been associated with both instance hardness and known clause quality heuristics. Our tool SATViz visualizes CNF formulas using the variable interaction graph and a force-directed layout algorithm. With SATViz, clause proofs can be animated to continuously highlight variables that occur in a moving window of recently learned clauses. If needed, SATViz can also create new layouts of the variable interaction graph with the adjusted edge weights. In this paper, we describe the structure and feature set of SATViz. We also present some interesting visualizations created with SATViz.
papers.comment: Presented at Pragmatics of SAT Workshop (no proceedings)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SATViz 是一个用于可视化 SAT 实例中 CNF 公式的工具，基于变量交互图 (variable interaction graph) 和力导向布局算法 (force-directed layout)。该工具可以将子句证明 (clausal proofs) 制作成动画，连续高亮最近学习子句滑动窗口中出现的变量，并能在需要时以调整后的边权重重新生成变量交互图布局。论文描述了 SATViz 的结构、功能集，并展示了一些由该工具生成的示例可视化。
Motivation: SAT 实例的图可视化布局能够突出其社区结构 (community structure)，而社区结构已被认为与实例难度和已知子句质量启发式相关；该工具旨在帮助研究人员直观地观察这些结构。
Method: SATViz 使用变量交互图来表示 CNF 公式，采用力导向布局算法进行可视化；通过动画形式展示子句证明，持续高亮滑动窗口内最近学习子句中出现的变量，并支持基于调整后的边权重重建布局。
Result: 论文介绍了 SATViz 的结构与功能集，并呈现了若干使用该工具生成的有趣可视化结果，但摘要中未报告定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 该工具为 SAT 实例的社区结构和子句证明过程提供了实时可视化能力，主要面向 SAT 求解领域的研究人员；摘要未明确讨论其局限或与其他可视化工具的对比。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Tensor Data Scattering and the Impossibility of Slicing Theorem
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a standard way to represent sparse tensors. A broad theoretical framework for tensor data scattering methods used in various deep learning frameworks is established. This paper presents a theorem that is very important for performance analysis and accelerator optimization for implementing data scattering. The theorem shows how the impossibility of slicing happens in tensor data scattering. A sparsity measuring formula is provided, which can effectively indicate the storage efficiency of sparse tensor and the possibility of parallelly using it. A Python reference implementation is provided as ancillary material with this arXiv submission.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种表示稀疏张量的标准方式，并为深度学习框架中常用的张量数据散射方法建立了统一的理论框架。核心贡献是一个关于数据散射中切片不可能性 (impossibility of slicing) 的定理，对性能分析和加速器优化有重要意义；同时给出了一个稀疏度量公式，用于指示稀疏张量的存储效率和并行使用可能性。论文还随 arXiv 提交提供了 Python 参考实现。
Motivation: 深度学习框架中稀疏张量的数据散射实现缺乏统一的理论基础，切片不可能性对性能分析和加速器优化构成关键障碍，现有表示方式不够标准化。
Method: 提出一种标准的稀疏张量表示方法，建立覆盖数据散射的通用理论框架，并证明了一个解释切片不可能性如何发生的定理；同时推导出一个稀疏度测量公式。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，主要结果是理论层面的定理和稀疏度量公式，并给出了 Python 参考实现。
Conclusion: 该定理可用于指导数据散射的性能分析与加速器优化，稀疏度量公式能够有效指示存储效率与并行潜力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TORUS: A Test of Rendering-Understanding Self-Coherence for Unified Audio Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified audio models capable of audio understanding, audio generation and, increasingly, audio editing are proliferating rapidly. Yet a basic question about them remains unanswered: do the two heads of a unified model agree about the same audio? Current practice evaluates each capability in isolation on specialized benchmarks, and never asks whether a model can make sense of its own generations. We present TORUS, the first self-coherence test for audio-native unified models. TORUS comprises 48 three-stage self-coherence tests carrying 432 six-option questions spanning speech, sound and music across five task families. We holistically evaluate five open unified models alongside a Cascaded Baseline that combines state-of-the-art specialized generation, editing and understanding models. The best unified model answers 50.5% of questions against the Cascaded Baseline's 63.2% and a 16.7% chance floor. Models struggle on audio editing. Among the evaluated audio models (specialized and unified), we observe limited self-coherence, and thus position self-coherence as an essential test for future audio systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TORUS，首个面向音频原生统一模型（audio-native unified models）的自一致性测试，用于检验统一模型的理解头与生成头是否对同一音频达成一致。TORUS 包含 48 个三阶段自一致性测试、432 道六选一问题，覆盖语音、声音和音乐的五类任务族；在五个开放统一模型和一个级联基线（Cascaded Baseline）上的评估显示，最佳统一模型答对 50.5%，低于级联基线的 63.2%，而随机猜测基线为 16.7%。
Motivation: 现有统一音频模型同时具备理解、生成乃至编辑能力，但评测通常按能力分别在专用基准上进行，从未检验模型能否理解自己生成的音频；这种理解与生成两个头之间的不一致是一个尚未回答的基本问题。
Method: 构建 TORUS 自一致性测试套件，设计 48 个三阶段测试与 432 道六选一问题，覆盖语音、声音和音乐五个任务族；将五个开放统一模型与结合专用生成、编辑和理解模型的级联基线进行整体评估。
Result: 摘要报告最佳统一模型在问题上的正确率为 50.5%，级联基线为 63.2%，随机猜测下限为 16.7%；模型在音频编辑任务上表现困难，且所有受评音频模型（专用与统一）都表现出有限的自一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为自一致性应成为未来音频系统的关键测试维度；当前开放统一模型尚未展现出足够的自一致性，特别是编辑能力存在明显短板。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 TORUS，首个面向音频原生统一模型（audio-native unified models）的自一致性测试，用于检验统一模型的理解头与生成头是否对同一音频达成一致。TORUS 包含 48 个三阶段自一致性测试、432 道六选一问题，覆盖语音、声音和音乐的五类任务族；在五个开放统一模型和一个级联基线（Cascaded Baseline）上的评估显示，最佳统一模型答对 50.5%，低于级联基线的 63.2%，而随机猜测基线为 16.7%。

summary_sections.method: 构建 TORUS 自一致性测试套件，设计 48 个三阶段测试与 432 道六选一问题，覆盖语音、声音和音乐五个任务族；将五个开放统一模型与结合专用生成、编辑和理解模型的级联基线进行整体评估。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告最佳统一模型在问题上的正确率为 50.5%，级联基线为 63.2%，随机猜测下限为 16.7%；模型在音频编辑任务上表现困难，且所有受评音频模型（专用与统一）都表现出有限的自一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为自一致性应成为未来音频系统的关键测试维度；当前开放统一模型尚未展现出足够的自一致性，特别是编辑能力存在明显短板。

papers.title: Identifying Informative Environments for Cognition Parameter Inference via Bayesian Experimental Design
papers.abstract_en: Computational cognitive modeling seeks to infer latent cognitive mechanisms underlying observed behavior. Bayesian inverse planning provides a principled framework for such inference, but its success depends critically on the experimental environment. Existing approaches typically treat environments as fixed, leaving open the question of which cognitive experiments are most informative for cognition parameter inference. We formulate the design of cognitive planning experiments as a Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) problem, treating the experimental environment as the design variable. We establish an exact Monte Carlo BED benchmark and introduce an amortized Bayesian experimental design framework for efficient posterior inference and design evaluation. Experiments on the Mouselab-MDP process-tracing paradigm show that amortized BED closely matches the environment rankings of exact Monte Carlo BED while substantially reducing computational cost. We further show that no single environment is uniformly optimal across cognitive inference objectives, revealing trade-offs between expected information gain, posterior recoverability, and information efficiency. These results provide a principled framework for designing informative cognitive experiments for Bayesian parameter inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将认知规划实验的设计问题形式化为贝叶斯实验设计 (Bayesian Experimental Design, BED)，把实验环境本身当作设计变量，用于推断隐藏的认知参数。作者建立了精确蒙特卡洛 BED 基准，并提出摊销式 (amortized) BED 框架以高效进行后验推断与设计评估。在 Mouselab-MDP 过程追踪范式上的实验显示，摊销 BED 与精确蒙特卡洛 BED 的环境排序高度一致，同时显著降低计算成本；并且没有单一环境对所有认知推断目标都最优。
Motivation: 计算认知建模依赖贝叶斯逆规划推断潜在认知机制，但现有方法通常把实验环境视为固定，未回答哪些认知实验对参数推断最具信息量的问题。
Method: 提出将认知规划实验设计建模为 BED 问题，以实验环境为设计变量；构建精确蒙特卡洛 BED 基准，并引入摊销式贝叶斯实验设计来实现高效的后验推断与设计评估。
Result: 在 Mouselab-MDP 过程追踪范式上，摊销 BED 的环境排序与精确蒙特卡洛 BED 接近，而计算成本大幅降低；实验还显示期望信息增益、后验可恢复性 (posterior recoverability) 与信息效率之间存在权衡，不存在对所有认知推断目标都一致最优的单一环境。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为设计用于贝叶斯参数推断的信息性认知实验提供了原则性框架。

papers.title: Agreement Is Not Quality: Blind Expert Verification of Human and LLM Qualitative Coding When Human Consensus Is Not Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of LLM-assisted qualitative coding almost universally measure model performance as agreement with human coders, a practice that presumes human coding is the standard to approximate. This study provides empirical evidence that the presumption fails in ways agreement metrics cannot detect. Five LLM systems and three trained human coders independently applied a 72-item hierarchical codebook to 2,560 educator messages from a K-12 AI platform. Beyond conventional agreement analysis, an independent domain expert judged 855 pairwise comparisons of code sets blind to source, treating human and machine sources symmetrically. The two evaluation approaches diverge in both directions. Human-LLM agreement (mean Jaccard 0.30) falls well below human-human agreement (0.52), which standard practice would read as inferior LLM coding, yet the blind verifier preferred human and LLM coding at indistinguishable rates (51.5% vs. 48.5%, p = 0.537), and a Bradley-Terry ranking placed two LLMs above two of three human coders. For several substantive codes, human consensus encoded shared bias that the verifier rejected in favor of the LLM interpretation. Agreement-based evaluation is therefore insufficient for automation decisions, and the study demonstrates a transferable verification protocol and a code-level division-of-labor framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 辅助定性编码 (qualitative coding) 的评估方式，指出以与人类编码者的一致性作为模型性能标准的前提可能失效。五套 LLM 系统与三名受过训练的人类编码者独立使用 72 项分层编码表对 K-12 AI 平台的 2560 条教师消息进行编码；除常规一致性分析外，独立领域专家对 855 个成对编码集进行盲审。结果显示人机一致性 (平均 Jaccard 0.30) 低于人人一致性 (0.52)，但盲审专家对人机编码的偏好率无显著差异 (51.5% 对 48.5%，p = 0.537)，且 Bradley-Terry 排名中两套 LLM 胜过三名人类编码者中的两名；部分实质编码中人类共识编码了共享偏差，而专家更认可 LLM 的解释。
Motivation: LLM 辅助定性编码的评估几乎普遍用与人类编码者的一致性来衡量模型性能，这预设人类编码是应逼近的标准。作者认为该前提可能在一致性指标无法察觉的方式下失效，需要实证检验。
Method: 作者让五个 LLM 系统和三个训练过的人类编码者独立应用 72 项分层编码表编码 2560 条教师消息；在常规一致性分析之外，由独立领域专家对 855 个成对编码集进行盲审，将人类与机器来源对称对待，并辅以 Bradley-Terry 排名。
Result: 摘要报告人机一致性 (平均 Jaccard 0.30) 远低于人人一致性 (0.52)，但盲审专家对人类与 LLM 编码的偏好率无显著差异 (51.5% 对 48.5%，p = 0.537)；Bradley-Terry 排名将两套 LLM 排在三名人类编码者中的两名之上，且对若干实质性编码，盲审拒绝了人类共识并认可 LLM 的解释。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于一致性的评估不足以支持自动化决策，并提出了一种可迁移的盲审验证协议以及编码级别的分工框架 (division-of-labor framework)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Human-LLM Collaborative Inductive Coding for Conceptualizing K-12 Educator AI Use
papers.abstract_en: Qualitative researchers increasingly encounter interaction corpora whose scale exceeds what manual coding alone can address, and large language models (LLMs) are frequently proposed as analytic assistants. The open questions are not whether LLMs can participate in qualitative analysis but to what extent, in what phases, and under what safeguards. This article provides a detailed procedural account of a multi-phase human-LLM collaborative pipeline that adapted open, axial, and selective coding to develop a hierarchical codebook from 45,000 messages exchanged between K-12 educators and a generative AI platform. Across three phases, LLMs generated candidate labels and structured annotations at scale, while human researchers retained conceptual authority over category definitions, merging decisions, and interpretive frameworks. The resulting instrument was then tested through systematic human coding, in which three trained coders with educational domain expertise applied the codebook to an independent sample of 2,560 messages, established reliability through iterative calibration using set-valued agreement measures appropriate for multi-label annotation, and extended the instrument with five codes that the LLM-assisted phases had not surfaced. The final codebook comprises 72 items within 19 categories and six domains. We reflect on the methodological decisions the pipeline required, including the choice of a conversational unit of analysis, the treatment of the LLM as a labeling instrument rather than an interpretive agent, the measurement of intercoder agreement under multi-label coding, and the conditions under which human domain expertise remained decisive. The account is offered as an auditable template for qualitative researchers considering LLM assistance in codebook development while preserving human interpretive authority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多阶段人机协作的归纳编码流程，将开放编码、轴心编码与选择性编码适配到 LLM 辅助的定性分析中，用于从 K-12 教师与生成式 AI 平台的 45,000 条消息中构建层级化编码本。LLM 负责规模化生成候选标签和结构化标注，人类研究者保留类别定义、合并决策与解释框架的权威。最终编码本经三位领域专家人工编码 2,560 条独立样本验证，扩展出 5 个新编码，共含 19 个类别、72 个条目和 6 个域。
Motivation: 定性研究面临交互语料规模超出纯人工编码能力的问题，LLM 常被提议作为分析助手，但学界尚不清楚其在哪些阶段、以何种程度、在何种保障下参与分析。
Method: 提出多阶段人-LLM 协作流水线，用 LLM 生成候选标签与结构化标注，人类研究者掌控类别定义、合并决策和解释框架；随后通过三位领域专家对独立样本进行系统人工编码，并使用适用于多标签标注的集值一致性度量进行迭代校准。
Result: LLM 辅助阶段未覆盖的编码中，人工编码扩展出 5 个新编码；最终编码本包含 72 个条目、19 个类别和 6 个域，并报告了基于 2,560 条消息的信度建立过程。
Conclusion: 文章以可审计模板的形式呈现，强调在编码本开发中保留人类解释权威，并讨论了对话分析单元选择、LLM 作为标注工具而非解释代理、多标签编码下的一致性测量等方法论决策。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: To Add Is Machine, To Delete Is Human: Measuring and Mitigating Deletion Avoidance in LLM Code Editing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly write and repair production code, yet evidence is mounting that their test-passing patches leave codebases harder to maintain. We identify one concrete source: deletion avoidance, the systematic tendency to retain code that an intended edit requires removing. Across the five leading models on the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard, deletion recall against the developer patch reaches at most 71.7% even on tasks all five solve, and models reach the right file for over 92% of required deletions but cut the exact line in under 52% of cases. Instead, 29.0% of passing patches wrap the targeted code in a guard or fallback, a pattern we call Guard-and-Go. Such patches pass because the original tests rarely check removal: when we retrofit 34 Verified tasks with tests that fail if the targeted code remains, four frontier models spanning closed and open weights fall from 63.2% to 41.9%. Because real repairs mix removal with addition, we curate CanItDelete, a benchmark of 200 tasks mined from real commits whose entire required edit is deletion. Even with the addition work gone, the best model still fails one task in five, and smaller open models fall to 18.0%. We then ablate GPT-5.6 Sol under four cumulative prompts; success moves little until we supply the exact lines, which nearly eliminate incomplete deletion yet raise success only to 80.5% because the model then deletes beyond the spans or adds code instead. Finally, through a pilot study we show one potential fix: teaching deletion during post-training reduces deletion avoidance and improves broader code-editing performance, suggesting the behavior is undertrained rather than beyond reach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并量化大语言模型在代码编辑中的“删除回避”(deletion avoidance)现象，即模型系统性地倾向于保留本应删除的代码。基于 SWE-bench Verified 榜单上五款领先模型的分析显示，删除召回率最高仅 71.7%，且大量通过测试的补丁采用 Guard-and-Go 模式（包裹或回退目标代码）而实际未删除。作者构造 CanItDelete 基准并通过后训练 (post-training) 干预的试点研究初步表明，该行为可被缓解。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成的测试通过补丁可能让代码库更难维护，作者定位到一个具体来源——删除回避；原始测试很少验证“代码是否被删除”，因此模型可以通过测试却未完成必要的删除操作。
Method: 作者首先测量五款领先模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上的删除表现，并将 34 个任务改造为“目标代码残留即失败”的测试；随后从真实提交中挖掘并构建 CanItDelete 基准（200 个纯删除任务）；最后对 GPT-5.6 Sol 进行四种累积提示的消融，并通过后训练中教授删除的试点研究检验缓解效果。
Result: 删除召回率最高仅 71.7%，模型在超过 92% 的必要删除中找到正确文件，但精确删除具体行的比例低于 52%；29.0% 的通过补丁采用 Guard-and-Go。改造测试后，四个前沿模型（闭源与开源）从 63.2% 降至 41.9%。CanItDelete 上最佳模型仍失败五分之一任务，较小开放模型降至 18.0%；提供精确待删行几乎消除不完整删除，但成功率仅升至 80.5%，因为模型转向过度删除或添加代码。
Conclusion: 作者认为删除回避普遍存在于 LLM 代码编辑中，且更接近“训练不足”而非“不可及”，因为后训练中教授删除能减少删除回避并改善更广泛的代码编辑性能；这一结论来自试点研究，属于初步证据。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 删除召回率最高仅 71.7%，模型在超过 92% 的必要删除中找到正确文件，但精确删除具体行的比例低于 52%；29.0% 的通过补丁采用 Guard-and-Go。改造测试后，四个前沿模型（闭源与开源）从 63.2% 降至 41.9%。CanItDelete 上最佳模型仍失败五分之一任务，较小开放模型降至 18.0%；提供精确待删行几乎消除不完整删除，但成功率仅升至 80.5%，因为模型转向过度删除或添加代码。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为删除回避普遍存在于 LLM 代码编辑中，且更接近“训练不足”而非“不可及”，因为后训练中教授删除能减少删除回避并改善更广泛的代码编辑性能；这一结论来自试点研究，属于初步证据。

papers.title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
papers.abstract_en: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $η$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $η$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. Our results highlight the danger of overoptimization and motivate AI designs that limit optimization pressure, such as quantilizers, rather than relying solely on pre-deployment training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个对齐问题模型：智能体先经历理想化的对齐训练，保证其值函数在优化世界之前满足某个代理条件（proxy condition），随后再对世界进行优化。主要结果刻画了在何种人类价值函数形式和代理条件准确度下，会部署一个 η-灾难性（η-catastrophic）值函数的智能体——即该智能体在优化能力极限下必然把人类价值的期望推到 η 以下。作者借此强调过度优化的危险，并主张采用限制优化压力的 AI 设计（如 quantilizers），而非仅依赖部署前的训练。
Motivation: AI 安全领域普遍担忧人类价值是脆弱的：对不完美代理指标过度优化可能带来灾难性后果。论文针对这一担忧，试图从理论上刻画在何种条件下这种灾难性失败会发生，从而为部署决策提供依据。
Method: 提出一个形式化的对齐问题模型，其中智能体经历理想化的对齐训练以保证其值函数满足某种代理条件，然后才进行世界优化。作者分析人类价值函数的结构以及多种代理条件的准确度，推导出会导致 η-灾难性值函数被部署的充分条件。
Result: 主要结果给出了对人类价值函数与代理条件准确度的条件，在这些条件下，一个保证在优化极限下将人类价值期望降至 η 以下的智能体会被部署。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 结论强调过度优化的危险性，并指出应设计限制优化压力的 AI 系统（如 quantilizers），而不能只依赖部署前的对齐训练。

papers.title: LayoutBench: Performance Benchmarking of Cloud Storage Layouts for Multimedia Data
papers.abstract_en: Modern multimedia machine learning workloads increasingly store large-scale datasets in cloud object storage services such as AWS S3. How these samples are physically organized in storage (i.e.,storage layout) directly affects how quickly and cheaply they can be retrieved. Yet the benchmarks used to guide storage decisions today focus on database engines and query processing, and none systematically evaluates how different storage layouts perform for multimedia data retrieval. We present LayoutBench, the first benchmark designed to fill this gap. It evaluates three representative layout strategies: storing each sample as an individual object (L1), sequentially packing samples into tar archives (L2), and organizing samples as columns in Parquet files (L3). We measure retrieval time, data transferred, and monetary cost using 11 queries of varying result-set sizes on ImageNet across six AWS EC2 instance configurations that span different network bandwidth and memory tiers. Our experiments reveal that L2 achieves lower latency than L1 and L3 through connection reuse, but loses this advantage as retrieval sizes become very large. L3 is the fastest for very large retrievals but transfers substantially more data across all query sizes due to row-group granularity, and requires significantly more memory. Across all layouts, data transfer cost dominates total expenditure, with L3 costing an order of magnitude more than L1 or L2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LayoutBench，据称是第一个针对多媒体数据云存储布局的基准。它在 AWS S3 上用 ImageNet 和 11 个不同结果集大小的查询，跨 6 种 EC2 实例配置测量三种布局的检索时间、传输数据量和货币成本：单对象存储 (L1)、tar 打包 (L2)、Parquet 列式 (L3)。实验显示 L2 通过连接复用获得更低延迟，但超大检索时优势消失；L3 在超大检索时最快但传输数据显著更多且内存需求更高；所有布局中数据传输成本主导总成本，L3 成本比 L1/L2 高约一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有用于指导存储决策的基准聚焦于数据库引擎和查询处理，没有系统评估不同存储布局对多媒体数据检索的性能与成本影响。
Method: 提出 LayoutBench 基准，定义三种代表性布局策略（单个对象、tar 归档、Parquet 列式），并在 AWS S3 上对 ImageNet 执行 11 个查询，覆盖 6 种不同网络带宽和内存档位的 EC2 实例配置，测量检索时间、传输数据量和货币成本。
Result: L2 通过连接复用实现比 L1 和 L3 更低的延迟，但在检索规模很大时失去该优势；L3 在最大规模检索下最快，但因行组粒度在所有查询规模下传输显著更多数据，并需要明显更多内存；数据传输成本在所有布局中占主导，L3 的总成本比 L1、L2 高约一个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调存储布局对多媒体数据检索的延迟和成本有显著影响，并认为需要专门针对此类负载的基准来指导云存储决策。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RareSense: Rarity-Aware Similarity Search for Anomaly Retrieval in Transactional Data
papers.abstract_en: Similarity search over sparse set-valued data is often dominated by frequent background attributes because classical measures such as Jaccard, cosine, and Hamming compare objects through atomic overlap. IDF (Inverse document frequency) weighting partially reduces this effect but remains atom-wise and cannot explicitly represent informative higher-order co-occurrences. We introduce RareSense, a rarity-aware similarity framework for sparse transactional anomaly data. RareSense mines minimal rare itemsets as intermediate structures, derives reliable rare association rules, maps objects into sparse rare-rule profiles, and compares them using weighted Jaccard similarity. Rule weights combine inverse support, confidence, lift, structural complexity, and stability, so that neighborhoods are determined by shared rare evidence rather than uniform feature overlap. We show that IDF-weighted Jaccard is a restricted singleton case of RareSense, and that the induced distance is a pseudometric on the original objects and a metric over equivalence classes defined by identical rule profiles. Experiments across four benchmark families spanning cybersecurity and general categorical domains show that RareSense attains the highest observed macro-average query-conditioned retrieval performance among the evaluated similarity measures. The statistical analysis indicates significant overall differences, with corrected paired comparisons favoring RareSense over the atomic baselines. The gains remain workload-dependent and are strongest when anomalies share repeatable rare higher-order structure. For global anomaly ranking, RareSense achieves the highest observed macro-average performance while remaining statistically comparable to several strong dedicated detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RareSense，一种面向稀疏事务型异常数据的稀有性感知相似度检索框架。它通过挖掘最小稀有项集 (minimal rare itemsets) 作为中间结构，推导稀有关联规则 (rare association rules)，把对象映射为稀疏的稀有规则 profile，并用加权 Jaccard 相似度比较。摘要报告在四个基准族上其检索性能优于原子式相似度基线。
Motivation: 在稀疏集合值数据上，Jaccard、cosine、Hamming 等经典度量往往被频繁背景属性主导，IDF 加权虽能部分缓解，但仍是逐原子 (atom-wise) 的，无法显式表达有信息量的高阶共现结构。
Method: RareSense 先挖掘最小稀有项集，再从中推导可靠的稀有关联规则，将每个对象表示成稀疏的稀有规则 profile，最后用加权 Jaccard 比较；规则权重综合了逆支持度、置信度、lift、结构复杂度和稳定性，使邻域由共享的稀有证据决定。
Result: 在覆盖网络安全和一般类别型数据的四个基准族上，RareSense 取得最高的宏观平均 query-conditioned 检索性能，统计分析显示与原子基线存在显著差异且修正配对比较偏向 RareSense。在全局异常排序任务中它也取得最高的宏观平均性能，并与多个强专用检测器统计可比。
Conclusion: 作者证明 IDF 加权 Jaccard 是 RareSense 的受限单例情形，且 RareSense 诱导的距离在原对象上是伪度量 (pseudometric)、在规则 profile 相同的等价类上是度量。收益与工作负载相关，在异常共享可重复稀有高阶结构时最强。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Open-Source LLM-Driven Formal Verification: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for RTL Repair
papers.abstract_en: Verification consumes the majority of modern chip design effort, yet the formal verification tools that provide mathematical guarantees of correctness remain expensive and restrictively licensed. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for hardware design, existing approaches to RTL repair validate their results through simulation - which exercises only a subset of inputs - or rely on commercial tools, and few combine formal proof with an entirely open-source toolchain. In this paper, we present a multi-agent pipeline that couples an LLM with an open-source formal backend (Yosys, SymbiYosys, and Z3) to repair RTL through counterexample-guided iteration: the framework generates formal properties, verifies the design, and feeds counterexamples back to the LLM until the design is proved correct by k-induction or an iteration budget is exhausted. Through an ALU case study, we show that the pipeline can detect and repair a real functional bug with a formal proof of correctness. Across a six-benchmark suite, one design is repaired reliably, and we characterize four distinct failure modes: bounded-cover vacuity, specification ambiguity, temporal-logic bugs, and multi-property pressure. We frame this work as a feasibility study with a detailed failure analysis, and additionally report a practical limitation of the Yosys bind directive relevant to the open-source formal verification community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多智能体流水线，将大语言模型 (LLM) 与完全开源的正式验证后端 (Yosys、SymbiYosys、Z3) 结合，通过反例引导迭代修复 RTL：流水线生成正式属性、验证设计，并把反例反馈给 LLM，直到设计被 k-induction 证明正确或迭代预算耗尽。在 ALU 案例中，流水线检测并修复了一个真实功能 bug 并给出正式正确性证明；在六个基准测试中，只有一个设计被可靠修复，作者还刻画了四种失败模式。作者将其定位为可行性研究并给出详细失败分析，同时报告了 Yosys bind 指令的一个实际限制。
Motivation: 验证占现代芯片设计工作量的大部分，但提供数学正确性保证的正式验证工具昂贵且许可证受限。现有基于 LLM 的 RTL 修复要么通过仿真验证（只覆盖部分输入），要么依赖商业工具，很少有工作将正式证明与完全开源工具链结合。
Method: 提出一个多智能体流水线：LLM 负责生成正式属性，开源正式后端 (Yosys、SymbiYosys、Z3) 验证设计，并将反例反馈给 LLM 进行迭代修复，直到设计被 k-induction 证明正确或达到迭代预算。
Result: 在 ALU 案例研究中，该流水线检测并修复了一个真实功能 bug，且获得了正式正确性证明。在六个基准测试中，只有一个设计被可靠修复；作者识别出四种失败模式：bounded-cover vacuity、规格歧义、时序逻辑 bug 和多属性压力。
Conclusion: 本文是一项可行性研究，附带详细的失败分析，并报告了 Yosys bind 指令的一个实际限制，该限制对开源正式验证社区具有参考价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Predict Performance-induced Emotion Differences in Classical Piano Music
papers.abstract_en: Music is often used as a medium for communicating emotion, with performers shaping perceived affect through interpretation. This study addresses the challenge of identifying and predicting subtle changes in perceived emotion that are exclusively due to differences in performance. We focus on classical solo piano music, using a set of 6 commercial recordings of Bach's Well-Tempered Clavier Book I, annotated in terms of valence and arousal. By encoding the recordings through performance-specific features only, we isolate performance information from aspects of the composition itself, which tend to dominate the overall perceived emotional category. A preliminary analysis validates that these features vary meaningfully across performers. We then propose a relative regression framework, Delta-VA, to predict deviations in valence-arousal relative to an ``average'' performance, thereby focusing on the changes in emotion brought about by a specific way of playing a piece. In addition to the standard $R^2$ regression score, we introduce geometric evaluation metrics to assess the preservation of pairwise differences between performances. Results indicate high directional consistency with the ground truth, but also a compression in prediction magnitude, indicating that the model tends to underestimate expressive performance effects.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何识别并预测仅由演奏差异导致的古典钢琴音乐情绪感知变化。作者使用巴赫《平均律钢琴曲集》第一卷 (Bach's Well-Tempered Clavier Book I) 的6个商业录音，以效价 (valence) 和唤醒度 (arousal) 进行标注，并仅用演奏特定特征编码录音以隔离作曲信息。提出相对回归框架 Delta-VA 预测相对“平均”演奏的情绪偏差，并引入几何评估指标衡量演奏间成对差异的保持。结果显示方向一致性高，但预测幅度存在压缩，模型倾向于低估演奏表达效果。
Motivation: 演奏诠释会改变听众感知的情绪，但作曲本身往往主导整体情绪类别，因此单独识别和预测纯由演奏方式引起的细微情绪变化存在困难。
Method: 仅使用演奏特定特征 (performance-specific features) 编码录音，从作曲信息中隔离演奏信息；提出 Delta-VA 相对回归框架，预测相对“平均”演奏的 valence-arousal 偏差；除标准 R^2 外，引入几何评估指标来检验不同演奏之间成对差异的保持程度。
Result: 初步分析验证了演奏特征在不同演奏者间存在有意义的变化；模型预测与真实情绪的方向一致性较高，但预测幅度被压缩，即倾向于低估演奏带来的表达效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模型在判断情绪变化方向上有较好表现，但在量级上偏保守；研究范围限于古典钢琴独奏录音，且关注相对演奏差异而非绝对情绪类别。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Validation Evidence in LLM Repair Agents: How Much of What Passes Actually Tests the Bug?
papers.abstract_en: When a repair agent runs a test and sees it pass, the result is treated as evidence about the reported defect. We measure how often that treatment is warranted. BSG-VA (buggy-state/candidate-state/gold-fix validation analysis) captures each validation command at its exact working-tree state, extracts a test-only patch, and replays the command on the original buggy code (B), the candidate state (S), and the developer gold fix (G). The captured outcome and the replay results assign every event an evidence role, from gold-aligned bug-discriminating through regression-only to misleading. Across 3,730 events in 643 rollouts on 110 tasks, 46.0% of positive comparable events carry no bug-discriminating information; 23.8% of baseline rollouts, with no feedback injected, close with a patch whose entire positive evidence base is of this kind. A three-arm experiment tests whether returning the B-replay outcome to the agent changes this pattern. Bug-contrast feedback reduces evidence-inadequate closure by 7.8 percentage points relative to an attention-matched reminder (p = 0.0029) and raises bug-discriminating evidence by 7.4 points (p = 0.011), with no detectable cost to repair success. Both estimates fall below the prespecified 10-percentage-point smallest effect size of interest, so practical magnitude remains uncertain. Roughly a third of the improvement traces to the reminder alone; across two exploratory replications, varying the scaffold and the model, the B-replay content adds a detectable increment only with gpt-5.6-sol under the unconstrained tool-use loop. BSG-VA applies post hoc to any replayable repair trajectory that preserves the required code states and execution environment. Keywords: program repair agents, validation evidence, test adequacy, large language models, software quality, controlled experiment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究修复代理（repair agent）在测试通过时是否真的验证了所报告的缺陷。作者提出 BSG-VA（buggy-state/candidate-state/gold-fix validation analysis），在每个验证命令的精确工作树状态下捕获命令、提取纯测试补丁，并分别在原始 bug 代码、候选状态和开发者金修复上重放，从而为事件分配证据角色。基于 110 个任务、643 次 rollout、3730 个事件的测量发现，46.0% 的正向可比较事件不携带 bug 判别信息；三臂实验表明向代理返回 bug 重放结果能减少证据不充分的收尾，但效应量低于预定最小效应值。
Motivation: 修复代理把测试通过当作缺陷证据，但这类通过可能并没有实际测试原始 bug。现有评估缺乏对验证证据是否真正区分 bug 的度量手段，导致修复质量被高估。
Method: 提出 BSG-VA 分析框架：捕获每次验证命令的精确工作树状态，提取仅含测试的补丁，并在原始 bug 状态 (B)、候选状态 (S) 和金修复状态 (G) 上重放命令，将捕获结果与重放结果对照后为每个事件分配证据角色（从 gold-aligned bug-discriminating 到 regression-only 再到 misleading）。随后进行三臂实验，比较向代理返回 B 重放结果与仅返回注意力匹配提醒的效果。
Result: 在 110 个任务的 643 次 rollout、3730 个事件中，46.0% 的正向可比较事件不携带 bug 判别信息；23.8% 的基线 rollout 最终补丁的整个阳性证据基础属于该类型。Bug-contrast 反馈使证据不充分收尾减少 7.8 个百分点（p = 0.0029），使 bug 判别证据提高 7.4 个百分点（p = 0.011），且未检测到修复成功率的代价；但两个估计值都低于预设的 10 个百分点最小效应量。约三分之一的改进来自提醒本身；两个探索性复制（改变脚手架与模型）中，B 重放内容的可检测增量仅出现在 gpt-5.6-sol 的无约束工具循环条件下。
Conclusion: BSG-VA 可事后应用于任何保留所需代码状态和执行环境的可回放修复轨迹。向代理提供 bug 对比反馈能改善验证证据质量，但实际效应幅度仍不确定，且受提醒效应、脚手架和模型选择影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Aligned Self-Supervised Learning for Scientific Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentations define the invariances learned by self-supervised learning (SSL). Standard augmentation pipelines were designed for natural images, yet scientific imaging modalities are governed by physical measurement processes with distinct symmetry and acquisition constraints. Enforcing invariances that contradict these constraints can distort learned representations and limit downstream performance, but practitioners moving from machine learning into a new scientific modality currently have little guidance beyond transferring natural-image pipelines unexamined. We address this gap with a principled, reproducible procedure for augmentation design in scientific SSL: we formalise the physics-aligned augmentation set as a union of measurement-consistent symmetries and acquisition-driven perturbations, and we give a concrete, largely label-free workflow---enumerate candidates, label each by the measurement operator, validate with representation-geometry diagnostics, and confirm by single-factor ablation---for selecting them. We instantiate the procedure for real-space electron microscopy and reciprocal-space 4D-STEM diffraction, and evaluate it across five SSL paradigms (DINOv2, SimCLR, MAE, VICRegL, I-JEPA) on classification and crystal-orientation regression. Physics-aligned augmentations substantially improve downstream performance for objectives relying on cross-view consistency, reduce geodesic error and improve robustness under realistic acquisition variability (detector gain, resolution loss), and systematically reshape representation geometry. While our experiments use electron microscopy, the procedure is modality-agnostic and applies to other measurement-driven domains such as medical and remote-sensing imaging. These results position augmentation design as a primary, and controllable, source of inductive bias in scientific self-supervised learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向科学成像中的自监督学习（SSL），提出一种物理对齐的数据增强设计流程：将增强集形式化为测量一致对称性与采集驱动扰动的并集，并给出枚举、标注、表征几何诊断、单因子消融的完整工作流。作者在实空间电子显微镜与倒空间4D-STEM衍射上实例化该方法，并在DINOv2、SimCLR、MAE、VICRegL、I-JEPA五个SSL范式上验证，物理对齐增强可显著改善依赖跨视角一致性目标的下游性能、降低测地线误差并提升对采集变异的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 标准数据增强流程针对自然图像设计，但科学成像受物理测量过程的不同对称性与采集约束支配；强加与之矛盾的不变性会扭曲学习到的表征并限制下游性能。转向新科学模态的实践者目前只能不加审视地迁移自然图像流程，缺少设计指导。
Method: 提出物理对齐增强集的形式化定义（测量一致对称性与采集驱动扰动的并集），并给出大体无需标签的流程：枚举候选增强、按测量算子标注、用表征几何诊断验证、以及单因子消融确认。该流程在电子显微镜中实例化为实空间成像和倒空间4D-STEM衍射两套具体增强方案。
Result: 实验覆盖五个SSL范式（DINOv2、SimCLR、MAE、VICRegL、I-JEPA）上的分类与晶体取向回归任务。摘要报告物理对齐增强大幅提升依赖跨视角一致性目标的下游性能，降低测地线误差，并在检测器增益、分辨率损失等现实采集变异性下提升鲁棒性，同时系统性重塑表征几何；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该流程与成像模态无关，可推广到医学成像、遥感等其他测量驱动领域，并将增强设计定位为科学自监督学习中一种主要的、可控的归纳偏置来源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Conditioning Tree-Based Diffusions and Flows for Probabilistic Tabular Regression
papers.abstract_en: Tree-based diffusion models fit flexible conditional predictive distributions for tabular regression without a neural density estimator, but they inherit their design defaults---noising path, parameterization, training distribution, features, sampler---from the neural setting. We show these defaults are the binding constraint: what a gradient-boosted ensemble actually solves is a supervised regression problem whose conditioning they determine. We present DiffGBM, which makes them explicit along two axes. First, a Gaussian-path flow-matching trainer for $p(y \mid x)$ that learns a velocity field directly and recovers the score algebraically, admitting few-step deterministic ODE sampling. Second, we expose the score-side recipe---residualization, EDM-style preconditioning, log-sigma time sampling, noise-level features, loss weighting, and histogram resolution---as jointly tunable axes over a shared LightGBM surface rather than one frozen bundle. This \emph{score-flex} space represents the published recipe as a special case; across eleven tabular benchmarks under fold-0 tuning, folds-1--5 evaluation, and a matched 40-trial budget and sampler, the selected configurations beat that baseline on \emph{every} dataset (paired Wilcoxon $11/0$, $p<10^{-3}$), with the best aggregate CRPS skill (0.725 vs.\ 0.699) of any row. The two rows are complementary: score-flex buys accuracy with a stochastic sampler and is the slowest row, while flow matching is the cheapest sampler ($5.2\times$ faster than the published baseline) and the best-calibrated DiffGBM row. Tuned non-diffusion baselines still win individual datasets, and stochastic ($\varepsilon>0$) flow samplers do not Pareto-dominate the deterministic corner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于树的扩散模型 (tree-based diffusion models) 在表格回归中的条件预测分布建模，指出现有方法从神经扩散设置继承的设计默认项（噪声路径、参数化、训练分布、特征、采样器）是性能的制约因素。作者提出 DiffGBM，沿两条轴显式处理这些默认项：一是面向 p(y|x) 的高斯路径 flow matching 训练器，直接学习速度场并代数式恢复 score，支持少步确定性 ODE 采样；二是将残差化、EDM 风格预处理、log-sigma 时间采样、噪声水平特征、损失加权与直方图分辨率作为可联合调节的 score-flex 空间。在十一个表格基准上，选出的配置在每份数据上都超过已发表基线（配对 Wilcoxon 11/0，p<10^-3），最佳聚合 CRPS skill 为 0.725 对 0.699。
Motivation: 树基扩散模型无需神经密度估计器即可拟合灵活的表格回归条件分布，但直接继承了神经扩散的设计默认项，而梯度提升集成实际求解的是一个监督回归问题，这些默认项决定了该问题的 conditioning，成为限制性能的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 DiffGBM 框架，包含两条互补的技术路线：高斯路径 flow matching 训练器直接学习速度场并代数恢复 score，实现少步确定性 ODE 采样；以及将残差化、EDM 式预处理、log-sigma 时间采样、噪声水平特征、损失加权和直方图分辨率等 score 侧组件作为共享 LightGBM 表面上的可调轴，称为 score-flex 空间，已发表配方是其特例。
Result: 在十一个表格基准上采用 fold-0 调参、folds-1–5 评估、40 次试验预算与匹配采样器的设置，选出的配置在所有数据集上均超过基线（配对 Wilcoxon 11/0，p<10^-3），最佳聚合 CRPS skill 为 0.725 对 0.699；flow matching 是成本最低的采样器（比已发表基线快 5.2 倍）且校准最好，而 score-flex 用随机采样器换精度但最慢。
Conclusion: 两种路线互补：score-flex 以随机采样器换精度，flow matching 更快且校准更佳。但调优后的非扩散基线仍能在个别数据集上胜出，且随机（ε>0）flow 采样器并未 Pareto 支配确定性端点。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 提出 DiffGBM 框架，包含两条互补的技术路线：高斯路径 flow matching 训练器直接学习速度场并代数恢复 score，实现少步确定性 ODE 采样；以及将残差化、EDM 式预处理、log-sigma 时间采样、噪声水平特征、损失加权和直方图分辨率等 score 侧组件作为共享 LightGBM 表面上的可调轴，称为 score-flex 空间，已发表配方是其特例。
summary_sections.result: 在十一个表格基准上采用 fold-0 调参、folds-1–5 评估、40 次试验预算与匹配采样器的设置，选出的配置在所有数据集上均超过基线（配对 Wilcoxon 11/0，p<10^-3），最佳聚合 CRPS skill 为 0.725 对 0.699；flow matching 是成本最低的采样器（比已发表基线快 5.2 倍）且校准最好，而 score-flex 用随机采样器换精度但最慢。
summary_sections.conclusion: 两种路线互补：score-flex 以随机采样器换精度，flow matching 更快且校准更佳。但调优后的非扩散基线仍能在个别数据集上胜出，且随机（ε>0）flow 采样器并未 Pareto 支配确定性端点。

papers.title: TextCloak: Thwarting Unauthorized LLM Exploitation via RL-Driven Unlearnable Text
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to significant advances across a wide range of language tasks, while simultaneously raising growing concerns about unauthorized data exploitation and privacy leakage. Unlearnable examples (UEs) offer a promising defense by introducing carefully designed perturbations into data such that models trained on them exhibit degraded utility. However, existing methods for text protection are primarily designed for classification tasks (e.g., sentiment analysis) in discriminative language models and often rely on injecting class-specific linguistic cues, which limits their effectiveness in the open-ended generation settings of LLMs. In this work, we propose TextCloak, an RL-driven framework for protecting textual data against unauthorized LLM exploitation. TextCloak employs a generative policy that transforms batches of clean text into unlearnable examples while preserving semantic fidelity and linguistic naturalness. To optimize the policy, we introduce GRPO-UE, which rewards generated unlearnable text based on the downstream degradation they induce in fine-tuned surrogate LLMs and updates the generator parameters via group-relative policy optimization. This bi-level optimization enables the generator to discover generalizable protective patterns beyond class-specific cues. Comprehensive experiments on six publicly available datasets and nine state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that TextCloak consistently impairs unauthorized fine-tuning while maintaining text utility for legitimate use. Further analyses establish its transferability and robustness across model architectures, training configurations, and adaptive attacks, highlighting its broad applicability as a practical defense against unauthorized LLM exploitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TextCloak，一个基于强化学习的文本保护框架，旨在防止大型语言模型（LLM）对未授权文本数据的微调利用。TextCloak 通过生成式策略将批量干净文本转换为不可学习样本（unlearnable examples），在保持语义保真度和语言自然性的同时，使基于这些数据微调的模型性能下降。作者引入 GRPO-UE 优化策略，利用组相对策略优化（group-relative policy optimization）根据下游微调替代模型上的退化程度更新生成器参数，从而实现超越类别特定线索的泛化保护模式。实验在六个公开数据集和九个 LLM 上验证了该方法能持续削弱未授权微调并保持合法使用的文本效用。
Motivation: 现有文本不可学习样本方法主要面向判别式语言模型中的分类任务（如情感分析），依赖注入类别特定的语言线索，在 LLM 的开放式生成场景下效果有限。随着 LLM 快速发展，未经授权的数据利用和隐私泄露问题日益严重，需要针对生成式 LLM 的文本保护手段。
Method: TextCloak 采用生成式策略将成批干净文本转化为不可学习样本，同时保持语义和语言自然性。策略优化采用 GRPO-UE，基于微调替代 LLM 后下游任务性能的退化程度计算奖励，并通过组相对策略优化更新生成器参数，形成双层优化（bi-level optimization）以发现可泛化的保护模式。
Result: 在六个公开数据集和九个 LLM 上的实验表明，TextCloak 能持续削弱未授权微调的性能，同时维持文本对合法使用的效用。进一步分析显示该方法在不同模型架构、训练配置和自适应攻击（adaptive attacks）下具有可迁移性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者将 TextCloak 定位为一种实用的防御手段，强调其相较类别特定线索的泛化能力以及在多种设置下的广泛适用性。摘要未提及具体的局限性或失败场景。

papers.title: The Debiased Score Test: Hunt-and-test for Semiparametric Hypotheses
papers.abstract_en: The parametric score test assesses a hypothesis through derivatives of the log-likelihood, whose expectation vanishes under the null. When the parameter of interest is a regression function identified as a risk minimiser, we extend this idea to test whether it belongs to a given linear function class. This yields goodness-of-fit tests for common semiparametric regression models, including generalised additive and partially linear models. Suitably formulated, the framework also detects effect modifiers in observational studies. We propose a hunt-and-test strategy that splits the data into two: on one part, after fitting the null model, machine learning is used to identify a promising direction in the empirical scores; on the other, we test whether the score vanishes in that direction. To account for error in estimating the null model, we apply a debiasing correction based on a weighted least squares projection. We establish Type I error control under relatively mild conditions and show the test has power whenever the hunted direction is correlated with the true score. Simulations and real-data examples demonstrate favourable performance, including identifying effect modifiers in an HIV clinical trial and assessing an additive model for insurance claims. The methodology is implemented in the R package dScoreTest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出去偏得分检验 (debiased score test)，将参数化得分检验扩展到回归函数是否属于给定线性函数类的假设检验，用于广义可加模型、部分线性模型等半参数回归模型的拟合优度检验，也可用于观测性研究中的效应修饰因子检测。方法采用 hunt-and-test 策略：一部分数据拟合零模型并用机器学习寻找经验得分中的有希望方向，另一部分数据检验该方向上得分是否为零；通过加权最小二乘投影进行去偏校正以处理零模型估计误差。作者证明在较温和条件下控制 Type I error，并在模拟和真实数据（HIV 临床试验效应修饰、保险理赔可加模型）中展示效果，方法由 R 包 dScoreTest 实现。
Motivation: 现有参数得分检验只能针对有限维参数；当目标参数是作为风险最小化器的回归函数时，需要检验其是否属于给定线性函数类，这是半参数模型拟合优度检验和效应修饰检测中的核心问题。
Method: 提出 hunt-and-test 框架，将数据分成两部分：一部分拟合零模型并用机器学习搜索经验得分中可能的方向，另一部分检验该方向上得分是否为零；对零模型估计误差采用基于加权最小二乘投影的去偏校正。
Result: 建立 Type I error 控制在较温和条件下的保证，且当被搜索方向与真实得分相关时检验具有功效；模拟和真实数据（HIV 临床试验中的效应修饰因子、保险理赔的可加模型）显示性能良好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为半参数假设提供可计算的去偏得分检验，并提供了 R 包 dScoreTest 实现；适用范围包括广义可加模型、部分线性模型和观测性研究的效应修饰检测。

papers.title: A Unified Benchmark of Deep Learning Models for Multi-task 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Automatic brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has become a fundamental task in computer-assisted diagnosis, treatment planning, and disease monitoring. Although numerous deep learning architectures have recently been proposed, objective comparisons remain challenging because published studies often employ different datasets, preprocessing strategies, training protocols, and evaluation procedures. This work presents a unified experimental benchmark for comparing representative convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Transformer-based models, and recent State Space Model (SSM) architectures under homogeneous experimental conditions. Five state-of-the-art three-dimensional segmentation models, including 3D U-Net, SegResNet, Swin UNETR, SegMamba, and SegMambaV2, are evaluated on two brain tumor segmentation datasets representing distinct clinical scenarios: intracranial meningioma segmentation (BraTS 2023) and post-treatment glioma segmentation (BraTS 2024). All architectures are trained using identical preprocessing, data augmentation, optimization strategies, and evaluation protocols to ensure a fair comparison. Performance is assessed using segmentation accuracy metrics together with computational cost indicators, including inference time and the size of each model. The results provide practical insights into the trade-offs between segmentation accuracy and computational efficiency, highlighting the suitability of different architectural paradigms for challenging three-dimensional brain tumor segmentation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个统一的实验基准，在完全相同的预处理、数据增强、优化和评估协议下，对代表性 CNN、Transformer 和状态空间模型 (SSM) 的三维脑肿瘤分割性能进行公平比较。研究评估了五个模型（3D U-Net、SegResNet、Swin UNETR、SegMamba、SegMambaV2），覆盖颅内脑膜瘤（BraTS 2023）和术后胶质瘤（BraTS 2024）两类临床场景，并同时报告分割精度与计算成本（推理时间和模型大小）。摘要指出结果揭示了分割精度与计算效率之间的权衡，以及不同架构范式在三维脑肿瘤分割任务中的适用性。
Motivation: 尽管已有大量深度学习分割架构被提出，但现有研究常采用不同的数据集、预处理策略、训练协议和评估流程，导致客观比较困难，需要统一条件下的基准来消除这些干扰因素。
Method: 在完全相同的预处理、数据增强、优化策略和评估协议下，训练并比较五个三维分割模型，包括 3D U-Net、SegResNet、Swin UNETR、SegMamba 和 SegMambaV2，并在两个不同临床场景的数据集（BraTS 2023 与 BraTS 2024）上进行评估。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化数值，仅说明结果提供了关于分割精度与计算效率（推理时间、模型大小）权衡的实用见解，并凸显了不同架构范式在三维脑肿瘤分割任务中的适用性。
Conclusion: 统一条件下的基准比较可以为选择适合挑战性三维脑肿瘤分割的架构范式提供实践指导，但摘要未明确指出任一模型的绝对优势或局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast Rates for Swap-Agnostic Learning of Proper Losses
papers.abstract_en: Swap-agnostic learning strengthens classical agnostic learning by allowing the comparator to select a different hypothesis on each level set of the learner's predictions. This benchmark captures prediction-dependent postprocessing, but appears to require solving a separate agnostic-learning problem for every possible prediction value. We show that, for proper losses, these prediction-level comparisons can instead be controlled jointly. Our main result is an offline swap-agnostic learner for any fixed proper loss. For a finite hypothesis class $H$ and any fixed smooth proper loss, the excess risk from $m$ i.i.d. samples is $\widetilde{O}((\log |H|/m)^{2/3})$, with a corresponding online swap-regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/3}(\log |H|)^{2/3})$. We also give algorithms whose predictions are simultaneously swap-agnostic for entire families of losses. For all proper losses bounded in $[-1,1]$, we obtain online and offline rates of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{T\log |H|})$ and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\log |H|/m})$, respectively. For convex, $1$-Lipschitz proper losses, these rates improve to $\widetilde{O}(T^{1/3}(\log |H|)^{2/3})$ online and $\widetilde{O}((\log |H|/m)^{2/3})$ offline. These bounds are tight up to logarithmic factors and improve upon the $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3}(\log |H|)^{1/3})$ rate implied by the swap-omniprediction guarantee of Luo et al. (2025). Our main technical contribution is a reduction from swap-agnostic learning to a second-order form of multicalibration, obtained via Blackwell approachability with a Bernstein-style variance correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 proper loss 下的 swap-agnostic 学习，提出将问题归约到二阶多校准 (second-order multicalibration)，从而联合控制所有预测水平集上的比较。对固定光滑 proper loss，得到离线超额风险 tilde O((log|H|/m)^{2/3}) 与在线 swap regret tilde O(T^{1/3}(log|H|)^{2/3})；对凸 1-Lipschitz proper loss 族也有相应改进，并证明这些界紧至对数因子。
Motivation: 经典 agnostic learning 只允许固定比较器，而 swap-agnostic 基准允许比较器在每个预测水平集上选择不同假设，能刻画预测相关的后处理；但朴素方法需要对每个预测值分别求解 agnostic learning 问题，代价过高。作者希望证明这些逐预测值比较可以被联合控制。
Method: 主要技术贡献是把 swap-agnostic learning 归约到二阶形式的 multicalibration，归约通过 Blackwell approachability 结合 Bernstein 式方差修正实现；同时给出算法，使预测对整族损失同时满足 swap-agnostic 保证。
Result: 对有限假设类 H 与固定光滑 proper loss，m 个 i.i.d. 样本下离线超额风险为 tilde O((log|H|/m)^{2/3})，在线 swap regret 为 tilde O(T^{1/3}(log|H|)^{2/3})。对所有有界于 [-1,1] 的 proper loss，得到在线/离线 tilde O(sqrt{T log|H|}) 与 tilde O(sqrt{log|H|/m})；对凸 1-Lipschitz proper loss 改进为 tilde O(T^{1/3}(log|H|)^{2/3}) 与 tilde O((log|H|/m)^{2/3})，并优于 Luo et al. (2025) 的 tilde O(T^{2/3}(log|H|)^{1/3}) 上界。
Conclusion: 作者指出这些速率在忽略对数因子意义下是紧的，并改进了此前由 swap-omniprediction 保证给出的速率；核心 takeaway 是将预测级比较统一处理，并借助二阶多校准获得更快的学习速率。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究 proper loss 下的 swap-agnostic 学习，提出将问题归约到二阶多校准 (second-order multicalibration)，从而联合控制所有预测水平集上的比较。对固定光滑 proper loss，得到离线超额风险 tilde O((log|H|/m)^{2/3}) 与在线 swap regret tilde O(T^{1/3}(log|H|)^{2/3})；对凸 1-Lipschitz proper loss 族也有相应改进，并证明这些界紧至对数因子。
summary_sections.motivation: 经典 agnostic learning 只允许固定比较器，而 swap-agnostic 基准允许比较器在每个预测水平集上选择不同假设，能刻画预测相关的后处理；但朴素方法需要对每个预测值分别求解 agnostic learning 问题，代价过高。作者希望证明这些逐预测值比较可以被联合控制。
summary_sections.method: 主要技术贡献是把 swap-agnostic learning 归约到二阶形式的 multicalibration，归约通过 Blackwell approachability 结合 Bernstein 式方差修正实现；同时给出算法，使预测对整族损失同时满足 swap-agnostic 保证。
summary_sections.result: 对有限假设类 H 与固定光滑 proper loss，m 个 i.i.d. 样本下离线超额风险为 tilde O((log|H|/m)^{2/3})，在线 swap regret 为 tilde O(T^{1/3}(log|H|)^{2/3})。对所有有界于 [-1,1] 的 proper loss，得到在线/离线 tilde O(sqrt{T log|H|}) 与 tilde O(sqrt{log|H|/m})；对凸 1-Lipschitz proper loss 改进为 tilde O(T^{1/3}(log|H|)^{2/3}) 与 tilde O((log|H|/m)^{2/3})，并优于 Luo et al. (2025) 的 tilde O(T^{2/3}(log|H|)^{1/3}) 上界。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者指出这些速率在忽略对数因子意义下是紧的，并改进了此前由 swap-omniprediction 保证给出的速率；核心 takeaway 是将预测级比较统一处理，并借助二阶多校准获得更快的学习速率。

papers.title: Learning Manifolds in High-D Point Embedding for Anisotropic Surface Approximation from Unstructured Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: Dense 3D sensors in various real-world fields produce point clouds that are geometrically redundant for real-time processing. In this paper, we propose an efficient and scalable learning-based anisotropic surface approximation framework, HD-PEA, that operates directly on unstructured point clouds, integrating anisotropic optimization into reconstruction to produce compact, geometry-aligned surface representations with higher fidelity, fewer elements, and improved numerical stability compared to isotropic and adaptive meshes. Firstly, we develop a novel learning-based high-dimensional (high-d) Euclidean point embedding method to map the input point clouds into a high-d manifold embedding space. For handling large-scale point clouds without retraining and fine-tuning, a patch-based meta-embedding scheme is designed during the inference stage. Then, we develop a new tangent subspace estimation for the high-d embedding manifold approximation and anisotropic manifold reconstruction in high-d space. The main contribution of this work is to propose a scalable deep learning framework and a variety of datasets for constructing a high-d Euclidean point embedding space aimed to 3D anisotropic surface mesh approximation and Riemannian curvature tensor estimation from point clouds. We extensively evaluate our method against state-of-the-art surface reconstruction approaches using several datasets, such as Thingi10K dataset, AIM@SHAPE and Stanford 3D Scanning Repository, ScanNet dataset, and further demonstrate its generalization and usability on diverse unseen shapes and applications from these datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HD-PEA，一种基于学习的各向异性曲面逼近框架，直接在非结构化点云上操作，将各向异性优化集成到重建中，以产生紧凑、几何对齐的曲面表示。方法先将点云映射到高维欧氏点嵌入空间，推理阶段采用 patch-based meta-embedding 方案处理大规模点云而无需重训练，再通过新开发的切子空间估计完成高维嵌入流形逼近与各向异性重建。在 Thingi10K、AIM@SHAPE、Stanford 3D Scanning Repository、ScanNet 等数据集上与 SOTA 重建方法进行对比评估。
Motivation: 稠密 3D 传感器产生的点云对实时处理而言存在几何冗余，需要高效且可扩展的曲面重建方法；现有各向同性与自适应网格在保真度、元素数量和数值稳定性上仍有不足。
Method: 提出 HD-PEA 框架：先设计学习式高维 (high-d) 欧氏点嵌入方法，将非结构化点云映射到高维流形嵌入空间；推理阶段引入基于 patch 的元嵌入方案以支持大规模点云且无需重训练和微调；随后提出新的切子空间估计方法，用于高维嵌入流形的逼近和各向异性流形重建。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 Thingi10K、AIM@SHAPE、Stanford 3D Scanning Repository、ScanNet 等数据集上相对现有曲面重建方法进行评估，并展示对未见形状和应用的泛化性与可用性；相比各向同性和自适应网格，生成更紧凑、几何对齐的表示，具有更高保真度、更少元素和更好的数值稳定性。
Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是可扩展的深度学习框架及数据集，用于从点云构建高维欧氏点嵌入空间，服务于 3D 各向异性曲面网格逼近和黎曼曲率张量估计；摘要未明确讨论方法局限性。
Relevance: 0
