papers.title: An analysis of machine learning approaches for enhancing decision-making in complex discrete choice tasks
papers.abstract_en: Discrete choice modeling is a common tool used for preference elicitation during policy-making, but this is typically done through parametric models. Machine learning can push the boundaries of discrete choice modeling for policy-based preference elicitation by adopting a data-driven approach or learning individual preferences. However, there is limited knowledge of how well machine learning methods can estimate individual discrete choice rules under individual heterogeneity, especially in the context of challenges often experienced during preference elicitation. This study evaluates four machine learning models (multinomial logistic regression, generalized additive model, twinned neural network, and Gaussian process) with respect to their capacity to learn and predict five choice rules that are important in the behavioral and social sciences (linear strong utility, monotonic strong utility, ideal point, lexicographic semiorder, and multiattribute linear ballistic accumulator). Monte Carlo experiments were performed to assess model performance when increasing a) the number of attributes in the choice alternatives, b) the number of training choice sets, and c) the choice rule's determinism. The simulation results demonstrated that semi-parametric and non-parametric models generally outperform parametric models across all choice rules and experimental contexts. Model performance also generally improves by 6% to 96% and 0% to 55%, respectively, with an increase in training choice sets and choice rule determinism. A case study using real energy policy preference data was also conducted, where TNN performed best with a BIC of 13.351. This work demonstrated the viability and limitations of semi-parametric and non-parametric models in the context of policy-centric discrete choice modeling and showed how the choice task context should drive model selection.
papers.comment: Published in Decision Analytics Journal, Dec 16 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估四种机器学习模型（多项逻辑回归、广义可加模型、孪生神经网络和高斯过程）在个体异质性下学习与预测五种离散选择规则的能力。通过蒙特卡洛实验考察属性数量、训练选择集规模和选择规则确定性对性能的影响，并用真实能源政策偏好数据进行案例研究。结果表明半参数与非参数模型普遍优于参数模型，且任务背景应驱动模型选择。
Motivation: 离散选择建模常用于政策制定中的偏好 elicitation，但传统上依赖参数模型；机器学习虽有潜力，但对其在个体异质性下估计离散选择规则的能力缺乏系统了解。
Method: 设计蒙特卡洛实验，比较四种模型对五种行为/社会科学重要选择规则（线性强效用、单调强效用、理想点、词典式半序、多属性线性弹道累积器）的学习与预测能力，并逐步增加属性数、训练选择集数和规则确定性；另以真实能源政策偏好数据做案例研究。
Result: 模拟结果显示半参数和非参数模型在所有选择规则与实验情境下普遍优于参数模型；训练选择集增加带来6%至96%的性能提升，规则确定性增加带来0%至55%的提升；案例研究中TNN表现最佳，BIC为13.351。
Conclusion: 工作证明了半参数与非参数模型在政策导向离散选择建模中的可行性与局限，并强调选择任务背景应驱动模型选择。

papers.title: Hypergradient-based Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Improved Sample Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) is an important framework within the literature of RL that can be used to formalize various categories of problems, such as meta-learning, hierarchical task decomposition, and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RL-HF). Most of the bilevel RL algorithms are either not scalable because of using hypergradient with Hessian, or they suffer from high sample complexity because of using penalty-based approximation methods. In this work, we propose a hypergradient-based bilevel RL algorithm using the optimality of the Boltzmann policy for the entropy regularized discounted RL objective function. Our proposed algorithm is Hessian-free and obtains an iteration complexity of $O(ε^{-1})$ and state-of-the-art sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ under mild regularity conditions. Further, in our convergence analysis, we are able to remove the assumption of the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition on the outer-level objective function present in the prior state-of-the-art sample complexity work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于超梯度 (hypergradient) 的双层强化学习 (bilevel RL) 算法，利用熵正则化折扣 RL 目标下 Boltzmann 策略的最优性构造超梯度，从而避免 Hessian 计算。作者在温和正则性条件下给出迭代复杂度 O(ε^{-1}) 和样本复杂度 Otilde(ε^{-2})，并在收敛分析中移除了外层目标函数上的 Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) 条件。
Motivation: 现有双层 RL 算法要么因使用含 Hessian 的超梯度而难以扩展，要么因采用基于惩罚项的近似方法而样本复杂度较高；本文目标是获得可扩展且样本高效的双层 RL 算法。
Method: 算法利用熵正则化折扣 RL 目标下 Boltzmann 策略的最优性条件来设计 Hessian-free 的超梯度更新，并在较温和的正则性假设下进行收敛性分析。
Result: 摘要报告迭代复杂度为 O(ε^{-1})，样本复杂度达到当前最优的 Otilde(ε^{-2})；相比先前最优样本复杂度的工作，本文不再需要外层目标满足 PL 条件。
Conclusion: 作者强调该算法在避免 Hessian 计算的同时取得当前最优样本复杂度，并扩展了双层 RL 收敛分析适用范围；摘要未给出具体数值实验或任务验证。

papers.title: DeltaServe: Host-Agnostic Co-Serving of Inference and Fine-Tuning for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: LLM serving systems are provisioned for peak load to meet strict latency targets, leaving substantial GPU compute idle whenever traffic falls below peak. We present DeltaServe, a host-agnostic co-serving design that converts this idle inference capacity into LoRA fine-tuning throughput while preserving inference service-level objectives (SLOs). DeltaServe integrates with existing inference engines through a compact hook interface that requires only multi-LoRA batching support. It exploits the shared execution structure of inference prefill and LoRA fine-tuning forward passes, and uses an SLO-aware scheduler to admit and execute fine-tuning only when sufficient inference headroom is available. The scheduler is driven by a CUDA-graph-aware latency model calibrated offline and refined online. We integrate DeltaServe with vLLM, SGLang, and S-LoRA. On a production trace from Company X, DeltaServe on vLLM delivers 2.9x higher fine-tuning throughput than LLMStation at 100% inference SLO compliance, versus 85% for LLMStation. It also achieves 39% higher fine-tuning throughput than a baseline running vLLM+torchtune, using no additional hardware and maintaining full SLO compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DeltaServe，一个与具体推理引擎无关（host-agnostic）的协同服务（co-serving）设计，将 LLM serving 系统中低于峰值流量时的空闲 GPU 算力转化为 LoRA 微调吞吐，同时保持推理服务等级目标（SLO）。DeltaServe 通过紧凑的 hook 接口集成到现有引擎（仅需支持 multi-LoRA 批处理），利用推理 prefill 与 LoRA 微调前向传播的共享执行结构，并用 SLO 感知调度器决定何时执行微调。在 vLLM 上的生产流量 trace 中，相比 LLMStation 获得 2.9 倍微调吞吐提升且 100% 推理 SLO 合规，相比 vLLM+torchtune 基线提升 39% 且无需额外硬件。
Motivation: LLM serving 系统按峰值负载配置资源以达成严格延迟目标，当流量低于峰值时大量 GPU 算力闲置，造成资源浪费。现有方案未能有效利用这些空闲算力做有意义的计算，如微调。
Method: DeltaServe 是一种宿主无关的协同服务架构，通过只要求 multi-LoRA 批处理支持的 hook 接口接入现有推理引擎（已集成 vLLM、SGLang、S-LoRA）。它复用推理 prefill 与 LoRA 微调前向传播的公共执行结构，并由 SLO 感知调度器控制微调任务的准入与执行；调度器由离线校准、在线细化的 CUDA 图感知延迟模型驱动，只在推理 headroom 充足时执行微调。
Result: 在 Company X 的生产 trace 上，DeltaServe（vLLM 集成）在 100% 推理 SLO 合规下比 LLMStation 的微调吞吐高 2.9 倍（LLMStation 合规率为 85%）；相比 vLLM+torchtune 基线，不使用额外硬件且保持完全 SLO 合规，微调吞吐提高 39%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DeltaServe 证明了在不增加硬件、不牺牲推理 SLO 的前提下，可将空闲推理容量高效转换为 LoRA 微调吞吐，并已在多个主流推理引擎上验证其通用性。

papers.title: Seeing the Forest for the Trees: The Gaussian Process Limit of BART
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) have shown state-of-the-art performance in both prediction and causal inference problems. Previous theoretical work has attempted to explain BART's superior performance by establishing posterior contraction rates for standard BART models, but these rates depend strongly on the number of covariates. Here, we take a different approach and study the behavior of BART as the number of trees grows towards infinity. We show that in this regime, BART converges to a Gaussian process (GP) with a particular kernel. The kernel and its corresponding reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) have favorable inferential properties that help explain BART's excellent performance. We introduce *random tree features* as an approximation to this limiting GP, and establish minimax-optimal learning rates for ridge regression on these random features that depend only logarithmically on dimension. In addition to providing insight into the empirical success of BART, random tree features offer a computational benefit over traditional MCMC estimation. The random-features approximation also allows practitioners to easily incorporate BART into any model which has a linear predictor, expanding the applicability and flexibility of BART.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, plus references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) 在树数量趋于无穷时的极限行为，证明其收敛到一个具有特定核的高斯过程 (Gaussian process, GP)，并刻画了该核对应的再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS)。作者引入随机树特征 (random tree features) 来近似该极限 GP，证明基于这些随机特征的岭回归可实现仅关于维度对数依赖的 minimax 最优学习率。该视角除解释 BART 的经验成功外，还提供了相比传统 MCMC 估计更高效的计算途径，并允许把 BART 嵌入到任何具有线性预测子的模型中。
Motivation: 已有理论工作通过建立标准 BART 模型的后验收缩率来解释其优异性能，但这些速率强烈依赖协变量数量，难以系统解释 BART 在预测和因果推断中的表现。本文转向考察树数量趋于无穷时 BART 的极限分布，以获得不同的理论理解。
Method: 证明当树数量趋于无穷时 BART 依分布收敛到带有特定核函数的 Gaussian process，并分析该核及 RKHS 的推断性质；随后提出随机树特征作为该极限 GP 的近似，并研究基于这些特征的岭回归学习理论。
Result: 摘要报告随机树特征上的岭回归可以达到 minimax 最优学习率，且对维度的依赖仅为对数级别；相比传统 MCMC 估计，随机特征近似还带来计算上的收益，并可将 BART 扩展到任何含线性预测子的模型中。
Conclusion: 作者认为无穷树极限及其随机特征近似既能解释 BART 在预测和因果推断中的成功，又提升了计算效率与模型适用性。摘要未说明具体局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FocusGS: Spatial Delta Layers for Local Repair and Deterministic Editing of Trained 3D Gaussian Assets
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is evolving from one-time reconstruction into deliverable, inspectable, and maintainable visual assets. Existing workflows focus on global reconstruction, training-time density control, or open-ended generative editing, leaving trained assets without precise local maintenance. We propose FocusGS, which unifies local repair and deterministic editing as composite spatial deltas. Repair is the purely additive special case: its base-manipulation term is empty, and it adds only local Gaussian bases; deterministic editing uses erase-insert factorization (EIF) to combine old-carrier erasure with new-content insertion. FocusGS addresses spatial gradient starvation: local repair raises target-region PSNR by 7.91 dB over 93 evaluation views. Across all 83 deterministic editing trials, the target ROI improves, with a trial-averaged mean edited ROI PSNR of 21.97 dB and a mean gain of +11.05 dB; across five public editing cases, FocusGS-EIF reaches 33.17 dB Target-mask PSNR and 0.994 Target-delta Correlation, while both text-driven baselines fail to complete the prescribed updates. FocusGS provides a lightweight, verifiable 3DGS maintenance operator.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary demonstration video included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FocusGS，将训练好的3D高斯资产（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）的局部修复与确定性编辑统一为复合空间增量（composite spatial deltas）。修复被建模为纯加法特例，确定性编辑通过擦除-插入分解（erase-insert factorization, EIF）实现。实验表明局部修复在93个评估视图上目标区域PSNR提升7.91 dB，83次确定性编辑均改善目标ROI，公共案例上比文本驱动基线更可靠。
Motivation: 现有3DGS工作流侧重全局重建、训练时密度控制或开放式生成编辑，缺乏对已训练资产的精确局部维护能力，难以完成局部修复和确定性编辑。
Method: 提出FocusGS，将局部修复和确定性编辑统一为复合空间增量；修复是纯加法特例（基础操作项为空，只添加局部高斯基），确定性编辑使用擦除-插入分解（EIF）将旧载体擦除与新内容插入结合，以解决空间梯度饥饿问题。
Result: 摘要报告局部修复在93个评估视图上目标区域PSNR提升7.91 dB；83次确定性编辑全部改善目标ROI，平均编辑ROI PSNR为21.97 dB，平均增益为+11.05 dB；五个公共编辑案例中FocusGS-EIF达到33.17 dB Target-mask PSNR和0.994 Target-delta Correlation，而两个文本驱动基线未能完成指定更新。
Conclusion: 作者认为FocusGS提供了一种轻量、可验证的3DGS维护算子，弥补了已训练资产局部维护方面的空白。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Unlearning Fails: Reliable Data Deletion under Post-Training in Agent Networks
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving federated agent networks keep training after deployment by collecting new trajectories with the current policy and feeding them back into later rounds. This closed loop makes unlearning harder than a one-time model repair. When a data owner requests deletion, the target data may have already shaped later retained trajectories, so retraining or model-side unlearning can leave an influence echo that returns as the network continues to operate. We show that this echo survives retained-data retraining, grows with the amount of forget-shaped retained data, and can be traced from deployment, collection, and aggregation records. To address this problem, we propose MUTE, a Muting Unlearned Trajectories' Echoes method for reliable deletion in self-improving federated agent networks. MUTE estimates downstream influence from a lightweight server ledger, removes the current residue through a forget-retain update, contains high-influence retained trajectories through quarantine or down-weighting, and audits later behavior to schedule additional erasure under an uplink budget. Experiments on LIBERO with two vision-language-action backbones, three deletion granularities, and a physical Jetson-based edge testbed show that MUTE keeps behavioral leakage and influence regeneration low while preserving task utility and using much less communication than full retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自改进联邦智能体网络（self-improving federated agent networks）在部署后持续训练场景下的数据删除问题。作者指出，闭环训练会使目标数据通过影响后续保留轨迹而产生影响回声（influence echo），该回声在保留数据重训后依然存在。为应对这一挑战，论文提出 MUTE 方法，在 LIBERO 基准和 Jetson 边缘测试台上验证其能降低行为泄漏与影响再生，同时保持任务效用并减少通信开销。
Motivation: 现有 unlearning 研究多针对一次性模型修复，而自改进联邦智能体网络在部署后持续用当前策略收集的新轨迹训练，使删除请求到来时目标数据可能已塑造后续保留轨迹，导致重训或模型侧 unlearning 留下难以消除的影响回声。
Method: MUTE 从轻量级服务器账本估计下游影响，通过 forget-retain 更新移除当前残留，对高影响的保留轨迹进行隔离（quarantine）或降权（down-weighting），并在上行链路预算下审计后续行为以安排额外擦除。
Result: 在 LIBERO 上使用两种 vision-language-action 主干、三种删除粒度以及基于 Jetson 的物理边缘测试台进行实验，MUTE 在保持行为泄漏和影响再生较低的同时保留任务效用，且通信量远小于完全重训。
Conclusion: 论文强调影响回声可被追踪，并提出 MUTE 作为在自改进联邦智能体网络中实现可靠删除的方法；其有效性在机器人操作基准和边缘测试台上得到验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Distilling Knowledge from Large Language Models into Lightweight Reinforcement Learning Agents for Autonomous Cyber Operations
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Cyber Operations (ACO) are increasingly important for defending enterprise networks as cyber threats continue to evolve in sophistication. ACO applications commonly employ Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents to learn defensive behaviors through interaction with environments. However, RL agents typically require extensive exploration during training, often resulting in unstable behavior and poor initial decision-making before converging toward effective defense strategies. In this work, we investigate the use of a Large Language Model (LLM) to improve autonomous defensive decision-making within an ACO environment. Through prompt engineering rather than fine-tuning, we demonstrate that an 8-billion parameter LLM pretrained on cybersecurity data can outperform a baseline RL agent in a modified CybORG CAGE Challenge 2 environment. We then propose an online policy distillation framework that transfers the LLM's defensive policy into a lightweight RL agent containing only 64,910 parameters, reducing model size by several orders of magnitude while maintaining effective defensive capabilities. This provides a pathway toward operationalizing frontier cybersecurity models within lightweight, deployable agents. To evaluate transferability, we construct CybORG scenarios ranging from 4 to 12 hosts and assess the approach across varying network configurations. We also evaluate teacher-guided RL stabilization strategies and observe that none consistently surpass the optimized teacher policy, suggesting policy-alignment limitations between reward-driven RL optimization and teacher-guided defense strategies. Our results demonstrate the potential of cybersecurity-focused LLMs as sources of expertise for autonomous cyber defense, while policy distillation provides a practical path toward operationalizing frontier cybersecurity models within efficient, scalable agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何在自主网络对抗 (Autonomous Cyber Operations, ACO) 中用大规模语言模型 (LLM) 提升防御决策。作者通过提示工程而非微调，证明一个 80 亿参数、在网络安全数据上预训练的 LLM 能在修改后的 CybORG CAGE Challenge 2 环境中胜过基线 RL 智能体；随后提出在线策略蒸馏框架，将该策略转入仅 64,910 参数的轻量 RL 智能体，在多个 CybORG 场景（4 到 12 台主机）中保持防御能力。摘要还指出，教师引导的 RL 稳定化策略未能一致超过优化后的教师策略。
Motivation: ACO 中的 RL 智能体在训练中通常需要大量探索，收敛前行为不稳定且初始决策差，因此需要更可靠的知识来源来改进自主防御决策。
Method: 采用网络安全预训练的 8B 参数 LLM 作为教师，通过提示工程直接提供防御策略；随后提出在线策略蒸馏框架，将 LLM 的策略迁移到仅含 64,910 参数的轻量 RL 智能体，并同时评测不同的教师引导 RL 稳定化策略。
Result: 在修改后的 CybORG CAGE Challenge 2 中，该 LLM 教师胜过基线 RL 智能体；蒸馏后的轻量智能体以数量级更小的模型规模维持有效防御能力；教师引导稳定化策略中没有一种能一致超越经优化的教师策略。
Conclusion: 作者认为网络安全领域 LLM 可作为自主网络防御的专家知识来源，而策略蒸馏为将前沿模型落地为轻量可部署智能体提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Best Friends, Not Forever: Evaluating Long-Horizon Persona Collapse and Behavioral Drift in AI Companions
papers.abstract_en: As AI companions increasingly mediate repeated social interaction, users may rely on a stable role and shared history, yet locally acceptable replies do not ensure that either persists. We study two observable long-horizon failures: 'persona collapse', the loss of a deployed role, boundaries, values, or style, and 'behavioral drift', the gradual or recurrent erosion of those properties. We introduce ANCHOR, a controlled synthetic audit that separately measures persona enactment and trajectory recall. The study contains 2,008 conversations spanning 27 personas, nine interaction schedules, three generated memory settings, and four evaluated models. The Identity Probe combines a sealed 102-item questionnaire with turn-level judgments, while the Trajectory Probe scores 110 calibrated counterfactual questions from 35 conversation banks. Our results show that no evaluated model and configuration reliably preserves either dimensions: trajectory accuracy averages only 44.4%, user-state recall remains near four-option chance, and no tested context condition or memory consistently resolves these failures. Questionnaire retention also varies by model and persona facet, disagrees with turn-level behavior, and is sensitive to evaluator choice. These results indicate that current systems do not yet reliably support long-horizon companion continuity and that audits must distinguish persona enactment, trajectory recall, evaluator provenance, and deployment context rather than collapse them into a single trust or stability score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI陪伴系统在长期多轮交互中出现的两类失效：人格坍缩 (persona collapse) 与行为漂移 (behavioral drift)，即系统丢失已部署的角色设定或逐渐偏离边界、价值观与风格。作者提出ANCHOR，一种受控合成审计方法，分别测量人格扮演与轨迹记忆，并基于2,008段对话、27个人格、九种交互安排、三种记忆设置和四个模型进行实验。结果显示所有模型与配置均无法可靠维持长期连续性，轨迹准确率平均仅44.4%，用户状态回忆接近四选项随机水平。
Motivation: AI陪伴系统日益承担重复性社交互动，用户依赖稳定的角色与共享历史，但局部可接受的回复并不保证长期一致；现有评估缺乏对人格扮演、轨迹记忆、评估来源与部署上下文的区分。
Method: 提出ANCHOR审计框架，将人格扮演与轨迹回忆分别测量：Identity Probe采用102项封闭问卷结合回合级判断，Trajectory Probe使用来自35个对话库的110个校准反事实问题打分。
Result: 2,008段对话的实验中，无任何模型与配置能可靠保持人格与轨迹维度；轨迹准确率平均44.4%，用户状态回忆接近四选一随机水平，且问卷保留结果随模型和人格侧面变化、与回合级行为不一致，并受评估者选择影响。
Conclusion: 当前系统尚不能可靠支持AI陪伴的长期连续性；审计应区分人格扮演、轨迹回忆、评估来源和部署上下文，而不应合并为单一的信任或稳定性分数。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究AI陪伴系统在长期多轮交互中出现的两类失效：人格坍缩 (persona collapse) 与行为漂移 (behavioral drift)，即系统丢失已部署的角色设定或逐渐偏离边界、价值观与风格。作者提出ANCHOR，一种受控合成审计方法，分别测量人格扮演与轨迹记忆，并基于2,008段对话、27个人格、九种交互安排、三种记忆设置和四个模型进行实验。结果显示所有模型与配置均无法可靠维持长期连续性，轨迹准确率平均仅44.4%，用户状态回忆接近四选项随机水平。
summary_sections.motivation: AI陪伴系统日益承担重复性社交互动，用户依赖稳定的角色与共享历史，但局部可接受的回复并不保证长期一致；现有评估缺乏对人格扮演、轨迹记忆、评估来源与部署上下文的区分。
summary_sections.method: 提出ANCHOR审计框架，将人格扮演与轨迹回忆分别测量：Identity Probe采用102项封闭问卷结合回合级判断，Trajectory Probe使用来自35个对话库的110个校准反事实问题打分。
summary_sections.result: 2,008段对话的实验中，无任何模型与配置能可靠保持人格与轨迹维度；轨迹准确率平均44.4%，用户状态回忆接近四选一随机水平，且问卷保留结果随模型和人格侧面变化、与回合级行为不一致，并受评估者选择影响。

papers.title: Rolling With Resistance: Preference-Optimized LLM Counselors Can Trade Goal Persistence for Relational Attunement in Motivational Interviewing
papers.abstract_en: In Motivational Interviewing (MI), a client's sustain talk (arguments for the status quo) calls for the counselor to roll with resistance, a move that can fail in two opposite ways: capitulation (abandoning the change agenda to preserve rapport) or confrontation (arguing or directing, overriding the client's autonomy). We introduce a two-axis evaluation of counselor responses, anchored in the Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI) code, Goal Persistence (GP) and Relational Attunement (RA), yielding a four-quadrant framing in which rolling with resistance is high on both, and we ask whether penalizing one failure through preference optimization teaches rolling with resistance or provokes its opposite. From the expert-annotated AnnoMI corpus we build topic-disjoint Direct Preference Optimization data whose preference sets differ only in which failure is rejected, using on-policy negatives. An automatic judge, validated against AnnoMI's expert labels and rechecked by trained human coders, scores blind pairwise win-rates against each base under a firewall in which disjoint model families generate, label, and judge. Across three aligned instruction models spanning the Qwen and Llama families, penalizing confrontation reliably lowers goal persistence below parity, on every base and in every seed run, a robust cost, whereas the attunement gain is base-dependent, present on two of the three bases but absent on the third. Penalizing capitulation is inert, because these models rarely capitulate on-policy, so the trade is gated by each base's failure profile. A prompt-only control raises attunement without the goal-persistence cost, locating the cost in the optimization rather than in attunement itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在动机性访谈（Motivational Interviewing, MI）中，通过偏好优化训练大语言模型咨询师如何“随阻力而行”（roll with resistance）。作者提出基于 MITI 编码的目标坚持（Goal Persistence, GP）与关系协调（Relational Attunement, RA）两轴评估，并构造偏好集仅在被拒绝失败类型上不同的 DPO 数据。实验显示，惩罚对抗（confrontation）会稳定降低目标坚持，而惩罚投降（capitulation）几乎没有效果，且该权衡受基线模型失败画像的制约。
Motivation: 动机性访谈中，咨询师面对来访者的维持性话语（sustain talk）需要“随阻力而行”，失败模式有两种对立方向：投降（放弃改变目标以维持关系）或对抗（争辩或指挥，压制来访者自主性）。作者希望弄清偏好优化中惩罚其中一种失败，究竟是在教会模型正确策略，还是诱发其相反的失败模式。
Method: 从专家标注的 AnnoMI 语料构建主题不相交的 DPO 数据，偏好对仅在哪个失败被拒绝上不同，并使用 on-policy 负例；同时设置“防火墙”，让不相交的模型族分别负责生成、标注和评判。评估采用经 AnnoMI 专家标签验证并由训练过的人类编码员复核的自动评判器，对每个基座模型进行盲法成对胜率比较。
Result: 在跨越 Qwen 和 Llama 家族的三个对齐指令模型上，惩罚对抗在所有基线和所有随机种子下都把 GP 稳定降至 parity 以下，这一代价具有稳健性；RA 的收益则依赖基座，只在三个基线中的两个出现。惩罚投降无效，因为这些模型在 on-policy 条件下很少投降。另设的仅提示（prompt-only）对照能在不损失 GP 的情况下提升 RA，说明代价来自优化过程而非协调本身。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，偏好优化中针对单一失败模式的惩罚会引发非单调的行为权衡，其方向和大小由基座模型的失败画像决定；提示层面的控制可以规避这种优化代价。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Bayesian Mediation Analysis for Individualized Treatment Rules
papers.abstract_en: The value of an individualized treatment rule (ITR), defined as the expected outcome under treatment assignment according to the rule, is useful for assessing average clinical benefit but does not explain how the benefit of a rule is generated. We propose a causal mediation framework for decomposing the value contrast between a prespecified candidate ITR and a clinically meaningful reference rule into direct and indirect components. Using rule-specific nested potential outcomes, we define natural direct and indirect rule effects that quantify the extent to which the improvement in value arises through pathways operating directly on the outcome versus through a specified mediator. We give identification conditions under which these components are identified by a rule-level mediation g-formula. For estimation, we adapt Bayesian causal mediation forests to obtain posterior inference for the value contrast and its path-specific components. Our simulations demonstrate that the proposed estimator achieved near-nominal credible interval coverage with decreasing bias and root mean squared error as sample size increased in settings with varying direct and mediated contributions. We further illustrate the method using data from the TRIUMPH trial, decomposing the cognitive benefit of a lifestyle intervention rule through candidate neurovascular, cardiorespiratory, and behavioral mediators. The proposed framework complements optimal ITR learning with explanation using mediation, providing a natural approach for mechanistic evaluation of ITRs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个因果中介分析框架，用于将个性化治疗规则 (ITR) 的价值对比分解为直接效应与间接效应。作者基于规则特定的嵌套潜在结果定义自然直接与间接规则效应，并给出识别条件；估计方面将贝叶斯因果中介森林 (Bayesian causal mediation forests) 适配到规则层面，以进行价值对比及其路径成分的后验推断。模拟显示置信区间覆盖接近名义水平且偏差与均方根误差随样本量下降，并在 TRIUMPH 试验数据上分解生活方式干预规则的认知获益。
Motivation: ITR 的价值仅描述平均临床获益，无法解释获益是如何产生的；现有评估工具缺少对规则获益进行机制性分解的手段。
Method: 提出规则层面的中介 g-formula 作为识别基础，并将贝叶斯因果中介森林适配到 ITR 情境中，对价值对比及其直接与间接路径成分做后验推断。
Result: 模拟实验显示该估计器在中介贡献比例不同的设定下获得接近名义水平的可信区间覆盖率，且偏差和均方根误差随样本量增大而减小；TRIUMPH 试验分析将认知获益分解到神经血管、心肺和行为等候选中介。
Conclusion: 该框架为最优 ITR 学习补充了基于中介的解释途径，提供一种天然的机制性评估 ITR 的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model or Harness? An Interaction-Centric Taxonomy for Localizing Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: Existing evaluations often reduce agent failures to system-level outcomes, obscuring where the fault originated and which intervention would improve the agent system. This creates a repair-assignment problem: the same visible failure may call for model post-training, harness engineering, environment redesign, or benchmark repair depending on its source. Because agent behavior emerges from interactions among models, harnesses, users, tools, memory, and environments, outcome-level labels are often insufficient for improvement. Most failure taxonomies do little to resolve this problem because they are benchmark-specific and lack a shared structure. We introduce an interaction-centric taxonomy that localizes failures to the interactions in which they originate and identifies the responsible component. It organizes 41 failure modes by assigning each to an edge between two components and a fault side indicating where the repair belongs. This makes the taxonomy actionable: model-side failures identify targets for post-training, harness-side failures point to scaffolding and tool-integration fixes, and environment or grader failures reveal evaluation conditions requiring redesign. The schema applies across agent architectures, from coding assistants to long-horizon personal assistants and multi-agent systems. We ground the taxonomy in worked examples from public benchmarks, model system cards, published reports, and logged agent trajectories, and evaluate its reproducibility using independent reasoning agents as judges. Across four frontier models, the strongest judge reaches Cohen's $κ=0.76$ against human category labels, suggesting that the categories capture shared structure rather than annotator-specific preferences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能体系统故障归因不清的问题，提出一种以交互为中心的故障分类法 (interaction-centric taxonomy)。该分类法将 41 种故障模式分配到两个组件之间的边上，并标注故障侧以指出修复归属。作者用公共基准、模型系统卡、报告和记录轨迹中的实例进行验证，并用独立推理智能体评估可复现性。
Motivation: 现有评估常把智能体故障归结为系统级结果，掩盖了故障源头，导致修复指派困难：同一可见故障可能源于模型后训练、工程脚手架、环境或基准设计。已有故障分类法多为基准特化，缺乏共享结构。
Method: 提出以交互为中心的故障分类法，将 41 种故障模式各自指派到两个组件之间的边，并给出故障侧（模型侧、支座侧或环境/评分侧），使分类法可操作。该框架适用于编码助手、长时程个人助手和多智能体系统等多种智能体架构。
Result: 以四个前沿模型作为独立推理评判者，最强评判者对人工类别标签达到 Cohen's κ=0.76。摘要未给出其他定量结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该分类法捕捉的是共享结构而非标注者偏好，并可直接指导修复：模型侧故障对应后训练，支座侧故障对应脚手架和工具集成修复。

papers.title: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark datasets are central to evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), yet they are typically conceived as monolithic tasks, obscuring substantial variation in the demands of individual samples. We introduce a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets at the sample level along five latent dimensions: 1. Cognitive and Knowledge Demands, 2. Language and Content Quality, 3. Task Properties, 4. Context, and 5. Ethics, Safety, and Fairness. Applying this framework, we annotate five influential benchmarks -- MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, and TruthfulQA -- revealing pronounced internal heterogeneity that is not captured by aggregate accuracy scores. We show how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite benchmark subsets across datasets, supporting targeted evaluation of model capabilities such as Reasoning Depth or Ethical Sensitivity. This approach reframes benchmark evaluation as dataset introspection, providing a principled methodology for analyzing and re-composing existing benchmarks to better reflect diverse evaluation needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据集为中心的元评估框架，在样本级别审计 LLM 基准数据集，沿五个潜在维度（认知与知识需求、语言与内容质量、任务属性、上下文、伦理安全与公平性）进行标注。作者将该框架应用于 MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag 和 TruthfulQA 五个基准，揭示聚合准确率无法捕捉的内部异质性，并展示这些标注如何支持跨数据集按标准组合子集，以定向评估推理深度或伦理敏感性等能力。
Motivation: 基准数据集通常被视为单一整体任务，掩盖了单个样本在难度和需求上的显著差异，导致聚合指标无法反映模型能力的细粒度表现。
Method: 提出样本级审计框架，对基准数据集的每个样本沿五个潜在维度进行标注，并基于这些标注实现跨数据集的标准驱动子集组合（criterion-driven orchestration）。
Result: 对 MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag 和 TruthfulQA 的标注揭示了显著的内部异质性，且这些标注支持按标准构建复合基准子集，用于定向评估特定模型能力。
Conclusion: 本文将基准评估重新定义为数据集内省（dataset introspection），为分析和重组现有基准提供了一套方法论，以更好满足多样化的评估需求。

papers.title: Can Synthetic Data Overcome the Generalization Limits of AI-Based Flower and Pod Detection Across Cowpea Breeding Genotypes and Environments?
papers.abstract_en: High-throughput phenotyping requires AI-enabled computer vision models that generalize across genotypes, locations, and growing seasons, yet such models often lose accuracy under new conditions. Annotating real imagery for every genotype-by-environment (G x E) combination a breeding program encounters is prohibitively expensive. We quantify how G x E shifts affect AI-based detection of cowpea flowers and pods across two California locations and two growing seasons. Flower detection mAP@50 fell from 76.3% to as low as 50.6% under unseen shifts, and pod detection was more sensitive. Feature-space and image-quality diagnostics confirmed these losses track measurable distributional shifts. Because closing this gap with real data alone is not practical, we test whether synthetic imagery, rendered from a procedural 3D cowpea model, can substitute for that annotation burden. Synthetic supervision alone improved over pretraining but remained limited by a domain gap driven by camera image formation, not scene content. A domain-gap-aware camera-realism augmentation strategy, optimized against measured real-image statistics via Wasserstein distance, narrowed this gap, and a linear HDR representation converted a smaller measured gap into a larger detection gain than an 8-bit representation. Optimized HDR synthetic data combined with as few as five real images matched or exceeded the real-data baseline for spatial generalization, and pod detection benefited most at the lowest shot counts, with more modest gains under temporal shift. These results show that synthetic data can overcome the generalization limits of AI-based flower and pod detection, but only when the domain gap is measured and optimized rather than assumed away.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 目标检测模型在豇豆花与豆荚识别中的跨基因型×环境 (G x E) 泛化问题，指出模型在新条件下精度显著下降。作者用程序化 3D 豇豆模型生成合成图像，并提出基于 Wasserstein 距离的、考虑域差距的相机真实感增强策略，配合线性 HDR 表示，最终使合成数据加上少量真实图像即可匹配甚至超过纯真实数据的空间泛化基线。
Motivation: 高通量表型分析需要能跨基因型、地点和生长季泛化的计算机视觉模型，但为每个基因型-环境组合标注真实图像成本过高，因此需要探索合成数据是否能替代真实标注负担。
Method: 构建程序化 3D 豇豆模型渲染合成图像；提出域差距感知的相机真实感增强策略，用 Wasserstein 距离对标实测真实图像统计量进行优化；并对比线性 HDR 与 8-bit 图像表示对检测增益的影响。
Result: 花检测 mAP@50 在未见过的分布转移下从 76.3% 降至最低 50.6%，豆荚检测更敏感。仅用合成监督优于预训练但受相机成像导致的域差距限制；优化后的 HDR 合成数据结合少至 5 张真实图像，在空间泛化上达到或超过真实数据基线，其中豆荚检测在最低样本数时获益最大，时间转移下的增益较小。
Conclusion: 合成数据能够克服花和豆荚检测的泛化极限，但前提是域差距被测量并优化，而不是被假定不存在。

papers.title: EarlyDx: An Admission-Anchored Benchmark for Open-Ended Generation of Evidence-Supported ED-Encounter Diagnoses
papers.abstract_en: Clinical diagnosis at hospital admission must be made rapidly from limited, incomplete evidence. Existing diagnosis-prediction benchmarks are poorly suited to this setting: they restrict prediction to closed code sets, exclude free-text notes, and supervise with discharge diagnoses that incorporate the full inpatient course. We introduce EarlyDx, a large-scale benchmark for open-ended early diagnosis, built from 154,834 emergency department encounters in MIMIC-IV. Each encounter is restricted to records available at admission time $t_0$ and supervised by the diagnoses recorded during the ED encounter rather than at discharge. An LLM auditor further verifies every free-text label as supported, partially supported, or unsupported by that evidence; the primary evaluation scores only fully supported labels. Under a semantic LLM-as-judge protocol, no evaluated system --- frontier general, medical-specialized, or in-domain post-trained --- synthesizes admission-time evidence reliably. Zero-shot models score largely by extraction, recovering only 3-31% of diagnoses that must be inferred rather than read from the record; post-training raises inference-dependent recall to 56%, but a sizeable margin remains, and on time-critical conditions no system attains a clinician's balance of sensitivity and precision. We release the full construction and evaluation pipeline at here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EarlyDx，一个基于 MIMIC-IV 中 154,834 次急诊科（ED）就诊记录的大规模开放式早期诊断基准。每个就诊样本仅使用入院时刻 t0 可得的记录，并以急诊就诊期间记录而非出院时的诊断作为监督；LLM 审计器将每条自由文本标签验证为受支持、部分支持或不受支持，主要评估只计完全支持的标签。在语义 LLM-as-judge 协议下，没有系统能可靠地综合入院时证据，零样本模型主要靠抽取、仅恢复 3–31% 需推断的诊断，后训练虽将推断依赖的召回率提高到 56%，但差距仍大，且时间关键条件下没有系统达到临床医生的敏感性与精确度平衡。
Motivation: 现有诊断预测基准不适合入院时必须基于有限、不完整证据快速诊断的实际场景：它们将预测限制在封闭代码集、排除自由文本笔记，并用包含完整住院过程的出院诊断进行监督。因此需要一个能反映急诊早期诊断真实挑战的开放式基准。
Method: 构建 EarlyDx 基准：从 MIMIC-IV 选取 154,834 次急诊就诊，将输入限制为入院时刻 t0 可获得的记录，用急诊期间记录而非出院时的诊断作为监督标签。使用 LLM 审计器将每个自由文本标签标记为受支持、部分支持或不受支持，主要评估仅使用完全支持的标签；评估采用语义 LLM-as-judge 协议。
Result: 摘要报告，在评估的前沿通用、医学专用和域内后训练模型中，没有系统能可靠综合入院时证据。零样本模型主要依靠抽取，仅恢复 3–31% 需要推断而非直接读出的诊断；后训练将推断依赖的召回率提升到 56%，但仍留有可观差距；在时间关键条件下，没有任何系统达到临床医生那样的敏感性与精确度平衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有系统在开放式的入院早期诊断生成上仍不可靠，并发布了完整的构建与评估流程。摘要同时表明即使经过后训练，推断依赖的召回率仍不高，说明该任务仍有较大改进空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stratified Negation in RDF Rules: A Correct Approach (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: Combining RDF rule languages, such as N3 or SHACL Rules, with default negation is challenging. Existing methods to stratify negation often fail for RDF rules, since individual triples do not carry enough information to meaningfully restrict potential dependencies. Blank nodes in rule heads further complicate the matter, since the order of rule applications may determine whether new values are created, which in turn can change the applicability of rules with negation. To solve these open problems, we propose chain stratification as a robust new condition that guarantees a well-behaved semantics for RDF rules with negation, and existential rules in general. Our condition combines an elaborate analysis of potential multistep derivations with a mechanism for using integrity constraints to discard impossible cases. Applying rules in any order that respects chain stratification is guaranteed to derive an RDF graph that is unique, lean, and justified under the usual negation-as-failure semantics. To show the practicality, we also provide a prototype implementation.
papers.comment: Technical report of our ISWC'26 paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 RDF 规则语言（如 N3 或 SHACL Rules）中默认否定的分层问题，提出链式分层 (chain stratification) 条件，用于保证带否定规则的良定义语义。该条件结合对潜在多步推导的分析，并利用完整性约束排除不可能情况；任何尊重该分层的规则应用顺序都会推导出唯一、精简 (lean) 且符合否定即失败 (negation-as-failure) 语义的 RDF 图。作者还提供了原型实现，并指出该方法同样适用于一般存在性规则 (existential rules)。
Motivation: 现有对否定进行分层的方法往往在 RDF 规则上失效，因为单个三元组所含信息不足以有意义地限制潜在依赖关系；此外，规则头中的空白节点 (blank nodes) 使得规则应用顺序可能决定是否创建新值，进而改变带否定规则的适用性。
Method: 提出链式分层条件，通过精细分析可能的多步推导，并用完整性约束 (integrity constraints) 排除不可能的情况；在满足该条件的任意规则应用顺序下，保证得到唯一、精简且语义合理的 RDF 图。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化实验数据，但指出为验证实用性提供了原型实现。
Conclusion: 作者认为链式分层是处理带否定 RDF 规则及更一般存在性规则的健壮新条件，能保证良定义语义；该文为 ISWC'26 论文的技术报告版本。

papers.title: Representations from Pretrained Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials as Coarse Coordinates for Material Generation and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Generative machine learning is increasingly used for inorganic crystal structure generation. Most models and the corresponding evaluation approaches rely on simple forms of crystal structure representation. In this paper, we showcase the power of atom-averaged features from pretrained Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs), such as MACE, for such tasks. We first introduce a distance measure that assesses the output of material generative models by capturing both quality and novelty in a single distribution-based evaluation framework. In particular, we introduce the Coarse-Fine Transport Distance (CFTD) using two different featurizers, where the quality component is based on coarse MACE features. We showcase CFTD's versatility in capturing crystal-structure quality while also detecting memorization, and compare it with the recently introduced continuous SUN metrics. We further show that coarse MACE features can be used as guidance for a material generative model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示预训练机器学习原子间势（如 MACE）的原子平均特征可用于无机晶体结构生成与评估。作者提出 Coarse-Fine Transport Distance (CFTD) 距离度量，在单一分布评估框架中同时衡量生成结构的质量与新颖性，并能检测记忆化（memorization）；此外，粗 MACE 特征还可作为生成模型的引导。摘要中与近期提出的连续 SUN 指标进行了比较。
Motivation: 现有材料生成模型及对应评估方法大多依赖简单的晶体结构表示，难以同时刻画生成结果的质量与新颖性，缺乏统一的分布级评估手段。
Method: 作者利用预训练 MLIP（如 MACE）的原子平均特征作为粗坐标（coarse coordinates），提出 CFTD 度量，采用两种特征化器，其中质量分量基于粗 MACE 特征；同时将粗 MACE 特征用作材料生成模型的引导信号。
Result: 摘要报告 CFTD 能捕获晶体结构质量并检测记忆化，并与连续 SUN 指标进行了比较；还表明粗 MACE 特征可有效指导材料生成模型。
Conclusion: 预训练 MLIP 特征可作为材料生成与评估的粗坐标，提供兼顾质量与新颖性的分布级评价框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do Medical Foundation Models Generalize on the African Brain?
papers.abstract_en: Medical foundation models (FMs) are increasingly used for brain MRI analysis. However, their evaluation remains dominated by high-resource datasets, leaving generalization to African cohorts underexplored. We assess whether FMs generalize equally to African and non-African brain MRI data across two tasks: dementia classification using a Nigerian dataset and brain tumor segmentation using BraTS-Africa. We evaluate two generalist FMs (BrainIAC, 3DINO) and two segmentation-specific FMs (MedSAM2, Medical-SAM2) against a from-scratch baseline. For classification, FMs provide limited gains (highest ROC-AUC of 0.86 with BrainIAC), whereas for segmentation they consistently improve performance, reaching up to 0.86 Dice with MedSAM2. Performance differences between African and non-African cohorts are inconsistent and appear more related to dataset size than data origin. These results suggest that FMs do not exhibit an inherent bias against African cohorts, and highlight the limited availability and diversity of African neuroimaging datasets as the main barrier to robust evaluation and deployment.
papers.comment: Submitted to the AFRICAI workshop (Held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026, Strasbourg, France)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估医学基础模型（foundation models, FMs）在非洲人群脑MRI上的泛化能力，涵盖尼日利亚痴呆分类数据集和BraTS-Africa脑肿瘤分割数据集。作者比较两个通用FM（BrainIAC、3DINO）和两个分割专用FM（MedSAM2、Medical-SAM2），并与从零训练基线对比。结果显示分类任务FM提升有限（BrainIAC最高ROC-AUC 0.86），分割任务FM稳定提升（MedSAM2最高Dice 0.86），非洲与非非洲队列的性能差异不稳定，更可能与数据集规模而非数据来源有关。
Motivation: 医学基础模型在脑MRI分析中日益普及，但评估主要依赖高资源数据集，非洲队列上的泛化能力尚未被充分探索，阻碍了公平且可靠的部署。
Method: 在痴呆分类和脑肿瘤分割两个任务上，使用尼日利亚数据集和BraTS-Africa，对比两个通用FM（BrainIAC、3DINO）与两个分割专用FM（MedSAM2、Medical-SAM2），并以从零训练模型作为基线。
Result: 分类任务中FM仅带来有限增益（最高ROC-AUC 0.86，来自BrainIAC）；分割任务中FM一致提升性能，最高Dice 0.86（MedSAM2）。非洲与非非洲队列间的性能差异不一致，且似乎更多由数据集规模而非数据来源解释。
Conclusion: 作者认为FM对非洲队列并未表现出固有偏见，主要瓶颈是非洲神经影像数据集的可用性和多样性不足，这限制了稳健评估与部署。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Deepfake Detection via Multi-View Structural Learning
papers.abstract_en: Security-critical biometric and forensic applications require accurate predictions and reliable confidence estimates, particularly under distribution shift. This challenge is especially acute for deepfake detection, where foundation-model-based detectors often exhibit overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution manipulations, which limits their suitability for operational deployment. We propose an uncertainty-aware deepfake detection framework that identifies manipulations through inconsistencies across complementary evidence sources. The framework integrates three streams: a visual stream based on an adapted CLIP encoder, a semantic stream that models consistency among facial attributes through differentiable constraints, and a structural stream that captures class-dependent dependency patterns between semantic and forensic features. To effectively combine these signals, we introduce Inter-Branch Disagreement Calibration (IBDC), a disagreement-aware uncertainty modeling mechanism that links predictive uncertainty to conflicts among evidence streams. Extensive cross-dataset experiments using FaceForensics++ as the training source demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves state-of-the-art generalization across multiple out-of-distribution benchmarks while consistently improving calibration and selective prediction performance. These results show that combining complementary evidence with disagreement-aware uncertainty provides a robust foundation for trustworthy and well-calibrated deepfake detection under distribution shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种不确定性感知的深度伪造检测框架，通过视觉流（基于适配的 CLIP 编码器）、语义流（可微约束建模面部属性一致性）和结构流（捕获语义与取证特征间的类别相关依赖）三个互补证据源来识别操纵，并引入 Inter-Branch Disagreement Calibration (IBDC) 将预测不确定性映射到证据流间的冲突。在以 FaceForensics++ 为训练源的跨数据集实验中，该方法在多个分布外（OOD）基准上取得最先进的泛化性能，同时持续改善校准和选择性预测。
Motivation: 安全关键的生物识别与取证应用需要准确预测和可靠置信度，而现有基于基础模型的深度伪造检测器在分布偏移下常对操纵样本表现出过度自信，限制了实际部署。
Method: 构建三流框架：基于适配 CLIP 的视觉流、通过可微约束建模面部属性一致性的语义流，以及捕获语义与取证特征间类别相关依赖模式的结构流；并提出 IBDC，一种不一致感知的不确定性建模机制，将预测不确定性与证据流间的冲突联系起来。
Result: 使用 FaceForensics++ 作为训练源、在多个 OOD 基准上进行的跨数据集实验表明，该方法在泛化、校准和选择性预测性能上均达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将互补证据与不一致感知的不确定性结合，能够为分布偏移下可信且良好校准的深度伪造检测提供稳健基础。

papers.title: Feature Interaction Modeling for Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: This work embeds feature interaction modules derived from factorization machines (FMs) into physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and neural operator learning, to enhance model expressiveness for solution manifolds of parameterized partial differential equations (PDEs). Motivated by the second-order Taylor expansion of multivariate functions to characterize variable couplings, we first propose FM-PINN. It explicitly captures spatio-temporal variable interactions and improves the approximation accuracy for smooth high-order PDEs. We further group spatial coordinates, time, physical parameters, and initial and boundary conditions into independent feature sets and model their cross-group interactions. Based on this strategy, we develop FM-Operator and FM-DeepONet, which are particularly effective for nonlinear conservation laws and problems with sharp gradients or discontinuities, while offering no consistent advantage on smooth operator learning benchmarks. Numerical tests demonstrate that the proposed mechanism delivers substantial accuracy gains on challenging shock-dominated equations, indicating a promising direction for physics-consistent modeling of parameterized PDEs with strong cross-field dependencies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将因子分解机 (factorization machine) 的特征交互模块嵌入物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 与神经算子学习，提出 FM-PINN、FM-Operator 和 FM-DeepONet，用于参数化偏微分方程 (PDE) 解流形的表达增强。方法显式建模时空变量交互以及空间坐标、时间、物理参数与初边值条件之间的跨组交互。数值测试显示，该机制在激波主导方程与非线性守恒律上带来明显精度提升，但在光滑算子学习基准上并无一致优势。
Motivation: PINNs 与神经算子对参数化 PDE 解流形的表达能力有限，缺乏对变量耦合关系的显式刻画；多变量函数的二阶泰勒展开为建模特征交互提供了动机。
Method: 从因子分解机出发，将特征交互模块嵌入 PINN 得到 FM-PINN；进而把空间坐标、时间、物理参数、初始和边界条件划分为独立特征集，并建模其跨组交互，据此构建 FM-Operator 与 FM-DeepONet。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在非线性守恒律、尖锐梯度或不连续问题以及激波主导方程上获得实质性精度提升，而在光滑算子学习基准上未提供一致优势。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该机制为具有强跨场依赖性的参数化 PDE 建模指出了有前景的方向，强调了物理一致性建模的潜力。

papers.title: WaiT for the Signal: Simple Frequency-Aware Flow-Matching
papers.abstract_en: As image generation models scale to ever higher resolutions, global coherence, local detail, and texture fidelity become critical axes for generation quality. However, standard flow matching treats all spatial frequencies uniformly, ignoring the natural frequency hierarchy where high-frequency bands become indistinguishable from pure noise far earlier than coarse structures. We introduce WaiT, a Wavelet-aware image Transformer that decomposes generation into coarse and fine bands via lossless wavelets. True to its name, the high-frequency bands wait for the signal: staying pure noise until coarse structure has emerged, then joining the flow for joint refinement. Since standard FID discards fine-grained detail through aggressive downsampling, we introduce a more stringent three-axis evaluation protocol to assess quality at native resolution. On ImageNet 512x512, WaiT achieves a pixel-space FID of 1.43 and is Pareto-optimal across all three axes, reducing sampling compute by up to 50%. With our largest 2B model, we set a new state-of-the-art FID of 1.3 for pixel-space models on ImageNet 512 resolution. Our formulation outperforms even the strongest latent-space models on texture fidelity, and scales seamlessly to high-resolution OpenImages and to video generation, achieving a state-of-the-art FVD of 0.84 on Kinetics-600 with no algorithmic modifications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaiT，一种基于小波的图像 Transformer 生成模型，将 flow matching 生成过程按无损小波分解为粗、细两个频带。高频带在粗结构出现之前保持纯噪声，之后才加入流进行联合精修。在 ImageNet 512x512 上，WaiT 达到 pixel-space FID 1.43，并在三个评估轴上均处于 Pareto 最优，采样计算最多节省 50%；最大的 2B 模型实现 1.3 的 FID，刷新该分辨率下 pixel-space 模型的纪录。该方法在纹理保真度上超过最强 latent-space 模型，且无需算法改动即可扩展到高分辨率 OpenImages 和视频生成，在 Kinetics-600 上取得 0.84 的 FVD。
Motivation: 标准 flow matching 对所有空间频率一视同仁，忽略了高频带远比粗结构更早退化为纯噪声这一频率层级特性；同时标准 FID 通过激进降采样丢弃细粒度细节，无法在原生分辨率下评估生成质量。
Method: WaiT 通过无损小波将图像生成分解为粗频带与细频带，高频带先保持纯噪声，等待粗结构出现后再参与流动以实现联合精修；此外引入一个更严格的三轴评估协议，在原生分辨率下评估质量。
Result: 在 ImageNet 512x512 上，WaiT 取得 pixel-space FID 1.43，三轴评估下均 Pareto 最优，采样计算最高减少 50%；2B 模型将 FID 提升至 1.3，为 pixel-space 模型新纪录。其纹理保真度优于最强的 latent-space 模型，并能无缝扩展至高分辨率图像和视频生成，在 Kinetics-600 上取得 0.84 的 SOTA FVD。
Conclusion: 作者强调，频率感知的粗-细分解能够同时改善全局一致性、局部细节与纹理保真度，并可规模化为高分辨率图像与视频生成方法，无需针对任务修改算法。

papers.title: SCMA: Structure-Conditioned and Metal-Aware Flow Matching for CT Metal Artifact Reduction
papers.abstract_en: In X-ray CT, metallic objects cause beam hardening, photon starvation, and scattering, leading to projection inconsistency, streaks, dark bands, and structural distortions that compromise clinical diagnosis and quantitative analysis. Existing metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods remain limited: optimization-based methods may leave residual artifacts or blur structures, regression networks may generalize poorly across scenarios, and generative models without sample-specific structural guidance and physical constraints may produce anatomically inconsistent structures. Flow Matching learns a continuous-time velocity field that deterministically transports a source distribution to a target distribution, providing a flexible MAR prior. However, standard unconditional Flow Matching does not exploit sample-specific structure, spatially nonuniform metal-induced degradation, or measured projections. To address these limitations, we propose SCMA, a structure-conditioned and metal-aware Flow Matching framework. First, a linear-interpolation-corrected image is fed into the velocity network with the intermediate state as a sample-specific structural condition, guiding inference toward artifact-free CT images while preserving anatomy. Second, time-varying spatial weights from the metal mask and its distance transform are incorporated into the Flow Matching loss to emphasize severe degradation within and around metal regions. Finally, conditional Flow Matching updates alternate with projection-consistency correction during inference, allowing reliable measurements outside metal traces to constrain predictions. Experiments on simulated and real CT data demonstrate that SCMA more effectively suppresses metal artifacts, preserves local anatomical structures, and reduces hallucination-like structures inconsistent with projection measurements than representative MAR methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCMA，一个面向 CT 金属伪影去除的结构条件与金属感知流匹配 (Flow Matching) 框架。方法把线性插值校正图像与中间状态作为样本特定的结构条件，在流匹配损失中引入由金属掩膜及其距离变换导出的时变空间权重，并在推理阶段交替执行条件流匹配更新与投影一致性校正。在模拟和真实 CT 数据上的实验表明，SCMA 比代表性 MAR 方法更能抑制金属伪影、保留局部解剖结构并减少与投影测量不一致的类幻觉结构。
Motivation: CT 中金属物体会导致束硬化、光子饥饿和散射，造成条状伪影、暗带和结构扭曲，影响临床诊断。现有 MAR 方法各有局限：优化方法易残留伪影或模糊结构，回归网络泛化差，生成模型缺乏样本特定结构引导和物理约束；标准无条件 Flow Matching 也未利用样本特定结构、空间不均匀的金属退化及实测投影。
Method: SCMA 以 Flow Matching 为生成先验，具体包含三部分：将线性插值校正后的图像连同中间状态输入速度网络，作为样本特定的结构条件引导推理；在 Flow Matching 损失中用来自金属掩膜及其距离变换的时变空间权重强调金属区域内外的严重退化；推理阶段交替进行条件 Flow Matching 更新与投影一致性校正，使金属轨迹外的可靠测量约束预测。
Result: 在模拟和真实 CT 数据上的实验显示，与代表性 MAR 方法相比，SCMA 更有效地抑制金属伪影、保留局部解剖结构，并减少与投影测量不一致的类幻觉结构。摘要未报告量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将样本特定结构条件、金属感知损失权重和投影一致性校正引入 Flow Matching，可以有效缓解现有生成式 MAR 方法在解剖一致性和物理一致性上的不足。

papers.title: TAGTorch: A PyTorch Library for Geometry, Topology, and Symmetry-Aware Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Over the last decade, neural networks have been applied to an increasingly diverse range of applications, including data with rich geometric, topological, or symmetry-related structure. As a result, researchers have increasingly drawn inspiration from topology, algebra, and geometry. Despite this rich algorithmic development, the supporting software ecosystem remains fragmented. Many important methods exist only as research prototypes in unmaintained repositories. We address this by introducing Topology, Algebra, and Geometry Torch (TAGTorch), an open-source, PyTorch-based library that unifies tools inspired by topology, algebra, and geometry, including data-preprocessing methods, architectures, training techniques, and model analysis tools. We describe the design philosophy of TAGTorch and then discuss its current architecture and capabilities, highlighting areas where it can fill gaps in the current software ecosystem. We conclude with a discussion of our future development priorities for the library.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 TAGTorch（Topology, Algebra, and Geometry Torch），一个基于 PyTorch 的开源库，用于统一受拓扑、代数和几何启发的机器学习工具，涵盖数据预处理、模型架构、训练技术与模型分析工具。抽象主要描述库的设计理念、当前架构与能力，并展望未来开发优先级，未报告具体实验基准。
Motivation: 近年来神经网络被用于具有丰富几何、拓扑或对称结构的数据，相关算法虽有大量发展，但支撑软件生态碎片化，许多重要方法仅存在于未维护的研究仓库中。
Method: 提出开源 PyTorch 库 TAGTorch，集成拓扑、代数和几何相关的工具，包括数据预处理方法、架构、训练技术和模型分析工具，并讨论其设计哲学与当前能力覆盖。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，主要贡献是描绘 TAGTorch 的架构、能力以及它在现有软件生态中可以填补的空缺。

papers.title: ReLoop-UME: Recurrent Depth with Learnable Retrieval Registers for Universal Multimodal Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space. Existing UME models either form embeddings through single forward encoding or add computation through explicit rationale tokens and latent autoregressive states. Although token expansion can improve complex matching, serial generation increases retrieval latency and makes the final embedding depend on generated intermediate states. This raises a different question: can useful computation be expanded along model depth while keeping the token workspace fixed? We analyze positive-negative similarity separation at every layer of independently trained UME models and observe a shared progression: early layers contextualize multimodal inputs, a contiguous middle-to-late stage forms retrieval-discriminative features, and the final layers map them into the embedding space. Based on this finding, we propose ReLoop-UME, which executes the early layers once, recurrently reuses a parameter-shared retrieval-forming block, and applies the final mapping layers after the last loop. Learnable Retrieval Registers provide persistent retrieval-specific states that accumulate and exchange evidence across loops, with the final register serving as the embedding readout. On MMEB-V2 and MRMR, ReLoop-UME consistently improves retrieval across different backbones while running 44.9x faster than UME-R1 and 1.5x faster than PLUME.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLoop-UME，一种在不扩大 token 工作空间的前提下沿模型深度扩展计算的多模态通用嵌入方法。作者先分析独立训练的 UME 模型各层的正负样本相似度分离情况，发现早期层负责上下文化、中后期连续层形成检索判别特征、最后层映射到嵌入空间，并据此设计循环复用的检索形成模块。在 MMEB-V2 和 MRMR 基准上，ReLoop-UME 在不同主干上一致提升检索性能，且比 UME-R1 快 44.9 倍、比 PLUME 快 1.5 倍。
Motivation: 现有通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型要么单次前向编码，要么通过显式推理 token 和潜在自回归状态增加计算；token 扩展虽能改善复杂匹配，但串行生成带来检索延迟，且最终嵌入依赖生成的中间状态。作者提出的问题是：能否在保持 token 工作空间固定的情况下沿模型深度扩展有用计算。
Method: 提出 ReLoop-UME：早期层只执行一次，参数共享的检索形成块被循环复用，最后在最后一轮循环后应用最终映射层。可学习检索寄存器（Learnable Retrieval Registers）提供持续的检索特定状态，在循环间积累和交换证据，最终的寄存器作为嵌入读出。
Result: 在 MMEB-V2 和 MRMR 上，该方法在不同骨干网络下一致提升检索性能，同时运行速度比 UME-R1 快 44.9 倍、比 PLUME 快 1.5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要表明通过沿深度扩展循环计算并固定 token 工作空间，可以在避免 token 扩展和串行生成开销的同时提升跨模态检索效果。

papers.title: DragonCrawl: A Generative, Intent-Based Framework for Scalable Mobile End-to-End Testing
papers.abstract_en: As mobile applications grow in complexity, traditional End-to-End (E2E) testing frameworks struggle with UI volatility, maintenance overhead, and cross-platform scalability. This paper presents DragonCrawl, an AI-driven mobile testing system for continuous regression testing that has evolved from embedding-based similarity matching to generative intent-based reasoning using large language models. Unlike prior LLM-based testing research focused on exploratory testing and crash detection, DragonCrawl validates specific user flows on every code change, blocking commits that break critical functionality. By leveraging GPT-4o's multimodal capabilities, DragonCrawl achieves 91.6% pass rate on iOS and 92.2% on Android across 1,013 automated tests running continuously in CI/CD pipelines. The system reduces test onboarding time from 96-120 hours to under 4 hours and has saved an estimated 27 developer years in test maintenance effort. We present the architectural evolution from V1 (semantic embedding matching) to V2 (generative intent-based reasoning), discuss implementation challenges including token explosion and memory constraints, and report operational experience from production deployment. The integration of multimodal vision for end-state detection and tool calling for backend state transitions enables comprehensive regression testing that bridges UI interactions with system state. Our results demonstrate that AI-driven testing can maintain stability while eliminating the brittleness of traditional automated tests, enabling continuous quality assurance at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 DragonCrawl，一个面向移动端持续回归测试的 AI 驱动测试系统，其架构从 V1 的语义嵌入相似度匹配演变为 V2 的基于大语言模型的生成式意图推理。系统利用 GPT-4o 的多模态能力验证每次代码变更后的用户流程，并阻止破坏关键功能的提交。在 CI/CD 管道中运行 1,013 个自动化测试，iOS 和 Android 上分别达到 91.6% 和 92.2% 的通过率，测试上线时间从 96-120 小时降至 4 小时以内，并估计节省了约 27 人年的测试维护工作量。
Motivation: 传统移动端端到端测试框架面临 UI 易变、维护开销大和跨平台扩展性差等问题，而现有基于 LLM 的测试研究多聚焦于探索性测试和崩溃检测，缺乏对每次代码变更的关键用户流程验证。
Method: 提出生成式意图推理测试框架 DragonCrawl，结合 GPT-4o 的多模态能力进行端状态检测，并通过工具调用 (tool calling) 实现后端状态转换，从而将 UI 交互与系统状态桥接；系统从 V1 的语义嵌入匹配演进到 V2 的生成式意图推理。
Result: 在 1,013 个自动化测试上取得 iOS 91.6%、Android 92.2% 的通过率；将测试接入时间从 96-120 小时减少到 4 小时以内，并估计节省 27 人年的测试维护工作量。
Conclusion: 作者报告了生产部署中的运行经验，包括 token 爆炸和内存约束等实现挑战，并认为 AI 驱动的测试可以在消除传统自动化测试脆弱性的同时维持稳定性，实现大规模持续质量保障。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mirror Learning
papers.abstract_en: We investigate imitation learning through the lens of third-person observation and propose a framework for mirror learning: acquiring actionable policies from passive observation. While behavior cloning (BC) excels under dense, well-aligned first-person data, it fundamentally fails to leverage the rich observational signals arising from third-person demonstrations that humans and animals routinely exploit. We introduce a method that composes (i) a learned perspective transformation that places learners in demonstrators' shoes using a fine-tuned video diffusion model and (ii) an inverse dynamics model that infers action trajectories in the learners' control space. This enables the synthesis of mirror data, pseudo first-person expert data generated from third-person observations of demonstrator behavior. Empirically, we show that mirror data alone can train effective policies, and that augmenting first-person BC training with mirror data further improves downstream policy performance. Our results suggest that modern generative world models implicitly encode sufficient structure to enable a scalable and safe alternative to teleoperation-heavy data collection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 mirror learning 框架，研究如何从第三人称观察中获取可行动策略。方法将微调视频扩散模型 (video diffusion model) 学到的视角变换与逆动力学模型 (inverse dynamics model) 组合，把第三人称演示合成为伪第一人称的镜像数据 (mirror data)，并验证这些数据可单独训练策略，也能增强第一人称行为克隆 (BC) 的训练。
Motivation: 行为克隆在第一人称、稠密且对齐的数据上表现良好，但无法利用人类和动物常依赖的第三人称演示所蕴含的丰富观察信号。
Method: 组合两个组件：一是用微调视频扩散模型学习视角变换，使学习者处于演示者的视角；二是用逆动力学模型在学习者的控制空间内推断动作轨迹，从而从第三人称观察合成镜像数据。
Result: 实验显示镜像数据单独即可训练有效策略，并且将镜像数据添加到第一人称 BC 训练中能进一步提升下游策略性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为现代生成式世界模型隐式编码了足够的结构信息，可提供一种可扩展且安全的替代方案，减少对遥操作 (teleoperation) 数据采集的依赖。

papers.title: A user's guide to PINNs in geometric analysis: lessons from the asymptotic Plateau problem
papers.abstract_en: This proceedings contribution elaborates on the findings of arXiv:2605.26234v2: a joint work with Marco Usula, where we introduced a machine learning framework based on physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), aimed at constructing near-minimal discs in hyperbolic space asymptotic to a prescribed knot at infinity. We used this method to provide numerical evidence for a conjecture of Joel Fine relating minimal surfaces in $H^{4}$ to the coefficients of the HOMFLY polynomial. This is a methodological companion to that paper, based on a presentation given at the 2026 edition of the workshop "DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry". Rather than reviewing the results, which are presented extensively in the preprint above, we discuss the two aspects of the framework which, in our experience, determined whether the method worked at all. First, the geometry of the problem must be encoded in the architecture of the model, so that the boundary condition and asymptotics at infinity hold exactly for every value of the learnable parameters - leaving us with a single-component loss function; second, the evaluation of the PDE residual must be engineered with care to ensure that complete trainings can be performed in a reasonable time. On the latter point, we describe two implementation techniques which are not spelled out in detail in the original paper: replacing nested reverse-mode automatic differentiation with the forward propagation of second-order jets, and compiling the computational graph of the residual once instead of rebuilding it at every optimisation step. Together, on identical hardware, these two changes reduce the cost of a training step by a factor of roughly forty to fifty. We hope these methodological discussions can be useful for researchers in differential geometry and geometric analysis who wish to deploy PINNs on problems of their own.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 arXiv:2605.26234v2 的方法论补充，讨论基于物理信息神经网络 (PINNs) 在双曲空间中构造以给定无穷远结为边界的近似极小圆盘。文章指出两个决定方法是否可行的关键：把几何信息编码进网络架构，使边界条件与无穷远渐近性对任意可学习参数都精确成立，从而损失函数只有单一分量；以及对 PDE 残差求值做工程化处理以节省训练时间。作者还给出两种原论文未展开的实现技巧：用二阶 jets 前向传播替代嵌套反向模式自动微分，并将残差计算图只编译一次而非每次优化重建，二者在相同硬件上使单步训练成本降低约 40–50 倍。
Motivation: 原论文用 PINNs 为 Joel Fine 关于 H^4 中极小曲面与 HOMFLY 多项式系数的猜想提供数值证据，但实现细节未充分展开；本文作为会议 proceedings 的方法论同伴文章，目标是帮助微分几何与几何分析研究者将 PINNs 应用于自己的问题。
Method: 框架包含两方面：一是将双曲空间几何和无穷远边界条件直接编码进模型架构，使边界条件与渐近行为在参数空间中恒成立，最终只剩单一分量损失；二是谨慎设计 PDE 残差评估，具体技巧包括用二阶 jets 的前向传播替换嵌套反向模式自动微分，以及只编译一次残差计算图而不再每步重建。
Result: 摘要报告，两项实现技巧在相同硬件上把单步训练成本降低约 40–50 倍；关于 Fine 猜想的数值证据等结果不在本文复述，而是指向 arXiv:2605.26234v2。
Conclusion: 作者希望这些方法论讨论对希望部署 PINNs 的微分几何与几何分析研究者有用；本文定位为方法论配套文档，不系统回顾原论文的结果。

papers.title: MMFGU: Multimodal Federated Graph Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal federated graph learning enables clients to collaboratively train graph models over structural, textual, and visual signals without sharing private local data. However, the presence of heterogeneous multimodal content also makes unlearning requests more frequent and fine-grained: users may delete accounts or interactions, remove a particular image or text while retaining the associated entity, or revoke the learned correspondence between retained modalities or graph attributes. Existing federated graph unlearning mainly handles entity/relation or client removal and cannot directly satisfy these multimodal requests. They introduce three challenges: removing only the requested information without damaging retained content, preventing the target from being recovered through remaining modalities or graph neighborhoods, and stopping related traces on other clients from re-entering the global model after aggregation. To address them, we propose \textsc{\textbf{MMFGU}}, a multimodal federated graph unlearning framework built around target-specific representation decoupling. \textsc{MMFGU} maps heterogeneous requests into unified target carriers, decouples requested representations while anchoring retained semantics, exposes and repairs propagated residuals with lightweight probes, and selectively purges affected clients through compact prototype and response signals. Experiments show that \textsc{MMFGU} effectively removes requested information, preserves retained graph utility, and achieves a $\boldsymbol{41.5\times}$ speedup over full retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMFGU，一个面向多模态联邦图学习的遗忘（unlearning）框架，用于处理结构、文本和视觉信号上的细粒度遗忘请求。框架将异构请求映射为统一目标载体，通过目标特定表示解耦（representation decoupling）移除请求信息并锚定保留语义，用轻量探针暴露和修复传播残差，再基于原型（prototype）和响应信号选择性净化受影响客户端。实验表明 MMFGU 能有效移除请求信息、保留图效用，并比完全重训练快 41.5 倍。
Motivation: 现有联邦图遗忘方法主要处理实体/关系或客户端删除，无法满足多模态内容带来的更细粒度请求，例如删除某个图像或文本但保留关联实体、撤销保留模态之间或图属性上的对应关系。作者指出这带来三个挑战：只移除请求信息而不损伤保留内容、防止目标通过剩余模态或图邻域被恢复、以及阻止其他客户端的相关痕迹在聚合后重新进入全局模型。
Method: MMFGU 围绕目标特定表示解耦构建：把异构遗忘请求统一映射为目标载体，解耦请求对应表示同时锚定保留语义；用轻量探针暴露并修复传播残差；通过紧凑的原型和响应信号选择性净化受影响的客户端，从而在联邦聚合层面切断痕迹回渗。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明 MMFGU 能有效移除请求信息、保留剩余图的效用，并实现相对完全重训练 41.5 倍的加速。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MMFGU 填补了多模态联邦图学习中的细粒度遗忘请求空白，兼顾遗忘效果、保留效用与训练效率。摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Accelerated Random-Sweep Gibbs Sampling for Gaussian Graphical Models via Dual Normal Factor Graphs
papers.abstract_en: We study the convergence properties of the random-sweep Gibbs sampler for Gaussian graphical models with a thin-membrane prior. We demonstrate that the convergence rate of the Gibbs sampler is significantly accelerated in the dual model, which is obtained by applying the Fourier transform to the local factors of the normal factor graph representing the original model. In both domains, we derive the exact convergence rates for homogeneous $k$-regular graphs. We prove that, for all homogeneous models whose graphical representations contain cycles, the convergence rate in the dual domain is universal and independent of the underlying graph topology. Moreover, we show that the effective convergence rate in the dual domain is governed by the algebraic connectivity of the graph, providing an additional acceleration without increasing the computational complexity per sweep. We further establish an explicit algebraic relation between the covariance structures of the primal and dual models, enabling marginal statistics of the primal model to be recovered directly from those of the dual model. Finally, numerical experiments on several graph families confirm our theoretical results and demonstrate substantial improvements in the convergence rates in various settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有薄膜先验 (thin-membrane prior) 的高斯图模型上随机扫描 Gibbs 采样器的收敛性质，提出对表示原始模型的正常因子图 (normal factor graph) 的局部因子应用傅里叶变换得到对偶模型，并在对偶域中采样以加速收敛。理论部分对齐次 k-正则图给出精确收敛率，并证明含有环的齐次模型在对偶域的收敛率与图拓扑无关，仅由代数连通度控制。数值实验在多个图族上验证了理论结果并显示收敛率显著提升。
Motivation: 随机扫描 Gibbs 采样器在高斯图模型上的收敛速度受图结构影响，尤其在使用薄膜先验时可能较慢；论文目标是找到一种不增加每轮计算复杂度的加速采样途径。
Method: 对原始高斯图模型对应的正常因子图 (normal factor graph) 中的局部因子做傅里叶变换，得到对偶模型并在对偶域运行随机扫描 Gibbs 采样器；同时建立原模型与对偶模型协方差结构之间的显式代数关系，以便从对偶模型的边际统计量恢复原模型统计量。
Result: 对齐次 k-正则图推导出原域和对偶域的精确收敛率；证明对含有环的齐次模型，对偶域的收敛率是普适的且不依赖底层图拓扑，实际有效收敛率由图的代数连通度 (algebraic connectivity) 主导。多个图族上的数值实验证实理论结果，并在多种设置中带来收敛率的实质性改善。
Conclusion: 作者强调对偶域表示能显著加速 Gibbs 采样且不增加每轮计算复杂度，并通过协方差结构的显式关系直接恢复原始模型的边际统计量。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Simulative Anomaly Detection using 2D Tomography
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel technique for predicting the imaging quality of anomalies such as cancer cells located inside organic tissues. This technique is useful for evaluating and designing RF tomography sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于预测有机组织内部异常物（如癌细胞）成像质量的技术，基于二维断层成像 (2D tomography) 进行模拟异常检测。摘要指出该技术可用于评估和设计射频断层成像 (RF tomography) 传感器，但没有报告具体算法细节或定量结果。
Motivation: 面向 RF 断层成像传感器在设计与评估环节难以预先判断异常目标成像质量的问题，提出一种仿真层面的预测手段。
Method: 提出一种基于 2D 断层成像的模拟异常检测技术，通过预测异常物在有机组织内的成像质量来支持传感器的评估与设计。
Conclusion: 摘要将这项技术定位为评估与设计 RF 断层成像传感器的有用工具；论文仅 3 页，摘要中未给出实验细节或局限说明。

papers.title: WitCert: Sound Runtime Risk Observability and Gating for KV-Cache Quantization
papers.abstract_en: KV-cache quantization is validated today by offline benchmark averages; a deployed system cannot tell whether compression is damaging the request it is serving right now. We give it a provably sound runtime meter, a "DTrace for KV quantization": a per-(layer, head, step) upper bound on the total variation between exact and compressed attention. The meter has two tiers: a deterministic band-norm-witness bound, sound for any cache-preserving black-box quantizer and for any query (adaptive-safe, worst-case Cauchy-Schwarz plus RoPE band-unitarity), and a tighter probabilistic certificate for a controlled subtractively-dithered INT8 quantizer under an explicit request-level failure budget (stated for non-adaptive queries; core theorems machine-checked in Lean 4). Three results. Observability: the meter enters SGLang through an environment-guarded patch, and any scheme registered as one tensor function is measured in live serving. Repair: meter-driven gating, risk-ranked where the witness is saturated and certified where it is informative, empirically restores the quality floor at benchmark scale. For example, raw-cast FP8 improves from 22.8 back to 79.7 on hard RULER tasks, with the difference from uncompressed bounded at [+0.0, +0.8] by a paired test. Analysis: aggressive schemes survive on cross-layer error cancellation, not per-step fidelity. In a 28-layer sweep, no single layer's pollution alone loses anything (0/28), and the certified INT8 cache serves 1.88 times more KV tokens at the same memory in SGLang.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 7 figures. Includes machine-checked Lean 4 proofs and end-to-end SGLang evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WitCert，一个为 KV-cache 量化提供可证明有界运行时风险观测与门控（gating）的机制，可视为“KV 量化的 DTrace”。它针对每个 (layer, head, step) 给出精确注意力与压缩注意力之间总变差的上界，分为确定性 band-norm-witness 界与面向受控减性抖动 INT8 量化器的概率证书两类，核心定理在 Lean 4 中做了机器验证。该系统通过环境守卫补丁接入 SGLang，能够在线测量任意注册为张量函数的量化方案，并依据风险排序进行门控修复。实验显示，raw-cast FP8 在困难 RULER 任务上从 22.8 恢复到 79.7，且与未压缩版本的差异由配对检验界于 [+0.0, +0.8]。
Motivation: KV-cache 量化目前仅靠离线基准平均值来验证，部署中的系统无法判断压缩是否正在损害当前正在服务的请求。研究者希望为运行时提供可证明可靠的观测手段，而不是依赖静态平均指标。
Method: 提出了一个两层运行时计量器：一层是对任意保持缓存的不可知量化器（adaptive-safe）都成立的确定性 band-norm-witness 上界，基于 Cauchy-Schwarz 与 RoPE 的 band-unitarity；另一层是针对特定减性抖动 INT8 量化器的更紧概率证书，在显式请求级失败预算下给出（声明适用于非自适应查询），核心定理在 Lean 4 中机器验证。计量器通过环境守卫补丁接入 SGLang，并基于 witness 饱和程度与证书信息量进行风险排序的门控修复。
Result: 摘要报告三项结果：观测上，方案在 SGLang 中实现在线测量；修复上，门控在基准规模下恢复质量下限，例如 raw-cast FP8 在困难 RULER 任务上从 22.8 提升到 79.7，与未压缩版本的差异界于 [+0.0, +0.8]；分析上，在 28 层扫描中没有任何单层污染单独造成损失（0/28），而经过认证的 INT8 缓存在相同内存下可服务 1.88 倍的 KV token。
Conclusion: 作者强调，激进的量化方案之所以能存活，依赖的是跨层错误抵消而非每步保真度；WitCert 通过可证明的运行时边界与门控来恢复质量下限。论文同时指出概率证书部分目前仅针对非自适应查询，且核心定理的机器验证范围以摘要所述为准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow Matching with Missing Data
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching assumes fully observed training data, which many real-world applications rarely provide. We propose Missing-Data Flow Matching, which treats the missing coordinates of training samples as latent variables and averages the flow matching loss over the values they could take. We first prove the correction is exact rather than approximate. Under missing completely at random with true completions, the incomplete-data objective equals the complete-data objective, so missingness changes nothing about what flow matching learns and the entire difficulty relocates to the completion model. Our finite-sample analysis then answers design questions that the algorithm leaves open, and the answers are not the ones intuition suggests. Missingness transfers estimator variance rather than adding it, one completion per example already matches complete-data variance exactly, and under a fixed evaluation budget one completion is optimal. A learned completion model contributes a single irreducible bias, which we bound by its expected conditional Wasserstein distance to the true completion law. Experiments numerically validate the theoretical predictions, show that deterministic rather than frozen imputation is what collapses the generated distribution, and place our method alongside strong classical and deep imputation baselines on real tabular data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出缺失数据流匹配 (Missing-Data Flow Matching)，将训练样本的缺失坐标视为隐变量，并对这些坐标的可能取值做流匹配损失的期望。作者证明在完全随机缺失 (MCAR) 与真实补全条件下该修正是精确而非近似的：不完整数据目标与完整数据目标相等，因此缺失本身不改变流匹配的学习内容，全部困难转移到补全模型。有限样本分析给出若干反直觉结论，数值实验在真实表格数据上验证了理论预测，并比较了经典与深度插补基线。
Motivation: 流匹配通常假设训练数据完全观测，而现实应用常存在缺失值；现有做法缺少对缺失条件下目标函数性质的严格刻画，也不清楚缺失如何影响估计误差和补全策略的选择。
Method: 将缺失坐标作为隐变量，对缺失坐标可能取值求流匹配损失的期望，证明该目标在 MCAR 与真实补全下与完整数据目标精确相等；随后进行有限样本分析，刻画估计量方差在缺失性下的转移，并用期望条件 Wasserstein 距离界定学习补全模型带来的单一不可约偏差。
Result: 摘要报告：缺失性转移而非增加估计量方差；每个样本一次补全即可精确匹配完整数据方差；在固定评估预算下一次补全最优。实验验证这些理论预测，并表明导致生成分布坍缩的是确定性插补而非冻结插补，方法在真实表格数据上与经典及深度插补基线相当。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作将缺失数据流匹配问题归约为补全模型的设计，并给出补全数量与方差、偏差的定量答案；实验层面聚焦于真实表格数据，验证了理论正确性。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出缺失数据流匹配 (Missing-Data Flow Matching)，将训练样本的缺失坐标视为隐变量，并对这些坐标的可能取值做流匹配损失的期望。作者证明在完全随机缺失 (MCAR) 与真实补全条件下该修正是精确而非近似的：不完整数据目标与完整数据目标相等，因此缺失本身不改变流匹配的学习内容，全部困难转移到补全模型。有限样本分析给出若干反直觉结论，数值实验在真实表格数据上验证了理论预测，并比较了经典与深度插补基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 流匹配通常假设训练数据完全观测，而现实应用常存在缺失值；现有做法缺少对缺失条件下目标函数性质的严格刻画，也不清楚缺失如何影响估计误差和补全策略的选择。
summary_sections.method: 将缺失坐标作为隐变量，对缺失坐标可能取值求流匹配损失的期望，证明该目标在 MCAR 与真实补全下与完整数据目标精确相等；随后进行有限样本分析，刻画估计量方差在缺失性下的转移，并用期望条件 Wasserstein 距离界定学习补全模型带来的单一不可约偏差。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：缺失性转移而非增加估计量方差；每个样本一次补全即可精确匹配完整数据方差；在固定评估预算下一次补全最优。实验验证这些理论预测，并表明导致生成分布坍缩的是确定性插补而非冻结插补，方法在真实表格数据上与经典及深度插补基线相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调该工作将缺失数据流匹配问题归约为补全模型的设计，并给出补全数量与方差、偏差的定量答案；实验层面聚焦于真实表格数据，验证了理论正确性。

papers.title: Mitigating Class-Tail Undercoverage in Medical Vision-Language Models under Clinical Shift
papers.abstract_en: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) can retain high observed marginal coverage after clinical shift while substantially under-covering an individual disease class. The affected class varies with acquisition protocol and backbone geometry, so source prevalence does not reliably reveal the failure. Existing localized and tail-aware conformal methods respectively adapt to test neighborhoods and source-frequency tails, leaving held-out class-wise coverage failure unmodeled. We introduce Class-Tail Adaptive Localized Conformal Deferral (CALCoDe), a post-hoc reliability layer for frozen medical VLMs. Cross-fitted validation predictions identify classes at risk of undercoverage, and a disjoint calibration split estimates their class-conditional tail thresholds. CALCoDe combines each protected threshold with a localized conformal threshold using a one-sided maximum. The resulting set contains every label admitted by the localized rule, with additional protection confined to validation-identified classes. An independently calibrated support audit defers cases with insufficient inlier support. Under exchangeability among accepted examples within each protected class, CALCoDe provides finite-sample coverage at the prespecified guard level and contains the corresponding localized conformal sets; coverage on shifted external cohorts is evaluated empirically. Among standard conformal baselines and recent VLM-specific conformal methods evaluated across two dermatology shifts (HAM10000 to ISIC 2019 and HAM10000 to PAD-UFES-20) and four frozen VLM backbones (BiomedCLIP, OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32, PubMedCLIP ViT-B/32, and MedSigLIP-448), CALCoDe is the only approach whose observed marginal and worst-class accepted coverage both reach 0.95 in all eight settings. On HAM10000 to ISIC 2019, its average worst-class accepted coverage is 0.970, compared with 0.926 for sTACP and 0.864 for LCP-VLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CALCoDe（Class-Tail Adaptive Localized Conformal Deferral），一种用于冻结医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）的后置可靠性层，旨在解决临床分布偏移下个别疾病类别覆盖率不足的问题。该方法通过交叉拟合验证识别有欠覆盖风险的类别，用不相交的校准分割估计类条件尾部阈值，并将其与局部共形阈值通过单侧最大值结合；独立校准的支持审计会延迟低支持样本。在两种皮肤科偏移场景和四种冻结 VLM 骨干上，CALCoDe 是唯一在全部八种设置中边际和最差类别接受覆盖率均达到 0.95 的方法。
Motivation: 医学 VLM 在临床偏移后可能保持较高的总体边际覆盖率，但某个疾病类别的覆盖率会显著不足，且受影响类别随采集协议和骨干网络几何而变化，源域患病率无法可靠预测该失败。现有的局部共形方法和尾部感知方法分别适应测试邻域和源频率尾部，但未对保留类别的类条件覆盖失败建模。
Method: 提出 CALCoDe：使用交叉拟合验证预测识别有欠覆盖风险的类别，从不相交的校准分割中估计这些类别的类条件尾部阈值，并将每个受保护阈值与局部共形阈值通过单侧最大值（one-sided maximum）结合，使得输出集合包含局部规则接受的所有标签，同时额外保护仅限于验证识别的类别。另有一个独立校准的支持审计，用于延迟内嵌支持不足的样本。理论保证在受保护类别内被接受样本满足可交换性时，提供预设保护水平下的有限样本覆盖率，并包含相应局部共形集合。
Result: 在两个皮肤科偏移基准（HAM10000 到 ISIC 2019、HAM10000 到 PAD-UFES-20）和四个冻结 VLM 骨干（BiomedCLIP、OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32、PubMedCLIP ViT-B/32、MedSigLIP-448）上，CALCoDe 是唯一在所有八种设置中边际和最差类别接受覆盖率都达到 0.95 的方法。在 HAM10000 到 ISIC 2019 上，其平均最差类别接受覆盖率为 0.970，而 sTACP 为 0.926，LCP-VLM 为 0.864。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 CALCoDe 为冻结医学 VLM 提供带有限样本覆盖率保证的后置可靠性层，并在临床偏移的外部队列上通过经验评估验证覆盖率。作者强调该方法在边际与最差类别覆盖率上均优于标准共形基线及近期 VLM 特定共形方法。

papers.title: Predicting Steel Fatigue Life from Micrographs Using Physics-Informed Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Here is the plain text version optimized for arXiv's submission form. Custom macros (like \CV and \SI) have been converted to standard text/math so they render correctly on the webpage: Evaluating the fatigue life of structural steels conventionally requires mechanical testing lasting tens to hundreds of hours, making it impractical for rapid quality control. We present CV, a computer vision framework that estimates the fatigue life ($\log N_f$) of lightweight alloy steels directly from optical micrographs without physical testing.The pipeline features a seven-stage OpenCV preprocessing routine to remove artifacts, a 28-dimensional physics-informed feature extractor (quantifying crack morphology, grain structure, porosity, and texture), and a CNN regression model trained with a Gaussian negative log-likelihood (GNLL) loss to jointly predict $\log N_f$ and sample-specific uncertainty $\hatσ$.Evaluating three architectures (SE-CNN, ResNet-50, VGG-16) on a synthetic micrograph benchmark, ResNet-50 achieves $R^2 = 0.93$, RMSE = 0.18 log-cycles, and macro-F1 = 0.91. The GNLL objective reduces Expected Calibration Error by 76% compared to a mean-squared-error baseline (ECE: $0.089 \rightarrow 0.021$). Grad-CAM maps confirm the network attends to metallurgically meaningful microstructural features.Running in under 65 ms per image, the pipeline and synthetic dataset generator are open-sourced. Because validation relies entirely on synthetic micrographs, these results demonstrate methodological soundness under simulated conditions; a domain-transfer study on real field samples is the immediate next step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 CV 的计算机视觉框架，直接从光学显微图像估计轻量化合金钢的疲劳寿命 (log N_f)，无需机械测试。流程包含七阶段 OpenCV 预处理、28 维物理信息特征提取器 (裂纹形态、晶粒结构、孔隙率、纹理) 以及用高斯负对数似然 (GNLL) 损失训练的 CNN 回归模型，同时预测寿命与样本不确定性。在合成显微图像基准上，ResNet-50 达到 R²=0.93、RMSE=0.18 log-cycles、macro-F1=0.91；GNLL 将期望校准误差 (ECE) 从 0.089 降至 0.021。作者指出验证完全依赖合成显微图像，下一步是真实现场样本的域迁移研究。
Motivation: 结构钢疲劳寿命的传统评估需要数十至数百小时的机械测试，难以满足快速质量控制需求。本文针对这一瓶颈，尝试用显微图像直接预测疲劳寿命以替代物理测试。
Method: 提出 CV 框架：先经七阶段 OpenCV 预处理去除伪影，再提取 28 维物理信息特征 (裂纹形态、晶粒结构、孔隙率、纹理)，最后用 CNN 回归模型以高斯负对数似然损失联合预测 log N_f 和样本级不确定性。评估了 SE-CNN、ResNet-50、VGG-16 三种架构。
Result: 在合成显微图像基准上，ResNet-50 达到 R²=0.93、RMSE=0.18 log-cycles、macro-F1=0.91；GNLL 相比均方误差基线将 ECE 降低 76% (0.089→0.021)。Grad-CAM 显示网络关注冶金学上有意义的微观特征，单张图像推理耗时低于 65 ms。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果证明方法在合成条件下具有方法学合理性，但验证完全依赖合成显微图像；对真实现场样本的域迁移研究是直接下一步。

papers.title: SEDR-Seq2P: A Lightweight Dilated Residual Sequence-to-Point Network for Multi-Task Industrial NILM
papers.abstract_en: Industrial NILM remains challenging because measurement noise and widespread concurrent machine operation reduce the generalization of models tuned on residential data. This work adopts a one-to-many, multi-task disaggregation setting, in which a single network estimates multiple industrial machine loads from aggregate power. Under a unified evaluation protocol on IMDELD, we benchmark Seq2Seq, Seq2SubSeq, Seq2Point, GRU, and WaveNet using energy-estimation metrics and the accuracy-delay criterion. While Seq2Point offers a stronger accuracy-delay balance than Seq2Seq/Seq2SubSeq, GRU and WaveNet achieve higher accuracy at markedly higher computational cost. To close this gap, we propose SEDR-Seq2P, a lightweight Seq2Point extension with dilated residual blocks and squeeze-and-excitation attention. Relative to the Seq2Point baseline, SEDR-Seq2P reduces MAE by approximately 7%, improves the coefficient of determination by approximately 1%, and increases the match rate by approximately 0.8%. In addition, compared to WaveNet, SEDR-Seq2P reduces inference latency by approximately 58%, yielding a favorable accuracy-delay trade-off for scalable industrial deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业 NILM（非侵入式负荷监测）中测量噪声与多设备并发运行导致模型泛化差的问题，采用一对多、多任务分解设置，在统一评估协议下对比 Seq2Seq、Seq2SubSeq、Seq2Point、GRU 和 WaveNet，并提出轻量级 SEDR-Seq2P 网络。该网络是 Seq2Point 的扩展，引入膨胀残差块与 squeeze-and-excitation 注意力；在 IMDELD 数据集上相对 Seq2Point 基线将 MAE 降低约 7%、决定系数提高约 1%、匹配率提高约 0.8%，相对 WaveNet 将推理延迟降低约 58%。
Motivation: 工业 NILM 因测量噪声和广泛的并发机器运行而具有挑战性，依赖住宅数据调优的模型难以泛化到工业场景；同时高精度方法（如 GRU、WaveNet）计算成本显著偏高，需要更轻量且准确率-延迟权衡更优的方案。
Method: 采用一对多、多任务分解的负荷分解框架，由单一网络从聚合功率中估计多个工业设备负荷。提出 SEDR-Seq2P，一种轻量级 Seq2Point 扩展，核心组件为膨胀残差块（dilated residual blocks）和挤压激励注意力（squeeze-and-excitation attention）。
Result: 在统一评估协议下，使用能量估计指标和准确率-延迟准则对 IMDELD 上的五种基线进行基准测试；SEDR-Seq2P 相对 Seq2Point 将 MAE 降低约 7%、决定系数提升约 1%、匹配率提升约 0.8%，相对 WaveNet 将推理延迟降低约 58%。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，在保持轻量级结构的同时，SEDR-Seq2P 能取得优于 Seq2Point 的精度并显著低于 WaveNet 的延迟，适合可扩展的工业部署场景。

papers.title: SciToolAgent-Evo: An Ontology-Aware Self-Evolving Agent for Open-World Scientific Tool Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have been increasingly adopted in scientific research for organizing and invoking specialized computational tools. However, their reliance on predefined tool spaces with static semantics limits their applicability to open-world scientific workflows, where tool requirements, capabilities, and boundaries evolve dynamically. To this end, we propose SciToolAgent-Evo, an ontology-aware self-evolving agent for open-world scientific tool acquisition. Driven by an evolving memory of skills, experiences, and an ontologized tool graph, it distills generalizable knowledge from contrastive trajectories during accumulation, whereas during inference, it formulates active requests and utilizes a LinUCB-based bandit gate to dynamically balance exploration and exploitation. Once a novel tool is acquired, its scientific ontology is completed online for seamless integration into the known graph. Moreover, we introduce OpenSciToolBench, a benchmark containing 900 realistic tasks across four difficulty levels. Extensive evaluations show that SciToolAgent-Evo achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its robustness and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SciToolAgent-Evo，一个面向开放世界科学工具获取的本体感知自进化智能体。它维护技能、经验与本体化工具图 (ontologized tool graph) 的演化记忆，在知识积累阶段从对比轨迹 (contrastive trajectories) 中蒸馏可泛化知识，在推理阶段利用基于 LinUCB 的 bandit gate 动态平衡探索与利用；获取新工具后在线补全其科学本体以无缝接入已有图。作者还引入包含 900 个任务、四个难度等级的基准 OpenSciToolBench，实验表明该方法达到 state-of-the-art，并验证了其鲁棒性与泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体依赖预定义工具空间和静态语义，难以应对开放世界科学工作流中工具需求、能力与边界动态演化的问题。
Method: 提出本体感知的自进化智能体架构，包含演化记忆（技能、经验、本体化工具图），在积累阶段从对比轨迹中蒸馏知识；推理时通过 LinUCB 的 bandit gate 动态平衡探索与利用；对获取的新工具在线完善其科学本体并融入已知图。同时构建了包含 900 个真实任务、横跨四个难度级别的基准 OpenSciToolBench。
Result: 摘要报告 SciToolAgent-Evo 在 OpenSciToolBench 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并验证了方法的鲁棒性与泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该智能体能够有效处理开放世界科学工具获取，并展现出良好的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Relevance: 5
