papers.title: Code Is the Body: Agent-Owned Software Bodies for Recursive Evolution and Descent
authors: Zhenyu Zhao (2) ((1) Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Personalized AI agents are often configurable without giving users control over the artifacts that determine their future behavior. We present OurArk, an architecture for persistent personal agents centered on an agent-owned software body: an identity-bearing, inspectable, and versioned artifact under human custody. The body contains behavior-defining code, prompts, tools, skills, policies, tests, and evolution mechanisms. Memories and credentials remain private instance state, while model inference is treated as a replaceable external service. OurArk defines governed self-evolution and recursive descent over the same body. Self-evolution produces isolated candidate changes that are validated, reviewed, and merged under human control, enabling human-agent co-development of the agent's software body. Descent creates an independently versioned descendant with a distinct identity, mission, history, and fresh private-state boundary; compatible descendants can themselves source further descent. After divergence, direct-parent changes and peer skills can be inspected for selective local adaptation. We implement the architecture in the open-source Genesis creation engine and Enoch reference agent. A four-agent, three-descent linear lineage and executable regression tests demonstrate recursive creation, inherited validation contracts, isolated body changes, human-controlled review, and failed-update recovery. OurArk provides a concrete substrate for personal agents that people can possess, govern, specialize, and evolve over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OurArk 架构，以“代理拥有的软件实体”（agent-owned software body）为核心，为持久化个人代理提供具有身份、可检查、可版本化且由人类保管的构建产物。该实体包含行为定义代码、提示、工具、技能、策略、测试与演化机制；自演化产生隔离的候选修改，经人工验证、审查与合并，而“下降”（descent）机制则创建具有独立身份、任务、历史和全新私有状态边界的后代版本。作者在开源的 Genesis 创建引擎和 Enoch 参考代理上实现了该架构。
Motivation: 现有个人化 AI 代理通常可配置，但用户无法控制决定其未来行为的构建产物（artifacts），缺乏对代理的持久占有、治理、专门化与长期演化能力。
Method: 提出 OurArk 架构，将行为定义集中在代理拥有的软件实体中，记忆与凭据作为私有实例状态，模型推理作为可替换的外部服务；定义受治理的自演化（self-evolution）和递归下降（recursive descent）机制，并实现为 Genesis 创建引擎与 Enoch 参考代理。
Result: 通过一个四代理、三次下降的线性谱系和可执行回归测试，演示了递归创建、继承的验证契约、隔离的实体变更、人工控制的审查以及失败更新的恢复。摘要未提供定量数值结果。
Conclusion: OurArk 为个人代理提供可被用户占有、治理、专用化和长期演化的具体基础（substrate），但摘要强调的是架构设计与定性验证，未给出实验基准或局限性讨论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reflected UAS: Corrected Deterministic Stability and Direct CTMC Drift Calculation
papers.abstract_en: We analyze Reflected UAS routing for heterogeneous multi-server queues at fixed parameters under subcritical load. The deterministic surrogate is a reflected ODE on the nonnegative orthant, not the unconstrained drift equation. This reflected ODE has a unique boundary equilibrium characterized by a scalar consistency equation and a convex-potential representation; all trajectories converge to it. The older argument lifting deterministic Lyapunov descent to CTMC stability fails: the exact generator applied to the deterministic potential produces a boundary term absent from the reflected-ODE descent identity. We give a direct Foster-Lyapunov drift inequality for the CTMC using a weighted-quadratic function, bypassing the failed lift. At the benchmark parameter point, the boundary equilibrium matches the numerical attractor to machine precision, and the default Reflected UAS policy has lower mean queue length than UAS and JSSQ across independent seed blocks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究异构多服务器队列在亚临界负载下、固定参数时的 Reflected UAS 路由策略。作者指出正确的确定性代理是定义在非负象限上的反射 ODE（reflected ODE），而非无约束漂移方程；该 ODE 存在由标量一致性方程和凸势表示刻画的唯一边界平衡点，且所有轨迹收敛到它。旧的“将确定性 Lyapunov 下降提升为 CTMC 稳定性”的论证被证明失效，作者转而直接对 CTMC 给出加权二次型函数的 Foster-Lyapunov 漂移不等式。基准参数点上，边界平衡点与数值吸引子达到机器精度一致，且默认 Reflected UAS 策略的平均队列长度在独立随机种子块上低于 UAS 和 JSSQ。
Motivation: 先前关于 Reflected UAS 的确定性稳定性论证存在缺陷：将确定性 Lyapunov 下降直接提升到 CTMC 稳定性的做法不成立，因为精确生成元作用在确定性势函数上会产生反射 ODE 下降恒等式所没有的边界项。需要修正稳定性分析方法，并直接为随机过程建立稳定性依据。
Method: 将确定性替代系统建模为非负象限上的反射 ODE，用标量一致性方程和凸势表示刻画唯一的边界平衡点；绕过失败的提升论证，直接对 CTMC 构造加权二次型（weighted-quadratic）函数并推导 Foster-Lyapunov 漂移不等式。
Result: 在基准参数点上，反射 ODE 的边界平衡点与数值吸引子精确到机器精度吻合；默认 Reflected UAS 策略在独立随机种子块上的平均队列长度低于 UAS 和 JSSQ。
Conclusion: 摘要强调被忽略的反射边界项是先前证明失败的关键，直接对 CTMC 计算漂移可给出修正后的稳定性证明；实验结果表明 Reflected UAS 在平均队列长度上优于所比较的路由策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Technological Advances in Detecting and Managing Cognitive Impairment in Older Adults: Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: As populations age, cognitive decline from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) to dementia is a defining health challenge of the coming decades, yet routine assessment often misses its earliest signs. This article critically synthesizes recent technological advances for detecting and managing cognitive impairment in older adults, spanning neurophysiological signals (chiefly electroencephalography, EEG), structural and molecular neuroimaging (MRI and amyloid/tau PET), blood-based biomarkers, and digital markers, integrated through artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL). Beyond summarizing, it contributes a cross-disciplinary taxonomy, a methodological-rigor lens foregrounding subject- and site-independent validation, an integrative early-detection framework linking tiered screening to intervention, and comparison tables of detection methods, interventions, and risk and protective factors. EEG markers (alpha/theta changes, P300 latency) and deep models (CNNs, LSTM/BiLSTM, transformers, self-supervised EEG foundation models) report strong accuracy, yet many rest on small, single-site datasets unlikely to survive rigorous external validation. Elsewhere, gains are tangible: plasma p-tau217 has reached clinical utility, with the first blood test cleared to aid Alzheimer's diagnosis in 2025; anti-amyloid therapies (lecanemab, donanemab) are approved despite modest, contested benefits; and multidomain lifestyle prevention has matured. Wearable, remote, speech, and virtual-reality tools enable continuous, ecologically valid monitoring, and multimodal fusion improves sensitivity and specificity. Barriers remain: standardization, explainability, data privacy, and equitable, externally validated deployment. The field's near-term promise lies in trustworthy, multimodal, longitudinally validated systems linking early detection to actionable, personalized care.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，批判性综合了用于老年人认知障碍检测与管理的近期技术进展，涵盖神经生理信号（主要为EEG）、结构与分子神经影像（MRI、淀粉样/Tau PET）、血液生物标志物和数字标志物，并通过AI/ML/DL进行整合。作者贡献了跨学科分类法、强调受试者与站点无关验证的方法学严谨性视角、将分层筛查与干预相连的整合早期检测框架，以及检测方法、干预和风险/保护因素的比较表格。文中指出EEG标志物（alpha/theta变化、P300潜伏期）与深度模型（CNN、LSTM/BiLSTM、Transformer、自监督EEG基础模型）报告了较高准确性，但许多结果基于难以通过严格外部验证的小型单中心数据集。
Motivation: 人口老龄化使得从轻度认知障碍（MCI）到痴呆的认知衰退成为未来几十年的核心健康挑战，然而常规评估往往遗漏其最早期的迹象。
Method: 作者以批判性综述方式综合多模态检测与管理技术，并通过人工智能（AI）、机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）进行整合；同时提出跨学科分类法、方法学严谨性视角、整合早期检测框架以及多种比较表格，而非仅罗列已有结果。
Result: 摘要报告血浆p-tau217已达到临床效用，2025年首个血液测试获批用于辅助阿尔茨海默病诊断；抗淀粉样疗法（lecanemab、donanemab）获批但收益有限且有争议；多领域生活方式预防已成熟。EEG标志物与深度模型报告高准确性，但许多依赖小规模、单中心数据集，难以经受严格外部验证；可穿戴、远程、语音和虚拟现实工具可实现连续、生态有效的监测，多模态融合提高了敏感性与特异性。
Conclusion: 文章强调标准化、可解释性、数据隐私以及公平且外部验证的部署仍是主要障碍；近期的前景在于可信、多模态、经过纵向验证的系统，将早期检测与可操作、个性化的护理联系起来。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Optical Flow Sensor: A Direction-Selective Bionic Retina Design
papers.abstract_en: Optical flow characterizes motion in the visual field and is fundamental to motion perception and tracking in biological and artificial vision systems. Biological retinas extract motion efficiently through local ON/OFF pathways and parallel processing, while conventional frame-based optical flow relies on dense sampling and global computation, resulting in high latency and power consumption. To overcome these limitations, we present a pixel-level Optical Flow Sensor (OFS) integrated circuit. The design combines Dynamic Vision Sensor (DVS) ON/OFF event comparison with time-difference measurement to enable fully parallel optical flow computation on-chip. An optical-flow-specific Address-Event Representation (OF-AER) interface supports low-power, high-throughput readout. \rev{Based on the CMOS-based OFS, we further propose optical memristor-based OFS to reduce sensor power consumption and area overhead.} Experimental results show that the proposed OFS achieves a 303$\times$ reduction in power consumption compared with FPGA-accelerated DVS systems while maintaining microsecond-level latency. Moreover, by directly outputting optical flow vectors, the OFS reduces output data size by approximately 3.3$\times$, demonstrating strong potential for ultra-high-speed, low-power vision sensing applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种像素级光流传感器 (Optical Flow Sensor, OFS) 集成电路，将动态视觉传感器 (DVS) 的 ON/OFF 事件比较与时间差测量结合，在芯片上实现全并行的光流计算。基于 CMOS 的 OFS 还进一步提出了光学忆阻器 (optical memristor) 版本以降低功耗和面积开销。实验显示相比 FPGA 加速的 DVS 系统功耗降低 303 倍，并保持微秒级延迟；直接输出光流向量的方式使输出数据量减少约 3.3 倍。
Motivation: 传统基于帧的光流计算依赖密集采样和全局计算，延迟和功耗高；生物视网膜通过局部 ON/OFF 通路和并行处理高效提取运动信息。本文旨在用像素级电路克服传统方案的延迟与功耗瓶颈。
Method: 设计 OFS 集成电路，利用 DVS ON/OFF 事件比较结合时间差测量实现片上全并行光流计算，并采用面向光流任务的地址事件表示 (OF-AER) 接口支持低功耗高吞吐读出；同时在 CMOS 版基础上提出基于光学忆阻器的 OFS 以降低功耗与面积。

papers.title: Safety, or Just Capability? A Validity Audit of Agent-Safety Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Agent-safety benchmarks measure different behaviors, and their scores get quoted interchangeably as an agent's safety. We treat four of them (R-Judge, InjecAgent, AgentHarm, AgentDojo) as measurements to be validated, running each under its official implementation and author-provided scorer on up to 22 models, with MMLU and GPQA measured by us under one protocol as a capability composite. The metric is the first problem. On any binary trace-judgment benchmark scored by $F_1$, an ``always positive'' policy attains $F_1 = 2π/(1+π)$; on R-Judge that is $0.690$, above five of the 21 models that actually discriminate. The three broad-coverage benchmarks then rank the same 18 models differently, and the trade-off behind that disagreement is a small-panel artifact: R-Judge specificity against AgentHarm safety correlates $-0.64$ at $n{=}7$ and $+0.02$ at $n{=}18$, and a quarter of random size-7 subsets reach $|ρ| \geq 0.5$ around that near-zero value. Held-out validity turns on which outcome you pick. Capability predicts task success ($ρ{=}{+}0.60$) but correlates negatively with misalignment safety ($ρ{=}{-}0.44$, $n{=}21$). On their paired $n{=}20$ panel, the corresponding contrast is $Δ{=}{-}1.00$ (95% CI $[-1.48, -0.49]$, $p<0.001$), and it survives leave-one-organization-out and organization-clustered bootstrap analyses. On an expanded 41-model panel, the misalignment correlation weakens to $-0.16$ (95% CI $[-0.54, +0.22]$) and jailbreak strengthens to $+0.34$, though neither change is significant. \mbox{AgentHarm} shows the strongest held-out association, $ρ{=}{+}0.72$ with three-template jailbreak safety after controlling capability. But both instruments score harmful compliance, so this is evidence of convergent validity rather than general safety. Naming the benchmark, metric, target behavior, and model panel is the minimum a safety claim needs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把四个智能体安全基准（R-Judge、InjecAgent、AgentHarm、AgentDojo）当作待验证的测量工具，在官方实现和作者提供的评分器下对最多 22 个模型运行，并统一用 MMLU 与 GPQA 作为能力复合指标。摘要指出这类基准存在指标缺陷、模型排序不一致以及效度随目标行为而变的问题：在 R-Judge 上‘恒为正’策略也能达到 F1=0.690，能力与任务成功正相关但与错位安全负相关，而 AgentHarm 的关联更多体现聚合效度而非一般安全性。
Motivation: 不同智能体安全基准测量的是不同行为，其分数却被当作智能体安全性的可互换指标；作者认为需要像对待测量工具一样对这些基准进行效度审计。
Method: 在每个基准的官方实现与作者提供的评分器下对最多 22 个模型进行评测，并用统一协议的 MMLU 和 GPQA 作为能力复合指标；随后进行基准间相关性、配对面板对比、留一组织与组织聚类 bootstrap 分析，并扩展到 41 个模型的验证面板。
Result: 在 R-Judge 上‘恒为正’策略可达到 F1=0.690，高于 21 个有判别力模型中的 5 个；三个宽覆盖基准对同一批 18 个模型的排序不一致，R-Judge 特异度与 AgentHarm 安全的相关系数在 n=7 时为 -0.64、在 n=18 时为 +0.02。能力预测任务成功（ρ=+0.60），但与错位安全负相关（ρ=-0.44，n=21）；配对 n=20 面板的对比为 Δ=-1.00（95% CI [-1.48, -0.49]，p<0.001），扩展至 41 模型后错位相关减弱为 -0.16、越狱相关增强为 +0.34。控制能力后 AgentHarm 与三模板越狱安全的关联最强（ρ=+0.72）。
Conclusion: 作者强调两个工具衡量的都是有害顺从，因此 AgentHarm 的关联只构成聚合效度（convergent validity）证据，而非一般安全性；安全声明至少应指明所用基准、指标、目标行为和模型面板。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Library Reachability in LSR-Synth: How Anti-Memorization Design Changes the Measurement of Symbolic Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Existing benchmarks for scientific equation discovery are largely composed of well-known equations available in the public domain, making it difficult to determine whether a model is discovering laws from data or merely recalling answers from its training corpus. LSR-Synth mitigates this problem by introducing novel synthetic terms into established scientific mechanisms and filtering the resulting tasks for novelty, solvability, and scientific plausibility. This paper examines a narrower measurement question: can these tasks further distinguish scientific priors supplied by language models from conventional operator search that does not access task semantics? We construct a semantics-free baseline using a fixed vocabulary with publicly documented provenance, and assess the role of candidate coverage through semantic blinding, library weakening, and matched operator-family knockouts. Under the current task snapshot, search budget, and scoring protocol, the fixed vocabulary already covers most tasks, while language-model-generated candidates rarely expand the set of solvable instances. Their marginal contribution becomes substantial only when vocabulary coverage is selectively disrupted. Strict out-of-distribution evaluation lowers the absolute success rates of all methods but does not alter this relationship. These findings neither invalidate LSR-Synth's controls against memorization of complete formulas nor imply that language-model priors are generally unhelpful. Rather, they support a more limited conclusion: most current tasks remain suitable for evaluating the fitting and recombination of previously unseen expressions, but are insufficient on their own to identify contributions from priors beyond a fixed search space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察 LSR-Synth 符号方程发现基准的度量问题：现有任务能否区分语言模型提供的科学先验（scientific priors）与不访问任务语义的常规算子搜索。作者构造了一个使用公开来源固定词表的无语义基线，并通过语义遮蔽、词库弱化和匹配算子族剔除来评估候选覆盖的作用。在当前任务快照、搜索预算和评分协议下，固定词表已覆盖大多数任务，语言模型生成的候选很少扩大可解实例集合；该边际贡献仅在词表覆盖被选择性破坏时才显著。严格的分布外评估降低所有方法的绝对成功率，但不改变上述关系。
Motivation: 科学方程发现基准多由公开已知方程构成，难以判断模型是从数据中发现规律还是从训练语料中回忆答案；LSR-Synth 通过引入新的合成项缓解了这一点，但本文关注一个更窄的测量问题：这些任务能否进一步把语言模型先验与不使用任务语义的常规算子搜索区分开。
Method: 作者构建了一个语义无关基线，使用词表固定且来源公开的算子库，并通过三种干预评估候选覆盖的作用：语义遮蔽（semantic blinding）、词库弱化（library weakening）以及匹配的算子族剔除（matched operator-family knockouts）。
Result: 在当前任务快照、搜索预算和评分协议下，固定词表已覆盖大多数任务，语言模型生成候选很少扩大可解实例集合；仅当词表覆盖被选择性破坏时，其边际贡献才变得显著。严格的分布外评估会降低所有方法的绝对成功率，但不改变该相对关系。
Conclusion: 作者强调这些发现既不能否定 LSR-Synth 对完整公式记忆的防控，也不意味着语言模型先验普遍无用；更有限的结论是，当前多数任务适合评估对未见表达式的拟合与重组，但不足以单独识别超出固定搜索空间的先验贡献。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Metaphor-Induced Algorithmic Steering: Cross-Domain Procedural Transfer in LLM Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models benefit from elements in natural language, such as metaphors and analogies in training data and inference input to achieve generalisability across different domains. However, these language elements may also lead to unwanted behaviors when metaphorical expressions implicitly transfer inappropriate procedural patterns into new tasks. In this paper, we show that metaphorical instructions can induce analogical transfer of procedural mechanisms, thus steering code-generation models towards less efficient algorithms. We refer to this metaphor-induced effect as metaphorical algorithmic steering: a skill that is benign and plausible within its source domain transfers an abstract procedural schema into a programming task, causing the model to favor exhaustive search, full scans, or repeated reconstruction without explicitly mentioning the target algorithm. More broadly, this suggests that code-generation models can carry procedures that are appropriate in a task's background domain into the task's programming problem, where they can lead to unwanted outcomes. To study this phenomenon, we develop MASC (Metaphorical Algorithmic Steering for Code Generation), a framework that iteratively metaphorizes and refines benign skills to elicit low-efficiency code while remaining benign and task-relevant. Beyond behavioral evaluation, we study whether this phenomenon is detectable and mechanistically reflected in model representations. Our method achieves high detection rates for metaphorical skills and less-efficient implementations. We also find that metaphorical skills induce a hidden-state shift towards lower-efficiency procedural behavior prototypes. These results suggest that metaphorical algorithmic steering operates through the transfer of procedural patterns associated with metaphorical source scenarios rather than surface level metaphorical language alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并研究“隐喻算法引导”(metaphorical algorithmic steering) 现象：LLM 代码生成模型会因比喻性指令把源领域中的过程性模式迁移到编程任务，从而倾向穷举搜索、全扫描或重复重建等低效算法。作者开发 MASC (Metaphorical Algorithmic Steering for Code Generation) 框架，通过迭代隐喻化和精炼良性技能来诱发低效代码，并从行为与模型表征两个层面分析该现象。结果显示该方法对隐喻技能和低效实现具有高检测率，且隐喻技能会使隐状态向低效过程行为原型偏移。
Motivation: 自然语言中的比喻和类比能帮助 LLM 跨领域泛化，但也可能隐式传递不恰当的过程模式，导致代码生成模型在使用隐喻指令时偏好低效算法；现有研究尚未系统刻画这种由隐喻触发的算法级偏差及其内在机制。
Method: 提出 MASC 框架，迭代地对良性技能进行隐喻化并精炼，以生成保持良性且任务相关的低效代码；除行为评估外，还研究该现象在模型表征中的可检测性及机制性反映。
Result: 摘要报告该方法对隐喻技能和低效实现达到高检测率；隐喻技能会诱导隐状态向低效过程行为原型偏移，表明该现象源于隐喻源场景关联的过程模式迁移，而非仅表层隐喻语言。
Conclusion: 作者认为隐喻算法引导通过跨领域过程模式迁移运作，说明代码生成模型可能把任务背景领域中合理的过程带入编程问题并造成不良后果；摘要未额外讨论缓解措施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A2TTA: Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation for Evolving Traffic Sensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting is important for efficient traffic management and route planning in smart cities. Existing traffic forecasting studies typically assume fixed sensor graphs, overlooking the continuous evolution of real-world traffic networks, e.g., ongoing road network construction and evolving human mobility patterns. These dynamic changes can substantially degrade conventional forecasting models, motivating test-time adaptation (TTA) to efficiently adapt pretrained models during deployment. However, applying TTA to evolving traffic sensor networks remains challenging in two aspects. First, topology expansion introduces new sensors and connections, continuously reshaping the sensor graph. Second, tem- poral shifts vary in time scale and stability, requiring differentiated adaptation to long-term and short-term shifts. In this study, we address these challenges by proposing A2TTA, an Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation framework for evolving traffic sensor networks, which transforms topology-induced forecasting errors into an expandable output calibration problem and separates tem- poral adaptation into persistent global correction and agile context-specific specialization. By jointly addressing topology evolution and multi-scale temporal shifts, A2TTA enables efficient and robust adaptation to continuously evolving traffic environments. Extensive experiments on ten real-world traffic networks demonstrate that A2TTA consistently improves forecasting performance across different backbones, datasets, and prediction horizons. Our code is available in https://github.com/lixus7/A2TTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 A2TTA，一个面向持续演进交通传感器网络的测试时适应 (TTA) 框架，用于在部署阶段高效适配预训练交通预测模型。该方法把拓扑变化引起的预测误差转化为可扩展的输出校准问题，并把时间漂移适应拆分为持久全局校正与敏捷上下文特化两部分。在十个真实交通网络上，A2TTA 在不同 backbone、数据集和预测时域上一致提升预测性能。
Motivation: 现有交通预测研究通常假设传感器图固定，而真实交通网络会因道路施工和出行模式变化而持续演进，导致常规预测模型性能明显下降；将 TTA 用于此类场景时，需要同时处理拓扑扩展引入的新传感器和连接，以及时间尺度与稳定性各异的多尺度时间漂移。
Method: A2TTA 将拓扑引发的预测误差建模为可扩展的输出校准问题，并将时间适应分为两部分：持久全局校正负责长期稳定漂移，敏捷上下文特化负责短期不稳定漂移，从而联合处理拓扑演进与多尺度时间漂移。
Result: 在十个真实交通网络上的大量实验表明，A2TTA 在不同 backbone、数据集和预测时域上均能一致提升交通预测性能；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时处理拓扑演化与多尺度时间漂移可以使模型在持续变化的交通环境中实现高效且鲁棒的适应，并已公开代码。

papers.title: FORGE: Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled long-form video understanding at a scale that was not previously possible. However, the density of relevant content decreases sharply as video sequence length increases, and exposing the model to more irrelevant content measurably reduces its accuracy. In this paper, we address the problem of maximizing query-relevant information in a frame subset selected at inference time, without training. FORGE (Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry) is a model-agnostic method that induces a query-conditioned geometry on a pretrained multimodal embedding space, unifying relevance and diversity into a single objective. In this space, frames that cover independent query-relevant directions are far apart, and selecting the subset of maximum information captures diverse query-relevant content within the budget. Experiments on Video-MME and LongVideoBench at budgets of 16, 32, and 64 frames show that FORGE improves the unified keyframe selection score by 11.0-15.3 points over the strongest training-free baseline and up to doubles keyframe recall (0.415 vs. 0.204 at K=64 on Video-MME). The gains extend to question answering, where accuracy improves in every evaluated setting across eight open-source MLLMs spanning 4B to 32B parameters, by up to 8.7 points over uniform sampling and 5.2 points over the strongest baseline. Our findings suggest that aligning the embedding space with the query's high-dimensional structure is a promising direction for inference-time video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FORGE (Frame Orthogonality in Relevance Geometry)，一种模型无关的推理时关键帧选择方法，用于长视频理解。它在预训练多模态嵌入空间上诱导查询条件化的几何结构，把相关性与多样性统一为单一目标，使覆盖独立查询相关方向的帧彼此远离，从而在预算内选取信息量最大的帧子集。在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 上以 16、32、64 帧预算评测，FORGE 相对最强无训练基线提升统一关键帧选择分数 11.0–15.3 点，且关键帧召回率大幅提高。
Motivation: 长视频中相关内容的密度随序列长度增加而急剧下降，给模型暴露更多无关内容会明显降低准确性；因此需要在不训练的情况下，在推理时选出的帧子集中最大化与查询相关的信息。
Method: FORGE 是模型无关的推理时方法，对预训练多模态嵌入空间施加查询条件化的几何结构，将相关性和多样性统一进一个目标：在该几何空间中，覆盖独立查询相关方向的帧彼此远离，选择最大信息子集即在帧预算内覆盖多样且查询相关的内容。
Result: 在 Video-MME 和 LongVideoBench 上，16/32/64 帧预算下 FORGE 相对最强无训练基线将统一关键帧选择分数提升 11.0–15.3 点；在 Video-MME 的 K=64 设置下关键帧召回率约为基线两倍（0.415 对 0.204）。在 8 个参数量 4B–32B 的开源 MLLM 上，所有评测设置的问答精度均有提升，最高比均匀采样高 8.7 点、比最强基线高 5.2 点。
Conclusion: 作者认为将嵌入空间与查询的高维结构对齐是推理时视频理解的一个有前景的方向；摘要本身未讨论训练或微调场景下的适用性。

papers.title: CodeRescue: Budget-Calibrated Recovery Routing for Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents increasingly operate in executable environments where a failed attempt produces actionable feedback rather than merely an incorrect answer. Existing cost-aware systems typically treat such failures as cascade decisions: try a cheap model first, then escalate hard cases to a stronger and more expensive model. In coding, however, execution feedback can also make further cheap-model recovery worthwhile, raising a budgeted deployment question: when should an agent spend more cheap compute, and when should it escalate? We formulate this post-failure decision as recovery routing over heterogeneous actions and train a supervised router from execution rollouts. To make the same router usable under changing budgets, we add a Conformal Risk Control (CRC) layer that selects a deployment-time cost penalty without retraining and provides marginal expected-cost control under exchangeability. Across held-out failures from five coding benchmarks, cheap recovery and escalation exhibit complementary success patterns. The calibrated frontier improves over fixed actions, prompt-only routers, and a binary cascade baseline; in the main GPT-5.4-nano/GPT-5.4 setting, one CRC-calibrated frontier point exceeds always-escalate solve rate while using 35% of its mean recovery cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Qijia-He/agent-budget-control.
papers.comment: Withdrawn at the request of ByteDance because the manuscript was submitted before completing the company's required internal review and approval process
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeRescue，将编程智能体失败后的恢复决策建模为 recovery routing：在廉价模型与更强模型的异构动作之间做预算校准的路由。作者利用执行回滚训练监督路由器，并用 Conformal Risk Control (CRC) 层在部署时选择成本惩罚，提供边际期望成本控制。摘要报告在五个编码基准的失败样本上，校准前沿优于固定动作、仅提示路由器和二元级联基线；在 GPT-5.4-nano/GPT-5.4 设定中，一个 CRC 校准点以 35% 的平均恢复成本超越 always-escalate 的求解率。注意该论文已应 ByteDance 要求撤回，因其在完成公司内部审查前投稿。
Motivation: 现有成本感知系统通常把失败当作级联决策——先试廉价模型，再把困难案例升级到更强更贵的模型；但在编程中，执行反馈可能让继续用廉价模型恢复变得值得，因此需要回答何时多花廉价算力、何时升级。
Method: 将失败后的决策形式化为异构动作上的恢复路由 (recovery routing)，从执行回滚中训练监督路由器；为适应变化预算，加入 Conformal Risk Control (CRC) 层，无需重训练即可在部署时选择成本惩罚，并在可交换性假设下提供边际期望成本控制。
Result: 在五个编码基准的 held-out 失败上，廉价恢复与升级表现出互补成功模式；校准前沿优于固定动作、仅提示路由器和二元级联基线。主要设定 GPT-5.4-nano/GPT-5.4 中，一个 CRC 校准前沿点超过 always-escalate 求解率，同时只用其 35% 的平均恢复成本。
Conclusion: 摘要认为预算校准的恢复路由可以在低成本下维持甚至超过升级策略的求解率；但该稿件已因 ByteDance 内部流程原因撤回，读者需注意其状态。

papers.title: CPInj: Uncovering Prompt Injection Risks in Textual Collaborative Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Textual Collaborative Prompt Optimization (TCPO) extends TextGrad (Yuksekgonul et al., 2025) to a decentralized setting by allowing multiple clients to jointly improve prompts for large language models (LLMs) while keeping their data locally. Its reliance on free-form textual updating and aggregation introduces a new and largely unexplored attack surface, i.e., malicious instructions can be injected into local prompts and propagated through server-side prompt aggregation. Unlike conventional prompt injection attacks, attacking TCPO targets the collaborative optimization loop in TCPO. This setting is more challenging because malicious instructions must survive aggregation, persist through subsequent benign prompt optimization, and evade server-side defenses. To expose this risk, we propose Collaborative Prompt Injection (CPInj) attack that contaminates the aggregated global prompt with malicious instructions, degrades downstream task performance, resists purification by prompt optimization on benign clients, and evades advanced detection-based defenses on the server. We find that current defense methods are ineffective against CPInj. We further propose Anchored Purification Aggregation (APAgg), a defense-oriented aggregation that purifies malicious instructions without severely degrading TCPO utility. We conduct extensive experiments across three LLM families and five reasoning tasks in math, logic, and medicine, and demonstrate that our proposed attack reveals a critical vulnerability in TCPO. Although we take a first step toward mitigation, the attack remains highly effective and far from fully resolved, calling for more robust defense for TCPO.
papers.comment: Accepted by COLM 2026 and AI4GOOD workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出协作式提示注入攻击 CPInj，针对文本协作提示优化 (TCPO) 这一将 TextGrad 扩展为多客户端联合优化提示词的分散式框架。攻击利用 TCPO 依赖自由文本更新与服务器端聚合的特点，将恶意指令注入本地提示并使其在聚合后的全局提示中存活。作者进一步提出防御性聚合方法 Anchored Purification Aggregation (APAgg)，并在三个 LLM 家族、五个数学/逻辑/医学推理任务上验证了攻击的有效性与防御的初步效果。
Motivation: TCPO 在分布式场景下允许多客户端在不共享数据的前提下联合优化 LLM 提示词，但其自由文本式的更新与聚合机制引入了新的攻击面：恶意指令可通过本地提示注入并在服务器端聚合中传播。与常规提示注入不同，攻击 TCPO 需要恶意指令在聚合、后续良性优化和服务端防御下持续存活，这构成了一个尚未被充分研究的安全挑战。
Method: 作者提出 CPInj 攻击，通过污染聚合后的全局提示来注入恶意指令，目标是降低下游任务性能、抵抗良性客户端的提示优化净化并规避服务端的检测型防御。针对该攻击，文章提出 APAgg，一种面向防御的聚合策略，在不严重损害 TCPO 效用的情况下净化恶意指令。
Result: 实验表明现有防御方法对 CPInj 基本无效；APAgg 能在一定程度上净化恶意指令，但攻击仍然高度有效，问题远未完全解决。实验覆盖三个 LLM 家族以及数学、逻辑、医学五类推理任务。
Conclusion: CPInj 揭示了 TCPO 在协作优化环路中的关键安全漏洞，APAgg 只是缓解的第一步，作者呼吁为 TCPO 设计更稳健的防御机制。

papers.title: EduPanel: A Three-Agent LLM Judge for Teaching Videos -- Reliability, Complementarity, and Human Trust Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Teaching videos are becoming a major medium for education, creating a growing need for scalable evaluation of their pedagogical quality. Existing automatic judges do not fully address this setting because teaching quality depends on multimodal evidence and should be evaluated with respect to the intended learner rather than as a universal property. We present EduPanel, a rubric-grounded, learner-conditioned LLM judge that decomposes evaluation across specialized agents to produce interpretable assessments for different aspects of teaching quality. Across expert studies, architecture ablations, and learner-persona analyses, EduPanel achieves reliability comparable to a median human expert. In expert evaluation, its feedback improves scoring accuracy (MAE 0.87 to 0.73), while experts remain able to detect unreliable outputs (AUC = 0.77) instead of accepting them blindly. These results suggest that EduPanel can serve as effective assistants for educational evaluation rather than replacements for human experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EduPanel，一个基于评分 rubrics、面向学习者条件 (learner-conditioned) 的三 agent LLM 评判器，用于将教学视频质量评估分解给专门 agent，生成可解释的多维评估。摘要报告其可靠性可与中位人类专家相当；在专家研究中，其反馈将评分 MAE 从 0.87 降至 0.73，而专家仍能识别不可靠输出（AUC=0.77）。作者认为 EduPanel 更适合作为教育评估的辅助工具而非人类专家的替代品。
Motivation: 教学视频正成为主要教育媒介，需要可扩展的教学质量评估；现有自动评判器未充分处理多模态证据，也未针对目标学习者进行个性化评估。
Method: 提出由三个专门 agent 组成的 EduPanel 架构，采用 rubric 引导、学习者条件化的 LLM 评判方式，将教学质量的评估解耦为多个可解释维度。
Result: 通过专家研究、架构消融和学习者画像分析，EduPanel 达到与中位人类专家相当的可靠性；专家使用其反馈后评分 MAE 从 0.87 改善到 0.73，且能检测不可靠输出（AUC=0.77）。

papers.title: Frontier AI performance across the business disciplines: a case-grounded benchmark of knowledge work and analytical reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are improving rapidly as reflected in benchmark scores, yet these AI benchmarks largely test capabilities such as factual recall, narrow question answering, mathematical problem-solving, and coding and agentic tool-use. What remains poorly measured is AI progress on the analytical knowledge work white-collar professionals perform daily, including synthesizing complex information, exercising judgment under uncertainty and incomplete information, applying strategic and adversarial thinking in multi-stakeholder settings, weighing trade-offs, and producing defensible, structured analyses. This gap is even more pronounced for subjective components of such work, where success can be challenging to define. The "case method" form of education practiced by top business schools provides a natural foundation for addressing this measurement gap, and we construct BusinessCaseBench, a benchmark spanning hundreds of questions drawn from business cases across eighteen disciplines, each paired with a grading rubric derived from the expert-written instructor case solution. On BusinessCaseBench, frontier AI models already score highly against instructor rubrics, and capability within one model family improves substantially over two years. These results provide strong evidence that AI performance on this class of work is already high and rapidly improving, with implications for business schools, where case pedagogy trains undergraduates and MBAs in this kind of analytical reasoning, and for entry-level professional roles, where such skills have historically anchored early-career work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BusinessCaseBench，一个基于商学院案例教学法（case method）构建的基准，覆盖 18 个学科的数百道商业案例题，每题配有由专家编写的教师案例解决方案衍生的评分标准。摘要报告前沿 LLM 在该基准上已能取得高分，且同一模型家族的能力在两年内有显著提升，说明 AI 在白领分析性知识工作上的表现已经很高且快速进步。
Motivation: 现有 AI 基准主要测试事实回忆、窄问答、数学解题、编程和智能体工具使用，但很少测量白领每日进行的分析性知识工作，如综合复杂信息、在不确定和不完整信息下做判断、多利益相关方场景中的战略与对抗性思维、权衡取舍以及产出有依据的结构化分析，尤其难以度量其中的主观成分。
Method: 作者借鉴顶级商学院采用的案例教学法，构建 BusinessCaseBench，题目来自 18 个学科的商业案例，每道题配对由专家编写的教师案例解决方案推导出的评分标准，用于评估模型的分析推理能力。
Result: 摘要报告前沿 AI 模型在 BusinessCaseBench 上按照教师评分标准已能取得高分，且同一模型家族的能力在两年内显著提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果对商学院案例教学法和入门级专业岗位具有启示，因为这类分析推理技能历史上锚定了早期职业工作；作者认为 AI 在该类任务上的表现已经很高且正在快速提升。

papers.title: Native Multi-Dimensional Subquadratic Operators via Input Dependent Long Convolutions
papers.abstract_en: Subquadratic alternatives to attention require compromises when applied to multi-dimensional data: standard convolutions lack global receptive fields and input dependency, while recurrent models require rasterizing data such as images, volumes, and partial differential equation (PDE) into an ad-hoc $1\rm D$ scan order that violates their spatial structure. We introduce \textit{HyenaND}, a subquadratic, global, input-dependent operator that acts directly on the native geometry of multidimensional data through convolutions with implicitly parametrized global, input-dependent multi-dimensional convolutional kernels. Our CUDA implementation, \texttt{nSubQ}, fuses the FFT-convolution path to turn HyenaND's $\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ scaling into wall-clock speedups. Across long-context genomics, computer vision, medical imaging, and PDE modeling, pure HyenaND stacks match the accuracy of strong attention baselines, while hybrid configurations that interleave HyenaND and attention layers outperform both pure attention and strong recurrence-based hybrids.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyenaND，一种面向多维数据的次二次复杂度、全局且输入依赖的算子，通过隐式参数化的全局多维卷积核直接作用于数据的原生几何结构，避免将图像、体数据或 PDE 栅格化为 1D 扫描顺序。作者还提供 CUDA 实现 nSubQ，融合 FFT 卷积路径，将 O(L log L) 的缩放转化为墙钟时间加速。在长上下文基因组学、计算机视觉、医学影像和 PDE 建模上，纯 HyenaND 堆叠可匹配强注意力基线的精度，而混合配置优于纯注意力与基于递归的强混合基线。
Motivation: 注意力的次二次替代方案在处理多维数据时需要妥协：标准卷积缺乏全局感受野和输入依赖，递归模型则要求将图像、体数据和偏微分方程等数据栅格化为临时的一维扫描顺序，破坏其空间结构。
Method: 提出 HyenaND 算子，用隐式参数化的全局、输入依赖的多维卷积核对多维数据执行卷积；并实现 CUDA 内核 nSubQ，将 FFT 卷积路径融合进来，使理论上的 O(L log L) 复杂度转化为实际的墙钟加速。
Result: 在长上下文基因组学、计算机视觉、医学影像和 PDE 建模等任务上，纯 HyenaND 堆叠的精度与强注意力基线相当；交错混合 HyenaND 与注意力层的配置在精度上同时超过纯注意力和基于递归的强混合基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为直接在多维原生几何上构造次二次全局输入依赖算子可行，且与注意力层混合能取得最佳精度。摘要未讨论明确局限。

papers.title: Anti-Prompt: Image Protection against Text-Guided Image-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Image-to-Video generation allow a single image to be animated into a convincing video under text guidance, raising serious copyright and privacy risks. We propose Anti-Prompt, an image protection approach that injects imperceptible perturbations into an image, inducing visible inconsistencies and structural failures in text-guided I2V generation. Our method is motivated by a simple empirical observation. When text guidance is removed from modern I2V models, generation quality degrades markedly, not only in motion realism but also in subject preservation, structural coherence, and temporal consistency. Building on this insight, Anti-Prompt exploits the model reliance on textual guidance by attenuating text-conditioned interactions during denoising while strengthening visual-only pathways. To further systematically evaluate protection effectiveness, we introduce a Video-LLM-assisted evaluation protocol that provides interpretable, frame-grounded analyses of generation artifacts and inconsistencies. Experiments on two representative I2V architectures demonstrate that our method achieves strong protection performance while improving efficiency and cross-model transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Anti-Prompt，一种图像保护方法，通过向图像注入不可感知的扰动，使文本引导的图像到视频（I2V）生成出现可见的不一致和结构失败。方法源于一个经验观察：移除文本引导后现代 I2V 模型的质量显著下降，因此通过衰减去噪过程中的文本条件交互并强化纯视觉通路来利用模型对文本引导的依赖。作者还引入 Video-LLM 辅助的评估协议，并在两个代表性 I2V 架构上验证了强保护性能、更高效率和跨模型迁移性。
Motivation: 文本引导的 I2V 生成可以把单张图像动画化为逼真视频，带来严重的版权与隐私风险，因此需要有效的图像级防护手段。
Method: Anti-Prompt 将不可感知的扰动注入图像，在去噪过程中衰减文本条件交互、强化纯视觉通路，从而诱导生成视频出现可见伪影与结构错误；同时提出基于 Video-LLM 的评估协议，对生成伪影和不一致进行可解释、帧级粒度的分析。
Result: 在两个代表性 I2V 架构上的实验表明，Anti-Prompt 在取得强保护性能的同时，还提升了效率并表现出跨模型迁移性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用 I2V 模型对文本引导的依赖可以实现有效、高效且可迁移的图像保护，但其未讨论具体局限。

papers.title: The Metanym Game: A Self-Contained, Self-Consistent LLM Peer-Community Benchmark for Structural Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The metanym game is a competitive word game for LLMs that measures structural intelligence against established cognitive-science constructs. No content is given in advance; the contestants create all of it -- a new kind of analogy test, analogical production falsifiable sentence by sentence, with no fixed test set to leak into training (contamination-resistant by construction). In the council-of-peers benchmark, the contestants also rate each other's creations. We introduce the first spectral solution, to our knowledge, to the wicked problem of benchmarking LLMs' factual accuracy without golden keys or oracle models: one singular value decomposition of the evaluators' ratings matrix yields their competence as both generators and judges of true statements at once. Competence on the subjective criteria comes from each judge's rating consistency as the yardstick shifts. The factual rating correlates with GPQA Diamond at Pearson r = 0.92. Scored separately, making and judging dissociate -- judging is the scarcer skill: the strongest generators are middling judges, the sharpest judge a mid-pack generator. To scale, the strongest players form a council that does the official benchmarking; its seats are contestable -- a stronger model earns one on the benchmark's own rating. The benchmark is entirely self-contained and self-consistent, a stable gauge over time. Code and data are available at https://github.com/dnordfors/metanym-game-paper
papers.comment: 71 pages (main text + four appendices: full generation/evaluation prompts, the anchor submission excerpt, and a council-evaluation excerpt), 1 figure, 17 tables. Github repo with pages/figures/tables/code and data for reproducing results: https://github.com/dnordfors/metanym-game-paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 metanym game，一种面向 LLM 的竞技性文字游戏基准，用于对照认知科学既有构念衡量结构智能 (structural intelligence)。游戏不预设内容，参赛者自行创造全部内容，构成一种逐句可证伪的类比生成测试，且没有固定测试集可供训练数据泄漏。在 council-of-peers 基准中，参赛者还互评彼此的作品；作者引入一种谱方法：对评分矩阵做奇异值分解 (SVD)，即可同时得到模型作为真实陈述生成者与评判者的能力。
Motivation: 在没有 golden keys 或 oracle 模型的情况下评测 LLM 的事实准确性是一个棘手的难题 (wicked problem)，而固定测试集容易被训练数据污染；同时需要一种能对齐认知科学构念、且随时间稳定的结构智能度量。
Method: metanym game 让参赛 LLM 自行创作全部内容，完成逐句可证伪的类比生成；council-of-peers 基准中参赛者互评。作者对评判者评分矩阵做一次奇异值分解，同时估计每个模型作为生成者与评判者的能力；主观标准上的能力来自评判者在标尺变化时的评分一致性。扩展方式是由最强玩家组成官方评测委员会，且席位可通过在该基准自身评分上的表现被挑战。
Result: 事实性评分与 GPQA Diamond 的 Pearson 相关系数为 r = 0.92。分开计分时，生成与评判能力发生分离 (dissociate)：最强生成者只是中等评判者，而最敏锐的评判者只是中等生成者，说明评判是更稀缺的技能。
Conclusion: 该基准完全自包含且自洽，可作为随时间稳定的度量工具；代码与数据已公开在 GitHub 仓库中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Model-Driven Approach for Developing Families of Reinforcement Learning Environments
papers.abstract_en: Virtual training environments are software-intensive systems in which reinforcement learning (RL) agents learn, adapt, and demonstrate meaningful behavior. Virtual training environments offer a safe and cost-efficient alternative to training agents in real-world settings. However, to converge, most realistic RL problems require training in multiple, mostly similar but slightly different environments - i.e., families of environment variants. The typical development process of environment families is a labor-intensive and error-prone manual endeavor that does not scale well. To alleviate these issues, in this paper, we propose a model-driven approach for developing families of RL training environments. To obtain the family of environments, we develop an approach and prototype tool. In our approach, a hybrid genetic algorithm - a combination of population-based global search and heuristic local search - generates environment families. Mutations and constraints are expressed as model transformations and are operationalized into a search process by a state-of-the-art model transformation engine. We demonstrate the soundness of our approach in a wildfire mitigation scenario and curriculum learning - a particular learning paradigm that relies on environment families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模型驱动的方法来开发强化学习（RL）训练环境的家族（families of environment variants），以解决环境变体手动开发耗时易错、难以扩展的问题。方法采用混合遗传算法（结合种群全局搜索与启发式局部搜索）生成环境家族，并将突变和约束表达为模型变换，由模型变换引擎操作化为搜索过程。作者在野火缓解场景和课程学习（curriculum learning）中演示了该方法的可行性。
Motivation: 现实中的强化学习问题通常需要在一组相似但略有不同的环境变体中训练才能收敛，而环境家族的传统开发过程是劳动密集且易错的手工工作，难以规模化。
Method: 提出模型驱动开发方法及原型工具，使用混合遗传算法，即种群全局搜索与启发式局部搜索的组合，来生成环境家族；突变和约束以模型变换的形式表达，并由模型变换引擎将其操作化为搜索过程。
Result: 摘要通过在野火缓解场景和课程学习场景中的演示验证了方法的正确性（soundness），但未报告具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为RL训练环境家族开发提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，能够缓解手动开发的痛点；其当前验证范围限定于野火场景和依赖环境家族的课程学习范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Implicit Reasoning for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted as backbones for Generative Recommendation (GR), promising access to pretrained world knowledge. Yet reliably invoking this knowledge for GR remains poorly understood. A key obstacle is that LLM-based GR typically represents items with Semantic IDs (SIDs), disrupting LLMs' natural-language reasoning interface because these tokens are unseen by the LLM during pretraining. Existing approaches address this with expensive multi-stage pipelines that ground SIDs and elicit explicit rationales, but offer limited insight into when and why each stage is necessary. In this work, we systematically decompose explicit reasoning training pipelines for LLM-based GR, revealing three key limitations: weakened world-knowledge verbalization, misalignment between SID and natural-language token embedding spaces, and sensitivity to rationale quality, all of which hurt explicit reasoning performance. To circumvent these issues, we propose PauseRec, a lightweight implicit reasoning paradigm tailored for GR. PauseRec is exceptionally practical, avoiding costly reasoning trace acquisition and reasoning alignment training, leading to a multitude of benefits: (1) it outperforms standard explicit CoT methods by up to 6.22%, (2) it reduces training cost by up to 65% GPU hours, and (3) it speeds up inference by up to 71.3%. These results position PauseRec as a lightweight alternative to explicit rationale generation, enabling more effective and efficient LLM-based GR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式推荐（Generative Recommendation, GR），指出用语义 ID（Semantic IDs, SIDs）表示物品会打断 LLM 的自然语言推理接口，并系统拆解显式推理训练流水线，发现其存在世界知识表达弱化、SID 与自然语言 token 嵌入空间错位、以及推理质量敏感等局限。作者提出轻量级隐式推理范式 PauseRec，避免昂贵的推理轨迹获取和对齐训练，在推荐效果、训练成本和推理速度上均优于标准显式 CoT 方法。
Motivation: LLM 已成为生成式推荐的主流骨干，但如何可靠地调用其预训练世界知识仍缺乏理解；现有方法用语义 ID 表示物品并经过昂贵的多阶段流水线引导显式理由生成，却对每个阶段何时必要、为何必要缺乏系统认知。
Method: 作者先系统分解显式推理训练流水线，指出三类关键局限；随后提出 PauseRec，一种面向生成式推荐的轻量级隐式推理范式，不依赖显式推理轨迹获取与推理对齐训练，从而绕开显式推理的上述问题。
Result: 摘要报告 PauseRec 相对标准显式 CoT 方法最高提升 6.22% 的推荐性能，最多节省 65% 的 GPU 训练时长，并将推理速度提升最高 71.3%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PauseRec 是显式理由生成的轻量级替代方案，能够更有效且更高效地实现基于 LLM 的生成式推荐。

papers.title: A Fully Convolutional Approach to Denoising 2D Correlation Spectra
papers.abstract_en: We present a fully convolutional denoising autoencoder (FC-DAE) tailored for two-dimensional representations of dynamic correlations that is applicable to many experimental techniques. Here, we demonstrate its performance on two-time intensity correlation functions ($C_2$) from X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy (XPCS). Unlike conventional denoising autoencoders that are typically restricted to fixed input sizes, the FC-DAE accepts inputs of arbitrary dimensions while preserving correlation structures across diverse dynamical regimes. The model is trained using experimentally derived $C_2$ data collected at NSLS-II beamlines, with data augmentation applied to expand the diversity of the dataset and reduce overfitting. The FC-DAE successfully recovers intricate dynamical features in low signal-to-noise conditions while maintaining structural fidelity. To assess reconstruction reliability, we employ quantitative metrics to evaluate structural fidelity and identify potential model-induced bias. Our results demonstrate that the FC-DAE provides robust denoising performance with high computational efficiency, enabling recovery of XPCS dynamics under photon-limited and low-dose measurement conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全卷积去噪自编码器（FC-DAE），用于处理动态关联的二维表示，并演示其在 X 射线光子相关谱 (XPCS) 的两时间强度关联函数 (C2) 去噪上的效果。该模型支持任意尺寸输入，训练数据来自 NSLS-II 光束线的实验 C2 数据，并采用数据增广降低过拟合。摘要报告该方法在低信噪比条件下能恢复精细动力学特征，并在光子受限和低剂量测量条件下实现高效去噪。
Motivation: 传统去噪自编码器通常受限于固定输入尺寸，难以直接用于实验获取的二维动态关联谱；同时 XPCS 等实验在光子受限和低剂量条件下信噪比低，需要能保持关联结构并高效去噪的方法。
Method: 提出全卷积去噪自编码器 (FC-DAE)，接受任意维度输入以保留不同动力学区间的关联结构；使用 NSLS-II 实验得到的 C2 数据训练，并通过数据增广扩大数据多样性、减少过拟合；采用定量指标评估结构保真度和模型引入的偏差。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在低信噪比条件下成功恢复精细动力学特征并维持结构保真度，与定量评估结合表明 FC-DAE 具有稳健去噪性能和较高计算效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FC-DAE 可用于从光子受限和低剂量测量条件下恢复 XPCS 动力学，且方法本身适用于多种实验技术产生的二维动态关联表示。

papers.title: LearnedCache: eBPF-Integrated Perceptron-Based Eviction Policies for the Linux Page Cache
papers.abstract_en: Any device that runs Linux uses the Linux page cache, a central pillar in OS and application performance, serving to reduce extraneous disk access. Many page cache eviction policies have been developed but remain bound by the rigidity of heuristics. Promising research has been done on neural cache eviction policies, but only in the field of user-space applications such as CDNs. We present LearnedCache, a set of machine-learning-based page cache eviction policies that run live inside the Linux kernel through the cache_ext eBPF framework. LearnedCache trains a lightweight perceptron per workload on kernel trace data collected using eBPF to predict whether eviction candidates will be reused within a bounded horizon and deploys it through two eBPF policies. The resulting policies consistently compete with and outperform both external heuristic policies and the kernel's own, improving application throughput by up to 44% versus standard kernel policies.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 8 figures, 3 listings. Policies and harnesses: https://github.com/JayAndJef/cache_ext_lc . Model and visualizations: https://github.com/JayAndJef/learnedcache
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LearnedCache，一组基于机器学习的 Linux 页缓存 (page cache) 驱逐策略，通过 cache_ext eBPF 框架在内核中实时运行。每个工作负载使用 eBPF 收集的内核 trace 数据训练一个轻量级感知机 (perceptron)，预测驱逐候选是否会在有限时间范围内被再次访问，并以两个 eBPF 策略部署。摘要称该方法在应用吞吐量上比标准内核策略最高提升 44%，并与外部启发式策略和内核自带策略持续竞争或胜出。
Motivation: 现有页缓存驱逐策略受启发式方法的刚性限制，而神经缓存驱逐策略的研究主要集中在 CDN 等用户态应用，缺乏内核态实时可部署的方案。
Method: 利用 cache_ext eBPF 框架在内核中实时运行机器学习策略；为每个工作负载基于 eBPF 收集的内核 trace 数据训练轻量级感知机，用于预测驱逐候选在有限时间范围内的复用概率，并通过两个 eBPF 策略进行部署。
Result: 摘要报告相较于标准内核策略，应用吞吐量最高提升 44%；与外部启发式策略及内核自带策略相比，能持续竞争或超越。
Conclusion: 摘要表明通过 eBPF 在 Linux 内核中实现基于学习的页缓存驱逐策略是可行的，并能在吞吐量上带来可观收益；其范围限于页缓存驱逐策略。

papers.title: Statistical Inference for Stochastic Gradient Descent: Beyond Finite Variance
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is foundational to large-scale statistical learning and stochastic optimization. However, in some modern statistical learning problems, stochastic gradients can exhibit infinite-variance behavior. Consequently, classical inference methods for SGD that rely on a finite-variance assumption break down. We develop a model-agnostic methodology for constructing confidence regions from SGD iterates in both the finite- and infinite-variance regimes. We first show that Polyak--Ruppert averaging has an asymptotic directional scale no larger than that of the fastest-rate final iterate, analogous to its lower asymptotic variance in the finite-variance setting. Accordingly, we focus our inference methodology on the Polyak--Ruppert averaged estimator. Specifically, we establish a joint central limit theorem for this estimator and an empirical second-moment normalizer from the same iterates. This joint limit yields a self-normalized statistic in which the leading tail-dependent scaling terms cancel. We then use subsampling to estimate the relevant quantiles, avoiding explicit estimation of nuisance parameters including tail indices, slowly varying functions, or stable-law parameters. The resulting confidence regions are straightforward to implement and asymptotically valid in both the finite- and infinite-variance regimes. Empirical studies show reliable coverage in various settings, supporting the proposed method as a practical tool for uncertainty quantification in stochastic optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 SGD 在随机梯度具有无穷方差（infinite variance）时经典推断方法失效的问题，提出一种与模型无关的置信域（confidence region）构造方法。作者首先证明 Polyak–Ruppert 平均估计量的渐近方向尺度不超过最快收敛的末次迭代，继而建立该估计量与由同一迭代路径得到的经验二阶矩归一化量的联合中心极限定理，构造出自归一化统计量，并用子抽样（subsampling）估计分位数。该方法可避开尾部指数、慢变函数和稳定分布参数等冗余参数的显式估计，在有限方差与无穷方差两种情形下均渐近有效，经验研究显示覆盖可靠。
Motivation: 经典 SGD 推断方法依赖随机梯度的有限方差假设，而现代统计学习问题中随机梯度可能表现出无穷方差行为，导致这些方法失效。
Method: 先证明 Polyak–Ruppert 平均的渐近方向尺度不比最快末次迭代更大，然后聚焦该平均估计器，建立其与同一迭代序列的经验二阶矩归一化量的联合中心极限定理，得到可抵消主导尾部依赖尺度的自归一化统计量；最后用子抽样估计相关分位数，避免显式估计尾部指数、慢变函数或稳定律参数等冗余参数。
Result: 摘要报告所构造的置信域在有限方差和无穷方差两种情形下均渐近有效，并在多种设定下获得可靠的覆盖率（coverage）；未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者将该方法定位为随机优化中不确定性量化的实用工具，强调其实现简单且无需估计繁琐的冗余参数，适用范围涵盖 SGD 推断的有限与无穷方差两种体制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Teaching Video Generators to Remember: Eliciting Dynamic Memory for Out-of-Sight State Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Video world models should maintain evolving states when evidence is unobserved, yet current generators often freeze hidden states upon interruption. This is not simply a capacity problem: pretrained video diffusion transformers already possess KV-cache mechanisms capable of non-local retrieval, but they are rarely trained to use them as dynamic memory. We introduce ReMind, a framework eliciting dynamic memory behavior via memory-oriented data, event-aware training, and cache adaptation. Organized around a taxonomy of 100+ dynamic events, we build a camera-annotated training mixture combining VLM-filtered real videos, generated hard dynamics, synthetic camera loops, and memory-interruption augmentations. Each clip is converted into a frame graph with protected anchors, degraded intervals, and explicit temporal gaps. A node-structured curriculum -- including node-drop, noisy memory, frontier continuation, and reference-cache training -- forces the model to retrieve relevant past states across interruptions rather than relying solely on local continuity. PM-RoPE, an elegant camera-phase RoPE extension, unlocks spatiotemporal retrieval at a single-attention cost while preserving pretrained pathways. ReMind achieves the best overall scores on STEVO-Bench and recovery tasks. Furthermore, general image-to-video evaluations confirm this curriculum avoids catastrophic forgetting. We have released our code, data, and models on our project page \href{https://remind-applied.github.io/}{https://remind-applied.github.io/}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReMind 框架，用于让视频生成模型在证据未被观测到的时间段内维持演化状态，而不是在中断时冻结隐状态。作者指出预训练视频扩散 Transformer 已具备 KV-cache 机制来实现非局部检索，但很少被训练用作动态记忆。ReMind 通过面向记忆的数据构造、事件感知训练和缓存适配，结合基于 100+ 类动态事件的相机标注混合训练集与节点结构课程，并引入 PM-RoPE 扩展，在 STEVO-Bench 和恢复任务上取得最佳总分，且不损害通用图生视频能力。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型在观测中断时往往冻结隐状态，无法维持未观测到的状态演化。作者认为这不是单纯的容量问题，而是预训练视频扩散 Transformer 的 KV-cache 检索能力未被训练用于动态记忆。
Method: ReMind 框架包括三部分：面向记忆的数据（基于 100+ 动态事件分类构建相机标注混合数据，含 VLM 过滤真实视频、生成的困难动态、合成相机循环和记忆中断增强），每个片段转换为带保护锚点、退化区间和显式时间间隙的帧图；节点结构课程（节点丢弃、噪声记忆、前沿延续、参考缓存训练）迫使模型跨中断检索相关过去状态；PM-RoPE 作为相机相位 RoPE 扩展，以单注意力成本实现时空检索并保持预训练通路。
Result: 摘要报告 ReMind 在 STEVO-Bench 和恢复任务上取得最佳总体分数，并确认该课程在通用图生视频评估中避免了灾难性遗忘。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过记忆导向的数据、事件感知训练和缓存适配，可以激发预训练视频扩散 Transformer 已有的动态记忆能力，并指出代码、数据和模型已开源。

papers.title: AI4BayesCode: From Natural Language Descriptions to Validated Modular Stateful Bayesian Samplers
papers.abstract_en: Coding and computation remain major bottlenecks in Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) workflows, especially as modern sampling algorithms have become increasingly complex and existing probabilistic programming systems remain limited in model support, extensibility, and composability. We introduce \textbf{AI4BayesCode}, an extensible LLM-driven system that translates natural-language Bayesian model descriptions into runnable, validated MCMC samplers. To improve reliability, AI4BayesCode adopts a modular design that decomposes models into modular sampling blocks and maps each block to a built-in sampling component, reducing the need to implement complex sampling algorithms from scratch. Reliability is further improved through pre-generation validation of model specifications and post-generation validation of generated sampler code. AI4BayesCode also introduces a novel recursively stateful coding paradigm for MCMC, allowing modular sampling components, potentially developed by different contributors, to be composed coherently within larger MCMC procedures. We develop a benchmark suite to evaluate AI4BayesCode for sampler-generation. Experiments show that AI4BayesCode can implement a wide range of Bayesian models from natural-language descriptions alone. As an open-ended system, its capability can continue to expand with improvements in the underlying AI agent and the addition of new built-in blocks. The software is available at https://ai4bayescode.com/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI4BayesCode，一个由 LLM 驱动的可扩展系统，将自然语言的贝叶斯模型描述转换为可运行、经过验证的 MCMC 采样器。系统采用模块化设计，把模型分解为模块化采样块并映射到内置采样组件，并引入预生成与后生成的两阶段验证，以及一种用于 MCMC 的递归有状态（recursively stateful）编码范式。作者构建了基准套件评估采样器生成能力，实验表明仅凭自然语言描述即可实现多种贝叶斯模型，且系统能力可随底层 AI agent 与新增内置模块持续扩展。
Motivation: MCMC 工作流中编码与计算仍是主要瓶颈，现代采样算法日益复杂，而现有概率编程系统在模型支持、可扩展性和可组合性方面受限。
Method: 提出可扩展的 LLM 驱动系统 AI4BayesCode：将模型分解为模块化采样块并映射到内置采样组件，通过预生成阶段的模型规格验证与后生成阶段的采样器代码验证提升可靠性，并引入递归有状态编码范式使来自不同贡献者的模块化组件能在更大的 MCMC 流程中连贯组合。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明该系统仅从自然语言描述就能实现广泛的贝叶斯模型，并发布了一个用于评估采样器生成的基准套件。
Conclusion: AI4BayesCode 作为一个开放式系统，其能力可随底层 AI agent 的改进和新增内置模块而持续扩展；软件已公开提供。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CREST: Curvature-Regulated Event-Centric Sampling for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Selecting informative frames from long videos is a combinatorial problem that existing methods address either through efficient heuristics without explicit modeling of query-conditioned temporal structure, or through multi stage retrieval pipelines with substantial preprocessing cost. We propose \textbf{CREST}, a training-free frame selection method grounded in the temporal geometry of query--frame relevance. CREST is based on the observation that relevance over time exhibits structured local variation: sharp curvature around salient events and flatter regions in redundant segments. By using local curvature to guide selection, CREST allocates a fixed frame budget more effectively across brief decisive events and slowly evolving evidence. Under a fixed backbone and frame budget, CREST achieves higher accuracy than AKS, a lightweight relevance--coverage baseline, on LongVideoBench and VideoMME, while retaining 93--95\% of the accuracy of MIRA, a stronger multi-stage retrieval pipeline, at only 3--4\% of its preprocessing cost.\footnote{Code and implementation details are included in the supplementary material and will be released publicly upon acceptance.} On TempRel, our diagnostic benchmark for temporal frame selection, CREST achieves a 6.88\% relative improvement over AKS. Pairwise LLM-as-a-judge evaluation further shows that CREST-selected frames yield more coherent frame-conditioned descriptions, with win rates of 60.58\% and 54.50\% on the two benchmarks. These results show that local temporal geometry provides a simple and efficient basis for long-video frame selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CREST，一种免训练的帧选择方法，利用 query-frame 相关性在时间轴上的局部曲率来分配固定帧预算：曲率大的位置对应显著事件，平坦区域对应冗余片段。在固定 backbone 和帧预算下，CREST 在 LongVideoBench 和 VideoMME 上比轻量基线 AKS 更准，并保留强多阶段检索管线 MIRA 93–95% 的准确率，而预处理成本仅为其 3–4%。作者还构建了诊断基准 TempRel，并在成对 LLM-as-a-judge 评估中显示 CREST 选出帧的描述一致性更高。
Motivation: 长视频中挑选信息帧是一个组合问题；现有方法要么采用不显式建模 query 条件时间结构的轻量启发式，要么依赖预处理成本较高的多阶段检索管线。
Method: 提出免训练的 CREST 框架，基于 query-frame relevance 随时间变化的局部几何结构（曲率）指导帧选择，将固定预算集中于短暂决定性事件与缓慢演化的证据上，并配套构建了用于诊断时间帧选择的基准 TempRel。
Result: 摘要报告 CREST 在 LongVideoBench 和 VideoMME 上准确率高于 AKS，保留 MIRA 93–95% 的准确率且仅需其 3–4% 的预处理成本；在 TempRel 上相对 AKS 提升 6.88%；LLM-as-a-judge 成对评估中胜率分别为 60.58% 和 54.50%。
Conclusion: 作者认为局部时间几何为长视频帧选择提供了简单且高效的依据；方法免训练，且在固定 backbone 和帧预算下验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SREGym: A Live Benchmark for AI SRE Agents with High-Fidelity Failure Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly used to diagnose and mitigate failures in production systems, known as agentic Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Current SRE benchmarks are limited to oversimplistic SRE tasks and are unfortunately hard to extend due to bespoke designs. We present SREGym, a high-fidelity benchmark for SRE agents. SREGym exposes a live system environment built atop real-world cloud-native system stacks, where high-fidelity failure scenarios are simulated through fault injectors. SREGym models the complexity of production environments by simulating (1) a wide range of faults at different layers, (2) various ambient noises, and (3) diverse failure modes such as metastable failures and correlated failures. SREGym is architected as a modular, extensible framework that orchestrates fault and noise injectors across stacks. SREGym currently includes 90 realistic, challenging SRE problems. We use SREGym to evaluate frontier agents and show that their capabilities varies significantly in addressing different kinds of failures, with up to 40% differences in end-to-end results. SREGym is actively maintained as an open-source project and has been used by researchers and practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SREGym，一个面向 AI SRE（站点可靠性工程）智能体的高保真基准。该基准基于真实云原生系统栈搭建实时系统环境，通过故障注入器模拟多种高保真故障场景，并纳入环境噪音以及 metastable failures 与 correlated failures 等复杂失效模式。SREGym 目前包含 90 个真实且具有挑战性的 SRE 问题，用于评估前沿智能体在不同故障类型上的诊断与修复能力。
Motivation: 现有 SRE 基准局限于过度简化的 SRE 任务，且由于定制化设计而难以扩展，缺乏能够反映生产环境复杂度的评测平台。
Method: SREGym 构建在真实云原生系统栈之上，提供实时系统环境；通过故障注入器模拟不同层面的广泛故障，并采用模块化、可扩展的框架来编排各栈上的故障和噪音注入器。
Result: 使用 SREGym 评估前沿智能体后发现，它们在不同故障类型上的能力差异显著，端到端结果的最大差异可达 40%。
Conclusion: SREGym 作为一个积极维护的开源项目，已被研究者和实践者采用，但其适用范围限定于 SRE 智能体评测，而非其他领域的通用基准。

papers.title: A Nonlinear Singular Value Theory for Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recently Brown et al. [2025] established a singular value decomposition (SVD) for maps (especially nonlinear) satisfying certain norm conditions. We prove that most modern neural architectures admit this nonlinear SVD (NLSVD) representation---with no change in input--output behavior---and enumerate the classes covered. In this factorization the network is a left-invertible nonlinear map followed by a final linear layer. Moreover, the left-invertible factor is norm-preserving, so distances in the embedding (activations before the final linear layer) calibrate directly to distances in input space. We introduce a flexible architecture that yields an explicit decomposition at training time, a data-driven algorithm for estimating the representation from trained models, and the mathematical foundations for nonlinear analogues of row and null spaces in neural networks. Empirical case studies illustrate uses of the theory for latent-space pullback (visualization and data generation), bias detection, and membership-inference robustness under training. Altogether, these foundations support new approaches to core problems in neural-network analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Brown 等人 2025 年提出的非线性奇异值分解 (NLSVD) 理论基础上，证明大多数现代神经网络架构可以在不改变输入-输出行为的前提下接受该表示，并枚举了覆盖的架构类别。该分解将网络写成一个保范数的左可逆非线性映射后接一个最终线性层，从而让嵌入空间 (最终线性层前的激活) 中的距离直接对应输入空间距离。作者还提出可在训练时获得显式分解的灵活架构、从已训练模型估计该表示的数据驱动算法，以及非线性行空间与零空间的数学基础，并用实证案例展示其在潜在空间拉回、偏差检测和成员推断鲁棒性方面的用途。
Motivation: 已有的 SVD 理论主要针对线性映射或满足特定范数条件的非线性映射，本文旨在证明现代神经网络普遍满足这种非线性 SVD 条件，并为其提供可计算的表示和估计算法，使神经网络分析具备与输入空间对齐的几何结构。
Method: 通过理论证明并枚举可接受 NLSVD 表示的现代神经网络架构类别；引入一种在训练时即可得到显式分解的灵活架构；提出从已训练模型中数据驱动地估计该表示 (即左可逆保范数因子加最终线性层) 的算法；并建立非线性行空间和零空间的数学基础。
Result: 摘要中的实证案例研究展示了该方法在潜在空间拉回 (latent-space pullback) 用于可视化和数据生成、偏差检测 (bias detection) 以及训练下成员推断鲁棒性 (membership-inference robustness) 方面的用途；摘要未给出定量结果。
Conclusion: 这些理论和方法为神经网络分析中的核心问题提供新工具，关键收益是保范数嵌入使得潜在空间距离与输入空间距离直接对应；摘要未提及局限性或定量评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文在 Brown 等人 2025 年提出的非线性奇异值分解 (NLSVD) 理论基础上，证明大多数现代神经网络架构可以在不改变输入-输出行为的前提下接受该表示，并枚举了覆盖的架构类别。该分解将网络写成一个保范数的左可逆非线性映射后接一个最终线性层，从而让嵌入空间 (最终线性层前的激活) 中的距离直接对应输入空间距离。作者还提出可在训练时获得显式分解的灵活架构、从已训练模型估计该表示的数据驱动算法，以及非线性行空间与零空间的数学基础，并用实证案例展示其在潜在空间拉回、偏差检测和成员推断鲁棒性方面的用途。
summary_sections.motivation: 已有的 SVD 理论主要针对线性映射或满足特定范数条件的非线性映射，本文旨在证明现代神经网络普遍满足这种非线性 SVD 条件，并为其提供可计算的表示和估计算法，使神经网络分析具备与输入空间对齐的几何结构。
summary_sections.method: 通过理论证明并枚举可接受 NLSVD 表示的现代神经网络架构类别；引入一种在训练时即可得到显式分解的灵活架构；提出从已训练模型中数据驱动地估计该表示 (即左可逆保范数因子加最终线性层) 的算法；并建立非线性行空间和零空间的数学基础。
summary_sections.result: 摘要中的实证案例研究展示了该方法在潜在空间拉回 (latent-space pullback) 用于可视化和数据生成、偏差检测 (bias detection) 以及训练下成员推断鲁棒性 (membership-inference robustness) 方面的用途；摘要未给出定量结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 这些理论和方法为神经网络分析中的核心问题提供新工具，关键收益是保范数嵌入使得潜在空间距离与输入空间距离直接对应；摘要未提及局限性或定量评估。

papers.title: EgoEverything: A Benchmark for Human Behavior Inspired Long Context Egocentric Video Understanding in AR Environment
papers.abstract_en: Long context egocentric video understanding has recently attracted significant research attention, with augmented reality (AR) highlighted as one of its most important application domains. Nevertheless, the task remains highly challenging due to the need for reasoning over extended temporal contexts and diverse, unstructured activities. Although several benchmarks exist, most egocentric datasets rely on human worn cameras and focus mainly on visual content, with limited consideration of underlying user behavior when forming video-related queries. EgoEverything is a benchmark that explicitly considers human behavior by leveraging human attention signals, abstracted from gaze data, when generating questions. It comprises over 5,000 multiple choice question answer pairs, spanning more than 100 hours of video. By integrating human attention signals during question generation, it more faithfully captures natural human behavior and offers a realistic evaluation setting for long-context egocentric video understanding in AR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoEverything，一个面向增强现实（AR）环境下长上下文第一视角（egocentric）视频理解的基准。该基准包含超过 100 小时的视频和 5,000 多个选择题问答对，并在问题生成时引入从注视数据抽象出的人类注意力信号，以更真实地反映自然人类行为。作者认为这为 AR 中的长上下文第一视角视频理解提供了更现实的评测设置。
Motivation: 现有第一视角数据集大多依赖人戴相机，主要关注视觉内容，在形成与视频相关的问题时很少考虑底层用户行为；而 AR 这类应用需要对长时间跨度的多样、无结构活动进行推理，任务仍然具有挑战性。
Method: 构建 EgoEverything 基准，利用从 gaze data 抽象出的人类注意力信号来辅助生成问题，从而将人类行为显式纳入问题生成过程，而非仅基于视觉内容。
Result: 摘要报告基准规模为超过 5,000 个选择题问答对，覆盖超过 100 小时的视频；未给出具体的模型评测数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过整合人类注意力信号可以更忠实地捕捉自然人类行为，为 AR 环境中的长上下文第一视角视频理解提供一个现实的评测场景。

papers.title: ActionParty: Multi-Subject Action Binding in Generative Video Games
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video diffusion have enabled the development of "world models" capable of simulating interactive environments. However, these models are largely restricted to single-agent settings, failing to control multiple agents simultaneously in a scene. In this work, we tackle a fundamental issue of action binding in existing video diffusion models, which struggle to associate specific actions with their corresponding subjects. For this purpose, we propose ActionParty, an action controllable multi-subject world model for generative video games. It introduces subject state tokens, i.e. latent variables that persistently capture the state of each subject in the scene. By jointly modeling state tokens and video latents with a spatial biasing mechanism, we disentangle global video frame rendering from individual action-controlled subject updates. We evaluate ActionParty on the Melting Pot benchmark, demonstrating the first video world model capable of controlling up to seven players simultaneously across 46 diverse environments. Our results show significant improvements in action-following accuracy and identity consistency, while enabling robust autoregressive tracking of subjects through complex interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActionParty，一个面向生成式视频游戏的多主体动作可控世界模型，解决视频扩散模型难以将具体动作绑定到对应主体（action binding）的问题。它引入主体状态 token（subject state tokens）与空间偏置机制（spatial biasing mechanism），将全局视频帧渲染与个体动作控制解耦。在 Melting Pot 基准上，该方法支持最多七个玩家在 46 个环境中同时控制，并在动作跟随准确率和身份一致性上取得显著提升。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散世界模型大多局限于单智能体场景，无法同时控制场景中的多个智能体；核心问题是视频扩散模型难以把特定动作与场景中对应的主体正确关联起来。
Method: 提出 ActionParty，引入持续捕获每个主体状态的主体状态 token，并与视频潜变量（video latents）通过空间偏置机制联合建模，从而将全局视频帧渲染与由动作控制的个体主体更新相解耦。
Result: 在 Melting Pot 基准上，该方法成为首个能同时在 46 个多样化环境中控制多达七个玩家的视频世界模型；摘要报告其在动作跟随准确率和身份一致性上取得显著改进，并能通过复杂交互进行稳健的自回归主体跟踪。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模主体状态并将全局渲染与个体动作控制解耦是多主体动作可控世界模型的关键。

papers.title: Inference-time Trajectory Optimization for Structure-Preserving Manga Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: We present a lightweight, training-free trajectory correction method that adapts a pretrained image editing model to each input manga image using only the input itself. Despite recent progress in pretrained image editing, such models often underperform on manga because they are trained predominantly on natural-image data, while re-training or fine-tuning them on manga is costly and raises copyright concerns. Many manga image editing tasks encountered in practice are structure-preserving, requiring local details to be modified while the input's global composition is retained. To support this common editing setting, our method corrects the early editing trajectory by anchoring it to an empty-prompt reconstruction trajectory. Experiments indicate improved performance in the main text-removal setting, while qualitative examples suggest better composition preservation in screentone synthesis. With FLUX.1 Kontext on an RTX A6000, the method incurs 11% runtime overhead and 0.1% peak-memory overhead; an additional runtime measurement with Qwen Image Edit 2509 on an NVIDIA H200 shows only a 0.1% increase.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级、无需训练的轨迹校正方法，仅利用每张输入漫画图像本身来适配预训练图像编辑模型。方法将早期编辑轨迹锚定到空提示（empty-prompt）重建轨迹，以支持保持结构（structure-preserving）的漫画编辑，例如文字移除和网点合成。实验显示文字移除场景性能提升，且在 FLUX.1 Kontext 上仅带来 11% 运行时开销和 0.1% 峰值内存开销。
Motivation: 预训练图像编辑模型主要基于自然图像训练，在漫画上表现不佳，而针对漫画重训或微调成本高昂并引发版权顾虑。实际中很多漫画编辑任务需要保持全局构图、仅修改局部细节，缺乏轻量适配方案。
Method: 提出训练免费的推理时轨迹校正方法，通过把早期编辑轨迹锚定到空提示重建轨迹，修正预训练模型在漫画输入上的编辑轨迹，使其适应保持结构的编辑任务。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在主要文字移除设置中性能提升，定性示例显示网点合成（screentone synthesis）中构图保持更好；在 RTX A6000 上 FLUX.1 Kontext 的运行时开销为 11%、峰值内存开销为 0.1%，在 NVIDIA H200 上 Qwen Image Edit 2509 的额外运行时仅增加 0.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以极小计算开销实现无需训练的逐图适配，适用于保持结构的漫画编辑；但实验证据主要集中在文字移除与网点合成的定性/定量结果。

papers.title: OPERA: Online Data Pruning for Efficient Retrieval Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Domain-specific finetuning is essential for dense retrievers, yet not all data pairs contribute equally to the learning process. We introduce OPERA, a data pruning framework that exploits this heterogeneity to improve both the effectiveness and efficiency of retrieval model adaptation. We first investigate static pruning (SP), which retains only high-similarity query-document pairs, revealing an intrinsic quality-coverage tradeoff: ranking (NDCG) improves while retrieval (Recall) can degrade due to reduced query diversity. To resolve this tradeoff, we propose a two-stage dynamic pruning (DP) strategy that adaptively modulates sampling probabilities at both query and document levels throughout training, prioritizing high-quality examples while maintaining access to the full training set. Evaluations across eight datasets spanning six domains demonstrate the effectiveness of both approaches: SP improves ranking over standard finetuning (NDCG@10 +0.2 points), while DP achieves the strongest performance on both ranking (NDCG@10 +1.0 points) and retrieval (Recall@20 +0.4 points), with an average rank of 1.38 across all methods. These findings scale to Qwen3-Embedding, an LLM-based dense retriever, confirming architecture-agnostic benefits. Notably, DP reaches comparable performance in less than 50\% of the training time required by standard finetuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OPERA，一个面向稠密检索模型领域微调的数据剪枝框架。作者先研究静态剪枝 (SP)，即仅保留高相似度的 query-document 对，发现其存在内在的质量-覆盖度权衡：排序指标 (NDCG) 提升但检索指标 (Recall) 因 query 多样性下降而退化。为化解该权衡，作者提出两阶段动态剪枝 (DP) 策略，在训练中同时于 query 和 document 层面自适应调整采样概率。在八个数据集、六个领域的评测中，DP 在排序和检索任务上均取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 稠密检索器的领域微调中，并非所有数据对都对学习过程贡献相同，而现有方法未利用这种异质性；简单的静态剪枝又会因降低 query 多样性而牺牲检索召回。
Method: 提出 OPERA 数据剪枝框架：先分析只保留高相似度数据对的静态剪枝 (SP)，再提出两阶段动态剪枝 (DP) 策略，在训练过程中自适应调整 query 级和 document 级的采样概率，优先使用高质量样本同时保持对完整训练集的访问。
Result: 在八个数据集、六个领域的评测中，SP 相比标准微调提升排序 NDCG@10 +0.2 点；DP 同时在排序 (NDCG@10 +1.0 点) 和检索 (Recall@20 +0.4 点) 上达到最强，所有方法中平均排名 1.38。该结论可扩展至 LLM 基稠密检索器 Qwen3-Embedding，且 DP 在不到标准微调 50% 的训练时间内达到可比性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调动态剪枝能够在保持全训练集访问的同时优先高质量样本，从而同时提升检索模型适配的排序与检索效果，并具有架构无关性。

papers.title: GEMSS: A Variational Method for Discovering Multiple Sparse Solutions in Classification and Regression Problems
papers.abstract_en: In underdetermined regression and classification problems, multiple feature subsets often yield equivalent predictive performance. In applied settings, especially with $n \ll p$, high dimension or collinearities, it is valuable to provide a domain expert with a menu of statistically plausible explanations, rather than one arbitrary solution. This creates the need for appropriate methods. We present Gaussian Ensemble for Multiple Sparse Solutions (GEMSS), a method that uses a single variational mixture to approximate the corresponding multimodal posterior. Its evidence lower bound contains a built-in repulsion between the mixture's components, enabling the model to simultaneously produce several distinct sparse solutions. We evaluate GEMSS on a novel, reusable benchmark. The ground-truth solution set and its structure are known by construction and set-level recovery metrics are evaluated. GEMSS consistently outperforms dedicated multiplicity methods (Enumeration LASSO, ALFESE), two strong sampling baselines that approximate the same posterior (Randomized-LASSO ensemble, BB-SSL), and naive iterative masking. As solutions' overlap increases, the gap widens and additional ensemble restarts cannot close it. Only ALFESE proves competitive. Further, GEMSS is validated on real-world datasets, producing multiple distinct and highly predictive solutions: the practical goal that existing methods struggle to meet. The open-source Python package 'gemss' is available (github.com/kat-er-ina/gemss) and democratized through a free online application at huggingface.co/spaces/kat-er-ina/gemss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEMSS（Gaussian Ensemble for Multiple Sparse Solutions），一种利用单一变分混合近似多模态后验的方法，用于在欠定回归和分类问题中同时发现多个不同的稀疏解。其证据下界（ELBO）内置了混合分量之间的排斥项，使模型能够生成互异的稀疏特征子集。实验表明，GEMSS 在集合级恢复指标上优于多种现有方法，并在真实数据集上产生多个不同且高预测性的解。
Motivation: 在欠定回归和分类问题（尤其是 n≪p、高维或共线情形）中，多个特征子集往往具有等效预测性能，而现有方法通常只给出单一任意解，难以向领域专家提供一组统计上合理的解释候选。
Method: GEMSS 使用一个高斯变分混合（variational mixture）来近似多模态后验分布，并在其 ELBO 中引入混合分量间的内置排斥机制，从而在同一模型中同时逼近多个稀疏解，而无需逐一枚举或反复重启。
Result: 在一个可重复构造的基准上，GEMSS 在集合级恢复指标上持续优于 Enumeration LASSO、ALFESE、Randomized-LASSO ensemble、BB-SSL 以及朴素迭代掩码；当解之间的重叠增大时优势扩大，且额外 ensemble 重启无法弥合差距，仅 ALFESE 具有竞争力。真实数据集实验也证实其能产生多个不同且预测性能高的解。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GEMSS 是发现多个稀疏解的有效方法，能够满足现有方法难以达成的实践目标，并提供了开源 Python 包 'gemss' 及免费在线应用，方便实际使用。

papers.title: FineInstructions: Scaling Synthetic Instructions to Pre-Training Scale
papers.abstract_en: Due to limited supervised training data, large language models (LLMs) are typically pre-trained via a self-supervised "predict the next word" objective on a vast amount of unstructured text data. To make the resulting model useful to users, it is further trained on a far smaller amount of "instruction-tuning" data comprised of supervised training examples of instructions and responses. To overcome the limited amount of supervised data, we propose a procedure that can transform the knowledge in internet-scale pre-training documents into billions of synthetic instruction and answer training pairs. The resulting dataset, called FineInstructions, uses ~18M instruction templates created from real user-written queries and prompts. These instruction templates are matched to and instantiated with human-written source documents from unstructured pre-training corpora. With "supervised" synthetic training data generated at this scale, an LLM can be pre-trained from scratch solely with the instruction-tuning objective, which is far more in-distribution with the expected downstream usage of LLMs (responding to user prompts). We conduct controlled token-for-token training experiments and find pre-training on FineInstructions outperforms standard pre-training and other proposed synthetic pre-training techniques on standard benchmarks measuring free-form response quality. Our resources can be found at https://huggingface.co/fineinstructions .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FineInstructions，一种把互联网规模预训练语料中的文档转化为数十亿条合成指令-回答训练对的方法。该方法利用约 1800 万个由真实用户查询创建的指令模板，将模板与无结构预训练文档匹配并实例化，从而让 LLM 可以仅用指令微调目标从头预训练。受控的 token-for-token 训练实验显示，FineInstructions 预训练在自由形式回答质量的标准基准上优于标准预训练及其他合成预训练方法。
Motivation: 由于监督指令数据有限，LLM 通常先用海量无结构文本做自监督的下一词预测预训练，再用少量指令微调数据适配下游用法，导致预训练目标与用户提示回答这一下游分布不一致。
Method: 提出一个将互联网规模预训练文档中的知识转化为数十亿条合成指令-答案训练对的流程，核心是约 1800 万个源自真实用户查询的指令模板，这些模板被匹配并实例化到人类撰写的源文档上。
Result: 在受控的逐 token 匹配训练实验中，仅用 FineInstructions 指令目标预训练的模型，在衡量自由形式响应质量的标准基准上优于标准预训练和其他已提出的合成预训练技术。
Conclusion: 在预训练规模上提供监督式合成数据，使 LLM 能够仅用指令微调目标从头训练，该目标与下游用户提示回答的用法更同分布。

papers.title: Multimodal Reinforcement Learning with Adaptive Verifier for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reasoning models trained with multimodal reinforcement learning (MMRL) have become increasingly capable, yet they are almost universally optimized using sparse, outcome-based rewards computed based on the final answers. Richer rewards computed from the reasoning tokens can improve learning significantly by providing more fine-grained guidance. However, it is challenging to compute more informative rewards in MMRL beyond those based on outcomes since different samples may require different scoring functions and teacher models may provide noisy reward signals too. In this paper, we introduce the Argos (Agentic Reward for Grounded & Objective Scoring), a principled reward agent to train multimodal reasoning models for agentic tasks. For each sample, Argos selects from a pool of teacher-model derived and rule-based scoring functions to simultaneously evaluate: (i) final response accuracy, (ii) spatiotemporal localization of referred entities and actions, and (iii) the quality of the reasoning process. We find that by leveraging our agentic verifier across both SFT data curation and RL training, our model achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple agentic tasks such as spatial reasoning, visual hallucination as well as robotics and embodied AI benchmarks. Critically, we demonstrate that just relying on SFT post-training on highly curated reasoning data is insufficient, as agents invariably collapse to ungrounded solutions during RL without our online verification. We also show that our agentic verifier can help to reduce reward-hacking in MMRL. Finally, we also provide a theoretical justification for the effectiveness of Argos through the concept of pareto-optimality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Argos (Agentic Reward for Grounded & Objective Scoring)，一个用于多模态强化学习 (MMRL) 训练 agentic 推理模型的奖励智能体。Argos 针对每个样本从教师模型派生的与基于规则的评分函数池中选择函数，同时评估最终回答准确性、所指实体与动作的时空定位以及推理过程质量，并将其用于 SFT 数据筛选和 RL 训练。摘要报告该方法在空间推理、视觉幻觉以及机器人/具身 AI 基准上达到 SOTA，并表明仅靠 SFT 后训练不够，RL 中若无在线验证智能体必然坍缩为无 grounding 的解。
Motivation: 现有的多模态推理模型几乎普遍使用基于最终答案的稀疏结果奖励 (outcome-based rewards)，而基于推理 token 的稠密奖励能提供更细粒度指导，但在 MMRL 中难以计算，因为不同样本需要不同评分函数，且教师模型给出的奖励信号可能带噪声。
Method: Argos 是一种奖励智能体：对每个样本，从教师模型派生和基于规则的评分函数池中选择合适的函数，同时评估三类信号——最终回答准确性、所指实体和动作的时空定位、推理过程质量；该验证器既用于 SFT 数据策展，也集成到 RL 训练中。
Result: 摘要报告 Argos 在空间推理、视觉幻觉及机器人和具身 AI 基准上取得 SOTA；仅依赖高度策展推理数据的 SFT 后训练不足以防止 RL 中的 ungrounded 坍缩，而在线验证可避免该问题并减少 reward-hacking；论文还通过 Pareto 最优性给出理论解释。
Conclusion: 作者强调，接地且客观的 agentic 验证器 (verifier) 能显著改进 MMRL 训练，在线验证对于防止 agent 在 RL 中坍缩到无 grounding 的解至关重要，其有效性可从 Pareto 最优性角度得到理论支持。

papers.title: AREA3D: Active Reconstruction Agent with Unified Feed-Forward 3D Perception and Vision-Language Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Active 3D reconstruction enables an agent to autonomously select viewpoints to efficiently obtain accurate and complete scene geometry, rather than passively reconstructing scenes from pre-collected images. However, existing active reconstruction methods often rely on hand-crafted geometric heuristics, which can lead to redundant observations without substantially improving reconstruction quality. To address this limitation, we propose AREA3D, an active reconstruction agent that leverages feed-forward 3D reconstruction models and vision-language guidance. Our framework decouples view-uncertainty modeling from the underlying feed-forward reconstructor, enabling precise uncertainty estimation without expensive online optimization. In addition, an integrated vision-language model provides high-level semantic guidance, encouraging informative and diverse viewpoints beyond purely geometric cues. Extensive experiments on both scene-level and object-level benchmarks demonstrate that AREA3D achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy, particularly in the sparse-view regime. Code will be made available at: https://github.com/TianlingXu/AREA3D .
papers.journal_ref: Tianling Xu, Shengzhe Gan, Leslie Gu, Yuelei Li, Fangneng Zhan, Hanspeter Pfister. The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) (The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AREA3D，一个面向主动 3D 重建 (active 3D reconstruction) 的智能体，利用前馈 3D 重建模型与视觉-语言引导来选择视角，而不是依赖手工设计的几何启发式。框架将视图不确定性建模与底层前馈重建器解耦，无需昂贵的在线优化即可进行精确不确定性估计；同时集成视觉-语言模型提供高层语义引导，鼓励信息丰富且多样的视角。在场景级和物体级基准上，AREA3D 在稀疏视角设置下取得先进的重建精度。
Motivation: 现有主动重建方法常依赖手工几何启发式来选择视角，导致冗余观测且未能显著提升重建质量。作者希望让智能体自主选择视角，以高效获得准确完整的场景几何。
Method: 提出一个主动重建智能体，使用前馈 3D 重建模型 (feed-forward 3D reconstruction model) 作为底层重建器，并将视图不确定性建模与重建器解耦，从而避免昂贵在线优化的精确不确定性估计；再集成视觉-语言模型 (vision-language model) 提供语义层面引导，使视角选择超越纯几何线索。
Result: 摘要报告在场景级和物体级基准上的大量实验表明，AREA3D 在重建精度上达到目前最优 (state-of-the-art)，尤其在稀疏视角 (sparse-view) 场景下提升明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为解耦不确定性建模并引入视觉-语言语义引导，可以有效改善主动 3D 重建的视角选择与重建质量。代码将公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Robust Bidirectional Associative Memory via Regularization Inspired by the Subspace Rotation Algorithm
papers.abstract_en: Bidirectional Associative Memory (BAM) trained with Bidirectional Backpropagation (B-BP) often suffers from poor robustness and high sensitivity to noise and adversarial attacks. To address these issues, we propose a novel gradient-free training algorithm, the Bidirectional Subspace Rotation Algorithm (B-SRA), which significantly improves the robustness and convergence behavior of BAM. Through comprehensive experiments, we identify two key principles -- orthogonal weight matrices (OWM) and gradient-pattern alignment (GPA) -- as central to enhancing the robustness of BAM. Motivated by these findings, we introduce new regularization strategies into B-BP, resulting in models with greatly improved resistance to corruption and adversarial perturbations. We further conduct an ablation study across different training strategies to determine the most robust configuration and evaluate BAM's performance under a variety of attack scenarios and memory capacities, including 50, 100, and 200 associative pairs. Among all methods, the SAME configuration, which integrates both OWM and GPA, achieves the strongest resilience. Overall, our results demonstrate that B-SRA and the proposed regularization strategies lead to substantially more robust associative memories and open new directions for building resilient neural architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对双向反向传播（B-BP）训练的双向联想记忆（BAM）在噪声与对抗攻击下鲁棒性差的问题，提出无梯度的双向子空间旋转算法（B-SRA）。通过实验归纳出正交权重矩阵（OWM）与梯度模式对齐（GPA）两个提升鲁棒性的关键原则，并将其作为正则化策略引入 B-BP。在 50、100、200 个联想对的记忆容量及多种攻击场景下，同时集成 OWM 与 GPA 的 SAME 配置表现最强。
Motivation: 现有 BAM 采用 B-BP 训练时对噪声和对抗扰动高度敏感，鲁棒性较差，缺乏有效的训练策略来改善其抗干扰能力。
Method: 提出无梯度的 B-SRA 训练算法，并从实验中提炼 OWM 与 GPA 两个原则作为正则化策略纳入 B-BP；同时进行跨训练策略的消融研究，评估不同攻击场景和记忆容量下的鲁棒性。
Result: 摘要报告 SAME 配置（同时集成 OWM 与 GPA）在 50、100、200 个联想对及多种攻击下鲁棒性最强；B-SRA 与所提正则化策略显著改善了 BAM 的鲁棒性和收敛行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果证明 B-SRA 和正则化策略能带来更鲁棒的联想记忆，并为构建抗扰动的神经架构开辟新方向。
