papers.title: Monotone and Separable Set Functions: Characterizations and Neural Models
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by applications for set containment problems, we consider the following fundamental problem: can we design set-to-vector functions so that the natural partial order on sets is preserved, namely $S\subseteq T \text{ if and only if } F(S)\leq F(T) $. We call functions satisfying this property Monotone and Separating (MAS) set functions. % We establish lower and upper bounds for the vector dimension necessary to obtain MAS functions, as a function of the cardinality of the multisets and the underlying ground set. In the important case of an infinite ground set, we show that MAS functions do not exist, but provide a model called our which provably enjoys a relaxed MAS property we name "weakly MAS" and is stable in the sense of Holder continuity. We also show that MAS functions can be used to construct universal models that are monotone by construction and can approximate all monotone set functions. Experimentally, we consider a variety of set containment tasks. The experiments show the benefit of using our our model, in comparison with standard set models which do not incorporate set containment as an inductive bias. Our code is available in https://github.com/structlearning/MASNET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一类称为 Monotone and Separating (MAS) 的集合到向量函数，要求集合的包含关系 S⊆T 当且仅当 F(S)≤F(T)，并以此处理集合包含 (set containment) 任务。作者给出实现 MAS 所需向量维度的上下界，证明在无限基集下 MAS 函数不存在，转而提出具备弱化性质“weakly MAS”且满足 Hölder 连续性的模型。实验表明该模型相比未引入集合包含归纳偏置的标准集合模型在多种集合包含任务上有优势。
Motivation: 集合包含问题的应用需要将集合映射到向量空间并保持自然偏序关系，即 S⊆T 当且仅当 F(S)≤F(T)；现有标准集合模型通常没有显式编码这种归纳偏置 (inductive bias)。
Method: 定义了 Monotone and Separating (MAS) 集合函数，分析实现该性质所需的向量维度上下界；针对无限基集情形证明 MAS 函数不存在，提出一种在有限基集上可证满足弱化性质“weakly MAS”并具 Hölder 连续性的模型，同时给出可近似所有单调集合函数的通用单调模型。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但实验覆盖多种集合包含任务，表明所提模型优于未将集合包含作为归纳偏置的标准集合模型；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 作者强调有限基集下可用有界维度构造 MAS 函数，而无限基集需采用 weakly MAS 松弛以获得稳定的模型；该框架为单调集合函数的神经建模提供了理论基础和实用方案。

papers.title: Epistemic-aware Vision-Language Foundation Model for Fetal Ultrasound Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Recent medical vision-language models have shown promise on tasks such as VQA, report generation, and anomaly detection. However, most are adapted to structured adult imaging and underperform in fetal ultrasound, which poses challenges of multi-view image reasoning, numerous diseases, and image diversity. To bridge this gap, we introduce FetalMind, a medical AI system tailored to fetal ultrasound for both report generation and diagnosis. Guided by clinical workflow, we propose Salient Epistemic Disentanglement (SED), which injects an expert-curated bipartite graph into the model to decouple view-disease associations and to steer preference selection along clinically faithful steps via reinforcement learning. This design mitigates variability across diseases and heterogeneity across views, reducing learning bottlenecks while aligning the model's inference with obstetric practice. To train FetalMind at scale, we curate FetalSigma-1M dataset, the first large-scale fetal ultrasound report corpus, comprising 20K reports from twelve medical centers, addressing the scarcity of domain data. Extensive experiments show that FetalMind outperforms open- and closed-source baselines across all gestational stages, achieving +14% average gains and +61.2% higher accuracy on critical conditions while remaining efficient, stable, and scalable. Project Page: https://hexiao0275.github.io/FetalMind.

papers.title: Patch-Based 3D Variational Autoencoder for Super-Resolution of Turbulent Channel Flow
papers.abstract_en: Direct numerical simulation (DNS) accurately resolves all spatio-temporal scales of wall-bounded turbulence but becomes prohibitively expensive as the Reynolds number increases. Super-resolution (SR) provides a practical alternative by reconstructing fine-scale flow structures from coarse fields. Most existing SR methods focus on two-dimensional data, where vortex stretching is absent, and extend poorly to three dimensions because model complexity increases with the reconstructed volume. We propose a patch-based three-dimensional variational autoencoder (3D-VAE) that reconstructs a local (16^3) high-resolution block from a larger coarse neighbourhood. The learned operator is then applied convolutionally across the domain with overlap averaging, making the parameter count dependent only on patch size rather than domain size. The model is trained using the streamwise velocity from a single DNS snapshot of turbulent channel flow at (Re_τ\approx 1000) from the Johns Hopkins Turbulence Database and evaluated on a held-out snapshot. Compared with DNS, the proposed method achieves a mean absolute error of 0.055, outperforming tricubic (0.075) and Lanczos (0.076) interpolation. In spectral space, it reduces the mean absolute error of the two-dimensional Fourier amplitude from 2.63 and 2.85 to 0.91, an improvement of about threefold. Applied to coarse finite-element simulations, the model reconstructs spectral content absent from the input, demonstrating transfer beyond filtered DNS. A conditional 3D-GAN trained on the same data failed to converge under Wasserstein training and is reported as a negative result. The main limitations are attenuation of the smallest resolved scales, periodic artefacts caused by the patch stride, and under-prediction of extreme velocity values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向壁面湍流的三维超分辨率问题，提出基于块的 3D 变分自编码器 (patch-based 3D-VAE)。模型从较大的粗尺度邻域重建局部 16^3 高分辨率块，并以重叠平均的卷积方式遍历全区域，参数数量仅依赖 patch 大小而非域大小。在 Re_τ≈1000 的湍流槽道流 DNS 快照上训练并在留出快照上评测，MAE 为 0.055，优于三三次插值 (0.075) 和 Lanczos (0.076)；在谱空间将二维 Fourier 振幅的 MAE 从 2.63/2.85 降到 0.91。作者同时报告了条件 3D-GAN 在 Wasserstein 训练下不收敛的负结果，并指出最小尺度衰减、patch 步长引起的周期伪影和极端速度预测偏低等局限。
Motivation: DNS 能精确解析壁面湍流的所有时空尺度，但随雷诺数升高计算代价急剧增加；超分辨率可从粗场重建细尺度结构。现有方法多基于二维数据，缺乏涡拉伸效应，且扩展到三维时模型复杂度随重建体积增大而上升。
Method: 提出 patch-based 3D-VAE：从较大的粗尺度邻域重建局部 16^3 高分辨率块，再将学到的算子以重叠平均方式卷积式地施加到整个区域，使参数量只依赖 patch 大小而非域大小。模型用 Johns Hopkins Turbulence Database 中 Re_τ≈1000 湍流槽道流的单个 DNS 快照的流向速度训练，并在留出快照上评测。
Result: 相比 DNS，方法达到 0.055 的平均绝对误差，优于三三次插值 (0.075) 和 Lanczos (0.076)；在谱空间将二维 Fourier 振幅的平均绝对误差从 2.63 和 2.85 降至 0.91，约三倍改善。在粗尺度有限元模拟上，模型能重建输入中缺失的谱内容，显示可迁移到 filtered DNS 之外。条件 3D-GAN 在 Wasserstein 训练下未收敛，作为负结果报告。
Conclusion: 作者指出主要局限包括最小可分辨尺度的衰减、patch 步长导致的周期伪影以及对极端速度值的预测偏低；明确提及这些是该方法当前的主要不足。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Moment kernels: a simple and scalable approach for equivariance to rotations and reflections in deep convolutional networks
papers.abstract_en: Translation equivariance is a central reason convolutional neural networks have been successful in computer vision. Other symmetries, such as rotations and reflections, are similarly important in fields such as biomedical image analysis, but equivariant methods for these symmetries remain less widely adopted, especially in 3D. Existing approaches often rely on group convolutions, harmonic bases, irreducible representations, or specialized libraries, which can obscure the explicit form of admissible kernels for practitioners. We introduce moment kernels, a simple Cartesian parameterization of convolution kernels equivariant to orthogonal transformations, $O(d)$, between tensor-valued feature fields. We prove that every such $O(d)$-equivariant kernel can be represented as a sum of radial functions of $|x|$ multiplied by products of coordinate components $x^i$ and Kronecker deltas. This gives a complete, dimension-agnostic kernel family complementary to harmonic-basis approaches and implementable using standard convolution modules. We implement a discrete version of moment-kernel networks and evaluate on biomedical tasks with different transformation laws: invariant 2D image classification and equivariant 3D affine-transform regression for brain MRI. Across these tasks, moment kernels improve worst-case orientation consistency and remain trainable in 3D, while avoiding the orientation-channel expansion required by group convolutions, which reaches 48 orientations for 90-degree rotations and reflections in 3D. The resulting models provide exact consistency under grid-preserving rotations and reflections, and remain practical for standard CNN workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 moment kernels，一种面向正交变换 O(d) 的笛卡尔参数化卷积核，用于在张量值特征场之间实现旋转与反射等变。作者证明任意 O(d)-等变核可表示为 |x| 的径向函数乘以坐标分量 x^i 与 Kronecker delta 的乘积之和，从而给出与调和基（harmonic-basis）互补的完整核族。离散实现分别在 2D 不变图像分类和 3D 等变仿射变换回归（脑 MRI）上验证，能提升最坏情况下的方向一致性并避免群卷积所需的方向通道扩展。
Motivation: 旋转和反射等变在生物医学图像分析等领域很重要，但现有等变方法多依赖群卷积、调和基、不可约表示或专用库，实践者难以获得显式的可容许核形式，尤其在 3D 场景下采用率低。
Method: 引入 moment kernels，一种简单的笛卡尔参数化：将 O(d)-等变卷积核表示为径向函数与坐标分量乘积及 Kronecker delta 的组合，并证明其完备性；实现离散版 moment-kernel 网络，可用标准卷积模块搭建。
Result: 在 2D 不变分类与 3D 脑 MRI 仿射变换回归任务上，moment kernels 改善了最坏情况方向一致性，且在 3D 中保持可训练；相比之下，群卷积为 90 度旋转和反射需要扩展到 48 个方向通道。
Conclusion: 该模型在保持网格的旋转和反射下提供精确一致性，同时避免方向通道扩展，适合标准 CNN 工作流。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cooperative Variance Estimation and Bayesian Neural Networks for Disentangling Aleatoric and Epistemic Uncertainties
papers.abstract_en: Real-world data contains aleatoric uncertainty - irreducible noise arising from imperfect measurements or from incomplete knowledge about the data generation process. Mean-variance estimation networks can learn this type of uncertainty but require ad-hoc regularization strategies to avoid overfitting and are unable to predict epistemic uncertainty (model uncertainty). Conversely, Bayesian neural networks predict epistemic uncertainty but are notoriously difficult to train due to the approximate nature of Bayesian inference. We propose to cooperatively train a variance estimation network with a Bayesian neural network and empirically demonstrate that the resulting model disentangles aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties while improving the mean estimation. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of this method across a diverse range of datasets, including a time-dependent heteroscedastic regression dataset we created where the aleatoric uncertainty is known. The proposed method is straightforward to implement, robust, and adaptable to various model architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/bessagroup/VeBNN.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 camera-ready. 38 pages, 26 figures. Code: https://github.com/bessagroup/VeBNN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将方差估计网络 (variance estimation network) 与贝叶斯神经网络 (Bayesian neural network) 协同训练，以同时估计并解耦偶然不确定性 (aleatoric uncertainty) 与认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty)，同时改善均值预测。作者在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性，包括他们构造的、已知偶然不确定性的时变异方差回归数据集。文章为 ICML 2026 camera-ready 版本，代码已开源。
Motivation: 均值-方差估计网络能学习偶然不确定性，但需要专门的正则化策略防止过拟合，且无法预测模型不确定性（认知不确定性）；而贝叶斯神经网络能预测认知不确定性，却因贝叶斯推断的近似性而难以训练。现有方法难以同时获得两类不确定性，需要新的训练方案。
Method: 提出将方差估计网络与贝叶斯神经网络进行合作式训练 (cooperative training)，使两者在同一个框架下联合优化，从而实现两类不确定性的解耦，并提升均值估计的质量。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种数据集上表现出有效性与可扩展性，其中包含作者构造的时变异方差回归数据集，该数据集中的偶然不确定性是已知的，可用于验证解耦效果。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法实现简单、鲁棒，并能适配多种模型架构；代码已在 https://github.com/bessagroup/VeBNN 提供。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Revisiting Multi-Permutation Equivariance through the Lens of Irreducible Representations
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores the characterization of equivariant linear layers for representations of permutations and related groups. Unlike traditional approaches, which address these problems using parameter-sharing, we consider an alternative methodology based on irreducible representations and Schur's lemma. Using this methodology, we obtain an alternative derivation for existing models like DeepSets, 2-IGN graph equivariant networks, and Deep Weight Space (DWS) networks. The derivation for DWS networks is significantly simpler than that of previous results. Next, we extend our approach to unaligned symmetric sets, where equivariance to the wreath product of groups is required. Previous works have addressed this problem in a rather restrictive setting, in which almost all wreath equivariant layers are Siamese. In contrast, we give a full characterization of layers in this case and show that there is a vast number of additional non-Siamese layers in some settings. We also show empirically that these additional non-Siamese layers can improve performance in tasks like graph anomaly detection, weight space alignment, and learning Wasserstein distances. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/yonatansverdlov/Irreducible-Representations-of-Deep-Weight-Spaces}{GitHub}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用不可约表示（irreducible representations）和Schur引理来刻画排列及相关群的等变线性层，作为传统参数共享（parameter-sharing）方法的替代。作者用该框架重新推导了DeepSets、2-IGN图等变网络和Deep Weight Space (DWS)网络，其中对DWS网络的推导比此前结果更简单；随后将方法扩展到需要wreath product等变性的未对齐对称集，给出了该类等变层的完整表征，并发现存在大量额外的非Siamese层。实验显示这些非Siamese层在图异常检测、权重空间对齐和学习Wasserstein距离等任务上能提升性能。
Motivation: 以往刻画排列等变层主要依赖参数共享，而针对未对齐对称集的wreath等变问题只在很受限的设置下研究过，几乎只能得到Siamese层。本文希望用不可约表示与Schur引理提供统一且更简洁的推导，并填补wreath等变层完整表征的空白。
Method: 采用基于不可约表示和Schur引理的方法论，重新推导既有等变网络结构，并将其推广到需要wreath product等变性的情形，从而系统刻画所有wreath等变线性层，识别出先前方法遗漏的大量非Siamese层。
Result: 摘要报告该方法给出了比以往更简单的DWS网络推导；在实验部分，额外发现的非Siamese层在图异常检测、权重空间对齐以及学习Wasserstein距离等任务上带来了性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为不可约表示视角能够统一并简化多排列等变层的推导，并在wreath等变设置中提供完整表征，表明非Siamese层在若干实际任务中具有价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Tipping Point Forecasting in Non-Stationary Dynamics on Function Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Tipping points are abrupt, drastic, and often irreversible changes in the evolution of non-stationary and chaotic dynamical systems. For instance, increased greenhouse gas concentrations are predicted to lead to drastic decreases in low cloud cover, referred to as a climatological tipping point. In this paper, we learn the evolution of such non-stationary dynamical systems using a novel recurrent neural operator (RNO), which learns mappings between function spaces. After training RNO on only the pre-tipping dynamics, we employ it to detect future tipping points using an uncertainty-based approach. In particular, we propose a conformal prediction framework to forecast tipping points by monitoring deviations from physics constraints (such as conserved quantities and partial differential equations), enabling forecasting of these abrupt changes along with a rigorous measure of uncertainty. We illustrate our proposed methodology on non-stationary ordinary and partial differential equations, such as the Lorenz-63 and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations. We also apply our methods to forecast a climate tipping point in stratocumulus cloud cover and airfoil wake and stall transitions using only limited knowledge of the governing equations. For the latter, we show that our proposed method zero-shot generalizes to forecasting multiple future tipping points under varying Reynolds numbers. In our experiments, we demonstrate that even partial or approximate physics constraints can be used to accurately forecast future tipping points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳混沌动力系统中临界点（tipping point）的预测问题，提出一种基于循环神经算子（RNO）的方法。作者仅在临界点前的动力学数据上训练 RNO，随后结合共形预测（conformal prediction）框架，通过监测物理约束（如守恒量和偏微分方程）的偏离来预测临界点并给出不确定性度量。方法在 Lorenz-63、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 方程以及平流层积云覆盖、翼型尾流与失速转变等任务上得到验证，并展示了对变雷诺数下多个未来临界点的零样本泛化。
Motivation: 临界点会导致非平稳混沌系统发生突然、剧烈且往往不可逆的变化，例如温室气体浓度升高可能引发低云量剧减的气候临界点。现有方法难以在仅有临界点前动力学数据的情况下提前预测这类变化，因此需要一种能学习函数空间映射并输出可量化不确定性的预测框架。
Method: 使用循环神经算子（RNO）学习函数空间之间的映射，仅以临界点前的动力学为训练数据；随后提出基于共形预测的不确定性框架，通过监测物理约束（如守恒量、偏微分方程残差）的偏差来检测并预报临界点。该框架允许使用部分或近似的物理约束。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在非平稳 ODE/PDE（如 Lorenz-63 和 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 方程）上有效，并能预测平流层积云覆盖及翼型尾流/失稳转变中的临界点；在变雷诺数场景下可零样本泛化到多个未来临界点，且即使使用部分或近似物理约束也能准确预报。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，即使在仅有部分或近似物理约束的条件下，该不确定性感知框架也能可靠地预报非平稳动力系统中的临界点，为气候与流体力学中的突变预测提供了通用途径。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: MPP-GNN: Subject-Adaptive Community Detection for fMRI-Based Alzheimer's Disease Classification
papers.abstract_en: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) is a widely used technique for studying the brain. Recent methods that utilize graph neural networks (GNNs) for analysis of brain functional connectivity have shown great potential for the classification of brain disorders, such as Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, these methods often assume a preset number of functional modules across all subjects, which overlooks inter-subject variability. In addition, the discovered modules are rarely used to directly guide the learned connectivity patterns. Here, to address these issues, we propose a Meta Probabilistic Pooling GNN (MPP-GNN). We frame the model's task as a coupled, bilevel optimization that performs adaptive graph partitioning hierarchically to discover subject-specific modules and then uses the discovered brain modules as an explicit prior to guide edge refinement and representation learning. We validate MPP-GNN on two public datasets for AD classification, achieving the highest AUC in comparison to established baselines for both datasets. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that MPP-GNN shows significant alignment with the canonical functional-network organization defined by the Yeo brain atlas and reveals a network-level dedifferentiation pattern for AD.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MPP-GNN（Meta Probabilistic Pooling GNN），用于基于 fMRI 的阿尔茨海默病（AD）分类。该方法将任务建模为耦合的双层优化，通过分层自适应图划分发现受试者特异性的功能模块，并将这些模块作为显式先验指导边细化与表征学习。在两个公共数据集上与既有基线相比取得最高 AUC，且分析显示所学模块与 Yeo 脑图谱的典型功能网络组织显著对齐，并揭示 AD 的网络级去分化模式。
Motivation: 现有基于 GNN 的脑功能连接分析方法通常预设所有受试者具有相同数量的功能模块，忽略了个体间差异；同时，发现出的模块很少被直接用于约束或指导学习的连接模式。
Method: 提出 MPP-GNN，将学习目标视为耦合的双层优化，在层次结构中进行自适应图划分（adaptive graph partitioning）以发现受试者特异模块，随后用发现的脑模块作为显式先验来引导边细化（edge refinement）和表征学习。
Result: 在两个公共数据集上的 AD 分类任务中，该方法相对既有基线取得最高 AUC；进一步分析表明其与 Yeo 脑图谱的典型功能网络组织显著一致，并呈现出 AD 相关的网络级去分化（dedifferentiation）模式。
Conclusion: 作者强调自适应地发现受试者特异功能模块并将其作为先验，能够提升 fMRI 上的 AD 分类性能，同时提供与已知脑功能组织相符的可解释模式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TELLER: Dual-Path Iterative Preference Optimization for Table Entity Linking
papers.abstract_en: Entity linking in tables matches short and ambiguous cell mentions to their corresponding knowledge-base entities. Existing approaches typically rely on data preprocessing pipelines that retain either compact or extensive table content as contextual evidence, and then formulate entity linking as a language generation task for instruction-tuned models; recent systems further incorporate explicit reasoning to disambiguate challenging mentions. However, their training supervision is usually static: fixed preference data cannot adapt to the residual errors of an evolving model, while variations in reasoning length can bias sequence-level preference learning. To address these limitations, we present TELLER: Table Entity Linking through Learning from Errors and Reasoning. We first retrieve and rank Wikidata candidates and retain reduced table evidence in the prompt. The direct-answer path applies iterative direct preference optimization and refreshes its preference data with residual errors from the updated model. The reasoning path uses filtered and compressed chain-of-thought rationales for supervised fine-tuning, followed by our iterative length-normalized regularized preference optimization. On the TableInstruct entity-linking subset, the direct-answer path improves accuracy from 94.35\% to 94.50\%; on the MammoTab V2 evaluation set, it improves accuracy from 87.59\% to 88.20\%. The reasoning path improves accuracy from 92.90\% to 92.95\% on TableInstruct and from 79.09\% to 81.85\% on MammoTab V2, while maintaining high rates of complete reasoning generation. These results show that iterative preference learning benefits both concise entity prediction and explicit reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TELLER，一种面向表格实体链接 (table entity linking) 的双路径迭代偏好优化方法。直接答案路径采用迭代直接偏好优化，并用更新模型的残余错误刷新偏好数据；推理路径使用过滤压缩的 chain-of-thought 理由进行监督微调，再配合迭代长度归一化正则偏好优化。在 TableInstruct 和 MammoTab V2 上，两条路径均提升了准确率。
Motivation: 现有表格实体链接方法的训练监督通常是静态的，固定偏好数据无法适应模型演化过程中的残余错误，且推理长度变化会偏置序列级偏好学习。
Method: 首先检索并排序 Wikidata 候选，在提示中保留精简后的表格证据；此后并行两个路径：直接答案路径使用迭代直接偏好优化并基于模型残余错误刷新偏好数据；推理路径基于过滤压缩的 chain-of-thought 理由进行监督微调，再应用迭代长度归一化正则化偏好优化。
Result: 在 TableInstruct 实体链接子集上，直接答案路径准确率从 94.35% 提升到 94.50%；在 MammoTab V2 上从 87.59% 提升到 88.20%。推理路径在 TableInstruct 上从 92.90% 提升到 92.95%，在 MammoTab V2 上从 79.09% 提升到 81.85%，同时保持较高的完整推理生成率。
Conclusion: 实验表明迭代偏好学习对简洁实体预测和显式推理均有收益。摘要未提及该方法的局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 TableInstruct 实体链接子集上，直接答案路径准确率从 94.35% 提升到 94.50%；在 MammoTab V2 上从 87.59% 提升到 88.20%。推理路径在 TableInstruct 上从 92.90% 提升到 92.95%，在 MammoTab V2 上从 79.09% 提升到 81.85%，同时保持较高的完整推理生成率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实验表明迭代偏好学习对简洁实体预测和显式推理均有收益。摘要未提及该方法的局限。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Planning with Spatio-Temporal and Topological Constraints using STL-GO
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent planning problems arise in a variety of engineering applications, such as multi-robot wildfire fighting and unmanned aerial inspection in factories. A particular challenge is the existence of spatio-temporal (i.e., when and/or where an agent should do what) and topological constraints (i.e., how agents should interact), as typically formalized via the notion of graphs. Over the last years, various frameworks have been proposed that can capture such constraints via spatio-temporal logics. We focus here on spatio-temporal logic with graph operators (STL-GO), a recent formalism that supports reasoning about multiple agents and their topologies, such as sensing, communication, and task topologies. In this paper, we consider the problem of planning multi-agent paths that satisfy constraints written in STL-GO. This problem is particularly challenging due to the need of encoding multiple, potentially time-varying graphs via the graph operators inherent to STL-GO. We present two encodings of this problem, one based on mixed-integer programming (MIP) and another based on satisfiability modulo theory (SMT), with soundness guarantees. We provide a unified interface for specifying agent constraints, their graph topologies, and the STL-GO specification, enabling seamless use of both methods and facilitating direct comparison between them. We evaluate both encodings on a multi-UAV search-and-rescue benchmark, ablating over team size and graph complexity, highlighting the expressiveness of the proposed encodings under dynamic multi- graph interactions.
papers.comment: Accepted at Formal Methods for Computer-Aided Design 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体路径规划问题，要求同时满足时空约束（何时/何地执行动作）与拓扑约束（智能体如何交互），约束用 STL-GO（spatio-temporal logic with graph operators）这一支持多智能体与动态图拓扑的形式化语言描述。作者提出两种编码方案，分别基于混合整数规划（MIP）和可满足性模理论（SMT），并提供统一接口来指定智能体约束、图拓扑与 STL-GO 规范。在 multi-UAV 搜救基准上对两种编码进行团队规模与图复杂度的消融评估。
Motivation: 多智能体规划中，时空约束与拓扑约束的联合满足是一个挑战，尤其是 STL-GO 需要编码多个潜在时变的图（传感、通信、任务拓扑）。现有方法难以高效处理这种动态多图交互下的路径规划问题。
Method: 提出两种带可靠性保证（soundness guarantees）的规划编码：一种基于混合整数规划（MIP），另一种基于可满足性模理论（SMT）；同时构建统一接口，使智能体约束、图拓扑和 STL-GO 规范可以无缝输入两种方法并直接比较。
Result: 在 multi-UAV 搜救基准上评估两种编码，并对团队规模和图复杂度进行消融，结果表明所提编码在动态多图交互场景下具有表达能力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 两种编码均有可靠性保证，并能在统一接口下支持动态多图交互的 STL-GO 约束规划。摘要未讨论局限性与计算开销细节。

papers.title: ViSAGE: Constructing Self-Correcting Memories for Long-Form Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents operating in long-horizon environments must build and continually update multimedia memories to support entity-consistent, temporally grounded reasoning. However, existing agentic memory approaches often discard fine-grained dentity cues under aggressive compression and segment-wise processing. They also rely heavily on vector similarity retrieval, which can surface semantically related yet identity-mismatched evidence, leading to entity confusion, error propagation, and hallucinated answers. We propose ViSAGE, a multimodal agentic memory framework that constructs self-correcting, entity-centric memories. Specifically, ViSAGE anchors entity identity via cross-modal binding over long temporal ranges. It then applies bidirectional memory refinement to propagate delayed identity evidence, retroactively unifying historical records and improving future reasoning. We also introduce multi-agent cross-verification to assess retrieved evidence under an identity-evidence alignment onstraint, enabling abstention instead of unsupported answers when evidence is missing. Extensive results demonstrate that ViSAGE consistently outperforms the strongest baseline, achieving 5.9% higher accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViSAGE，一个面向长时视频理解的多模态智能体记忆框架，目标是构建可自我修正的、以实体为中心的记忆。该方法通过跨模态绑定锚定实体身份，用双向记忆精化传播延迟出现的身份证据，并引入多智能体交叉验证在证据缺失时选择弃答而非生成无依据答案。摘要报告 ViSAGE 在基准上超过最强基线，准确率提高 5.9%。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆方法在激进压缩和分段处理下会丢失细粒度身份线索，且依赖向量相似度检索可能返回语义相关但身份不匹配的证据，导致实体混淆、错误传播和幻觉回答。
Method: ViSAGE 首先通过跨模态绑定 (cross-modal binding) 在长时间范围内锚定实体身份；随后应用双向记忆精化 (bidirectional memory refinement)，传播延迟出现的身份证据并追溯统一历史记录；最后引入多智能体交叉验证 (multi-agent cross-verification)，在身份-证据对齐约束下评估检索证据，证据缺失时允许弃答 (abstention)。
Result: 摘要报告 ViSAGE 在相关基准上一致优于最强基线，准确率提升 5.9%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ViSAGE 通过实体中心的自我修正记忆与证据缺失时的弃答机制，可以改善长时视频理解中实体一致性和时序推理的可靠性。

papers.title: Reasoning in Real World Clinical Care: Why Large Language Models Are Not Yet Safe for Autonomous Clinical Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: LLM now pass medical licensing examinations and, in curated cases, can rival physicians at diagnostic reasoning. These developments have accelerated the use of LLMs for symptom assessment and clinical decision support in diagnostic and treatment guidance, administrative documentation, and rules-based alert enhancement. This Perspective concerns the most consequential of these applications: the autonomous triage of self-presenting, undifferentiated patients, with little or no clinician in the loop. For that task, the evidence of safety does not yet exist. The gap is not in medical knowledge but in the fidelity of clinical evaluation: a model optimized to continue the most probable text is not optimized to act safely when the safe answer is the improbable must-not-miss diagnosis. Safe triage is not the selection of the most likely diagnosis; it is a sequential decision under asymmetric cost, in which the single catastrophic miss outweighs many false alarms, and the decisive signal may be one the patient has not volunteered - and that the model has not been trained to seek. The core deficit is therefore one of information gathering under uncertainty. Under incomplete histories, LLM systems may fail to show the behaviors safe triage requires: broadening the differential; seeking the missing red flag; lowering the threshold for escalation; deferring judgement until sufficient information is obtained; and escalating concern where high-harm diagnoses remain unexcluded. These modes of failure for LLMs can be difficult to detect considering that evaluations to date often use complete, well-curated, confidence-gated simulations. The application of LLMs under these conditions may be amplified by assistant-like behaviors and positive bias, including credulity, agreeableness, and miscalibration - when these are not constrained by clinical triage logic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇观点文章（Perspective），讨论大语言模型（LLM）在临床决策支持中最具风险的应用——对自述症状、未分诊患者进行自主分诊且几乎无临床医生介入。作者认为该任务尚不存在安全性证据，核心缺陷不在于医学知识，而在于不确定性下的信息收集；模型优化的是续写最可能文本，而非在非对称代价下安全行动。文章列出安全分诊所需但 LLM 可能缺失的行为，并指出现有评估多用完整、精心整理且置信度门控的模拟，难以暴露这些失败模式。
Motivation: LLM 已能通过医学执照考试、在精选案例中可与医生比肩诊断推理，这推动了其在症状评估、诊断与治疗指导、行政记录和规则警报增强中的应用。作者聚焦自主分诊这一后果最严重的场景，指出该场景下安全性的证据尚不存在。
Method: 作为观点文章，本文通过概念分析论证安全分诊本质上是不对称代价下的序贯决策，单次灾难性漏诊超过多次误报；由此提出核心缺陷是信息收集（information gathering）问题，并列举安全分诊必需的行为：扩展鉴别诊断、追问缺失的红色警示信号、降低升级处置阈值、在信息不足时延迟判断、在高危害诊断未排除时升级关注。
Result: 摘要未报告新实验数据；作者强调现有评估因使用完整、精心整理的置信度门控模拟而难以检测 LLM 的这些失败模式。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 尚不能安全用于自主临床决策支持；若不受临床分诊逻辑约束，类助手行为与正向偏差（轻信、顺从、校准错误）可能放大风险。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Meshy T2: Fast Native Mesh Generation with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Polygonal meshes are the standard surface representation of modern 3D pipelines, and generating high-quality meshes with artist-style topology is essential for film, gaming, and interactive 3D applications. Mainstream approaches serialize a mesh into a token sequence and decode it autoregressively, which is slow at inference and sensitive to error accumulation, making them impractical for interactive asset creation. We present Meshy T2, a fast native mesh generation framework built on flow matching. At its core is a vertex-set mesh VAE that encodes a mesh into one continuous latent token per vertex and decodes vertices, edge connectivity, and face winding order in a single pass, preserving high-precision geometry and artist-authored topology without vertex quantization or welding. Generation proceeds as a coarse-to-fine cascade of two flow-matching models: an image-conditioned voxel flow first sketches the overall shape as a coarse occupancy scaffold, and a mesh flow then populates the scaffold with per-vertex latent tokens, conditioned on the image, the scaffold, and a requested vertex budget. This design delivers three practical capabilities: interactive generation speed through parallel flow-based synthesis; effective face-count control through the requested vertex budget; and native support for multi-part assets, whose components emerge directly from the generated connectivity. In our experiments, Meshy T2 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and completes end-to-end image-to-mesh generation within a median of 6 seconds, over an order of magnitude faster than autoregressive baselines. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/meshy-dev/meshy-t2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Meshy T2 是一个基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的原生网格生成框架，面向图像到网格 (image-to-mesh) 的交互式 3D 资产生成。其核心是顶点集网格 VAE，将网格编码为每个顶点一个连续潜在 token，并在单次前向中解码顶点、边连接和面绕序，避免顶点量化或焊接。生成过程采用粗到细的级联：图像条件体素流先勾勒粗粒度占据骨架，网格流再根据图像、骨架和指定的顶点预算填充逐顶点潜在 token。实验表明该方法在几何保真度上达到当前最优，端到端生成中位时间约 6 秒，比自回归基线快一个数量级以上。
Motivation: 主流方法将网格序列化为 token 序列并用自回归方式解码，推理慢且对误差累积敏感，难以用于交互式 3D 资产生成。作者希望实现快速、可控面数、支持多部件资产的原始网格生成。
Method: 提出顶点集网格 VAE (vertex-set mesh VAE)，每个顶点对应一个连续潜在 token，一次解码出顶点、边连接和面绕序；生成采用两个流匹配模型的粗到细级联：先以图像为条件的体素流给出粗占据骨架，再由网格流以图像、骨架和请求的顶点预算为条件填充逐顶点潜在 token。
Result: 摘要报告 Meshy T2 在几何保真度上达到当前最优，端到端图像到网格生成中位时间为 6 秒，比自回归基线快一个数量级以上，并提供有效的面数控制与原生多部件资产支持。
Conclusion: 作者认为并行流式生成、顶点预算控制和基于连接性的多部件生成使该方法适合交互式 3D 资产生成；代码和权重将在 GitHub 上发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Hard Does It Think? Analyzing Step-Aware Reasoning Energy in LLM Chain-of-Thought Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how computational effort is allocated across individual chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning steps remains an open challenge: existing interpretability methods rely on output-level signals or collapse processing depth into a single trajectory-level scalar, leaving step-wise effort opaque. We propose Step-Aware Reasoning Energy (SARE), a geometric framework that quantifies effort at the granularity of individual CoT steps via Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) between Gram matrices of token hidden states across adjacent transformer layers, capturing inter-token relational structure without requiring eigenvector alignment or cluster correspondence. SARE further contextualizes this energy within reasoning's semantic progression by modeling CoT trajectories as transitions among latent semantic states. Across six reasoning benchmarks and three open-weight LLMs, we find that reasoning energy is highly non-uniform across step types, exhibiting phase-like transitions invisible to trajectory-level metrics; incorrect trajectories show systematically lower energy at critical reasoning junctions; and SARE-based features match or outperform output-based confidence baselines in most settings, indicating that internal geometric dynamics encode predictive information beyond surface-level signals.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: LAWFUL: Law-Aligned Witness for Faithful Use of Latents
papers.abstract_en: When a neural network predicts a physical system accurately, has it learned the governing law as formal, structured knowledge, and if so, does the network's internal computation actually use that representation throughout the law's domain of validity? We identify four interpretability gaps that limit answering these questions for {\em physics laws over continuous variables}: the absence of a coverage-aware causal-consistency measure over continuous counterfactuals; of a domain-of-validity test for the identified circuit; of a verification of the law's invariants and forbidden behaviors; and of a quantification of how a derived physical quantity flows through the circuit. We develop a foundational framework, LAWFUL, that closes the first two and lays groundwork for the remaining two, and illustrate it on the Mocap2Radar transformer, validating whether it learns and internally uses the Doppler frequency law $f(t) = \frac{2 v(t)}λ$ from motion-capture and radar data in which neither $f(t)$ nor $v(t)$ appears.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LAWFUL，一个面向连续变量物理定律的可解释性框架，旨在回答网络是否把物理规律学成了形式化结构知识、以及其内部计算是否在定律有效域内使用该表示。框架补全了覆盖感知的因果一致性度量（coverage-aware causal-consistency measure）和电路有效域测试两类空白，其余两类空白只做了铺垫。作者在 Mocap2Radar transformer 上进行了验证，判断它是否从运动捕捉和雷达数据中学到并内部使用多普勒频移定律 $f(t) = \frac{2 v(t)}{\lambda}$，而数据中并不直接出现 f(t) 或 v(t)。
Motivation: 现有可解释性研究难以回答神经网络是否把连续变量上的物理定律表示为结构化知识并在其有效域内实际使用；作者明确列出四个解释性缺口：连续反事实下缺乏覆盖感知的因果一致性指标、缺少对已识别电路的有效域测试、缺少对定律不变量和禁止行为的验证、以及缺少对派生物理量在电路中流动路径的量化。
Method: 构建 LAWFUL 基础框架，统一处理前两个缺口，并为后两个缺口打基础；框架被应用于 Mocap2Radar transformer，在 f(t) 与 v(t) 均未显式出现的数据上检验模型是否学习和使用多普勒频移定律。
Result: 摘要报告 LAWFUL 能够验证 Mocap2Radar transformer 是否真正学习并在内部使用多普勒频移定律；未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者把 LAWFUL 定位为连续变量物理定律可解释性的基础性框架，明确只完整解决四个缺口中的前两个，其余留作后续工作。

papers.title: Fracture Risk Prediction in Adults Over 50 Years Old Using DXA and EHR: Comparison of Traditional and Machine Learning Models in Two Large Cohorts
papers.abstract_en: Accurate fracture risk prediction is important for osteoporosis management, but commonly used clinical tools may not fully use information available in electronic health records (EHRs) and dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA) reports. We developed and externally validated time-to-event fracture prediction models among adults aged 50 years or older with clinically obtained DXA reports in 2 US health care systems. The development cohort was derived from NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center and the external validation cohort from the Indiana Network for Patient Care. Predictors included demographics, lifestyle factors, prior fracture, comorbidities, medication exposures, osteoporosis treatment history, and DXA-derived T-scores extracted from radiology reports. The outcome was time from index DXA to first incident fragility fracture identified from structured diagnosis codes. We evaluated penalized Cox regression, random survival forest, gradient-boosting survival, and XGBoost survival models using 2 prespecified predictor settings and compared discrimination with clinically reported FRAX major osteoporotic fracture probabilities. The development cohort included 11,510 adults, of whom 858 sustained incident fragility fractures; the external validation cohort included 1,932 adults, of whom 180 sustained fractures. In internal validation, the expanded Cox model achieved a mean Harrell C-index of 0.779, compared with 0.653 for FRAX. In external validation, the corresponding Cox model achieved a Harrell C-index of 0.714, compared with 0.590 for FRAX; gradient-boosting survival had the highest external discrimination (0.725). EHR- and DXA-enhanced models showed better discrimination than clinically reported FRAX scores in this DXA-tested population, but calibration assessment, prospective evaluation, and implementation workflow assessment are needed before clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在50岁以上接受临床DXA报告的成人中，基于电子健康档案（EHR）和DXA报告开发并外部验证了时间到事件（time-to-event）骨折风险预测模型。开发队列来自NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medical Center，外部验证队列来自Indiana Network for Patient Care。研究比较了惩罚Cox回归、随机生存森林、梯度提升生存和XGBoost生存模型，并对照临床报告FRAX主要骨质疏松性骨折概率。内验证中扩展Cox模型的平均Harrell C-index为0.779，而FRAX为0.653；外验证中相应Cox模型为0.714，FRAX为0.590，梯度提升生存模型外验证判别力最高（0.725）。
Motivation: 常用临床工具如FRAX可能未能充分利用EHR和DXA报告中已有的信息，而准确的骨折风险预测对骨质疏松症管理很重要。作者希望检验在DXA检测人群中，结合EHR和DXA的模型是否能提供比临床报告FRAX更好的判别能力。
Method: 利用两个美国医疗系统中临床获得的DXA报告和EHR数据，构建时间到事件预测模型。预测因子包括人口统计学、生活方式因素、既往骨折、合并症、药物暴露、骨质疏松治疗史以及从放射学报告中提取的DXA T评分。结局是从指标DXA到首次脆性骨折的时间，由结构化诊断编码识别。研究评估了惩罚Cox回归、随机生存森林、梯度提升生存和XGBoost生存模型，采用两种预设预测因子设置，并与临床报告的FRAX概率进行比较。
Result: 开发队列纳入11,510名成人（858例骨折），外部验证队列纳入1,932名成人（180例骨折）。内验证中扩展Cox模型的平均Harrell C-index为0.779，高于FRAX的0.653；外验证中相应Cox模型为0.714，高于FRAX的0.590，且梯度提升生存模型的外验证判别力最高（0.725）。
Conclusion: 在DXA检测人群中，EHR和DXA增强模型比临床报告的FRAX评分展现出更好的判别力，但作者指出临床使用前还需要进行校准评估、前瞻性评估和工作流实施评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-\texorpdfstring{$K$}{K} Routing: Two-Sided Dependence Control for Frozen Mixture-of-Experts at Fixed Per-Token Routing Laws
papers.abstract_en: A stochastic Gumbel-Top-$K$ router defines, for every token of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, a \emph{routing law}: a distribution over ordered expert lists and mixture weights. We ask which \emph{joint} distributions over the routing choices of different tokens are reachable while every individual token's complete routing law is held exactly fixed. We give a two-sided construction, \emph{Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-$K$} (\CGA{}). Within a group of related tokens, an exchangeable Gaussian copula positively correlates the Gumbel perturbations at each expert coordinate, which can increase within-group expert-set coherence. Across disjoint pairs of groups, a tunable antithetic construction introduces a selectable amount of negative dependence. We prove that both operations leave each token's ordered Top-$K$ sample, mixture weights, and inclusion probabilities identical in distribution to independent routing \emph{at a routing layer conditioned on its pre-routing logits}; conditional expected expert traffic is preserved as a consequence. We characterize the resulting trade-off: positive within-group coupling can only inflate the variance of realized expert loads relative to independent routing, while nonnegative cross-group opposition can only reduce it relative to flat coupling at the same within-group strength. Coherence and load dispersion are thus controlled by two complementary dependence dials on the invariance constraint surface. Because the base model is untouched, the dials can be driven by a small controller over frozen features, trainable with a score-function estimator: the frozen network is evaluated only in the forward direction, and gradients are confined to the controller. An initial small-scale pilot validates the mechanism and the training route, but does not establish task-level fine-tuning gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合专家模型 (MoE) 中的随机 Gumbel-Top-$K$ 路由器，提出 Hierarchical Copula-Gumbel-Top-$K$ (CGA) 构造：在固定每个 token 完整路由律（ordered Top-$K$ 样本、混合权重与包含概率）不变的前提下，对组内 token 的 Gumbel 扰动引入可交换 Gaussian copula 正相关，并对跨组 token 对引入可调的反演 (antithetic) 负依赖。作者证明这些操作在条件于预路由 logits 的路由层上与独立路由同分布，并刻画了专家负载方差与相关强度之间的权衡。小规模 pilot 验证了机制和训练路线，但没有建立任务级微调增益。
Motivation: 在 MoE 中，随机 Gumbel-Top-$K$ 路由为每个 token 定义一个路由律；尚未明确的问题是：在保持每个 token 的边缘路由律完全固定的前提下，不同 token 路由选择的联合分布可以达到哪些形态，从而同时控制组内专家集合的连贯性 (coherence) 与跨组负载分散度 (load dispersion)。
Method: 提出两面对称构造 CGA：组内使用可交换 Gaussian copula 在各专家坐标上对 Gumbel 扰动做正相关；跨组则使用可调的反演构造引入任意数量的负依赖。作者证明这两种操作在条件于预路由 logits 的路由层上保持每个 token 的 Top-$K$ 有序样本、混合权重和包含概率与独立路由同分布，因此条件期望专家流量不变；控制器可用 score-function 估计器训练，冻结的基础模型只需前向计算。
Result: 理论刻画了权衡关系：组内正耦合只能增大实得专家负载的方差，而组间非负反向依赖在相同组内强度下只能相对平耦合 (flat coupling) 降低方差。初步小规模试验验证了机制与训练路线，但摘要明确说明尚未建立任务级微调增益。
Conclusion: 论文的核心主张是相干性和负载分散度可以通过不变约束面上的两个互补依赖旋钮独立调节，且基础模型不被改动；其适用范围目前限于对冻结 MoE 的控制，任务级效果仍待更大规模验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LARA: Lightweight Adapters in the Residual Stream for Composable Adaptation and Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We present LARA (Lightweight Additive Residual Adaptation), a method for efficient adaptation that operates in the residual stream of a frozen model rather than in its weights. Where LoRA adds an update of low rank to weight matrices, LARA reads the hidden state at a small set of layers and adds a correction of low rank back to the residual stream, leaving all base weights untouched. On a code fine-tuning task and on preference optimization (DPO), LARA matches LoRA at equal parameter counts. Because adaptation is a frozen base plus a residual, LARA exposes a scale γ, applied at inference, that interpolates smoothly between base and adapted behavior, a form of graded control that adaptation in weight space does not offer. Finally, because each behavior is a small residual module over a shared frozen base, many behaviors can be held resident at once and routed automatically per token. We place seven behaviors, six fine-tuned and one optimized for preference, on one frozen 1.5B model for roughly 33 MB of overhead, against one full model for each behavior. Because the base is untouched, behaviors are trained separately and selected per token rather than loaded on demand, which suits hosting many behaviors, and adding new ones, on a single model on a device.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LARA，一种在冻结模型的残差流 (residual stream) 中进行轻量级加性适配的方法。与 LoRA 在权重矩阵上加低秩更新不同，LARA 在若干层读取隐藏状态并把低秩修正加回残差流，基础权重完全不变。摘要报告在代码微调和偏好优化 (DPO) 上以相同参数量匹配 LoRA，并提供推理时可调的比例系数 γ 以实现基础行为与适配行为之间的平滑插值。多个行为可以以小型残差模块形式常驻同一冻结基础模型，并按 token 自动路由；七个行为共占用约 33 MB 额外开销。
Motivation: LoRA 等权重空间适配方法无法提供行为级的可组合控制，且多个适配行为通常需要按需加载。LARA 旨在通过残差流上的独立轻量修正，在不改动基础权重的前提下实现多行为常驻、按 token 路由和可分级控制。
Method: LARA 在冻结模型的一小组层上读取隐藏状态，把低秩修正加回残差流，所有基础权重保持不变；推理时通过标量 γ 插值基础与适配行为，并将每个行为封装为共享基础之上的小残差模块，按 token 自动路由选择。
Result: 在代码微调和 DPO 任务上，LARA 以相同参数量匹配 LoRA；在一个冻结的 1.5B 模型上同时驻留七个行为（六个微调、一个偏好优化），总开销约 33 MB，而基线为每个行为各需一个完整模型。
Conclusion: 由于基础模型不被修改，各行为可独立训练并逐 token 选择而非按需加载，适合在单一设备模型上托管和新增大量行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Guarantees on Dynamical System Distinguishability for LLM Token Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that classifying large language models (LLMs)' responses can be distinguished by modeling token embeddings as trajectories of a black-box dynamical system (DS) and comparing prediction residuals of two DSs. Despite the empirical success of this dynamical approach, a theoretical understanding of why it works, how well it scales as a function of the token sequence, and when it transfers across embedding models remains lacking. We address these questions by formalizing the classification task as a binary hypothesis test between two stochastic linear DSs. We show that the total variation distance between the stationary marginal distributions of the two DSs can be arbitrarily small even when the dynamics differ substantially, which provides a fundamental accuracy floor for any classifier that ignores token dynamics. We then show that the misclassification probability of DS-based classification decays exponentially in the sequence length $L$, with the decay governed by a dynamical discriminability quantity $δ^2$ that captures the spectral distance between the two DSs. We also characterize cross-embedding generalization by introducing an approximate intertwining condition between embedding models and establishing a lower bound on the transferable discriminability in terms of the intertwining map's smallest singular value. Together, these results explain the empirical performance of DS-based classification and motivate further investigation into using DS theory to analyze AI systems, in contrast to the more common approach of using AI to model dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为基于黑箱动力系统（dynamical system, DS）来区分大语言模型（LLM）响应的方法提供理论保证，将分类任务形式化为两个随机线性 DS 之间的二元假设检验。摘要证明忽略 token 动力学的任何分类器都存在准确率下限，并指出基于 DS 的分类误分类概率随序列长度指数衰减，衰减速率由刻画两 DS 谱距离的动力学可区分量 δ² 控制。作者还引入近似交织条件（approximate intertwining condition）刻画跨嵌入模型的泛化，并用交织映射的最小奇异值给出可转移判别力的下界。
Motivation: 基于 DS 的 LLM 响应分类虽有经验成功，但缺乏理论理解：它为何有效、如何随 token 序列长度扩展、以及何时能跨嵌入模型迁移，这些问题尚未被回答。
Method: 将分类任务形式化为两个随机线性 DS 的二元假设检验；利用平稳边际分布的全变差距离分析忽略动力学时的分类器性能；定义动力学可区分量 δ² 刻画误分类概率的指数衰减；通过近似交织条件建立跨嵌入模型的可转移判别力下界。
Result: 摘要表明两个 DS 的平稳边际分布之间的全变差距离可以任意小，即使动力学差异显著，这为忽略 token 动力学的分类器设置了准确率下限；基于 DS 分类的误分类概率随序列长度 L 指数衰减，衰减由 δ² 决定；跨嵌入泛化由交织映射的最小奇异值给出可转移判别力的下界。
Conclusion: 这些结果解释了 DS 方法分类 LLM 响应的经验表现，并激励进一步用 DS 理论分析 AI 系统，这与通常用 AI 建模动力系统的思路相反。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Checking Problem: What must be true before AI ships in a regulated firm
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI programmes stall at a rate that is widely quoted and poorly explained. This paper measures the mechanism. Six document-heavy workflows of the kind performed daily in regulated financial services were run across four model families and three tool configurations, three times each, producing 5,093 scored output elements across 72 configurations. Each configuration was assessed twice: against a demonstration bar, being a single correct run on a single case, and against a production bar requiring sustained accuracy, reproducibility across repeats, verifiable attribution, and a confidence signal that carries information. 57 of 72 configurations cleared the demonstration bar and 32 cleared the production bar, a survival rate of 56.1%. The paper then computes the review burden each configuration imposes, estimated out of sample rather than with hindsight. A tool that states no confidence requires review of 100% of its output, because it offers a reviewer no basis for triage. Requiring the tool to cite its sources and state a confidence reduces that to 49% while holding the residual error tolerance in 17 of 20 configurations. Adding a self-verification pass costs 2.3 times the latency of the plain configuration, reaches 44%, and is the only configuration that fails to hold the error tolerance. The practical implication is that the value of an AI workflow is set less by how often it is right than by how much of it a human must still check, and that the second property is measurable and rarely measured.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对受监管企业中 AI 项目高失败率但缺乏机制解释的问题，对金融服务业日常的六类文档密集型工作流进行受控测量。作者在四个模型家族、三种工具配置、各重复三次的设置下得到 5,093 个评分输出元素与 72 个配置，并分别用演示标准 (demonstration bar) 和生产标准 (production bar) 评估。结果显示 57/72 配置通过演示标准，32/72 通过生产标准，存活率 56.1%；进一步估算各配置的人工审查负担后发现，AI 工作流的价值更多取决于仍需人工检查的比例，而非单纯正确率。
Motivation: 企业 AI 项目在受监管环境中停滞率很高，但常被引用却缺少机制层面的解释；同时，AI 输出的可检查性——即人工仍需审查多少内容——很少被量化，而这恰恰是决定部署价值的关键。
Method: 作者设计了一个测量机制：对受监管金融服务中六种文档密集型工作流，跨四个模型家族和三种工具配置各运行三次，并在演示标准与生产标准（持续准确率、重复可复现性、可验证归因、携带信息的置信度信号）下分别评估；随后用样本外估计的方式计算每种配置的审查负担。
Result: 72 个配置中 57 个通过演示标准，32 个通过生产标准（存活率 56.1%）。不提供置信度的工具要求审查 100% 输出；要求引用来源并给出置信度可将该比例降至 49%，且 20 个配置中有 17 个维持残余错误容限；增加自验证 (self-verification) 环节的延迟为普通配置的 2.3 倍，可将审查比例降至 44%，却是唯一无法维持错误容限的配置。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AI 工作流的价值主要不由正确率决定，而由人类仍需检查的输出比例决定，且这一可检查性属性是可测量但通常未被测量的；该结论对受监管场景的 AI 部署实践具有直接启示。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Sensitivity Analysis of GRU, LSTM and Transformer Encoder in Classification of Automated Driving Systems
papers.abstract_en: Automated driving systems (ADSs) are becoming ubiquitous. Future Software Defined Vehicles (SDVs) may be able to run multiple ADSs, both native and aftermarket such as Comma.ai's Openpilot. Monitoring systems to independently verify which automated driving system is active are important for safety monitoring, regulatory compliance, insurance assessment, and anomaly detection. In this paper, we first evaluate the effectiveness of three sequence-based classification models: Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and a Transformer encoder model for identifying Level 2 automated driving systems using vehicle telematics data alone: Comma Openpilot, Tesla Autopilot, and Cadillac Super Cruise, along with manual driving. All three models achieve strong clean-data performance with macro F1-scores of 0.92 (GRU), 0.90 (LSTM), and 0.93 (Transformer encoder model) when trained on clean data; threat-matched training yields 0.904-0.916 macro F1 with only a modest clean-data penalty. Second, we introduce a modular robustness evaluation framework that simulates realistic telematics degradation through five corruption families at five severity levels (L1-L5). Continuous channels are perturbed using additive white Gaussian noise with cumulative drift, correlated cross-channel noise, and temporal jitter. Binary event signals are subjected to burst loss, delayed transitions, spurious toggles and cross-feature inconsistencies inspired by communication errors. Robustness is measured using macro-F1, which gives equal weight to each class and is suitable for imbalanced multiclass evaluation. Our evaluation reveals a sharp failure-mode split: event-level corruptions reduce macro-F1 only slightly (greater than equal to 0.87 at L5), while temporal jitter collapses macro-F1 to 0.44-0.50 across GRU, LSTM, and Transformer encoder model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 GRU、LSTM 与 Transformer encoder 在仅使用车辆遥测数据 (vehicle telematics) 分类不同 Level 2 自动驾驶系统（Comma Openpilot、Tesla Autopilot、Cadillac Super Cruise 与手动驾驶）上的表现，并在干净数据下分别达到 0.92、0.90、0.93 的 macro F1。作者进一步提出模块化鲁棒性评估框架，模拟五类遥测退化并测量 macro-F1；结果显示事件级扰动影响较小，而时间抖动 (temporal jitter) 使三类模型的 macro-F1 跌至 0.44-0.50。
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统日益普及，未来软件定义汽车 (SDVs) 可能同时运行多种 ADS，独立验证当前激活的系统对安全监控、法规合规、保险评估和异常检测很重要。现有工作缺乏对序列分类模型在遥测退化下鲁棒性的系统评估。
Method: 比较三种序列分类模型，并引入模块化鲁棒性评估框架，包含五个退化族 (corruption families) 和五个严重级别 (L1-L5)；连续通道使用加性高斯白噪声、累积漂移、相关跨通道噪声和时间抖动，二元事件信号则模拟突发丢失、延迟转换、虚假切换和跨特征不一致。鲁棒性用 macro-F1 衡量。
Result: 干净数据下 GRU、LSTM、Transformer encoder 的 macro F1 分别为 0.92、0.90、0.93；威胁匹配训练达到 0.904-0.916，仅带来微小干净数据惩罚。在 L5 级事件级扰动下 macro-F1 仍不低于 0.87，而时间抖动使所有模型的 macro-F1 降至 0.44-0.50。
Conclusion: 摘要强调事件级退化对分类鲁棒性影响有限，时间抖动是主要脆弱点；该鲁棒性评估框架可用于监控系统对 ADS 激活状态的独立验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: NeuroSynth: A Biologically Inspired Continual Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems often perform well on isolated tasks but struggle under continual learning conditions, where training on new tasks can overwrite previously acquired knowledge, a failure mode known as catastrophic forgetting. Biological learning systems reduce this interference through complementary memory processes involving rapid hippocampal encoding and slower cortical consolidation. This study introduces NeuroSynth, a brain-inspired continual reinforcement learning architecture designed to mitigate catastrophic forgetting through a dual-pathway consolidation mechanism. NeuroSynth separates rapid task acquisition from long-term retention using distinct "plan" and "habit" pathways combined with replay and knowledge distillation. NeuroSynth was evaluated against Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) across three sequential navigation tasks with changing goal locations in a non-revisitation continual learning setting. Across six independent seeds, NeuroSynth preserved substantially more early-task knowledge than PPO after sequential training, achieving 18.00% Task A success rate compared to 0.33% for PPO (p = 0.014929, Cohen's d = 1.49) and 35.33% Task B success rate compared to 0.00% for PPO (p = 0.002376, Cohen's d = 2.31). NeuroSynth also demonstrated higher final Task C performance than EWC, achieving 9.00% compared to 2.00% (p = 0.226643, Cohen's d = 0.56), indicating a moderate but not statistically significant advantage. These findings suggest that biologically inspired consolidation mechanisms may improve the stability-plasticity balance in continual reinforcement learning systems.

TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroSynth，一种受大脑记忆巩固机制启发的持续强化学习架构，通过双通路（“plan”与“habit”）结合回放和知识蒸馏来缓解灾难性遗忘。作者在三个目标位置变化的顺序导航任务、非重访式持续学习设定下，与 PPO 和 EWC 对比，NeuroSynth 在保留早期任务知识方面显著优于 PPO，并在最终任务上相对 EWC 有中等但不显著的提升。

Method: NeuroSynth 采用受生物启发的双通路巩固机制，将快速任务获取与长期保留分离：用独立的“plan”和“habit”通路，并结合回放（replay）与知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）。

Conclusion: 作者认为受生物启发的巩固机制可能改善持续强化学习系统的稳定性-可塑性平衡（stability-plasticity balance）。

papers.title: An Ontology-Guided, Deduplication-Aware Extraction Layer for Knowledge Graph Construction from Heterogeneous Documents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models extract entities and relationships from unstructured documents fluently but inconsistently: type vocabularies fracture across documents, the same person surfaces under several name variants, relationships duplicate, and distinct individuals who share a name risk silent conflation. This paper presents the design, implementation, and empirical refinement of a production extraction layer that converts a live document stream into a validated knowledge graph aligned to a formal ontology. The system consumes document metadata from Kafka, routes PDF, spreadsheet, Office, and image content through handlers built for each format, and extracts entities and relationships in two passes using a locally hosted Qwen3.5-9B model tuned on the ontology. Its distinguishing component is ontology-guided extraction: the relevant slice of a curated ontology is retrieved live from a graph database by embedding similarity and injected into the extraction prompt, reducing catalog overhead by about 94 percent relative to static domain slices. Extracted results then pass through a refinement pipeline of five stages: deterministic cleaning, merging across chunks, a second pass for relationships, six deduplication algorithms that require no model inference, and an embedding resolution subsystem whose conflict guard no similarity score can override. Evaluation on intelligence corpora improved search recall from roughly 70 to 95 percent with no false merges, and corrected seven classes of silent quality defect, ranging from a bug that truncated source text by a single character to the systematic duplication of entities that carried title prefixes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个面向异构文档流的生产级抽取层，将实时文档流转为对齐形式化本体 (formal ontology) 的、经过验证的知识图谱。系统通过 Kafka 接收文档元数据，为 PDF、电子表格、Office 和图片内容分别构建处理模块，并使用本地部署的、针对本体微调的 Qwen3.5-9B 模型进行两轮实体与关系抽取。其核心特点是本体引导抽取：从图数据库按嵌入相似度实时检索相关本体片段并注入抽取提示，使目录开销相对静态领域切片降低约 94%。抽取结果再经过五阶段精炼流水线，最终在情报语料上把搜索召回率从约 70% 提升到 95%，且无错误合并。
Motivation: 大语言模型从非结构化文档抽取实体和关系时流畅但不可靠：类型词汇表跨文档分裂、同一人物出现多种姓名变体、关系重复，且同名不同个体存在被静默混淆的风险。因此需要一个能够生产级运行、并与正式本体对齐的验证式知识图谱抽取层。
Method: 提出一个两轮抽取的知识图谱构建系统：第一轮抽取实体并在跨块间合并，第二轮抽取关系；使用基于本体微调的本地 Qwen3.5-9B 模型。本体相关切片通过嵌入相似度从图数据库实时检索并注入提示。精炼流水线包含五阶段：确定性清洗、跨块合并、关系第二轮抽取、六种无需模型推理的去重算法，以及带冲突守卫 (conflict guard) 的嵌入解析子系统，任何相似度分数都不能覆盖该守卫。
Result: 在情报语料上，搜索召回率从约 70% 提升到 95%，且没有出现错误合并；同时修正了七类静默质量缺陷，包括一个将源文本截断单个字符的 bug，以及系统性地重复携带标题前缀的实体等问题。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，结合本体引导抽取与免推理去重流水线，可以让 LLM 驱动的抽取在知识图谱生产构建中达到可靠水平；效果数据与缺陷清单来自情报语料评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Empowering Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Hybrid Tokenization and Serial-Parallel Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain sequential recommendation (CDSR) aims to model users' dynamic interest transitions and sequential patterns across multiple domains. Recently, generative recommendation (GR) has emerged. It first learns semantic identifiers (SIDs) from item semantics and formulates recommendation as autoregressive generation. However, existing methods face two critical issues: (1) they ignore collaborative correlations across domains during tokenization, and (2) they adopt inefficient decoding strategies, such as beam search, during generation, which hinders real-time deployment. To address these limitations, we propose GenCDSR, an effective and efficient generative framework for CDSR. Specifically, we design a cross-domain hybrid tokenization mechanism with a multi-tower architecture to jointly capture cross-domain commonalities and domain-specific distinctions through hierarchical shared-specific and fine-grained codebooks. Furthermore, we develop a cross-domain serial-parallel decoding strategy that leverages the hierarchical SID structure to partially parallelize generation, significantly reducing inference latency while preserving generation consistency. Experiments on three public datasets show that GenCDSR achieves an average accuracy improvement of 1.5 percent and an average inference latency reduction of 85.1 percent compared with state-of-the-art baselines. The implementation code and datasets are available online: https://github.com/Applied-Machine-Learning-Lab/RecSys2026_GenCDSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GenCDSR，一个面向跨域序列推荐 (cross-domain sequential recommendation, CDSR) 的生成式推荐框架。该方法设计跨域混合分词机制和序列-并行解码策略，在三个公开数据集上相较现有最优基线平均准确率提升 1.5%，推理延迟平均降低 85.1%。论文已被 RecSys 2026 接收，代码与数据集已公开。
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法在分词阶段忽略跨域协同相关性，且采用 beam search 等低效解码策略，难以满足实时部署需求。
Method: 提出跨域混合分词机制，采用多塔架构和层级共享-专属 (shared-specific) 与细粒度码本 (codebook) 联合捕捉跨域共性与域间差异；并利用层级 SID 结构设计跨域序列-并行解码策略，部分并行化生成过程以降低延迟并保持生成一致性。
Result: 在三个公开数据集上的实验显示，GenCDSR 相较最先进基线取得平均 1.5% 的准确率提升和平均 85.1% 的推理延迟降低。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架可同时提升 CDSR 的有效性与效率，并公开了实现代码和数据集供复现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Evaluating Federated Pre-Training: On the Reliability of Downstream Fine-Tuning and Intrinsic Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Federated pre-training offers a way to train foundation models on private or distributed data without centralizing the underlying datasets. However, evaluating federated pre-training remains challenging because differences in client participation and local data availability can make directly comparable evaluation difficult. Moreover, pre-training test perplexity is tied to the pre-training distribution, while downstream benchmarks introduce task-specific adaptation that may not faithfully reflect the test perplexity established during pre-training. In this work, we study which evaluation protocol more reliably reflects federated pre-training quality. Using a controlled set of centralized and federated-trained models of a 16M parameter transformer model trained on identical client data, we assess evaluation protocols by whether they preserve a reference ranking established on the same pre-training testset. We compare downstream fine-tuning on GLUE, including full, head-only, and reduced-data variants, with next-token prediction on GLUE text as an intrinsic evaluation signal. Our results show that downstream fine-tuning does not reliably preserve the pre-training ranking, whereas direct next-token prediction exhibits a strong correspondence with the pre-training test perplexity. These findings suggest that downstream fine-tuning alone can be misleading when comparing federated pre-trained models, and that evaluation signals closer to the original pre-training objective deserve greater attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦预训练 (federated pre-training) 的质量评估协议。作者在相同客户端数据上训练 16M 参数 Transformer 的集中式和联邦式模型，检验下游微调与内在评估是否保持基于预训练测试集建立的参考排序。结果显示下游微调不能可靠保持预训练排序，而直接的下一个 token 预测与预训练测试困惑度有强对应关系，提示应更关注接近原始预训练目标的评估信号。
Motivation: 联邦预训练中客户端参与度和本地数据可用性差异使得直接可比评估困难；预训练测试困惑度与预训练分布绑定，而下游基准引入了任务特定适应，可能不能真实反映预训练阶段建立的困惑度。
Method: 使用受控的集中式和联邦训练 16M 参数 Transformer 模型，在相同客户端数据上训练；对比 GLUE 上的下游微调（全量、仅头部、减少数据变体）与对 GLUE 文本做下一个 token 预测的内在评估，并检验这些协议能否保持在同一预训练测试集上建立的参考排序。
Result: 结果表明下游微调不能可靠保持预训练排序，而直接的下一个 token 预测与预训练测试困惑度表现出强对应关系。
Conclusion: 作者认为单独使用下游微调来比较联邦预训练模型可能具有误导性，需要更重视与原始预训练目标更接近的评估信号。

papers.title: TAPR: Enhancing LLM Performance with a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often require carefully crafted prompts to unlock their full potential, which can be a barrier for non-expert users. This work addresses the challenge by introducing a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter (TAPR), a model that reformulates user prompts into task-optimized prompts with the explicit goal of improving downstream LLM performance. We train TAPR using reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), where rewards are derived from LLM-as-judge evaluations of both the reformulated prompt and the corresponding task output. Experimental results on diverse tasks, such as question answering, summarization, and arithmetic reasoning, show that our method yields consistent gains over base models in prompt rewriting ability. Fine-tuning Phi-4-mini-instruct (as the base model for TAPR) produces prompts that contain clearer and more instructive language, leading to higher accuracy on established benchmarks such as Natural Questions and GSM8K. Our code is available at: https://github.com/OliverSavolainen/task-specific-prompt-rewriter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter (TAPR)，一个用于将用户提示改写为任务优化提示的模型，目标是提升下游 LLM 性能。TAPR 使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 进行强化学习训练，奖励来自 LLM-as-judge 对改写后提示及对应任务输出的评估。在问答、摘要和算术推理等任务上的实验表明，该方法在提示改写能力上较基础模型取得一致提升；将 Phi-4-mini-instruct 微调为 TAPR 后，生成的提示包含更清晰且更具指导性的语言，并在 Natural Questions 和 GSM8K 等基准上获得更高准确率。
Motivation: LLM 常常需要精心设计的提示才能发挥全部能力，这对非专家用户构成障碍；现有方法缺少面向任务的、能显式优化下游性能的提示改写机制。
Method: 训练一个提示改写模型 TAPR，以用户原始提示为输入，生成任务优化的提示；训练采用 GRPO 强化学习，奖励由 LLM-as-judge 同时评估改写提示本身和对应任务输出来计算，基础模型使用 Phi-4-mini-instruct。
Result: 在问答、摘要和算术推理等多样任务上，TAPR 相比基础模型在提示改写能力上取得一致提升；在 Natural Questions 和 GSM8K 上实现更高准确率，且改写后的提示语言更清晰、更具指导性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调任务感知的提示改写可以稳定改善下游 LLM 性能，并公开了代码；实验覆盖的任务类型有限，未涉及其他模态或更广泛场景。

summary_sections.method: 训练一个提示改写模型 TAPR，以用户原始提示为输入，生成任务优化的提示；训练采用 GRPO 强化学习，奖励由 LLM-as-judge 同时评估改写提示本身和对应任务输出来计算，基础模型使用 Phi-4-mini-instruct。
summary_sections.result: 在问答、摘要和算术推理等多样任务上，TAPR 相比基础模型在提示改写能力上取得一致提升；在 Natural Questions 和 GSM8K 上实现更高准确率，且改写后的提示语言更清晰、更具指导性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调任务感知的提示改写可以稳定改善下游 LLM 性能，并公开了代码；实验覆盖的任务类型有限，未涉及其他模态或更广泛场景。

papers.title: Geographically Weighted Surrogate Models for Rapid Small-Area Chronic Disease Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Small-area estimation (SAE) enables researchers and policymakers to identify spatial disparities in health outcomes, but survey-based SAE products carry an inherent lag. Gold-standard estimates such as CDC PLACES are released roughly two years after the underlying survey data are collected, limiting their use for time-sensitive decision-making. This study evaluates the potential for machine learning (ML) to serve as a surrogate, learning the relationship between frequently updated area-level predictors and existing SAE outputs to generate timely, comparable estimates in years when SAE from surveys are unavailable or delayed. We evaluate several global and geographically weighted ML models for county-level SAE of ten chronic conditions across the US: COPD, asthma, heart disease, arthritis, cancer, depression, diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and stroke. Our findings suggest that geographically weighted ML frameworks like geographically weighted random forest and geographically weighted regression offer scalable and open data surrogates for rapidly generating SAE and supporting data driven decision making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估机器学习模型作为小域估计 (small-area estimation, SAE) 替代品的可行性，以缓解基于调查的 SAE 产品（如 CDC PLACES）约两年发布滞后的问题。作者对比多种全局与地理加权 ML 模型，对美国县级十种慢性病（COPD、哮喘、心脏病、关节炎、癌症、抑郁、糖尿病、高血压、高胆固醇、中风）进行估计。结果表明地理加权随机森林和地理加权回归等地理加权框架可作为可扩展、开放数据的代理模型，快速生成 SAE 并支持数据驱动的决策。
Motivation: 基于调查的 SAE 产品存在固有滞后：金标准估计如 CDC PLACES 在数据收集约两年后才发布，限制了时间敏感决策的使用。需要利用频繁更新的区域级预测因子和已有 SAE 输出来生成及时且可比的估计。
Method: 评估多种全局和地理加权 ML 模型，学习经常更新的区域级预测变量与现有 SAE 输出之间的关系，以在没有或延迟调查 SAE 的年份生成估计；模型包括地理加权随机森林和地理加权回归，应用于美国县级十种慢性病的小域估计。
Result: 摘要报告地理加权 ML 框架（如地理加权随机森林和地理加权回归）能够提供可扩展、开放数据的替代方案，用于快速生成 SAE；未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 地理加权 ML 框架可在调查报告缺失或延迟时作为代理模型，支持数据驱动的公共健康决策。

papers.title: HenTwin: A Multimodal Digital Twin Framework for Longitudinal Biological State Monitoring in Laying Hens
papers.abstract_en: Early-life monitoring in laying hens remains constrained by fragmented single-modality sensing and the absence of formal system-level state representations. HenTwin, a multimodal digital twin framework implemented as a five-layer IoT architecture, formalizes flock-level multimodal biological state dynamics from hatch through 25 weeks of age. A four-dimensional biological state vector integrating body surface temperature, acoustic energy entropy, band energy ratio, and optical-flow-based motion is defined, with the temperature-humidity index treated as an exogenous environmental input to preserve intervention capability. A discrete-time state transition model is estimated from 25 weeks of longitudinal multimodal data collected from 150 Lohmann LSL-Lite hens across five controlled rooms at the Atlantic Poultry Research Centre, Dalhousie University. The estimated transition matrix exhibits modality-specific persistence while remaining asymptotically stable. Perturbation analysis demonstrates that a sustained +2.0 THI increase produces a stable long-run acoustic entropy elevation of 0.54 nats, approximately one-quarter of the entire 1.87-nat developmental decline observed across the study period. Pettitt change-point detection identifies coordinated multimodal developmental state transitions at Weeks 12-14. Cross-room validation suggests that structural transition parameters are partially transferable across rooms, whereas environmental input sensitivity requires room-specific calibration, supporting a two-tier IoT deployment architecture. Leave-one-out cross-validation demonstrates consistent out-of-sample model performance. HenTwin takes a first step toward formal, state-aware digital twin inference in precision livestock farming.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HenTwin 是一个面向产蛋鸡早期生命监测的多模态数字孪生 (digital twin) 框架，以五层 IoT 架构实现，将从孵化到 25 周龄的鸡群级多模态生物状态动态形式化。框架定义了由体表温度、声学能量熵、频带能量比和基于光流运动的四维生物状态向量，并将温湿度指数 (THI) 视为外生环境输入。基于 Dalhousie 大学 Atlantic Poultry Research Centre 五个受控房间中 150 只 Lohmann LSL-Lite 蛋鸡的 25 周纵向数据估计离散时间状态转移模型。摘要报告转移矩阵具有模态特异性持久性且渐近稳定，并识别出第 12-14 周的协调发育状态转变。
Motivation: 早期产蛋鸡监测受限于碎片化的单模态传感，且缺乏正式的系统级状态表示，难以对鸡群生物状态进行整体建模与推断。
Method: 提出五层 IoT 架构的多模态数字孪生框架 HenTwin，定义四维生物状态向量，将 THI 作为外生环境输入；估计离散时间状态转移模型，并进行扰动分析、Pettitt 变点检测、跨房间验证和留一交叉验证。
Result: 估计的转移矩阵表现出模态特异性持久性并保持渐近稳定；持续 +2.0 THI 增加会使声学熵长期稳定升高 0.54 nats，约占研究期间 1.87 nats 发育下降的四分之一；Pettitt 检测识别出第 12-14 周的协调多模态发育状态转变；跨房间验证表明结构转移参数可部分迁移，而环境输入敏感性需逐房间校准；留一交叉验证显示一致的样本外性能。
Conclusion: HenTwin 朝着精准畜牧业中正式的、状态感知的数字孪生推断迈出第一步，并支持两层式 IoT 部署架构。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Unanticipated Effects of Generative AI on Expertise Pathways and Performance Perception in System Administration
papers.abstract_en: While industry discourse often emphasizes immediate productivity gains and frames GenAI primarily as a tool for automation, the integration of GenAI into system administration may involve deeper shifts in professional practice that are not yet fully understood. Drawing on 14 semi-structured interviews with IT professionals, this paper explores the lived reality of embedding GenAI into daily routines of troubleshooting, scripting, and system verification. Through inductive thematic analysis, we uncover two unanticipated socio-technical findings. First, we describe a "compression of traditional expertise pathways" where GenAI appears to function as both a mentor-like tutor and a "ladder-shortening" tool. While the tool can support faster task performance in unfamiliar domains, our findings suggest it may also reduce a practitioner's exposure to the foundational, hands-on cycles of building, failing, and debugging that historically served as the training ground for technical expertise. Second, we describe a "performance perception shift," where the speed of AI-assisted work begins to reset organizational and self-expectations for productivity. This shift may create a "two-speed culture" within teams and introduce "productivity guilt," as necessary manual work, even when required for safety or validation, is increasingly perceived as slow or a failure of efficiency. Our results raise broader questions about how GenAI may influence expertise development, how professional value is assessed in high-stakes technical environments, and the role of human judgment in complex technical environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于对14名IT专业人员的半结构化访谈，探讨生成式AI（GenAI）融入系统管理日常工作（故障排除、脚本编写、系统验证）后的实际影响。通过归纳主题分析，作者发现两个未预期的社会技术现象：一是传统专业技能路径被压缩，GenAI既像导师又像缩短晋升阶梯的工具，可能减少从业者通过构建、失败和调试积累基础经验的机会；二是绩效感知发生转变，AI辅助工作的速度重置了组织与个人的效率预期，可能引发团队内"双速文化"和"生产力愧疚感"。
Motivation: 行业讨论多强调GenAI带来的即时生产力提升并将其视为自动化工具，但其对系统管理专业实践可能造成的深层结构性影响尚未被充分理解。
Method: 采用质性研究方法，对14名IT专业人员进行半结构化访谈，并对访谈数据进行归纳主题分析，揭示嵌入GenAI后的职业实践变化。
Result: 识别出两个核心发现："传统专业知识路径压缩"（GenAI既充当导师式工具又缩短成长阶梯）和"绩效感知转变"（AI辅助速度重置工作效率预期，催生双速文化与生产力愧疚感）。
Conclusion: 研究提出GenAI可能影响专业知识发展、高风险技术环境中专业价值的评估方式以及人类判断在复杂技术任务中的角色等更广泛问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COSI-Lab: Conference Living Lab for Modeling Multi-Perspective Multimodal Social Intention
papers.abstract_en: COSI-Lab presents a multimodal, multi-sensor dataset of an interdisciplinary scientific workshop containing 32 academics at an international conference. It captures ecologically valid social interactions in a weakly scripted setting consisting of two 30-minute mingling sessions with real professional and social consequences for the participants involved. We argue that future intelligent systems could be better equipped to handle subjective perceptions by modeling their multiplicity not as label noise but as a explainable perspective-driven reasoning process. We focus on the Apparent Intent Inference (AII) problem as determined by ex-situ observers and conceptualize intentions to be independent of manifest future outcomes. We contribute 1. a novel annotation process for AII that accounts for a perceiver's own interpretative tendencies, 2. quantitative and qualitative analyses of intent narratives with respect to diversity, grounding, and plausibility; 3. benchmark tasks for AII and surrounding relevant contextual factors such as social involvement; 4. speech quality audio for all participants as well as privacy preserving multi-modal data, enabling lexical and nonverbal behavior analysis; and 5. coupling of self-reported goals of each participant (30 minute to 3 hour) with annotated AII (seconds).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 COSI-Lab，一个多模态多传感器数据集，记录国际会议中 32 位学者的跨学科研讨会，包含两次各 30 分钟、弱脚本化的社交交流环节，具有生态效度与现实社交后果。数据集服务于表观意图推断 (Apparent Intent Inference, AII) 问题，核心观点是将主观感知的多样性建模为可解释的视角驱动推理过程，而非标签噪声。作者贡献了新的 AII 标注流程、对意图叙述的定量与定性分析、AII 及社交参与等情境因素的基准任务、语音质量音频与隐私保护多模态数据，以及参与者自报目标（30 分钟至 3 小时尺度）与秒级 AII 标注的耦合。
Motivation: 未来智能系统需要处理主观感知，但现有方法常把语义的多样性当作标签噪声；本文主张这种多重性应被建模为可解释、由视角驱动的推理过程。此外，现有社会交互数据集缺乏兼具生态效度与多模态传感器覆盖的场景，难以支撑这一目标的实证研究。
Method: 在真实国际会议上采集非严格脚本化的两段 30 分钟交流环节，覆盖 32 位学者；提出考虑标注者自身解释倾向的 AII 标注流程；对意图叙述做多样性、grounding 与合理性分析；构建 AII 及社交参与等情境因素的基准任务；同时发布语音质量音频与隐私保护多模态数据，并将参与者自报目标与秒级 AII 标注在时间尺度上耦合。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标，主要贡献是数据集本身及其分析：包括对意图叙述多样性、grounding 与合理性的定量定性分析，以及面向 AII 和社交参与等情境因素的基准任务。
Conclusion: 作者认为将感知多样性视为可解释的视角驱动推理过程，有助于未来智能系统更好地处理主观判断；该数据集与标注方法为这一研究方向提供了实证基础。由于是数据集论文，结论聚焦于数据资源、隐私保护设计及基准任务的可用性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将感知多样性视为可解释的视角驱动推理过程，有助于未来智能系统更好地处理主观判断；该数据集与标注方法为这一研究方向提供了实证基础。由于是数据集论文，结论聚焦于数据资源、隐私保护设计及基准任务的可用性。

papers.title: Why It Hurts: Identifying the Drivers of Negative Thoughts in Emotional Support Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for emotional support tasks, such as negative thought reframing. This task relies on modifying cognitive appraisals, the subjective interpretation of events that elicit negative emotions, which is typically conceptualized along multiple discrete dimensions. Current LLM-based frameworks model cognitive appraisal by exhaustively evaluating all possible dimensions, but they fail to account for the varying saliency of these dimensions across different contexts. In this work, we investigate a vital yet overlooked question: "Can LLMs infer the salient appraisal dimensions from emotional support conversations?" To address this question, we introduce the AppraiSal benchmark, containing 996 emotional support conversations with human-annotated mental states, including salient cognitive appraisal dimensions. Furthermore, we propose PRISM, a multi-agent probabilistic framework grounded in Bayesian Inverse Planning, designed to improve LLMs' ability to identify context-specific appraisal dimensions. Experimental results show that PRISM brings improvements to LLMs across various sizes, particularly in identifying the most salient appraisal dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在情绪支持对话中识别认知评价（cognitive appraisal）维度的问题。作者引入 AppraiSal 基准，包含 996 个人工标注心理状态（含显著认知评价维度）的情绪支持对话，并提出基于贝叶斯逆规划（Bayesian Inverse Planning）的多智能体概率框架 PRISM。实验表明 PRISM 能在不同规模的 LLM 上提升识别上下文特定评价维度的能力，尤其在识别最显著维度方面。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的情绪支持任务（如消极想法重构）依赖修改认知评价，但当前框架通常穷举评估所有评价维度，忽略了不同维度在不同语境下的显著性差异。作者因此探究一个被忽视的问题：LLM 能否从情绪支持对话中推断出显著的评价维度。
Method: 提出 AppraiSal 基准，包含 996 段带有人工标注心理状态和显著认知评价维度的情绪支持对话；同时提出 PRISM，一个基于贝叶斯逆规划的多智能体概率框架，用于增强 LLM 识别上下文特定评价维度的能力。
Result: 实验结果显示 PRISM 对不同规模的 LLM 均带来改进，尤其在识别最显著的认知评价维度上提升明显；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为在情绪支持任务中考虑认知评价维度的显著性差异，能够改进 LLM 对上下文相关评价维度的识别，从而更好地支撑认知重塑等应用。

papers.title: ConnectED: A Curriculum-Aligned AI System for Vietnamese Instructional Lesson Planning and Student Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ConnectED, a human-centered AI system that supports the full instructional lifecycle in Vietnamese education by linking curriculum-aligned lesson design, interactive student learning, and feedback-driven refinement. Built on VietEduQwen, a Vietnamese educational large language model trained via supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization, the system ensures academically accurate, pedagogically appropriate, and student-safe interactions. ConnectED operationalizes the ADDIE framework through structured prompt templates aligned with Official Dispatch No. 5512/BGDDT-GDTrH, where each phase serves as both a generation step and a teacher validation gate. The Evaluation phase further closes the loop by connecting student performance data with iterative lesson improvement. Beyond lesson generation, the system integrates a student-facing interactive environment, enabling continuous collection of learning signals to support teacher decision-making. Evaluation on 3,119 questions from the 2025 Vietnamese National High School Examination shows that VietEduQwen achieves 87.02% accuracy, outperforming Qwen3-8B by 6.10 percentage points. Surveys of teachers (n=18) and students (n=214) demonstrate strong satisfaction with curriculum alignment, lesson clarity, and usability. In practice, lesson preparation time is reduced from 3--4 hours to approximately 30--45 minutes with teacher-in-the-loop review. Ablation studies confirm that both DPO training and ADDIE-based orchestration contribute independently to system performance, highlighting the importance of structured teacher oversight for practical deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 ConnectED，一个面向越南教育的人机协同 AI 系统，覆盖课程对齐的教案设计、交互式学生学习和基于反馈的迭代改进。系统基于越南教育大模型 VietEduQwen（经监督微调和直接偏好优化训练），并将 ADDIE 框架与越南教育部 5512 号公文结合，使每个阶段既是生成步骤也是教师验证关卡。在 2025 年越南全国高中考试的 3,119 道题上，VietEduQwen 达到 87.02% 准确率，比 Qwen3-8B 高 6.10 个百分点；教师和学生调查显示对课程对齐、清晰度和可用性满意。
Motivation: 针对越南教育场景中教案设计与学生学习全流程缺乏课程对齐、教师备课负担重的问题，构建兼顾学术准确性、教学适宜性与学生安全的 AI 系统，并引入教师监督闭环以支持实际教学。
Method: 提出 ConnectED，基于 VietEduQwen（由监督微调 SFT 与直接偏好优化 DPO 训练得到），通过结构化提示模板操作化 ADDIE 框架，并按 5512 号公文要求将每个阶段同时作为生成步骤和教师验证门；评估阶段利用学生表现数据迭代改进教案，同时集成学生端交互环境以持续收集学习信号。
Result: 在 2025 年越南全国高中考试的 3,119 道题上，VietEduQwen 达到 87.02% 准确率，超过 Qwen3-8B 6.10 个百分点；教师（n=18）与学生（n=214）调查显示对课程对齐、教案清晰度和可用性满意度高；实际备课时间从 3–4 小时降至约 30–45 分钟；消融实验表明 DPO 训练与 ADDIE 编排各自独立贡献系统性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DPO 训练与 ADDIE 编排对系统性能的独立贡献，指出结构化教师监督对实际部署的重要性；系统主要面向越南教育场景，跨场景泛化等局限未在摘要中展开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Looks Right, Works Right: A Project-Level Benchmark for Multi-Screen Mobile App Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models can convert visual designs directly into executable code, but real mobile products require multiple screenshots to become a buildable codebase with shared components and working navigation. This project-level setting exposes three limits of existing design-to-code benchmarks: they focus on single-page generation rather than complete codebases, cannot evaluate cross-page navigation, and do not measure project-wide maintainability. We introduce MobileForge, the first benchmark for project-level multi-screen mobile app generation, comprising real mobile apps, human-reviewed screens, structured page-relationship annotations, and navigation test specifications. MobileForge supports five-axis evaluation of build, navigation, visual fidelity, code maintainability, and efficiency. We also propose state-isolated navigation testing to avoid cascading failures in navigation evaluation and an anchor-referenced list-wise visual evaluation protocol to improve visual-judge reliability. Across end-to-end runs on six frontier multimodal LLMs, current models can build mobile-app projects that compile and reach the correct pages, but interactive navigation remains unreliable and visual fidelity and maintainability still lag. The benchmark and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/anoa12159-hue/mobileforge_eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobileForge，据称是首个面向项目级多屏移动应用生成的基准，包含真实移动应用、人工审核的屏幕、页面关系标注和导航测试规范。基准支持构建、导航、视觉保真度、代码可维护性和效率五个维度的评估，并提出状态隔离导航测试与锚定参照的列表式视觉评估协议。在六个前沿多模态大语言模型上的端到端评测显示，当前模型能生成可编译并到达正确页面的项目，但交互式导航仍不可靠，视觉保真度和可维护性也存在差距。
Motivation: 现有设计到代码基准主要针对单页面生成，无法评估跨页面导航和项目级可维护性，而真实移动产品需要多个截图才能生成带共享组件和可用导航的完整代码库。
Method: 构建 MobileForge 基准，包含真实应用、页面关系标注和导航测试规范；提出状态隔离导航测试以避免级联失败，以及锚定参照的列表式视觉评估协议以提高视觉评判可靠性。
Result: 在六个前沿多模态大语言模型上的端到端运行中，模型可以构建可编译且能到达正确页面的移动应用项目，但交互式导航仍不可靠，视觉保真度和可维护性仍落后。
Conclusion: 摘要强调项目级多屏移动应用生成仍存在导航不可靠、视觉保真度和可维护性不足的问题，并公开了基准与支持材料。

papers.title: Seeing Differently: Modeling Interpretive Perspectives in Computational Creativity using a Four-World Framework
papers.abstract_en: Creativity in computational systems is often evaluated as an objective property of artifacts, with existing Computational Creativity (CC) frameworks assessing creative merit at the level of outputs or systems rather than interpretive context. However, artistic meaning is inherently perspective-dependent and can vary across viewers and critical traditions. This paper proposes a computational approach to modeling interpretive perspectives rather than treating creativity as a single measurable construct. The study adopts a twelve-trait creativity framework, organized across four conceptual domains, and operationalizes it through three evaluative personas: formalist, social-historical, and iconographic. Using 1,069 artworks from the SemArt dataset, the analysis generates 38,484 persona-based evaluations to examine how perspectives shape creativity assessment. Results show systematic divergence across perspectives, with traits such as Social Reflexivity exhibiting strong viewpoint sensitivity. Linear probing of CLIP image embeddings reveals that perspectives correspond to distinct orientation vectors in representation space, suggesting that creativity evaluation depends on which visual features become salient under each persona condition. These findings support a relational view of creativity and indicate that incorporating multiple evaluative perspectives could enable co-creative systems to support interpretively diverse human collaborators.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 17th International Conference on Computational Creativity (ICCC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算创造力（Computational Creativity）中把创造力当作客观属性来评估的惯例，提出从解释性视角（interpretive perspectives）建模艺术意义的方法。作者基于十二特质创造力框架，操作化为形式主义、社会历史、图像学三种评估人格（persona），对 SemArt 数据集中 1,069 件艺术品生成 38,484 条基于人格的评估，发现不同视角下创造力评价存在系统性分歧。对 CLIP 图像嵌入的线性探测显示，不同视角对应表征空间中的不同方向向量，暗示创造力评估取决于视角条件所凸显的视觉特征。
Motivation: 现有 CC 框架通常在输出或系统层面评估创造性，忽略艺术意义依赖观看者与批评传统的特性；创造力被视为单一可测量构造，缺乏对解释性语境（interpretive context）的建模。
Method: 采用跨四个概念域的十二特质创造力框架，通过形式主义、社会历史、图像学三种评估人格对 SemArt 数据集的 1,069 件艺术品进行自动化评估，并使用 CLIP 图像嵌入的线性探测（linear probing）分析不同视角对应的表征方向。
Result: 摘要报告 38,484 条人格评估显示不同视角之间存在系统性分歧，其中 Social Reflexivity 等特质对视角高度敏感；线性探测表明视角对应表征空间中的不同方向向量。
Conclusion: 研究支持创造力的关系性视角（relational view），并指出融入多种评估视角可帮助协同创造系统（co-creative systems）支持解释性多样的人类协作者。
Relevance: 3
