papers.title: ThinkReset: Learnable Intermediate Interface Construction for Bounded-Context Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves performance on complex problems, but it also introduces redundancy accumulation, context overflow, and error anchoring. We argue that under bounded context windows, the core bottleneck is not trajectory compression or test-time control, but the absence of a reusable intermediate interface that can replace discarded history and support continued solving. We further identify a key failure mode of outcome-reward-driven long-chain reinforcement learning: when the model has not solved the task before the window is nearly exhausted, the final-answer reward encourages premature guessing rather than continued careful reasoning. We propose ThinkReset, a text-space instantiation of this view. ThinkReset explicitly constructs reusable intermediate interfaces through interface writeback and reset, and directly optimizes post-reset continuation success. Across multiple long-horizon reasoning benchmarks, this perspective consistently improves success rates under fixed context windows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出在有限上下文窗口中，长链思维推理（long chain-of-thought reasoning）的主要瓶颈并非轨迹压缩或测试时控制，而是缺乏可复用的中间接口来替代被丢弃的历史并支持继续求解。作者提出 ThinkReset，一种文本空间实现，通过接口回写（interface writeback）与重置显式构造可复用中间接口，并直接优化重置后继续求解的成功率。在多个长时程推理基准上，该方法在固定上下文窗口下稳定提升成功率。
Motivation: 长链思维虽提升复杂问题性能，但带来冗余积累、上下文溢出和错误锚定（error anchoring）。作者还指出结果奖励驱动的长链强化学习存在关键失败模式：在窗口即将耗尽时，最终答案奖励会鼓励模型提前猜测而非继续谨慎推理。
Method: 提出 ThinkReset，在文本空间显式构造可复用的中间接口，通过接口回写与重置来替代被丢弃的历史，并直接针对重置后的连续求解成功率进行优化。
Result: 摘要报告在多个长时程推理基准上，ThinkReset 在固定上下文窗口下一致地提升了成功率。
Conclusion: 作者认为核心瓶颈是可复用中间接口的缺失，并以该视角设计文本空间的解决方案；其主张在长时程推理任务中获得验证，但摘要未讨论具体基准名称、量化增益或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Formalism Trap: Are LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluators Blinded by Consensus Mimicry under Social Load?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the \textit{Agentic Formalism Trap} and the Evaluative Dissonance Index ($D_E$), quantifying how LLM-as-a-Judge systems conflate structural proceduralism with semantic truth under adversarial load. Analyzing 22,500 trajectories across 3 domains (GAIA, SWE-bench, Multi-Challenge), we extract a semantic taxonomy of hallucination maneuvers, validated via deterministic lexical grounding ($p < 10^{-120}$). A logistic meta-evaluator isolates the exact syntactic triggers of this evaluator capture (ROC-AUC 0.8779), while a zero-shot Leave-One-Domain-Out transfer proves the vulnerability is universally domain-agnostic (mean ROC-AUC 0.7482). Architectural profiling reveals that distinct simulated swarm topologies induce mathematically disparate semantic blind spots, proving that unanchored closed-loop evaluation is unstable, systemically divergent and necessitates architecture-specific vigilance filters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Formalism Trap（智能体形式主义陷阱）概念与 Evaluative Dissonance Index（D_E，评估失调指数），用以量化 LLM-as-a-Judge 系统在对抗性社会负荷下把结构化程序性（proceduralism）误当作语义正确性的倾向。作者分析 GAIA、SWE-bench、Multi-Challenge 三个领域的 22,500 条轨迹，提取幻觉手法（hallucination maneuvers）的语义分类，并通过确定性词汇基准确认（p < 10^-120）。结果表明这种评估器捕获（evaluator capture）具有领域无关的普适性，且不同模拟蜂群拓扑（swarm topologies）会产生数学上不同的语义盲区。
Motivation: 现有 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估在对抗性负载下可能混淆表面程序化与真实语义正确性，作者希望量化并定位这种“形式主义陷阱”，证明无锚定的闭环评估（unanchored closed-loop evaluation）不稳定且系统性发散。
Method: 引入 Agentic Formalism Trap 与 Evaluative Dissonance Index（D_E）；基于跨 3 域的 22,500 条轨迹提取幻觉手法的语义分类并用确定性词汇基准确认；通过 logistic meta-evaluator 隔离触发评估器捕获的精确句法触发器；使用 zero-shot Leave-One-Domain-Out 迁移验证领域无关性，并对不同模拟蜂群拓扑做架构剖析。
Result: logistic meta-evaluator 定位精确句法触发器的 ROC-AUC 为 0.8779；zero-shot 跨域迁移的平均 ROC-AUC 为 0.7482，表明该漏洞与领域无关；架构剖析显示不同 swarm 拓扑产生数学上不同的语义盲点。
Conclusion: 作者强调无锚定的闭环评估是不稳定且系统性发散的，需要针对具体架构的警戒过滤器（architecture-specific vigilance filters）来应对此类评估器捕获。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should generate consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images, resulting in sequences where visual tokens are interleaved with text tokens. Based on TokenSwap, we transform existing text-based benchmarks such as MMLU into image-interleaved counterparts, resulting in TokenSwap-Bench. Across 42 MLLMs, we observe a pervasive modality gap, with performance decreasing by 4.2% to 47.4% when moving from text-only to image-interleaved inputs, averaging 19.6% +/- 3.3% across models. Notably, we observe that reasoning models exhibit consistently smaller gaps, achieving an average gap of 10.1% compared to 25.5% for non-reasoning models. In contrast, neither prompting strategies nor scaling training compute alone reliably reduces the modality gap. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating TokenSwap during training effectively mitigates this gap while preserving strong text-only and vision-language performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在语义等价的文本与多模态输入下预测不一致的问题，定义了模态差距（modality gap），并提出 TokenSwap 方法将文本概念替换为语义对齐的图像，从而构建文本与视觉 token 交错的输入序列。基于该方法，作者将 MMLU 等文本基准转换为图像交错版本 TokenSwap-Bench，并在 42 个 MLLM 上系统评测，观察到普遍的模态差距。结果表明，在训练中纳入 TokenSwap 可以有效缓解这一差距，同时保持纯文本与视觉语言性能。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型对语义等价的跨模态输入应给出一致响应，但实际存在系统性预测偏差；目前缺乏对这种模态差距的量化基准与可靠的缓解手段。
Method: 提出 TokenSwap 方法，将文本概念替换为语义对齐的图像，生成视觉 token 与文本 token 交错的序列；并基于此将现有文本基准（如 MMLU）转换为图像交错版本 TokenSwap-Bench，以测量模型在纯文本与多模态输入下的性能差异。
Result: 在 42 个 MLLM 上，从纯文本到图像交错输入的性能下降范围为 4.2% 到 47.4%，平均为 19.6%±3.3%；推理模型（reasoning models）的平均差距为 10.1%，而非推理模型为 25.5%；仅靠提示策略或扩展训练计算无法可靠缩小模态差距。
Conclusion: 作者展示在训练过程中纳入 TokenSwap 能有效缓解模态差距，并保持模型在纯文本和视觉语言任务上的性能；该工作为评估和减少多模态大语言模型的模态差距提供了基准与方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Asymmetric Effects of Knowledge Distillation on Bias in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We show that knowledge distillation in small instruction-tuned language models has asymmetric effects on bias. On unambiguous tasks (BBQ-disambig), response-based distillation from a Gemma-2-9B teacher improves context-following: for the most biased baseline (SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct), it cuts the context-overriding error rate from 44% to 24%. On ambiguous tasks (BBQ-ambig), the same distillation destroys per-item refusal calibration: 15% of items where the baseline correctly abstained instead receive stereotype answers, even when overall refusal rate is preserved. The pattern reproduces on a second student family (OLMo-2-1B-Instruct), with silence-loss of 8% and filled-silence accounting for 89% of new bias. Across the full 28-configuration grid, the magnitudes of silence-loss and filled-silence are uncorrelated (Spearman $ρ=0.19$, n.s.), indicating that the two effects arise from distinct mechanisms. Aggregate stereotype metrics (CrowS-Pairs, overall BBQ Stereotype Reliance Score) average over both effects and conceal the per-item harm. We trace the calibration loss to a data-side mechanism: an audit of four training corpora finds <0.5% refusal-as-answer-shape. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with refusal injection either breaks parsing or over-corrects into a trivial-refuser regime (refusal rate 99.8%, disambig accuracy 0.2%) that aggregate metrics would call perfectly calibrated. We propose Per-Condition Calibration Diagnosis (PCCD), a three-step protocol that evaluates refusal calibration, context-following, and capability preservation. PCCD catches both the asymmetric harm and the trivial-refuser failure mode that aggregate evaluations miss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证了知识蒸馏对小指令微调语言模型偏见的影响是非对称的：在无歧义任务 (BBQ-disambig) 上，Gemma-2-9B 教师的响应式蒸馏将最偏基线 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 的上下文覆盖错误率从 44% 降到 24%；而在歧义任务 (BBQ-ambig) 上，同一蒸馏破坏了逐项拒绝校准，原本正确弃权的 15% 项目转而给出刻板答案。该模式在 OLMo-2-1B-Instruct 上复现，且两种效应幅度不相关，提示不同机制。作者提出 Per-Condition Calibration Diagnosis (PCCD) 协议来同时捕捉这两种失败模式。
Motivation: 现有聚合偏见指标（如 CrowS-Pairs、整体 BBQ Stereotype Reliance Score）会平均掉蒸馏对偏见的相反方向影响，掩盖逐项伤害；同时蒸馏可能造成拒绝校准破坏或退化为平凡拒绝者，这些问题需要专门诊断。
Method: 提出 PCCD 三步协议，评估拒绝校准、上下文跟随和 capability 保持；并对四个训练语料进行审计，发现拒绝作为答案形状的比例低于 0.5%，将校准损失追溯到数据侧机制。
Result: BBQ-disambig 上上下文覆盖错误率从 44% 降至 24%；BBQ-ambig 上 15% 本应弃权的项目变为刻板答案。OLMo-2-1B 上 silence-loss 为 8%，filled-silence 占新偏见的 89%。全 28 配置网格中两种效应 Spearman ρ=0.19（不显著）。SFT 注入拒绝会导致平凡拒绝者模式（拒绝率 99.8%，disambig 准确率 0.2%）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调聚合度量会同时掩盖非对称偏见伤害和平凡拒绝者失败模式，而 PCCD 能捕捉这两类问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Stateful Predictive Knowledge From Experience
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly learn from experience, they primarily rely on trajectory-level reflection to extract insights. Viewed through the lens of predictive knowledge, we argue that this approach operates on episodic hindsight rather than predictive foresight, yielding brittle, path-dependent heuristics. To address this, we propose Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL). SKL shifts the agent's focus from trajectory-level summarization to maintaining Stateful Knowledge: explicit, declarative predictive assessments anchored to state. We first demonstrate a motivating example showing how stateful knowledge provides granularity, enhances generalization, and enables knowledge bootstrapping. To further scale up the idea, we introduce two algorithms via self-distillation (SKL-SD) and reinforcement learning (SKL-RL), training agents to autonomously extract state-grounded predictive knowledge from experience and learn to leverage it for policy making. Experiments on interactive environments (WebShop, ScienceWorld) and a complex reasoning task (ChessPuzzles) demonstrate that equipping models with the inherent ability to learn stateful predictive knowledge significantly outpaces current reflection-based training paradigms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL)，将 LLM 智能体从基于轨迹级反思的经验学习转向基于状态的预测性知识维护。作者通过自蒸馏 (SKL-SD) 和强化学习 (SKL-RL) 两种算法训练智能体从经验中自主提取状态锚定的预测性知识并用于决策。实验在 WebShop、ScienceWorld 和 ChessPuzzles 三个任务上表明，该方法显著优于现有基于反思的训练范式。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体从经验中学习主要依赖轨迹级反思，作者认为这本质上是情节性事后视角 (episodic hindsight) 而非预测性前瞻 (predictive foresight)，容易产生脆弱且路径依赖的启发式规则。
Method: SKL 维护显式的、声明式的、锚定于状态 (state) 的预测性评估知识；进一步提出两种扩展算法，即通过自蒸馏 (SKL-SD) 和强化学习 (SKL-RL)，使智能体自主提取状态基础预测知识并将其用于策略制定。
Result: 在交互式环境 (WebShop、ScienceWorld) 和复杂推理任务 (ChessPuzzles) 上的实验表明，具备学习状态预测性知识能力的模型明显超过当前基于反思的训练范式。
Conclusion: 作者认为将学习重点从轨迹级总结转向状态锚定的预测性知识，可提供更细粒度、更强的泛化能力并支持知识引导 (knowledge bootstrapping)。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体从经验中学习主要依赖轨迹级反思，作者认为这本质上是情节性事后视角 (episodic hindsight) 而非预测性前瞻 (predictive foresight)，容易产生脆弱且路径依赖的启发式规则。
summary_sections.method: SKL 维护显式的、声明式的、锚定于状态 (state) 的预测性评估知识；进一步提出两种扩展算法，即通过自蒸馏 (SKL-SD) 和强化学习 (SKL-RL)，使智能体自主提取状态基础预测知识并将其用于策略制定。
summary_sections.result: 在交互式环境 (WebShop、ScienceWorld) 和复杂推理任务 (ChessPuzzles) 上的实验表明，具备学习状态预测性知识能力的模型明显超过当前基于反思的训练范式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将学习重点从轨迹级总结转向状态锚定的预测性知识，可提供更细粒度、更强的泛化能力并支持知识引导 (knowledge bootstrapping)。

papers.title: Imbalanced Data Clustering via Targeted Data Augmentation Using GMM and LLM
papers.abstract_en: In Natural Language Processing (NLP), dealing with underrepresented topics is challenging, especially in unsupervised tasks where clustering might not adequately capture minority topics. To tackle this challenge, our paper presents a novel unsupervised data augmentation method that integrates Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs). Due to their flexibility and robustness, GMMs can detect clusters corresponding to underrepresented areas in the data, while LLMs create synthetic documents to enrich these clusters and improve their representation. Experiments on various imbalanced text datasets demonstrate that our approach preserves clustering performance in all cases and often enhances cluster interpretability, offering a robust and scalable solution for improving data representation in unsupervised NLP tasks.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Intelligent Data Analysis: 23rd International Symposium on Intelligent Data Analysis; IDA 2025; Proceedings; pp 246-260
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 NLP 无监督聚类中少数主题（minority topics）表示不足的问题，提出一种结合高斯混合模型（GMM）和大型语言模型（LLM）的无监督数据增强方法。GMM 用于检测数据中代表性不足的簇，LLM 则生成合成文档以丰富这些簇。在不平衡文本数据集上的实验显示，该方法在所有情况下保持聚类性能，并常常提升聚类可解释性。
Motivation: 无监督聚类在处理 NLP 中代表性不足的主题时存在困难，少数主题可能无法被聚类充分捕捉，需要一种无需监督信号的数据增强手段来改善这些簇的表示。
Method: 提出将 GMM 与 LLM 集成的无监督数据增强方法：利用 GMM 的灵活性和稳健性识别对应于数据中欠表示区域的簇，再由 LLM 生成合成文档加入这些簇以增强其表示。
Result: 在多个不平衡文本数据集上的实验表明，该方法在所有情况下都保持原有聚类性能，并常常提升聚类的可解释性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法为改善无监督 NLP 任务中的数据表示提供了稳健且可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Can LLMs Really Understand Item Difficulty Levels? Implications for Automated Item Generation Using LLMs
papers.abstract_en: The estimation of item difficulty plays a key role in both formative assessment and large-scale high-stakes summative assessments. This study explores how large language models (LLMs) perform in predicting item difficulty levels using items from a large-scale Reading and Writing test. The study investigated various prompting strategies and parameter settings across multiple LLMs. LLM performance was compared with encoder-only language models and feature-based supervised machine learning models. Zero-shot GPT-4.1 with a temperature of 0 yielded the highest item difficulty level prediction accuracy, with a quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) of 0.578. However, LLMs' prediction accuracy was lower than that of ConvBERT (QWK = 0.625), which outperformed the best feature-based supervised machine learning model. Further analysis showed that all LLMs struggled to label hard items; in particular, the current advanced GPT-5.4 tended to underestimate item difficulty levels. Dimension reduction of embeddings showed that item embeddings from different difficulty levels were mixed together, indicating that semantic information from items alone is likely insufficient for item difficulty level prediction. The findings suggest that if LLMs cannot understand item difficulty levels as evidenced by empirical data and tend to treat most items as easy when their own capabilities increase, caution should be exercised when using LLMs to generate items with targeted difficulty levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在预测试题难度水平上的表现，使用大规模阅读与写作测试题目，比较多种提示策略和参数设置，并与 encoder-only 语言模型和基于特征的监督机器学习模型进行对比。零样本 GPT-4.1（temperature=0）取得最高的 LLM 预测准确率，二次加权 kappa（QWK）为 0.578，但仍低于 ConvBERT（QWK=0.625）；进一步分析显示所有 LLM 都难以标注难题，且 GPT-5.4 倾向于低估题目难度。嵌入降维表明不同难度水平的语义信息相互混合，说明仅凭语义信息不足以预测难度水平。
Motivation: 题目难度估计在形成性评估和大规模高风险总结性评估中起关键作用，但 LLM 是否真正理解题目难度水平缺乏实证检验，因此需要系统评估其预测能力。
Method: 使用来自大规模阅读与写作测试的题目，跨多个 LLM 探索不同提示策略和参数设置，并将 LLM 性能与 encoder-only 语言模型及基于特征的监督机器学习模型比较；同时通过嵌入降维分析题目难度与语义信息的关系。
Result: 零样本 GPT-4.1（temperature=0）达到最高的题目难度水平预测准确率（QWK=0.578），但低于 ConvBERT（QWK=0.625），后者也优于最佳基于特征的监督学习模型；所有 LLM 均难以正确标注难题，GPT-5.4 尤其趋于低估难度，嵌入降维显示不同难度水平的语义信息混在一起。
Conclusion: 实证数据表明 LLM 并未真正理解题目难度水平，且随着自身能力提升倾向于把多数题目视为简单，因此使用 LLM 生成指定难度水平的题目时应保持谨慎。

papers.title: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
papers.abstract_en: Disaggregated LLM inference creates a datacenter networking problem that no existing system solves correctly. When prefill and decode run on separate GPU pools, the KV cache must be transferred between them. For a 70B model this is 2.6 GB per request, exceeding 100 GB/s aggregate at production scale. Yet DistServe, Splitwise, and Mooncake all use uniform RDMA, ignoring that bandwidth between two GPUs varies by 72x depending on their physical relationship: 900 GB/s via NVLink within a domain, 50 GB/s via InfiniBand across nodes, 12.5 GB/s via TCP across data centers. We design a topology-aware transfer orchestrator that discovers interconnect hierarchy at startup and selects optimal transport per transfer. Three mechanisms work together: (1) pipelined layer-by-layer transfer that overlaps transmission with ongoing prefill, hiding 60 to 85 percent of latency behind computation; (2) NVLink domain-aware placement for Mixture-of-Experts models that co-optimizes expert dispatch with KV cache locality; and (3) CXL 3.0 memory expanders as a shared overflow tier providing 6x capacity at 86x lower latency than NVMe. Full evaluation requires multi-node clusters with heterogeneous interconnects and CXL 3.0 hardware that is beyond academic resources and not yet available in GPU clouds. We present analytical bandwidth models, component implementations, and projected analysis across three architectures showing 3 to 18x transfer latency reduction over uniform RDMA.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. To be submitted for a systems conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分解式 LLM 推理中 KV cache 在 prefill 与 decode GPU 池之间传输的难题，提出一种拓扑感知的传输编排器，在启动时发现互连层次并为每次传输选择最优路径。摘要报告该设计相比统一 RDMA 可将传输延迟降低 3 至 18 倍，并给出了解析带宽模型、组件实现与投影分析。
Motivation: 现有 DistServe、Splitwise、Mooncake 等分解式推理系统均采用统一 RDMA 传输，忽略了 GPU 间物理互连的带宽差异（NVLink 域内 900 GB/s、跨节点 InfiniBand 50 GB/s、跨数据中心 TCP 12.5 GB/s，相差约 72 倍）。对于 70B 模型，每请求需传输 2.6 GB KV cache，生产规模下超过 100 GB/s 聚合带宽，成为数据中心网络瓶颈。
Method: 提出拓扑感知传输编排器，启动时发现互连层次并按传输选择最优传输协议，包含三个协同机制：逐层流水线传输以重叠 prefill 计算并隐藏 60% 至 85% 延迟；面向 MoE 模型的 NVLink 域感知放置，联合优化专家分发与 KV cache 局部性；以及将 CXL 3.0 内存扩展器作为共享溢出层，相比 NVMe 提供 6 倍容量且延迟低 86 倍。
Result: 由于完整评估需要具备异构互连与 CXL 3.0 硬件的多节点集群，而此类资源超出学术机构且 GPU 云尚未提供，论文以解析带宽模型、组件实现和对三种架构的投影分析为主，结果显示传输延迟相比统一 RDMA 降低 3 至 18 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调全量实际评估仍受限于缺乏 CXL 3.0 等异构硬件环境，目前成果以可部署的组件实现与投影分析支撑所提出的拓扑感知传输方案。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LLM Framework for Discovering Major Mathematical Conjectures: AI's Quest for the Next Riemann Hypothesis
papers.abstract_en: Major mathematical conjectures still depend heavily on expert intuition, so a unified method for the systematic generation and validation of conjectures with substantial mathematical potential remains unavailable. We present a three stage pipeline for major conjecture discovery, with region search from explicit local evidence modules, reflective validation for foundationality, novelty, and potential significance, and formal validation in Lean 4 and Mathlib. The objective is the discovery of mathematical problems with high problem taste, namely problems whose proofs could reorganize the language of a research area and provide durable help to human mathematical research. Experiments on twenty candidates showstable passage from natural language to formal checks, with twenty out of twenty candidates passing Lean parsing and type checking, twenty out of twenty candidates not directly absorbed by exact?,twenty out of twenty candidates not automatically discharged by aesop, and no explicit duplicates or near duplicates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三阶段流水线，用于自动发现和验证重大数学猜想：先通过显式局部证据模块进行区域搜索（region search），再进行反思性验证（reflective validation）评估基础性、新颖性和潜在重要性，最后在 Lean 4 和 Mathlib 中进行形式化验证。目标是发现具有高“问题品味”（problem taste）的数学问题，其证明可能重组研究领域语言并为人类数学研究提供持久帮助。在 20 个候选上的实验显示全部通过 Lean 解析和类型检查，20/20 未被 exact? 直接吸收，20/20 未被 aesop 自动处理，且没有显式重复或近似重复。
Motivation: 重大数学猜想仍严重依赖专家直觉，缺少一种统一的、能够系统化生成并验证具有实质数学潜力猜想的方法。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：区域搜索（region search）从显式局部证据模块中寻找候选，反思性验证（reflective validation）检查基础性、新颖性和潜在意义，形式化验证在 Lean 4 和 Mathlib 中完成从自然语言到形式化检查的转换。
Result: 在 20 个候选上，20/20 通过 Lean 解析和类型检查，20/20 未被 exact? 直接吸收，20/20 未被 aesop 自动消解，且没有出现显式重复或近似重复，表明从自然语言到形式化检查的通道稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能够稳定生成并形式化验证具有高问题品味的数学猜想，为系统化发现重大数学猜想提供了可能路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can AI Evaluate AI Scientists? A Benchmarking Study of Autonomous Research Generation Systems Using Automated Multi-Model Review
papers.abstract_en: AI Scientist systems capable of autonomous research have the potential to significantly accelerate scientific discovery. However, evaluating and comparing the quality of AI-generated papers remains an open challenge. We propose and implement a rigorous benchmarking protocol using an automated peer-review system that harnesses frontier large language models to assess scientific papers across four core dimensions: originality, scientific rigor, clarity, and significance. We evaluate four leading AI Scientist frameworks: \textit{Sakana AI (v1 & v2)}, \textit{CycleResearcher}, and \textit{Data-to-Paper}. Each framework was run on a consistent set of 15 research proposals published by a commercial autonomous AI scientist company (FARS), generating 60 papers that we evaluate alongside 15 FARS benchmark papers. Using three independent LLM reviewers (GPT-5.4, Gemini, and Claude), we find that FARS benchmark papers significantly outperform all competing frameworks, achieving mean scores of 2.14--2.47 on a 1--5 scale compared to 1.00--1.87 for other systems. Notably, FARS scores are more than 2$\times$ higher than the next-best systems on Gemini and Claude evaluations. We find strong agreement among Gemini and Claude ($ρ$ = 0.907, $p < 0.001$), and both correlate extremely strongly with the synthesis score ($ρ$ = 0.961, $p < 0.001$), validating the reliability of automated evaluation. However, GPT-5.4 exhibits weaker agreement ($ρ\approx 0.32$), suggesting it evaluates papers using different criteria. These results establish the first quantitative benchmark for AI Scientist systems and demonstrate that multi-model LLM evaluation provides a scalable, consistent framework for assessing autonomous research quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自动化多模型同行评审协议，用于评估四个 AI Scientist 框架（Sakana AI v1/v2、CycleResearcher、Data-to-Paper）与 FARS 基准论文。使用 GPT-5.4、Gemini、Claude 三个 LLM 评审者在原创性、科学严谨性、清晰度和重要性四个维度上对 75 篇论文评分，发现 FARS 论文显著优于其他框架，且 Gemini 与 Claude 的评审高度一致。
Motivation: AI Scientist 系统有潜力加速科学发现，但 AI 生成论文的质量评估与系统间比较仍缺乏统一基准，现有方法难以规模化、一致地评判自主研究质量。
Method: 构建基于前沿大语言模型的自动化同行评审协议，在固定 15 个研究提案上运行四个框架生成 60 篇论文，并连同 15 篇 FARS 基准论文一起，用三个独立 LLM 评审者按四个核心维度打分。
Result: FARS 基准论文的平均分为 2.14–2.47（1–5 分制），显著高于其他系统的 1.00–1.87；在 Gemini 和 Claude 评审下 FARS 得分是次优系统的两倍以上。Gemini 与 Claude 评分一致性为 ρ=0.907（p<0.001），二者与综合评分的相关性为 ρ=0.961（p<0.001），而 GPT-5.4 与其他评审者一致性较弱（ρ≈0.32）。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了 AI Scientist 系统的首个定量基准，表明多模型 LLM 评审可提供可扩展且一致的自主研究质量评估；但 GPT-5.4 的评审标准分歧提示评审者选择会影响评估结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Scaffolding Critical Engagement with GenAI: Transforming Ethnic Minority Preparatory Students' Collaborative Discourse in Prompt Engineering Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (GenAI) holds significant promise for advancing educational equity among ethnic minority students by broadening access to learning resources and mitigating linguistic barriers. However, these benefits are counterbalanced by the risk of cognitive laziness, whereby students may treat GenAI as an answer engine or shortcut rather than as a partner in thinking. This design-based research investigated how pedagogical scaffolding can shift students from passive consumption to critical co-creation with GenAI. The study involved 78 ethnic minority preparatory students in China participating in a three-week GenAI course that integrated a human-in-the-loop workflow and teacher modeling with contrasting cases to disrupt uncritical reliance on GenAI. We employed epistemic network analysis to examine collaborative discourse, thematic analysis to analyze student reflections, and paired-samples t-tests to assess changes in prompt self-efficacy. Results revealed a phenomenon of strategic repurposing: initially, students instrumentalized strategy talk to coordinate efficient copying; however, after the intervention, they realigned strategic planning to scaffold critical evaluation and peer co-construction. Qualitative findings further indicated that the teacher's scaffolding helped students overcome their initial authority bias and prompt paralysis, repositioning themselves as active gatekeepers of AI-generated content; these shifts were corroborated by a significant increase in students' prompt self-efficacy. The study suggests that, particularly for ethnic minority students, technical training alone is insufficient; educators should design targeted pedagogical interventions around human-AI collaboration to prevent cognitive complacency and cultivate epistemic agency.
papers.comment: Accepted as a full paper by the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一项设计型研究（design-based research），针对少数民族预科学生将生成式AI（GenAI）当作“答案引擎”而非思维伙伴的认知惰性风险，设计了三周GenAI课程，整合人机协同工作流（human-in-the-loop workflow）与教师建模和对比案例（contrasting cases）。78名学生参与，通过认知网络分析、主题分析和配对样本t检验发现，学生的策略性谈话从“协调复制”转向“批判性评估与同伴共建”，提示自我效能显著提升。作者认为仅靠技术培训不足，需要围绕人机协作设计针对性教学干预。
Motivation: GenAI有望通过扩大学习资源和缓解语言障碍促进少数民族学生的教育公平，但存在认知惰性风险：学生可能将其视为答案引擎或捷径而非思考伙伴。论文旨在通过教学脚手架（pedagogical scaffolding）促使学生从被动消费转向与GenAI的批判性共同创造。
Method: 采用设计型研究方法，在78名中国少数民族预科学生的三周GenAI课程中，引入人机协同工作流和教师建模与对比案例，以打破对GenAI的盲目依赖。分析手段包括认知网络分析（epistemic network analysis）处理协作话语、主题分析处理学生反思，以及配对样本t检验评估提示自我效能（prompt self-efficacy）的变化。
Result: 发现“战略性重定向”（strategic repurposing）现象：干预前学生将策略性谈话用于协调高效复制，干预后策略规划重新指向批判性评估和同伴共建。质性结果表明教师脚手架帮助学生克服权威偏见和提示性瘫痪，并主动把关AI生成内容；统计结果支持学生提示自我效能的显著提升。
Conclusion: 作者提出，尤其对于少数民族学生，仅提供技术训练是不够的；教育者应围绕人机协作设计针对性的教学干预，以防止认知自满并培养认知能动性（epistemic agency）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenClaw and Ollama in Agentic AI: Toward Fully Autonomous and Scalable AI Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: The rapid transition from reactive large language models (LLMs) to persistent, action-capable systems has exposed critical gaps in the architectural understanding of Agentic AI, particularly in separating inference, orchestration, and execution layers for autonomous AI agents. Despite recent advances, unified frameworks for designing and evaluating full-stack agentic systems remain limited. This paper presents a comprehensive, layered architecture for Agentic AI, outlining the evolution from reactive LLM interfaces to persistent, goal-driven autonomous AI agents with memory, planning, and continuous execution. We analyze OpenClaw and Ollama as a full-stack Agentic AI system, where Ollama serves as the LLM inference layer and OpenClaw enables agent runtime orchestration, integrating reasoning, tool use, and action execution. A prototype experimental validation of the OpenClaw-Ollama architecture demonstrates that capabilities such as persistent memory, tool utilization, and adaptive decision-making emerge from system-level integration rather than standalone models, with performance improving consistently as architectural complexity increases. The study further examines challenges in scalability, security, privacy, governance, and evaluation of agentic systems, highlighting the need for robust benchmarking and system-level design. Future directions include scalable multi-agent architectures, distributed autonomous systems, and human-aware Agentic AI frameworks for responsible deployment. Overall, this work establishes a unified architectural foundation for Agentic AI, validates the effectiveness of full-stack autonomous AI agents, and provides a roadmap for building scalable, secure, and trustworthy agentic systems. All models, code, and datasets are publicly released to support reproducibility and benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个分层的 Agentic AI 架构，将自主智能体系统划分为推理 (inference)、编排 (orchestration) 与执行 (execution) 层，并以 OpenClaw 作为 agent 运行时编排层、Ollama 作为 LLM 推理层，构成全栈式原型系统。摘要称原型实验显示持久记忆、工具使用与自适应决策等能力来自系统级集成而非独立模型，且随架构复杂度提升而一致改进。文章还讨论可扩展性、安全、隐私、治理与评测挑战，并公开模型、代码与数据集以支持复现。
Motivation: 从反应式 LLM 到持久、可行动系统的转变暴露出 Agentic AI 架构理解的缺口，尤其是推理、编排与执行层的分离问题；统一的全栈式 agentic 系统设计与评测框架仍然有限。
Method: 提出一个分层 Agentic AI 全栈架构，并以 Ollama 作为 LLM 推理层、OpenClaw 作为 agent 运行时编排层进行原型实现，集成推理、工具使用与动作执行，并通过原型实验验证该架构。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明持久记忆、工具利用与自适应决策等能力源于系统级集成而非独立模型，且性能随架构复杂度增加而一致提升。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为 Agentic AI 的统一架构基础，验证了全栈自主 agent 的有效性，并指出未来方向包括可扩展多智能体架构、分布式自主系统以及面向人的 (human-aware) 负责任部署框架，同时强调需要稳健的基准评测与系统级设计。
Relevance: 0
